tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 2 gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas stsal ba'i bka' slob phyogs bsdebs

tei:div.tei:p: gleng brjod/༄༅༅// srid zhi'i 'dren mchog 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchog nas/ phyi lo 1959 nas 1999 bar btsan byol bod mi ser skya rgan gzhon rnams la 'phral yun gyi blang dor lam ston bka' slob rmongs mun sel ba'i sgron me dang / yid gdung sel ba'i bdud rtsi/ 'dod rgu 'grub pa'i nor bu lta bu shin tu rtsa che mtha' yas pa zhig stsal ba'i khongs nas/ rgya che'i ser skya mang tshogs la bka' slob stsal ba khag khe gtsang phyogs bsdebs/ pod gnyis pa/ 'di dag sku sgor yig tshang gi bod yig sde tshan nas phyogs sgrig dang / skyid grong gra 'bar ru 'og skal bzang phun tshogs kyis /ma pu ṭar nang 'god 'jug gis deb gzugs par gzhi bskrun/rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags 'brug bod zla 1 tshes 14 nyin 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang rtsepho brang po ta lar 7rgyal mchog sku phreng gong rim gyi gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus te mi lo drug cu tham pa 'khor ba dang / lcags stag bod zla 10 tshes 8 nyin 7gong sa mchog gis bod rgyal khab kyi lugs zung chab srid thugs khur bzhes nas mi lo lnga bcu tham pa 'khor bar bod 'bangs yongs nas bka' drin rjes

dran zhu ba'i dus tshigs khyad par can dang bstun te/ bod gzhung phyi dril las khungs nas par bskrun 'grems spel zhus pa lags na/ rgya che'i rang rigs ser skya mang tshogs rnams nas snying du bcangs 'os 7rgyal ba'i bka' slob dgongs don khag la slob sbyong nyams len tshul bzhin gnang ste/ rang rang 'di phyi'i bde thabs 'chug med sgrub pa dang chabs cig snga dus shar glinga.e sha ya'i nang snyan grags ldan pa'i rlabs chen bod rgyal khab dang / bod mi rigs/ zab cing rgya che'i chos dang rig gzhung bcas pa mi nyams dar rgyas yun gnas yong ched lhag bsam blo rtsal zung 'brel gyis 'bad brtson che bskyed yong ba'i re skul bcas/bod rgyal lo 2127 rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags 'brug zla 5 tshes 23phyi yo 2000 zla 7 tshes 24 la//
me ḍi san du.a snge rdeng / khe na ḍar gnas 'khod bod mi ser skya nyis brgya lnga bcu skor la stsal ba'i bka' slob/
gnas mchog rdo je gdan du bod nas ched bcar bod mi bdun stong brgal bar stsal ba'i bka' slob/
skreglo smre —skaje byashe chon chos gling gtsug lag khrang du lam rim chen i gsu+ong chos grub nyin tsho ba'i bka' slab/
rme ri lo sirmen ji li sir dus 'khor dbang chen zhu bar bcar ba'i bod mi mang tshogs la bka' slob stsal ba/
rme ri lo sirmen ji li sir dus 'khor dbang chen zhu bar bcar ba'i bod mi mang tshogs la bka' slob stsal ba/
u ru su'i rgyal sa rme+o—ོ smrekoramimang chig stong brgal ba'i mang tshogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1979 zla 7 tshes 22 nyin sud sir sku'i 'khrungs skar skabs stsal ba'i bka' slob/da lta 'dir nga rang sto bod rigs ser skya rgan byis tsho dang / sku mgron rnam pa phebs pa khyed rang tsho tshang ma'i thog la zhu rgyur/ da ring 'dir nga'i skyes tshes kyi thog la khyed rang tsho 'dzoms/ 'di'i thog la ched mngags sku mgron rnam pa kha shas shig phebs pa la ha cang dga' po byung / khyed rang tsho tshang mar thugs rje che zhes zhu gi yod/ nga'i skyes tshes ngo ma de phyi 7 tshes ca dang /bod zla 5 tshes 5 red/ da ring 'dir sud si la bod pa tsho 'dzoms rgyu dang / nga'i dus tshod stabs bstun gyis da ring tshes 22 'khel ba red/khyed rang tsho tshang mas nga rang sger gyi thog la dga' po dang / sems thag nye po'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa la dga' po byung / nga rang chos pa red/ khyed rang tsho tshang mar bya ba lam 'gro yong ba dang / sems la bde skyid yong ba'i smon lam zhu gi yin/ nga'i lo hril po byas pa yin na/ bzhi bcu zhe bzhi dang / bzhi bcu zhe lnga'i sgang la phyogs par slebs pa red/ 'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhi lhag gi ring la lo nyi shu rtsa lnga nas/ bzhi bcu zhe grangs kyi bar de mi tshe'i nang gi dus skabs bzang shos dang / rtsa ba che shos chags bsdad yod pa red/ de 'dra'i dus chod bzang shos de'i ring rang gi 'dod pa'i cha nas byas na rang gi lung pa'i nang rgya che'i mi mang de dag la chos srid gnyis kyi thog nas zhabs 'degs phun sum tshogs pa zhig bsgrub thub na bsam pa'i re ba yod na yang /so so'i las dang bsod nams dang / spyi mthun gyi rkyen mang po zhig gi dbang 1

gis rang gi lung pa bral nas mi'i lung par sdod dgos pa zhig dang / rang gi lung pa'i na nga gi bod mi tsho da /'a sdug mang po myong dgos pa/ bod mi tsho khag gcig mi'i lung pa sna tshogs shig gi nang la 'khyar nas sdod dgos pa zhig chags pa red/ yin na'ang nga rang tsho tshang mas drang po drang bzhag dang / bden pa bden thub kyi bsam blo gtong gi yod pa dang / bsam blo btang ba nang bzhin lag len gyi thog la yang bsam pa rnam dag rgyab mdun ngo lkog med pa zhi ga byed kyi yod par brten/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bden pa la bden mtha' gsal rgyu yod pa zhig tan tan red/ da phan lo nyi shu tham pa 'di'i ring gi nyams myong nas bltas pa yin na/ gang la gang 'tshams tshod thig pa zhig red/phyogs gcig nas blo pham po dang / sems skyo wa'i rang bzhin zhig yin na'ang /mi'i snying stobs ma zhum pa dang / sems shugs ma chag par 'bad rtsol lan dgu chad mthud rgyun bsrings byas pa yin na/ bden pa'i mtha' gsal rgyur yid ches byas chodzig pa zhig red bsam gyi 'dug nga rang gi ngos nas yin kyang 'das pa'i mi tshe'i ring la bsam pa dang sbyor ba gang 'dra zhig bsten pa de bzhin du/ da dung ma 'ongs pa'i mi tshe bskyel rgyu de dag la'ang bod mi rigs spyi la phan pa zhig dang / rgya che sa nas bde don bsgrub thub pa zhigayab sku(nga mi yong bsam blo gtong gi yod/ ma 'ongs pa la sems shugs chag rgyu dang / blo la 'gyur ba thebs pa gang yang med/ rtsa ba nga rang la cha bzhag na/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'brangs dge slong zhig de'i nang nas theg pa chen po'i chos la mos pa yod mkhan/ theg pa chen po'i chos la mos pa dang dag snang sbyangs 2

nas nyams len byed mkhan zhig yin/ de 'dra'i nyams len byed mkhan gyi bsam blo gang gtong dgos zer na/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /sman dang dgon pa'i shing bzhin du/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyis/ /rang dgar dbag med dpyad byar shog ces dbu ma rin chen phreng ba'i nang gsungs pa dang / spyod 'jug nang / ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa dang / /'gro ba ji srid gnas gyur pa/ /de srid bdag ni gnas gyur nas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog ces gsungs pa ltar theg pa chen wa'i lam la mos pa yod mkhan gyi nyams len byed stangs dang /bsam blo gtong stangs de yin pa red/ tshe 'di tsam du ma zad/ tshe rabs nas tshe rabs la 'gro ba sems can gzhan gyi don la gang phan ci phan byed rgyu'i bsam 〈 de so so'i dam bca' lta bur bzhag nas bsam cho de 'dra zhig gtong gi yod/ nga rang gi ngos nas bsam pa rnam dag da lta phan la byas pa bzhin ma 'ongs pa la yin kyang byed kyi red/ de de bzhin khyed rang tsho mi 54 nga gi thog nas yin na yang / nga la da ring skyes tshes kyi nyin mo 'dir mi tshos lag rtags sprod pa'i lugs srol yod pa ltar/ nga la lag rtags gang sprod dgos zer na/khyed rang tsho tshang mas mi yin pa'i cha nas ya rabs dang / drang po byas// las 'bras ma swārtegs pa byas/ mi gzhung bzang 11 yag po zhig byas pa yin na/ nga la lag rtags gcig de red/ lag rtags gnyis pa de gang yin zer na/ nga tsho bod pa yin pa'i cha nas so so'i mi rigs kyi sha zhen dang / mi rigs kyi la rgya ma brlag pa// nga rang tsho mi rigs kyi spyi'i rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i 'thab rtsod 3

byed pa'i don dag ma brjed par sems khur blangs thub pa zhig byung na/ nga'i lag rtags gnyis pa de red/ shes song ngam/ da ring 'dir skyes skar rten 'brel la 'dzoms pa'i thog khyed rang tshos lag rtags ngo thog nga yid tshim pa zhig sprod 'dod yod na/ da lta bshad ma thag pa'i don dag de gnyis kyi thog la khyed rang tshos hur thag byed rogs byed/ nga la gzhan dag zer rgyu gang yang mi 'dug tshang mar bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che/khyed rang tshor bod don gyi gnas stangs gang 'dra yod med shes 'dod yod kyi red/ ngas bod pa'i las ka byedakyi yod stabs rob tsam lab na bsam byung / bod don gnas stangs khyed rang chos gang la gang 'tshams shes kyi red/rgya nag nang la nye char sgyur bcos phyin pa'i rkyen byas te bod nang la'ang phran bu'i lhug tu 'gro gi yod pa red/ yin na'ang gzhi rtsa'i mi rnams dngangs skrag byed dgos pa dang / sems ma skyid pa shugs chen po yod pa/ lto gos kyi thog la dka' ngal/ rang dbang gi thog la dka' ngal bcas yod mus las 'gyur ba gang yang phyin mi 'dug 'das pa'i lo nyi shu'i ring la nga tsho mi'i lung par bsdad pa'i dgos don de bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang gi khe phan zhig nga tshos sgrub kyi yod pa red/ bod rgya che'i mi mang gi khe phan bsgrub pa la/ dngos gnas don dam bod rgya che'i mi mang gi bsam tshul gang 'dra zhig yod pa dang / gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig yod pa de nga tshos shes dgos pa red/ de ma shes na nga tshos las ka byed thub kyi ma red/ nga tshos 'dir 'thab rtsod byed rgyu'i ngo tho de 7rgyal ba rin po che sger gyi thob thang rtsod pa dang / de bzhin nga tsho yul gzhan du gyar 4

bsdad pa'i bod mi tsho'i thob thang rtsod pa rtsa ba nas ma red/ sngon la chab srid kyi skad cha bshad mi dgos/ bod nang gi mi tsho 'gro ba mi yin pa'i cha nas dngos gnas drang gnas mi la dgos pa'i thob thang ma tshang ba'i dka' ngal yod pa'i gnas tshul de'i thog nas nga tshos 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod pa red/ gal te bod nang la gnas tshul gra 'grigs po zhig dang / 'dod pa tshims pa zhig yod pa yin na nga tshos 'dir rtsod pa rgyag dgos don gang yang med/ nga tshos bod nang gi gnas tshul ngo ma gang 'dra yod pa rnams shes thub pa'i ched du bod nang nas tshur btsan byol la yong mkhan de 'dra'i skad cha dang / yang bod nang la phar gnas tshul bsgrub mkhan btang ba/ phyi rgyal gyi mi nga cho'i ngo shes 'ga' zhig bod nang blta skor la 'gro mkhan de tsho'i mthong tshul nyan pa bcas thabs shes rnams yod rgu rtsal sprugs byas te bod kyi gnas tshul shes thabs byed kyi yod /de yang bod nang rgya mis sdug po byas pa de dag kyang nga tshos shes dgos la/ rgya mis yag po byas pa de dag kyang nga tshos nges par du shes dgos/ nga tsho rgya mi la ྅du rgol byed mkhan yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas te bod nang nas brosape'ong mkhan gyi mi dang / bod nang la gnas tshul bsgrub tu 'gro mkhan tsho nas nga tshor gnas tshul bshad pa'i skabs la rgya mis gang sdug sdug byas pa rnams dang / gra ma 'grigs yod pa'i phyogs de bshad/ legs cha rnams ma bshad na nga tsho mgo 'khor thebs kyi sku da pa ma gtogs/ gnas tshul dngos yod cha tshang shes mi thub/ sdug po yod na sdug po'i gnas tshul rnams shes dgos la/ legs pa'i gnas tshul rnams kyang nga tshos rtogs dgos kyi red/ gnad don de la 5

nga tshos rgyun du nan po byas nas do snang byed kyi yod/ de 'dra'i thog nas 'das pa'i lo nyi shu'i ring la nga tshor gnas tshul go thos byung ba dang / bar skabs phran bu'i sgo phye nas bod phyi nang la gnyen 'phrad 'gro 'ong gi go skabs byung ba/phyi rgyal gyi mi de 'dra bod nang blta bskor la phyin pa/ de dag gi mthong tshul bcas phyogs bsdoms byed skabs gnas tshul gcig gyur ra 'phrod byung don la/ bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang brgya cha dgu bcu go dgu rgya mi la mi dga' ba yod pa gsal 11 'dug brgya cha gcig rgya mi la dga' mkhan yong srid pa zhig red/ dper na grong gseb gcig la mi stong phrag bzhi lnga zhig yod pa'i nang rgya mi la dga' po byed mkhan mdzub mo'i sgang la grangs ka rgyag rgyu'i bzhi lnga tsam las yod tshod mi 'dug bcings bkrol zer ba'i ming snyan po zhig yod kyang dngos yod gnas tshul la rgya che'i mi mang rnams so so'i lung pa'i nang la mi'i thob thang gang yang med pa dang / lto gos kyis phongs pa/ nyin re'i ngal rtsol gyi dka' ngal chen po myong dgos pa'i gnas tshul la brten nas bod mi rnams rang bzhin gyis rgya mi la mi dga' ba dang / zhen log gi bsam tshul de yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas mi rigs kyi sems shugs 'gran zla bral ba yod 'dug lhag don gzhon skyes tsho'i nang la ha cang sems shugs chen po 'dug khong tshos rgya mi la zhed snang mi byed pa'i gnas tshul ngon gsal dod po yod sa red/ sngon ma dang mi 'dra ba'i bar skabs gnas tshul gsar pa zhig la gzhon skyes tsho'i nang nas ma'o rtse tung gi lta ba dang / dmar po'i lta ba slob sbyong gang 'tshams byasaskusad stabs/ khong tshos yig cha'i nang gi gnad 6

don rgyu mtshan rnams bgrangs te rgya mir skyon brjod byed skabs lam seng log spyod pa red ces ming btags stangs ma shes pa lta bu chags yong gi yod pa red/gzhon skyes tsho'i nang sems shugs chen po yod pa'i tshod 'dug gang ltar nga rang tsho bod mi rigs kyi 'das pa'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus ring po'i nang la bod mi rigs rlabs chen yin pa'i lo rgyus mang po bshad rgyu yod pa red/ da lta nga rang tsho'i mi thog 'di ga'i ring la mig gis mthong / lag gis phrin pa'i nyams myong la bsam blo zhig btang na yang nga tsho bod mi rigs 'di gyong po dang mkhregs po zhig yin pa gsal po yod/ ma gzhi mi su dang su yin kyang dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i skabs su mkhregs su 'gro ba spyir btang chos nyid red la/ de'i nang tshan nas nga tsho bod mi rigs la rgya mis da phan lo nyi shu tham pa'i ring la rdog brdzis sdug sbyong btang rkyang byas yod kyang / da cha des 'grig gi med pa'i ngos 'dzin byas te bsgyur bcos gtong gi yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la༄ btsan byol ba mang po yod pa red/ rgya nag dang 'brel ba yod pa'i rgya mi btsan byol ba dang / sog po dang / shin cang btsan byol ba sogs yod pa red/ nye char nga sog yul la phyin pa'i skabs la shin cang pa kha shas thug 'phrad kyi go skabs byung / kho rang tshos ha cang dga' po byed kyi 'dug shin cang gi btsan byol ba'i grangs 'bor la mtshon na u ru su'i sa khongs la snga rjes bsdoms phal cher 'bum gsum tsam yod pa dang / de bzhina.ab gan ni si than gyi nang dang / krar ki'i nang / pa ki si than gyi nang bcas par gang 'tshams re yod 'dug kyang / khong tshor gong bu'i nus pa chig 7

bsgril zhig dang / 'dzam bu gling gi phyi nang gang sa nas dmigs bsal do snang byed yul tshang mas shes gsal zhig rang med pa lta bu 'dug 'on kyang khong tsho sems shugs ni ha cang chen po 'dug nga rang tsho btsan byol ba stong phrag brgya skor zhig yod pa rnams spyir btang shes yon dang gang ci'i gnas stangs nga tsho skyo ba ma gtogs drag pa med na yang / rgya mi'i ngos la bzod ma bde yong ba la bod mi tshos gnod che ri+ogos yong gi yod pa red/ rgya mi bod du slebs nas 04sa ka byed stangs la phyogs ba༄/mas shig byas pa yin na thog mar rgya mis mkhas po dang byams po byas te blo 'gugs thabs byas yod/ yang 'jam rtsub gnyis ldan gyi thog nas bod rigs nang khul dkrug shing byed pa sogs byed thabs mang po zhig gi thabs shes sgo gang sa nas byas yod kyang / lo nyi shu tham/ pa phyin pa'i ring la rgya mis bod kyi thog la las ka byas pa rnams pham nyes la phyin te bod mi yongs rdzogs kyi bsam blor rgya mis rang 'dod ltar dbang sgyur byed thub yod pa ma red/ shrīng rang tsho bod mi kha shas kyi bsam blo'i nang la gcig byas na 'di 'dra yong srid pa red/ dus rabs sngon ma tsho'i skabs mi rigs so so'i lta ba dang /la rgya mkhregs po zin te phan tshun khe gtsang sdod rgyur 'bad brtson byas/ yod kyang / deng sang gi dus tshod la 'dzam gling khyon yongs la 'gyur ba chen po phyin yod pa dang / phan tshun gcig gis gcig la 'brel ba nye po dang / mthong rgya chen po bsam blo gu yangs po chags stabs nga tsho dang / khong tsho zhes 'thab rtsod byed rin med pa lta bu'i bsam blo 'khor srid kyi red/ gzhi rtsa tan tan 8

red/ nga rang tsho tshang ma 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la 'gro ba mi'i rigs gcig gyur red/ ma 'ongs pa la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la don dam gyi bde skyid yong ba la nga tsho tshang ma mi'i rigs gcig gyur gyi lta tshul dang / mi'i rigs gcig gyur gyi bsam tshul thog nas thabs shes 'bad brtson byed thub pa byung ba yin na/ nga tsho'i dka' ngal mang po zhig rang bzhin gyis zhi 'gro rgyu yin par nga rang yid ches yod/ nga rang yang 'di'i thog la do snang yod mkhan zhig dang / dga' mos yod pa zhig yin/ nga tshor skad yig 'dra mi 'dra/ lam lugs 'dra mi 'dra/ cha lugs 'dra mi 'dra mang po yod pa 'di dag phyi'i rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba'i khyad par tsam red ma gtogs/ don dam pa'i nang gi bsam blo'i nang tshang ma bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa gcig gyur ma gtogs de la phyogs dang ris su phye dgos pa'i khyad par gang yang med/ gzhi rtsa de dngos gnas yang dag pa red/ yin na yang da lta'i dngos yod kyi gnas stangs la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la ches mtho'i rgyal khab mi grangs sa ya mang po yod pa tshos rang gi mi rigs dang / rang gi lung pa'i khe phan don dag la bsam blo gtong rgyu dang / 'bad rtsol byed rgyu'i thob thang yod pa ltar/ rang don rang gces kyi las ka byed kyi yod pa yin na/ nga tsho bod mi sa ya drug ma gtogs med mkhan/ der yang deng sang dka' ngal chen po 'phrad bsdad mkhan zhig gis gzab gzab byed ma thub na mi rigs ming med 'gro rgyu'i nyen ka yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig gi 'og la mi sa ya drug gi bde don la bsam blo btang nas rang gi mi rigs srung skyob byed rgyu dang / mi rigs de'i khyad chos 9

dang rig gzhung rnam pa ma nyams par 'dzin rgyu la rgyu mtshan yod/ de yang dag pa zhig red/ nga tsho bod mi sa ya drug la dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi gnas stangs josgog nas kha stabs med na yang / nga tsho mi yin pa'i cha nas mi spyi mtshungs kyi rang dbang bde skyid la spyod pa'i thob thang los yong / de'i cha nas nges par mi sa ya drug yod pa'i bod zer mkhan lung pa de'i sgang la bsam blo gtong 'os pa zhig dang / bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig sku(da/ gal te bod nang mi sa ya drug gi gnas tshul de 'dzam gling spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs mi'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la spyod rgyu yod pa zhig gi nyi ma shar song na mi sa ya drug rang mgo thon pa red/ bod mi sa ya drug gi bde skyid 'dod pa khengs pa zhig byung ba red/ de'i tshe nga tshos bod mi rigs kyi skad cha ma bshad kyang 'grigs pa red/ 'on kyang da lta'i gnas skabs la gnas stangs de 'dra min pas nga tshos bod mi rigs kyi bde don sgrub 'os pa zhig red/ nges par du bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug rang nyid bod pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan du byas te la zhen gyi bsam blo ma btang kyang / bod mi sa ya drug mi yin pa'i cha nas brtse ba byed dgos pa dang / de dag gi bde ba sdug bsngal la sems khur len dgos par rgyu mtshan 'dug dper na/ rgya gar nang dang / a mi ri lnga'i nang phyi rgyal lung pa gang sar nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi bde ba sdug bsngal gyi don dag la sha tsha byas nas bsam blo gtong mkhan gang la gang 'tshams skurdzong gi yod pa red/de rnams rang nyid mi rigs 'di'i khungs yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas pa min par/bod mi rnams 'gro ba mi'i rigs spyi mtshungs yin pa'i cha nas nga tshor sha tsha 10

byas/ rgyab skyor dang rogs ram byed kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho dang mi rigs tha dad yin pa zhig gis 'gro ba mi spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs kyi spun zla 'du shes bzhag nas do snang sems khur byed kyi yod na/ nga rang tsho sha khrag gcig las mched mkhan tshos so so'i mi rigs sa ya drug gi don dag la sems khur len dgos pa la nges par du rgyu mtshan yod/ yang nga tsho 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi mi rigs shig yin na jigang rlabs chen po dang ngoms 'os pa'i khyad chos dge mtshan gang yang med pa'i mi rigs shig yin na gnas tshul tha dad red de/ nga tsho de 'dra yang min/ nga tsho bod kyi spyi tshogs rjes lus red/ de ni bod gcig pu ma gtogs 'dzam gling sa phyogs gzhan dag la ma byung ba gang yang min/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi sa gnas gang sar thog ma'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs dma' po zhig nas ga le ga ler yar rgyas phyin pa red/ dper na/ snga mo yo rob nang la cha bzhag na/ bod nang gi lam lugs las sdug tsam gyi tshe g.yog lam lugs dang / zhing bran lam lugs/ rgyal wa'i ring lugs/ gnas tshul thabs 〉 rwaku byung yod/ 'dzam gling gi mi'i rigs tshang ma spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam 'phrang 'di bshar nas phyin pa sha stag red/ nga tsho bod pa rnams la go skabs ma byung ba'i dbang gis yar rgyas mgyogs po 'gro ma thub pa red/ de la nga tsho spam shor dgos don mi 'dug rtsa ba'i mi rigs kyi cha nas bsam blo btang ba yin sdus nga rang tsho bod mi risas sngong sa rgya nar nang dang / sung si/ r+bhe rgyal gzhan dag bcas par spyir btang bod mi rnams lto gos 'tshol thabs grung po/11

lung pa gang du slebs na'ang lung pa de ga'i goms gshis dang bstun nas lam seng spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs kyi mi tshe skyel thub mkhan zhig yin/ dper na/ rgya gar gyi nang la bod mi su krar gyi tshong rgyag mkhan tshor sa khang rgyu nor dang /dngul khang nang bcol dngul sogs gang yang med rung / rgya gar ba'i tshong pa tshos hin sgor khri phrag mang po'i sud krar bod mir snga 'don du bskur/ rjes su sud krar btsongs tshar ba'i rjes la gzhi nas phar de'i rin 'bab rnams sprod len byed kyi yod pa red/ des ga re'i rtags bstan gyi yod pa red zer na/bod mir yid ches dang / blos 'gol byas chog pa'i mi drang bden dang / ya rabs tshul mthun la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ de bzhin a mi ri ka khul la'ang ḍo lar stong phrag kha shas dngul rkyang lag thog snga g.yar byed mkhan de 'dra yong gi 'dug des spyir btang bod mi rnams gzhung bzang po/ gdong brtan po/ blos bkal chog pa zhig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ de rlabs chen red bsam gyi 'dug dper na/ sngar gyi lo rgyus thog bsam blo zhig thongs dang / nga tsho bod mi rigs kyis shar phyogs rgya nag dang / lho ngos rgya gar dang dus rabs mang po'i ring 'brel ba byas nas bsdad pa red/ rgya nag gi phyogs la skabs re gnyen nye'i mdza' 'brel dang / skabs re dgra gshed du bzung nas 'khrug pa rgyag pa sogs de 'dra byas nas mi rabs mang po sbrel nas dus rabs mang po zhig song ba'i ring bod pas mkhregs thag chod byas nas bsdad pa red/ de ltar na nga rang tsho'i mi rigs 'di la gnas tshul mang po'i cha nas gces zhen 'os pa dang / gus bkur 'os pa/ nga tsho spobs pa skyes 12

'os pa zhig yin pas nga tshos so so'i lung pa'i don dag la tshang mas da lta bar du sems khur byed kyi yod pa ltar/ da dung yang sems shugs nges par du bskyed dgos pa zhig red/ bar lam rgya mi'i gnas tshul la 'gyur ba phran bu 'gro gi yod pa red/phyogs gcig nas rgya nag nang la dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal mang po 'phrad/gnyis nasa.u ru su'i phyogs nas dmag gi nyen ka zhig kyang byung / de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas da cha rgya nag nang la de snga phan chad rgya mi'i dpon po tshos bshad ma snudang ba'i skad cha gsar pa shod pa dang / rnam 'gyur bstan ma myong ba zhig bstan gyi yod pa red/ rang la nor 'khrul yod na de ngos len byed dgos zer ba dang / bod don gyi thog la yang rgya bod gnyis lnga'i phyogs nas nor yod ces gsal po bshad kyi 'dug dngos sku da gnas tshul gyi thog nas bden pa 'tshol dgos zhes ting zha'o phing gi gsung bshad nang la thon yong gi yod pa red/ ma gzhi rgya mi gung khran gyi yig cha dang gtam gleng nang rang gis rang la skyon brjod byed dgos pa dang / gcig gis gcig la skyon brjod rogs ram byed pa de gal che shos yin lugs zer gyi yod na yang / ngo thog lag len bkal skabs so so'i nor 'khrul chen po zhig kyang chung chung bzo ba dang / kho rang tshos ngoms dgos pa zhig yin na/ chung chung zhig yin kyang chen po bzos nas rtag par bshad kyi yod/ da cha de'i gnas tshul phran bu 'gyur nas dngos yod gnas tshul sgang la gang la gang 'tshams 'gro gi yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug rtsa ba rgya nag nang spyi yongs kyi srid byus 'gyur ba zhig phyin 13

pa'i rkyen gyis bod don gyi thog la'ang rgya mi'i srid byus phran bu 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu'i rnam 'gyur zhig thon gyi 'dug bar skabs kyi dus tshod zhig ring 'dzam gling phyi nas rgya mir yag nyes kyi skad cha ga re bshad kyang / de dag ma nyan par g.yugs rkyang dang / rang gi lung pa'i nang la so so rang mgo thon pa zhig dang /mi su la yang re mi dgos pa byed dgos zer ba'i lta ba de 'khyer nas gzhan dag la stabs bstun byed kyi med kyang / da cha rgya nag la dpal 'byor gyi rogs ram yong thabs dang / u ru su'i 'jigs snang sel ba'i don du 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la gnyen mang tsam bzo thabs dang / spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs kyi mi gral la tshud thabs 'brel ba 'dzugs pa'i thabs shes mang po byed kyi 'dug thabs shes de byed kyi yod pa'i rkyen gyis rgya mis phyi rgyal la rnam 'gyur mdzes po dang /'dra chags po ston pa'i skabs su zhabs 'dren bod kyi gnas tshul 'dis zhu gi yod stabs/ da cha bod nang la rnyog khra med pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig ga tshod thub thub bstan thabs byed kyi 'dug bod nang la bar skabs yar rgyas phyin pa de tsho bstan rgyu'i don dag la gsar 'god pa de 'dra gang la gang 'tshams btang ba dang / de tsho'i gras dang po nas rgya mis 'dems sgrug byas nas btang ba sha stag red/ khong tsho rwaped nang la slebs pa'i skabs la rgya mis btsugs pa'i skad bsgyur zhig brgyud/ rgya mis snga sa nas gra sgrig byas pa'i sa cha khag la blta skor la rākhrid/ de'i nang gi mi tshor skad cha shod stangs/ rnam 'gyur bstan stangs tshun chad la skam sbyangs mthar phyin pa byas yod pa red/ ngas phe lim zhig mthong song / phe lim de'i nang la ngal rtsol byed mkhan bod mi tsho'i gyon gos 14

gsar pa gsar rkyang red/ 'bras spungs nang la bla ma mchod pa 'don mkhan de tshos dril bu tshig mtshams gang du dkrol dgos min tsam yang shes kyi mi 'dug lha sa gtsug lag khang dang / rtse pho brang gi par tshon khra yag wa de 'dra rgyab 'dug lo gcig rgya nag gi bod zer ba'i par deb nang / rtse pho brang shar brgyud kyi gzim chung gcig gi par 'ga' shas 'dug de'i nang bzhugs sgrom de'i nang la zla gam zhig dang / 'og der 'ja' chen zhig bzhag 'dug de'i mdun der rdo je dril bu dang / ka pa li de 'dra bzhag 'dug ngas nam rgyun cog tse'i steng dpe cha bzhag gi yod ma gtogs/ rdo rje dril bu dang ka pa li de 'dra sgrig gi med/ de tsho yang sgrig stangs mi shes mkhan zhig gis bsgrigs 'dug sngon ma'i gzhung zhabs rgan pa de 'dra dang / yar thon yin zer mkhan gyi 'go byed mkhan de 'dra/ slob phrug skad cha shod mkhan de 'dra 'dug de tsho'i rnam 'gyur la ltos dang / skad cha dri mkhan phyi rgyal gyi mi de'i gdong la ma bltas par zur zhig la blta bzhin skad cha shod kyi 'dug de'i zur der rgya mi'i skad bsgyur yin na'ang rung / sne shan yin na'ang rung / khong tshos bstun dgos the'i mi zhig yod pa'i rtags gsal po 'dug gnyis nas skad cha bshad mkhan sa khul 'dra mi 'dra'i mi sna tshogs yin na yang / skad cha tshang ma ngag la zin pa lta bur tshig dang / don tshang ma gcig gyur sha stag bshad kyi 'dug gang ltar gnas tshul tshang ma rgya cha brgya tham pa 'khrab ston byas te phyi mir mgo bskor btang ba sha stag red/ yin na yang rgyus med phyi mi 'ga' shas kyis yag po 'dug ces bshad kyi yod pa red/15

skabs der nga tshos gnas tshul de tsho ham rdzun 'khrab ston byas pa red/bod nang dka' ngal mu mthud nas sku da pa red ces u tshugs byas na nus pa thon mi thub stabs/ rgya mis bod nang la yar rgyas btang / rgya mis bod mir byams skyong yag po byas yod na/ de nga tshos ngos len byed kyi red/ da cha bod nang la yag po yod na sgo phye ste nga tshor bstan dgos kyi 'dug de sbas dgos don gang yang mi 'dug phyi rgyal du sdod mkhan bod mi tsho bod nang blta skor la gtong dgos kyi 'dug ces kha sang gsum bcu'i dus dran thog ngas thog ma'i bsam 'char 'di bshad pa yin/ de bshad pa'i rjes la rgya gar nang gi bod mi bco brgyad nas ldi lir yod pa'i rgya mi'i gzhung tshab la 'brel ba byas te bod nang blta skor la 'gro rgyu'i thabs shes byas pa red/ de la rgya mis thog mar 'grigs kyi red ces lan sprad pa red/ de rjes rgya mi'i gzhung tshab khang nas rgya gar gzhung gis sprad pa'i bod mi btsan byol ba'i lag 'khyer des 'grig gi ma red/ rgya mi'i phyi sdod rang mi yin zer ba'i lag khyer rgya mi'i gzhung tshab khang nas len dgos zhes rgya mis rnyog khra bshad pa red/ rgya mi'i gzhung tshab khang nas phyi sdod rang mi'i lag 'khyer blangs na/ nga tsho'i rtsa don dang phyogs 'gal 'gro rgyur brten/ khe gyong gdam kha ma log pa byas te bod mi bco brgyad bod la 'gro rgyu sgor sgor so so'i ngos nas phyir 'then byas pa red/ de min mi sger pa re zung 'gro mkhan byung yod pa red/ lag 'khyer dang srid don gyi rnyog khra med pa'i thog nas blta skor ba gtong thub na bsam pa'i thabs shes byed kyi yod/ bsam tshul 'dis nga tshos rgya mi la mgo sgur ba min la/ nga tsho'iri rtsa 16

don gyi bsam blo gtong phyogs la 'gyur ba phyin pa yang ma red/ bod la 'gro thub pa zhig byung na/ nga tshos srid don skor la lam seng bshad bde ma byung na yang / rgya gar gyis mtshon pas phyi rgyal lung pa'i nang nga tsho btsan byol ba 'di dag gzhi rtsa gang 'dra zhig tshugs yod pa dang / las ka gang 'dra byas yod pa/ 'tsho thabs kyi gnas stangs gang 'dra yod pa 'di dag nga tshos 'grel bshad byas pa yin na bod nang la sems shugs bskyed rgyur phan thogs yong rgyu dang /gtso che shos gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang gi bsam tshul dang / nga tsho byes la yod pa'i bsam blo gtong stangs gnyis wa de phar tshur gsal po shes rtogs thub pa byung ba yin na/ dge mtshan chen po zhig med dam snyam pa nga dzaX) bsam tshul de red/ rgya mi'i ngos nas rnam 'gyur phran bu gu yang du btang nas kho rang tshos go skabs shig btsal nas yong gi yod stabs/ nga rang tshos kyang go skabs de zin nas rgya mi nga cho'i dgra red/ rgya mi la 'brel ba byas na mi 'grigs ma bshad par rgya mi la 'brel ba byas/ gdong bstan nas skad cha bshad/ rgya mi'i ngos nas bsam blo gang 'dra zhig gtong gi 'dug rgyu mtshan ji tsam bdagad sa yod med blta dgos kyi 'dug nga tshos rtsa don rtsod gling byed pa 'di a mi ri ka dang / u ru su/ rgya gar/ rgya mi dang bcas par bsam tshul gcig gyur bshad rgyu ma gtogs/ de la ngo lkog mdo sbug byed dgos pa rtsa ba nas med/ rgya mis bod bcings bkrol gtong bar yong pa yin zer gyi yod/ bcing bkrol gtong bar yong pa yin na bcings pa'i sdug bsngal las grol dgos/ dngos yod gnas tshul la sdug bsngal mang du btang ba yin na/ bcings bkrol 17

zer ba'i dgos don ma tshang ba red/ nga tshos rgya mi rigs la ngo rgol byed kyi med/ dmar po la ngo rgol dang / gsar brje la ngo sgol byed kyi med/ bcos sgyur la ngo rgol byed kyi med/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi lung pa 'ga' zhig zhes dmar po la ngo rgol byed pa'i srid byus de 'dra'i 'og la nga tshos phyin med/'gro 'dod med/ nga tshos bod mi rigs sa ya drug gi thob thang de rtsod kyi yod/de snga phan chad phyi lo 1956 57 gyi gong la yang bod rigs gung khran tang mi gang la gang 'tshams yod pa red/ khong tshos lhag bsam rnam dag gi thog nas dmar wa'i lta ba la yid ches byed kyi yod pa dang / dmar wa'i ring lugs la yid ches kyi thog nas rang gi lung par zhabs 'degs bsgrub rgyu de thabs shes yag shos yin par yid ches byed kyi yod pa red/ mtha' ma de khong tsho'i gras mi rigs gu dog ring lugs la 'gro mkhan red ces ming 'dra mi 'dra re re btags te las gnas nas phyir 'bud dang / bod rigs yod sa'i sa khul la bsdad mi chog pa bzos pa red/ nga tshos bod mi sa ya drug gi bde ba sdug bsngal gyi bya ba bsgrub rgyu'i dmigs yul zhig dang / lam phyogs shig yod pa 'di dang mthun pa'i rogs ram zhig yin na de nga chos len gyi red/ dper na/ sngon ma a mi ri /'i ngos nas rogs ram phran bu byas pa de blangs pa red/yin na'ang nga tshosa.a mi ri ga'i rgyugs khyi byas yod pa ma red/ bod don 'thab rtsod kyi bkod byusa.a mi ri gas byas pa'ang ma red/ de 'dra yin na lo shas sngon a mi ri yis rgya nag la 'brel ba byas/ bod don la rogs ram byed mtshams bzhag pa'i nyin mo de nas nga tsho'i las mtshams bzhag dgos kyang /18

nga tshos las mtshams ma bzhag par so 16) las don mu mthud nas sgrub kyi yod/sngon ma lnga bcu nga dgu nas bzungs nga tshos dmar po la ngo rgol dang /u ru su la ngo rgol ma byas par/ so so'i rang tshugs bzung nas bsdad pa red/so so'i bden don rtsod nas bsdad pa red/ de 'dra'i rkyen gyis lnga bcu nga dgudrug cu'i lo stod la u ru sus bod don la blta stangs de dang / deng sang u ru sus bod don la blta stangs gnyis wa de la 'gyur ba chen po phyin yod/ u ru sus bod don 'di mi rigs kyi thob thang skor gyi 'thab rtsod yin pa gsal po bshod yong dus da cha rgyab skyor gyi rnam 'gyur thon yong gi yod pa red/ de yag pa 'dugayang nga rang tsho bod mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod 'di'i thog la go ming tang gi phyogs nas rogs ram byed 'dod yod pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan yong gi yod pa red/ rnam 'gyur de rogs ram gyi rnam pa yin na yang / rtsa ba'i ngo bo'i bsam blo gtong stangs de bod rgya khongs yin pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi thog nas nga tshor lag pa btang yong gi yod pa red/ de nga tsho'i rtsa don dang mi mthun par brten rogs ram de nga tshos len gyi yod pa ma red/ de ni nga tshos go ming tang la dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur dang / nga tsho the wan la yod pa'i rgya mi de dag la dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur gang yang ma red/ the wan nas bod rgya khongs red ces skad cha gcig gyur bshad pa de nga tshos dang len byed thabs med pa'i gnas tshul red/ go ming tang gis nga tshor rogs byed pa de skam sa chen po bcings bkrol gtong rgyu'i don dag dang / skam sa chen por da lta dmar pos 19

dbang sgyur byed pa der ngo rgol byed ched nga tshor lag pa brkyangs yong gi yod pa de ngorā len byas pa yin na/ nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i 'thab rtsod byed pa'i rnam pa de yang 'gyur rgyu'i nyen ka yod pa'i gnas tshul gyi cha nas nga tshos yid gzab byed dgos don de red/deng sang pe cing dang 'brel ba yong gi yod par brten/ mgyogs po tu la'i bla ma log gi red ces gsar mkhan de 'dra nas dris kyi 'dug ste/ da lta nga tsho log ma log gi dus tshod la rtsa ba nas slebs med/ ji srid bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams kha zhe gnyis med yid tshims pa zhig dang /'dod pa khengs pa zhig gi gnas tshul ma byung bar du nga tsho range gi lung pa la log 'dod yod kyang / log nas phan thogs gang yang med pa red/ de las mi'i lung par da mus bzhin bsdad nas bod kyi bden pa'i gnas tshul skad 'bod dang / mi la gsal bshad 'dra byas pa yin na bod mi mang la zhabs 'degs 'grub che ba zhig dang / phan thogs yod pa mthong chos kyi gnas tshul 'di red / da res ghi ri si rgyal sras dang skad cha byung / khong sngon ma nas ngas ngo shes pa zhig red/ khong gis nga log rgyu'i bsam blo btang gi yang ma red/ log rgyu'i bsam blo gtong rgyu mi 'dug yag po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug zer gyi 'dug de rnams deng sang bod nang gi gnas stangs dang / rgya mis rnam 'gyur gang 'dra zhig bstan gyi yod pa/ de gzhi la bzhag nas nga tshor bsam tshul gang 'dra zhig yod pa dang / thabs shes gang 'dra byed kyi yod pa bcas mdor bsdus de 'dra zhig yin/ shes song ngam/20

de nas rgya gar nang la lo nyi shu 'di'i ring gi las don la phyi mig bltas pa yin na/ nga tshos las ka gang 'tshams yag 11 byas yod/ thog mar nga cho ra bsam tshul mang po byung / 'ga' shas kyis srid don rang gi thog la shugs brgyab nas rgya gar byang brgyud sa mtshams khag la drag dpung dang bcas bca' sdod thub thabs byed dgos/ rgya gar lho phyogs su gzhis chags kyi 'char gzhi bting na mang tshogs sems shugs chag gi red zer ba sogs bsam tshul mang po byung na yang / nga tshos 'thab rtsod byed sa rgya mi yin pa dang / lam seng dus yun thung ngur nga tsho'i dmigs yul 'grub rgyu khag po red/ lo nyi shu sum cu 'gor gyi yod na'ang rung / gal srid mi rabs nas mi rabs 'gor gyi yod kyang / nga tsho mi'i lung par sra thag thag byas te bsdad thub pa zhig dang / de'i thog nas las don sgrub dgos kyi 'dug ces bsam tshul 'di 'khyer nas 'bad brtson byas pa red/ skabs der rgya gar srid blon ne ru bzhugs yod/ rgya gar srid blon ne+e rus bod don thog thugs khur chen po bzhes te bod pa'i rnam pa ma yal bar bsdad thub pa'i ched du gzhis chags dang gcig bod phrug tshor slob sbyong dmigs bsal byed sa yod mkhan slob grwa dang gnyis/ 'di'i tsho'i thog la nga tshos 'char gzhi bting pa red/ 'char gzhi ji ltar bting pa bzhin 'das pa'i lo nyi shu tham pa'i ring la nga tsho sra thag thag byas nas bsdad yod pa red/ rgya mis phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod pa tsho bod la log dgos pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan gyi yod pa der nga tsho gad mo shor gyi 'dug gzhi nas bsam blo zhig thongs dang / nga tsho mi'i lung par lo nyi shu tham pa bsdad pa 'di'i ring 21

la lto gos kyi phyogs nas bsam blo btang na rang gi lung par yod mkhan gyi mi las nga tsho drag pa yod/ 'di'i thog la nga tsho rang dbang yod pa red/ dngangs skrag byed dgos pa med/ spyir btang mi yin pa'i cha nas mi'i thob thang la longs spyod rgyu yod/ so soge gad mi rigs yin pa'i cha nas so so'i mi rigs kyi zhabs 'degs gang 'dra zhig bsgrubs 'dug gam/ so so'i chos dang rig gzhung /mi rigs kyi bzang po'i goms gshis khag srung skyob/ gzhan dag phar bzhag nas mdor na gzhas rnam thar zhig yin kyang so lhastu) mi rigs kyi gshis ka dang /rnam 'gyur ma brlag par 'dzin skyong byas yod/ bod nang la bod mi sa ya drug gis so so'i mi rigs kyi don dag la srog blos btang nas 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod kyang / khong tshor rang dbang med stabs bod pa'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa shugs che tsam bstan pa yin na/ lam seng rgya mis mi rigs gu dog ring lugs zhes 'dra mi 'dra'i ming btags nas med pa bzo rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi 'dug bod kyi nang so so'i mi rigs kyi goms gshis kyi srung skyob byed rgyu'i las ka byas pa yin na khrims 'gal la brtsi gi yod pa red/ da res ghi ri si rgyal sras dang skad cha byung / khong bod nang la lta skor du bskyod skabs bod pa'i gzhas dang zhabs khro de 'dra blta dgos yod ces bshad par/ sne shan des bod pa'i gzhas dang zhabs bro yag po ni med/ skyug bro po de 'dra bltas nas gang yong zer gyi 'dug mthong rgyu gang yang mi 'byeg sud si'i nang bod mi nyung shas las med kyang khong tshos bod pa'i gzhas dang zhabs bro/ bod pa'i lha mo bcas 'khrab ston byed pa'i skabs chas gos gyon stangs/ gdong gi rnam 'gyur ston stangs 22

tshang ma dngos gnas bod pa'i rnam 'gyur ma yal ba shugs che ba 'dug ces khong gis zer byung / 'di'i bzo 'dra zhig red/ ho' go phing gis mi rigs grangs nyung tsho la dmigs bsal gyi goms gshis dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chod yod pa rnams nga tshos srung skyob byed dgos kyi 'dug ces bshad 'du ga kyang / skad cha stong pa red/ lag len thog kha thabs gang 'dra zhig 'dug gam/de bzhin 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi spyir btang gi shes yon thog la cha bzhag na yang / nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba stong phrag brgya skor 'di'i nang nas ga tshod nyung na yang phru gu nyis brgya skor zhig tshad ldan mtho rim ches mtho'i slob tshan gyi rim pa la slebs yod/ rgya nag nang la rgya mi kho rang tsho yang 'dzam bu gling gi spyir btang shes yon thog la 'thus shor chen po phyin nas 'dzam gling gi shes yon spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs kyi gdan gral nang la ma tshud par bsdad yod na/ bod par slob sbyong tshad longs sprod rgyu ha cang khag po red/ lo nyi shu tham pa'i ring la nga tsho btsan byol ba tsho'i gnas stangs dang / bod nang la rgya mis 'go 'khrid pa'i 'og la bod mi cho'i gnas stangs bsdur ba yin na/ bod mi rigs la nga tshos byas rjes mang ba bzhag yod/ de nga tsho spobs pa skyes rgyu zhig red/ lo nyi shu tham pa'i gong la bod mi btsan byol du phyin pa 'di dag log spyod pa nyung shas shig red/ khong tshor log spyod pa'i ming btags te ming de ga'i 'og nas sdug gyong btang bzhag na gang mtshams shig nas sdug thag chod de rang shir 'gro gi red bsam pa'i bsam tshul 'di rgya mis bcangs yod kyang /23

da cha de bcangs thub kyi yod pa ma red/ de bzhin bod kyi chos la cha bzhag na/ lnga bcu nga dgu'i lo rgya mis bod nang drag gnon byed skabs log spyod pa'i bsam tshul de lo re zung zhig red ma gtogs yal 'gro gi red bsam pa'i tshod dpag byas yod kyang / da cha lo nyi shu tham pa phyin pa'i rjes la nga tsho mkhregs po byas nas bsdad yod pa dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la cha bzhag na yang so so'i mi rigs tsam ma yin pa'i mi rigs gzhan dag nang nas der dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed mkhan mang po yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul chags nas bsdad yod/ de dag spyi'i gnas tshul tsam red /bye brag nga tsho bod don gyi 'thab rtsod 'di rtsa ba bod mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod red ma gtogs/ chos gcig pu'i skad cha ma red/ yin na'ang so so'i lung pa'i nang la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di dngos gnas gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i cha tshang ba dang / spus dag po zhig yod pa yin dus de nga tshos srung skyob mu mthud nas byed rgyu de nga tsho'i las 'gan gtso bo zhig red/ rgya gar nang la bod mi 'dus sdod gzhis chags khag gi nang la ris su ma chad pa'i chos sgar mang po sku da pa khyed rang tshos shes gsal red/ nga tsho thog ma'i bsam tshul byas na sngon la gzhis chags sra thag thag zhig bzos/ rim pas dpal 'byor gyi nus pa ldang ba'i mtshams la dgon pa gra tshang brgyab chog gi red bsam pa byung na yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don dag la sman pa zhig dang zhabs 'degs 'grub pa zhig byung na 'grigs pa red/ rtsa ba chos sgar khag yag thag chod tshugs yod pa red/ de snga yin na khu nu/ spi ti/ la dwags/24

rgya gar byang brgyud kyi sa khul gyi mi nang pa yin pa/ bod kyi theg pa chen wa'i chos nyams len byed mkhan/ de dag bod nang la phyin nas slob gnyer rgyag gi yod pa red/ da cha bod nang 'gro yul med stabs nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba'i chos skar khag gi nang la tshur yong nas slob sbyong byed mkhan brgya phrag brgal ba yod pa red/ 'di dag gi thog nas nga tshos bod mi rigs kyi nang la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos srung skyob byas pa tsam du ma zad/ rgya gar byang brgyud kyi sa khul la yod pa'i nang pa gcig gyur tsho la yang nga chos gang thub zhabs 'degs sgrub rgyu dang / phan thogs byed pa'i babs 'os yod pa ltar byed kyi yod pa red/ shes rig thog la mtshon na yang / dper na/ la dwags khul gyis mtshon pas sa khul khag kha shas la nga rang cho dad pa'i dge rgan gtong rgyu dang / bod pa'i slob deb gtong rgyu sogs kyi rogs phan byed kyi yod/ lung pa de dag srid don gyi sa mtshams dbye ba gcod stangs kyi thog nas rgya gar gyi khongs su chod bsdad yod pa red de/ bod kyi shes rig gcig gyur yin stabs nga tshos zhabs 'degs sgrub rgyu 'os 'gan red/ nga tshos khong tsho'i nang srid la the byus byas pa gang yang ma red/ yin na yang phan thogs sku1da pa yin na nga tshos byed rgyu babs 'os red/ nga tshos dga' zhing spro zhing byed dgos pa zhig red/rgya gar nang dgon pa khag chags bsdad pa 'di dag skor dgon pa so so'i nang la skabs gang 'khel gyi bla ma so so dang / gra pa so sos so so'i ngo gdong gi gnas tshul gcig pu ma gtogs ma gzigs pa ma yin par rgya gar 25

spyi yongs nas chos brgyud (8 dra mi 'dra gang 'dra yod pa dang / chos brgyud rang rang so so'i nang gses kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes mi 'dra ba gang 'dra yod pa/ 'di dag cha tshang mthong ba'i thog nas 'dzin skyong gnad 'khel po zhig byed dgos kyi 'dug bod nang la yod pa'i dgon pa gra tshang cha tshang nga tshos rgya gar nang la srung skyob byed thub kyi yang ma red la/ ha cang khag po red/bod nang la yod pa'i nga'i bla ma'i phyag bzhes 'di yin zhes pa gcig pu min par bod spyi yongs nang chos brgyud khag gi phyag bzhes gtso che ba che ba gang dang gang yod pa 'di dag phyogs bgos lta bu byas te 'dzin skyong nyams len byed thub pa zhig byung na yag po zhig mi yong ngam snyam pa nga tsho'i bsam tshul 'di red/de 'dra'i thog nas nga tshos gung bsgrigs nas las ka byed kyi yod pa red/de nas shes rig gi thog la deng sang bod pa'i phru gu stong phrag bco lnga nas nyi shu'i dbar zhig rgya gar nang la gzhi rim gyi slob sbyong byas nas rim pas thon yong gi yod pa red/ 'di dag la so so'i skad yig dang / goms gshis/rgyal rabs chos 'byung cha tshang slob sbyong byed kyi yod pa'i khar/ deng dus kyi shes yon slob sbyong sprad de 'dab gshog zung sbrel gyi thog nas 'gro gi yod/ da cha nga tsho mi'i lung par slebs nas lo nyi shu phyin pa red/ ji srid nam gnas bar du bod pa'i phru gu'i shes yon slob sbyong rgya gar gzhung gi 'gan len bya rgyu rgya gar gzhung la yang mdzad dka' yong rgyur brten rim pas so so'i phru gur slob sbyong sprod rgyu'i las 'gan de nga rang tsho bod pa rang gis mang tsam len thub na snyam pa'i bsam tshul byung / na ning rgya gar shes rig las khungs dang bka' 26

mol 'go btsugs te rgya gar gzhung gi rtsa don gyi thog la dgongs pa mnyam pa lta bu yin/ sngon la nga tsho'i gtan 'jags slob grwa khag gi 'dzin skyong de nga rang cho ༷ped mi rang gis 'gan 'khyer/ der rgya gar gzhung gi rogs ram zhig gnang rgyu byas na shes yon slob sbyong thog la tshags tshud pa dang / 'dzin skyong gi tho ga la stabs bde ba mi yong ngam bsam pa 'dug shes rig gi thog la de 'dra zhig byed kyi yod pa red/de nas gzhis chags khag 'di dag ni gzhis chags so so rang kha rang gso thub pa'i thog la bod pa'i rnam pa ma yal ba zhig dgos kyi 'dug ces nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i bsam tshul 'di red la/ da lta phan la rgya gar nang gi gzhis chags phal che bar nga tsho'i dang po'i bsam tshul yod pa de ga'i thog la phyin pa red/gzhis chags khag nang yod pa'i bod pa tsho'i rnam 'gyur dang / rang bzhin gyi bsam blo gtong stangs bod pa'i rnam 'gyur shugs che ba gnas rgyur phan thogs chen po byung 'dug da dung bod mi stong phrag bdun brgyad zhig gzhis chags byed rgyur bsdad yod pa red/ khyed rang tsho mang che ba rgya gar nang 'gro myong ba yin dus/ khyed rang chos mthong gsal red/de nas rgya gar gtso bor gyur pa'i sa khul khag la yod pa'i bod mi spyi yongs la blta rtogs byed mkhan sgrig 'dzugs de dha ram sa lar yod pa'i las khungs khag 'di dag red/ de yang mang gtso'i rnam pa jon thub pa/ mi mang tsho'i bsam tshul gsal po tshur 'don thub pa/ dus tshod dang mthun pa'i mang gtso yag po zhig chags thub pa'i rtsa ba la nga chos mi mang spyi 'thus kyi sgrig 27

'dzugs btsugs pa red/ yin na yang 'dod pa khengs pa zhig gi las ka yag po zhig yong dang mi yong dang / tshags tshud po yong dang mi yong de mi la rag las pa red/ mi la cha bzhag na yang phyogs gcig nas lhag bsam dang /khyedags gcig nas nyams cadang / sdudags gcig nas shes yon bcas dgos kyi 'dug 'dzoms pa rnam gsum 'dod pa khengs pa zhig yong rgyu khag po red/yin na yang btsan byol ba gzhan dag tsho'i gnas stangs gang 'dra 'dug nga rang tsho'i gnas stangs skyo po 'di la gzhigs pa'i bsam blo btang ba yin na yag thag chod chags bsdad yod/ nga tsho'i btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs dha ram sa lar yod pa red/ 'gan 'khyer mkhan zhig yod na de la yag shag nyes shag ces shod pa de lugs srol red/ rgya gar nang dang / a mi ri ka sogs 'dzam gling lung pa gang 'dra zhig la cha bzhag kyang / 'gan 'khyer mkhan de la yag shag nyes shag ces shod pa 'di spyi'i chos nyid red/ lhag don nga tsho bod mi rnams mi'i lung pa'i nang gnas yod stabs las ka 'gul tsam byed dgos byung kyang mi la bstun nas byed rgyu ma gtogs rang 'dod ltar byed bde med pa dang / dngos yod gnas tshul 'gal rkyen mang po zhig yod pa'i cha nas lam seng 'grub thub rgyu khag po red/ nga rang tsho'i nus pa'i cha nas kyang dka' ngal chen po yod pa red/ ji ma ji bzhin 'dod pa khengs pa yong gi mi 'dug ste yin na yang gzhi rtsa'i cha nas da lta'i gnas skabs la bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'di ngas 'gan 'khyer nas bsdad yod pa red/ yin na'ang bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs de nga la bdag pa ma red/ nga ma shi bar du ngas bod 28

gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'gan 'khyer rgyu zhig yong gi yang ma red la/ yong dgos don yang yod pa ma red/ dper na/ bod rang btsan gyi 'gyur ba byung song na/ rang btsan byung ba'i nyin mo de nas ngas bod la chab srid kyi las ka mu mthud nas byas bsam pa rtsa ba nas med/ ngas sduge so'i mig dpe blta sa de lhan rdi la byed kyi yod/ maha rda ma lhan rdis rgya gar rang btsan ma byung bar du srid don gyi 'thab rtsod gnang ba red/ rgya gar rang btsan byung ba dang gzhung gi 'gan 'khyer nas ma bzhugs par phyi sku(gas su bzhugs pa red/ nga'i bsam tshul de red/ de min nga tsho mi'i lung par bsdad pa'i ring la yang mtha' gcig tu nga ma shi bar du ngas 'gan 'khyer nas bsdad dgos pa'i nges pa gang yang yod pa ma red/ gzhung 7rgyal ba rin po che'i gzhung rtsa ba nas ma red/ bod gzhung 7rgyal ba rin po cher bdag pa yang ma red/ da lta'i gnas skabs su nga la 'byon thang dang nus pa med na yang / 7rgyal ba rin po che'i ming yod pa la brten nas bod pa tshos spyir btang re ba dang / dga' po byed kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul gyi thog nas ngas 'gan 'khyer nas bsdad yod pa red/ sgrig 'dzugs nang la las ga'i 'gan 'khyer mkhan 'di dag la skyon dang nor 'khrul med pa myongang gi ma red/ yin na yang che sa dang / brgya cha bskor ba yin na brgya cha mang ba de lhag bsam rnam dag gi thog nas zhabs phyi zhu gi yod pa red/de ngas khyed tshor mgo bskor btang ba yang min/ ngas khas len gtsang ma byas chog gi red/ nga rang tsho'i spyi'i las 'gan 'khyer mkhan gyi sgrig 'dzugs de la gang 'dra yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa dang yid ches chu nga drag pa lta bu byas 29

na yag po yod pa ma red/ gal srid khyed rang tshos yid ches brlag gi 'dug na yang / nga tshor spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig ma byung thabs med red/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs da lta yod pa 'dis 'grigs kyi mi 'dug na de min pa'i thabs shes 'di 'dra byed dgos/ gnyen po 'di 'dra zhig bsten dgos/ dmigs sgo 'di 'dra zhig 'dug ces gra sgrig cha tshang byas nas bsam 'char 'don dgos/dper na/ rgya gar lta bu'i gros tshogs nang gzhung 'dzin skyong byed mkhan gyis ma 'grigs pa'i skyon brjod byed kyi yod pa red/ skyon brjod byas te gzhung 'dzin snurags pa de pham nyes shor sdu/nga na/ de'i tshab la sngor rgol shog khag zhig langs chog chog byas nas bsdad yod pa red/ nga tshor de 'dra'i dmigs sgo gang yang med pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gcig pu 'di la 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces bshad na dgos pa gang yang mi 'dug da lta nga tshor spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'di mi mang gi don dag dang / bod spyi pa'i don dag la btsugs pa red/gal srid rgya gar la 11da mi btsan byol ba stong phrag brgya las mang tsam zhig gi stong phrag nyis brgya tham pa slebs yod na yang nga tshor spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig med na da cha lo nyi shu tham pa phyin pa'i rjes la phal cher kha 'a11ra tshar ba red/ nga tsho lo nyi shu tham pa phyin pa'i rjes la yang da dung bod pa btsan byol ba zhes pa'i ming yod pa 'di mi mang gi sems shugs gcig tu bsgril ba'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi gong bu'i nus pa 'di'i thog nas byung ba red/ mi'i spyi tshogs gang du yin kyang mi mang gi sems shugs gcig tu bsgril nas gong bu'i nus pa de thon thub kyi yod pa dang / de la brten nas spyi tshogs kyi nang la gzhung gi sgrig 30

'dzugs chags yong gi yod pa red/ gong bu'i nus pa 'di ha cang gal chen po red/ da lta'i sgrig 'dzugs 'dis da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red la/da dung yin kyang hur thag byed kyi red/ gal te nges med kyi ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa'i rgyu mtshan dngos dngos rjen rjen byas nas gnas tshul bshad rgyu yod pa yin na bshad chog gi red/ nga da res 'dir slebs yod pa red/ khyed rang tshor ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa'i gnas tshul rgyu mtshan ldan pa ra sprod 'pher ba'i skad cha bshad rgyu yod na nga la gsal po byas nas bshad rogs byed/ de bzhin rgya gar nang bka' shag la thad gar yi ge btang chog gi red/ spyi 'thus tsho la thad gar yi ge btang chog gi red/ dngos gnas rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i thog nas/ 'di dang 'di lta bu byung 'dug 'di 'grigs kyi mi 'dug skyon 'di 'dug ces thad shar bshad pa yin na brgya cha brgya tham pa dga' bsu zhu gi red/ da1dus gnas drang gnas ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig nas gnyis su bgrangs pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gi thog nas khe gyong bltas nas rgya che'i mi mang gi yid ches brlag pa dang / phan 11gas med pa yin na/las ka bzhag ces lab na bzhag las sla 11 red/ mi'i spyi tshogs nang gi las ka zhig yin dus mi gsar pa zhig slebs yong gi red/ mi gsar pa'i thog nas las ka byas byas/ thabs shes byas na ma 'grigs pa sku1nga gi ma red/ nga tsho dngos gnas kha zhe gnyis med mang gtso'i sgang la 'gro gi yod pa red/ mi su 'dra zhig yin kyang las sha'i 'gan khur byed mkhan gyis phongs pa ma gtogs /byed chog gi ma red zer mkhan su yang med/ rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i dge skyon 31

bshad rgyu yad na mdun la bshad dgas/ mdun la bshad ma nus par dkag gtam rgyab bshad byas na phan thogs gang jigang med/ bden pa yin na mdun la shod dang / ga re 'grig gi mi 'dug ngas nor ba yin na dgongs dag zer gyi red/ nga bcom ldan 'das kyi na bza' gyon mkhan ham rdzun bshad rgyur dga' po med/ de bzhin nga tsho'i las ka byed mkhan tsho yin kyang ngas nor 'dug ces dgongs pa zhu gi red ma gtogs nor med ces sus ham pa bshad kyi red/ tam pa bshad nas la gang 'dra byas nas dag gi reng/ nga tsho rang dbang lung pa'i nang la bsdad yod pa red/ nga tshos drang bden gyi 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod/ drang bden gyi 'thab rtsod byed mkhan gyi mi zhig gis ngo lkog gang 'dra byas nas byed dgos/ nor 'khrul 'dug na mdun la bshad res byas/yin dang min gyi khungs bskyel byas chog gi red/ yin dang min gyi rnam dbye chod thub kyi red/ mdun la ma bshad par rgyab tu gang byung shod rgyu de la cho khyon nas mi 'dug 11 so yang ma skyid pa/ mi gzhan dag kyang bag ma phebs pa chags/ spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi nus pa la yang gnod na yag po mi 'dug skad cha zhig go ba tsam la cha ma bzhag par so sos dge skyon brtag dpyad byed dgos/brtag dpyad byas nas rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yin na ga dus yin kyang de bshad rogs byed/ nga stos dga' bsu zhu gi red/ nga mos dga' zhing spro bzhin du nor bcos byas chog gi red/ dga' bzhin spro bzhin du nga tshos bsgyur bcos btang chodag gi red/ mtha' na mi gcig gi sa nas dngos gnas d+me 'grigs pa zhig 'dug na dga' po byas nas dgongs pa zhus chog gi red/ gnas 32

dbyungs btang chog gi red/ nga rang tsho'i spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di yis phan thogs chen po skudad/ de yag po zhig yong ba la mi mang gi rgyab skyor dgos kyi red/ mi mang gi rgyab skyor yong ba la de la yid ches dgos kyi red/ yid ches yong ba la dkrog gtam la lam seng bden 'dzin min par rgyu ma phu 'ded kyis brtsad gcod yag po byas/ ra 'phrod pa'i rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig 'dug na bshad sa der bshad/ su dza lan ḍir cha bzhag na don gcod btsugs yod pas don gcod kyi thog la thad gar 'di la gsal bshad dgos pa yod/ 'di gang 'dra red/ 'di ci 'dra red ces khyed rang tshos gsal po byas nas dris kyi yin na yag po yong gi red/de bzhin lung tshan gyi 'then 'khyer byed mi rung / nga rang tsho rgya gar lung par slebs pa'i nyin mob de nas chol kha gsum dbye ba med pa/ nga tsho tshang ma mnyam du bsdad pa red/ de rlabs chen po red/ gal chen po red/ rgya mis bod nang bod mi rigs la dbye ba mang po phye yod/ dper na/ bod rang skyong zer ba dang / zi khron khongs la bod rigs dum bu gcig yu nan khongs la bod rigs dum bu gcig kan su'i khongs la bod rigs dum bu gcig mtsho sngon khongs la bod rigs dum bu gcig bcas de 'dra'i dum bu mang po ched mngags bzos yod pa shin tu thabs sdug po red/ nga tshos rgya gar nang la lo nyi shu tham pa 'di'i ring la bod chol kha gsum da bye ba med pa'i thog nas las ka byas te bsdad yod/ bka' blon nang la yin na'ang rung / spyi 'thus nang la yin nang rung / gang du yin kyang chos lugs dang lung tshan dbye ba med 33

par blta rgyu de gal chen po zhig la rtsis nas lag len bstar gyi yod/ rgya gar nang la skusgod pa'i btsan byol bod mi mang nyung jodzig nas bshad pa yin na phal cher stod khul dang / dbus gtsang khul nas mi mang ba yod 'gro/ yin na yang nga tshos de la cha ma bzhag par ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi bsam sdus btang nas chol kha gsum cha snyoms byed stangs de 'dra red/ da phan rgya mi'i 'og la sdug bsngal chol gsum gcig gyur myangs pa red/ rgya mi la ngo rgol yang chol gsum gcig gyur gyi thog nas byed kyi yod pa red/ ma 'ongs pa la nga rang tsho'i bden pa'i bden 'bras gsal te skyid pa'i nyi ma shar ba'i skabs la yang nga tsho chol gsum gcig gyur thog gnas thub pa los dgos/ 'das pa'i 'o rgyus kyi nang la chol gsum chab srid gcig gyur min pa'i gnas tshul byung yod na yang /bod mi rigs kyi bsam blo dang / bod mi rigs kyi shes rig thog la chol kha gsum gyi bsam tshul 'du shes gcig tu bsgril nas bsdad yod pa red/ dper na/ gdan sa khag gis mtshon pas ris su ma chad pa'i dgon sde mang po yod sa dbus gtsang khul yin kyang gra rgyun mdo stod smad gnyis nas yong gi yod pa red/ de dag gi thog nas nga tsho chos dang rig gzhung gcig gyur gyi thog la phyin pa red/ gcig gyur gyi thog nas bod mi rigs la zhabs 'degs mang po bsgrub yod/ chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba 'di'i 'og nas bod mi rigs kyi ngo bo ma brlag par gnas thub pa byung yod/ bod kha bral nas dum bu mang por phyin pa yin na ha cang nyen kha chen po red/ des bod mi rigs spyi la gnod kyi red/ 'das pa'igeng rgyus nang la nga tsho srid don gyi thog nas chig bsgril 34

ma thub kyang / chos dang shes rig gi thog nas nus pa chen po thon yod pa red/da lta'i gnas skabs la yang bod mi tshang ma gong bu gcig gyur gyis thog nas rgya mi la ngo rgol byed kyi yod pa red/ ma 'ongs pa la yin kyang chos/ shes rig srid don tshang ma'i thog nas gcig bsgril bya rgyu de nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i dam bca' red/ gnad don 'di la tshang mas yid zab byed dgos/rgya gar nang la/ rgya gar gzhung dang nga tsho'i 'brel ba ha cang ya ga po yod/ gtso che shos nga rang tsho'i ngos nas drang pos gzhung bsrangs/ lhag bsam rnam dag byas nas bsdad pa'i nyer len gyis deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi che btsan rgyal khab tsho'i dgra gnyen la 'gyur/ gnyen dgra la 'gyur na yang /nga tsho'i thog la tshang mas blta stangs rnam 'gyur 'gyur dgos don gang yang med/'di ga su'i si'i nang la don gcod yod par brten/ 'di khul gnas tshul gang byung thad kur 7snyan zhu yong gi yod pa red/ spyir btang gi gnas tshul ngas shes kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang da res nyin shas ring dngos su so so mig gis mthong ba'i gnas tshul la/ phyogs gcig nas tshang ma lto gos kyi mthun rkyen yag thag chod red/ de'i thog la lo re nas lo re mi 'dra bar gzhon skyes mang po 'tshar longs yong gi yod pa red/ gzhon skyes tsho bod don thog la do snang chen po yod mkhan/ so so'i mi rigs kyi thog la sems shugs dang / dmigs bsal gyi do snang chen po byed kyi yod pa la ha cang dga' po byung / da dung yang gtso che shos dpal 'byor yag po yod pa'i lung pa'i nang 35

la dgos med rgyas 1sgos stor rkyen ma byas par gsog 'jog byas/ rgya gar nang la pha ma spun nye de 'dra'i thog la rogs ram 'dra byas na phan thogs yong gi red/ gzhon skyes tshos da lta bar du sems shugs chen po byas pa yag po 'dug da dung yin kyang kha sang gzhon nu kha shas thug pa'i skabs la skad cha byung ba bzhin/ bod pa'i skad yig la do snang byed dgos/ bod pa'i gnas tshul shes rgyu de gal chen po red/ de'i thog la khyed rang tsho gzhon skyes slob sbyong byed thub mkhan tshos slob sbyong thog la nges par du dwang bstod byed dgos/sud si 'jar man gyi skad yig shes pa tsam gyis 'grig gi ma red/ skad de brjod byed kyi tshig yin pa red/ de brgyud nas brjod bya'i don mang po zhig shes dgos pas nges par du mtho rim gyi slob sbyong byed rgyu gal chen po 'dugarang dbang lung pa'i nang la shes yon gyi gnas tshad gang la gang 'tshams yod ces spobs pa byed kyi yod pa ltar/ khyed rang tshor go skabs yag po dang / de 'dra'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms nas yod stabs nges par du mtho rim ches mtho'i slob sbyong byas te phyin chad tshan rig dang / bzo las/ em rje la sogs pa'i rigs gcig mkhas pa byed thub pa'i 'bad brtson byed dgos/ de 'dra byung na rang rang sger so so'i thog la yin na yang gzi brjid red la/ bod mi rigs kyi gzi brjid red/ kha sang rgya gram dmar po'i tshogs pa'i las byed pa kha shas thug byung / khong tshos bod pa'i phru gu slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs yod pa dang /byed thub mkhan tshos slob sbyong gang la gang 'tshams byung ba dang de nas slob mtshams bzhag ste bzo gra'i nang la phyin/ dngul gsog rgyu'i 'phral sel gyi 36

dgos pa chung chung gi las ka byed pa de gyong gun chen po red/ yag po mi 'dug ces de 'dra bshad kyi 'dug de bden pa red/ gang ltar rgya gram dmar po'i tshogs pa'i bsam 'char skusad min la ma ltos par nga rang tshor go skabs yag po dang / mthun rkyen 'dzoms nas yod pa 'di nges par du bed spyod byas nas phyin chad so so'i mi rigs kyi nang la deng dus kyi shes sku(na tshad mthor son pa de 'dra gang mang thon thub pa byed dgos/ gnad don de la phru gu so sos kyang do snang byed dgos pa dang / pha ma spun mched tshos kyang 'bod skul byas/ de tsho'i thog la don gcod nas kyang phar tshur thabs shes 'bod bskul lam ston byed dgos/ yang de 'dra'i thog la 'gro song 'dra dgos kyi yod na mi mang gi bde rtsa'i thog la gtong rgyu'i spyi dngul 'dra dang / don gcod kyi 'gro song thog la gtong rgyu'i dmigs sgo phran bu yod pa de 'dra'i thog nas phan thogs byed thub min go bsdur 'dra byas/ gang ltar yang snying mtho rim gyi slob sbyong bon pa'i rigs gcig mkhas pa gang mang thon thub pa'i ngas re ba byed kyi yod/bar lam nga rang tsho gsum bcu'i dus chen gyis mtshon pas de 'dra'i skabs la khyed rang tshos gdug rtsub dang / ma rabs kyi rnam pa med pa/ ya rabs 'jam wa'i rnam 'gyur thog nas bod kyi bden don ched rngams ston khrom skor byed stangs de tsho'i gras yag po byung 'dug de tsho'i thog la khyed rang tsho mi mang gi thog nas dang blangs kyi zhal 'debs bsdu sprod byas pa sogs khyed rang tshos dmigs bsal gyis khur blangs pa der dga' po byung / dus rgyun gtan nas rang rang so sos bod don skor do snang byas/ chab srid kyi gnas 37

tshul shes pa byas/ go skabs byung ba'i skabs la mda' 'ben sar 'khyol ba'i gzi brjid ldan pa'i thog nas dril bsgrags dang / 'bod bskul byas na ha cang yag po 'dug dga' po byung / thugs rje che zhes zhu gi yod/de nas 'dir chos byed dge 'dun pa khya shas shig yod pa red/ khyed tshos da phan hur thag gnang gi yod pa red/ thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu yin/ da dung yin na yang nga rang tsho'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di ngoms chog pa dang / gzi brjid ston thub nges shig yod pas da dung yin kyang hur thag gnang rogs gnang zhu rgyu yin/ 'dir gnad 'gag gcig gang yod zer na/ kha sa kha nyin zhu rgyu byung ba bzhin/ bod nang gi byed stangs de ga rang byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yang yod pa ma red/ spyir gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa sna tshogs yin/ lhag don 'di nas tshur shes bya'i 'du shes kyi thog nas nang pa'i chos slob sbyong byed mkhan mang po yong gi red/ log lta can gyi mi de 'dra yang tan tan yong gi red/ de tsho gnas tshul tha dad red/ nang pa'i chos 'di dad pa yod mkhan 'ba' zhig la lkog tu bstan dgos pa zhig rtsa ba nas ma red/ nga tsho'i nang pa'i chos 'di bsreg btub 'pher ba/ su la yang bshad chog pa dang / bstan chog pa zhig red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs snying don de nga tshos bstan thub pa zhig byung na 'gro ba mi'i spyi tshogs nang shes rig 'dra mi 'dra dang / ye shu la sogs pa'i chos lugs 'dra mi 'dra/ chos khyon nas med mkhan tshang mar phan thogs spongad pa zhig yin/ dper na/ ma'o tse tung gis kyang rang bde don gnyer gyi blo nyung tsam gyis/ gzhan bde don 38

gnyer gyi blo mang tsam byed dgos zer gyi yod pa red/ skye ba snga phyi khas ma blangs/las rgyu 'bras khas mi len pa'i mi yin na'ang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snying don bslab bya de kun la mkho ba zhig red/ snying don de nga chos dang len byed thub pa byung na yag po red/ de min nga rang tshos 'don pa 'dra bton/ mi la 'grel bshad zhib phra zhig byed ma thub/ mi tshos gnad don gang yang mgo ma 'tshos par mthong tshul mang po zhig yong ba 'di tsho yag po gang yang mi 'dugasngon ma rdo je gdan la mchod 'bul byed pa'i skabs la/ rdo je gdan gyi dge slong tshos bla ma mchod pa brke(na gyi yod pa red/ 'dra chags po zhig rtsa ba nas mthong ma byung / rdo rje gdan la bcom ldan 'das kyi rten khyad par can de'i drung la mchod 'bul byed dus ris su ma chad pa'i nang pa mang po/ dper na/tha'i lan gyi dge slong dang / sing ga la'i dge slong de 'dra 'dus yong gi yod pa red/ nang pa min pa'i lhan rdu de 'dra mang po 'dus yong gi yod pa red/ bod pa'i nang nas mchod 'bul byed pa'i skabs su 'dul ba nas bkag pa'i sha dang chang sgrig de'i sgang la dung dang rgya gling btang ste 'dra mi 'dra byas yong dus khyad mtshar po zhig chags pa red/ sngags kyi skabs su sha lnga dang / bdud rtsi lnga sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum byed pa'i nyams len khyad par ba bshad pa ma gtogs/ las dang po pas gang byung byed rgyu bshad yod pa ma red/ 'di dag la 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu skusgod pa tsam gyis 'grig gi yod na/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis skusangs grags byas nas gsang sngags gnang dgos tshod red de gnang med/ gdul bya pha rol po mang tshogs kyi blo la 'jug po zhig 39

ma byung na phan thogs med par brten bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang sngags mkhyen te gsang sngags kyi lam bstan yod na yang / gdul bya yongs grags kyi ngo la nyan thos kyi gzhung nas bstan pa'i dge slong nang bzhin byas nas bzhugs kyi yod pa red/ bod nang gi bzang po g.yam rgyugs kyi goms gshis 'di tshor do snang byed dgos/ rdo rje gdan la mchod 'bul byed stangs de bstan 'gyur nang la yod pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi bstod pa/ yan lag bdun pa'i gsol 'debs dang bcas pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i khyad par 'phags bstod la sogs pa de tsho'i gras tshig bzang po/ don bzang po/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa tshang mas gcig gyur la bton chog pa dbyin ji dang / hin di la sogs rma skad yig 'dra mi 'dra sum cu bzhi bcu'i nang la bsgyur nas bton pa yin kyang thams cad la rtsod pa med pa/ thams cad kyi dad pa jog snang 'phel ba'i rgyur 'gro mkhan 'di tsho'i gras bton gyi yin na gzi brjid chen po 'dugadangos gnas ha las pa'i yag po 'dug gsang sngags lkog chos red/ lkog chos de yongs grags byas na dge la 'gro gi yod dam/ skyon la 'gro gi yod bshad khag po red/ mgo ma 'tshos pa zhig gis gcig byed kyin bsdad pa yin na mchod 'bul la bltas bsdad mkhan tshos mchod 'bul zhig gnang song /ga re yin nam shes ma sku/nga bsam pa zhig byung na byab gangayang mi 'dug mthong rgyu ga re mthong yod dam zer na/ sha chang bsgrigs pa de mthong yong bod pa'i gra pa tshos 'tshe ba med pa'i nang pa'i chos byed kyi yod zer yang / sha za gi 'dug ces bsnyad smod byed yul zhig chags kyi yod pa red/ de la rgyu mtshan 40

mang po bshad rgyu yod kyang / rgyu mtshan de dag ma bshad gong mi la rnam rtog skyes tshar dus khyad mtshar zhig mthong gi yod pa red/ de khyed rang tshor ngas 'phros bshad lta bur zhus pa yin/ khyed rang tsho chos byed rnam pa tshos dgongs pa bzhes/ rdo the gdan la mchod 'bul byed dus 'don rgyu'i phyogs bsgrigs dpe cha zhig yod/ de da res 'khyer mi 'dug mjug la tshur btang thub na khyed rang tshos gzigs/ spyi yongs kyi mchod 'bul byed rgyu de tsho'i thog nas byas pa yin na yag gi red bsam gyi 'dugan ning gsum bcu'i dus chen gyi bka' shag gsung bshad nang la gsal ba ltar/ nga lce2) chos tshogs khag gi las 'gan gtso bo chos kyi thog nas yin na yang / nga rang tsho bod mi rigs yin pa'i cha nas bod kyi srid don gyi thog la rgyun du do snang yod pa dang / go skabs yod pa de 'dra byung na bod kyi dngos yod bden pa'i gnas tshul gang yod pa rnams gsal bshad gnang thub pa byung na yag po red/ khyed rang tsho'i chos tshogs khag la mi 'dra mi 'dra thug 'phrad yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas dri ba 'dra mi 'dra yong rgyur/ gsal bshad lan 'debs byed bde yod pa yin na/ lam seng gsal bshad byas/yang / rtsod pa dogs 'dri ya mtshan po de 'dra dang / khyad mtshar po de 'dra byung ba yin na de tsho brjed tho zin bris brgyab/ nang khul phan tshun dus dus la go bsdur de 'dra yong ba'i skabs la de tsho go bsdur byas/ de tsam du ma zad rgya gar nang la'ang btang nas 'di 'dra 'di 'dra'i rtsod pa dang dogs 'dri yong gi 'dug lan 'debs gsal bshad byed phyogs gang legs zhes btang ba 41

yin na nga tsho nang khul go bsdur byed rgyu dang / de tsho'i gras gnas tshul mang tsam shes pa la phan thogs yong gi red/ de 'dra dran byung / gzhan zhu rgyu med/da lta nga tsho dus tshod gnyan 'phrang zhig gi sgang la slebs yod/ da lta phan la nga tsha'i gnas stangs 'di'i thog nas rgya mi la bzod ma bde zhig chags nas rgya mis nga tshor 'brel ba dang thabs shes byed pa'i dus skabs shig tu slebs yod pa red/ nga tshos da lta phan la lhag bsam rnam dag dang / rgyab mdun ngo lkog med pa/ drang pos gzhungs bsrangs nas bden don 'thab rtsod byas pa ltar da dung mu mthud nas byas te shugs bskyed thub pa yin na/ bod spyi pa'i don dag gi bden mtha' myur du gsal ba zhig dang / 'bras bu bzang po zhig yong ba'i re ba chen po yod pas/ tshang mas hur thag 'bad thag byed rogs zhes zer rgyu yin/ tshang mar ngas bkra shis bde legs yod/ tshang ma sems skyid po byas nas sdod/ tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don dag ma brjed pa dang / sems bzang po byas/ gcig gis gcig la 'cham po byas/ nga'i ngos nas khyed rang tshor rtag tu smon lam rgyag rgyu sogs los byed/ da res nga sud dza lan la khyed ra nga mi mang gi thog nas mgron 'bod byas ste 'gro song 'di dag btang ba red/ nga rang yang de'i zhor la brtag dpyad sman bcos byas te yag po byung / mi mang la brdabs gsigs chags song bsam nas nga'i sems nang 'tsher shur shur yong gi 'dug ste/ khyed rang tsho tshang mas ha cang dga' po byas pa la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ bkra shis bde legs zhes bka' 355// //42

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1 981 zla 7 tshes 14 nyin a rir dus 'khor gsung chos skabs bod mi tshor pung5 ba'i bka' slob/nga rang tsho thug pa la ha cang dga' po byung / dus 'khor dbang chen zhu rgyu'i don du khyed rang tsho ched mngags do snang chen po byas te 'byor pa red/yag po byung 'dug kha sa bka' chos sar lab pa bzhin/ gtso che shos nga tsho tshang mas sems rgyud bzang po byed dgos/ mi ya rabs byed dgos pa/ de shin tu gal chen po red/ tshe phyi ma'i thag ring po'i skad cha bshad ma dgos par mi tshe 'di ga'i ring la ji tsam gyi mi ya rabs pa dang / spyod pa bzang po byung na nyin re nyin re'i sdod bzod bde ba zhig dang / sems skyid pa/ rogs pa tshang ma bag phebs pa/ mi tshang mas rang bzhin gyi dga' po byed rgyu zhig chags yong gi red/ nga rang tsho tshang mas chos don du gnyer gyi yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi bslab bya rtsa ba de ni sems bzang po byed rgyu de yin/sems rgyud dul po zhig dang / mi ya rabs shig byed kyi yin na so so 'phral du skyid po gcig dang / bag phebs po yong gi red/ sems nang la zhi zhing dul ba dang bag phebs po zhig ma byung na skyid po yong rgyu khag po/ red/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bslab bya sems dul po dang / sems bzang po byed dgos gsungs pa de tshe phyi ma khas ma blangs par tshe 'di ga 'ba' zhig gi bsam blo gtong mkhan la yang bslab bya de shin tu rtsa ba chen po dang / spus dag po zhig yin/ nga rang tsho tshang ma ston pa bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi gi yod/dper na nga rang cha bzhag pa yin na yang / ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bslab bya 43

sems bzang po byed dgos pa dang / gzhan phan yag po byed dgos gsungs pa'i bslab bya de nyal langs 'gro 'dug gang gi skabs suyang de bsam blo 'khor yong dus dngos gnas drang gnas bslab bya de rtsa ba chen po dang / kha yod lag yod kyi sems la shin tu phan po yong gi 'dug so so'i sems nang la gzhan phan byed rgyu'i bsam blo dang / ya rabs byed rgyu'i bsam blo'i goms pa gang 'tshams shig skusgod na gra ma 'grigs shig don pa yin na yang skabs der ca ma ming bsam pa dran gyi 'dug ste/ yin na yang kho ga le ga ler yal 'gro rgyu red/rtsa ba gzhan phan bsgrub rgyu'i bsam cho de gang la gang 'tshams kyi brtan po zhig yod pa yin na/ kha chag sna ral byung skabs la bsun po 'dra po zhig ma gtogs sems nang yun ring po bsdad kyi mi 'dug gzhan phan bsgrub stangs de yang nga rang tsho'i nang pa'i chos kyi nang la mi tshe gcig gi don dag dang /nyi ma gcig gnyis kyi don dag tsam ma yin par/ bskal pa nas bskal pa/ skye ba nas skye ba/ mdor na spyod 'jug las gsungs pa bzhin/ ji srid nam mkha' ma zad bar dang / sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can nam yod kyi bar la gzhan don bsgrub rgyu'i bsam blo skyes nas yong dus snying stobs skye ba'i bslab bya dngos gnas ha las pa zhig red/ nga rang tshos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi bslab bya rnams so sos nyams len byas/ dngos gnas drang gnas nyin re nyin re so so'i 'tsho ba'i nang la spyod thub pa zhig byung ba yin na/ sems bag phebs pa/ snying stobs skyes rgyu/ sems bzod bde ba yong ba sogs la phan thogs shin tu chen 11 yod/ nga rang tshos kha nas bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes bshad 44

kyi yod/ nang pa'i chos la so so dad pa dang / dga' mos shig byed kyi yod/skyabs 'gro kha nas bton pa tsam gyis 'grig gi yod pa ma red/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya rnams sems la bcangs nas ngo thog lag len la 'gel rgyu de dngos gnas gal chen po red/ ngas rtag par bshad bsdad mus de red/ nga rang tshos skabs re snang ba skyid wa'i chos 'dra po chags te kha nas chos bshad rgyuyod mkhan/ lag len gyi thog kha chag sna ral byung ba'i skabs la chos brjed de rgyag res rgyag dgos sar rgyag res brgyab/ kha btang dgos sar kha btang /'khrug pa rgyag dgos sar 'khrug pa brgyabs te sdod pa de ma 'grigs pa red/chos kyi bslab bya'i nang nga rang tsho sems rgyud bzang po byed dgos pa dang / mi tshang ma mthun po byed dgos pa/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad so so'i pha mar gyur pa sha stag dang / drin chen po sha stag red/ de dag la phan btags dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar nga rang tshos dus rgyun ldan nas gcig gis gcig la rogs yag po byas/ gcig gis gcig la phan sems byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po yin pas de khyed rang tshos rgyun du sems la bcang dgos/da res dus 'khor dbang chen zhus nas thub rogs byas na dus 'khor bla ma'i rnal 'byorate nyi ma re la tshar drug re bton thub na thun drug gi go chod pa/ spas dag po yod pa red/ gal srid de 'dra lcog gi med pa yin na/ nyi ma re zlo thun re tsam ma chag pa bton thub na yag po red/ dus 'khor bla ma'i rnal 'byor de'i nang don dag yag po yod/ nyin mo dang / mtshan mo dran dgos pa de tsho'i gras dran gso gtong rgyu cha tshang yod pa'i thog la/ dus 'khor 45

kyi yod/ nang pa'i chos la so so dad pa dang / dga' mos shig byed kyi yod/skyabs 'gro kha nas bton pa tsam gyis 'grig gi yod pa ma red/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya rnams sems la bcangs nas ngo thog lag len la 'gel rgyu de dngos gnas gal chen po red/ ngas rtag par bshad bsdad mus de red/ nga rang tshos skabs re snang ba skyid wa'i chos 'dra po chags te kha nas chos bshad rgyuyod mkhan/ lag len gyi thog kha chag sna ral byung ba'i skabs la chos brjed de rgyag res rgyag dgos sar rgyag res brgyab/ kha btang dgos sar kha btang /'khrug pa rgyag dgos sar 'khrug pa brgyabs te sdod pa de ma 'grigs pa red/chos kyi bslab bya'i nang nga rang tsho sems rgyud bzang po byed dgos pa dang / mi tshang ma mthun po byed dgos pa/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad so so'i pha mar gyur pa sha stag dang / drin chen po sha stag red/ de dag la phan btags dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar nga rang tshos dus rgyun ldan nas gcig gis gcig la rogs yag po byas/ gcig gis gcig la phan sems byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po yin pas de khyed rang tshos rgyun du sems la bcang dgos/da res dus 'khor dbang chen zhus nas thub rogs byas na dus 'khor bla ma'i rnal 'byorate nyi ma re la tshar drug re bton thub na thun drug gi go chod pa/ spas dag po yod pa red/ gal srid de 'dra lcog gi med pa yin na/ nyi ma re zlo thun re tsam ma chag pa bton thub na yag po red/ dus 'khor bla ma'i rnal 'byor de'i nang don dag yag po yod/ nyin mo dang / mtshan mo dran dgos pa de tsho'i gras dran gso gtong rgyu cha tshang yod pa'i thog la/ dus 'khor 45

gyi lha sgom rgyu dang / dus 'khor gyi sngags bgrang rgyu sogs cha tshang ba zhig yod/cho ga bsdus bsdus yin na yang bsdus bsdus la dpags pa'i sne kha 'dzoms po dang / don dag cha tshang po spas dag po zhig yod/ dus 'khor bla ma'i rnal 'byor de nyin re nyin re tshar re btsam bton thub na yag po yong gi red/ mtha' ma de yang ma thub na dus 'khor gyi sngags gang 'tshams re chag med bgrang thub na phan gyi red/bod nang la yod mkhan bod pa tsho rang bzhin gyis rgya mi dang mi 'dra ba'i gshis ka legs pa dang / kun spyod bzang ba yod pa de mang po zhig gis mthong gi yod pa red/ bar lam bod la blta skor la 'gro mkhan phyi rgyal mi de 'dra kha shas thug 'phrad byung / de tsho mang che bas bod pa'i gshis ka dang / rgya mi'i gshis ka khyon nas 'dra gi mi 'dug bod pa'i gshis ka ha cang yag po 'dugadaka' ngal de 'dra zhig gi 'og dang / dngangs skrag de 'dra zhig gi 'og la bsdad yod na yang rang bzhin gyis bag phebs po dang / snang ba skyid po'i rnam 'gyur yod mkhan/ grogs po'i rnam 'gyur bzang po yod pa ha cang yag po 'dug rgya mi dang / bod pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi khyad par shin tu chen po 'dug ces de 'dra mang po bshad kyi 'dug rgya gar la yin na yang de de bzhin red/ bod rigs spyir btang bshad yong dus lto gos grung po/ drang po yod mkhan/ mi gzhung bzang po/ gzhung brtsi rgyu yod mkhan zhig yod/ bod phyi nang gang du yin na yang spyir btang gi thog nas bshad pa yin na bod rigs rnams mi 'dra 'dra'i nang nas zhabs 'dren mi zhu mkhan zhig mi 'dra 'dra'i nang nas gang la gang 46

'tshams kyi spus dag wa'i phyogs la bzhag chog pa zhig chags yod/ 'di dag gi rgyu rkyen gang nas byung ba'i rtsa ba thug sa de nga rang tsho la sha rus mi 'dra ba gang yang med kyang / nga rang tsho'i mi che'i nang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bslab bya de gzhi la bzhag pa'i goms gshis kyi thog nas byung ba yin/ mi ya rabs byed pa gcig dang / sems rgyud bzang po byed pa rtag par kha la 'jags bsdad yod/ dper na/ srog chag phra mo 'bu srin zhig yin na yang snying rje zer ba zhig chos gting zab po ma shes kyang pha ma'i ngag rgyun nas slebs mkhan zhig dang / goms bsdad mkhan zhig yin/ che sa mi'i srog la brtsi srung byed pa lta ci smos/ so sos srog gcod rgyu phar bzhag nas mi gcig bsad pa go na yang / a tsi gang drag zer ba 'dra po/ skad cha de yang nyan ma nus pa'i bzo 'dra po snga mo yin na de 'dra byed kyi red/ bar lam rgya mis ni mi dmar bsad gtong ba dang / ltog shi thebs pa de tsho'i gras la do snang ci yang byed kyi med/gang ltar yang snying nga rang tsho spyir btang bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la snying rje de rtsa ba chen po 'dzin gyi yod pa'i rkyen pas rang bzhin gyis spyi tshogs nang mi gzhan zhig la sdug pa 'dra po zhig dang / dka' ngal byung ba yin na/ ma mtha' yin na'i kha nasa.a kha zer ba 'dra po dang / snying rje zer ba zhig gi ngam ngam shug shug gi thon yong gi yod/ ston pa'i bslab bya 'di yis bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la de lta bu'i shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod/ nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang la ngo tsha khrel med kyi mi yong lta yong gi red de/ yin na yang spyir btang bshad pa yin na mi gdong brtan po 'dra po/ mi gcig gis gcig la las ka zhig mngags 47

gtam bcol ba yin na yang / khos nga la re ba byas nas mngags byung / ngas ma bsgrub na 'grigs kyi ma red bsams pa'i gzhung bzang po yod pa red/ deng sang nga rang tsho'i mi thog 'di dus tshod gnyan 'phrang gi skabs la skyes pa'i mi thog shig yin pas/ nga rang tsho tshang mas nga rang tsho'i bod pa'i goms gshis nang la yod pa'i legs cha 'di dag la nges par du do snang byas/ bzang po'i yon tan bzang po la ngo shes pa byed rgyu 'di dngos gnas gal chen po red bsams pa dran gyi 'dug nga rang tsho la bzang po'i yon tan yod pa 'di dag bzang po'i yon tan yin pa la ngo shes ma thub pa dang / do snang ma byung bar snang med la mi thog gcig phyin/ mi thog gnyis phyin/ gang 'tshams nas bzang po'i legs cha rnams brlag song ba yin na shin tu phangs po red/ do snang dang bdag ces byas nas ma byung na 'gyod pa med/ dang po nas nga rang tshos so sor rin thang yod pa 'di rin thang can la ngos 'dzin ma thub pa'i ngang la snang med du phyin/ de'i zhor la so so'i phru gu tshos de las kyang do snang chung ba byas/ de'i rjes ma des de las kyang do snang chung ba byas pa yin na mjug tu rtsa brlag 'gro rgyu'i nyen ka yod/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i goms gshis dang /bod pa'i spyir btang gi bsam blo gtong stangs dang / spyir btang gi mig tos bzang po dang / ya rabs kyi mig ltos yod pa 'di mi'i spyi tshogs nang la gal chen po gcig yin pa shes dgos/ nga rang tsho'i lung pa dpal 'byor thog nas skyo po red de/ yin na yang spyir btang gi mi'i spyi tshogs nang la nga tsho ya rabs dang drang bden gyi rigs rtsis sa yod pa'i spyi tshogs shig yin dus de 48

dngos gnas gal chen po yin bsam pa'i ngos 'dzin gsal po byed pa dang /ga tshad thub thub kyi der do snang byed rgyu gal chen po yin/ des nga rang tshor phan gyi red/ kha yod lag yod red/ bod la gnas tshul 'gyur ba thabs skyo ca zhig byung ste nga rang tsho mi gzhan gyi lung pa bcu drug tsam gyi nang la kha 'thor te gnas yod/ bod pa zhes phran bu'i mi 'dra tsam zhig byas nas bsdad thub pa 'di nga rang tsho la rig gzhung bzang po zhig yod pa 'dis rkyen pas 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gyi bsam blo gtong stangs kyi thog la phran bu'i khyad par yod pa dang /gzhi rtsa de'i thog nas nga rang tsho bod pa zhes byas nas zur gsal thon yong gi yod/ nga tsho rgya gar la bsdad pa'i nang la yin na yang / bod pa zur gsal du bsdad yod/ de bzhin phyi rgyal du sdod mkhan bod pa tsho yin na yang / ga re byas rung rnam 'gyur zur du yod mkhan zhig chags yod/ ma gzhi lung pa 'di dang de'i nang la lto gos btsal/ lung pa de dang de'i nang la mi tshe bskyel stangs cha tshang zhig shes kyi yod na yang / bod pa rnams zur gsal du gnas pa 'di nga rang tsho la skad yig dang / shes rig goms gshis bcas tha dad cig yod pa'i gzhi rtsa 'di'i thog nas nga rang tsho bod pa rnams zur gsal du gnas thub yod/ tshur phyogs rgya gar/ phar phyogs rgya mi/ de bzhin lung pa gzhan gang dang gang / skad yig 'dra min gang yin rung nga rang tsho la rig gzhung tha dad cig yod bsdad pa 'di'i thog nas dbye ba phye thub kyi yod/ de 'dra yin dus ma 'ongs pa la yin na yang / nga rang tsho'i rig gzhung dang / bzang po'i goms gshis zur gsal zhig yod pa 'di dag rtsa ba chen por rtsis te do 49
