la legs nyes gnyis lnga'i 'du shes med par sdod kyi yod red/ gang ltar 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la chos yod mkhan zhig dang / chos la ched mngags skyon 'dogs mkhan zhig yang chos la btang snyoms su 'jog mkhan zhig bcas rigs gsum yod/ de gsum ga bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa nga rang sto dang sgo kun nas mtshungs pa red/ rang rang so so'i bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs shes dang / sdug bsngal sel ba'i thabs shes byed stangs thad la so so'i yid ches dang / bsam blo gtong stangs mi 'dra ba chags bsdad kyi yod/ de'i nang nas nga rang tsho chos yod mkhan des chos byed dgos/ tshe blos gtong dgos/ mi tshe gcig gi don dag brjed dgos ces zer gyi yod pa ma red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi nang du phun tshogs sde bzhi zhes bshad yod/ nga rang tsho 'gro ba mi'i rigs ga༄0 nar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad la gnas skabs mngon mtho'i bde skyid dang / mthar thug thar pa'i lam la bgrod dgos pa 'di yin pa red/ de lta bu'i gnas skabs kyi mngon mtho'i 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i bde skyid cig dang / mthar thug thar pa'i bde skyid gnyis po 'di sgrub pa'i thabs shes la chos dang / nor gnyis bshad pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas phun tshogs sde bzhi zhes bshad yong dus gnas skabs mi'i mi tshe'i ring dpal 'byor longs spyod gang ci'i thog nas gra 'grigs phun sum tshogs pa'i mi tshe bskyel rgyu yod pa zhig dang / mthar thug thar pa'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i 'gro stangs dang / dmigs yul 'di chags bsdad yod pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos pa zhig gi ngos nas mi tshe 147

'di'i ring la lto gos kyi las don tshags tshud po zhig dang / yar rgyas 'gro thub pa byed dgos/ de yang / gzhan la 'tshe ba dang / gnod 'tshe'i rang bzhin ma 'dres pa zhig dgos/ 'dzugs skrun byas pa dang chabs cig tshe 'di 'ba' zhig ma gtogs bsam blo ma 'khor ba ma yin par phyi ma'i don dag de yang ma brjed pa byas te gang ltar 'di phyi gnyis yod gcig gi thog nas mi tshe bskyel dgos kyi yod/ de nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos pa zhig gi mi che'i 'gro stangs red/ shes song ngam/ 'phral dang phugs byas na phugs gal che ba yin dus thar pa'i go 'phang sgrub rgyu 'di gal chen po red/ thar pa'i go 'phang sgrub thabs su dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i thog nas las 'bras la lag len bkal te thog mar chotshe /na mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i dbang gis byung ba'i lus ngag gi nyes spyod sdom pa de rim pa dang po yin/ lus ngag gi nyes spyod sdom pa tsam gyis mi chog par lus ngag gi nyes spyod gang la brten nas byung ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu sems ma dul ba la thug pa yin dus sems rgyud ma rung ba byed pa'i nyon mongs 'dod chags dang / khong khro/ nga rgyal dang / phrag dog de tsho nga rang tsho'i sems rgyud la yod pa rnams med pa bzo dgos/ nyon mongs med pa'i sems rgyud gtsang ma bzos pa'i thog nas thar pa'i go 'phang sgrub dgos/ de ltar na lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len byed dgos pa red/de yang mdor bsdus na nga rang tsho'i bsgrub bya bde ba dang / sel bya sdug bsngal gnyis/ de la yang rgyu gnyis yod pas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi bshad pa red/de yang sdug bsngal 'grub pa'i rgyu kun 'byung bden pa dang / gtan du bde 148

ba thar pa'i bde ba sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu lam gyi bden pa zhes bshad pa red/chos dkon mchog ngo ma 'di thar pa'i lam gyi bden pa zer ba 'di yin pa red/de lta bu'i chos dkon mchog ngo ma thar pa'i lam gyi bden pa rang rgyud la skyes pa la de yi sngon la bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len byed dgos/ de'i rtsa ba mi dge bcu spongs kyi tshul khrims la blang dor byed dgos/ de'i rtsa ba la las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag shes dgos/ las rgyu 'bras shes pa'i sgo nas macesag gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro dang bcas te las rgyu 'bras lag len bkal dgos/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i thog nas thar pa'i bden pa bzhi las brtsams pa'i lam bslab pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos nyams len byas te thar pa'i go 'phang sgrub dgos/ de lta'i thar pa de la yang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam zad pa'i thar pa zhig dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam du ma zad/ shes bya'i sgrib pa yang zad pa'i thar pa 'am/ yang snying sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhes gnyis bshad pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs la bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems zer ba 'di dgos pa yin/ theg pa che chung gnyis su khyad par 'byed chos ni byang chub kyi sems zer ba de la thug yod/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems zer ba 'di gzhi la bzhag ste de'i steng nas phar phyin drug gi nyams len la brtson pa'i sgo nas nges legs mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub thabs gsungs pa red/ nga rang tsho'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs la yod pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 149

'di da lta shri ri lang ga dang / 'bar ma/ tha lan rnams la yod pa dang gcig gyur red/ 'phags pa gnas brtan sde pa'i lugs nas bshad pa'i bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len gyi gzhi rtsa'i 'gro stangs de rnams nga rang tsho bod gangs can pa'i ljongs la slob gnyer byed kyi yod la nyams len yang byed kyi yod/ 'di gzhi la bzhag pa'i thog la bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang / byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa'i thog nas spyod pa phyin drug la slob kyi yod/ de'i rtsa ba de sems bskyed yin dus nga rang tshos dus rgyun ldan nas sems bzang sngos byed dgos/ gzhan la phan sems yag po byed dgos/ gzhan la gnod sems bya rgyu yod pa ma red/ de lta bu'i theg chen byang chub kyi sems kyi nyams len dang 'brel ba'i thog nas sngags kyi nyams len byed dgos/sngags zer ba 'di la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i zab khyad dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad 'gag yod pa red/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs la gsang sngags dar so chen po yod/ phyi nyan thos kyi theg pa/ nang byang sems kyi theg pa/gsang ba sngags kyi theg pa bcas mi gcig gis dus tshod gcig la nyan thos kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i lam gyi nyams len dang de ga nang bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod nas gsungs pa'i lam gyi nyams len/ sngags kyi sde snod nas gsungs pa'i lam gyi nyams len de thams cad dus gcig tu nyams len byas chog pa de 'dra'i srol rgyun bzang po nga rang tsho bod du yod pa 'di yin pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin zer bzhin du nang pa'i chos yag po ma shes pa de 'dra yong gi 'dug pa de ni ha cang gi blo pham po dang / thabs skyo po red/150

nang pa'i chos shes pa'i thog nas rang nyid nang chos la dad pa yod pa zhig byed dgos pas nang pa'i chos shes thabs 'bad brtson byed dgos/ khyed rang tshos nang pa'i chos yag po shes thabs la do snang byed dgos/ khyed rang tsho 'dir dgon pa'i nye 'khris su yod pa red/ 'dir bla grwa kha shas shig yod pa red/ khyed rang tsho las lnga'i dus tshod bar gseng yod pa'i skabs la nang pa'i 'gro stangs phran ba shes thabs byas na shes tshad yag tu 'gro gi red/ nang pa'i chos spas ra pa r+sārang dag po yod na'ang so sos ma shes na so sor gyong gun red/ chos yag po shes dgos pa red/ chos kyi don dag ma shes pa dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi zab khyad spus dag po yod pa de dag nyams len byed ma thub par/ da dung nang pa sangs rgyas kyi chos yin dang min the tshom yinapa'i gto bcos byed pa dang / glud gtong ba'i bzo 'dra byed kyin bsdad na yag po yod pa ma red/gzab gzab byed dgos/ zhes stsal// //151

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1983 zla 3 tshes 27 dgong dro me'o chos 'phel gling gzhis chags mi mang la 455 ba'i bka' slob/de ring gzhis chags sar nga tsho nub 'dzoms tshogs 'du byed rgyu'i dus tshod byung ba dang / 'di ga'i gzhis chags skor zhogs pa skad cha byung ba ltar dmigs bsal gyi las ka gnyis pa zhig byed dgos byung ba'i dka' ngal 'phrad yod na'ang / da cha las bsdoms nang gsal ltar gang ltar gzhi rtsa yag po tshugs yod pa'i bzo 'dug sa cha'i bab nas yin na'ang yin mdog kha po 'dugagazhis chags nang sdod mkhan mi mang khyed rang tsho yang gsos ril ril yag thag chod 'dug pas nga ha cang gi dga' po byung / grub 'bras 'di dag gtso bo sa gnas sa thog tu sdod mkhan khyed rang mi mang tshos dbyar dgun ston dpyid med par tsha grang ngal dub khyad du bsad de dka' ngal dwang len gyi gang ltar dpung pa sa 'og la bcug nas las rtsol shugs chen byas pa'i rkyen gyis grub 'bras 'di thon pa red/ de ring gi go skabs 'dir khyed rang tsho tshang mar ngas thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ nga rang tsho rtsa ba rang gi lung pa bral te mi'i lung par gyar te bsdad yod/ thog mar nga tshor ngo shes pa sa dang gnam ma gtogs med pa lta bu'i gnas stangs de 'dra zhig gi 'og phyogs gcig nas so so'i 'tsho ba khungs 'khyol ba zhig dang / gnyis nas deng dus kyi shes yon 'jags thub pa/ gsum nas nga rang tsho bod mi rigs kyi goms gshis dang chos rig rgyun 'dzin thub pa zhig dang / lhag don nga rang tsho rang gi lung pa la rang dbang lon thub pa'i 'gan khur de rnams dus gcig tu blangs te bsdad pa red/ 'gyur 152

ba'i gnas tshul shin tu myur po 'gro gi yod pa dang / nga rang tsho'i mdun du las 'gan sne kha mang po dang / 'gan lci po zhig 'khyer dgos pa'i gnas tshul gyi rkyen pas nga tshor dka' ngal mang po zhig 'phrad yod pa red/ yin na'ang bod spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi las ka byed mkhan gyi thog nas yin na'i rung / de ga nang bzhin mi mang tsho'i thog nas yin yang rung / gang ltar nga rang tsho skya ser rgan gzhon mchog dman tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don du lhag bsam bcangs/nga rang tsho'i bden pa'i mtha' gsal gyi red bsam pa'i yid ches dang / snying stobs/ spobs pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas gang ltar dka' ngal khyad du bsad de lo nas lo bstud dka' las brgyab pa'i 'bras bur deng sang nga rang tsho bod mi btsan byol pa'i spyir btang gi gnas stangs la cha bzhag na 'dzam gling nang btsan byol ba ha cang mang po sposad na'ang btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra tsam gyi bod mi btsan byol ba zhes mdzub mo 'dzugs sa yod pa zhig chags bsdad yod pa dang / deng sang bod phyi nang gnyis phar tshur gnyen 'phrad 'gro 'ong kyi go skabs shar te rgya gar nang gi bod mi'i gnas stangs bod nang par go thub pa zhig dang / bod nang gi gnas tshul tshur go thub pa'i skabs la nga tshos mi'i lung par lo 24 ring dka' ngal ga tshod tsam brgyab pa dang grub 'bras ga tshod tsam son yod pa 'di mig gis mthong rgyu yod pa zhig dang / lag pas 'dzin rgyu yod pa zhig chags te grub 'bras bzang po thon yod pa red/ 'di ga'i gzhis chags la cha bzhag pa yin na'i de de bzhin gyi grub 'bras thon yod pa red/ da lta phan chad 'das pa'i lo de dag nang du nga tshos dka' las brgyab 153

pa rnams bye ma'i nang chu sim pa lta bu 'phro brlag tu phyin yod pa ma red/ gzhis sgar so so'i nang lto zas dang / gyon chas yag tu phyin pa dang / rig gzhung gi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshad phran bu'i drag tu phyin pa nga tshos mig gi dngos su mthong rgyu dang longs su spyod rgyu yod pa 'di dag gis dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas bod spyi pa'i don da ga dang / 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang du bod pa'i ming gi la rgya 'phral phyags gang ci'i don dag mang po zhig gi thog la grub 'bras thon yod/phan thogs byung yod/ da cha nga rang tsho tshang mas de snga 'das pa'i lo rgyus nang dka' las brgyab pa rnams nyams myong la 'khyer te ma 'ongs par de bas yar rgyas che ru 'gro thabs dang / da dung las rigs mang po zhig gsar gtod byed thub pa'i bsam blo nges par du btang ste spobs pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas shugs bskyed byed dgos/ nga tshos ma 'ongs par phyogs gcig nas dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong rgyu gal che shos shig chags yod pa red/ las ka gang byed dgos byung rung dpal 'byor la rag lus pa red/ dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i cha rkyen gcig zhing las kyi thog la gnas sku(da pas zhing las yar rgyas gtong ched thabs shes gang dang gang byed rgyu 'dug gsar gtod ji 'dra byed rgyu yod dam/ de tsho'i thog la bsam blo gtong dgos/ rang rang so sor sa cha 'di ga'i thog nas nyams myong phran bu phran bu yong gi yod pa red/ yang mi gzhan dag la'ang skad cha dris te shing 'bras kyi thon skyedakar rgyas gtong thabs/de bzhin 'bru rigs 'dra mi 'dra 'debs las thog nas yar rgyas gtong rgyu gang 'dug gam/ de tsho'i thad la bsam blo btang na yag po 'dug spyir btang 154

bod mi'i gzhis sgar khag mang po zhig gi nang so so'i khang pa'i nye skor la shing sna 'dra min 'dzugs rgyu dang / tshal zhing 'dra min 'debs las byas yong dus zas chog btung chog gi phan thogs yod pa dang / de bzhin khang pa'i mdzes cha la'ang phan mkhan yag 11 sku(nga gi 'dug gzhis chags khag dzaḥ) nang du so so'i khang pa'i nye 'khris la tshal zhing sdum rwa/ gtso che shos za zhing gi rwa ba zhes 'bras bu can gyi shing sna 'dzugs thabs 'bad brtson byed kyi yin na phan thogs yag po yong gi red/ 'di khul du'ang shing 'bras 'debs 'dzugs byed kyi yod pa yag po byung 'dugade min sa la brten pa ma yin pa'i thabs lam gzhan dag gi thog nas nga tsho'i dpal 'byor 'du 'god byed rgyu'i thabs shes gang 'dra yod dam/ da lta 'dir gzhi rtsa cung che ba yod pa rum gdan 'thag las byed pa 'di red/ da lta nga cho'i me 'o'i gzhis chags nas 'thag las byas pa'i rum gdan zhes ming thon yong mkhan gyi grub 'bras yod pa 'di dag nyams chag tu mi 'gro ba'i thog nas da dung thon rdzas shugs che ru gtong rgyu'i thabs shes ga re yod dam/ de min da phan 'di khula.ar las shing bzo'i las rigs rang mi rang las byas te da lta gzhi rgya chung chung zhig yod pa red/ yul 'di shing gi thon khungs yod par brten shing la brten pa'i dngos po ga re ga re bzo rgyuyod dam/ spyir btang nga rang tsho'i khyim tshang gi dgos mkhu+o'i rigs dang / yang nga rang tsho bod pa rang gi lag shes kyi rnam pa thon pa'i thog nas mdzes bkod sgrig dpyad rigs dper na/ brkos dkrol gyi dngos rigs dang / dkrug rgyab pa'i dngos rigs 155

de 'dra'i thog nas shing la brten pa'i dngos pos pad shag bzo thabs ga re ga re byed rgyu yod dam/ de tsho'i thog la rim pas bsam blo gtong thub na yag po red/ gang ltar dpal 'byor gyi thog la sa zhing gcig pu ma yin par phyogs gzhan dag nas yar rgyas gtong ched gsar gtod kyi bsam blo nges par du gtong dgos/ de sgyudan gzhis chags la 'byor mkhan mi thog sngon ma rnams de snga bod du myong goms gang yod de tsam ma gtogs/ de min las rigs gzhi rgya chen wa'i gsar gtod byed thub pa'i cha rkyen tshang gi yod pa ma red/ da cha mi'i lung par slebs nas lo nyi shu rtsa grangs phyin pa'i rjes su skad yig gsar pa dang / 'dzam bu gling gi spyir btang shes yon slob sbyong byas te de'i thog nas nar son pa'i gzhon skyes gang la gang 'tshams yong gi yod pa yin du sa mi'i 'jon thang dang / nus pa che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ 'jon thang dang nus pa che ru 'gro mkhan gyi mi de rnams nas 'tsho thabs thog las rigs gsar gtod gang 'gab kyi bsam blo gtong dar+shages/ yang mtha' gcig tu sa cha 'di ga'i sgang du sdod dgos pa ma red/ nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags 'di bzhin rang nyid kyi khyim tshang lta bu yin yang / so so'i 'tsho thabs kyi las ka grong dang grong khyer nang du byed thub pa yong gi red/ nga tshos mig rgyangs ring du btang ste phyogs gozhanoci+o dag nos thabs shes 'bad brtson ga re ga re byed thabs yod med bsam bla gtang dgas/de nas mnyam sbrel gyi las don gal cher brtsi gi yod pa red/ mnyam sbrel tshags tshud po dang yag po zhig byung ba yin na gzhis sgar spyi pa'i bde sdug 156

thog la yang blta rtogs bya rgyur phan thogs chen po yod pa red/ mnyam sbrel gyi las ka de phyogs gcig nas so so'i khyim tshang dang / thad shar 'brel ba med pa spyi pa'i mnyam sbrel yin dus spyi rta skal ral gyi bzo 'dra po yong gi yod pa red/ de ni mig rgyangs thung thung gi bsam blo'i skyon cha lhags pa red/ de 3dra'i bsam blo ma btang bar spyi pa tshags tshud po dang yag po byung ba'i tshod kyi sgor so sor shugs ma thub kyis phan thogs yod pa red/ spyi pa tshags tshud po ma byung ba yin na khyim tshang sgor so so'i nang du yin na'ang dka' ngal 'phrad rgyu ma gtogs byed thabs yod pa ma red/ nga tshos spyi pa tshags tshud yong ba'i do na du tshang mas hur thag byed kyi yod pa red la da dung yin na'ang hur thag byed dgos/de nas nga tshos deng dus kyi shes yon thad la shugs rgyag rgyu shin tu gal tshem po red/ nga rang tsho bod pa rang gi lung par yod pa'i skabs la nga tshor sa cha yag la thon skyed bzang ba/ spyir btang mi'i gshis ka legs pa/ 'jon thang che la dka' las rgyag thub mkhan/ sku( rabs brgya phrag mang po'i lo rgyus yod pa'i lung pa gzi brjid ldan pa zhig chags nas bsdad pa red/ yin na'ang bar lam tshudags gcig nas spyi mthun gyi bsod nams dman pa'i stabs kyis rkyen ngan de 'dra zhig byung / rkyen ngan de 'dra yong ba'i rgyu mtshan gcig nga rang tsho bod nang deng dus 'dzam gling gi shes yon thog la do snang bya rgyu ma byung ba dang / mthong rgya thos rgya'i gnas tshul ma 'dang ba/ sngar srol khege na'i bsam blo sbug srub dog por bsdad pa'i rkyen gyis 'thus shor tan tan phyin yod/ da 157

cha nga tshos 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong rnams deng sang gi dus tshod kyi sgang la tshur blangs te nga tshos gang byed dgos zer na/ deng dus kyi shes yon la dang dod dang slob sbyong byed rgyu ha cang gi gal chen po red/ thog mar nga tsho rgya gar du 'byor 'phral du gzhis chags kyi thog nas 'tsho ba rang skyong byed thub pa zhig dang / deng dus kyi shes yon slob sbyong byed rgyu 'di gnyis gal che shos su brtsi gi yod pa red/ skabs der paṇa ṭi ta ne+e ru nas kyang ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi bde ba sdug bsngal gyi don dag la da lta'i dus tshod 'dir slob sbyong bya rgyur rag lus pa red ces gsung gi yod/ gang ltar yang snying skabs der nga tshor dka' ngal mang po yod na'ang / dka' ngal de rnams khyad du bsad de nga tshos dmigs bsal gyi bod pa'i slob grwa zhes zur du btsugs te deng dus kyi shes yon rjes lus mi thebs pa zhig sku(nga thabs la nga tshos gal chen zhig tu brtsis nas 'bad brtson rim pa byas pa red/ da lta nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags 'di'i thog la cha bzhag na yang da lta las bsdoms nang gsal ba bzhin phru gu nyis brgya drug bcu skor zhig slob sbyong byed kyi yod pa red/ slob sbyong thog la phru gu tsho'i ngos nas kyang hur thag byas/ pha ma tsho'i ngos nas kyang phru gur shes sku(na yag po zhig 'jags thub thabs la nges par du bsam blo gtong dgos/ pha ma rang nyid phyi rgyal gyi skad yig phar bzhag so so bod pa'i lo rgyus dang / yi ge yang mi shes pa bzhin phru gu rnams de 'dra ma yong ba'i thabs shes nges par du byed dgos/ nga tsho tshang ma mi yin pa 'dra 'dra red/ yin na'ang yon tan yod pa dang med pa'i khyad kyis mi lag rdum pa zhig dang / lag pa yod mkhan 158

cha nga tshos 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong rnams deng sang gi dus tshod kyi sgang la tshur blangs te nga tshos gang byed dgos zer na/ deng dus kyi shes yon la dang dod dang slob sbyong byed rgyu ha cang gi gal chen po red/ thog mar nga tsho rgya gar du 'byor 'phral du gzhis chags kyi thog nas 'tsho ba rang skyong byed thub pa zhig dang / deng dus kyi shes yon slob sbyong byed rgyu 'di gnyis gal che shos su brtsi gi yod pa red/ skabs der paṇa ṭi ta ne+e ru nas kyang ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi bde ba sdug bsngal gyi don dag la da lta'i dus tshod 'dir slob sbyong bya rgyur rag lus pa red ces gsung gi yod/ gang ltar yang snying skabs der nga tshor dka' ngal mang po yod na'ang / dka' ngal de rnams khyad du bsad de nga tshos dmigs bsal gyi bod pa'i slob grwa zhes zur du btsugs te deng dus kyi shes yon rjes lus mi thebs pa zhig sku(nga thabs la nga tshos gal chen zhig tu brtsis nas 'bad brtson rim pa byas pa red/ da lta nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags 'di'i thog la cha bzhag na yang da lta las bsdoms nang gsal ba bzhin phru gu nyis brgya drug bcu skor zhig slob sbyong byed kyi yod pa red/ slob sbyong thog la phru gu tsho'i ngos nas kyang hur thag byas/ pha ma tsho'i ngos nas kyang phru gur shes sku(na yag po zhig 'jags thub thabs la nges par du bsam blo gtong dgos/ pha ma rang nyid phyi rgyal gyi skad yig phar bzhag so so bod pa'i lo rgyus dang / yi ge yang mi shes pa bzhin phru gu rnams de 'dra ma yong ba'i thabs shes nges par du byed dgos/ nga tsho tshang ma mi yin pa 'dra 'dra red/ yin na'ang yon tan yod pa dang med pa'i khyad kyis mi lag rdum pa zhig dang / lag pa yod mkhan 158

thug pa lta bu chags yod pa red/ phru gu tsho'i shes yon gyi thog la pha ma tshos nges par du do snang byed dgos/ 'phral sel so so'i nang la phru gu'i lag pa chung chung 'di bed spyod byas te phugs nas phru gu'i shes yon slob sbyong gi dus tshod 'phro brlag tu phyin pa yin na shin tu nor 'khrul red/ rdo don 'dir slob grwa'i dge rgan tsho dang / las byed pa tsho pha ma dang bcas pa tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/ phru gu tshos kyang so so'i slob sbyong thog hur skyed byed dgos/ 'di shin tu gal chen po red/nga tshos bod pa'i phru gu la deng dus kyi shes yon slob kyi yod pa ma gtogs nga rang tsho bod pa'i rnam pa bsgyur ba'i don dag ma red/ nga chos lung pa brjes pa dang chabs cig bsam blo gtong stangs de yang brjes/ shes yon de yang brjes nas bod pa rnams bod pa ma yin pa bzo rgyu'i don dag ma red/ bod rnga/ bod pa rang la bsdad pa'i thog nas shes zhi+o/na gyi nus pa dang / 'jon thang gi nus pa che ru gtong rgyu'i thabs shes byed kyi yod pa red/ phru gur deng dus kyi shes yon 'jags pa dang chabs cig nga rang tsho bod pa'i rnam pa ma yal ba bya rgyu 'di gal chen po red/ nga tsho mi'i lung par slebs rjes 'phral sel gyi 'tsho thabs gtso bor bzung ste bod mi kha 'thor du phyin yod na da phan lo nyi shu rtsa grangs shig phyin pa'i rjes su da cha grong gseb kyi sa cha kha shas su 'di tsho 1959 lo'i bod pa btsan byol ba red ces zer rgyu tsam ma gtogs/ bod mi btsan byol ba gong bu'i rdog rdog cig sdod thub kyi ma red/ de 'dra zhig chags pa yin na khyim tshang so 16) 'tsho ba khungs 'khyol tsam zhig byung ba yin na'ang 159

bod pa'i rnam pa 'di yal 'gro gi red/ brlag 'gro gi red/ nga tshos btsan byol ba 'tsho ba rang skyong byas pa dang chabs cig bod pa'i rnam 'gyur ma yal ba zhig dang / bod pa'i rnam pa ma yal ba'i don dag la nga tshos bod pa mnyam sdod kyi gzhis chags byas pa red/ de bzhin slob sbyong byed mkhan yin na'ang deng dus kyi shes yon bod pa'i slob phrug tshor tshur slob kyi yod pa red ma gtogs/ bod pa'i mi 'di phar bsgyur ba'i don dag la slob sbyong byed kyi yod pa ma red/ des na deng dus kyi shes yon sbyangs pa dang chabs cig so so rang nyid bod pa'i rnam pa gsal po 'dzin thub pa zhig dgos kyi yod pa red/ bod pa'i rnam pa gsal po 'dzin rgyu de gang yin zer na bod pa'i shes sku na dgos kyi yod pa red/ bod pa'i shes yon yod pa'i thog la deng dus kyi shes yon yod pa'i bod pa rnam dpyod ldan pa zhig dgos pa red/ bod pa'i shes yon dang / bod pa'i bsam sdus brlag pa yin na deng dus kyi shes yon chen po yod na'ang de la zhag rtsi skusgod pa ma red/ de tsam gyis phan thogs dang / nus pa gang yang yod pa ma red/ nga rang tshos bod pa'i rig gzhung ma nyams pa gces 'dzin byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po chags yod/ der brten khyed rang tshos bod kyi skad yig thog la do snang yag po byed dgos/ khyed rang tshor pad+ma bkod pa'i yul skad zer ba zhig yod pa red/ yul skad yod pa yag po red/ yin na'ang yul skad 'di yi ge yod pa zhig ma red/ nga rang tsho'i bod yig 'di bod kyi sa mtshams nub la dwags nas shar rgya nag gi sa mtshams dar rtse mdo bar du bod rigs yongs su rdzogs pa la yi ge gcig gis khyab nas bsdad yod/160

bod kyi nang du khyab thub pa tsam ma zad/ 'brug gi nang dang / 'bras ljongs kyi nang / la dwags nang / ga sha/ yi ti/ khu nu de tsho'i khul du yang ka mas sum cu yod mkhan gyi yi ge 'dis khyab yod pa red/ da gin 'dir chos 'brel byed pa'i skabs la skad sgyur zhig 'dug nga rang tsho bod mi nang khul la skad brda 'phrod ma 'phrod kyi snyenas tshul yong dus thabs skyo po red/ gang ltar yang snying nga rang tsho bod pa'i rig gzhung 'di dag dam 'dzin byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho bod rang gi rig gzhung gces 'dzin thog la phru gu tsam ma yin par rgan pa tsho yin na'ang do snang chen po byed dgos/ slob grwar 'gro rgyu'i dus tshod yol tshar ba red/ yin na'ang nga rang tsho'i bod yig klog thub pa dang / bris thub pa byed rgyur do snang byed dgos/ sngon ma nga rang tsho'i gzhis sgar yas mas su shes yon yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i don du shes yon tshogs chung zhig ched du btsugs te las 'gul spel yod pa red/ ma gzhi khyed rang tshor las ka byed rgyu dang / mthun rkyen 'dzoms min gyi dka' ngal yod/ yin na'ang rim pas rim pas cha rkyen 'dzoms te go skabs yong gi 'dug na bod yig bri klog shes thabs byed dgos/ de ni so so'i bsam blo gtong rgyur phan pa tsam du ma zad/ gtso che shos chos kyi bya bar yang phan thogs yod pa zhig red/ da nang skad cha byung ba bzhin nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos pa zhig yin pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad pa yod mkhan gyi mi zhig yin bzhin du nang pa'i chos mi shes pa 'di shin tu sems khyod nga dang / thabs skyo po red/ nang pa'i chos la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i 161

lam gyi rim pa'i rnam gzhag bdag gzhan gnyis kyi 11ga nas rnam grangs mang po dang / rgya chen po/ gting zab po/ spus dag po yod pa 'di dag ma shes par bsdad na shin tu phangs po red/ nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di snubs rgyud gzhan dag cig nas slob dgos pa dang / lo tsa ba gzhan zhig brgyud dgos med par/ nga rang tsho bod rang gi yi ge'i thog nas slob thub pa zhig yin pas shes thabs 'bad brtson byed dgos/ de ga nang bzhin nga rang tsho'i so so'i lung pa'i gzhas zhabs bro dang / de bzhin dga' dga' skyid skyid kyi glu gzhas de tshor do snang yag po byed dgos/ mi rigs tshang mas so so'i yul goms gshis lugs mi 'dra ba/ rig gzhung gi rnam pa mi 'dra ba yod bsdad pa de rnams rtsa cher 'dzin gyi yod/ nga rang tsho bod pa yin na'ang de de bzhin byas nas do snang yag po byed dgos/chos kyi thad/ nga rang tsho bod du lo brgya phrag mang po'i ring 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos cha tshang ba 'dzin skyong yod mkhan bar skabs shig tu bod lung pa ma gtogs ha lam med pa'i bzo lta bu chags bsdad yod/ bod du yod pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang du nang pa'i chos rgya che shos dang / spus dag shos chags nas bsdad yod/ de yin pa deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang du gzhi nas mngon gsal du gyur yod/ 1959(60 de'i skabs su bod nas yong ba'i nang pa tsho bon po dang 'dres bsdad yod pa'i mthong tshul yong gi yod pa red/de nas 1960 dang 70 brgal nas 80 lo shar nas skurdzong dus deng 162

sang nang pa zhig la bod kyi nang pa 'di rgya che shos dang / gting zab shos red ces do snang yod mkhan mang po zhig gis shod kyi yod pa dang / gnas tshul shes tshor yong gi yod pa red/ bod du yod pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos rgya chen po dang / gting zab po/ spus dag po/ zhib tshags po yod pa 'di nga rang tsho bod pa'i khyad nor lta bu chags sku da/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'dzin spel yong ba la dgon pa bzhengs thub tsam dang / grwa pa 'du tshogs thub tsam/ de bzhin dung dang rgya gling gtong shes pa tsam gyis 'grigs kyi yod pa ma red/ da nang 'dir khyed rang tshos gar 'chams 'khrab pa yag po red/ yin na'ang de tsam gyis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i coges 'dzin skyong thog la phan gyi yod pa ma red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ngo ma lung gi bstan pa dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa zhes gnyis bshad pa red/ lung gi bstan pa ni sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan byed rgyu de yin pa red/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa ni sde snod gsum nas bshad pa'i bslab pa gsum nyams su len rgyu de red/ bslab pa gsu ma gyi nyams su len ched rab byung yin na dge tshul slong gi sdom pa blangs/ khyim pa dang / sngags 'chang yin na'ang rang rang gi sdom pa len dgos/ nga rang tsho'e chos rgyal gyi skabs nas rab byung ngur smrig gi sde dang / gos dkar lcang lo'i sde zhes gnyis yod pa red/ deng dus yin na'ang nga rang tsho'i bod kyi chos pa'i nang du sngags pa dang / rab byung gi sde gnyis yod pa 'di 'grigs pa red/sang ltar khyim pa'i sdom pa yin yang rung / dge tshul slong gi sdom pa yin yang rung / don du sdom pa 'di rang rgyud la tshang ba'i thog nas ting nge 'dzin gyi 163

bslab pa de'i thog la chos rnams kyi gnas lugs de kho na nyid zer ba 'di shes pa byas/ de ltar bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len sku/da pa'i thog nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong byed dgos pa red/ dper na nga 'dra po zhig phyi'i rab tu byung ba'i gos gyon pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i go chod kyi ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zer ba 'di da lta lab pa bzhin/ gtso che shos bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len zhig rang gi rgyud la tshang ba'i thog nas rtogs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin dgos pa red/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa'i bstan pa rang gis 'dzin zhing gzhan la spel ba la lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan dgos pa red/ 'dul ba'i sde snod ma shes na sdom pa'i 'gro stangs rnams yag po shes kyi ma red/ mdo sde'i sde snod yag po zhig ma shes na ting nge 'dzin gyi 'gro stangs shes kyi ma red/ mngon pa'i sde snod yag po ma shes na shes rab kyi bslab pa'i skor yag po shes kyi ma red/ des na sde snod gsum gyi don dag la slob sbyong byed dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la dpe cha 'chad nyan dang / slob gnyer byas/ dpe cha nas bshad pa'i don dag rnams rang rgyud steng du rtogs thub pa tsam ma zad/ gzhan la'ang slob khrid byed thub pa zhig dgos/ kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho da lta mi'i lung par slebs nas dgon pa re zung las mang po yod pa ma red/ re zung yod pa 'di dag spus dag po zhig yong ba la nges par du 'bad brtson byed dgos/ da lta khyed rang tsho+o'i dgon pa'i 'go khrid mkhan bla ma drag gras shig byung na zhes chos don las khungs su 'brel/ ba byed kyi yod pa ha cang yag po byung 'dug gang ltar yang snying sangs rgyas 164

bstan pa'i gnad 'gag gzhan la yang 'grel bshad byed thub pa dang / so sos yin na'ang cha tshang nyams len byed thub pa zhig dgos rgyu gal chen po 'duganang pa'i chos spus dag yod pa 'di dang / nang pa ma yin pa'i chos gzhan dag rnam pa 'dra 'dra'i ngang phyin pa yin na yag po yod pa ma red/ chos lugs gzhan dag sdug chags red zer gyi yod pa ma red/ chos tshang ma yag po red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la/ nang pa ma yin pa'i ye shu'u dang /kha che/ mu stegs pa sogs grub mtha' 'dra mi 'dra mang po yod pa de rnams sems can re re'i khams dang mos pa sna tshogs la phan thogs yod pa red/dper na/ mi la lto zas bro ba dang / rnam pa gcig gis mi 'grigs par rnam pa sna chogs dgos pa ltar/ chos la yin na yang mi'i khams dang mos pa sna tshogs dang bstun nas chos lu/gas 'dra mi 'dra yod pa yag po red/ de lta na yang nga rang cho'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i 'grel bshad rgyu mtshan shod rgyu yod pa dang / khungs drangs rgyu yod pa'i spus dag po 'di dag snang med du lus bsdad na phangs po red/ gtso che shos khyed rang tsho dgon pa'i nang sdod mkhan tshos gtso bo'i 'gan 'khyer te mang tshogs kyi nang du nang pa'i chos kyi don dag ngo ma gang 'dra gang 'dra yin min gyi gnad 'gag shes thub pa zhig dang / de'i thog la do snang mang tsa ma slebs thub pa zhig nges par du byed dgos/ de 'dra byung na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la shes nas dad pa thob pa zer ba de yong thub kyi red/ rdo don yang snying skya ser mang tshogs spyi yongs la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi tho༄ )gas mtho ru gtong thabs dang /165

shes tshad yag tu gtong thub pa'i 'bad brtson byed dgos/ shes song ngam/'phral sel nga tsho dpal 'byor thog tshags tshud dang / shes yon/ chos bcas kyi chodag la bsam sdud gtong rgyu de ni da ring kha sa'i las 'gan gtso che shos yin/de nas bod spyi pa'i don dag skor bar lam nas gang la gang 'tshams kyi 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod pa red/ 'das pa'i lo nyi shu tsam zhig ring la bod du dka' ngal tshad med byung bas ma tshad rgya mi'i gdug rtsub dang mnar gcod 'og bod mi rang shi rgyag mkhan dang / mu gos shi ba/ dmar gsod btang ba/ btson du mnar gcod 'og shi ba bcas gange ltar gsod brdung bkol gsum 'og bod mi 'bum phrag bcu skor dus ma yin pa'i 'chi rkyen byung yod/ bod nang rgya che'i mi mang 'bum drug cu tsam mongad pa de'i nang nas brgya cha dgu bcu go lnga rgya mi la snying thag pa nas zhe 'khon 'dzin te bod mi'i thob thang dang / rang gi rang dbang gi thog la re ba brgyab bsdad mkhan dang / brtson len byed mkhan sha stag chags bsdad yod/ de ga nang bzhin rgya mi'i thog nas chodas zer mkhan 'di dug red ces btsan wa'i thog nas chos thong du 'jug rgyu'i thabs shes dang /las 'gul rim pa byed kyi yod kyang bod rgya che'i mi mang gi khrod du chos la dad pa sngar las kyang shugs che ru phyin pa'i bzo 'dra zhig chags 'dug gtso che bod nang du yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tsho ha cang gi sems shugs chen po dang /snying stobs chen por gnas pa'i rkyen gyis deng sang bod nang du rgya nag gzhung gi srid byus gang la gang 'tshams kyi 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod pa red/ bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams nas lhag bsam snying stobs zhum pa med par bsdad yod 166

pa'i 'bras bur rim pas rim pas gnas tshul tan tan drag tu 'gro gi red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug khyed rang tsho blo bde po dang / bag phebs po byas nas sdod/ nga rang tsho da lta dang / ma 'ongs pa ga dus yin na yang bod rigs rtsam pa za mkhan dang / ma ṇi bgrangs mkhan yongs rdzogs gcig gyur red ma gtogs de la lung tshan gyi dbye ba dang / chos lugs kyi dbye ba/ mdor na bon dang bcas par nga chos da bye 'byed rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ bod rigs yongs su rdzogs pa gcig gyur red/ nga rang tsho bod rigs yongs rdzogs skyid na skyid mnyam dang / sdug na sdug mnyam red/ don med lung tshan gyi thog nas 'then 'khyer dang / chos lugs kyi thog nas 'then 'khyer byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ ma gzhi da lta nga rang tsho me'o gzhis chags nang du de 'dra'i gnas tshul gang yang med pa lhing 'jags sgog sgrig 'dzugs kho na'i 'og tu tshang ma rdog bsgril po byas te bsdad pa ha cang gi yag po red/ da dung yin na'ang mthun po dang / gcig gis gcig la rogs ram yag lnga byas/ phan tshun phyar ba gru 'degs byed thub na yag po yong gi red / khyed rang mo tshang ma blo bde po byas nas sdod/ de ring nga 'dir shengs gcig slebs pa red/ ma 'ongs par yin na'ang nga slebs thub kyi red/ dngos su sa cha 'dir nga'i lus po slebs thub min la ma ltos par gzhis chags kyi dka' ngal che sa tshang ma nga'i bsam blo'i nang rtag par dran bsdad kyi yod/ nang srid las khungs dang / sa gnas kyi gzhis 'go sku( sos skabs 'phral nga la gzhis chags sdud so'i gnas tshul bshad yong gi yod/ de 'dra'i thog nas ngas gnas tshul rtogs kyi yod/ ngas 167

pa'i 'bras bur rim pas rim pas gnas tshul tan tan drag tu 'gro gi red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug khyed rang tsho blo bde po dang / bag phebs po byas nas sdod/ nga rang tsho da lta dang / ma 'ongs pa ga dus yin na yang bod rigs rtsam pa za mkhan dang / ma ṇi bgrangs mkhan yongs rdzogs gcig gyur red ma gtogs de la lung tshan gyi dbye ba dang / chos lugs kyi dbye ba/ mdor na bon dang bcas par nga chos da bye 'byed rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ bod rigs yongs su rdzogs pa gcig gyur red/ nga rang tsho bod rigs yongs rdzogs skyid na skyid mnyam dang / sdug na sdug mnyam red/ don med lung tshan gyi thog nas 'then 'khyer dang / chos lugs kyi thog nas 'then 'khyer byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ ma gzhi da lta nga rang tsho me'o gzhis chags nang du de 'dra'i gnas tshul gang yang med pa lhing 'jags sgog sgrig 'dzugs kho na'i 'og tu tshang ma rdog bsgril po byas te bsdad pa ha cang gi yag po red/ da dung yin na'ang mthun po dang / gcig gis gcig la rogs ram yag lnga byas/ phan tshun phyar ba gru 'degs byed thub na yag po yong gi red / khyed rang mo tshang ma blo bde po byas nas sdod/ de ring nga 'dir shengs gcig slebs pa red/ ma 'ongs par yin na'ang nga slebs thub kyi red/ dngos su sa cha 'dir nga'i lus po slebs thub min la ma ltos par gzhis chags kyi dka' ngal che sa tshang ma nga'i bsam blo'i nang rtag par dran bsdad kyi yod/ nang srid las khungs dang / sa gnas kyi gzhis 'go sku( sos skabs 'phral nga la gzhis chags sdud so'i gnas tshul bshad yong gi yod/ de 'dra'i thog nas ngas gnas tshul rtogs kyi yod/ ngas 167

rtag par do snang byed kyi yod pas khyed rang tsho tshang ma blo bde wa'i ngang sdod rogs byed/ de ring 'dir dus tshod med stabs mjal kha gtong khom byung ma song /khyed rang tsho gzhis skar spyi pa'i thog la ngas 'dir byin rten dang / srung mdud bzhag gi yin/ gathen che shos nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pas rgyun du sems bzang po dang / spyod lam ya rabs byas/ de'i thog nas skyabs 'gro dang /ma ṇi/ thub pa'i mtshan sngags/ slob dpon gyi mtshan sngags de 'dra bgrang gi yin na so so rang nyid kyi bsod nams 'phelo ba dang / las bzang wa'i rgyu sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'bras bu bde skyid yong ba dang / sdug bsngal sel ba/ bar chad sel thabs byed dgos/ rang gis sems bzang po byed rgyu dang / ya rabs kyi thog nas chos nyams len ma byas par mi la skyabs 'jug gnang rogs zhes lab na phan thogs yong ba khag po red/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku ngo ma bzhugs pa'i skabs la yang rang rang so so'i las kyi rjes 'brel las sangs rgyas rang gis gnang thabs gang yang med pa red/ dper na/ shākya'i rigs la dmag yong ba'i skabs su bcom ldan 'das la shākya'i rigs kyi phru gu gsum bcol po zhus te srung skyob gnang rogs zhus pa ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis phru gu gcig bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i 'khris su nyar nas bzhugs/ gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi thog nas sbas gnang ba red/ gang ltar dmag thag chod dus phru gu gsum po de shi bsdad yod pa red/ chos lugs gzhan dag nas bde sdug dkon mchog gis ba skos pa red zer gyi yod na yang /nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pas bde sdug 'di dag rang gi sems dul ma dul 168

gyi thog nas las bzang ngan bsags te de'i 'bras bur bde sdug byung bar bshad yod pas nga rang tsho so sos sems rgyud bzang po/ ya rabs byed kyi yin na rang la bde skyid yong gi red/ de 'dra yin dus khyed rang chos dus rgyun ldan nas sems bzang po dang / skyabs 'gro yag po byas/ sems bskyed yag po byas/ de'i thog gzungs sngags de 'dra bgrang gi yin na yag po yong gi red/bar chad kyang sel 'gro gi red/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel yong gi red/ shes song ngam/ 'di rnams khyed rang tsho'i sems la yag wad pes pa byas/ tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/ bkra shis bde legs// //rmo 169

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1983 zla 7 tshes 10 nyin sim lar bod mi rnams la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring sim lar nga rang tsho mnyam du 'dzoms pa la dga' po byung / sa cha 'di phyogs gcig nas sa bsil po dang / 'di'i g.yas g.yon la lto gos thabs 'tshol bde po yod stabs 'di khul sdod mkhan bod mi gang la gang 'tshams yod pa red/ nga rang tsho de snga bod la yod pa'i skabs nas sim la sim la zer ba 'di go myong yod pa red/ gang yin zer na/ sngon ma shing stag sim la'i chings yig bzhag sa'i sa cha de 'di yin pa red/ skabs der nga rang tsho bod kyi sku tshab bshad sgra blon chen dang / de dus rgya gar dbyin ji'i gzhung gis zin bsdad yod pa'i dbyin ji'i sku tshab/ rgya nag gi sku tshab bcas phyogs gsum gyi mi sna 'dir 'dzoms nas chings yig bzhag pa red/sim la sa khul la sdod mkhan khyed rang tsho mang che so so'i skabs su gang babs kyi thabs shes thog nas 'tsho thabs byas/ bod pa yin bsam pa'i 'du shes ma brlag pa'i thog nas bod pa spyi'i ming don la rgya snying la bcangs nas hur thag byas/ sa khul 'dir dmigs bsal rnyog khra ma thon pa'i thog la yang 'bad rtsol byed kyi yod pa yag po red/ khyed rang tshang mar thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ nga rang tsho gnas stangs btsan byol ba chags nas mi'i lung par gyar nas bsdad yod/ khul 'dir bzo gra 'di dang / g.yas g.yon la gzhis chags phran bu ma gtogs rgya chen po gang yang med/ yin na yang nga rang sto tshang ma sdod sa mi'i lung par bsdad yod kyang / rang dbang yod pa red/ bod lung 170

par cha bzhag na/ sdod sa rang gi lung par bsdad yod kyang rang dbang med pa red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi'i lo rgyus byung nas lo stong phrag khri phrag mang po phyin yod pa red/ de'i ring la mi'i spyi tshogs nang 'gyur ba ha cang mang po byung yod/ de sku(nga ba'i rgyu rkyen ni/ mi zer mkhan 'di sems can gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar/ mi'i bsam cho'i nang la so so'i bde ba bsgrub rgyu dang / sdug bsngal sel ba'i thabs shes rnam pa mang po zhig rang bzhin gyis bsam blo 'khor thub pa dang / bsam blo 'khor ba'i thog nas dmigs yul de bsgrub thabs la 'bad rtsol dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas byas pa'i rkyen byas nas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi'i spyi tshogs gang sar 'gyur ba mang po 'gro gi yod pa red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi rgyal khab 'pho 'gyur 'gro ba'i gnas tshul mang po zhig rang dbang yod med la thug gi yod pa red/ da lda bshad ma thag pa bzhin/ snga mo shing stag sim la'i chings yig bzhag pa'i skabs la 'di'i sa khul 'dir dbyin jis dbang sgyur byed kyi yod pa dang / rgya gar nang gi sa cha gal che sa kha shas la rgya gar sgye yul mi 'gro mi chogeg pa de 'dra byung yod pa red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sa cha mang po zhig la mi rigs kyi dbye 'byed btang nas btsan dbang byed mkhan mang po yod/ nga tsho thod gcig pā ma red/ 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la drang bden min pa dang / mis mi la dbang yod dang / mis mi la thub stod gtong ba'i gnas tshul zhig yin phyin/rang bzhin gyis ga le ga ler 'gyur 'gro gi yod pa red/ rgya gar la dbyin jis dbang sgyur byas nas rgya gar ba tsho bran g.yog lta bur sdod dgos byung na 171

yang / phyi lo 1947 lor rgya gar rang btsan byung ba red/ rgya gar la rjes lus kyi rnam pa mang po yod na yang rang dbang rang lag tu byung ba red/ de bde skyid red/ bod par cha bzhag na/ bod mi spyi byings so so'i lung par bsdad yod na yang / rang dbang bral nas yod pa yin dus rang dbang bral ba'i gzhan dbang zer ba de sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba red/ da phan 'das pa'i lo nyi shu rtsa grangs 'di'i ring la bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tshos bod lung pa bod mir bdag pa las/ rgya mis 'dzin pa'i thob thang med pa dang / rgyu mtshan med pa/ bden pa min pa la cadas 'dzin byas nas 11 sduḥ) mi rigs kyi don dag dang / so so'i rig gzhung / so so'i chos dad bcas par sems shugs chen 11 byas nas bsdad pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyis rkyen pas bar lam bdun cu don dgu nas bzung rim pas gnas tshul phran bu'i drag tu 'gro gi yod pa red/ drag tu phyin pa 'di la dga' bsu zhu 'os pa yin na yang /gzhi rtsa'i gnas stangs gzhan dbang gi 'og la gyar nas bsdad yod pa yin dus gnas tshul ha cang khag po red/ da lta nga rang tsho mi'i lung par bsdad yod kyang rang dbang yod/ so sos bsam blo btang nas thabs shes byas pa yin na byas chog gi ma red/ byas na khrims 'gal red zer mkhan su yang med/rang dbang zer ba 'di yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i cha rkyen gtso bo de red/ ji tsam mi la rang dbang yod pa'i tshod kyis gsar gtod byed thub pa dang / ji tsam gsar gtod mang ba'i stod kyis yar rgyas 'gro thub kyi yod/ rang dbang bral zhing btsan dbang 'og tu gsar gtod bya thabs med pa dang / gsar gtod 172

byed ma thub pa'i tshod kyi rjes lus thebs kyi yod pa red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la chab srid kyi lam lugs mi 'dra ba dang / lta ba'i lam lugs mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa 'di dag gi nang nas rang dbang yod pa'i lung pa'i nang la yar rgyas mang ba 'gro gi yod pa red/ rang dbang bral ba'i lung pa tsho'i nang du mi la dud 'gro nang bzhin bkol spyod byed kyi yod na yang / rang bzhin gyi mi'i bsam lha'i nang nas ma bskul dang len byed pa zhig ma byung na btsan po dbang yod kyis bskul ba de la grub 'bras 'dod pa khengs pa yong rgyu khag po red/ gang ltar 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la rang dbang zer ba 'di mi'i 'phyo ba'i nang la ha cang gal chen po yin pa de 'e1 rgyus kyi nang nas kha bsgrags yong gi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i ngos la cha bzhag na yang /rang dbang zer ba 'di shin tu rtsa chen yin pa dngos yod gnas tshul gyis kha bsgrags yong gi yod pa red/ dper na bar lam bod nas gnyen 'phrad yong mkhan nang nas kha shas dang skad cha byung / nga tsho so so'i lung par bsdad yod na yang gcig gis gcig la snying bstan nas skad cha bshad sa med/ rgya gar la tshur gnyen 'phrad la 'byor nas mi'i lung par slebs pa'i skabs la sdod sa mi'i lung pa yin na yang / so so'i bsam blo'i nang la yod pa 'di zhed snang med par bshad sa zhig yong gi 'dug ces de 'dra zer gyi 'dug de rtags mtshan gsal po red/'das pa'i lo nyi shu rtsa lnga ma lon tsam gyi ring la bod mi btsan byol ba 'bum lhag tsam zhig 'dzam bu gling gi rgyal khab mi 'dra ba bcu drug tsam gyi nang 173

la kha grams nas bsdad yod pa dang / mang shos rgya gar nang la bsdad yod/bod pa dang 'brel ba yod mkhan mi su 'dra gcig yin na yang / bod mir bsngags brjod byed pa dang / bod pa tsho to gos thog mgo grung po/ mi ya rabs/ris brtsi sa yod pa/ drang pos gzhung bsrangs byed mkhan zhig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi 'dug dper na rgya gar nang la cha bzhag na yang / bod mi gzhis chags sku(da sa'i sa khul khag mang po zhig la sa khul de ga'i dpon rigs tshos yul mir bskul ma dang / slob gso byed pa'i skabs la sa gnas 'dir yod mkhan bod mi tshos 'bad rtsol byas nasayar rgyas 'di tsam 'gro gi yod pa red/khong tshor dpe bltas nas khyed tshos yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i thabs shes dang /sems khur nges par blangs dgos zhes bod pa mig dpe blta sa 'dra por brtsi gi 'dug nga rang tsho btsan byol ba chags te mi'i lung par gyar bsdad yod na yang / rang dbang yod pa yin dus bod kyi chos/ bod kyi rig gzhung / bod pa'i goms gshis bzang po 'di tsho mi nyams rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu'i go skabs yod pa dang / byas chog gi yod pa redari/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas da cha 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la sngar nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos med sa nang chos cha rgyus med pa'i lung pa mang po zhig gi nang la deng sang bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzhi rtsa rgya chen po tshugs yod pa red/ nga rang tsho rang gi lung pa bral nas mi'i lung par gyar te thabs skyo po yin na yang / rang dbang yod pa yin dus gzhi rtsa'i cha nas yar rgyas gang la gang 'tshams 'gro thub yod/'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la btsan byol ba sa ya mang po yod na yang / btsan 174

byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas bod mi btsan byol ba rnams mi 'dra tsam zhig yod par ngos 'dzin dang cha 'jog byas yong gi 'dug gang ltar nga rang tsho bsdad sa mi'i lung par bsdad yod kyang / rang dbang yod pa 'di rtsa ba chen po dang skyid po red/ nga tsho mi'i lung par gyar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bod spyi pa'i don dag 'di nam yang ma brjed pa bya dgos/ bod spyi pa'i don dag brjed rgyu yod pa ma red/ tshang mas spyi don la sems shugs bskyed dgos/ bod nang la cha bzhag na da shin lab pa bzhin dka' sdug de lta bu'i 'og la sems shugs ma brlag par bsdad pa dang / lhag don gzhon skyes tsho'i nang la sems shugs shin tu chen po byas nas bsdad yod/ nga rang tsho mi'i lung par yod mkhan tsho nas de bas kyang da lta phan bzhin hur thag byed rogs byed zer rgyu yin/yul chu btung nas yul khrims 'khur zer ba ltar/ nga rang tsho sa cha gang du bsdad yod na yang sa cha de'i yul mi spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs kyi yul khrims 'khyer mkhan gyi mi bzang po zhig byed dgos/ ya rabs byed dgos/ bod pa'i nang nas rgya res rgyag mkhan/ rkun ma rku mkhan/ bod mi'i mtshan shas zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan de 'dra nam yang mi yong ba byed dgos/ mi'i spyod lam sdug po yong ba'i rkyen chang zer ba 'di nyes pa chen po red/ nam rgyun mi bag yod tshul mthun byed mkhan zhig yin na yang / chang btung nas ra bzi ba'i mtshams la bag yod dran shes bsten rgyu brjed de spyod lam ngan pa thon yong gi yod/ deng sang bod la yang chang btung mkhan mang po yod pa dang / de 'dra'i thog nas rnyog khra bzo mkhan yod tshod 'dug 'di khul la las ka dka' 175

las khag 1— de 'dra byed pa'i skabs dang / skyid skyid 'dra po'i skabs la phran bu 'dra 'thung dgos pa yong shas che ma gtogs/ rgyun du tshod med 'thung ba yag po gtan nas min pas gzab gzab byed dgos/ de gal chen po 'dugayul pa tsho la mthun po byed dgos/ rgya gar ni nga rang sto la dngos gnas drang gnas kyi bka' drin chen po red/ nga rang cho nad mi mang che ba de nang pa yin pa red/ nang pa yong sa rgya gar nas byung ba red/ sngar rgya gar gyi chos spyi dang / lhag par nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snang ba la brten nas bod kyi mun pa sel ba red/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus la yang gnas tshul de red/ bar skabs kyi gnas tshul yin na yang rgya gar bka' drin chen po yin pas yul pa la brtsi bkur yag po byas/ mthun po byed dgos/ nga rang tsho bod spyi pa'i don dag rim pas gnas tshul bzang du 'gro gi red bsam gyi 'dug tshang ma blo bde po byed/ shes song ngam/de nas nga tsho'i slob gra 'di sngon ma'i slob gra rnying khungs kyi gras shig red/ bar lam 'dir mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i dka' ngal mang po 'phrad pa red/ rim pas dka' ngal sel te yar rgyas tan tan 'gro gi red/ lhag don da ring phru gu tsho thug pa'i skabs la tshang ma grung tog tog yag thag chod 'dug dga' po byung / gal che shos khyed rang tsho slob sbyong hur thag byed dgos/nga tsho btsan byol bod mi'i phru gu phal mo che la slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs yod pa dang / slob sbyong la skul ma byed mkhan yang yod pa red/ nga tsho'i bod lung pa'i nang la cha bzhag na/ bdun cu don dgu brgyad cu nas phran bu'i drag tu 176

'gro gi yod pa ma gtogs/ spyi yongs la ha cang khag po chags bsdad yod/nga rang tsho mi'i lung par slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs yod pa'i skabs 'dir dus tshod 'phro brlag ma btang bar gzab gzab byed dgos/ phyin chad rang nyid chos dang 'jig rten gang gi thog la yin na yang rnam dpyod gtong rgyu'i cha rkyen gtso bo de slob sbyong la rag lus pa yin dus/ tshang mas sems shugs bskyed de slob sbyong hur thag byed dgos/ rgya gar gyi dge rgan tsho dang / bod rigs dge rgan tshang mas da phan hur thag gang yong byas yod/ lhag don bod dge tsho la so so rang nyid kyi phru gur blta rtogs byed rgyu'i dmigs bsal las 'gan 'khri bsdad yod pas hur thag byed rogs zhes zhen skul byed rgyu yin/de nas 'dir gzhis chags kyi cha rkyen lag shes bzo las 'di chags bsdad yod pa red/ ma gzhi ngas gnas tshul shes kyi yod pa red/ yin na yang da gin las bsdoms klog pa yin/ yar rgyas gang la gang 'tshams phyin 'dug da dung tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/ tshang ma sems skyid po byas nas sdod/ don dag med pa'i sems khral byas na phan thogs gang yang med/sems kyi bde skyid zer ba 'di rtsa ba chen po red/ sems kyi bde skyid yod pa yin na lus la dka' ngal phran bu 'phrad pa yin na yang / sems kyi bde skyid des lus kyi dka' ngal de zil gyis gnon thub kyi red/ lus kyi dka' ngal de bzod thub kyi red/ sems la bde skyid med na lus po'i gnas stangs mthun rkyen 'dzoms po yod na yang skyid po gang yang yod pa ma red/ dper na/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi mi tshang kha shas dngos gnas drang 177

gnas kyi 'byor ldan phyug po/ dpal 'byor dang shes yon gyi gnas stangs la sems khral byed mi dgos pa ha las pa'iyag posku(da pa yin na yang / sems la bde skyid med par dngangs skrag chen po yod mkhan mang po yod/ sems kyi bde skyid zer ba 'di gal chen po yin/ sems kyi bde skyid yong ba'i cha rkyen gce sku rang rang so so'i bsam blo gtong phyogs la rag lus pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas las rgyu 'bras dang / 'khor ba'i chos nyid la sogs pa gsungs pa de tsho'i gras dngos gnas drang gnas sems sdug bsngal las skyob thabs dang / sems la snying stobs gsar pa skye ba'i bslab bya ha cang bzang po yin/ gnas stangs 'di dag rang rang so so'i las 'bras kyi gnas tshul chags bsdad yod pa red/ gnyis nas ji srid sems nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i ring la sems kyi bde ba med pa 'khor ba'i chos nyid yin pa red/ de ltar na nga tshos de tsam gyi nad ma theg pa'i sems ma skyid pa byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod pa ma red/ nga rang tsho sems bag phebs po byed dgos/ che sa bod spyi pa'i don dag yin na yang / rim pas yar rgyas 'gro gi red/ bod mi rigs yin pa'i cha nas bsam na yang spobs pa byed 'os pa dang / snying stobs skyes 'os pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ gang yin zer na bod rigs zer ba 'di 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi nang la yang snyan grags ldan pa'i lo rgyus yod mkhan gyi mi rigs shig red/ bar skabs kyi gnas stangs la cha bzhag na yang / bod mi rigs zhes lab dus 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra tsam zhig yod pa ma gtogs/ gral mtha' la bsdad yod pa ma red/ des 178

na nga rang tsho zhum dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med/ tshang mas spobs pa dang ldan pa'i thog nas sems bag phebs po byas nas sdod dgos/ nga rang tsho bod mi spyi dang bye brag da ring 'dir mnyam du yod mkhan tshang ma mi tshe don dang ldan pa zhig dang / mi tshe bde skyid ldan pa yong ba dang / de tsam du ma zad skye ba nas skye ba bshad kyi yod pa ltar/ tshe rabs gtan du bde ba yong bar ngas smon 'a ma rgya ga gi yin/ rang nyid chos la dad pa med pa zhig yin na ni chos la dad pa byed dgos zhes btsan po dbang yod byed mkhan su yang yod pa ma red/ chos byed dang ma byed so so rang dbang red/ yin na yang chos khas blangs nas chos cig byas pa yin na/ bsam blo'i thog nas chos kyi nyams len rnam par dag pa byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos las rgyu 'bras dang / bden pa gnyis/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs 'di tsho'i gras so sos shes pa byas/ do snang byas/ de 'dra'i thog nas nyin re nyin re'i mi tshe bskyel ba'i skabs la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi bslab bya de tsho bsam thub pa byung na dngos gnas drang gnas sems la bde skyid yong gi red/ sems la snying stobs slebs yong gi red/ sems la zhum pa yong gi ma red/ phan thogs ha cang chen po yong gi red/ de 'dra'i nyams len yod pa'i thog la kha 'don dge sbyor byas na phan thogs yod pa red/ gzhi rtsa'i chos kyi nyams len bsam blo'i thog nas yag po zin ma thub na/ kha nas tshig skam po zhig bton pa tsam la/ phan thogs rgya chen po yong thub rgyu khag po red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi rtsa ba de gang yin pa shes pa byas te nyams len byed dgos/ rtsa ba de 179

phar bzhag nas yal ga phal pa gcig la mgo 'khor bsdad na de tsam gyis phan thogs yong thub kyi ma red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i nang la/ chos zer dus zhabs brtan bsgrub rgyu dang / phyag mchod 'bul byed rgyu tsam la mgo 'khor nas bsdad/rang rang so so'i sems rgyud la zhu dag gtong rgyu dang / sems ngan pa la skyon du bltas nas spongs thabs/ sems bzang po la yon tan du bltas nas yar rgyas gtong thabs ma byas pa de nor 'khrul red/ so so'i shag gi sbug la mchod gshoms shig bzos/ sku brnyan 'dra sgrig de la dngos po'i 'du shes shig ma gtogs/ skyabs 'aX'i bslab bya mtshan nyid ma tshang ba byas/ sku la yang rgyu yag nyes blta ba 'dra po de 'dra byas pa yin na shin tu nor 'khrul red/ phyi nas bltas na sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs te chos kyi bya ba byed kyi yod pa'i khul yin yang don dag yang snying rgyu cha yag nyes dang / gong che chung la bsam blo btang ba yin na sdig pa bsag gi yod pa red/ des phan gyi ma red/ de bzhin kha 'don 'dra byas/ dpe cha 'dra klog gi yod na yang / sems kyi nang nas mi la sems gnag byed rgyu dang / mi la mabed bskor rgyu/ mi la thub tshod shod rgyu de 'dra bsam blo 'khor ba yin na chos de rdzun ma chags pa red/ chos dang rgyab 'gal chags pa red/ mdo don snying po nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos shig khas blangs nas skyabs gnas bla ma dashosan mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro mkhan zhig yin na/ dus rgyun du sems bzang po byed dgos/ sems ngan pa byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ rang gzhan rogs gsum su 'dra zhig yin na yang tshang ma bde ba don du gnyer ba dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa gcig gyur 180

yin dus mi la phan sems bcang rgyu 'di chos kyi snying po red/ mi'i spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i cha la yin na yang snying po chags bsdad yod pa red/ mis mi la brtse ba brlag na mi'i spyi tshogs kyi bde skyid brlag 'gro gi red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la (5ra rgyas gtong rgyu'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul de mi'i bde skyid ched du red/ gal srid mi'i bde skyid brlag pa yin na gnam la 'phur ba'i gnam gru dang / sa la 'gro ba'i ril li dang / mtsho la 'gro mkhan gru gzings ga tshod yod na yang phan thogs yod pa ma red/ deng sang dngos po yar rgyas tshad mtho por slebs pa'i nub cadags rgyal khab mang 16) nang bsam sbru'i zhi bde brlag na dngos po gcig pu'i thog nas mi la bde skyid mi yong ba'i gnas tshul mngon gsum ra 'phrod yong gi yod pa red/ rgya mi la cha bzhag na/ gung bran kho rang tsho'i lta ba la yid ches byas/ mi'i bde skyid de dngos po yar rgyas kyi thog nas yong gi red bsam pa dang / chos la dug bzhin bltas nas spong gi yod pa red/ rgya mi'i mtho rim dpon rigs tsho gcig 'og gcig la ma 'dus pa/ nga rgyal phrag thosag mtho gnon 'gran sems kho na'i ngang nas mi tshe bskyal nas bsdad pa de tsho skyid po gang yang med/ cho sa spangs pa'i mi tshor chos yod pa las/ bde skyid lhag tsam zhig dang / chos yod pa las sems pa skyid pa zhig yod na 'grigs pa red/ de mi 'dug chos yod mkhan dang /chos med mkhan gnyis ka bde ba 'dod mkhan dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa 'dra 'dra red/ chos spangs pa'i mi de bde skyid nyung ba dang bsam blo'i nang ma skyid pa mang ba byung na de sdug gyong red/ mdo don yang snying chos byas pa'i dgos 181

don so so'i sems skyid pa gcig dang / bag phebs pa/ mi tshe skyid pa gcig dgos pa yin dus/ de yong ba'i rtsa ba mis mi la phan sems byed pa dang / mis mi la brtse ba byed rgyu de red/ de khyed rang tsho'i sems la nges pa byed dgos/'di'i thog nas nga rang tsho bod kha ba gangs can gyi sems can tsho 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la las 'brel yod pa yin dus ma ṇi yag po bgrangs/ thub pa'i mtshan sngags yag po bgrangs/ gtso che shos nyin re nyin re'i so so'i lag len gyi thog nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig byed kyi yin na spyi dang sger tshang mar phan gyi red/ da ring khyed rang tsho nyi mas 'tshig sa pa la dgongs dag zer gyi yin/ nga rang tsho 'dir thug pa la dga' po byung /khyed rang tshang ma sems skyid po byas nas sdod rogs byed/ hur thag byed a/shes song ngam/ thugs rje che zhes bka' stsal// / /182

༄tsho// phyi lo 1983 zla 8 tshes 3 nyin/ ku lu ma na lir mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/thog mar spi tir gsung chos gnang ba'i gnas lugs bka' gnang rjes/kha seng spi ti'i phyogs kyi yul pa tsho la'ang ngas skul ma byas pa yin/ khyed rang tsho tshang ma nang pa'i chos la so so yid ches byas nas nyams len byed kyi yod pa yag po red/ 'on kyang de nges par du shes dgos/ dper na/ 'tshems bu ba yin zer mkhan zhig gis gos 'tshems stangs ma shes na gad mo shor rgyu red/dpe de bzhin du nang pa yin zhes nang pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs gang 'dra yin min ma shes na shin tu thabs skyob nga red/ so sos dad pa byed sa'i chos de'i gnas tshul shes pa byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin stabs/ ngas slob sbyong byed dgos zhes gang sa gang la 'bod bskul byed kyi yod/ da ring 'di gar yang ngas gcig lab na bsam dran byung / nga tshos dad pa byed sa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di lta ba'i cha nas gting zab po/ spyod pa'i cha nas sa dang lam gyi 'gro stangs 'di tsho'i gras ha cang rgya chen po/ rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas nges pa rnyed rgyu yod pa zhin tu spus dag spro zhig yod pa red/ rang rang so so'i ngos nas de 'dra'i gnas tshul gang yang ma shes par phyag 'tshal zer ba dang / skyabs su mchi zer ba de tsam zhig ma gtogs ma shes par bsdad pa yin na shin tu thabs lha du dang / shin kha phangs po red/ so so'i ngo sa nas chos la dad pa med na de gnas tshul khag zlog red/ chos la dad pa byas pa'i rjes la dad pa byed sa'i chos de'i gnas tshul brtsad gcod byas/ shes pa byas/ de'i thog nas kha 'don dge sbyor 'dra 183

po gang byas pa yin na yang spus dag po gcig dang / tshad longs pa zhig yong gi red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas stangs gang yang ma shes pa'i jogeg nas ma ṇi 'bum kha shas shig bsags pa dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs shes pa'i sgo nas thog ma'i kun slong dang / bar du ma ṇi bgrang pa'i skabs la bsam blo gtong stangs/ mjug tu bsngo ba dang /dmigs med kyi rgyas 'debs byed pa sogs shes pa'i thog nas ma ṇi phreng skor gcig bgrang pa de phan yon che chung bsdur rgyu yod pa red/ sngar skal bzang lugs bzang dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ma gtogs de min pa'i gnas tshul mang po mthong rgyu dang thos rgyu med pa'i skabs kyi dus tshod lta bu deng sang bsdad med pa red/ deng sang phyogs gcig nas 'dzam bu gling 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi sku da pa dang / gnyis nas gnas tshul gsar pa mang po zhig nga tshos mthong thos yong gi yod pa red/ phar phyogs der 'char gzhi ldan pa'i thog nas dngos po btang nas las ka byas te zla ba gcig gnyis nang la mig mthong lag zin gyi grub 'bras bstan gyi yod pa red/ tshur phyogs 'dir nga tshos kha 'don dge rjodar byas nas zla ba gcig gnyis nang la mig mthong lag zin gyi grub 'bras bstan rgyu khag po red/ 'on kyang blo gzu bor gnas pa'i thog nas yun ring tsam brtag dpyad byas te chos yod pa'i mi de sems skyid pa 'dug gam/ chos med pa'i mi de sems skyid pa 'dug bltas pa yin na shes rgyu zhigayong gi red de/ spyir btang gi mthong snang la phyi dngos po yar rgyas phyin pa'i grub 'bras mig mthong lag zin yod pa ji bzhin/ nang bsam blo yar rgyas kyi grub 'bras de ma thag 184

tu ma mthong ba'i rkyen gyis chos byas kyang dgos pa de tsam mi 'dug bsam pa zhig mi su yin na'ang mthong srid kyi red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul la ltos na yang nga rang tshos chos kyi gnas tshul shes pa byed rgyu 'di gal chen po red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la chos mang po yod pa red/ chos tshang ma dngos gnas yag po red/ dper na ye shu'i chos dang / kha che'i chos/ mu stegs pa'i chos 'dra mi 'dra mang po yod red/ 'di tsho'i gras tshang mas spyir btang gi cha nas bshad pa yin na/ mi bzang po byed dgos pa dang / phan sems byed dgos pa/ sems pa bzang po byed dgos pa sogs kyi bslab bya chos lugs tshang mas byed kyisku/da/ chos lugs de dang de brgyud nas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la lo brgya phrag mang skra'i ring la mi sa ya mang po zhig la phan thogs bsgrubs yod pa red/ da lta'i skabs la yang mi'i khams dang mos pa sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'grel bshad las ye shu dang / kha che'i chos kyi 'grel bshad sems la zug che ba dang / phan shas che ba tan tan yong gi red/ der brten chos lugs 'dra mi 'dra yod pa yag po red/ nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'dir lta ba'i cha nas rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas ra 'phrod rgyu dang / nges pa rnyed rgyu yod pa/ spyod pa'i cha nas kyang mi la phan sems byed dgos zhes tshig skam po zhig ldab skyor byas pa tsam min par/ phan sems byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/phan sems kyi blo thog mar gzhi gang 'dra zhig gi thog nas bsgrub tshul/ de nas rim pas bloyar rgyas btang ste go rim ldan pa'i thog nas sems la bzo bcos byed stangs ha cang zhib tshags po dang / spus dag po yod par brten nga rang tsho 185

de dag shes pa byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug de snga phan chad chos slob gnyer byed rgyu gra sa la 'khri ba dang / de'i nang tshan nas gzhung chen mo blta mkhan tsho la 'khri ba las/ spyir btang gi mi mang tshos chos la dad pa byas pa de gas 'grigs kyi yod pa lta bu las/ mang tshogs kyi chos la slob gnyer byed dgos pa'i mig ltos de tsam med pa de tan tan rjes lus kyi bsam blo red/ de tsho snga mo'i goms gshis bzang po rtsa ba mas min/ skya ser pho mo su 'dra zhig yin na yang chos la dad pa ma byas na de ga med/ chos la dad pa yod pa zhig yin na so sos dad pa byed sa'i chos de slob sbyong nges par du byed dgos/ skyabs 'gro byed sa'i skyabs yul sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog de dag gang 'dra zhig yin pa/ skyabs ngo ma de chos dkon mchog yin pas de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin pa/ chos dkon mchog gis rang nyid 'jigs pa las skyabs stangs gang 'dra byas nas skyabs kyi yod pa de tsho'i gras nges par du do snang byas nas slob sbyong byed dgos/ tshes bzang dus bzang dang / las ka nyung ba de 'dra'i skabs la dpe cha shes mkhan de 'dra nas bshad/ tshe dbang zhus pa'i bzo 'dra po de 'dra byed ma dgos/ 'dzin gra tshogs pa lta bu byas te bshad mkhan gyis bshad/ nyan mkhan gyis nyan te gang ltar yang snying nang pa'i shes tshad yar rgyas gtong thabs la do snang byed dgos kyi 'dug dgon pa gra tshang khag gi nang la hong gnyer byed stangs 'dra min sna tshogs yod pa red/ rigs gcig gis gzhung chen mo'i 〉ba gnyer byed pa dang / rigs gcig gis mtshan nyid sbyang ba nang bzhin zhib tshags po ma byung na yang gzhung 186

don 'chad nyan gyi thog nas lam spyi'i 'gro stangs shes pa byas/ de 'dra'i thog nas cho ga phyag len rigs gnang gi yod pa red/ cho ga phyag len byed pa la yang thog mar lam spyi'i 'gro stangs cha tshang shes pa'i thog nas byed dgos pa las/lam spyi'i 'gro stangs rtsa ba nas ma shes par cho ga'i tshig skam po zhig bton nas bsdad na snying po de tsam med pas/ 'di tsho'i gras nga tshos nges par du yar rgyas gtong dgos/ rdo don yang snying nga rang tsho sger sger so i nyams len gyi ngos nas cha bzhag na yang chos shes dgos pa dang / bstan pa spyi'i gnas tshul gyi cha nas rtsis pa yin na yang chos shes dgos pas slob sbyong la do snang byed dgos kyi 'dugalhag don slob gra'i nang la yod mkhan phru gu tshor deng dus kyi shes yon cha tshang bslab kyi yod pa'i thog la/ nga rang tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung bcas bslab kyi yod pa 'di dag khyed rang tshor dpe ma srid pa'i go skabs bzang po yin pas slob sbyong hur thag byed dgos/ chos dgos dang mi dgos dang / chos kyis phan thogs yod dang med zer ba de so sos brtag dpyad byed dgos/ spyir btang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la chos khas len mkhan rigs gcig dang / chos khas mi len mkhan gyi rigs gcig yod pa red/ chos khas mi len mkhan gyi nang la yang khag gnyis yod/ spyir btang chos la do snang mi byed mkhan rigs gcig gis dngul dang / rgyu dngos wa'i 'du 'god la mgo 'khor nas sdod kyi yod pa red/ rgya mi gung khran la cha mtshon na/ chos la do snang mi byed pa tsam min par/ chos la dug lta bu'i skyon du bltas/ chos kyi bsam blo yod na mi'i 187

klad pa la skyon phog gi red ces ched du gnyer nas chos spangs kyi yod pa red/dper na/ chos la nyes dmigs su bltas te chos spangs pa'i mi gcig dang /chos dad yod pa'i mi gcig so so'i sger gyi sems la bde skyid che chung dang / spyi tshogs gnas stangs bzang ngan gang 'dra yod med nga tshos rtsis shig rgyag gi yin na/ dper na/ ye shu la cha zhag na/ spyod pa ngan pa dang / mi la dbang yod bshad na 'jig rten bkod pa po dkon mchog thugs khrel gyi red bsam pa'i thog nas dran shes bag yod bsten gyi yod pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas cha bzhag na/ khrims sa la gyar rung ma gyar rung / mi gzhan dag gis shes rung ma shes rung / ngas ya rabs ma byas par mi la gnod pa bskyal ba yin na las rgyu 'bras la ltos kyi ma red bsam ste so sku'i bsam cho'i nang nas ngo tsha khrel yod kyis stangs 'dzin phran bu byed kyi red/ chos spangs pa'i mi des khral sel khe phan gang che'i bsam blo ma gtogs/ ya rabs ma rabs kyi gnas tshul brtsi gi yod pa ma red/ dper na/ rgya mi gung bran gyi kha nas spyir 'gro ba mi/ de'i nang tshan nas ngal rtsol mi mang gi sdug bsngal sel rgyu dang / ngal rtsol mi mang gi bde ba sgrub rgyu zer gyi yod na yang lag len gyi thog la chags sdang rmongs gsum kho na'i gzhan dbang la phyin pa ma gtogs/ chags sdang gnyis la nyes dmigs su blta gi med/ dper na gung bran ring lugs nang gral rim gyi 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod pa de mi mang che ba'i bde ba bsgrub pa'i ched du yin zer yang / don la thabs shes de zhe sdang 'phel rgyas gtong mkhan 'dra po chags yod/ gral rim gyi 'thab rtsod byas te gcig gis gcig la 'khon 'dzin dang /188

gcig gis gcig la skyon brjod/ gcig gis gcig la gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor lag len byas pa'i 'bras bu la mi gcig gis gcig la yid ches dang / phan tshun mdza' mthun/ phan tshun gus brtsi bcas brlag ste kha nas mthun sgril dang /mthun sgril ga tshod bshad rung ma bshad rung lag len ngo ma'i thog la mi dang mi'i 'brel ba de phan tshun dgra gshed lta bu'i zhed snang dang / dngangs skrag gcig gis gcig la dwogs zon kho na byas nas sdod dgos pa'i spyi tshogs shig chags yod/ de yag po gang yang min/ ga res lan pa red zer na/ sems nang la byams pa dang / brtse ba dang / phan sems/ ya rabs kyi bsam blo med pas lan pa yin/ mis mi la brtse ba dang / mis mi la yid ches brlag pa'i 'bras bur nyi ma gang 'khyol ma gtogs/ bsam cho'i nang nas so sos dang bas kun nas blangs te ma bskul dang len gyi thog nas las ka byed mkhan yong gi yod pa ma red/ gang ltar rang phyogs la phan pa/ gzhan phyogs la sdang ba'i chags sdang drag wa'i thog nas mi tshe bskyal ba yin na skyid poskudang rgyu khag the rdod/ chags sdang la gnyen po brten nas re zhig yongs su spangs ma thub na yang / de la nyes dmigs su bltas nas spong sems brten pa yin na/ sems nang la bag phebs pa dang / zhi ba/ skyid pa zhig yong gi red/ chos spangs pa'i mi tshos kyang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang / bde skyid cig byung na bsam te chos spangs pa red/chos nyams len byed mkhan tshos kyang bde skyid byung na bsam te chos byed kyi yod pa red/ de gnyis kyi grub 'bras lci yang bshegs pa yin na/ chos yod mkhan de sems skyid pa yod/ des chos kyis mi la phan thogs yod pa gsal por mtshon 189

gyi yod/ chos 'dra 'dra'i nang nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di ha cang spus dag po yod/ spus dag po yin pa'i khungs lung rgyu mtshan mang po bshad rgyu yod pa zhig red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la lta ba dang spyod pa gnyis yod pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba de rten 'byung gi lta ba yin/ rten 'byung gi lta ba'i don de gang 'dra zhig yin nam zer na/ 'jig rten 'di'i bde skyid dang / sdug bsngal rnams dkon mchog gi blo yi g.yo ba sngon du 'gro ba'i thog nas byung ba ma yin par/ bde sdug de rnams rang rang gi las dang 'bras bu'i rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas byung bar bshad yod pas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba rten 'byung gi lta ba red ces zer don de red/ de nges pa byed dgos/ gang ltar yang snying longs spyad bya'i bde ba dang / sdug bsngal thams cad rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas byung ba dang / longs spyod pa wa'i bdag de yang rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas btags pa ma gtogs/ bdag rang skya thub pa'i sgo nas grub pa med pa red/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i spyod pa de 'tshe ba med pa'i spyod pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la theg pa chen po dang / theg pa dman pa gnyis yod/ theg pa dman pa'i chos kyi snying 17 de gzhan la 'tshe ba mi byed pa de yin pa red/ theg pa chen wa'i chos kyi rtsab de snying rje chen wa'i sgo nas gzhan la phan btags dgos pa gsung gi yod pa red/ gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i cho de brtse ba'i bsam pa snying rje'i dbang gis yong gi yod pa dang / gzhan la 'tshe ba mi byed pa de yang gal — — na pa'i bsam pa brtse ba de'i dbang gis yong gi yod par brten/ theg 190

pa che chung gnyis ga'i chos kyi rtsa ba de snying rje la thug gi yod pa red/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'dir mi gsod rgyu dang / mi rtsa med gtong rgyu'i lag cha dang / rdzas sbyor 'khrul chas thog 'gro song shin tu chen po btang nasayar rgyas 'di lta bu phyin yod pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis mi shin tu mang po zhig dngangs skrag dang / sdug bsngal chen po myangs nas sdod dgos kyi yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i dngos yod gnas tshul 'di lta bu'i dus skabs 'dir/ nang pa'i spyod pa 'tshe ba spangs pa'i thabs lam mam/ 'tshe ba spangs pa'i grub mtha' 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i skang la dgos nges thig nges kyi grub mtha' zhig chags bsdad yod/ deng sang mi shes yon can mang po zhig gis skud so bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs pa yin min la ma ltos par/ deng sang 'dzam gling gi gnas stangs 'dir ston pa shakyu thub pa'i bslab bya shin tu dgos gal chen po 'dug ces bshad kyi 'dug pa ltar/ nang pa'i spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa de dngos gnas 'dzam gling la dgos mkho yod pa dang /zhi bder phan thogs sku(da pa zhig chags bsdad yod pa red/ chos lugs gzhan dag gi nang la rang rang gi dkon mchog gis gsungs pa'i gsung rab de la brtag dpyad byed mi cerdzog na yang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas brtag dpyad byed dgos par bshad yod/ dper na bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi bka' la yang brtag dpyad byed dgos gsungs yod/ gnad don des nang pa'i chos kyi nang la rgyu mtshan gtso bo byed kyi yod pa'i rtags bstan gyi yod pa red/ rgyu mtshan la brtag dpyad byas/ rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas ra 'phrod kyi 'dug na khas blangs/ rgyu mchan gyi thog nas ra 'phrod kyi mi 'dug na dor dgos pa red/ nang 191

pas chos nyams len byed pa'i skabs la yang rig pa'i thog nas brtag dpyad byed rgyu gtso bor 'dzin pa ma gtogs/ lung de gtso bor rtsis kyi yod pa ma red/ lung de rnam dag yin min yang rig pa dang 'gal mi 'gal brtag dpyad byed dgos pa red/ deng sang mi mang po zhig gi bsam lho'i nang la/ chos kyi rig gnas dang / tshan rig gi rig gnas gnyis wa de mthun pa'i cha gtan nas med par shin tu tha dad yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa de 'dra ranga.e yin bsam gyi 'dug tshan rig pas rdzas dang 'khrul chas la brten nas gtso bor phyi'i dngos po gcig la brtag dpyad byas te bden don gcig btsal gyi yod pa dang / nang pa'i chos kyi thog nas kyang gang ltar bden don zhig btsal gyi yod pa red/ rig pa dang 'gal ba'i grub mtha' zhig yin na bden don min pa red/ rig pa dang 'gal ba'i grub mtha' zhig khas blangs na smra ba wa de tshad ma'i skyes bur mi 'dod pa red/ bden don dang 'gal na yang dag pa'i grub mtha' min par/ phyin ci log pa'i grub mtha' chags pa red/ nang pa'i chos dang / tshan rig gnyis ka nas dngos wa'i bden don 'tshol ba gcig gyur yin pas de gnyis kyi byed las dang da migs yul thag nye po yod pa red/ nang pas rten 'byung gi lta ba bshad pa 'di yang tshan rig dang mthun po chags bsdad yod/ de ltar nang pa'i chos kyi lta ba dang / spyod pa'i thog nas bsam blo yag po zhig btang nas brtag dpyad byas pa yin na/ chos 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i spus dag po dang / gting zab po rgya chen po zhig yin pas/ de dag shes thub pa bya rgyu shin tu gal chen spi yin/ nga rang tsho'i lta ba rten 'byung yin pas las rgyu 'bras srung dgos/ las 192

rgyu 'bras kyi tshul shes pa'i thog nas sdig spongs dge bsgrub lag len byed dgos/sdig spongs dge bsgrub byed pa de yang / nyin re nyin re'i bya gzhag nang lag len byed dgos pa las/ so so nyin re nyin re'i 'tsho ba bskyel ba'i ring la mi la gnod pa skyel ba dang / mi la sems gnag byed pa/ mi la thub tshod shod pa sha stag byas/ yud tsam zhig gdan sgang la bsdad nas kha 'don 'dra byas/'ag par phreng ba zhig 'khyer nas bsdad pa yin na de ga phyi ga log red/ rang nyid tshong rgyag gi yod kyang rung / ngal rtsol zhig rgyugs kyi yod kyang rung / zhing la sa/ dang / las khungs nang gi las ka/ slob gra'i las ka/ sman pa'i las la 'dra po gang 'dra zhig byed kyi yod na yang / so so'i las ka de byed pa'i skabs la sems pa bzang po zhig bskyed/ mi la phan yag po btags/ gal srid phan btags thub kyi med na yang / mi la gswārted pa nam yang ma bskyal ba zhig byed kyi yin na/ mi des chos byed kyi yod pa red/ so so nyin re'i las ka de drang po drang bzhag byas/ mi la ga tshad thub thub kyi phan btags/ gal srid phan btags ma thub na'ang mi la gnod pa ma 'khyol ba byas/ ya rabs spyod bzang gi sgo nas soso'i nyin ma gcig gi mi tshe bzang po zhig bskyel dgos/da dung yag po yong gi 'dug na/ zhogs pa yar langs pa dang skyabs 'gro yag po zhig byas/ nga nang pa yin/ da ring gi nyin ma 'dir ngas nang pa tshad longs pa zhig byed kyi yin/ ngas nang pa'i zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan zhig byed kyi min bsam pa byas/ de nas so so'i lto gos kyi las ka ga re byed kyi yod pa de rnams byas/ yang dgong mo nyal khar ngas da ring nang pa'i zhabs 193

'dren zhus 'dug gam mi 'dug bsam blo yag po zhig btang / da ring ngas nang pa'i zhabs 'dren rang zhus mi 'dug a'u tsam byas 'dug bsam na pho rgod po ngas da ring go chod po byas 'dug bsam nas dga' ba sgom/ yang da ring ngas nang pa'i zhabs 'dren zhus 'dug ngas mi la don dag med par kha rtsod byas/ ngas skyag rdzun bshad/ mgo skor btang ba sogs so sos 'gyod pa skyes gzhi'i gnas tshul byung 'dug na/ kho sprang po/ za 'dre/ khos thabs sdug 'di lta bu byas 'dug bsams nas so sos so sor dma' phab/ nag nyes bgrangs/ 'gyod pa chen pos bshags sdom byas/ ngas sang nyin phan chad 'di 'dra gtan nas byed kyi min bsam pa'i sdom sems yag po bskyed kyi yin na chos pa'i rtags bstan gyi yod pa red/ snga mo ༄1da la dge bshes 'ban gung rgyal zhu ba zhig byung ba red/ khong thog mar rkun ma brku mkhan zhig yin pa rjes la khong chos pa bzang po zhig chags pa red/ nyin gcig kho rang gi sbyin bdag zhig gi sa la slebs pa red/ khong sngon ma nas rkun ma brkus pa'i goms gshis kyi lag pa g.yas pas dngos po ba/ grab byed kyi yod pa red/ lam seng khong gis khyod chos pa yin pas/ rkun ma brkus na 'grigs kyi ma red ces lag pa g.yon pas lag g.yas pa bzung pa'i lo rgyus yod/ chos pa zer na de 'dra la zer ba red/ dper na/ tshong pa zhigayin na/ ngas mi la mgo skor gtong dgos/ mi la ham pa bshad dgos bsam pa'i bsam blo 'khor ba'i skabs la lam seng de'i skyon dran pa byas te/ nga bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes (1sgo ༷༷/sna rwarngordotho //rte//)pe/lce/ (1/ thu6)/ ri'abrangs na/ nga skyabs 'a 'a na mkhan ga na bsam pa lam sang 194

'dren zhus 'dug gam mi 'dug bsam blo yag po zhig btang / da ring ngas nang pa'i zhabs 'dren rang zhus mi 'dug a'u tsam byas 'dug bsam na pho rgod po ngas da ring go chod po byas 'dug bsam nas dga' ba sgom/ yang da ring ngas nang pa'i zhabs 'dren zhus 'dug ngas mi la don dag med par kha rtsod byas/ ngas skyag rdzun bshad/ mgo skor btang ba sogs so sos 'gyod pa skyes gzhi'i gnas tshul byung 'dug na/ kho sprang po/ za 'dre/ khos thabs sdug 'di lta bu byas 'dug bsams nas so sos so sor dma' phab/ nag nyes bgrangs/ 'gyod pa chen pos bshags sdom byas/ ngas sang nyin phan chad 'di 'dra gtan nas byed kyi min bsam pa'i sdom sems yag po bskyed kyi yin na chos pa'i rtags bstan gyi yod pa red/ snga mo ༄1da la dge bshes 'ban gung rgyal zhu ba zhig byung ba red/ khong thog mar rkun ma brku mkhan zhig yin pa rjes la khong chos pa bzang po zhig chags pa red/ nyin gcig kho rang gi sbyin bdag zhig gi sa la slebs pa red/ khong sngon ma nas rkun ma brkus pa'i goms gshis kyi lag pa g.yas pas dngos po ba/ grab byed kyi yod pa red/ lam seng khong gis khyod chos pa yin pas/ rkun ma brkus na 'grigs kyi ma red ces lag pa g.yon pas lag g.yas pa bzung pa'i lo rgyus yod/ chos pa zer na de 'dra la zer ba red/ dper na/ tshong pa zhigayin na/ ngas mi la mgo skor gtong dgos/ mi la ham pa bshad dgos bsam pa'i bsam blo 'khor ba'i skabs la lam seng de'i skyon dran pa byas te/ nga bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes (1sgo ༷༷/sna rwarngordotho //rte//)pe/lce/ (1/ thu6)/ ri'abrangs na/ nga skyabs 'a 'a na mkhan ga na bsam pa lam sang 194

blo skyon de 'gog dgos/ de 'dra byas na chos pa chags pa red/ chos pa zer ba de 'dra zhig la go dgos pa ma gtogs/ bsam blo gtong rgyu dang / lag len gang yang med par kha 'don byas pa tsam la ha las rgyu khyon nas yod pa ma red/nyin zhag phrug gcig ring bsam blo gtong stangs dang / mi tshe bskyel stangs tshad longs pa'i gzhi rtsa yag po zhig yod pa'i thog nas ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab sgrub pa/ lha yi rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i nyams len byed dgos pa las gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul gang yang mi shes par mthon po'i nyams len byed kyi yod zer na nor 'khrul red/ de bzhin so so'i shag gi sbag la phyag snam mchod gshoms de 'dra bsgrigs/ sku 'dra mang po bsgrigs zlo de tsho ma gzhi yag po red de yin na yang de gtso bo ma red/ gtso bo de sems la brtag dpyad byas/ sems la bzo bcos byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ mchod gshoms nang sgrig rgyu zhig ma red/ sku 'dra mang po bzhengs/ cha tshad longs pa zhig kyang med pa byas/ yang rgyu dngos po'i 'du shes byed pa de tsho ༄/ra 'khrul red/ nga rang chos gtso bo las 'bras la lag len bkal rgyu de chos kyi gtso bo yin/ gtso bo de lag len med par dor/ phal pa sku gsung thugs rten bsgrigs rgyu sogs la mgo 'khor na yag po yod pa ma red/ nga rang tshos sku gsung thugs rten 'di tsho'i gras rang gi rgyud la dge ba gsar pa 'phel ba'i don dag la bsgrigs kyi yod par brten dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan shes pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi nyams len ga tshad thub thub byas pa'i thog nas/ dngos gzhi'i lag len las rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor ma nor ba 195

byed rgyu gal chen po red/ nga kha seng a ru na cal la phyin pa yin/ mon pa tshos chos kyi gnas tshul gang yang ma shes kyang / dad pa shin tu chen po yod/dper na bla ma zhig la mgo gtugs rgyu byung na ha lam 'bras bu chen po zhig thob kyi yod pa lta bu byed/ kha shas kyis skyabs su mchi/ sangs rgyas mkhyen/phyi ma ngan song la mi gtong rogs zer gyi 'dug khong tsho ngan song la gtong dang mi gtong nga'i lag par yod na legs kyang / de 'dra ga la yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pas 'jig rten bkod pa po khas len gyi med par brten nga tsho ngan song la gtong dang mi gtong bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag la'ang med/ ngan song la 'gro dang mi 'gro so so'i lag par yod/ so sos ngan song la 'gro ba'i rgyu bkag mngon mtho thob pa'i rgyu rang rang so sos bsgrub na ngan song gi sgo 'gog thub kyi red/ chos la dad pa yod kyang / chos byed stangs ma shes par bsdad na thabs skyo po red/ tshang mas nang pa'i chos shes pa byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ da ring nga tsho khyug tsam thug skabs nga rang gi bsam tshul 'di dag bshad na bsam byung / tshang mas do snang byas nas nges par du shes pa byed dgos/ dper na nga rang la cha bzhag na yang bar seng yod tshad la dpe cha klog gi yod/ 'bad rtsol byed kyi yod/ 'bad rtsol byas pa'i 'bras bu la phan thogs tan tan yong gi 'dug sems la yar rgyas 'gro rgyu 'dug tshang mas 'bad rtsol byed kyi yin na yar rgyas tan tan 'gro gi red/ tshang mas hur thag byed shog a/ yang nga tsho ma 'ongs pa la thug gi red/ bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che/ zhes bka' 455// //196
