༄༄// phyi lo 1984 zla 6 tshes 7 nyin ku lu ma na lir mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/nga da res tsha g.yol yong ba yin/ khyed tsho khyug tsam thug na bsam pa zhwa/sa dmigs bsal chos 'brel dang / skad cha shod rgyu gang yang med/ khyed rang tsho sems pa skyid po byas nas sdod dgos/ 'jig rten 'dir skye ba zhig blangs pa red/ sems pa skyid po byas nas sdod rgyu de gal chen po 'dug nga tsho bod par cha bzhag na/ so so'i lung pa bral te mi'i lung par gyar nas dka' ngal mang po 'phrad pa'i gnas skabs la bsam sbru'i thog nas bag phebs po byas she bsdad na nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang la phan gyi red/ nga rang la cha bzhag na dka' ngal dang 'gan chen po zhig 'khri yod na'ang / so so ma skyid pa min par bag phebs po byas nas bsdad na gzugs po bde ba sogs la phan gyi 'dug nga tsho 'u nga pa med pa'i mi zhig yin dus bsam blo'i nang ma bde ba yong gi red de/se mas bag phebs po byas nas sdod rgyu de gal che shos red/ mi'i spyi tshogs nang nyon stongs dbang gis sems ma dul bar gnas pa'i ring la skyid pa yong thabs med pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs yod/ nga tsho'i mi tshe'i nang kha chag rna ral dang / gra ma 'grigs yong rgyu ni rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul red/ gra ma 'grigs yong ba'i skabs bsam blo gtong phyogs la khyad par chen po yod/ so so sems bag phebs po byas nas bsdad thub na de tsam gyi dngangs skrag dang / ma skyid pa/ srog rlung 'phar ba sogs mi yong ba la phan rgas yod/ khyed tsho tshang ma sems bag phebs po dang / skyid po byas nas 197

sdod dgos/ chos kyi thog nas bde sdug ji byung las bzang ngan dbang gis byung bar gsungs yod/ dka' ngal byung skabs so so'i las yin bsam pa dang / spyi don thog gra ma 'grigs yong dus/ nga tsho'i spyi mthun gyi las yin/las kyi 'bras bu thog tu babs pa red bsam na bsam khra'i nang de tsam ma skyid pa rang yong gi ma red/ las rgyu 'bras la bsam blo gtong rgyu de gal chen po red/ gnyis nas rang so so'i sems rgyud yar rgyas ma phyin bar sdug bsngal yong rgyu chos nyid red/ da lta thob pa'i so so'i mi lus 'di las dang nyon mongs dbang gis byung ba red/ las nyon dbang gis byung ba'i mi lus de ji srid yod pa'i ring der de la brten pa'i sdug bsngal rnam grangs mang po yong rgyu yin pa chos nyid red/ dper na/ me la lag pa 'chang na 'tshig pa de me'i rang bzhi na red/ me de sdug drag pa ma red/ me de'i rang bzhin de 'dra zhig tu grub yod pa red/ lag pa 'tshig pa'i sdug bsngal de mi 'dod na me la lag pa 'chang rgyu yod pa ma red/ dpe de bzhin du nga tshor las dang nyon mongs dbang gis skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yong gi yod pa red/ sdug bsngal de dag mi 'dod na/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las ngan pa rnams spongs ngagos/ don dag che sa la bsam blo gtong dgos/ nga tshos dka' ngal yong skabs nga tsho 'khor bar 'khyams nas bsdad yod stabs sdug bsngal yong rgyu chos nyid red bsam na khyad par chen po yod/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sdug bsngal gyi bden pa/ kun 'byung gi bden pa/ 'gog pa'i bden pa/ lam gyi bden pa zhes gsungs pa de rnams shin tu phan thogs chen po skusgod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i 198

chos kyi nang la bde sdug gang byung rung de la dpag pa'i chos kyi nyams len byed rgyu yod/ dper na/ nad gzhi sdug po byung na des sngon bsags kyi las sbyong rgyu dang / sdug bsngal byung ba 'dis rkyen byas te sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la mi 'dod pa skye ba/ dper na/ nad pa zhig gis na tsha 'di gang drag bsam pa yod na/de tsam gyis na zug mngon che ba yong gi yod pa/ na ba de so so'i tshe sngon las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin pa dang / so so'i lus 'di blangs rjes sdug bsngal mang po yong rgyu yin pa thag chod pa red/ da res kyi sdug bsngal 'dis las ngan mang po zhig dag pa dang / 'di dang 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal sems can gzhan la'ang yod pa de rnams da re sa nga'i nad 'dis go chod pa zhig yong ba shog bsam pa'i bsam blo zhig 'altosar thub na/ na tshar mi bzod pa med pa'i thog la da dung sems nang dga' spro skye thub pa yong gi 'dug de ltar sdug pa byung na bsam blo gtong stangs gcig yang gra 'grigs po dang bde skyid zhig byung na de la bsam blo gtong stangs gcig yod pa red/ yag po zhig byung na de bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu red bsam nas rjes su yi rangs byas/rma/ 'ongs pa na'ang bsod nams gsog dgos kyi 'dug bsam nas 'bad brtson byas/ rang gi bsod nams des rang gzhan rgya che zhig la phan pa shog bsam pa bya dgos/ de ltar bde sdug gang byung yang bsam blo gtong phyogs kyi thog nas khyad par chen po yod/ nga tshos chos byed pa 'di bde skyid yong ba'i don nga yin pas/ las rgyu 'bras la bsam blo btang na/ sems bag phebs sngoge jong bde skyid yong gi red/ khong khro dang / nga rgyal/ phrag dog de tsho'i gras 199

kyis sems ma skyid pa bzo gi yod/ su yin na'ang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa yin stabs sdug bsngal gyi rgyu khong khro la sogs pa de tsho spongs dgos/ dper na/ mi gcig sems skyid po byas bsdad pa'i skabs su de la mi dga' ba'i dgra'i lo rgyus shig bshad na/ de ma thag khong khro skyes nas sems ma skyid pa yong gi yod/ so so sems ma skyid pa byas pa gyong red ma gtogs/ khong khro des dgra de la gnod kyi ma red/ dper na/ bod nang gi gnas tshul bod pas go skabs khong khro langs kyang rgya mir gnod kyi ma red/ so so ma skyid pa byas pa de sdug gyong las phan thogs gang yang med/ yang so so'i rogs pa tshor gyon chas dang / sku(na tan sogs legs pa sku(da na/ der phrag casag skyes nas kho la sdug pa zhig byung na bsam kyang / kho la des gnod kyi ma red/ sems pa skyid po yong ched las 'bras dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rang bzhin dang / blo sbyong gi bsam blo gtong rgyu gal chen po red/ nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhig yin stabs nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ma shes par bsdad na thabs skyo po red/ so so'i dad pa bya sa de shes pa byas te lag len 'gel gyi yin na phan thogs ji+o5ོda pa mig gis mthong rgyu sku(da pa zhig cesang gi red/ chos zhes pa de lha khang nang la yod pa zhig min pas/ so so'i bsam blo'i nang skye dgos/ chos kyi nang don snying po bsam pa bzang po bya rgyu dang / gzhan la gnod sems ma byas par phan sems byas na de cho sa red/ mi la thub tshong shod pa dang / bsam pa ngan po byas na lus la gra chas gyon yod na'ang de chos pa ma red la/ rgyun du kha 'don dge sbyor bya gi yod na'ang phan thogs yod pa 200

ma red/ bsam pa bzang po bya dgos/ spyir stangs bod pa'i gshis ka de ngang rgyud ring po/ bsam pa bzang po yag po 'dug ces mi mang pos bstod bsngags byed kyi 'dug de'i yong rkyen gtso bo bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang theg pa chen po'i chos dar khyab chen po byung ba des nga tshor goms gshis bzang wa de 'jags pa red/ sems bzang po bya rgyu de mi'i mi che'i nang rtsa ba che shos shig red/ ngas rnam kun mi su thug kyang bsam pa bzang po byed pa las/ mi ngan pa bya rgyu yod pa ma red ces shod kyi yod/ nga rang yang gang thub kyi bsam pa bzang wa'i nyams len byed kyi yod/ mi che'i nang chos zhes pa 'di yod pa rang drin che ba 'dugachos yod na skye ba phyi ma brjod med red/ tshe 'di la yang phan thogs yod pa tan tan red/deng sang bod nang rgya mis dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong phyogs skor la srid jus gtan 'bebs byas 'dug yar rgyas phyin na 'phral sel phan gyi red/ 'on kyangag tso bo rang dbang yod na bde skyid yong gi yod pa ltar bde nyid kyi rtsa ba rang dbang la thug yod/ rang dbang med na lto grod pa gang gi bde skyid yong rgyu khag po red/ 'di khul phru gu sbyor slob sbyong gi go skabs yod pa 'di rtsa ba chen po red/ bod pa'i phru gu tshos deng dus kyi slob sbyong byed pa dang rngo bas cig so so'i bod rang gi rig gzhung la slob sbyong yag po byed dgos/ sngon ma nas bod pa'i gzhis chags zur gsal byed dgos pa 'di bod pa la so so'i chos dang rig gzhung zhig yod pa 'di dag mi nyams rgyun 'dzin thub pa'i ched du byas pa red/ deng sang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog la bod pa'i skad 201

yig 'di yag shos chags yod/ snga dus nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog la 'brel bshad legs sbyar gyi skad dang / pa li'i thog nas byed kyi yod kyang /deng sang bod skad thog nas bya dgos kyi 'dug bod skad de gsal shos dang khungs btsan chags yod/ slob sbyong byed mkhan tshos bod pa'i yi ge'i thos slob sbyong bya rgyu gal chen po red/ bod pa tshang mas gshis rgyud dal po'i thog/ nas tshang ma 'cham po byed dgos pa dang / de bzhin yul mi tsho la'ang sngar bzhin mthun po dang 'cham po byed dgos/ yul mi nang pa'i chos la dad pa yod pa tshos sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun zhes pa gang 'dra zhig la zer gyi yod pa shes pa byed dgos/ skyabs ngo ma de chos yin pas de nga tsho'i rgyud la skye ba la las rgyu 'bras la yid ches kyi thog nas mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims la nyams len yag po byed dgos/ ma ṇi yag po bgrangs dgos/ khyed rang tshos skyabs 'gro byed kyi yod pa ltar/ phru gu tshor sangs rgyas dkon mchosachos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro stangs dang sems bskyed zer ba de shin tu rgya chen po dang / rlabs chen po yin pa/ nge tsho'i gras ma brjed par 'dzin thub pa bya rgyu gal chen po red/ na ning yi cir bskyod nas mar lam khyed tsho khyug tsam thug pa red/ de nas da bar lo gcis lhag tsam phyin pa red/ mi'i mi tshe dang / dus stod ni skad cig kyang mi sdong par rdzogs 'gro gi yod pa red/ dus tshod de nga tshos yag spro zhig bskyal yong na 'grigs pa red/ dus chod de chud thos phyin nas yag po byung med na'ang dus stod de bskyar du yong rgyu med pa red/ chos byed mkhan zhig yin na nyin 2(/lha

re nyin re chud zos ma song ba zhig byed thub na/ nyin re bsags pa'i zla ba/zla ba bsags pa'i lo sbrel te mi tshe don dang ldan pa zhig yong rgyu dang / mi tshe'i rma tha' ma de slebs skabs sems nang dga' spro gdeng dang ldan pa zhig yong gi red/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang / slob sbyong bya mkhan gang yin yang / nyin re'i dus tshod chud zos min par bskyel thub na yag po yong gi red/ lo sngon ma de'i nang yongs 'dzin rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs pa red/ de bzhin ser tong rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs pa red/ sems khral dang sdug bsngal byas pas phan thogs yod pa ma red/ de ni chos nyid red/ gang gal chen po red zer na/ dus tshod 'gro bzhin pa de'i ring la gang thub kyis mi bzang po dang / ya rabs bya rgyu de gal chen po red/ de ring bod zla 4 tshes 8 yin pas nga tsho mnyam du ma ṇi gsog dgos/ nga tsho bod kha ba gangs can gyi lha skal 3phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs sngags yig drug zer ba 'di phan yon chen po red/ drag zhan sus kyang 'don bde ba yag po red/ spyir btang sngags bgrangs skabs gnod pa dang / bar chad zhi ba'i ched du bsam blo 'khor yang /ma ṇi bgrangs skabs phal che ba'i blo la rigs drug sems can thams cad kyi don yin bsam pa yong ba 'di yag po red/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi yon tan dran pa'i 11ga nas ma ṇi 'thosan dbotos zhes ma ṇi gang 'tshams shig mang tshogs dang lhan du gsungs rjes da ring nga thug pa'i dgos don/ ngas da lta gong du bshad pa'i skad cha rnams sems la yag po zhog dgos/ ngas smon lam rgyab dzadag ces bka' 4skor// //203

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1984 zla 10 tshes 4 nyinas rir bod mi sto khag gcig la bka' slob 455 ba/'dir yod pa'i bod pa tsho da ring tsam min par sngon ma nas tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don dag la sems khur blangs te do snang byed mkhan tsho yang bskyar thug pa la dga' po byung / thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ nga rang tsho 'dir mi'i lung par gyar nas bsdad yod pa 'di so so'i ngos nas khrims 'gal nag nyes byas te mi'i lung par gyar ba ma red/ rkyen ngan pa zhig gi 'og nas nga rang tsho mi'i lung par gyar nas bsdad pa 'di'i ring la sa khul gang du bsdad yod na yang don dag yang snying nga rang tsho bod mi rigs kyi spyi'i las 'gan de nga rang tsho bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs rdzogs la 'khri bsdad pa zhig dang / khur du babs bsdad yod pas/ tshang mas sems khur blangs dgos kyi red la/ da lta bar du khyed rang tshos sems khur blangs pa der dga' po byung / da dung yin na yang tshang mas sems khur mu mthud blang rgyu gal chen po red/ bod gzhung gi las byed pa'i ming gi khungs la yod min la ma ltos par so so bod mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas skabs su babs pa ga re bya rgyu yod pa 'di dag sems khur blangs nas byed dgos pa red/ nga rang cho dud mi gnas sa lung pa gang du yod nasang tshang mas spyi pa'i don dag la sems khur blangs dgos kyi red/ sa gnas 'di gar yod mkhan tshos da lta bar du hur thag byas pa la dga' po byung / thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ ma 'ongs pa la yin na yang khyed rang tsho tshang mar hur thag byed rogs zer rgyu yin/204

spyir nga chos ngad mi tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ha cang khyab gdal chen po mā+oṃ da sa'i lung pa zhig nas yong ba'i mi red/ bye brag tu nga rang tsho ༄bad la yod pa'i chos 'di theg pa chen wa'i chos yin pas/ bslab bya'i gatho rwag sems pa bzang po byed dgos pa dang / snying rje dang / phan sems byed dgos pa 'di yin/ de 'dra'i dbang gis nga rang cho༄ 1da pa'i spyi tshogs nang la rang bzhin gyis 'bu srin tshun chad kyi srog la brtsi po byed pa dang / 'bu srin gcig shi ba yin na'i snying rje zer ba zhig nga rang tsho'i kha rgyun la 'jags bsdad yod/ 'di ni mig ltos bzang po zhig red/ dper na/ nga rang tsho'i bod pa kha shas nas chos de tsam shes kyi med na yang / rang bzhin gyis 'bu'i srog la thug pa'i skabs su kha nas snying rje zer ba zhig goms gshis la 'jags pa lta bu yod/ yang 'di phyogs su yod pa'i bod mi kha shas nang pa'i chos la do snang dang dad mos yod na yang / sbrang 'bu gsod rgyu la do snang de tsam med pa'i bzo 'dra zhig yong gi 'dug yin na yang nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs nang theg pa chen lnga'i chos kyi shugs rkyen gyis gzhan gyi srog la brtsi po byed rgyu dang / gces spras byed rgyu de goms gshis la 'jags pa zhig tan tan yod pa 'dra/ spyir btang nga bo da pa'i goms gshis la sems pa bzang po byed dgos nga/ dang / las rgyu 'bras la brtsi 'jog yod pa mi'i rus brtsi sa yod bsdad pa zhig dang / gzhung ded sa yod bsdad pa zhig nga rang tshos da lta byed kyi yod pa red/ sa gnas 'dra mi 'dra'i nang la bod pa'i gzhis chags yod pa de tsho'i nang la bod mi re zung re zung gi thog nas/ rnyog khra bzo mkhan dang / skad cha 'ad mi 'dra dang / bsam tshul 'dra mi 'dra yong gi yod pa de 205

chos nyid red spyir btang cha snyoms byas te bshad pa yin na/ bod mi gang du yod pa yin na yang sa khul de ga'i yul mi tshos bod pa zhes bstod bsngags gtong sa zhig dang / kun spyod yag po/ ya rabs/ rus rtsi sa yod pa zhig 'dug ces gang du yin nayang phal che bar bsngags brjod thob mkhan zhig chags bsdad yod/ nga rang tsho bod pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad mos byed mkhan zhig yin pas ya rabs spyod bzang byed rgyu 'di gal chen po red/ so so gang du bsdad yod na yang mi bzang po byed rgyu dang / ya rabs kyi spas tshad ston mkhan byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho so so'i mi hrī gcig gi nang la cha bzhag na yang / mtha' ma'i dus la nga rang tsho shi rgyu red/ gson pa'i mi tshe 'di'i ring la mi tshe bzang po zhig bskyal ba yin na/ shi ba'i skabs skye ba phyi ma de la blta so 'jog so yod pa zhig chags chags pa red/ kha nas sems can thams cad ces smon lam rgyab kyi yod pa ltar/ bsam blo'i nang nas gcig gis gcig la mdza' po byed rgyu dang / byams brtse byed rgyu/ bsam pa bzang pos gnod 'tshe med pa'i thog nas ya rabs byed rgyu 'di gal chen po red/bod pa yin pa'i cha nas bod spyi pa'i don dag la sems khur ma brjed pa dang / sems khur ma brlag pa byed dgos/ gtso che shos bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs tshos dngos gnas lo mang 'di'i ring la mnar gcod de lta bu myangs pa red/ phyi byug nang blug gang yong ci yong gi thog nas/ 'jam po byas na.e drag rtsub po byas na.e drag thabs shes rnam pa yod rgu rtsal sprug byas yod kyang / dngos gnas rang ha las pa'i sems shugs g.yo 'gul med 206

chos nyid red spyir btang cha snyoms byas te bshad pa yin na/ bod mi gang du yod pa yin na yang sa khul de ga'i yul mi tshos bod pa zhes bstod bsngags gtong sa zhig dang / kun spyod yag po/ ya rabs/ rus rtsi sa yod pa zhig 'dug ces gang du yin nayang phal che bar bsngags brjod thob mkhan zhig chags bsdad yod/ nga rang tsho bod pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad mos byed mkhan zhig yin pas ya rabs spyod bzang byed rgyu 'di gal chen po red/ so so gang du bsdad yod na yang mi bzang po byed rgyu dang / ya rabs kyi spas tshad ston mkhan byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho so so'i mi hrī gcig gi nang la cha bzhag na yang / mtha' ma'i dus la nga rang tsho shi rgyu red/ gson pa'i mi tshe 'di'i ring la mi tshe bzang po zhig bskyal ba yin na/ shi ba'i skabs skye ba phyi ma de la blta so 'jog so yod pa zhig chags chags pa red/ kha nas sems can thams cad ces smon lam rgyab kyi yod pa ltar/ bsam blo'i nang nas gcig gis gcig la mdza' po byed rgyu dang / byams brtse byed rgyu/ bsam pa bzang pos gnod 'tshe med pa'i thog nas ya rabs byed rgyu 'di gal chen po red/bod pa yin pa'i cha nas bod spyi pa'i don dag la sems khur ma brjed pa dang / sems khur ma brlag pa byed dgos/ gtso che shos bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs tshos dngos gnas lo mang 'di'i ring la mnar gcod de lta bu myangs pa red/ phyi byug nang blug gang yong ci yong gi thog nas/ 'jam po byas na.e drag rtsub po byas na.e drag thabs shes rnam pa yod rgu rtsal sprug byas yod kyang / dngos gnas rang ha las pa'i sems shugs g.yo 'gul med 206

par bsdad yod red/ phyi'i lung pa rgya mis dbang sgyur byas yod kyang / bod pa'i bsam blo rgya mis bsgyur thub med pa yin dus/༄dus da lta yin na yang bod pa'i thog la rgya mi'i ngos shes dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed dgos pa dang / gang ltar da lta 'grigs po med pa'i ngos 'dzin gsal po mi byed dka' med chags nas bsdad yod/ bod nang la yod pa'i bod mi'i bsam cho'i 'khyer stangs gnas tshul gzhan dag cig yin na/ nga snur ngad mi nyung shas phyi la bsdad mkhan tsho sdug gyong btang bzhag na las sla po red/ gtso che shos bod nang la bod mi sa ya drug skor yod pa 'di dag gi bsam cho'i nang nas rgya mir blo blta gi med pa dang / rgya mis khong tsho'i bsam blo dbang sgyur me thub pa zhig cha gas bsdad yod pa yin dus/ ga re byas na'i bod phyi nang gnyes kyi thog nas rgya mir dka' ngal zhig 'phrad kyi yod pa red/ bod pa'i gnas tshul thog la rgya mis mi 'dod bzhin du bag zon phran bu byed dgos pa zhig tan tan chags bsdad yod/ bar lam rgya mi'i gtam bshad byas pa'i nang la 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang nas bod la do snang byed mkhan mang po yod pa dang / bod nang gnas tshul chung tshag cig byung ba yin na yang /lam seng 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la brag cha 'khor las sla po yod/ da phyin chad bod nang gi gnas tshul gang ci'i thag gcod ma byas gong bsam blo nan tan btang dgos pa/ lhag don mi 'dzin bzung bya rgyu'i rigs la yid gzab dgos lugs bshad 'dug nam rgyun ngas bshad pa ltar/ bod rgya mis zas te khyur mid btang na yang / da lta 'ju thub yod ma red/ snga phyi ma gtogs yang na skyug dgos pa dang / yang na bshal rgyur bsdad pa de phal cher 'dra po yod pa'i bzo lta 'dug 207

de ltar na nga rang tsho mi'i lung par yod mkhan tshos sems shugs ma chag par ga tshad thub thub kyis bod spyi pa'i don dag la sems khur blangs nas skabs su babs pa'i bya rgyu ga re ga re yod pa de tsho nga tshos bsam blo btang ste byed dgos kyi 'dugadeng sang rgya nag gzhung dang nga ྾ 'brel ba'i gnas stangs thad rgya mi'i ngos nas thog mar nga sbyor 'brel ba byed dus phal cher rgya mi'i bsam li nang la phyi la yod pa'i tā la'i bla mas 'go 'khrid pa'i bod pa 'di dag la/ lag pa brkyangs pa yin na lam seng sgur sgur la logayong gi red bsam pa'i rtsis rgyab pa 'dra/ de rtsis log thebs pa red/ nga tsho lo 'di rnams kyi ring la mi'i lung par khungs ma 'khyol bar 'a chad 'u thug gi gnas tshul 'og la gyar te rgya mi'i ngos nas phran bu'i rnam 'gyur bzang du phyin pa yin na/ nga tsho log snga phyir ltos nas bsdad pa de 'dra ma red pa/ nga sto gyar sa mi'i lung par gyar nas bsdad yod kyang / nga tshor rang dbang yod pa byas nas bsdad yod/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi skor la dngos gnas byas na so so rang nyid kyi lung pa'i nang la spas dag pa zhig dang / khyab che ba zhig dgos kyi yod na yang / so i lang —ri ༅ ri mepa'i nang la rang dbang med dus ha cang khag i sgang la bsdad yod/ nga tsho sdod sa mi'i lung par bsdad yod kyang / rang dbang yod pa zhig yin dus chos dang rig gzhung gi gnas stangs nga tsho legs pa yod/ bod lung pa'i nang la so i rig gzhung la gces spras byed mi chog pa dang / bod pas bod pa'i zhen khog byas pa yin na khrims 'gal/ bod pas rgya mi'i zhen khog byas na yang dag 268

pa yin pa bcas bod nang la gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig chags bsdad yod/ nga tsho bod phyi nang gi 'brel ba yong ba'i skabs la/ bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs tshos rgya mir mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur shugs chen po 'thon yong ba dang / nga rang tsho mi'i lung par yod mkhan tsho yin na yang / lo 'di dag gi ring la gzhi rtsa ang ki dang po tshugs nas bsdad yod pa yin dus/ da cha rgya mis bsam blo gsar pa zhig btang gi yod bzo 'dug deng sang rgya mis phyogs gcig nas rgya nag rang gi nang dpal 'byor gnas stangs bar lam 'thus shor nyams rgud chen po phyin pa de dag slar gso bya rgyu'i don dag la shugs bskyed ma byed rang byed chags pa red/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lta ba dang 'gal gyi yod na yang / de blos btang ste kha yod lag yod kyi yar rgyas 'gro dgos kyi yod pa yin dus/ deng sang bsgyur bcos mang po zhig 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa red/de dang dus tshungs su bod rnong la yin na yang / da lta bar du rtsub po'i thog nas gang yod ci yod kyis thabs shes byas pa lam ltongs ma byung ba yin dus da cha 'jam 'dul rgyag rgyu'i bsam blo zhig gtong gi 'dug rgya mi'i ngos nas bod nang la 'jam 'dul rgyab nas rim pas rim pas dus tshod gang la gang tsam phyin pa'i mtshams la bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs 'di dag gis rgya nag gzhung la bsam blo gtong phyogs 'gyur ba tan tan yong gi red bsam pa zhig dang / 'gyur ba phyin song na phyi la yod bsdad pa'i bod pa 'di dag gi rin thang brlag 'gro gi red bsam pa'i srid jus 'di bting gi yod pa'i bzo 'dug khong tsho'i yig cha'i nang la'ang de 'dra 'dug da lta bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i 209

mi dmangs chos tā la'i bla mas 'go 'khrid pa'i phyi la re ba stong pa zhig rgyab kyi yod red/ bod nang 'dzugs bskrun byas te yar rgyas yag po zhig phyin pa yin na/ re ba stong pa 'di rim pas rim pas yal 'gro gi red ces bkod 'dugagang ltar deng sang bsam tshul 'di 'dra zhig gi thog nas srid jus zin bsdad yod pa red/ yang de dang chabs cig nga tshor tshur 'brel ba byed rgyu'i thog la mu mthud 'brel ba byed 'dod yod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan gyi yod/ nga tsho'i ngos nas yin na'ang rgya nag gzhung la thad kur 'brel ba yod na yod pa de dge mtshan che ba 'dug 'brel ba mu mthud nas bsdad yod/ mi gsum gyi sku tshab tshogs pa phyin te skad cha byed skabs dngos yod gnas tshul la mingan pa lta bu byung 'dugarim pas rim pas nyams myong bsags yong gi red/ dus tshod phyin pa'i rjes/ la/ rim pas na gzhon pa 'di dag yar slebs yong gi red/ dpal 'byor yar rgyas phyin/ shes sku(na yar rgyas phyin pa yin na/ de gnyis kyi gnas tshul/ thog nas bsam blo gtong stangs la bsgyur bcos shig 'gro gi red/ 'on kyang gtso bo nga rang tsho'i 'bad brtson la rar+sha lus yod/ rgya mi'i ngos nas bod nga la sha tsha dang drin chen spro zhig gi thog nas bod pa la yag dzed byed kyi red dam zer na/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi nang bltas pa yin na de 'dra byed rgyu khag po red/ nga rang cho rwa1da pa'i ngos nas rgya mi la bsun po bzo rgyu 'di gal chen po 'dug rim/ bzhin rkyen mang po zhig 'dzoms pa'i thog nas gnas tshul je bzang je bzang 'gro ba tan tan yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug des na don chen sgrub par ngang ring dgos pa ltar/ don chen po zhig nyin ma gcig gnyis kyi nang la lam seng 'grub 210

mi thub pas 'bad brtson yun bsrings nas byed dgos/chos lugs 'dra mi 'dra 'di dag gis mi bzang po zhig yong rgyu dang / mi ya rabs shig yo nga ba'i don dag la bslab bya byed pa tshang ma gcig gyur chags bsngad yod/ thabs shes bsten stangs la kha shas kyis dkon mchog yod ces bshad pa dang / kha shas kyis las rgyu 'bras 11ga nas bshad pa sogs 'dra mi 3dra sna tshogs yod/ nga tsho mi'i lung par slebs nas chos lugs 'dra mi 'dra dang / bsam blo'i lta ba'i rnam gzhag 'dra mi 'dra mang po thug ste skad cha yong ba'i skabs la/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di dngos gnas rang rgya chen po zhig dang / gting zab po rdzogs rgyu med pa zhig tan tan red/ de yang rgyu mtshan lngan pa/ rgyu mtshan med pa'i rmongs dad u btsugs min pa/ dngos gnas spus dag po red/ de lta bu'i sgo nas ston pa bcom ldan 'das la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa byed rgyu de gal chen 11 yin/ rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa byung na dad pa brtan dzes/nga gi red/ nga rang tsho nang pa yin zhes skyabs 'gro tshig tsam ston shes pas 'grigs kyi mi 'dug nga rang tshos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos shes pa byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho de snga bod la yod pa'i skabs mig ltos sdug cag cig yod/ de gang yin zer na/ dpe cha sbyong rgyu de mtshan nyid pa dang / dpe cha ba tshor 'khri ba ma gtogs/ spyir btang mi zhig gis gzhung chen mo blta rgyur dang dod byas na/ ha lam 'phya smod byed pa lta bu'i mthong tshul yod pa de shin tu nor 'khrul red/ ngas rgya gar hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud la bod kyi nang pa'i chos nyams len byed mkhan gyi sa khul de 'dra la phyin 211

pa'i skabs su ngas rtag par bshad kyi yod/ nga rang tsho'i dad pa byed yul nang pa'i cesas 'di shes dgos/ nang pa yin pa la nang pa'i chos ma shes na mi 'grigs pas nang pa'i chos la slob gnyer bya rgyu gal chen po red/ do snang bya dgos ces ngas nam rgyun rtag par 'bod bskul byed kyi yod/ nga rang tsho bod pa tsho yin na'ang 'di la tan tan do snang bya dgos/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi chos mdor bsdus nas bshad pa yin na/ ngas nam rgyun bod pa snurar bshad dus bsdus bsdus go las sla po bshad kyi yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snying po gang yin zer na/ lta ba dang spyod pa gnyis yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba gang yin zer na/ rten 'byung gi lta ba yin/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i spyod pa gang yin zer na/ 'tshe ba mi byed pa 'di yin/ don dag snying po 'di shes pa byed dgos/ nang pa'i spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa 'di la yang rgya che chung gnyis yo/da/ rgya che sa nas bshad pa yin na/ gzhan la phan btags dgos pa /de yin/ de theg pa chen ྅6) chos kyi snying 11 yin/ rgya chung sa nas gzhan la 'tshe ba mi byed pa'am/ gzhan la gnod pa mi bskyal ba 'di yin/ de theg pa chung ngu'i chos kyi snying don yin/gang ltar theg pa che chung gnyis ga'i chos kyi rtsa ba de sting rje la bzhag gi yod/ de la go ba phra rags mang po zhig yong gi yod/ gang ltar rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'byung gi 'brel ba bshad kyi yod/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'byung gi 'brel ba 'di'i steng nas las bzang po bsags na 'bras bu bde skyid dang / las ngan pa bsags na 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras rten 'brel de bshad pa red/ rten 'brel gyi don de las phra ru phyin pa'i skabs la/ rten cing 'brel 212

bar 'byung ba yin dus ltos nas grub pa dang / ltos nas grub pa yin dus rang bzhin gyis stong pa red ces dang / chos thams cad bdag med pa dang / chos thams cad bdag tu ma grub pa/ chos thams cad bden pas stong pa red ces nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung nang gi stong nyid kyi don bshad yong gi yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'byung gi lta ba 'di la go rgyu chen po yod pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba rten 'byung gi lta ba/ spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa 'di shes dgos/ ngas nam rgyun nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ྅rtod pa 'tshe ba med pa 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi zhi bde dang 'brel ba yod ces dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba rten 'byung 'di tshan rig dang 'brel ba yod ces ngas 'di 'dra bshad kyi yod/ de yin pa'i bzo 'dra zhig yod pa red/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la zhi bde dgos kyi yod pa yin dus/ zhi bde la zhal 'debs nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa'i cha nas rgyag thub kyi red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi skyabs gnas mthar thug tshan rig red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'byung gi lta ba des tshan rig phyug po chags 'gro gi yod pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'byung gi lta ba 'di tshan rig dang skyid sdug 'brel nas bsdad thub kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ tshan rig dang skyid sdug tha dad byed dgos kyi yod pa ma red/ de rtsa ba chen po red/ rdo don snying po nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la lta spyod gnyis yod pa de khyed tsho'i sems la nges pa byas/ so so'i 1dus nas ga chord thub thub kyi dus rgyun ldan nas bsam pa bzang po byas/ mi la thub tshod gtong rgyu dang / mi la mgo skor gtong ba 213

11gas byas na yag po med/ tshang ma gcig gis gcig la mthun po byas/ bod rigs tsam ma yin pa mi su dang su la yin na yang / phan sems yag po byas/bsam pa bzang po byas/ phan btags dgos/ so sor dngos gnas rang ma 'os ma 'tshams pa'i gyong gtong mkhan zhig byung na de 'khur dgos zer ba'i don dag min/ ma 'os ma 'tshams pa'i gyong gtong mkhan zhig byung na/ de la skabs dang sbyar ba'i lan rgyab dgos pa zhig tan tan yong gi red/ yin na yang lan 'di rgyag pa'i skabs la gnod sems kyi bsam pa dang / 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam pa byas na mi 'grigs/ 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam pa med pa'i thog nas dngos yod gnas tshul la skabs dang sbyar ba'i gang la de 'tshams gyi rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i lan slog na 'grigs pa red/ de gang ltar byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya'i nang la gsungs yod/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya'i nang la/ rkyen dang 'tshams par tshar mi gcod ces gsungs yod pas/ tshar mi gcod par bzhag na bslab bya dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa yong gi yod/ de lta na'ang phan pa'i bsam pas kun nas blangs te/ tshar gcod dgos pa ma gtogs/ gnod pa'i bsam pa'i thog nas tshar gcod rgyu'i skad cha ma red/ yang mang po zhig gi bsam par nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos zer mkhan 'di sems pa bzang sngod byed dgos pa dang / phan sems byed dgos pa/ bzod pa byed dgos pa yin dus/ gyong 'khyer dgos mkhan zhig red ces kha shas de 'dra zhig dran gyi yod sa red/ de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma red/ nang pa sangs pa'i chos 'di dngos gnas rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gyong po dang / rnam dpyod ldan pa'i snying stobs/ rnam dpyod ldan pa'i thabs mkhas 214

11gas byas na yag po med/ tshang ma gcig gis gcig la mthun po byas/ bod rigs tsam ma yin pa mi su dang su la yin na yang / phan sems yag po byas/bsam pa bzang po byas/ phan btags dgos/ so sor dngos gnas rang ma 'os ma 'tshams pa'i gyong gtong mkhan zhig byung na de 'khur dgos zer ba'i don dag min/ ma 'os ma 'tshams pa'i gyong gtong mkhan zhig byung na/ de la skabs dang sbyar ba'i lan rgyab dgos pa zhig tan tan yong gi red/ yin na yang lan 'di rgyag pa'i skabs la gnod sems kyi bsam pa dang / 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam pa byas na mi 'grigs/ 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam pa med pa'i thog nas dngos yod gnas tshul la skabs dang sbyar ba'i gang la de 'tshams gyi rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i lan slog na 'grigs pa red/ de gang ltar byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya'i nang la gsungs yod/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya'i nang la/ rkyen dang 'tshams par tshar mi gcod ces gsungs yod pas/ tshar mi gcod par bzhag na bslab bya dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa yong gi yod/ de lta na'ang phan pa'i bsam pas kun nas blangs te/ tshar gcod dgos pa ma gtogs/ gnod pa'i bsam pa'i thog nas tshar gcod rgyu'i skad cha ma red/ yang mang po zhig gi bsam par nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos zer mkhan 'di sems pa bzang sngod byed dgos pa dang / phan sems byed dgos pa/ bzod pa byed dgos pa yin dus/ gyong 'khyer dgos mkhan zhig red ces kha shas de 'dra zhig dran gyi yod sa red/ de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma red/ nang pa sangs pa'i chos 'di dngos gnas rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gyong po dang / rnam dpyod ldan pa'i snying stobs/ rnam dpyod ldan pa'i thabs mkhas 214

yod pa tan tan red/ de lta bu'i bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa bcom ldan 'das yin pa red/ ston pa shākya thub pa de'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba rnams dran bzhin pa'i thog nas/ thub pa'i mtshan sngags kyi bzlas lung byed kyi yin/ sngon la maṇ+ḍal zhig 'don dgos/ /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te 'bul ba yi sa/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog gzungs sngags 'ga' zhig gi ljags lung stsal rjes/ rig gzhung gang 'dra zhig la yin na'ang rig gzhung gi rtsa ba skad yig yin pas bod pa'i yi ge shes thabs bya rgyu gal chen 〈sna red/ khyed rang sto pha ma dang / rgan pa snuras dmigs bsal gyis 'bad brtson dang do snang byed dgos/ rang gi skad yig brjed tshar na/ gzhi nas bod kyi rig gzhung zhes lab sku(nga dus/ gzhan dag gi rig gzhung 'dra po chags yong gi red/ so so'i skad yig shes pa yin na/de la sems thag nye po 'byung / sems thag nye ba'i tshod kyis legs pa shes kyi red/ legs pa shes pa'i stod kyis bod kyi rig gzhung la dngos gnas srung skyob byas pa red/ rig gzhung srung skyob byed zer ba 'di klad pa'i nang la nyar tshag bya dgos pa red/ so so'i ngos nas 11da kyi rig gzhung ma shes na bod kyi rig gzhung gces spras bya thabs yod pa ma red/ rig gzhung yin zhes mchod sashom nang la sgrig thabs med la/ dngul khug nang la nyar thabs med/ rig ga zhung zer ba 'di shin tu gal chen po red/ bod lung pa'i nang la rgya mis bod pa'i ming tshig rgya mi'i ming tshig la brjes bzhin pa dang / rgya gar lung 215

par yod mkhan mos bod skad brjed de shin rdi'i ming tshig bed spyod byas/ 'di nas tshur yod mkhan tshos dbyin ji'i ming tshig bed spyod byas te gang 'tshams nas bod nang la yod mkhan tsho dang / mi'i lung par yod mkhan tsho tshang mar bod skad yag po mdzub mo 'dzugs sa med pa chags pa yin na/ dpe mi srid pa'i thabs lju rwa1 red/ nga rang chorwa 1da pa'i rig gzhung la bod pas gces spras ma byas na sus byed/ tan tan gzab gzab byed dgos kyi 'dug nga tshos tan tan gzab gzab byed ma thub par snang med du lus pa yin na rjes su phyi mi'i nang nas do snang byed mkhan mang po yod pa de tsho'i gras kyis snying rus thog nas sbyangs brtson byas/ sbyangs brtson byas pa'i 'bras bur gang la gang 'tshams shes/ gang 'tshams zhig nas bod pa'i rig gzhung brtsad gcod bya dgos byung na/ phyi rgyal gyi deb cig nang brtsad gcod bya dgos pa zhig dang / phyi rgyal gyi mi la re bco' byed dgos pa chags song na shin tu thabs sdug po red/ de 'dra yong rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug pas nga tshos nges par du gzab gzab bya dgos/ rgya gar nang la cha bzhag na nga rang tsho bod kyi rig gzhung thog la slob grwa khag gis gtsos tshang mar 'bod bskul byed kyi yod/ nga tshos slob grwa zur du btsugs pa 'di dag la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dge mtshan bon yod kyang / da dung nga tshos shugs rgyab nas nus pa 'don dgos kyi 'dug ga tshod thub thub byed kyi yod/ khyed rang tsho 'ji phyogs yod mkhan tshos kyang do snang byas/ bsam blo btang ba yag po red/ nga dung hur thag byed dgos/ khyed rang sto tshang mar thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ bkari drin che song / zhes bka' stsal// //216

༄tsho// phyi lo 1985 zla 8 tshes 27 nyin la dwags zhi ba'i tshal du stsal ba'i bka' slob/khyed rang tsho tshang ma dus rgyun ldan nas sems bzang po bya dgos/ de bslab bya'i gtso boyin/ de bzhin nga rang tsho'i ston pa bkrin can gyi bka' srol 'di la rigs mi gtso/ rus mi gtso/ sgrub pa gtso bo yin gsungs yod/ nga rang tsho'i la dwags sa khul 'dir rol mo bkrol mkhan dang / rda ma brdung mkhan de 'i gras la rigs dman par brtsi gi yod tshod 'dug de la dgos pa med/de 'dra byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ rda ma brdung rgyu de rten 'brel zhig ba rtsi gi yod pa ma red dam/ de gal chen po 'dug rten 'brel la brtsiyag gi rol mo bkrol mkhan mi de tsho rtsa chen red ma gtogs sdug cag ma red/ byang chub sems dpa'i la ma nyams len yag po yong ba la thos bsam yag po byed dgos/ nga rang tsho nang pa rnams so so'i dad pa byed sa'i chos de ma shes na ha cang gi blo pham wa rod/chos la slob sbyong byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/ de dge bshes tshos byed kyi red/ nga rang tsho mang tshogs nas chos bslab dgos kyi ma red bsam pa'i bsam blo btang na nor 'khrul chen po red/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la spyir btang shes yon yar rgyas 'gro gi yod pa red/ nga rang tshos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi shes yon de yang nges par du yar rgyas gtong dgos/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bslab bya gtso bo gcig la/ chang de bag med kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ zhes gsungs pas chang dang a rag 'thung rgyu 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis dgag pa chen po gnang yod/ bag med kyi rtsa bar 217

gsungs yod/ nga rang tsho bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs tshos chang rag bag med kyis longs spyad pa yin na nyes pa chen po red/ de yag po yod pa ma red/ gzugs po'i khams dang / ngal rtsol chen po byed pa'i skabs la phran bu 'dra btung na dmigs bsal yin 'gro/ de min bag med kyi snang ba skyid po byas te chang dang a rag 'thung na yag po yod pa ma red/ de 'dra ma byed/ de las 'bru la gces spras byas te 'bru des rtsam pa yag po bzos/ pag yag po zas/ ja yag po bzos na khre bzang red/ 'di 'dra byas na lus la mi gnod pa/ ja gar 17 des khrag dang mkhris pa la gnod kyi yod na ma gtogs gzhan sa mtho sa la 'phrod po dang / phan po yod red/ lus la phan gyi yod red/ a rag btung pa yin na mchin pa la gnod kyi yod red/ ga le ga ler lus rgud 'gro rgyu red/ de yag po mi 'dug de nas nga rang tsho'i dgon pa tsho spus dag po byed dgosdo// dgon pa tsho spus dag po byed rgyu 'di gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho phyi'i rtags cha lugs brjes thub pa tsam gyis mi 'grigs par nang bsam blo'i thog nas brjes thub pa zhig byed dgos/ khyim pa la gra chas g.yogs pa 'dra po byas na yag po yod ma red/ de ltar byas na lha mo dang zlos gar 'khrab mkhan 'dra po chags pa red/ de 'dra yin dus gra pa tsho spus dag po byed dgos/de yan chad kyi de ring la dwags lcog lam sar la chos 'brel yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i bshad lung dang / sems bskyed cho ga legs par zin pa yin/de ring nga rang dga' po byung / nga rang tsho yang skyar thug 'phrad byas nas chos 218

kyi 'brel ba byed rgyu byung ba dang / lhag par smon sems cho gas bzung ba byed rgyu byung ba yin dus nga rang yang bsod nams bsags pa red/ ha cang skal ba bzang po byung / khyed rang tsho yin na yang bsod nams dpag tu med pa bsags yod/ chos zer ba 'di bla ma tshar gcig mjal ba dang / smon lam rgyag rgyu byung song na/ de nas byed mi dgos pa de 'dra ma red/ nga rang tshos dus rgyun nas rang nyid ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang 'dra bar sangs rgyas kyi beta 'phang ma thob bar la cesas nyams len bya dgo sa pa yin/ de 'dra yin dus ngas da lta 'grel bshad rgyab pa de dag sems la nges pa byas nas/dus da nas bzung ste ga tshod thub thub kyi lo re nas lo rer rang rgyud je bzang je bzang du 'gro ba'i 'bad brtson bskyed dgos pa dang / smon lam rgyab dgos pa red/ de ring nga rang tshos chos 'chad nyan byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag la brten nas da lta dngos su nga rang tsho'i rgyud la chos kyi bag chags bzhag yod pa de gong 'phel du song nas nga rang tsho tshang ma'i rgyud la bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che myur ba nyid du bskyed thub pa gcig dang / de la brten nas mtha' yas pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi ched du bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i smon lam rgyag dgos pa dang / de bzhin bye brag tu bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs su da lta nag phyogs kla glo'i dpung gis bcom te ha cang gi thabs skyo po byas nas bsdad yod/ de lta na'ang nga rang tsho'i tshad thub kyi lung bstan dang / phyi nang gi gnas tshul gang sar bltas pa yin na yang da lta bstan pa'i khug pa zhig ma gtogs pa'i bstan pa'i mtha' la thug 219

pa zhig min pas na/ nga rang tshos 'chad nyan byas pa'i dbe+e ba'i rtsa ba des bod gangs can gyi jongs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing / sngon gyi chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ mkhan slob chos gsum de tsho'i thog nas dka' ba brgya phrag du ma'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che sngar med pa gsar du spyan drangs/ de nas bar du rim mas gong nas gong du spel te dngos gnas drang gnas theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba yong sa su rdzogs pa/ spus dag po yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di slar yang nyams pa sor chud/ mi nyams par gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i thog nas/mdor na chos srid zung 'brel gyi rang dbang dga' bde'i nyi ma 'char thub pa la tshang mas smon lam yag po rgyab rogs/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs la slar yang gnas tshul 'gyur ba bzang po zhig byung ba yin na/ khyed rang la dwags pa sto la yang phan gyi red/ de tsam du ma zad rgya gar byang brgyud kyi sa khyal yongs rdzogs la zhi bde'i dpal yon rgyas thub kyi red/ de 'dra byung ba yin na rgya gar yongs la yang phan thogs yong gi red/ bod kyi sa cha'i gnas babs kyi cha nas bod kyi lung pa la dmag gi nyen kha'i gnas tshul de rtsa ba nas gtsang yal la phyin nas chos srid rang dbang gi pad mo bzhad thub pa zhig byung ba yin na/ che sa nas bshad pa yin na/ 'dzam bu gling spyi'i zhi bde la yang than thogs dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ de 'dra'i dgos pa rgyu mtshan yod pa yin dus/ de lta bu'i don chen gyi thog la tshang mas bsngo ba smon lam shugs drag po gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin/ zhes bka' stsal// //220

si༅// phyi lo 1985 zla 12 tshes 30 nyin gnas mchog rdo je gdan du bod nas ched du bcar ba'i gzhis lus mi dmangs bdun stong brgal bar stsa la ba'i bka' slob/da res bod kyi lha sa dang / stod mnga' ris/ khams/ a mdo bcas nas ched mngags mi mang po zhig 'byor yod pa red/ mjal kha bya rgyu dus tshod mi 'dug kyang nga tsho khyug tsam thug na bsam pa dran byung /spyir btang chos phyogs nas bsam blo gtong stangs dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs skor kha sang nas nyi ma sbrel te bshad zin pa red/de ring dmigs bsal bod pa khe gtsang thug ste bod pa'i bde sdug skor phran bu bshad na snyam byung / nga rang cho dud kha ba can gyi zhing 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi lung gis zin pa'i zhi bde'i bsti gnas shig red/ nga rang bo da mi rnams la cha bzhag na'ang lhan skyes su sems pa bzang po/ mi zhig shi na'ang a tsi kho shi 'dug ces tshang mas sems khral dang / do snang chen po byed pa'i goms gshis yod pa zhig red/ 'di 'dra'i nga tsho'i lung pa der bar lam rkyen ngan byung nas nga rang the ba'i bod mi 'bum gcig lhag tsam mi'i lung par btsan byol la gyar dgos byung ba red/ so so'i lung pa bral te mi'i lung par 'byor skabs 'go stod rgyus mnga' yod pa sa dang gnam las med pa zhig chags te dka' ngal phran bu byung yod/ de las sdug pa bod nang du sdod mkhan tshos lo nyi shu skor gyi ring la tshad las brgal ba'i sdug bsngal myangs pa red/ bod kyi da lta'i mi thog 'di dka' ngal che shos dang / sdug bsngal mang shos myong 221

ba'i mi thog gcig red/ma gzhi lo stong phrag gnyis tsam gyi bod kyi lo rgyus nang dar rgud sna tshogs byung yod kyang / da res nang bzhin gyi thabs skyo po dang yo 'khyoms chen po 'di 'dra phal cher byung ma myong ba zhig red/ bod nang gi bod mi tsho 'tsho gos kyi dka' ngal dang / mtha' ma so so'i brtse shos srog kyang phangs med la 'gro dgos pa'i dus tshod gcig byung te/ rnam kun dmyal ba mi yul du 'phos pa zhes bshad pa'i snyan ngag gi skad cha lta bu de 'dra min par dngos gnas ha las pa'i sdug sbyong myangs pa red/ de dang chabs cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bod kyi rig gzhung la cha bzhag na'ang ha las pa'i gtor bshig chen po byung ste nga tsho'i mi thog 'di dus tshod de 'dra zhig dang 'khel ba red/sngar chos rgyal tsho'i skabs nas bzung ste bod mi rigs 'di'i gzugs po'i gnas stangs kyang 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i mkhregs po zhig yo da de 'brel nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos gathorwa 1ra gyur ba'i rig gzhung gting zab po zhig yod pa des so so'i mi rigs kyi spobs pa ha cang chen po yod/ nga tshos dka' ngal bsam yul las 'das pa zhig myangs yod kyang bod pa rnams ming med shul med chags thub med/ de tsam ma zad rgya mi'i ngos nas sngon rma chis stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga lnga nga drug nas bzung ste bod nang la drag gnon breng pa'i gdug rtsub dmar rjen du thon te bod mtha' dbus yongs la rim pas drag gnon mi bzad pa zhig byas pa red/ de'i skabs rgya mi'i bsam blor ma 'ongs 222

pa chig stong dgu brgya drug cu bdun cu'i nang dang / brgyad cu'i nang la slebs r+sha bas bod pa zhes da dung rgya mir bsun po bzo mkhan zhig dang / 'dzam gling drug bod pa zhes mgo bo bteg nas gnas rgyu zhig rgya mi'i bsam blo'i nang la yod pa ma red bsam gyi 'dug de dus rgya mi'i bsam blor bod pa rnams rdog brdzis gtong gcig mar btang ste ming med shul med cig bzo thub kyi red stsa ma pa'i re ba dang / rtsis brgyab yod/ yin na'ang lo nyi shu rtsa grangs/ sum cu skor la slebs pa'i skabs la nga tsho bod pa la grong phog ste 'gyel yang dbugs chad med par brten 'gyel sa nas lang gi yin zhes nga tshos shug sa rgyag gi yod/nga tsho lo mang po'i ring skyid sdug gi nyams myong mang po bsags pa'i mi rigs shig yin/ nga rang tshos so so bod pa yin snyam pa'i sgobs pa skye dgos pa dang / zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs skye rgyu de ha cang gi gal chen po red/'dzam gling thog deng sang gi dngos yod gnas tshul la cha bzhag na/ bong nang gi rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams la bsam tshul gang zhig yod pa dang / bod nang rgya mis gdug rtsub gang 'dra zhig byas yod pa/ gtor bshig gang 'dra zhig btang yod pa/ gnas tshul de'i 'og la bod pa tshos bsam blo mkhregs po byas te ji ltar sdod kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul rnams deng sang 'dzam gling thog je gsal je gsal du 'gro gi yod/ sngon ma yin na nga tshos 'di khul nas bod nang gi gnas tshul 'grel bshad rgyag skabs ha lam bod mi btsan byol ba'i ngos nas so so'i mthong tshul de gtso bor bshad pa min nam snyam nas kha shas the tshom byed mkhan ya nga yong gi yod pa red/223

bar lam phyi lo 1979 tshun chad nas rtsa ba'i rgya nag gi srid byus phran bu gu yangs su phyin te bod nang la'ang phyi rgyal gyi tshags par 'god mkhan dang / tshogs pa dang / mi sger bcas kyi lta skor 'gro mkhan lo re nas lo re je mang du song ste bod nang dngos su slebs thub mkhan gang la gang 'tshams byung ba de tsho phal ces ches ha lam kha gcig grags kyi thog nas bod nang gi bod mi tsho sems shugs chen 11 sku(da pa dang / rgya mi la rtsa ba nas mi dga' ba yod pa'i gnas tshul ha cang gsal po chags pa red/ bod rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams lo de tsam ring gnya' ma chag par mkhregs po byas te bsdad pa 'dzam gling thog mthong gi yod pa red/ de sngon bod pa'i thog do snang med mkhan de tsho'i gras la'ang do snang gsar pa zhig slebs pa dang / sngon ma bod pa'i chab srid kyi gnas tshul la rin thang mi brtsi mkhan de tshos kyang da cha rin thang gsar pa zhig brtsi dgos pa'i gnas tshul chags yod/bod mi btsan byol ba rnams mi'i lung par slebs nas ha lam lo nyi shu rtsa bdun 'gro gi yod/ 'dzam gling thog btsan byol ba bod mi gcig pu ma yin par/ rgya mi rang gi btsan byol ba'ang mang po yod pa red/ sngon ma yo rob nang la'ang lung pa phan tshun nas btsan byol ba mang po yod pa red/ de dang des mtshon pa'i deng sang lung pa gang sar btsan byol ba gsar pa de 'dra yong dang yong bzhin pa red/ 'dzam gling thog btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas/ bod mi btsan byol ba zhes lab dus dngos gnas 'ju lung 'chang sa yod pa zhig dang / rigs brtsi sa yod pa zhig tu mthong gi yod pa red/ de la sgrig 224

'dzugs yod pa dang / spyi pa'i don la dmigs yul nges can zhig bzung ste de gzhir bzhag gis mi tshe skyel ba'i thog nas che gzhogs chung 'degs dang /phyar ba gru 'degs byas te btsan byol ba'i gong bu gcig tu bsdad thogasber so so'i 'phral sel lto gos kyi 'tsho thabs tsam ma yin par mi rigs spyi 'a/ zhen dang / spyi'i khe phan gyi don la rig gzhung dang / chab srid kyi gnad don tshang ma rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i thog nas bzung gi yod pa 'dzam gling thog mameng gi yod pa red/ bod pa btsan byol ba rgya gar nang thog mar 'byor te 1959 60461 62 de tsho'i skabs la bod par skyob gso'i las ka byed mkhan phyi rgyal gyi mi de 'dra na ning gzhes ning nga dang thug pa'i skabs la khong tsho ha cang dga' po byed kyi 'dug de dus bod par rogs ram byas pa de chud zos phyin mi 'dug bod pa tshos rogs ram blangs pa'i thog nas so so rang nyid kyi rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i mi tshe skyel stangs de yag po byung 'dug ces bstod bsngags byed kyi 'duga'adzam gling thog btsan byol ba mang po yod kyang kha shas ni rogs ram len thub tsam zhig ma gtogs so 16) 'tsho thabs sra thag thag cig byed mi thub pa/ dang / kha shas ni chab srid kyi gnas tshul kho na'i thog la smyo mchongs brgyab pa ma gtogs rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i thog la mi 'gro mkhan yong gi yod pa red/de 'dra'i thog nas spyir btang gi mthong tshul la/ chab srid kyi btsan byol kha sha sa kyis ha ca nga gdug rtsub che ba'i smyo mchongs brgyab ste gnas skabs ming grags dang gsar 'gyur gsar pa zhig bzo thub kyi yod kyang / gzhi rtsa'i 'dzam 225

gling thob mis mi la sha tsha byed pa'i brtse zhen de brlag 'gro gi yod pa red/ nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba rnams so so'i 'tsho thabs thad mgo grung thag chod dang gyong thag chod kyi sgo nas las ka byed thub pa dang gcig gnyis nas yul gang du bsdad yod kyang yul de'i gnas tshul gsar pa de so so'i 'tsho bar spyod shes pa zhig byed kyi yod/ dper na/ sud si'i nang bod mi btsan byol ba rgan gzhon bsdoms chig stong drug brgya tsam yod/ de bzhin khe na ḍa dang / a me ri ka sogs studan rgyal khab mi 'dra ba sum cu tsam gyi nang kha shas la bod mi tsho khag dang / kha shas la khyim tshang re gnyis/ kha shas la slob phrug gcig gnyis byas te bsdad yod cing / gang ltar 'dzam gling thog gi rgyal khab sum cu so grangs shig nang la bod mi slebs yod/ sa khul gcig gnyis tsam min par bod pa rgyus yod mkhan dang 'brel ba yod mkhan tshang mas bod pa ni mi gshis ka bzang po dang / mi ngang rgyud ring po/ mi snang ba skyid po/ mi sems bag phebs po/ mi blos 'gel chog pa/ mi gdong brtan po bcas de 'dra zhig la brtsi gi 'dug de skor zhib tshags shod dgos mi 'dug kyang nga la de 'dra'i lo rgyus mang po /ci /da rgyu yod/ nga la de skor shod mkhan mang po byung / dper na/ tshong gi gnas tshul dang / lan skyel ba/ dngos po skyel ba de 'dra la bod pa gtong gi yod pa red/ spyir btang yin na dngul phon chen po yod pa'i tshong shag dang / yang na nam rgyun ngo shes tan tan yod pa zhig min na dngul 'di 'dra sprod len byed kyi ma red/ rgya gar nang la'ang de 'dra yong gi 'dugabod pa tshos sud lngar gyi tshong mang po rgyag gi yod pa de 'dra'i thog sud krar gyi 226

rgyu cha nyo sgrub byed sa nas bod par yid ches dang / blos bkal nas sgor khri phrag gi dngos dze snga 'asnga na sprod pa sogs mang po zhig yong gi yod pa red/ a rir yang de 'dra zhig byung 'dug bod pa dngul skyel bar btang ste blos bkal/ ying ches byed kyi yod pa red/ bod pas rdzun shod kyi ma red bsam pa'i rang bzhin cha 'jog cig slebs yong gi yod pa red/ de ni mi'i nang la ha cang dkon po red/ dam pos bsdams pa'i btsan dbang gi gcun te sgrig lam ma 'khur mthu med cig yong gi skusgod kyang / rang bzhin mi so 11sa bsam blor nyu dag btang ste ya rabs byas na ma gtogs 'grig gi ma red bsam pa'i thog nas rang 'gul gyi sgrig lam 'khur te mi'i rin thang slebs rgyu de khag po red/spyir btang 'dzam gling thog mi mtshan nyid tshang ba dang / ya rabs kyi ngaspre bzhag sa de bod pa chags yod/ de rnams deng dus shes yon gyi 'jon po rgod po btang nas byung ba zhig min la/ rgyu dngos po dang / dbang shugs/dril bsgrags bcas la brten nas byung ba zhig kyang min par/ don dngos bden don la brten nas rin gong 'di 'dra zhig yong gi yod pa red/ bod pa zhes lab dus mi ya rabs dang / rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ bod mi rigs 'di 'dra zhig la rgya mi'i ngos nas sdod bzod mi bde ba bzos te bod mi btsan byol la gyar dgos byung ba dang / bod nang la'ang dka' ngal mang po 'phrad pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags sku nga dus/ dngos su lag len gyi thog nas tshar bcad tshur bsdus shig yong thub min la ma ltos pa ra sems nang rang bzhin lhan skyes kyis bod par sha tsha zhig slebs yong gi 227

yod pa red/ bod nang la yod pa'i bod pa tshos kyang dngos gnas snying stobs ldan pa'i sgo nas gyong thag chod byas te so so'i rigs zhen ma bor bar rang lugs gtsang ma bzung nas bsdad yod/ sdug bsngal 'di lta bu'i 'og dang / rgya mi'i mtshon rtse'i 'og la de ltar 'tsho sdod thub pa de las sla po zhig gtan nas :)na/'di khul btsan byol ba rnams nas kyang 'dzam gling thog btsan byol gyi gnas stangs skyo po zhig gi 'og nas da cha mi mthong cha 'jog 'pher ba'i mi zhig chags skurdzod/ de dang chabs cig bod la sku(da pa'i rig gzhung la mtshon na/ snga mo nga tshos phyi la 'brel ba byed rgyu nyung thag chod par brten bod pa'i rig gzhung zhes lab na ya mtshan dang / khyad mtshar po brtsi sa'i bzo lta bu zhig chags kyi yod pa/ dper na/ bod pa'i gnas tshul gyi deb phyi rgyal bas bris pa de 'dra klog na bod pa'i lugs srol nang la gus zhabs byed dus lce snar gyi red zer ba/ bod pa dri ma tsha po yod pa red zer ba sogs bshad nas bod pa'i rig gzhung la snang med dang mthong chung byed sa'i bzo zhig la brtsi gi yod/ dper na/ rgya mis kyang de 'dra bshad kyi 'dug rgya mis bod bcings bkrol gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de bod pa ha cang rjes lus thebs nas so so'i lto gos so sos 'tshol mi thub pa dang / de'i thog spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs ches mun nag ches gdug rtsub/ ches kla klo'i rang bzhin ldan pa yin dus yar thon can gyi bcings bkrol dmag mi yong ste bcings bkrol btang ba yin zhes 'khyog bshad byas nas shod kyi yod pa red/ spyir btang 'dzam gling thog la'ang bod pa'i rig 228

bzhung bstod bsngags byas pa de 'dra re zung tsam las spyir btang gis de tsam shes kyi yod pa ma red/nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas mi'i lung par slebs te 'dzam gling gang sa ga la 'brel ba chags/ ngo shes pa gsar pa sku nga dus rim pas bod pa'i rig gzhung gting zab po zhig yin pa dang / lhag don nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la cha bzhag na/ 'dzam gling 1sgog nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i cesas rgya che swākhes dang gting zab shos/ yag shos bod nang yod pa'i dri ma deng sang 'dzam gling thog tshor gyi yod pa red/ de snga ka sbug khul du yod pa'i ka yan de tsho bod rngu dang tshong rgyag pa'i don la pad shag gi grangs ka bshad rgyu yod pa dang / wa ra ṇa si khul gyi rgya se 'thag mkhan kha shas kyis bod skad phran bu rgyag gi 'dugade 'dra'i 'brel ba tsam las gzhan bod pa'i skad yig bslab mkhan dang / bod pa/'i chos la do snang byed mkhan snga mo nga rang tshor rang dbang yod pa'i skabs la yod pa ma red/deng sang nga tsho'i lung pa'i nang chos dang rig gzhung rtsa stongs 'gro ba'i dus tshod dang / nga tsho bod mi nyung shas shig phyi la btsan byol byas nas dka' ngal nang lhung pa'i skabs la gzhi nas bod pa'i skad yig bslab mkhan dang /bod kyi rig gzhung la do snang byed mkhan deng sang ha cang mang du 'gro gi yod/bod kyi chos 'di rnam grangs mang po dang / rgya chen po bsam blo gtong rgyu mang po yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob pa'i don la bod pa'i skad yi ga slob rgyur do snang gsar pa zhig slebs yod/229

nga tsho bod pa zhes pa 'di 'dzam gling thog mi 'dra 'dra'i nang nga tsho skyo po zhig tu khyon nas bsdad med/ 'dzam gling thog bod pa'i rig gzhung gi tshogs pa gsar pa brgya phrag kha shas shig tshugs yod/ kha shas chos tshogs dang / kha shas rig gzhung gi tshogs pa/ kha shas grogs 16) tshogs pa zhes pa 11gas phal cher bzhi brgya lnga brgya yod/ 'dzam gling thog chos dang rig gzhung gi 'brel ba'i thog nas tshogs pa dang skyid sdug gsar pa de 'dra gsar du yong gi yod pa red/rgya mi'i chos dang rig gzhung gi don la tshogs pa gsar pa btsugs pa de 'dra mi 'dug rgya mi'i lto zas bro ba chen po yod tsang rgya mi'i za khang mang po yod pa las/ rgya mi'i chos dang rig gzhung gi don la tshogs pa btsugs pa zer ba phal cher go ma myong / nga tsho bod pa'i spags dang / sha skam po za mkhan gyi za khang mi 'dug kyang / bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung la 'dzam gling thog do snang gsar pa zhig dang / dus skabs gsar pa zhig slebs nas dngos gnas snyan grags khyab kyi yod pa red/ zhib tu bsam blo gtong skabs rgya mi'i skad cha ltar/ nga tsho bod pa rlabs chen gyi mi rigs shig yin pa las skyo po zhig rtsa ba nas ma red/ ma gzhi phyogs gcig nas 'grims 'grul gyi gnas tshul yin srid kyang / de snga so so'i lung pa'i nang la rang dbang byas te phal cher nga tsho bod pas mang ba bsdad yod/ rgya mi la cha bzhag na skabs gcig la sog po'i 'og yun ring bsdad pa dang / skabs gcig la man ju'i 'og yun ring bsdad yod pa red/230

rgya nag gi zhing bran lam lugs de ྅ged kyi zhing bran lam lugs dang gcig pa yin na'ang rgya nag gi zhing bran lam lugs de gdug rtsub che ba dang /bod kyi zhing bran lam lugs de gzhan phan dang snying rje ldan pa zhig yin/ rgya rnag gi zhing bran lam lugs nang mi khyo ka pho chen dang / mo rkang ril bzos 'e das rabs nyi shu pa 'go tshugs skabs rgya mo rkang ril dang rgya mi 11 chen sku/da bsnyen pa red/ nga tsho bod kyi rgyal rabs ches mun nag dang / ches kla klo/ ches sadug rtsub red ces rgya mis brjod kyi yod na yang nga tshos mi gson wo rkang ril dang pho chen bzo gi med/ der brten ches mun nag dang ches gdug rtsub su che ba 'dug rtsis rgyag rgyu yod/ rgya mi'i ngos nas bod nang btsan dbang byas tshe b.rigad sa med pa ma gtogs drang po drang bzhag byas te bshad pa yin na gdug rtsub su che dang / nag nyes su che rtsis rgyag rgyu tan tan yod pa red/ der ba'en nga tsho bod pa 'dzam gling thog mig dper 'os pa'i mi rigs shig dang /rig gzhung sogs gang thad nas lo rgyus gting zab yo da pa'i mi rigs shig min pas nga chos spobs pa skye rgyu de gal chen po red/ de yang rgyu mtshan med sgor ham pa dang spobs pa byas na mi 'grigs/ dper na/ sngon ma ma'o tse tung gis a me ri ka shog bu'i stag red ces bshad de khyug tsam zhig la med mi bzo thub kyi yod pa lta bu dang / 'dzam gling thog stobs shugs che shos ru sna dang rgya nag yin pa lta bu bshad pa de 'dra ni tam pa red ma gtogs rgyu mtshan nge na pa 'i spobs pa ma red/ deng sang rgya mis a rir sprel lad ha cang 'khrab dbos kyi 'dug sa ri shog bu'i stag yin na de snga nas phal cher med pa chags 231

tshar ba red/ stag de shog bu rang red mi 'dug rgyu mtshan mi ldan pa'i ham pa byas na ma rabs red/ rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i spobs pa byed rgyu de gal chen po red/nga tshos chos dang 'jig rten gyi las ka gang yin kyang spobs pa yod na sgrub thub pa dang / spobs pa med na sgrub thub kyi ma red/ blo zhum nas nga tshos yong gi ma red ces lab nas bsdad na rjes lus thebs rgyu dang / pham gyi red /nga tsho'i mi rigs lo rgyus yod pa'i mi rigs shig yin/ mi rigs 'dis lo rgyus thog dka' ngal mang po myangs yod/ da lta 'dzam gling thog bod pa zhes ming yod pa zhig chags yod bsam pa'i thog nas spobs pa skye rgyu de gal chen po red/ nga tshos spobs pa bskyed de spyo mchongs brgyab zer ba min/ slobs pa yod pa'i thog nas drang bden gyi 'thab rtsod gnya' ma chag par snying stobs zhum pa med pa'i 'bad brtson snyugs bsrings nas bya rgyu gal chen po red/de ni nga tshos rgya mir mi dga' ba byas nas bshad pa gang yang min/ rgya mi la cha bzhag na'ang mi gcig yin pas bde skyid dgos kyi red/ rgya nag la cha bzhag na'ang rgya nag rang gi rig gzhung zhes 'dzam gling thog lo rgyus yun ri nga yod pas yag po red/ skyid po rgya mir ngagos la bod par yang dgos/ nga tshos ga re bshad kyi yod dam zhe na/ rgya mi skyid po dang / stobs chen yong ba'i don la bod pa rtsis med btang na 'grig gi mi 'dug ces shod kyi yod/ nga chorwa 1da pa'i ngos nas kyang bod pa yag po yong ba'i don la rgya mi rtsis med btang na 'grig gi ma red/ de bzhin rgya mi'i ngos nas kyang kho rang tsho'i don la bod 232

pa mu ge myang dgos pa mu ge myangs/ sdug shi rgyag dgos pa sdug shi brgyab/ rgya mi'i 'dod pa dang ma mthun na khrims 'og la shi dgos pa bcas de 'dra byed shes kyi ma red/ bar skabs kyi gnas stangs dang / deng sang yang bod pas bod pa'i zhen khog byas na khrims 'gal dang / bod pas rgya mir sprel lad 'khrab n+de zhen khog byas na yang dag par brtsi ba de nor 'khrul red/ nga tsho bod pas so so'i mi rigs dang so so'i lung pa'i don la sha zhen byas pa de byed 'os pa jig red/ deng sang bod mi rigs rang gi zhen khog dang / bod mi rigs kyis so so'i mi rigs la gus brtsi byas te mi rigs lo rgyus skor gyi skad cha b.rigad na mi 'grigs par/ tshang ma rgya mi'i thog la ngo so gtong dgos pa dang /rgya rgan bod la ma yong na bod pas gang yang shes kyi med pa lta bu de 'dra rtsa ba nas/ ma red/ ngas nam rgyun nas bod pa gyong po red ces shod kyi yod/ bod pas dngos yod gnas tshul la bltas te de dang mthun pa'i lag len 'gol gyi red/ dper na/ nga tsho bod pa'i khyim mtshes to la rgya gar dang / shar la rgya nag byang la sog po bcas chags yod/ de'i nang nas sog po tshos gyon chas la pags rigs 'dra min bed spyod byas te khong tsho'i gyon chas dro po yod pa red/ sog po'i gyon chas bod pa'i goms gshis nang mang po slebs yod/ lhag don de snga'i gzhung zhabs tsho'i gyon chas mang po'i nang sog po'i gyon chas yod/ gyon chas 'dra chags po dang / pags tshags thorwa 1 sog por yod tsang de sog po nas blangs/rgya mi'i lto zas zhim po dang / sne kha mang po yod tsang bod pa'i lto zas 233

pa mu ge myang dgos pa mu ge myangs/ sdug shi rgyag dgos pa sdug shi brgyab/ rgya mi'i 'dod pa dang ma mthun na khrims 'og la shi dgos pa bcas de 'dra byed shes kyi ma red/ bar skabs kyi gnas stangs dang / deng sang yang bod pas bod pa'i zhen khog byas na khrims 'gal dang / bod pas rgya mir sprel lad 'khrab n+de zhen khog byas na yang dag par brtsi ba de nor 'khrul red/ nga tsho bod pas so so'i mi rigs dang so so'i lung pa'i don la sha zhen byas pa de byed 'os pa jig red/ deng sang bod mi rigs rang gi zhen khog dang / bod mi rigs kyis so so'i mi rigs la gus brtsi byas te mi rigs lo rgyus skor gyi skad cha b.rigad na mi 'grigs par/ tshang ma rgya mi'i thog la ngo so gtong dgos pa dang /rgya rgan bod la ma yong na bod pas gang yang shes kyi med pa lta bu de 'dra rtsa ba nas/ ma red/ ngas nam rgyun nas bod pa gyong po red ces shod kyi yod/ bod pas dngos yod gnas tshul la bltas te de dang mthun pa'i lag len 'gol gyi red/ dper na/ nga tsho bod pa'i khyim mtshes to la rgya gar dang / shar la rgya nag byang la sog po bcas chags yod/ de'i nang nas sog po tshos gyon chas la pags rigs 'dra min bed spyod byas te khong tsho'i gyon chas dro po yod pa red/ sog po'i gyon chas bod pa'i goms gshis nang mang po slebs yod/ lhag don de snga'i gzhung zhabs tsho'i gyon chas mang po'i nang sog po'i gyon chas yod/ gyon chas 'dra chags po dang / pags tshags thorwa 1 sog por yod tsang de sog po nas blangs/rgya mi'i lto zas zhim po dang / sne kha mang po yod tsang bod pa'i lto zas 233

nang la phug dang / sngo tshal mang po zhig rgya mi'i zas ped spyod byed kyi yod/lta ba dang grub mtha'i chos kyi rnam bzhag dang / rig gnas kyi rnam bzhag de tsho'i thog la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos drag shos dang / gting zab shos chags yod pa de rgya gar nas byung ba red/ der brten bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung rgya gar nas blangs pa sha stag red/ nga rang tshor bka' 'gyur po ti brgya tsam dang / bstan 'gyur po tri nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam yod pa nas mdo re zung zhig rgya nag nas bsgyur ba phal cher yong mdog kha po yod/ gzhan bka' bstan 'gyur tshang ma rgya gar nas bsgyur ba sha stag red/ nga rang tshos dpe cha gang 'dra zhig klog pa yin kyang dbu la rgya gar skad du zhes pa las rgya neg skad du zhes pa.e yod/ rgya mis bod kyi chos de yang ta lam rgya nag nas yong ba red zer ba de 'dra bshad pa'i yi ge zhig na ning ngas mthong byung / ham pa de 'dra bshad 'a dug de la su yid ches kyi red dam/ nga tsho'i bod kyi lo tsā ba skad grags chen po de tshos rgya gar la phebs nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang mnyam du bsgyur ba sha stag red/ nga tsho bod pas khyim mtshes rgya gar tsha ba'i lung pa'i lto chas de gnam gshis grang mo'i nang la zhim po med pa de phar g.yugs te dngos gnas klad pa'i to chas chos dang rig ga zhung rgya gar gting zab po yod pa de bod du blangs pa red/ deng sang rgya mis snyigs dor bcud len zhes shod kyi 'dug par ltar/ nga tsho bod pas dngos gnas snyigs dor bcud len sngar nas byas yod/ dngos gnas mi rigs kyi thobes pa dang / rang gi lta ba de 'dzin rgyu gal chen po 'dug234

rgya mir cha bzhag na/ rgya mi'i don la bod pa'i thob thang rtsa ba nas rdog rol btang ba de ma 'grigs pa red/ der nga tshos rtsod pa byed kyi yod/ rgya mi yang skyid po dgos la/ nga tsho bod pa'ang skyid po dgos/ bod rgya gnyis tsā/ skyid po gang 'dra byas te byed dgos zhe na/ bod dang rgya nag gi sa 'dres de gna' snga mo nas yod pa zhig yin pa las phyis su chags pa zhig ma red/ bod rgya gnyis kyi 'brel ba de skabs re gnyen 'brel gyi thog nas 'brel ba yag po zhig dang / skabs re dmag 'khrug gi thog nas 'brel ba sdug po byas te sdod dgos pa 'di da res gcig pu min par snga mo nas byung tshar ba red/ skabs re rgya nag dang 'khrug pa brgyab ste bod pas rgya nag gong ma phyir 'bud byas pa'i gnas tshul yang byung yod/ dper na/ phyi lo 1954455 lo nga rang rgya nag la phyin te phal cher zla ba bcu tsam zhig bsdad pa red/ pe cing nas yar 'khor yong skabasashis rngan zhes pa'i lung pa der sdod dus gsal po dran pa zhig la/ nyin gcig dgong dro zhig la gna' snga mo'i rgya nag gong ma'i grong khyer rnying pa red zer ba zhig la lta skor dang 'cham 'cham la phyin pa yin/ sa cha grong gseb kyi bzo 'dra ba lcags ri chen po yod pa zhig la slebs te ngal gsos nas sdod skabs rgya mi dpon po des sngar bod kyi dmag mi 'di bar du slebs pa red/ rgya nag gong ma 'di nas bros dgos byung ba red ces bshad byung /de dus nga rang bsam blo zhig 'khor byung / nga tsho rgya nag la 'gro skabs dar rtse mdo nas shar phyogs su la chen 17 de brgyab nas g.ya' rngan zhes pa'i sa cha de la slebs/ g.ya' rngan nas da dung drin tu bar gang 'tshams 'gro dgos/235

drin tu nas shis rngan bar gnam grur phyin pa yin/ sngar bod kyi sa mtshams thag nye po 'di 'dra min par gang la gang 'tsham gyi sa thag ring po yod/ sa thag de 'dra zhig la rgya nag gong ma rang gi rgyal sar sdod ma thub par bros dgos pa'i dmag mi'i shugs shig yin dus dmag mi gang la gang 'tsham gyi phon che na po zhig med na de 'dra yong gi ma red/ dmag mi de 'dra zhig ma gir slebs dus de la dpag pa'i rgyab phyogs kyi dmag rgyag sogs yod pa red/ ma gzhi snga mo'i dmag gi 'gro stangs phran bu mi 'dra ba yin kyang / gang ltar bod pa'i dmag mi ma gi bar la slebs thub pa zhig dang / rgya nag gong ma sdod ma thub par de nas bros dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags pa des bod pa'i dmag shug/sa chen po yod pa'i rtags gsal po 'dug de bzhin rgya gar phyogs su yang chu mo gang gā bar bod pa'i dmag mi yong ba'i lo rgyus yod pa red/ bod dang rgya gnyis kyi 'brel ba de skabs re 'cham po dang / skabs re 'khrug ste bsdad pa red/ bod dang rgya nag 'cham po byed pa'i dus skabs su rdo ring thog chos rgyal gyi sku dus su bris pa'i yi ge'i nang / rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul na skyid/ ces 'khod 'dug de dngos gnas red/ rgya rgya yul la skyid cing / rgya mi 'bu la dga' po red/ 'bu tsha ba'i lung par ma gtogs med pas kho rang tsho rgya nag tu log phyin na 'bras zhing yang yod la/ rgya mtsho'i kha la 'bu mang po yod/ bod sa mtho po dang gnam gshis grang mo yin tsang 'bu mang po med / rgya mis sbal pa dang / nya phrug chung chung nga tsho snying rje skye yul de 'dra mang po sgrug nas za gi 'dug da dung cong mo dang / khang byi'u chung 236

chung de tsho khong tshos bro ba chen po zhig tu brtsi gi 'dugang mo bod pas 'bu za gi ma red/ nga tsho bod pa mar dang rtsam pa la dga' po yod/ nga tsho bod lung pa'i sems can bkrin caX / 'bri'i 'o mas ma ra bzos/ g.yag gi rtsid pas sbra gur bzos byed kyi red/ 'di 'dra'i sems can bkrin can de tsho bod sa mtho'i thog la ma gtogs 'dzam gling sa gnas bzhan la rtsa ba nas mi 'dug nga tsho bod pa 'bri g.yag mnyam du bod pa bod /yul la bsdad na skyid po 'dug rgya mi kho rang tso ngang pa dang / bya de mnyam da rgya thang la phyin na rgya rgya yul la skyid pa yod pa red/ der brten rgya rgya yul ṅge skyid/ bod bod yul na skyid ces pa de rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i skad cha red/bod la rgya mi yong nas bod las sla por dbang du bsdu thub bsam pa dang /las sla por 'dzugs skrun byed thub bsam pa'i re ba brgyab pa red kyang / da bar bod mi'i sems dbang du bsdu thub med pa dang / 'dzugs skrun yang byed thub mi 'dug gzhung lam bzos yod kyang de ni gtso che shos dmag lam dang /de'i thog rgya mi las byed pa mang po zhig bod nang bsdad pa de tshos bed spyod byed ched red/ de 'brel sman khang dang / slob gra/ bzo gra bcas 'dzugs skrun byas yod pa de tsho dngos gnas bod par 'phral phugs kyi drin chen po 'jags pa 'i sha tsha rnam dag gi 'char gzhi'i thog nas 'dzugs skrun byas pa zhig rtsa ba nas mthong gi mi 'dugargya mi bod la slebs pa des rgya dkar nag gi sa mtshams zhes pa zhig chags yod/ bod la rgya mi slebs med na rgya dkar nag gi sa mtshams zhes 237

pa yod pa ma red/ bod dang rgya gar gyi sa mtshams red/ dbyin jis bod la dmag drangs pa de ma gtogs lo stong phrag gi ring la bod dang rgya gar gyi sa mtshams la zhi bde lhing 'jags byas nas bsdad pa red/ rgya mis bod nang btsan 'dzul byas pa'i nyer len gyis rgya mi kho rang tsho'i ngos nas rgya nag gi lto nub sa mtshams brtan po bzos pa yin zer gyi yod kyang / don la rgya gar rgyal khab dang rnyog dra ston ma langs rgyu'i dus skabs shig la slebs yod/de nas gtso che shos bod nang gi mi tshos rgya mi la blo rtsa ba nas lta gi med pa dang / rgya mis rgyun du kha nas blo mthun dang / grogs po/ spun zla mi rigs zhes shod kyi yod kyang / bod du rgya mi'i dmag sgar nang bod pa gang la gang 'tsham yod pa de tsho go sa mtho por slebs kyi 'dug dang mi 'dug de bzhin bod rang skyong ljongs zhes zer ba'i nang ngo thog gi las ku'i 'gan de sus 'khyer gyi 'dug gam/ nga phod dang / paṇa chen rin po che la mtshan gnas chen spro zhig 'bul gyi yod na'ang ngo thog gi dbang cha gang yang med/ dper na/ paṇa chen rin po che dang / nga phod gnyis gas rgya mi'i gdong la gzigs te bag zon byas te bzhugs dgos pa dang / rgya mis ga re byed dgos zer ba la cho sang lta gin lta gin gnang rgyu zhig ma gtogs rang dbang med/ gang ltar bod nang la rgya mi'i phogs zas nas las ka byed mkhan mang che ba bod mi rigs kyi bsam blo yod mkhan sha stag red/ 'go stod gnas tshul yag po ma shes pa dang / nyams myong ma bsags pa'i skabs la rgya mis bshad pa de tsho yin pa red bsam pa dang / so so'i gral rim gnas stangs kyi thog nas spyi tshogs 238

ring lugs dang / gung bran ring lugs/ gsar brje/ yar rgyas/ bcings 'grol sogs bshad skabs de 'a/ yid ches byed mkhan re zung byung ba de ni srid pa zhig red/ lo nas lo bstud de rgya mi dang mnyam du gshibs/ dngos yod kyi nyams myong bsags dus zhing bran lam lugs sdug chag yin kyang so so'i lung pa'i nang la so so'i mi rigs shig gis lag len bstar ba'i zhing bran lam lugs shig red/ deng sang bod mi rigs yongs rdzogs rgya'i tshe g.yog chags 'dug de tsho nyams myong gi thog nas shes dus las byed pa phal mo che'i sems kyi gting la nga bod mi yin snyam pa'i bsam blo zhig dang / rgya rgan 'di tsho bsam pa zhig bsam blo'i nang slebs yod/rgya mis bod par blos ji tsam 'gel gyi yod med gnad don 'di tsho'i steng nas shes kyi red/ kha nas spun zla dang / tang yon yin na blo mthun pa/grogs po/ thob thang 'dra mnyam yin zer gyi yod kyang ngo thog las ka bskul stangs dang / mi mthong cha 'jog gang 'dra byed kyi yod bltas na ha cang khag po red/ rgya mir da bar bya long byed long ma byung ba min/ rgya mi slebs nas lo sum cu lhag tsam phyin yod/ lo de'i ring dang / lhag don phyi lo 1959tshun chad la khong tshor 'dod pa gang yod byed rgyu byung yod kyang / da dung rgya mis brgya cha brgya blos 'khel ba'i bod kyi 'gan 'khur thub mkhan gyi bod mi rdog po gcig bstan rgyu mi 'dug bod pa na gzhon nang nas 'tshar longs byung ste dngos gnas mi dmangs kyi spyi mos yod pa/ rgya mis blos 'khel ba/ las ga'i 'jon thang yod mkhan gyi bod pa da dung rdog po gcig bstan rgyu mi 'dug239

de gang byas pa red dam/ nga tsho phyi lo 1959 lo mi'i lung par gyar te btsan byol ba zhes pa'i ming gi thog nas gzhan la rogs ram btsal te slob gra btsugs nas slob sbyong sprad par brten deng sang mi mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig chags te bod kyi rig gzhung gi don dang / bod rgyal khab kyi don dag gang ltar chab srid dang / chos kyi thog nas gang la gang 'tsham gyi 'gan 'khur thub mkhan zhig bzo thub yod/ so so'i lung pa'i nang la da dung de 'dra thon thub kyi mi 'dug pa de ga re byas pa red dam/de bzhin phyi lo 1980 lor rgya mi brgya cha bdun cu brgyad cu 'then gyi yin zhes hu'u ya'o pang lha sar yod skabs bshad de gang la gang 'tsham lag len bstar ba yin pa reng/ rjes su bod pas 'jon gyi mi 'dug bod pas lag shes kyi las ka byed thub kyi mi 'dug ces kha 'phangs lag 'phyis kyis lha sar ar po rgyag mkhan rgya mi lag shes pa phon chen po slebs pa red/ bod pa rdo bzo bas rdo bzo shes kyi med pa dang / bod pa rdo bzo bas ar po rgyag shes kyi med pa/ bod pa shing bzo bas ka gdung bzo shes kyi med pa/ bod pas ar 'dam bsres sbyor byed shes kyi med pa de 'dra zhig la brtsi gi 'duga'adi ga re byas pa red dam/ rgya mis bod dbang sgyur byas stabs bod par slob sbyong sprod dgos pa'i 'gan de rgya mir yod pa re / yin na'ang bod par slob sbyong sprad mi 'dug bod pa rnams mi tshe sdug zad la gtong rgyu'i tshe g.yog gi 'du shes bzhag pa ma gtogs/ ngo ma'i lag len gyi thog nas bod lung pa'i nang gi las ka che phra chung gsum bod pas 'jon thub pa zhig yong ba'i ched du 240

sha tsha'i thog nas slob gso slob sbyong sprad yod pa yin na rgya mir 'dod pa gang yod byed rgyu byung nas lo nyi shu rtsa bdun phyin pa'i rjes la gang la gang 'tsham byed thub pa zhig dgos kyi ma red dam/ me shugs phur mda' bzo rgyu la sogs pa'i rig gnas dang / tshan rig gting zab lo mang slob sbyong byas na ma gtogs mi shes mkhan de 'dra yong thub kyi med kyang / spyir btang las ka gang la gang 'tsham byed thub pa zhig da mtshams yod dgos tshod kyang mi 'dug pa de ga re byas pa red zer na/ rgya mis bod pa'i thog la lta stangs de bod mir bed spyod byed rgyu dang / g.yog bskul bya rgyu'i 'du shes las/ gso skyong byas te bod nang bod pas rang mgo thon pa yong thabs la bsam blo btang mi 'dug 'char gzhi yang bting mi 'dug der brten nga tsho nad ma theg par skad rgyag dgos don 'di red ma gtogs nga tshos don med rgya mi la mi dga' ba byas nas skad rgyab pa ma red/rgya mi dung phyur bcu la bde skyid dgos kyi red la/ nga tshorayang bde skyid dgos kyi red/ nga tsho rtag par skyo thag chod byas nas sdod dgos pa gang yin nam/ dper na/ bod nang dpal 'byor gyi rgyab skyor chen po byed kyi yod brjod kyi yod pa ltar rgya nag dbus gzhung gis 'gro song btang yod pa red/ 'gro song btang ba'i mtha' ma hu'uya'o pang lha sar yong ba'i skabs la ha las te da lta bar du 'gro song btang ba rnams yar klung gtsang por g.yugs pa red dam zhes shod dgos byung ba red/ de ltar dbus gzhung nas 'gro song ji tsam btang yang lung pa dang / bod mi mang la don phan gang yang byung yod pa ma red/241

de bzhin du bod pa'i slob phrug tshor thob thang sprod rgyu yig cha'i thog 'dra chags po zhig yod na'ang / ngo ma slob phrug bsdu ba'i skabs la ltag sgo brgyud de rgya mi las byed pa'i bu phrug de tshor sngon dang por thob thang rag gi yod/ bod pa'i ched du dmigs te rgya nag nang slob gra drag gras la sa stong rkub stegs bzhag pa de tshor bod la yod pa'i rgya mi'i phru gu de tsho gtong gi yod pa red/ bod kyi rig gzhung yar rgyas gtong dgos shod kyi yod kyang / ngo thog lag len skabs rgya yig gi thog nas rgyugs 'phrod pa zhi ga dang / rgya yig tshad longs pa zhig ma byung na yong gi mi 'dug bod par thob thang sprad yod zer gyi yod kyang ngo thog thob thang de lag len 'gel gyi med pa gsal po 'dug bod nang la 'gro song gtong gi yod pa de rnams gtso che shos dmag mi gabo ra gyur pa'i rgya mi las byed rnams kyi phogs dang / 'gro song dang / de rnams kyi nang mi tshun la lta skyong byed dgos kyi yod pa red/rgya nag nas bod kyi dpal 'byor rgyab snon yin zhes dngos zog phran bu gtong gi yod na'ang bod nang slebs rjes rgya mi tshos gcig gis gcig la ngo shes kyi mgo 'dren ltag sgo brgyud nas gang ltar khong tshos 'khyer 'gro gi yong/ ca dngos legs pa zhig yod na'ang rgya mi las byed tsho'i lag par 'gro gi 'dusango thog ca dngos legs pa rgya mi tshor sprod rgyu yin na rgya nag nas sprad na bdal gla 'gro ma dgos pa khe bzang red/ bod pa'i ched du yin zhes rgya nag nas bda' gla sprad de btang nas lha sar slebs rjes rgya mi'i am phrag nang 'gro gi 'dusader brten dngos gnas bod lung pa'i nang la rgya mis da lta bar du byed stangs 242

sdig po zhig rtsa ba nas byas med/de la nga tshos skad rgyag dus mes rgyal kha bral du gtong gi 'dug zer gyi yod pa red/ kha bral sus btang ba red dam/ dud 'gro khyi phag cig dang /bya byi'u byol song zhig yin na'ang byams po byas na dga' po byed kyi red/ sdug po btang na sus dga' po byed kyi red dam/ sdug po gtong mkhan la dga' spro mi byed pa de chos nyid red/ bod pa rgya mi la sna 'tshig pa de bod pa'i rang gshis sdug drags pa red dam/ rgya mi gdug rtsub che drags pa red bsam blo gtong dgos/ sna 'tshig shin 'tshig shin la sdug po gtong mkhan de'i 'og 'a sdod dgos don med/ de ni mi phar bzhag sgo la btags pa'i sgo khyi zhig yin yang sbyin bdag gis rgyug pa mang po gzhus na lcags thag bcad nas bros rgyu'i byus byed kyi red/ de 'dra zhig yin na/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs mig gnyis dang rna ba gnyis bed spyod byed rgyu yod pa zhig gis sdug po gtong mkhan gyi 'og zhwa sdod kyi red dam/ khag po red/dngos gnas rgya mis bod pa kha bral byed 'dod med na byams po byed dgos/ 'das pa'i lo sum cu so grangs kyi ring la dngos gnas rgya mis bod pa ra kha zhe gnyis med kyi byams skyong byas yod na bod pa'i bsam tshul 'dir sdod kyi ma red/ bod pa kha bral 'gro gi 'dug kha bral gyi las 'gul byed kyi 3dug zer dgos pa'i kha bral gyi las 'gul byed dgos pa 'di rgya mi kho rang tshos bzos pa red/ de shes kyi mi 'dug la shod sa'ang mi 'dug nga tsho'i lung li 'i nang la mu gos lung tshan lung tshan nang mi mang po togs grir shi ba de snga'i 243

lo rgyus jog 'khod myong dang thos myong med pa red/ rgya mi slebs rjes phyi lo 1957458 nas bzung ste a mdo khul dang / khams khul/ de nas dbus gtsang khul bcas kyi yul tsho'i nang rim pas lto chas rdzogs nas bza' rgyu med par mu gos shi song zhes bar lam skyabs zhu mang po 'byor gyi 'dug bod nang phar gnyen 'phrad la song ba dang / bod nas tshur gnyen 'phrad du yong mkhan bcas mang po zhig gis de snga'i lo rgyus brjod skabs tshang mas mig chu btang nas nga'i pha bston khang nang shi song / ma ltogs shi thebs song / a zhang 3thab 'dzings 'og grongs song / a khu dmar gsod btang song zhes pa de 'dra ma gtogs dga' dga' spro spro byas nas bshad rgyu ha lam mi 'dug nga chos 'di lta bu'i sdug po zhig myong gin myong gin la da dung sdug po de myangs te sdod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mi 'dugabar lam rgya mis srid byus gsar pa zhig bzung ba de la zhib tu bltas na bod par sha tsha byas pa zhig rtsa ba nas ma red/ rgya nag khyon yongs kyi thog bar lam pham nyes kyi nyams myong mngayo byung ste da cha 'dzam gling kun dang mthun pa'i 'gro stangs thog la ma phyin na phugs la so sor gyong rag gi yod pa mthong nas slob sbyong dang / dpal 'byor gyi 'gro stangs thad deng sang bsgyur bcos phran bu zhig btang nas 'dzam gling kun dang mthun pa'i lam la 'gro rgyu'i rnam/ 'gyur bstan pa de cung yag po red/ de dang 'brel te bod kyi thog la'ang bod mi btsan byol ba gnyen 'phrad la 'gro 'o nga gi go skabs sprad pa dang / dpa' 'gyor yong lha'i don du 'dzam gling phyi'i mi mang po thod nanga'agro thub pa byung bayang 244

yar rgyas kyi rnam pa zhig red/ lhag don hu'u ya'o pang lha sar 'byor ba'i skabs la khong gis de snga nor 'khrul chen po byung 'dug de snga nor 'khrul chen po byung ba de dag dgongs dag phyin chad nor 'khrul med pa yag po byed kyi yin zhes yongs bsgrags byas nas bshad yod pa dang / tang gi tshogs 'du'i nang la'ang shod kyi yod pa ha cang yag po red/ rgya mi'i gnas tshul la ltos te ngo mtshar skye dgos pazhig red/ gang yin zhe na/ nam rgyun rgya mis nor 'khrul ngos len byed pa de ha lam mi srid pa lta bu red/ kho rang tshos nor ba ngos len byas pa de ha cang yag po red/yin na'ang phran bu bsgyur bcos 'gro ba der nga tshos rgya mis yag po byed kyi 'dug ces shod rgyu snga thashe chod pa red/ da lta yid ches thub pa ha cang khag po red/ 'das pa'i lo nyi shu rtsa grangs kyi nyams myong thog nas bltas na da lta lo lnga drug nang gi 'gyur ba de lam sang yag po 'dug lab thub rgyu khag po red/der brten bod nang yod pa'i bod mi tshor 'phral sel dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs lhug tu song ste so sor 'gan gtsang sprad nas 'tsho ba thabs 'tshol thub pa yin na thabs shes byed sa yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig byung ba red/ kha shas la bod nang gnas tshul gang 'dra yod dri dus/ yag chod dang skyid thag chod yod/ 'di las sdug tu ma phyin na yag thag chod 'dug zer mkhan de 'dra 'dugade ni khag med/ bar lam sdug po myangs che thag chod pas rkyen byas nas sdug pa de la ltos te.a'u tsam yod shod kyi yod pared/ yin na'ang 'grig bsdad yod ces chog shes byed pa'i dus mtshams la slebs yod pa ma red/245
