da lta'i dus tshod 'dir mi rigs dang rgyal khab yar rgyas gtong dgos zhes bshad pa de 'phral sel lto gos kyi gnas tshul gcig pu ma red/ gal che shos shes sku(na la thug sku(da/ shes yon yar rgyas kyi don la rgya mi'i ngos nas na ning tang gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs te krung dbyang yig chasang drug pa zer ba de'i nang bod kyi slob grar yar rgyas gtong dgos pa dang / slob gra'i nang bod yig gtso bor byed dgos pa de 'dra mang po bkod 'dug 'on kyang da phan lag len la ji ma ji bzhin bkal gyi med pa'i bzo 'dug de tsho ngo ma lag len thog yag po bkal te bod nang gtso che shos rig gnas kyi chu tshad yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang / de yang mi rigs so so rang nyid kyi khyad chos dang 'brel ba'i thog nas yar rgyas gtong thub pa zhig byung na dngos gnas yag po red/da lta de 'dra mi 'dugagal che shos da lta'i dus tshod 'dir so so'i rig zhung gi khyad chos ldan pa'i thog nas deng dus kyi shes yon la do snang byed rgyu de dza drag dang / gal chen po chags yod/ da phan rgya mis bod pas 'jon gyi mi 'dug ces mthong chung byed pa de nga tsho shes tshad kyis ma ldang pa yin tsang mthong chung myong dgos byung ba red/ rgya mi kho rang tsho la cha bzhag na'ang 'dzam gling thog mthong chung myong mus yin pa las/ 'dzam gling thog mngon par bstod sa'iyul zhig chags med/ rgya mis nga tsho bod par dpag tshod kyis 'gro tshod rtsis te bod pa rjes lus red zer ba de ji ltar byas te sel dgos zer na/ rtsa ba nga rang tsho'i mi rigs la mthun pa'i cha rkyen yod pared/ de'i thog deng dus kyi shes yon la 246

da lta'i dus tshod 'dir mi rigs dang rgyal khab yar rgyas gtong dgos zhes bshad pa de 'phral sel lto gos kyi gnas tshul gcig pu ma red/ gal che shos shes sku(na la thug sku(da/ shes yon yar rgyas kyi don la rgya mi'i ngos nas na ning tang gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs te krung dbyang yig chasang drug pa zer ba de'i nang bod kyi slob grar yar rgyas gtong dgos pa dang / slob gra'i nang bod yig gtso bor byed dgos pa de 'dra mang po bkod 'dug 'on kyang da phan lag len la ji ma ji bzhin bkal gyi med pa'i bzo 'dug de tsho ngo ma lag len thog yag po bkal te bod nang gtso che shos rig gnas kyi chu tshad yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang / de yang mi rigs so so rang nyid kyi khyad chos dang 'brel ba'i thog nas yar rgyas gtong thub pa zhig byung na dngos gnas yag po red/da lta de 'dra mi 'dugagal che shos da lta'i dus tshod 'dir so so'i rig zhung gi khyad chos ldan pa'i thog nas deng dus kyi shes yon la do snang byed rgyu de dza drag dang / gal chen po chags yod/ da phan rgya mis bod pas 'jon gyi mi 'dug ces mthong chung byed pa de nga tsho shes tshad kyis ma ldang pa yin tsang mthong chung myong dgos byung ba red/ rgya mi kho rang tsho la cha bzhag na'ang 'dzam gling thog mthong chung myong mus yin pa las/ 'dzam gling thog mngon par bstod sa'iyul zhig chags med/ rgya mis nga tsho bod par dpag tshod kyis 'gro tshod rtsis te bod pa rjes lus red zer ba de ji ltar byas te sel dgos zer na/ rtsa ba nga rang tsho'i mi rigs la mthun pa'i cha rkyen yod pared/ de'i thog deng dus kyi shes yon la 246

do snang sbyangs brtson bya rgyu gal chen po red/ lhag don bod kyi grong gseb khug kyog nang slob gra thebs chag cig las med na'ang de la phru gu slob sbyong byed par btang nas ma 'ongs par bod mi'i shes yon drag tu 'gro thabs byed rgyu de yang ha cang gal chen po yin pas tshang mas shugs rgyag dgos/ rgya yig slob mkhan rgya nag nang mi sa ya dang dung phyur yod pa red/ kha tsha lag 'thogs gal che shos spyir btang 'dzam gling gi rig gzhung thog nas rtsis pa yin na bod yig shes mkhan nyung nyung red/ bod yig bod pas ma sbyangs na sus sbyong / bod yig la bod pas bdag po ma brgyab na sus rgyag der brten bod yig gtso bor gyurapa'i shesayon la dang dod do snang byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ yang rgya mis btsugs pa'i slob gra'i nang bod yig bslab kyi mi 'dug na phru gu ma btang bar bod yig bslab na phru gu gtong gi yin/ bod yig ma bslab na gtong gi min zhes bshad na'ang rgyu mtshan ldan pa red/ bod yig bslab song na slob grar yin gcig min gcig gtong rgyu gal chen po red/ de la rjes lus thebs na yag po rtsa ba nas med/nga tsho btsan byol ba tsho mi'i lung par slebs nas dang por slob sbyong sprod rgyu de gal che shos la rtsis pa red/ phyi lo 1959 lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i nang rgya gar la slebs te lo de dang / de'i phyi lo nas bzung ste slob sbyong la shugs brgyab nas 'bad brtson gang yong ci yong dang thabs shes byas pa red/ grub 'bras kyang gang la gang 'tshams thon yod/ slob sbyong gi thog la do snang chen po byed dgos/ 247

de nas da lta lab pa bzhin deng sang srid byus phran bu gu yangs gtong ba'i skabs la de tsam gyi chog shes rtsa ba nas byed rgyu med/ rtsa ba rgya mi'i byed stangs de tan tan med/ rgya mi'i rtsa ba'i gnas tshul la 'dzam gling phyi'i rgyal khab mang po zhig gis rgya nag la stong 'brel byed rgyur do snang chen po byed kyi yod kyang / rtsa ba'i rgya nag gi srid byus de mi gcig la thug pa lta bu zhig yod stabs teng zha'o thing sdod pa'i ring la phal cher 'dir gnas mi yong ngam/ gal srid teng zha'o thing med pa chags na srid byus de gang 'dra byas yong / teng zha'o thing sdod pa'i ring la'ang gang 'dra byas yong zhes 'dzam gling thog tshang mas blo g.yeng byed kyi 'dug nga tshor cha bzhag na'ang da lta tshod thig rgyu rtsa ba nas med pas tshang mas rig pa bsgrims te gzab gzab byed dgos/ rgya mis dngos gnas sha tsha dang / bsam pa rnam dag gi srid byus shig 'dzin pa yin na de'i tshe de'i dus kyi gnas tshul tha dad red/ da lta de bshad thub rgyu ha cang khag po red/nga tsho bod pas bod pa'i thob thang rtsod len byed kyi yod/ rtsod len byed pa'i skabs la rgya mis bod pas kha bral gyi bsam blo gtong gi 'dug zer nas bod pas rgya mi'i 'og la sdug po myangs pa de myong dgos dang dgos mdog mdog byed pa de 'grig gi mi 'dug gang yin zer na/ 'dzam gling thog rgyal rabs ma byung gong gi gnas tshul ni tha dad red/ rgyal rabs byung ba'i rjes la rgya dang bod ces tha dad so so red ma gtogs/ bod rgya nag gi cha shas yin pa zhig rtsa ba nas chags med/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i yig cha gzu bor gnas te 248

rang bzhin drangapor brjod pa phal mo che'i nang la rgya dang bod/ hor zhes tha dang so sor ba shad pa las gcig pa yin pa zhig gtan nas bshad mi 'dugargya mis bod rgya nag gi cha shas yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ldan pa lab rgyu med dus rgya nag ces pa'i tshig gi tshab la (krung go nyi zhes pa'i tshig gsar pa zhig bcug nas bod krung go'i cha shas red ces u tshugs rgyag gi 'dug de ni bar lam rgya mis mgo bde dran 'khrul byas nas bshad pa red ma gtogs/ngo thog byas na krung go zhes pa de rgya nag rang la zer gyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i yig cha rnying pa'i nang / rgya nag stong khun rgyal po 'dra zhes rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i rnam thar nag sto lo tsā bas mdzad pa de'i nang la jo bo rje'i 'khrungs khang gi lo rgyus gsung dus de'i stobs 'byor mnga' thang de rgya nag stong khun rgyal po nang bzhin yod pa red ces tshig 'di gsungs yod/ 'di'i yi ge (stong khun nyi zhes bris yod/ de yang rgya skad kyi zur chag ste skad nyams song ba red/ don dngos rgya nag ces bod skad/stong khun zhes rgya skad yin pa red/ nga tsho'i yig cha rnying pa'i nang la stong khun nam krung go zhes pa de rgya nag la brtsi ba ma gtogs de'i nang bod the ba zhig rtsa ba nas chags yod pa ma red/ dber na/ bod pa kha shas la rgya mi'i goms gshis 'jags te bal yul sa mtshams la slebs dus krung bo'i sa mtshams zhes zer gyi 'dug de nor 'khrul red/ de 'dra shod rgyu med/ krung go'i sa mtshams rgya skad du 'ar lang hran zer ba'i ri de'i rgyab la bsdad yod pa las 'di khul yod pa ma red/ gal srid bod kyi sa mtshams zhes lab na rgya mi'i 249

rna bar mi 'gro ba byed kyi 'dug na bal wa'i sa mtshams zhes lab na 'grig gi red/ krung go'i sa mtshams zhes lab na ma dag rgyun 'byams chags rgyu'i nyen kha yod/nga tshos rgya mi tshor bod kyi de snga'i lo rgyus shod dgos byung na bod kyi rgyal rabs dang / rgya nag gi rgyal rabs/ rgya bod gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i skor bcas la dngos gan sa srid don gyi dbang shed med par gzu bor gnas pa'i drang yi thog nas nyams zhib byed dgos kyi 'dug bod dang rgya nag ces rtsa ba nas tha dad so so red/ ma 'ongs par gang 'dra zhig byed min ni de'i tshe de'i dus kyi nga rang cho ngad mi sa ya drug la khe phan che shos shig dang / thob thang yag shos shig dgos pa de ni mi'i bde skyid kyi rtsa ba yin/ 'dzam gling thog rgyal rabs la 'pho 'gyur ci yang yong gi yod/ gal che shos do bdag la bde skyid kyi thob thang che shos shig dgos pa de red/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus la cha bzhag na rgya dang bod ces tha dad so so red ma gtogs/ bod rgya nag gi cha shas su rtsa ba nas gtogs med/ yin na'ang rgyal khab gcig gyur dang / mnyam sbrel rgyal khab ces pa de 'dra 'dzam gling thog yong srid pa red/ 'dzam gling thog mi rigs gcig gyur yin pa zhig thun mong gi khe phan med pa chags dus dum bur gyes kyi yod pa dang / mi rigs tha dad cig thun mong gi khe phan dmigs bsal can zhig chags skabs mi rigs tha dad yin na'ang gcig gyur chags yong gi yod/ 'das pa'i gnas tshul cha bzhag na rgya dang bod ces rtsa ba nas tha dad so so red/250

rgya mir cha bzhag na'ang thog mar bod la yong skabs tha ma zhi ba'i bcings bkrol btang ba yin zhes gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun bzhag dgos pa zhig chags pa red/ de ga re byas nas chags pa red dam/ rgya dmag a mdo dang / khams khul nas yong dang yong bzhin pa'i mur chab mdo bar slebs pa red/ de nas chab mdor bsdad de bod gzhung dang gros mthun bzhag dgos pa de la rgyu mtshan zhig yod pa red/ yin na yang rgya mis 'grel bshad rgyag skabs de chings yig ma red/ gros mthun red ces shod kyi yod/ chings yig ces lab na rgyal khab rang btsan zhig gi gnas tshul red/ 'di ni dbus gzhung dang sa gnas gzhung dbar la gros mthun bzhag pa zhig red shod kyi yod/gros mthun yig cha dbyin ji'i yi ger bsgyur ba'i nang la chings yig ces pa'i ming tshig de rang gcig pa bsgyur 'dug pa las so so byas nas bsgyur mi 'dugade bzhin krung go zhes pa de bod skad nang krung go dang rgya nag dbye ba phye gi yod kyang / dbyin ji'i skad kyi nang la krung go ༄ra rung / rgya nag zer rung gang ltar (ca'e na ) zer ba zhig las yod pa ma red/ nga tsho bod pa'i thog rgya mis skad gnyis kyi bar la mgo bde dran 'khrul byed kyi 'dug pas de shes dgos/'das pa'i lo rgyus de 'dra red/da dang 'brel ba'i gnas skabs la bod nangayod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs mang che ba rgya mi'i 'og sdod 'dod rtsa ba nas med pa ha cang gsal po red/ de bzhin rgya mi'i zhi drag gi las byed khongs su yod pa'i bod mi rnams la cha bzhag na'ang re zung ni 'dra mi 'dra'i gnas tshul yong srid pa las/ mang che ba ni dngos 251

gnas so so'i mi rigs kyi zhen khog dang la rgya mi bsam mkhan ha lam med pa red/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir so so'i mi rigs kyi lta ba bzung nas yid gzab byas te sdod dgos pa'i dus stod gcig yin pa las mgo sla po byed pa'i dus tshod min/ tshang mas blo bde po'i ngang nas snying stobs bskyed de nga tsho bod mi rigs yin/ nga tsho chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi rjes 'brangs pa yin/nga tsho lo rgyus yod pa'i mi rigs yin/ 'dzam gling thog bod pa zhes mdzub mo 'dzugs sa dang / rigs brtsi sa yod pa'i mi rigs shig yin bsam pa'i sgobs pa'i thog nas snying stobs zhum pa med pa byed dgos/ da bar hur thag byas pa red/ da dung yang tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/de nas bod mi btsan byol ba 'di rnams kyis da phan lo nyi shu rtsa bdun ring gal che ba dza drag gi gnas tshul dpal 'byor thad so so rang kha rang gso byed thub kyi yod/ 'on kyang da dung dka' ngal yod pa nyung shas yod kyang mang che ba 'grigs nges chags yod/ nga tsho'i gal che shos de shes yon red/ phru gu lo gzhon pa rnams dbyin ji gtso bor gyur pa'i deng dus kyi shes yon thad spyir btang bshad na 'grigs tsam yod/ 'dzam gling thog skad grags yod pa'i mtho rim slob gra de tsho'i nang bod pa'i phru gu brgya phrag kha shas slebs yod/bod du rgya mis slob gso sprad pa'i bod pa'i phru gu 'dzam gling gi mtho rim slob gra mtshan nyid tshang ba de tsho'i nang rdog po gcig mthong rgyu mi 'dug la/ gtong gi yang med pa red/ der brten shes yon thad rgya gar nang legs pa chags 'dug252

de bzhin gdan sa khag gtso bor gyur pa'i ris su ma chad pa'i dgon sde khag gis che chung la ma ltos par bshad gra dang sgrub grwa btsugs te tshang mas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa'i sri zhu gang la gang 'tshams shig sgrub yod/ da lta nga sa bltas na bod nang las 'di khul dbang lung man ngag gi 'chad spel dang / bslab pa slob gnyer gang thad nas legs sgyu yod/ nga tsho btsan byowa ba mi'i lung par slebs nas byas rjes gang la gang 'tshams bzhag yod/ spyir btang nas bshad na chos lugs kyi 'then 'khyer dang / chol kha'i 'then 'khyer phran bu phran bu ni mi'i chos nyid red/ che sa'i thog nas bshad na tshang ma yag thag chod yod/ nga rang tsho tshang mas 'then 'khyer phyogs ris ma byas par gong bu gcig gyur dang mthun po bya rgyu de shin tu gal chen po red/ bod nang la cha bzhag na'ang yag thag chod yod bzo 'dug de snga phan la yin na a mdo khul la cha bzhag na lha sa dang choges kyi jog nas 'brel ba dam po yod pa las/ chab srid thog 'brel ba nyung zhing ha lam 'brel ba med pa lta bu red/ de bzhin khams la cha bzhag na'ang rgya sde bod sde gnyis su phye nas bsdad pa dang / a mdo phal che ba rgya sde lta bu byas nas bsdad pa dang / sa khul kha shas ni khrims mgo rang btsan lta bu byas nas rgya mi'i dbang shugs kyang ma slebs/ 'di nas bod gzhungagi dbang shugs kyang dmigs bsal ma slebs par bsdad pa red/bar lam rgya mis nga tshor sdug po gcig gyur btang ba'i nyer len gyis bod mi yongs rdzogs gangs can zhes pa'i tshig gcig gi 'og dog la 'dril ba'i gnas tshul yag po zhig yong gi 'dug 'di ha cang gal chen po red/ nga 253

tsho mi rigs nang khul 'then 'khyer shog sgril byas na skyon chen po yod/ spyir btang 'dzam gling thog mi ser spel ba'i lam lugs zer ba/ mi rigs gcig gis mi rigs gcig dbang bsgyur byed skabs dbang bsgyur byed stangs gang 'dra byed kyi yod dam zer na/ jobang bsgyur sa'i sa khul jo ma 'cham pa bzos kha bral dum bur btang ste nus pa chung bye song skabs dbang bsgyur byed kyi yod pa red/ rgya mis kyang ha lam de 'dra byed kyi 'dug bod pa nang khul kha bral dum bur btang ste gnas tshul de'i 'og bod bzung rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi yod bzo 'dug der brten bod pa nang khul bsam blo rgya che sa nas btang ste mthun po bya rgyu shin tu gal gnad che bas/ da phan yag thag chod yod pa ltar da dung tshang mas gzab gzab byed dgos/bod nang chos lugs kyi 'then 'khyer sdug pa zhig rtsa ba nas med pa yag po red/ chos dad rang mos kyi gnas tshul slebs pa'i skabs la gzab gzab byed dgos/ bsam med kha shas kyis rang ngos nas chos yag spro zhig ma shes par so so'i 'tsho thabs kyi don la chos bed spyod byas te chos kyi jog nas mang tshogs mgo sgor gtong mkhan de 'dra yong gi med dam snyam pa'i dogs pa 'dugade 'dra byas na shin tu thabs sdug red/ so so'i 'phral sel khe phan gyi don la rtsa ba'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi mthong brlag na yag po rtsa ba nas ma red /'di dang phyi ma spyi dang sger gang du'ang yag po med/ gal srid de 'dra yong ba'i nyen kha yod pa yin na tshang mas khur len nyen 'gog yid gzab byed dgos/ma 'ongs par nga tsho'i gnas tshul bzang du 'gro gi red/ gtso che shos 254

mi dmangs kyi sems shugs yin pas sems shugs yag 11 sku(da na sgrub khag po yin kyang sgrub thub cing / sems shugs med na sgrub sla po zhig yin kyang mi 'grub pa yong srid kyi red/ da phan tshang mas lhag bsam dung las dkar ba dang / sems shugs ri ltar g.yo ba med par bsdad pa red/ da dung yang mu mthud de ltar bya rgyu gal chen po red/ nga rang lus po'i cha nas mi yul rgya gar du sa khad chod nas bsdad yod kyang / bod rgya che'i mi dmangs kyis nga la re ba 'di lta bu byed kyi yod pa de ni nga rang tsho tshe rabs mang por las dang smon lam gyi 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pas ngas nam yang brjed kyi ma red/nga'i mi tshe gang la gang 'tshams kyi ring po sdod thub pa'i re ba dang smon lam rgyag gi yod/ ma shi bar du bod rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi don la bsam blo gtong gi red/ khyed rang tsho blo g.yeng gtan nas byed mi dgos/ gnas skabs shig nga tsho mi'i lung par sdod dgos byung ba'i ring la'ang bod spyi pa dang / bod mi rigs kyi don la sems khur blangs te gang yong ci yong gi thabs shes byed kyi yod/ phyin chad 11da nang gzhis byes mnyam 'a1nams byas nas bkra shis pa dang / skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig tan tan shar gyi red/ nga rang tsho tshang ma bkris lugs legs byas te nga'i mi tshe'i tshe lhag de bod nang bskyal thub kyi red/ tshang ma blo bde po gyis/ nga tsho'i las don 'di dag chung chung min pas don chen 'grub par ngang ring zer ba ltar da lta bar du dka' las de tsam zhi ga brgyab pa red/ da dung tshang mas sems shugs ma chag par hur bskyed byed dgos/deng sang bod nang la phyi rgyal ba lta skor 'gro mkhan mang po yod pa khong 255

mi dmangs kyi sems shugs yin pas sems shugs yag 11 sku(da na sgrub khag po yin kyang sgrub thub cing / sems shugs med na sgrub sla po zhig yin kyang mi 'grub pa yong srid kyi red/ da phan tshang mas lhag bsam dung las dkar ba dang / sems shugs ri ltar g.yo ba med par bsdad pa red/ da dung yang mu mthud de ltar bya rgyu gal chen po red/ nga rang lus po'i cha nas mi yul rgya gar du sa khad chod nas bsdad yod kyang / bod rgya che'i mi dmangs kyis nga la re ba 'di lta bu byed kyi yod pa de ni nga rang tsho tshe rabs mang por las dang smon lam gyi 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pas ngas nam yang brjed kyi ma red/nga'i mi tshe gang la gang 'tshams kyi ring po sdod thub pa'i re ba dang smon lam rgyag gi yod/ ma shi bar du bod rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi don la bsam blo gtong gi red/ khyed rang tsho blo g.yeng gtan nas byed mi dgos/ gnas skabs shig nga tsho mi'i lung par sdod dgos byung ba'i ring la'ang bod spyi pa dang / bod mi rigs kyi don la sems khur blangs te gang yong ci yong gi thabs shes byed kyi yod/ phyin chad 11da nang gzhis byes mnyam 'a1nams byas nas bkra shis pa dang / skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig tan tan shar gyi red/ nga rang tsho tshang ma bkris lugs legs byas te nga'i mi tshe'i tshe lhag de bod nang bskyal thub kyi red/ tshang ma blo bde po gyis/ nga tsho'i las don 'di dag chung chung min pas don chen 'grub par ngang ring zer ba ltar da lta bar du dka' las de tsam zhi ga brgyab pa red/ da dung tshang mas sems shugs ma chag par hur bskyed byed dgos/deng sang bod nang la phyi rgyal ba lta skor 'gro mkhan mang po yod pa khong 255

tshos bden pa'i gnas tshul mthong ste bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul rnams 'dzam gling thog khyab bsgrags byas stabs phan jogs chen po yong gi yod/ khong tsho'i gras bden dpang lta bu chags pa red/ rgya mis skad cha kyal rdzun chen po bshad pa de tsho'i gras la tshur phyogs nas blo gzu bor gnas pa'i mi zhig gis dngos su mthong ba'i gnas tshul khyab spel byed dus nus pa chen po 'dug phyi rgyal gyi mi'i nang la 'dra mi 'dra tan tan yong gi red/ yin na'ang phyi mi bod nang yong ba'i skabs la khong tshor bod pa'i ngos nas rnam 'gyur gsal po bstan dgos/ nga la phyi rgyal gyi mi mang po thug byung / khong tshos zer don/ khong tsho lha sa khul dang / g.yas g.yon grong gseb la 'gro skabs phyi mi khe gtsang bod pa dang thug dus bod pa tshos ha cang dga' po byed kyi 'dugakhong tsho rgya mi mnyam du 'gro skabs bod pa tshos rgya mi la mi dga' ba byas nas rnam 'gyur log 'gro gi 'dug ces bshad byung / phyi rgyal gyi mi kha shas de snga bod la ma 'gro gong bod kyi gnas tshul de tsho rtsa ba nas shes kyi med zer gyi 'dug ma 'ongs par phyi rgyal gyi mi bod la yong ba'i skabs la khyed rang tshos so so'i bsam cho'i nang gi gnas tshul de rnam 'gyur thog nas mtshon thub pa bya rgyu ha cang gal chen po 'dug lhag don phyi rgyal gyi mi kha shas de snga bod la ma bskyod gong dmar spro'i lugs srol la dga' po yod/ lhag par rgya nag gi gsar brje'i thog la dga' po yod/ yin na'ang bod nang thengs gcig gnyis bskyod/ bdun phrag re gnyis bsdad pa'i skabs la bod mir rgya mis sdug po btang 'dug ces kha shas nas mig chu btang ste bshad kyi 'dug de snga rgya mir dga' po yod na'ang / bod 256

nang gi gnas tshul mthong ba'i rjes la bsam blo tshang ma 'gyur song / der brten nga thu ga par yong ba yin zer mkhan kha shas byung / bden pa zhes pa 'di la mtha' gsal rgyu zhig yod pa ltar/ bden pa'i gzi brjid de yod thag chod red/ der brten bod nang phyi rgyal gyi mi yong ba'i skabs la dngos yod gnas tshul rnams gang thub kyis shes pa bzo dgos/ phan thogs 'dug lam sang lam sang grub 'bras chen po zhig thon rgyu khag po yin na'ang / rim pas rim pas des shugs rkyen tan tan thebs kyi red/ rgya mi la cha bzhag na'ang / rgya mi tshang ma sdug chags rtsa ba nas min/khong 'i srid byus 'gro stangs dang / bar lam gyi byed stangs de ha cang sdug chags shig chags te des nga tsho bod pa tsam du ma zad/ rgya mi kho rang tsho yang gnas tshul de'i 'og nas ha cang gi sdug po myangs pa de dngos gnas ya nga ba dang / snying rje ba zhig 'dug rgya mi blo gzu bor gnas pa de 'dra yong ba'i skabs la nga tsho bod pa'i bden don gyi gnas tshul de bshad dgos/ sems nang la 'khon 'dzin byas te rgya mi zhigayin phyin chad sdug pa yin par ngos 'dzin byed mi rung / yin na'ang so so'i bod mi rigs kyi don dag 'di nga tshos rgya mir mi dga' ba byas pa zhig min par so so'i thob thang rtsod pa zhig yin pas de gnas tshul khag khag red/ kha sang spyod 'jug nang la gsungs pa bzhin/rgya mi la ma rgan sems can thams cad ces pa'i brtse zhen de ma brlag pa'i thog nas nga rang tsho'i thob thang de rang don rang gces byas nas rtsod dgos pa 'di la 'gal ba gang yang med/ 257

bar lam bod nang chos dad rang mos phran bu gu yangs byung ba'i skabs la ma ṇi dung sgrub bsags mkhan mang po byung 'dug de yag po red/ rjes su yi rangs yod/ so so yang bsod nams chen po gsog gi red la bod spyi la'ang phan gyi red/ der brten yul tsho yul tsho dang / khyim tshang khag nas las zhor la ma ṇi dung sgrub gsog rgyur da dung shugs bskyed byed thub na phan thogs chen po yod/ de bzhin thub pa'i mtshan sngags dang / slob dpon rin po che'i mtshan sngags/ dmigs brtse ma bcas so so'i khams dang 'tshams pa'i thog nas bsags thub na phan thogs chen po yod/ nga tshos phyogs gcig nas mis thabs shes byed kyi yod pa dang / phyogs gnyis nas bsod nams bsags te de'i mthu rgyas thub pa byung na khyad par chen po yod pa red/ nga blo bde po byas nas sdod kyi yod/ dka' ngal phran bu phran bu ni da phan la'ang byung yod/ da dung yang 'dra mi 'dra yong mdog kha po red kyang / gang yang byed kyi ma red/ khyed rang tsho kha shas 'di nas thad kur log 'gro mkhan yong mdog kha po red/ kha shas 'dir nyin shas bsdad nas thug rgyu yong mdog kha po red/log 'gro mkhan tsho blo bde po byas nas rgyugs/ ma gzhi sems skyo po zhig red/khyed rang tsho so so'i skyes sa dang / lung pa'i nang la log 'gro gi yod na'ang dgra bo'i gzhan dbang du tshud pa'i yul de'i nang la gzhi nas 'gro dgos pa de sems skyo po red/ 'on kyang gang yang byed kyi ma red/ tshang ma blo bde po dang sems skyid po byas te sdod/ tshang mar bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' ྅skor// //258

si༅// phyi lo 198 5 zla 12 tshes 31 nyin rdor gdan gnas 'dzin rgya gar dge slong gi mgron khang du chogs 'du'i sar stsal ba'i bka' slob/tshogs bzhugs grogs po lhan rgyas la zhu rgyur/ de ring nga tsho 'dir yang bskyar nang pa'i mkhas pa dang / chos pa/ dge slong / nga tsho ngo shes pa rtag tu bsam blo'i nang gdong gi rnam 'gyur dran bzhin pa'i grogs po rnying pa rnams thug 'phrad go skabs byung bar ngos rang dga' po byung / thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ khyed rang tsho tshang mas so so'i nyin zhag phrug gcig gi nang la rang nyid kyis yid ches yod pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gus brtse chen wa'i thog nas so so rang nyid kyis nyams len byed rgyu dang / de bzhin lta ba 'di'i thog nas mi mang po zhig la phan thogs ji ltar sgrub thub thabs skor la bsam blo gtong gi yod pa la rjes su yi rangs yod/ khyed rang tsho la dka' ngal chen po yod kyang / yin na'ang sems shugs ma chag par tshogs 'du gra sgrig gnang / mi sna mang po 'dzoms thub pa yag po byung 'dug de ring tshogs 'du 'di'i thog la go bsdur gnang mkhan mang po zhig yong rgyu yin par brten/ go bsdur yag po zhig yong rgyur ngas re ba byed kyi yod/de ring nga tsho mnyam 'dzoms byung ba yin tsang ngos rang gi bsam tshul tshig kha shas shig bshad 'dod byung / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'gro ba sems can thams cad so so'i khams dang mos pa sna tshogs yod par gsungs yod/nang pa rang nyid kyi nang la cha bzhag na yang / bcom ldan 'das kyis mi 'di dang 'dis nga la dad pa byed kyi yod/ 'di la ngas ga re bshad kyang nyan gyi red 259

dgongs te gsungs pa ma yin par/ mi so so'i khams dang 'tshams pa zhig bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' gnang yod/ theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/'gro ba'i don la rtog pa po/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa'i dbang gis nang pa rang nyid kyi nang la yang theg pa sna chogs shig gsungs yod/ phyogs gzhan nas zhus na bcom ldan 'das kyis rang shed ma gnang bar/ mi so so'i khams dang mos pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis brtsi bkur gnang ba'i lta spyod 'di chos lugs tshang ma mthun po yong rgyu'i mthun rkyen gtso bo zhig chags bsdad yod/ nga rang tsho rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la cha bzhag na 'di 'dra'i chos lugs mang po yod/ 'dzam bu gling spyi yongs la mchon na yang de de bzhin gyi lta ba dang grub mtha' ha cang mang po zhig yod par brten/nang pa'i lta tshul 'di gal chen po dang / deng sang gi dus 'dir dngos gnas phan thogs yod pa zhig red/ deng dus 'dzam bu gling 'di'i dngos yod gnas tshul la/ dngos po yar rgyas kyi phongs med kyang / bsam blo yar rgyas kyi thog nas phongs bsdad yod/ bsam blo yar rgyas kyi gzhi rtsa de'i nang la zhal 'debs che zhog chung zhog rgyag mkhan gyi chos pa 'dra mi 'dra de dag mthun po byed rgyu de gal chen po 'dug de nas spyir btang chos lugs phal cher la yong mdog kha po red/ lhag par nang par cha bzhag na/ chos la dad pa byed mkhan rigs gcig gis rgyu mtshan la brtags dpyad byas te dad pa skyes mkhan rigs gcig rigs gzhan gcig rgyu mtshan gting zab po shes/ des drangs pa'i dad pa skyes pa ma yin 260

par spyir btang ston pa rtsa ba chen po red snyam pa tsam gyi thog nas chos la yid ches byed mkhan bcas rigs gnyis yod/ nga rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud la yod pa'i nang pa'i lha khang dang / nang pa'i dgon pa khag de bzhin rgya gar nang khul la yod pa'i nang pa'i sde tshogs de tsho'i nang la nang pa'i lha khang chung chung de gras dang / gsar pa bzhengs mkhan yong gi yod pa red/ de tsho dwang ba 'dren po zhig dang / spus dag po zhig dgos rgyu gal chen po 'dug phan thogs tan tan yod/ nga tsho nang tshag red/ so so'i bsam tshul ga re yod pa de bshad na yag gi red/ nga rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud la yod pa'i dgon pa de tsho'i gras spus dag po yong ba la rang rang so so'i bsam blo'i nang 'di mi tshe skyel sa zhig yin bsam pa'i 'du shes shig ma garke(gas ma byung na shin tu thabs skyo po red/ so so'i don dag yin na yang gtso bo sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / de brgyud nas 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i bde skyid kyi don dag la 'brel ba yod bsam pa'i thog nas bstan pa spyi'i mtshan la dgung 'degs thub pa dang /tshang mar dwang ba 'dren pa yong thabs la dang dod byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug de nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi rtsa ba'i nus pa 11na pa la slob rjodang byas/bsam blo btang / cho'i rnam dpyod kyi thog nas nang pa'i chos la gus brtse slebs pa zhig dang / de nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos pa red/ lhag don nang pa gsar pa tsho yod sar lam ston byed stangs skor sngon ma nas sku zhabs a mi ta gub ta dang / de bzhin sku zhabs ru pa ti li dang bka' mol tshar mang po byung / gang ltar sngon la nang chos kyi snying don de gras shog lhe chung 261

par spyir btang ston pa rtsa ba chen po red snyam pa tsam gyi thog nas chos la yid ches byed mkhan bcas rigs gnyis yod/ nga rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud la yod pa'i nang pa'i lha khang dang / nang pa'i dgon pa khag de bzhin rgya gar nang khul la yod pa'i nang pa'i sde tshogs de tsho'i nang la nang pa'i lha khang chung chung de gras dang / gsar pa bzhengs mkhan yong gi yod pa red/ de tsho dwang ba 'dren po zhig dang / spus dag po zhig dgos rgyu gal chen po 'dug phan thogs tan tan yod/ nga tsho nang tshag red/ so so'i bsam tshul ga re yod pa de bshad na yag gi red/ nga rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud la yod pa'i dgon pa de tsho'i gras spus dag po yong ba la rang rang so so'i bsam blo'i nang 'di mi tshe skyel sa zhig yin bsam pa'i 'du shes shig ma garke(gas ma byung na shin tu thabs skyo po red/ so so'i don dag yin na yang gtso bo sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / de brgyud nas 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i bde skyid kyi don dag la 'brel ba yod bsam pa'i thog nas bstan pa spyi'i mtshan la dgung 'degs thub pa dang /tshang mar dwang ba 'dren pa yong thabs la dang dod byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug de nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi rtsa ba'i nus pa 11na pa la slob rjodang byas/bsam blo btang / cho'i rnam dpyod kyi thog nas nang pa'i chos la gus brtse slebs pa zhig dang / de nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos pa red/ lhag don nang pa gsar pa tsho yod sar lam ston byed stangs skor sngon ma nas sku zhabs a mi ta gub ta dang / de bzhin sku zhabs ru pa ti li dang bka' mol tshar mang po byung / gang ltar sngon la nang chos kyi snying don de gras shog lhe chung 261

chung zhig las ma byung kyang bzos/ de 'dra'i thog nas skyabs 'aX'i tshig bton pa tsam ma yin par/ bud+dha dharmā/ saṅgha zer ba de gang 'dra zhig yin pa de'i bslab bya gatherga bo gang dang gang yin pa/ nga nang pa yin snyam pa'i 'du shes skyes pa tsam ma yin par / dngos gnas drang gnas nang pa yin na nyin zhag phrug gcig gi bsam blo'i nang la nang pa'i bslab bya gang dran dgos pa dang / blang dor gang zhig byed dgos pa/ des rang nyid la phan thogs gang yod pa rnams shes pa bzo dgos kyi 'dug de 'dra byas na phan thogs dngos gnas yong gi red/de nas spyir btang 'dzam bu gling 'di sgang la deng sang tshan rig gi thog nas mis brtag dpyad byed pa'i nus shugs che ru phyin pa'i skabs la brtag dpyad byas nas ra 'phrod byung ba rnams khas len byed rgyu las sla po zhig dang /brtag dpyad byas nas ra 'phrod ma byung ba'i rigs la the tshom che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ nang pa'i ngos nas tshan rig dgra red ces rtsa ba nas zer gyi med/dper na nang pa'i chos kyi nang la rton pa bzhi gsungs yod/ gzhal bya'i gnas shin tu lkog gyur rigs 'ga' zhig la thad /ra rig pas lam seng sgrub khag po 'dra tan tan yong gi red/ spyir btang gtso che ba'am/ gal che ba ni rig pa 'ba' zhig gis brtag dpyad byed dgos/ rig pas dngos yod gnas tshul la brtag dpyad byas te rig pa dang 'gal ba zhig yong gi yod na/ bcom/ ldan 'das kyi bka' zhig yin na'ang de drang don la bkral rgyu red ma gtogs/ rig pa dang 'gal bzhin du 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' red ces brjod na mi 262

'grigs/ de lta bu'i gzhi rtsa'i nang pa'i bsam blo'i 'khyer so de tshan rig gi 'gro stangs dang / tshan rig pa'i bsam blo'i 'khyer so dang phal cher 'dra po yod/ dper na/ nga rang tsho'i dus rabs 'di dang / dus rabs sngon ma'i nang la byung ba'i tshan rig pa chen wab de tsho dang / rigs gcig mkhas pa tshos so so'i 'dod mos yod pa'i shes bya gang rung la dmigs bsal gyi slob sbyong dang las ka byed kyi yod na yang mi so sor gzhi rtsa'i goms gshis dang / bag chags mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas rigs kha shas la/ so so'i tshan rig gi brtag dpyad byed pa de'i nang la blo gzu bor gnas pa'i thog nas brtag dpyad byed kyi yod na yang / tshad nges can zhig ma gtogs ha cang guyangs po zhig yong ba la gzhi rtsa so so'i bsam blo gtong phyogs dang / goms gshis kyi cha nas de la shugs rkyen gcig thebs kyi med dam bsam pa dran gyi 'dug nang pa'i tshan rig pa zhig byung ba yin na/ tan tan gu yangs ba byed thub pa zhig phal cher yong srid pa red/ yang nang pas nang pa'i tshan rig pa zhig thon dgos bshad pa 'di nang pa srung skyob kyi don dag la bshad pa ma red/ngos rang gis mthong tshul la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la dngos po yar rgyas phyin pa 'dis dngos gnas drang gnas nga rang tsho mi'i 'dod pa tshim pa zhig yong gi yod na nga tsho chos pa cho kha rog bsdad na 'grigs pa red/ nga rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ dngos po yar rgyas phyin yod kyang / yin na'ang mi la dngangs skrag chen po zhig yod/ spyir btang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la ral 'byor gyi dka' ngal sel thabs la dpal 'byor skor gyi 'char gzhi 'dra 263

bkod/ dpal 'byor yar rgyas btang ba'i thog nas mi'i bde skyid 'tshol thabs byed kyi yod/ nga rang tsho lung pa yar rgyas ma phyin gong la dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal yod pa dang / mi la dza drag gi sdug bsngal yod pa yin dus dza drag gi sdug bsngal de sel rgyu'i don dag la dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs 'dre mi 'dra la brtag dpyad byed rgyu dang / dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs nges can zhig brgyud nasari dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong rgyu de mi'i dka' sdug sel ba'i thabs lam drag shos shig yin pa red/ yin na'ang rnam pa thams cad du des 'grigs pa red dam zer na rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ nga tshos zhib 'jug dang bsam blo zhig btang ba yin na/ phal cher deng sang nga rang tsho'i slob sbyong gi lam lugs de'i nang rtsa ba'i nga rang tsho mi'i bsam blo'i lam ston byed phyogs de'i thog la nor 'khrul zhig med dam bsam gyi 'dug sgrung bshad lha(la zhig sku nga / mi lnga la bgo sha rgyag rgyu zhig sku(da pa la grangs ka rgyag mkhan khos rang nyid brjed de mi gzhan bzhi bgrangs pa'i sgrung yod pa bzhin/ nga tshos mi'i bde sdug skor la bsam blo btang ste 'bad brtson chen po byed kyi yod pa/ dper na/ mi'i bde sdug dang 'brel ba yod pa'i phyi'i lus kyi gnas tshul la zhib cing phra ba'i sgo nas brtsad gcod dang / brtag dpyad byas te gtan la phab kyi yod kyang /rtsa ba'i bde sdug myong mkhan nang rnam par shes pa kho zur du lhag te de la do snang khyon nas med par lus bsdad kyi yod/ rdo don snying po shes bya phyi yi /la rdzas sam/ rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi lus sam phyi yi dngos po gcig dang /de dang 'brel ba'i nang gi rnam par shes pa zer ba gnyis yod pa red/ de ni 264

nang pa dang / chos lugs mang po zhig gis bshad kyi yod/ don dngos po'i gnas stod la bde sdug gi rkyen byed mkhan phyi'i rdzas shig yod pa bzhin du/ de longs spyod mkhan nang gi rnam par shes pa zer ba zhig yod pa red/ nang gi rnam par shes pa la dga' sdug gi tshor ba sprod mkhan phyi'i rdzas de la brtag dpyad byas/ bzo bcos rgyab pa de bzhin du nang gi rnam par shes pa de bde sdug spyod mkhan gtso che shos yin stabs nang gi rnam par shes pa'i skor la yang de'i chod kyis brtag dpyad byas/ bsam blo btang / nyams zhib byed dgos pa de gal chen po zhig mthong gi 'dug gang ltar yang snying cha 'jog byed stangs dang brtag dpyad byed stangs de phyi'i dngos po ga cig po ma yin par/ nang gi rnam par shes pa la yang cha 'jog dang / brtag dpyad 'dra mtshungs byas te de gnyis zung 'brel gyi thog nas brtag dpyad bya rgyu yod pa zhig dang / slob sbyong bya rgyu yod pa zhig byung na/ tan tan mi'i bsam blo'i 'gro stangs la phan thogs yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug sngon gyi mkhas pa mang po zhig gis nang rnam par shes pa'i skor la brtag dpyad mang po gnang nas 'grel bshad skyon yod/ de gcig pu skyar zlos lta bur phyin pa yin na yang tshad longs yong gi yod med mi shes/ sngon gyi mkhas pa tshos brtag dpyad byas te gsungs pa de dang / deng sang tshan rig pas phyi'i yo byad la brten nas mi'i bsam blo'i 'gro stangs skor la brtag dpyad byed pa'i rig gnas shig yod pa de gnyis zung 'brel gyi thog nas nga tshos las ka byed rgyu gal chen po zhig mthong gi 'dug des na phyi'i dngos po dang / nang gi rnam par shes pa gnyis kur do snang byed dgos/265

rwade/ she ༷/rdo /rdo/tho ri ༷༷/dokhyerno rwarngod rwarngo|nganang rnam par sa pa ga ga pur bsam btang sta/ da sa yar rgyas la do snang ma byas par bsdad na/ nga tsho mu gos shi rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas gtong rgyu de yang ha cang gal chen po yin/ yang phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas gtong rgyu gcig pur mgo 'khor te nang gi rnam par shes pa bdag med du lus pa yin na/ nga sbyor dza drag dang / dngangs skrag rnyog khra tsha po 'di lta bu yod pa rnams sel mi thub/ thabs shes yang dag pa ni/ phyi yi dngos po dang / nang gi rnam par shes pa gnyis mar do snang gcig gyur byas te yar rgyas gtong dgos/ zhu rgyu de ga yin/ thugs rje che/ zhes tsho// //266

si༅// phyi lo 1986 zla 5 tshes 17 nyin ho lan ḍar yu rob khul gnas sdod bod mi mjal bcar ba rnams la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da lam nga 'di phyogs lung pa kha shas la yong don gtso bo tshan rig pa dang nang pa'i chos kyi dbar dngos po'i 'gro stangs dang / nang sems kyi 'gro stangs skor go sdur byed pa'i don du yin/ 'di la ngas gnad 'gag cig mthong gi 'dug spyir btang dus rabs bco brgyad bcu dgu'i nang tshan rig yar rgyas shugs chen phyin pa'i skabs la nang chos kyi bsam blo dang / phyi'i dngos po la brten pa'i tshan rig gi rig gnas gnyis 11 de kha bral nas phyin pa'i bzo 'dug tshan rig yar rgyas phyin nas mi'i nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang kha yod lag yod kyi mthun rkyen mang po zhig bsgrubs te phan thogs chen po yong gi yod/ nang chos kyi bslab bya de ngo thog sdug rus brgyab ste nyams len byed mkhan zhig yin na ni gnas tshul tha dad re da ma gtogs/ spyir btang nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang la lam sang mig mthong lag zin gyi mthun rkyen sgrub thub kyi med pa lta bu zhig tu mthong gi yod pa red/ phyi'i dngos thob de yar rgyas shugs chen po phyin/ nang gi bsam blo yar rgyas ma phyin par bsdad 'dug phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas ji tsam song yang mi ni mi rang la bsdad stabs/ nang gi chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis rkyen pas las ngan pa bsags nas bkra ma shis pa rgyun mi chad par yong ba de chos nyid red/ de 'dra'i dka' ngal 'phrad dus dngos wa'i yar rgyas gcig pus phan thogs med/ nang gi chags sdang rmongs gsum ma dul bar yod pa tsam du ma zad/ da dung shugs che ru song ba'i skabs la dngos po'i yar rgyas 267

de chags sdang gi zhabs phyi'i bzo lta bu chags te mi la nyen kha gsar pa dang /dka' ngal gsar pa/ dngangs skrag gsar pa bcas yong gi yod pa red/ dus rabs nyi shu pa 'di'i nang ga ler ga ler tshane rig rig gnas de tshad mtho ru dang / gting zab tu song ba'i skabs la gzhi nas mi'i gzhi rtsa'i bsam blo dang phran bu thag nye ru 'gro ba lta bu chags yong gi 'dug deng sang mi 'ga' shas phyi dngos po'i yar rgyas la thang chad pa dang / kha shas ni phyi dngos po'i yar rgyas der bsun snang slebs yod pa'i bzo 'dug de 'dra'i thog nas nang chos la tshur gzhi nas do snang gi bsam blo phran bu slebs kyi 'duga'adzam gling thog gi chos lugs spyi dang / lhag par nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad rgyu skusgod /gzhi'i rnam gzhag dang / lam gyi rnam gzhag 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag gzhi dngos po'i gnas tshul shod dus phyi 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag dang / nang bcud sems can gyi rnam gzhag bcud kyi sems can la cha bzhag na'ang lus kyi rnam gzhag dang / sems kyi rnam gzhag bcas mang po zhig yod/ tshan rig gi thog nas brtag dpyad byed yul phyi dngos po'i gnas tshul de dang / chos kyi thog 'grel bshad byed pa'i gnas tshul de gnyis 'grel bshad rgyag sa'i yul cig rang chags yod pa red/ de bzhin nang skyes bu'i lus kyi rnam gzhag dang /lus de la brten pa'i sems phra rags kyi rnam gzhag brtag dpyad byed sa yang yul gcig rang chags yod/shes dang ma shes gnas tshul tha dad red/ brtag dpyad byed stangs 268

thad gcig gis bsam 〈 bed spyod btang nas rgyu mtshan dang bsam blo rang gi thog nas brtag dpyad byed pa dang / gcig gis phyi'i yo byad sna tshogs dang / rdzas dang dngos po la brten nas brtag dpyad byed pa bcas byed stangs mi 'dra ba ma gtogs/ rtsa ba brtag dpyad byed sa'i yul gcig pa red/gang ltar rtsa ba'i 'grel bshad rgyag sa'i yul de gcig gyur yin dus da phan nga rang gi mthong tshul la rigs kha shas nga tsho nang pa'i rig gzhung nas 'grel bshad byed stangs de las deng sang tshan rig pa tshos 'grel bshad brgyab pa de zhib tshags pa dang / legs pa yod pa'i bzo 'dug dpe ra na/ rdul phra rab kyi gnas stangs shod dus ma gzhi nga tsho'i mngon pa gong 'og nang la rdul phran dang / rdul phra rab kyi rnam gzhag skor bshad yod/ yin na'ang deng sang tshan rig pa tshos bshad pa de la tos na zhib tshags po rang med pa'i bzo 'dugaphyi'i 'grel bshad rgyag stangs de tshos tan tan nga tshor phan thogs yod pa lta bu 'dus/ de bzhin mig gis mthong rgyu yod pa'i lus kyi bkod pa'i rnam gzhag la spyir btang rtsa'i rnam gzhag mang po zhig shod kyi yod/ rtsa'i bkod pa dang /lhag par lus kyi rtsa phran dang / lus kyi rdul phra rab kyi gnas stangs skor la deng sang tshan rig pa tshos shod rgyu mang ba dang / zhib cha che ba 'dug tshan rig pa tshos 'grel bshad brgyab pa'i nang nas nga tshos tshur bslab bya len dgos pa dang / shes dgos pa mang po zhig 'dugayang / mthong rgyu med pa'i sems kyi rnam gzhag dang / rlung gi rnam gzhag skor la tshan rig pa tsho mgo 'thoms pa ma ga)rtegs shod rgyu gang yang skusad 269

pa ma red/ nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung gi nang nas 'grel bshad mang po bya rgyu yod pa dang / nyams myong dngos su bsags pa'i grub 'bras mthong rgyu yod pa zhig dngos su chags yong dus nang pa'i chos kyi thog nas ha cang mang po shod thub kyi 'dug de yang chos kyi 'du shes min par spyir btang shes bya rig pa'i 'du shes kyi thog nas bltas te mnyam du slob sbyong byed thub pa byung na/ tan tan phan tshun tshang mar phan thogs chen 11 spongang gi yod pa zhig mthong gi 'dug dngos su shes bya rig pa'i rnam gzhag gi don la de gnyis mnyam bsdeb byas nas phan thogs yod pa dang / brgyud nas phyi dngos po'i rnam gzhag ltar nang sems kyi rnam gzhag dang / de dang 'brel ba'i skyes bu'am/ gang zag zer ba'i rnam gzhag cig shod rgyu yod pa de la do snang byung ba yin na yang phan thogs yong rgyu red/ dper na/ ji tsam phyi dngos po'i gnas tshul mang ba shes pa'i tshod kyis de'i thog la bsam blo gtong rgyu shugs che ru 'gro gi red/de bzhin nang sems kyi rnam gzhag thog la do snang byas nas shes thub pa byung na/ der bsam blo gtong rgyu zhig shugs kyis yong dus tan tan mi'i rtsa ba'i bsam sbru'i 'khyer sor phan thogs yong gi med dam snyam pa dran gyi 'dugad phan dngos po'i yar rgyas 'ba' zhig thog blo phyogs nas bsdad pa red/ phyi'i dngos po zhes bshad pa de la shes pa med la/ tshor ba dang 'du shes kyang med par brten bde sdug gi tshor ba'i skad cha yong thabs med/ nang rnam shes dang 'brel ba'i skad cha shod dus gang zag dang 'brel ba'i thog nas shod dgos par brten bde sdug dang / bzang ngan gyi tshor ba yong gi red/ de dang 'brel ba'i 270

thog nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i nang da bar 'gyur ba mang po zhig 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo de nang gi tshor ba dang / 'du shes de tsho'i thog nas 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod pa red/ dngos po gcig pur mgo 'khor nas bsdad na mi'i rin thang brlag pa'i bzo 'dra po dang / mi'i ngo bo ngos ma zin pa'i thog nas nyen kha zhig slebs kyi 'dugadaper na brtse ba zhes pa de gang nas yong gi yod dam zhe na/ bde sdug gi tshor ba'i gzhi rtsa'i thog nas brtse ba dang / byams pa slebs kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ bde sdug gi tshor ba'i rnam gzhag ma shes pa dang / de la do snang ma byas pa yin na byams pa dang brtse ba'i rin thang brlag zin pa red/ bde sdug gi tshor ba myong ni myong gi yod kyang / de la do snang rtsa ba nas med par snang chung du lhag sdod kyi yod pa red/ phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas dang / nang sems kyi yar rgyas gnyis 11 de mnyam du 'gro thub pa'i don la tshan rig pa tshos phyi dngos wa'i rnam gzhag btsal 'tshol byas pa'i nyams myong mthong tshul de dang /nga rang sto nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas 'grel bshad byed pa'i gnas tshul gnyis mnyam du byung ba yin na tan tan phan thogs yod pa mthong gi 'dugachos kyi thog nas bshad pa yin na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos nang 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu mang shos yod pa red/ chos lugs gzhan dag la gzhi'i rnam gzhag zhib tshags po dang / rgyas po de tsam rang yod pa ma red/ dad pa kho na'i thog nas 'gro mkhan phyogs gcig dang / dad pa rtsa ba nas khas mi lenapar brtag dpyad kho na'i thog la 'gro mkhan tshan rig pa'i 'gro stangs de 271

phyogs gcig chags 'duganang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs ni brtag dpyad byed dgos pa dang / brtag dpyad dang 'brel ba'i thog nas dad pa yang byed rgyu yod pa zhig yin dus nang pa'i chos ni de gnyis kyi dkyil la bsdad 'dug rgyu mtshan dang brtag dpyad byed pa kho na'i thog nas 'gro mkhan de'i phyogs la phyi dngos po'i rnam gzhag dang / lus kyi rnam gzhag la 'brel ba chen po yod pa zhig dang / yang spyir btang chos lugs pa tsho'i nang nas nga rang tsho mis mthong ba'i gnas tshul de las 'das pa'i nyams myong khyad par ba de 'dra skye rgyu yod pa'i gnas tshul mang spro zhig yod par yid ches byed kyi yod pa bzhin/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas kyang gzhi'i gnas tshul de dang 'brel ba'i lam gyi rnam gzhag nyams myong mang spro zhig yong rgyu yod pa dang / de la brten pa'i 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag da lta nga tsho tha mal pa'i bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul mang po zhig yod pa de dang yang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin stabs/gong gsal khag gnyis kyi bar der nang pa'i chos kyis ha lam zam pa lta bu'i 'brel mthud byas te tshan rig pa dang 'brel ba byas/ de yang chos phyogs kyi rnam pa min par spyir btang shes yon gyi 'du shes dang / gnas tshul gsar pa shes thabs don gnyer gyi kun slong 'khyer gyi yod/ phyogs gcig nas nga rang sger gyi ngos nas kyang de skor shes 'dod chen po yod/kha sa 'jar man la dge bshes lags khong tsho yang yod pa'i thog gtso bo rdzas kyi dngos po'i 'gro stangs skor go bsdur byung / gnad 'gag chen po 272

yod bzo 'dug kha sang o si ṭi ri yar yang tshan rig pa kha shas dang shes pa'i skor la skad cha byung / nga rang tsho'i bye brag smra ba'i lugs nas bshad pa'i shes pa rnam med du 'dod pa'i lugs dang / mdo sde pa yan chad kyi shes pa rnam bcas su 'dod pa bcas rnam med rnam bcas skor la go bsdur byung / khong tsho phal cher shes pa rnam bcas de rang 'dod kyi yod pa'am/ yang na de dang 'dra ba zhig 'dod kyi yod pa'i ba zo 'dugade nas dbang wa'i shes pa dang / yid kyi shes pa'i skor dper na/ mig gi shes pa lta bu/ mig gi dbang rten khog pa/ mig dbang la brten nas skye ba/ dper na/ sngo 'dzin gyis sngon po 'o snyam du mi 'dzin/ sngon po 'o snyam du 'dzin mkhan de rtog pa dang 'brel nas yid blo la sbyar ba gcig mig dbang la brten pa'i mig gi dbang po 'am shes pa de nga'i snang ba la kho rang mthong gi yod pa'i snang ba zhig shar yong giyod/ de min pa lta bu zhig bshad byung / dper na/ sngon po lta bu mig gi shes pas 'jal yong dus/ yul sngon po rnam pa bltas stobs kyis yul can shes pa de yul sngon po'i rnam rig tu skyes pa'i sgo nas rigs rgyu gcig dang / yang / 'di 'di red/ 'di bzang po red/ 'di ngan pa red bsam pa gcig yid blo la med par 'dod pa gcig yin na yang / sngon po tsam la 'dzin pa ni mig gi shes pa kho na'i steng nas shes kyi yod pa'i bzo 'dra po zhig ma red dam/kha sa o si ṭi ri yar klad pa'i rdul phran skor shod mkhan tshan rig pa zhig dang nga gnyis skad cha byung / phal cher klad pa la yar 'dres mkhan gcig273

ma gzhi klad pa'i nang gsos la/ dbang shes kyi las ka byedamakhan klad pa'i sde tshan gcig dang / yid shes kyi sde tshanagacig de gnyis po 'brel ba yod kyi red/ gsal po mi shes/ zhib tshags wa'i skad cha ni ma byung / ma gzhi nga tsho'i gzhung gi nang la yang / phyi'i mig rkyen 'phrad/ bdag rkyen 'phrad pa yin na yang / de ma thag rkyen ma 'phrad na shes pa skye thub kyi yod pa ma red/de ma thag rkyen gyi gnas tshul thog nas klad pa dang 'brel yong ba de 'dra zhig gi thog nas shod rgyu yong mdog kha po med dam/ yin na yang / nga la dogs pa gsar pa zhig byung / gang ltar da lta tha snyad sbyar stangs kyis tshig gi go brda 'phrod la ma 'phrod cig yong gi yod pa dang / dus chod kyang yod pa ma red/rim pas nga tsho tan tan go bsdur byed dgos kyi 'dugang chos kyang blo gzu bor gnas pa'i thog nas gnas tshul gsar pa shes thabs la do stang gi sgo nas sbyang gi yin na tan tan yag po yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug phar yang nang pa'i chos nas 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu yong gi red/ tshur la yang sgo rgyab nas ma bzhag par dngos gnas shes bya gsar pa zhig shes 'dod kyis don gnyer byas nas go bsdur byed thub na tan tan dge mtshan yod pa'i bzo 'dra po mthong byung / 'di rnams da res 'di phyogs yong ba'i rgyu mtshan de 'dra zhig gi thog nas byung ba red/ 'di la gnad 'gag cig 'dugade nas spyir btang chos lugs khag tsho'i mi sna tsho thug 'phrad byas/'dzam bu gling 'dir chos 'dra min gyi thog nas mi mang spyi la zhabs 'degs sgrub thub pa bya rgyu de dngos gnas dus babs kyi las 'gan zhig chags yod 274

pa dang / thun mong gi thog nas 'bad rtsol byed thub pa byung na yag po red/bar lam chos lugs phan tshun mthun sgril yag tu phyin nas/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig la 'brel ba yag tu song ba de shin tu yag po red/ 'di rnams ngas khyed rang tshor 'phros bshad yin/ de nas nga rang tsho bod pa'i skor/ deng sang nga rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal red/ bar lam phyi lo chig stong dgu brgya bdun cu don dgu dang / brgyad bcu'i mtshams nas da bar 'gyur ba mang po zhig 'gro gi yod pa red/ 'di'i nang bod la 'gro myong mkhan ga tshod yod/ lag pa rkyongs dang gsungs par/mi gnyis kyis lag pa brkyangs/gang ltar khyed rang tsho rwaped la 'gro myong mkhan yang yod pa red la/ tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ 'gyur ba mang po zhig 'gro gi yod pa red/ bod nang gi 'gyur ba'i gnas stangs de ga 'dra zhig gi thog la phyin yod dam zer na/ to gos kyi gnas stangs de la 'gyur ba phyin yod/ de yag po red/ sngon ma yin na mi ltogs rid shi ba mang po zhig yong gi yod kyang / da cha gnas tshul de yod pa ma red/ rjes su yi rangs 'os pa zhig red/ de bzhin de snga yin na/bod yig slob sbyong byed rgyur shin tu mthong chung dang / khyad gsod byas nas sa cha kha shas la bod yig slob sbyong byed rgyu rtsa ba nas bkag 'gog byed pa de 'dra byung yod pa red/ de la yang 'gyur ba phran bu phyin nas deng sang bod yig thog lag len ji ma ji bzhin 'khel thub kyi yod min la ma ltos par/ rtsa ba'i srid byus la bod yig thog do snang byed dgos pa zhig shod kyi yod pa de yag 275

po red/de bzhin bod kyi rig gzhung spyi dang / nang pa'i chos la yin na yang chos dad rang mos zhes spyir btang ma ṇi bgrang chog pa dang / phyag 'tshal bskor sbyong byas chog pa/ lha khang nang mchod mjal du 'gro ba/ lha khang dang / dgon pa de tsho'i gras la nyams gso phran bu 'dra byed pa/ gra pa'i grangs ka shin tu nyung nyung yin kyang / kha shas dgon pa'i nang bsdad chog pa'i chog mchan sprad yod pa red/ de rnams mthun phyogs kyi 'gyur ba yin pas yag po red/ yin na yang / nga rang tsho bod pa'i don dag de 'phral sel lto gos kyi sems khral med tsam zhig dang / 'phral sel phyag 'tshal bskor sbyong byed thub tsam zhig gis 'grig gi yod dam zer na/ des 'grigs kyi ma red/nga tsho bod pa'i don dag de phyogs gcig nas rgyal rabs lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i don gnad cig chags yod pa dang / gal che shos shig da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul la'ang bod nang gi mi rnams rgya mis ngo gdong khro 'dzum ston stangs 'dra min gang 'dra byas kyang / gang ltar bod dang rgya zhes tha dad so sor phye nas/ nga tsho bod pa zer ba zhig dang / khong tsho rgya mi zer ba zhig byas nas bsdad yod pa'i rang bzhin de bkrus nas dag rgyu dang / 'phyis nas zub rgyu yod pa zhig ma red/ dngos yod gnas tshul la rgya dang / bod ces tha dang red/ rgya dang bod zer ba de bar lam gsar du chags pa ma yin par/ de snga bod du mi'i srid pa chags pa nas bzung rgya dang / bod ces tha dad so sgo gzhis chags nas bsdad yod pa red/276

dus rabs bdun pa brgyad pa'i nang rgya nag dang bod dang / rgya gar dang bod dbar 'brel ba thog mar chags pa red/ rgya gar dang / bod kyi 'brel ba de chos phyogs dang / rig gnas kyi 'brel ba yin pa dang / spyir btang bshad na/ bla ma dang / slob ma nang bzhin gyi 'brel ba bzang po zhig byung yod pa red/ gcig byas na/ skabs der rgya gar phal cher rgyal phran sil bu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bod la nyen kha ma byung ba yin gyi red/ gang ltar rgya gar dang / bod kyi 'brel ba de bzang po zhig gi thog la bsdad yod pa red/sngon ma nga lha sang yod dus/ bde skyid gling gar sdod mkhan rgya gar gyi sku tshab dpon rigs gsar pa brje len byas pa khong nga thug 'phrad du yong dus/ yin gcig min gcig lha sar yod pa'i rgya mi'i phyi srid yan lag las khungs kyi mi gcig mnyam du yong gi red/ de dus rgya mis ngo so 'khyer nas rgya nag dang / rgya gar gnyis da lta bar du dmag khyon nas rgyag myong yod pa ma red/ rgya gar grogs po'i rgyal khab yag po gcig red ces bshad song /dngos 'brel byas na rgya mis ngo so 'khyer thabs yod pa ma red/ nga tsho bod ni rgya nag dang / rgya gar gnyis kyi dbar bsdad yod pas/ rgya gar dang rgya nag sa 'dres 'khel med par brten dmag rgyag pa'i gtam thag de gas chod rngu/sa dmag rgyag don yod pa ma red/ yin na'ang rgya mis bod rgya khongs yin pa'i 'du shes kyis ngo so cha tshang 'khyer nas/ nga tsho rgya nag rgyal khab dang / rgya gar rgyal khab nam yang dmag rgyag myong yod pa ma red zer song / nga bgad 277

mo shor byung / gang ltar bod dang / rgya gar gnyis kyi 'brel ba de dngos gnas ya rabs kyi 'brel ba zhig gi thog la bsdad yod pa red/shar tshudags rgya nag rgyal khab dang / nga bo da rgyal khab gnyis kyi 'brel ba de skabs re mthun 11 byas pa dang / skabs re 'khrug pa rgyag pa'i gnas tshul byung yod pa'i rkyen gyis mtha' ma lha sa gtsug lag khang gi mdun la da lta 'ang mig gis dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa dang / dpar brgyab na'ang rgyag rgyu yod pa'i rdo ring gcig btsugs yod/ rdo ring de'i thog rgya bod gnyis kyi chings/ yig bzhag pa'i yi ge brkos pa'i nang / rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul/ na skyid ces pa'i bod yig rgya yig gnyis ka yod/ da dung de'i rgya skad nang leng bostodi zhes/ rgyal khab gnyis yin pa'i tshig de rang 'khod 'dugang snur gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun zer ba de zhog skabs rgya mis sa gnas srid gzhung dang / dbus gzhung zer ba dang / de chings yig ma reng gros mthun red ces shod kyi 'dug rdo ring thog la yod pa'i rgya yig nang /(leng thor+shardo )zer ba bod skad la bsgyur na rgyal khab tha dad so so yin pa gsal thag chod ngos 'dzin byas yod pa rnod/ gzhi rtsa de'i thog nas rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul na skyid ces pa'i sngar gyi nga tsho'i bsam tshul de byung ba red/ de la 'gyur ba 'gro don mi 'dugadeng skabs bod nang lto gos phran bu drag tu phyin pa dang / nyen kha phran bu chung du phyin pa gcig pus nga tsho 'grigs pa ma red/ de ngos 'dzin gas/la po byed dgos pa gal chen po 'dug kha shas kyis gnas tshul bsam blo rgya chen 278

mo shor byung / gang ltar bod dang / rgya gar gnyis kyi 'brel ba de dngos gnas ya rabs kyi 'brel ba zhig gi thog la bsdad yod pa red/shar tshudags rgya nag rgyal khab dang / nga bo da rgyal khab gnyis kyi 'brel ba de skabs re mthun 11 byas pa dang / skabs re 'khrug pa rgyag pa'i gnas tshul byung yod pa'i rkyen gyis mtha' ma lha sa gtsug lag khang gi mdun la da lta 'ang mig gis dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa dang / dpar brgyab na'ang rgyag rgyu yod pa'i rdo ring gcig btsugs yod/ rdo ring de'i thog rgya bod gnyis kyi chings/ yig bzhag pa'i yi ge brkos pa'i nang / rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul/ na skyid ces pa'i bod yig rgya yig gnyis ka yod/ da dung de'i rgya skad nang leng bostodi zhes/ rgyal khab gnyis yin pa'i tshig de rang 'khod 'dugang snur gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun zer ba de zhog skabs rgya mis sa gnas srid gzhung dang / dbus gzhung zer ba dang / de chings yig ma reng gros mthun red ces shod kyi 'dug rdo ring thog la yod pa'i rgya yig nang /(leng thor+shardo )zer ba bod skad la bsgyur na rgyal khab tha dad so so yin pa gsal thag chod ngos 'dzin byas yod pa rnod/ gzhi rtsa de'i thog nas rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul na skyid ces pa'i sngar gyi nga tsho'i bsam tshul de byung ba red/ de la 'gyur ba 'gro don mi 'dugadeng skabs bod nang lto gos phran bu drag tu phyin pa dang / nyen kha phran bu chung du phyin pa gcig pus nga tsho 'grigs pa ma red/ de ngos 'dzin gas/la po byed dgos pa gal chen po 'dug kha shas kyis gnas tshul bsam blo rgya chen 278

po ma 'khor bar/ 'phral sel lto gos sems khral rgyag ma dgos pa phran bu'i dag tu phyin pa'i skabs la da skyid thag chod/ a'u tsam 'dug zer ba'i bzo 'dra po shod mkhan yong gi 'dug kha shas bal yul sa mtshams la slebs dus/krung go'o sa mtshams zer mkhan yang 'dug de 'dra zer mi rung / rgya mis krung go'o zhes pa'i rgya mi'i ming tshig de bod pa'i rna bar rtag par blugs te gang 'tshams nas krung go ther ba'i rgya skad kyi tshig de bod spyod ma byas rang byas la thug ste/ bod skad nang krung go'o zer ba'i tshig deya tshugs brgyab nas bcug zhing gi 'dugadon snying bod dang / rgya zhes tha dad so so yin pa zhig srid pa chags pa'i skabs nas yod pas nga rang sbyor da lta'i dus tshod la lto gos phran bu drag tu phyin pa dang / srid byus phran bu'i gu yangs su phyin pa des 'grigs pa'i bsam blo 'khor na nor 'khrul chen po red/bod pa'i spyi tshogs de mi yi spyi tshogs shig yin pa las dud 'ablo'i spyi tshogs min/ dud 'gro'i spyi tshogs shig yin na lto grod khog 'grangs pa zhig dang / tsha grang gi sdug bsngal med tsam zhig byung na lhod lhod byas te nyal sdod kyi red/ nga phyo 'gro ba mi red/ 'gro ba mi la to grod pa gang dang / gos lus po drod tsam zhig yod pa tsam gyis mi 'grigs par/ rang dbang dgos kyi yod pa red/ mi la rang dbang yod na mi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi nus pa cha tshang ba zhig bed spyod byed thub kyi red/ mi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi nus pa cha tshang zhig bed spyod byed thub na/ mi'i rang bzhin cha tshang ba zhig byung ba red/ lus 279

po mi yin na yang gzhan gyis bkod pa gang bshad gcig pu ma gtogs rang gis bsam blo gtong ba'i go skabs med na/ mi'i mtshan nyid ma tshang ba lta bu chags pa red/ nga tsho mi yin pas mi'i rang dbang dgos kyi yod pa red/rang dbang zer ba de shin tu rtsa ba chen po yin/ da lta bod nang yod pa'i bod pa spyi dang / lhag par gzhon skyes tshor chab srid kyi rang dbang la sems shugs dang / do snang chen po 'dug nga rang tsho mi'i lung par yod mkhan tsho yin na'ang de bzhin byed dgos/ lhag par bod pa'i don dag 'di srid don dang / rang dbang gi gnad don la thug pa yin dus/ bod nang gi mi tshos kyang sems shugs chen po byed kyi yod pa dang / lhag don lo gzhon pa tsho'i nang nas sems shugs chen po byed pa/ dper na/ nye char dus 'khor dbang chen gyi yas mas la ྅rtod nas gsar du 'byor ba'i gzhon nu'i gras rgya nag gi slob gra che khag la 'gro myong mkhan/ a mdo'i phru gu dang / de bzhin bod kyi sa khul gzhan dag nas yong ba'i phru gu slob sbyong gang la gang 'tshams thob pa dang / rgya mi'i las khungs nang las ka byed myong ba de 'dra kha shas thug 'phrad byung / kho tsho dngos gnas drang gnas kyi sems shugs chen po 'duga.a mdo'i phru gu gcig 'dug kho yang dpe mi srid pa'i gyong po 'dusakhos kho rang chos la dad pa med/ bod kyi nang la bod mi rgan pa lo drug cu bdun cu'i nang slebs pa tshor chos byung na gzhan la do snang rtsa ba nas byed kyi mi 'dus de nor 'khrul red/ bod mi rigs la chab srid kyi rang dbang dgos pa red ma gtogs chos gcig pus 'grigs kyi yod pa ma red/ chab srid kyi rang dbang 280

brlags pa'i nyin mon der/ bod kyi sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams 'gro gi yod pa red/ dper na/ 1959 lor bod nang chab srid kyi thog la 'gyur ba che na po zhig phyin pa red/ chab srid kyi 'gyur ba phyin rjes dgon pa rnams gnas thub song ngam/ zhes khos de 'dra zer gyi 'duga.a mdo ba slob phrug des chos byed dgon pa de rnams chab srid la 'gyur ba phyin dus bsdad thub thabs med pa red/ der brten chos phyogs sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa ba de chab srid kyi rang dbang la thug yod/ bod pa tshos chos la dad pa byed dgos pa shes/ dad pa byed yul rtsa ba'i chos gnas pa'i rkyen rtsa de bod mi'i rang dbang la thug pa de ngos 'dzin gsal po byed thub kyi mi 'dugade shin tu thabs skyo )/ red ces dang / kho rang rdo rje gdan la slebs nas kyang rma thong tshul de 'dra rang byung / bod pa tshos chos la dad pa chen po byed kyi 'dugabo rang phran bu yid thang chad pa'i bzo 'dra po gcig byung zer gyi 'dugagang ltar khos lo drug cu bdun cu'i nang la slebs pa'i bod pa tshos chos kyi thog la bsam blo 'khor ba ma gtogs chab srid kyi thog la bsam blo gto nga gi mi 'dug yo sum cu bzhi bcu'i nang slebs pa'i bod pa tshos chab srid thog la do snang phran bu byed kyi 'dug yin na'i ldeng gi mi 'dug slob gra'i nang la yod pa'i phru gu lo nyi shu yas mas slebs pa tsho la chab srid kyi bsam blo mang po zhig 'khor yong gi 'dug ces bshad byung /kho rang chos la dad pa byed ma byed de gnas tshul tha dad dang / so so'i don dag red/ rtsa ba nga tshos chab srid thog la do snang byed dgos pa de tan 281

tan red/ nga tshos rgya mi la ma dga' ba byas nas bod rang dbang dgos zhes shod kyi yod pa ma red/ nga rang tshor dngos gnas kyi thob thangayod pa zhig dang /nga rang sto skyid pa zhig byung na bsam nas nga tshor rang dbang dgos zer gyi yo da pa red/ nga tshos rgya mir mi dga' ba'i rgyu mtshan thog nas nga tsho rgya mi'i 'og sdod kyi min zer gyi med/ dngos gnas kha zhe gnyis med bshad na skyid pa rgya mi la yang dgos/ mi gcig pa red/ nga tsho bod pa skyid po dgos pa nang bzhin rgya mi yang skyid po los dgos/ yin na yang rgya mi'i ngos nas ran la ma ran dang 'jon la ma 'jon gyis bod du dbang sgyur byas nas sdod dus rgya mi kho rang sto yang skyid po med pa dang / bod pa ni spyod wa de bas kyang ga la yod/ phan tshun gnyis sdug red/ byas tsang nga rang tshos da lta rang dbang gi thob thang rtsod len byed pa 'di so so'i thob thong rtsod pa ma gtogs/ nga tshos khong khro dang /zhe sdang / nga rgyal gyi bsam blo'i thog nas rtsod kyi yod pa ma red/ drang bden gyi rgyu mtshan thog nas nga tshos h+pho ba thang rtsod kyi yod/nga rang tsho phyi rgyal la sdod mkhan bod pa tshos da phan tshang mas sems shugs chen pos hur thag byas pa red/ da dung yin na yang nges par du sems shugs bskyed nas shugs rgyag rgyu gal chen po red/da gin rang gis lab pa bzhin/ 1985 lo khyed rang tshos 'dir tshogs pa btsugs pa yin zer ba ltar yag po reng/ de bzhin rgya mi'i dpon po kra'o tse yung 'di khul yong ba'i skabs dang / gsum bcu'i dus dran sogs la khyed rang tshos gang thub thub kyi bod pa'i bden don khyab bsgrags kyi las 282

'gul byas pa ngas kyang shes kyi yod/ dngos gnas gnas tshul yag po red/sde cho gal chen po 'dug nga tsho phyi rgyal la sdod mkhan bod pa sto yin na'ang rung / nang la sdod mkhan bod pa tsho yin na'ang rung / gang ltar bod mi'i rang gi thob thang rtsod pa'i bden don 'thab rtsod skor 'dzam gling 'di'i snang la yang yang gsal ston thub pa dang / shes thub pa bya rgyu gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho bod pa sger so so'i ngos nas ngo shes pa gcig gnyis las med na'ang de la do snang byas te/ go skabs yong dus bod pa'i gnas tshul 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu de ha cang gal chen po 'dug shes song ngam/sngon ma yin na bod nang la rgya mis sdug sbyong chen po btang skabs 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu las sla 11 red/ rgya mis bod pa gsod kyi 'dug bod pa togs rid shi gi 'dug bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung gi rten gzhi tshang ma rtsa med bzo gi 'dug ces lab rgyu las sla po dang / 'grel bshad rgyag bde po red/da cha de 'gyur nas gnas tshul gsar pa zhig tu slebs dus 'grel bshad gting zab tsam dang / rgyu mtshan mang tsam zhig bgrang na ma gtogs lam seng don dag de gsal po bzo thub pa yong gi ma red/ byas tsang nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod kyi ngo bo de zab tu dang / rnyog phra tsha ru phyin yod pa red/ de la dpag pa'i nga chos 'grel bshad zab tu dang / zhib tshags su btang nas skad cha shod rgyu gal chen po 'dug dper na/ rgya mi'i ngos nas skad cha'i tshig gi dang por bod yar rgyas chen po btang yod zer gyi yod pa red/ yar rgyas btang ba red /lam khag bzos yod pa red/ yin na yang dngos gnas kyi thob thang ngam/ khe 283

phan de rgya mi kho rang tshor mang ba ma gtogs bod par yod pa ma red/de bzhin bod kyi 'dzugs bskrun thog la cha mtshon na'ang rgya mi'i sgor mo dung phyur sum cu lhag tsam btang ba yin kyang / grub 'bras mthong rgyu med pa de rnams yar klung gtsang po'i nang g.yugs pa red pas zhes/ hu'u ya'o pang bod la slebs dus de 'dra bshad 'dug bar lam gyi yig cha'i nang la ther 'bum chung ba bdun/ dung phyur bdun cu lhag tsam btang yod zer gyi yod pa red/ nga chos mgo 'tshos po zhig ma byas na/ rgya mis 'gro song de 'dra btang ba yin zhes lab dus chen po btang ba'i bzo 'dra zhig yod pa red de/ dngos yod gnas tshul gang 'dra red zer na/ dung phyur bdun cu lhag tsam gyi 'gro song btang yod na'ang gtso che shos bod nang rgya dmag phon 'bor chen po zhig bsdad yod pa dang / 'khor lam khag bzos pa/ rgya mi'i las byed phon chen po zhig bsdad yod pa bcas kyi 'gro song rnams de'i nang nas phyin yod pa red/ bod mi mang la dmigs pa yin zhes rgya nag nas dngos rigs dbor gyi yod pa nas/ dper na/ rgya nag la bzos pa'i rkang sga ril dang /ja dam/ /ma pā li sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dngos po legs pa rnams la hab thob sus rgyag gi yod pa red zer na/ rgya mi'i las byed pa de tshos rgyag gi yod pa red/ sngon dang por/ kho rang tsho las byed pa rnams gcig gis gcig la ngo shes btang ste/ 'brel ba'i ltag sgo brgyud nas rgya mi las byed kho rang tshos nang khul nyo tshong byas nas rgya nag la mar dbor 'gro gi yod pa red/bskor ba gcig brgyab nas khe phan rgya mi kho rang cho'i lag par blugs pa ma 284

gtogs bod par rag gi mi 'dug rgya nag nas tshur 'gro song btang ba yin zer ba de rnams 'gro song rgya mi de rnams la 'gro gi 'dugang rang tsho'i bod kyi rang byung jon skyes gras/ kong po rgyud dang / khams kyi lto rgyud/ 'bar ma dang yun nan gyi bar dang / shar rgyud zi khron la thug pa'i bar gyi nags tshal de tsho 'dzam bu gling gi nags tshal che shos gras la ngos 'dzin byed kyi 'dug de bzhin bod dbus khul lho phyogs rong mtshams rnams la nags tshal shin tu khyon che yod/ gro mo nas stod bar gyi rong mtshams phal cher la nags tshal mang po zhig yod/ sngar phan gcod bregs phog ma myong ba'i bod kyi srid pa'i nags tshal de dag rtsa med bzos nas shing cha rgya nag la ṭag 'khor dang / chu thog 'or 'dren gang 'dra zhig byas 'dug gam/ rgya nag nang la shing cha'i mthun rkyen dkon po yin stabs bod nas rgya nag tu phyir log byed mkhan rgya mi tshos pang leb kyi sgam chen bzos nas de'i nang la sgam gcig dang / de'i nang la sgam gcig de'i nang la yang skam gcig byas nas gang ltar ṭag gis 'khyogs tshad ga tshod dbor 'gro gi 'dugabod kyi sku gsung thugs rten dang / dgon pa gtor bshig byas pa rnams rtsis brgyab pa yin na/ yongs su grags pa'i dgon pa lha khang gtor bshig byas pa'i dngos po rgya nag la dbor ba de tsho smos ci dgos/ mdor na khyim tshang so so'i sku gsung thugs rten khongs nas 'jim pa las bzos pa'i sku rnams phan thogs med par brtsis nas lud la brgyab pa ma gtogs/ de min gser dngul zangs lcags kyi sku gsung thugs rten yongs rdzogs rgya nag la dbor 'dug285

dper na 1982 lo nang / bar skabs bod kyi rig dngos 'thor gyar rgya nag khul slebs pa'i lhag bsdad rnams bod la phyir sprod bya rgyur rtsis len byed mkhan gtong dgos zhes rgya mi'i bshad pa ltar/ sku zhabs ri 'bur deng sang rgya gar la slebs yod pa khong de dus lha sa'i chos tshogs kyi las byed pa'i khongs nas rgya nag la bod kyi sku brnyan rtsis len byed par bskyod skabs/ pe cing gi nye skor khang rnying zhig nang bod nas rgya nag la dbor ba'i sku brnyan sna tshogs lug rgyur spungs nas bzhag pa'i nang nas ra mo che jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku stod de rnyed pa red/ jo bo'i sku smad de gra bzhi'i nye skor zhig nas rnyed de lha sar yod mus red/ nga rang tsho'i rten gtso 'di gzhan dang 'dra gi yang ma red la/ las dang smon lam gyi thog nas stabs yag po zhig 'khel nas sku stod de rnyed 'dug de min gzhan dag rnams hrang tad sogs rgya nag sa khul gzhan dag la yang dbor yod pa red/ da lta ngas grangs ka lam seng shod thub kyi mi 'dug ma gtogs/ bod nas yong mkhan tshor ṭon stong phrag kha shas kyi gnas tshul shod rgyu 'dug kha shas hong kong brgyud nas btsongs pa'i skad cha yang 'dug de rnams phar bzhag mi tshang sger so so'i nang gi rgyan cha mdzub dkris yan rgya nag la 'khyer 'dugabar lam rgya gar nasa.a mdo khul la 'gro mkhana.a mdo ba gcig dang skad cha byung / khong tsho'i lung par de snga yin na mi tshang re re'i nang la dang dod byed sa rag gi skyogs dang / mdong mo rag shan ma dang / dngul shan ma/ zangs kyi chu ra ma bcas yin pas mi tshang so sor de dag med pa med/286

kho rang gnyen 'phrad la bskyod skabs rag skyogs rdog po gcig tsam yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug tshang ma rgya mis dbor tshar 'dug zer/ de dang de yis mtshon pa'i bod kyi snod bcud yongs rdzogs rgya mis dbang nas bsdad yod dus de dag la rin thang phab na tan tan sgor mo dung phyur bdun cu las ldab mang pos brgal gyi red ma gtogs chad kyi ma red/ rgya mis 11da par rogs byas pa yin zhes tshur ngo so btang nas bshad pa las/ phar rgya mis gang dang gang 'khyer ba rnams shod kyi med pa red/ de nga tshos shes dgos kyi 'dugade bzhin bod nang chos dad rang mos sprad yod zer gyi yod kyang / nang rngu sangs rgyas pa'i chos zer ba 'di/ tso1 ma ṇi ma ṇi zer ba gcig pus 'grig gi yod pa ma red/ nga rang tshos shes gsal bzhin chos la lo nas lo sbrel slob sbyong byas/ 'chad nyan gyi thog nas lung gi bstan pa 'dzin skyong byed dgos pa dang /de sgrub pa nyams len byas pa'i thog rtogs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong byed dgos pa bcas/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong byed stangs de 'dra red ma gtogs ma ṇi bgrang rgyu dang / bskor ba rgyag rgyu yod tsam zhig gis 'grig gi yod pa ma red/ de lhag go skabs rgya mis sprod kyi mi 'dug a mdo khul dang sa cha kha shas la 11da pa rang nyid kyis u tshugs brgyab nas cesag mchan yod min la ma tos par slob gnyer dang / 'chad spel phran bu byed kyi yod pa red/ lha sa'i gdan sa gsum nas dga' ldan gyi gnas tshul ni rbad de tha dad red/ se ra dang / 'bras spungs gnyis la mdun gyi sge khung rnams bsdad yod kyang / rgyab kyi khang pa tshang ma gyang gog red/ bar lam gra pa gsar zhugs 287

phran bu yong gi yod kyang / de tshor dngos gnas gzhung chen shes thub pa'i slob gnyer byed pa'i dus tshod mi 'dug kha shas la gza' 'khor gcig nang rtsod pa chu tshod gnyis tsam yod pa dang / kha shas la nya stong brgyad gsum la rtsod pa chu tshod re zung tsam yod tshod 'dug gang ltar nga tsho rgya gar la btsan byol du bsdad yod kyang slob gnyer bsdur na rgya gar nang la legs pa 'dug rtsa ba rgya mis chos de dug nang bzhin la brtsis nas phan thogs med par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa yin dus/ dug khyab spel gtong gi yang ma red la/ gtong 'dod kyang yod pa ma red/ dgon khag nyams gso byas pa de rnams ni 'grems ston khang gi 'du shes ma gtogs/ dngos gnas bshad sgrub gnyis kyi thog nas bstan pa 'dzin thub pa'i bsti gnas chags thub rgyu shin tu khag po yod/da lta rgya mis gu yangs kyi srid byus zer ba zhig shod kyi yod kyang / de dngos gnas bod par sha tsha ba dang / phugs la 'jog bzo yod pa bzo rgyu'i bsam tshul ma red/ 'dzam bu gling phyi la yin na'ang rung / bod pa nang khul la yin na'ang rung / mgo bskor gtong ba'i thabs shes shig tan tan chags bsdad yod/ gnad don de nga tsho tsam min par/ nye char rang bod dang rgya nag nas yong pa gong du bshad pa'i slob phrug de tsho'i gras dang / de dang de 'dra'i rgya rigs slob phrug de tshos kyang shod kyi 'dugargya nag nang la srid byus gu yangs yod lugs zer na'ang / gu yangs gtong sa de dpal 'byor sde tshan nang gi srid byus red ma gtogs/ srid don gyi sde tshan nang gu yangs phyin pa ma red/ dpal 'byor gyi sde tshan nang srid 288

byus gu yangs gtong ba de yang srid don gyi thad dam du gtong ba dang / srid dbang brtan du gtong ba'i don dag la dpal 'byor sde tshan nang rang dbang sprad pa zhig red ma togs/ mang tshogs la sha tsha'i sgo nas dpal 'byor sde tshan nang rang dbang sprad pa ma red ces rgya mi kho rang tsho'i kha nas shod kyi 'dugargya nag nang gi gnas tshul de 'dra zhig yin na/ bod ni de bas kyang smos ci dgos/ sa khul khag so sor sdod mkhan bod pa tshos de dag shes pa byed dgos/tshags par 'god mkhan smos ci/ dper na/ rgya mi zhig thug kyang de tshor gong gsal rnams shod thub na yag po red/ rgya mis tshur 'ur shob shod kyi yod pa red/ 'gro song tan tan btang yod kyi red/ yin na'ang nga tshor nyams chags ha cang chen po phyin yod pa de rnams tshur slog dgos/de bzhin dper na/ bod mi sa ya drug gi nang nas rgya mi slebs pa'i rkyen byas nas bod mi dus min shi chad phyin pa'i grangs ka 1983 phan chad la nga tshor bsdoms h+pho slebs pa der mi 'bum bcu gnyis tsam shi 'dug mi'i srog de tsam phyin pa red/ mi'i srog re la rgya mi'i ngos nas stong bsgrub dgos byung na des rin thang ga stod zin gyi red/ nga tsho ༷ da kyi stod bcud nyams chag phyin pa rnams la bsam blo btang na ther 'bum chung ba bdun cu ma tshad/ ther 'bum che ba brgya phrag stong phrag btang yang ha las dgos don med/ rtsa ba bod rgya mi la ma bdag pa zhig ham pa byas nas zin bsdad pa zhig la ngo snun de 'dra gtong ba'i spobs pa bral ba red/ dmar shed tsha thag chod nas de 'dra shod kyi yod pa ma gtogs dngos gnas byas na de 'dra shod shes kyi ma red/ gnad 289

don de sto tshang mas shes dgos kyi 'dug mdo don snying po nga tsho'i rtsod pa de chab srid dang 'brel ba'i gnas tshul gting zab po zhig yin pas/ de la dpag pa'i rtsod pa'i ngo bo yang rgya che ba zhig dang / rnam grangs mang ba zhig gi sgo nas rtsod dgos pa zhig red/ de tsho tshang mas nges pa byas nas hur thag byed dgos/bod mi'i bden don 'di bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs kyi 'gan red ma gtogs nga mi gcig la 'khri ba dang / yang na mi nyung shas la 'khri ba zhig ma red/ lhag par bod nang 'gyur ba phran bu phyin pa'i skabs mi tsho'i mthong snang la phal cher bod pa tsho 'dod pa khengs yod kyi red bsam pa'i rnam rtog 'char rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa red/ de 'dra'i skabs la 7rgyal ba rin po che gcig pus skad brgyab nas bsdad na 'ga' zhig gi mthong snang la bod mi tsho 'dong pa khengs kyi yod pa red de/ 7rgyal ba rin po che gcig nas dge slong yin zhes 'dod chungacungag shes che mdog kha po dang / phyogs gcig nas 'dod pa rtsa ba nas tshim rgyu mi 'dug bsam pa dran rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa red/bod don rtsod rgyu de 7rgyal ba rin po che'i don dag ma red/ 7rgyal ba rin po che 'dod pa khengs ma khengs kyi skad cha ma red/ bod mi'i 'dod pa khengs ma khengs kyi gnas tshul yin pas/ thosad mi spyi bo gnam bstan mchis so cog gi kha nas nga tsho bod pa'i don dag la nad theg gi mi 'dug nga tsho lto grod khog rgyags tsam gyi gnas tshul zhig min/ nga tsho dngos gnas rang dbang gi don dag yin/ zhes zer gyi yod/snga bar phyi gsum du phyi rgyal gyi stobs shugs bod du slebs skabs la 290

ṣ+ka pa nam yang skyid po byung da/ sngar sog po'i dbang shugs slebs skabs kyang bod pas dga' po byas med/ dper na/ lo rgyus kyi yig cha kha shas nang 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas sog po'i rgyal 11 dang 'brel ba byed skabs sog por bstun mkhas chen po gnang yod/ de ni mi gnang ka med byung ba'i gnas tshul yin pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bod la phyag bris gnang ba'i nang gsal po 'khod 'dug hor gyi rigs de ha cang gdug rtsub che zhing ya nga snying rje med pa zhig 'dug na/ de la mkhas po dang bstun mkhas byas na ma gtogs nga tsho nyams chags chen 11 'bes rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug ces gsungs pa las/ sku(ga 11 zhwa dga' po byas te bzhugs pa zhig min/ phyis su man ju'i shugs bod la slebs skabs kyang don dam yin rung min rung man ju gong mas bod pa'i chos la dad pa yod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan par brten/ bod pa tshos sbyin bdag yag po gcig rag song bsam nas re ba bcol ba dang / skad cha dmar po bshad na bod kyi chos byed bla ma tshos man ju gong ma sbyin bdag chags rogs byas na de las yag pa mi 'dug snyam nas sprel lad 'khrab kyi yod pa red/bcom ldan 'das kyis nga tsho gra par phu thung gyon mi cho ga pa dang / rgyan cha btags mi chog gsungs yod/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs tshos bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i bcas pa de las kyang / rgya nag gong mas tā go tse g.yog pa de la dga' ba byas te gyon pa red/ de rnams nga tshos nor ba dang / byab bskyal ba red/ yin na'ang dus skabs de dus man ju 'am/gang ltar dbang shugs ldan pa'i gong ma de tshos bod kyi chos la rgyab skyor byed 291

kyi yod pa dang / bod kyi chos dang mthun pa'i rkyen du 'gro gi yod pa zhig la ngos 'dzin byas te brtsi bkur byed kyi yod pa las/ bod man ju gong ma'i chab 'bangs la gtogs pa zhig dang / bod rgya nag gi cha shas sam/ mnga' 'og la ngos 'dzin byas nas 'brel ba byas yod pa ma red/ rgya/ hor/ bod zhes tha dad so sor ngos 'dzin gsal po yod pa'i thog nas mchod yon sbyin bdag gi 'du shes bzung ba'i 'brel ba byas yod la/ byab kyang bskyal yod/gal srid bod pa'i bsam khra'i rang bzhin la bod rgya 'og yin pa'i bsam tsā zhig yod pa yin na/ rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi blo la rgya mi zhes lab dus lam sang tha dad yin pa'i 'du shes de 'char gyi ma red/ bod pa'i ming tshig gi nang la bod rgya thun mong la khyab pa'i tshig gcig yod dgos tshod kyang rtsa ba nas mi 'dug gang ltar rgya bod ces tha dad so so yin pa dang / de yang srid don gyi rangabazhin ldan pa zhig red/ nga tshos srid don zhes snang ba skyid po'i ngang nas thob thang rtsod pa zhig nam yang min/ der gnad 'gag cig yod/ nga tsho rgya mi mnyam du bsdad na 'grigs nges 'thus nges shig yod bzhin du nga tshos thob thang rtsod pa zhig yin na lkug pa u tshugs yin 'gro/ de yang ma red /dngos yod gnas tshul gyi rgyu mtshan zhig yod/ de snga nas rgya mi'i khongs la tshud de rgya mis dbang sgyur byas pa'i sa khul/ dper na/ nga skye sa'i a mdo khul la cha bzhag na deng sang yul mi bod pa a mdo las rgya mi mang ba chags yod/ 1983 lor ngas mtsho sngon sa khul gyi rgya yig gsar shog cig mthong byung / de'i nang kho rang tshos mi 'bor bsdoms tho bkod pa ltar byas na sa 292

khyal der bod pa grangs 'bum bdun lhag tsam zhig dang / rgya mi grangs 'bum nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dugang skye sa'i mtsho sngon sa khul de bod pa'i sa cha red/ mtsho sngon zhes ming de ga ra nga nga tsho bod pa'i ming red/ bod ming de rgya skad la bslar te ching tad ces btags pa red ma gtogs/ rgya mi'i ching had zer bsru ming zhig yod nas nga chos bod pa'i skad la mtsho sngon zhes bsgyur ba zhig rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ sngar chos rgyal tsho'i skabs nas bzung ste d+metsho sngon gyi sa khul de rnams bod rigs kyi sa cha bsnyon med cig byas te phyi so dang / nang so zhes phyi nang gi so blta mkhan la bod kyi cesas rgyal tshos blon po btang nas de snubawa mi brgyud da lta yang phyi so sde pa dang / nang so sde pa zhes shod rgyu 'dug yod rgyun gcig la de khul gyi a mdo ba rnams bod dbus 'phan po khul nas yong ba red ces shod kyi 'dug skabs de'i chos rgyal dza() dus la ru shog ru shog byas nas g.yas ru/ g.yon ru/ dbus ru zhes lung tshan so so nas dmag dpung bsdus pa de tsho mar phyin nas gzhis chags te bsdad pa'i chos rgyal skabs kyi bod rigs bsnyon med chags yod/ de rnams la chab srid kyi rang dbang gang yang med par bsdad pa'i 'bras bu la so so'i lung pa'i nang la mi gzhan dag mang ba chags sku(da/'dzam gling thog rgya mi mi 'bor chen po yod pa yongs su grags pa tshang mas shes gsal red/ rgya rigs de dang po bod kyi rma chu rgya thang du babs pa'i chu chen rgya skad hong gī (gtsang po ser po )zer ba'i rgyud la chags yod 'dug293

de rim pas mi rigs 'phel rgyas chen po phyin pa dang / lto gos grung po/ khyab gdal 'gro shugs chen po zhig chags nas deng sang / dper na/ a mi ri ka dang / rgya gar la cha bzhag na sa cha mang po zhig la rgya mi'i grong sde zer ba de 'dra yod/ ga sa ga la rgya mi slebs 'dug rtsa ba ni so so'i lto gos mgo grung po dang / 'jon po byas pa yag po red/ lhag par so so'i rig gzhung zin nas bsdad pa de rjes su yi rangs mngon par bstod 'os pa red/ yin na'ang de 'dra'i gnas tshul thog nas sa gsar pa'i thog la rkang pa brkyangs ste sa chen po ham bzung byed kyi 'dug rgya mi'i rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul de 'dra zhig gi 'og nas yul mir chab srid kyi rang dbang med par rgya mi'i khongs su bsdad na/ nam zhig bod ces mdzub mo 'dzugs sa med pa zhig chags rgyu yin pa zur bltas leb mthong red/ der brten nga tshos snang ba skyid po byas nas bod rang btsan byed kyi yin lab pa zhig ma yin par/ dngos gnas bod mi rigs zhes pa rig gzhung sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i mi rigs shig 'tsho dang ma 'tsho'i gnad don la thug yod/ de red 'dug gam/mi 'dug gnad don de rnams so so'i blo la rtogs pa byas nas de dang 'brel ba'i thog nas chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ngas bshad pa'i skad cha rnams stong bshad lta bu chags/ khyed rang tsho yang chu tshod gcig tsam ring skad cha mang po zhig go/ de tshar nas sems la bsam rgyu dran rgyu gang yang med par bsdad na cho yod pa ma red/ ngas lab pa rnams khyed rang tsho'i lag par yod pa'i sgra 'dzin 'phrul 'khor nang gsal 294

po tshud yod na 'grigs pa red/ de med na don gcod kyi sa nas bshus te/khyed rang tsho mi re ngo res yang yang nyan te sems la nges pa byed dgos/nga ྾ 'thab rtsod kyi rang bzhin de gnad che ru dang / kha bde ru gtong dgos pa red/ sngon ma yin na mi bsad kyi 'dug gtor bcom byed kyi 'dug ces lab na de las lhag pa'i tshig mang po shod dgos mi 'dug deng sang gtor bcom ni byed kyi med/ mu gos ni shi gi med/ bod yig ni bslabs chog gi byedud/ ma ṇi ni bgrang chog gi yod/ rgya mis 'gro song mang po zhig ni gtong gi yod pa red/ da bod par gang gis 'grig mi 'dug gam zer na/ nga chos ma 'grigs pa rnams shod dgos/nga tsho mi'i lung par yod pa'i bod pa tshos da phan so so'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa de zin nas yag thag chod yod/ da dung yang da ngos gnas so so'i mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod las 'gan chen po zhig nga tsho'i mjing par 'khur yod pa'i dus tshod 'dir/ don med so so'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa brlag 'gro ba'i gnas tshul byung na yag po rtsa ba nas min/ da phan yang nga tsho bod pa yin snyam pa'i 'du shes ma brlag pa'i thog nas so so'i rang gshis bzung ste bsdad yod/ dper na/ khyed rang tsho'i nang phyi rgyal mi rigs dang gnyen sgrig byas pa re zung yong gi yod kyang / so so'i 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi rtsa ba yin pas blo mthun pa'i thog nas gnas tshul de chags pa red/ yin na'ang mang che ba bod rigs gtsang ma byas nas bsdad yod/ phyi rgyal mi rigs dang gnyen sgrig byas pa tsho yang bod pa'i lta ba dang / goms gshis nang tshur slebs thub pa'i bsam blo btang 295
