po tshud yod na 'grigs pa red/ de med na don gcod kyi sa nas bshus te/khyed rang tsho mi re ngo res yang yang nyan te sems la nges pa byed dgos/nga ྾ 'thab rtsod kyi rang bzhin de gnad che ru dang / kha bde ru gtong dgos pa red/ sngon ma yin na mi bsad kyi 'dug gtor bcom byed kyi 'dug ces lab na de las lhag pa'i tshig mang po shod dgos mi 'dug deng sang gtor bcom ni byed kyi med/ mu gos ni shi gi med/ bod yig ni bslabs chog gi byedud/ ma ṇi ni bgrang chog gi yod/ rgya mis 'gro song mang po zhig ni gtong gi yod pa red/ da bod par gang gis 'grig mi 'dug gam zer na/ nga chos ma 'grigs pa rnams shod dgos/nga tsho mi'i lung par yod pa'i bod pa tshos da phan so so'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa de zin nas yag thag chod yod/ da dung yang da ngos gnas so so'i mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod las 'gan chen po zhig nga tsho'i mjing par 'khur yod pa'i dus tshod 'dir/ don med so so'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa brlag 'gro ba'i gnas tshul byung na yag po rtsa ba nas min/ da phan yang nga tsho bod pa yin snyam pa'i 'du shes ma brlag pa'i thog nas so so'i rang gshis bzung ste bsdad yod/ dper na/ khyed rang tsho'i nang phyi rgyal mi rigs dang gnyen sgrig byas pa re zung yong gi yod kyang / so so'i 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi rtsa ba yin pas blo mthun pa'i thog nas gnas tshul de chags pa red/ yin na'ang mang che ba bod rigs gtsang ma byas nas bsdad yod/ phyi rgyal mi rigs dang gnyen sgrig byas pa tsho yang bod pa'i lta ba dang / goms gshis nang tshur slebs thub pa'i bsam blo btang 295

na des ma 'thus pa gang yang mi 'dug deng sang phyi rgyal mgo se'i nang bod pa'i rig gzhung la do snang byed mkhan mang po yod pas 'grig gi 'dug khyad par gang yang mi 'dugaphyi rgyal gyi mi dang gnyen sgrig byas pa'i 'bras bur so so phyi rgyal gyi mi lta bu zhig la bsgyur ba yin na phangs po red/ so so bod pa'i dri ma de ma brlag pa bya dgos/ dī'o so'iphru gu dang / grogs bza' zla tshos bod pa'i chos byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mtha' gcig tu med kyang / bod pa'i rig gzhung la do snang yod pa zhig dang / bod spyi pa'i don dag la tshur sha tsha yod pa zhig byas na yag po red/ khyed rang tsho skyag gnong byas nas ngo tsha kha skyengs byed dgos don med/ so so'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa zin rgyu de gal chen wared/ gzhan dag shod yag med/ mjug tu ma ṇi'i lung zhig 'don gyi yin/ zhes ljags lung bka' drin stsal/yang / de mjug bka' stsal don/ rang gis las bsdoms nang tshogs pa btsugs skor bshad pa der dga' po byung / nga tshor de 'dra zhig dgos spyi 'dug bod mi kha 'thor byas nas sdod sa tshor tshogs pa zhig byung ba yin na phan tshun 'brel ba byed sa dang / gnas tshul shod sa zhig chags nas gnad 'gag chen po 'dug bar lam yo rob khul bod pa yod sa phal mo che la bod pa'i tshogs pa btsugs te phan tshun 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa yag po jed/ sgrig 'dzugs zhes pa 'di gal chen po red/ de dbang yod gtong rgyu'i don dag ma red/ mi'i spyi tshogs nang thun mong gi nus pa 'don pa la sgrig 'dzugs shig 296

yod na phan thogs chen po yod pa red/ sgrig 'dzugs med na mi sger so so la lhag bsam skusnad kyang de gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa thon mi thub pa yong gi 'dug der brten sgrig 'dzugs btsugs pa de yag po byung 'dugang tsho rgya gar la cha bzhag na 'ang rtsa ba bod gzhung zhes sgrig 'dzugs shig chags yod dus rgya gar nang yin na'ang red/ bod mi sa khul gang du yod kyang tshang mas mdzub mo 'dzugs sa dang / 'brel ba byed sa gzugs gzhi'i rtsa rgyus 'dra po chags yod/ gzugs por rtsa rgyud med na lus kyi yan lag cha tshang ji+o5ོda kyang dum bur song ste phan thogs kyi ma red/ dpe debazhin nga tsho'i lus kyi/ yan lag gi cha shas lta bu rgya gar dang / a mi ri ka/ nyi hong / ni'u dzi lan ḍa/ o si ṭa'i li ya sogs 'dzam gling yul khag gang sa la bod pa kha gram ste bsdad yod pa tshos phan tshun grog skud lta bus mthud 'brel byed sa nga rang tsho spyi pa'i bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa des phan thogs chen po yong gi 'dugabod gzhung ni dngos gnas kha zhe gnyis med kyis mang gtso'i thog 'gro gi yod/ chol kha dang / chos lugs/ mdor na bon dang bcas pa la dbye ba med pa'i spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig tshugs yod/ rang bzhin gyi ngo bo de gal chen po red la/ bzang po zhig kyang chags yod/ yang las ka byed mkhan gyi thog nas 'grigs ma 'grigs dang / 'thus sgo tshang ma tshang sna tshogs yong gi red/ de 'dra yong skabs las byed pa mi 'di dang 'di zhes bya bas 'grig gi mi 'dug ces skyon brjod byed dgos/ nam rgyun ngas rtag par shod 297

pa bzhin 7rgyal ba rin 11 ches 'grig gi mi 'dug ces lab na 'grigs pa red/ming 'bod byas nas dngos gnas rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / khungs skyel rgyu yod pa zhig shod rgyu yod pa yin na yag po red/ skabs re khungs ma 'khyol ba yong gi 'dug skad char bdag po brgyab ste brda 'ded gtong mkhan ma byung ba'i ring la 'ur shob mang thag chod bshad/ brda 'ded gtong mkhan yong skabs bsam byung zer ba'i baXb de 'dra shod dgos byung na so ngo tsha rogs ma gtogs/cho gang yang mi 'dugami'i spyi tshogs nang la bsdad yod dus kha lheb lheb byed yag nyes kyis rkyen pas yag 'dug nyes 'dug zer ba phran bu yong rgyu'i nyen kha yod pas//dus dus la chorags 'du 'tshogs te tshang mas spyi pa'i don la lhag bsam 'khyer nas 'grigs ma 'grigs kyi thog la phran bu go tshul dang mthong tshul 'dra byung sku(da na skabs 'phral la gsal po bzos na de yag po yod pa jed/ de ga'/ chen po red/ nga tsho mi'i spyi tshogs nang mthong tshul 'dra min yong skabs lam/ sang 'grel bshad brgyab/ de yang nga rgyal khong khri'i thog na sa ma yin par rang bzhin yin lugs kyi dag 'bud byas te/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag sa gzhi rdul/ dag yong ba'i thabs shes bya rgyu de gal chen po red/ skabs skabs la 'dzoms dus gsal bshad byas na spus dag yag po chags kyi red/spyi don ched kyi sgrig 'dzugs 'di dag phyogs gang ci nas tshags tshud yong ba dang / nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs la tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa 'don rgyu de gal chen po red/ ma 'grigs pa 298

yod na skabs 'phral thad kur 'dis 'di 'grig gi mi 'dug 'thus shor gyi 'dug ces lab na sus yin kyang dga' bsu zhu gi red/ ma 'grigs pa dang /khong khro za sa/ blo pham sa'i rkyen de mi sger gcig gnyis thog nas byu nga / kha nas 'don skabs bod gzhung gis 'grig gi mi 'dug ces lab pa yin na dgos pa mi 'dug spyi pa'i don dag che sa zhig la bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'dis phan gyi yod pa red/ rgya mi'i ngos la cha bzhag na yang / nga tsho btsan byol ba 'bum gcig lhag tsam phyi rgyal la yod pa 'di rnams chu bye ma la sim pa nang bzhin zhig chags tshe de ring kha sang rgya mis btsan byol ba mgyogs myur log shog ces pa 'di zer mdog kha po ma red/nga tsho phyi rgyal la sgrig 'dzugs kyi gong bu gcig byas nas bsdad yod pa yin tsang rgya mis thugs khur bzhes kyi sku da pa red ma gtogs/ nga tsho bod pa rnams chu bye mar sim pa nang bzhin chags sku(da tshe rgya mis thugs khur ga la bzhes/ mig mi dgos ltag khung yang lta gi ma red/ nga tsho phyi la sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'dis rgya mir gnod kyi yod par brten sgrig 'dzugs de bshig thub pa'i ched du 'bad brtson byas te bod pa mi re ngo re la gad mo bgad de thabs shes byed pa 'di byung ba red ma gtogs dga' drags te byas pa ma red/ mi'i lung par nga tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'di 'dzam gling thog btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i ang ki dang po byas nas bsdad yod/ma 'ongs par yag po yong ba'i don la tshang mas sems khur len dgos/ tshang ma sems skyid po byas te sdod/ bkra shis bde legs// //299

yod na skabs 'phral thad kur 'dis 'di 'grig gi mi 'dug 'thus shor gyi 'dug ces lab na sus yin kyang dga' bsu zhu gi red/ ma 'grigs pa dang /khong khro za sa/ blo pham sa'i rkyen de mi sger gcig gnyis thog nas byu nga / kha nas 'don skabs bod gzhung gis 'grig gi mi 'dug ces lab pa yin na dgos pa mi 'dug spyi pa'i don dag che sa zhig la bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'dis phan gyi yod pa red/ rgya mi'i ngos la cha bzhag na yang / nga tsho btsan byol ba 'bum gcig lhag tsam phyi rgyal la yod pa 'di rnams chu bye ma la sim pa nang bzhin zhig chags tshe de ring kha sang rgya mis btsan byol ba mgyogs myur log shog ces pa 'di zer mdog kha po ma red/nga tsho phyi rgyal la sgrig 'dzugs kyi gong bu gcig byas nas bsdad yod pa yin tsang rgya mis thugs khur bzhes kyi sku da pa red ma gtogs/ nga tsho bod pa rnams chu bye mar sim pa nang bzhin chags sku(da tshe rgya mis thugs khur ga la bzhes/ mig mi dgos ltag khung yang lta gi ma red/ nga tsho phyi la sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'dis rgya mir gnod kyi yod par brten sgrig 'dzugs de bshig thub pa'i ched du 'bad brtson byas te bod pa mi re ngo re la gad mo bgad de thabs shes byed pa 'di byung ba red ma gtogs dga' drags te byas pa ma red/ mi'i lung par nga tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'di 'dzam gling thog btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i ang ki dang po byas nas bsdad yod/ma 'ongs par yag po yong ba'i don la tshang mas sems khur len dgos/ tshang ma sems skyid po byas te sdod/ bkra shis bde legs// //299

yang ho lan du 355 ba'i bka' slob khag gcig la/khyed rang tsho tshang mar 'tshams 'dri zhu rgyu yin/ de ring thug 'phrad du yong ba thugs rje che/ 'das pa'i lo nyi shu rtsa bdun lhag tsam ring / phyogs gcig nas nga tsho rang yul bral te mi yul la gyar/ so so'i lung pa'i nang sdod mkhan tsho la'ang dka' ngal dpag tu med pa myong dgos byung / 'phral sel mi'i dka' nga' tsam ma zad/ bod kyi rnam pa thon pa'i khyad chosayod pa de tsho tshang ma 'char gzhi ldan pa'i thog nas gtor brlag gtong ba'i dus skabs shig byung ba red/ yin na'ang bar lam gnas tshul phran bu bzang du phyin pa de blta rgyu gcig red /nga rang tsho mi'i lung par yod pa'i btsan byol ba rnams kyis phyogs gcis nas lto gos la bsam blo btang ste las ka ma byed rang byed red/ de dang chabs cig ma 'ongs pa'i bod rigs gzhon nu 'tshar longs byed mkhan snu'i) shes yon gyi thog la sgo gang sa nas thabs shes 'du 'god byas te gzhi rtsa a'u tsam tshugs yod/ gnyis nas nga tshos bod mi rigs kyi don la rang dbang rtsod len gyi 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod pa red/spyi ra btang mi yi rigs gcig pa yin na'ang / bod pa zhes ming sgos su thogs pa'i gnas tshul 'bur thon yong ba'i rgyu mtshan de gang red zer na so so'i rig gzhung dang / goms gshis de red/ mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod byed pa'i rmang gzhi gtso che shos de so so'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa zin rgyu de chags yod/ nga tsho mi'i lung par gyar nas lo de tsam phyin pa red/ 'dzam gling thog btsan byol ba 'dra mi 'dra mang po yod/ srid don gyi btsan byol ba yang mang po zhis 300

yod/ de tsho'i gnas stangs nga tshos gang yang lab ma dgos par/ btsan byol bar do snang dang 'brel ba yod mkhan mang po zhig kha gcig grags kyi thog nas/deng sang gi dus tshod la bod pa btsan byol ba rnams la btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i mthong tshul zhig dngos su chags yod pa red/ de nga tshos rgyu dngos po sprad nas nyos pa dang / mthu dang nus pa'i thog nas bsgrub pa ma red/ de ni rang bzhin gyi bden don zhig song stabs bden don ngos 'dzin byed rgyu de spyir btang mi'i gshis ka dang / chos nyid cig yin tsang da bar bod pa zhes lab dus mi bzang po zhig dang / mig dper thon thub pa zhig chags yod/de ha cang yag po red/da bar nga tsho mi lo nyer bdun nas nyer brgyad thog 'gro gi yod/ ma 'ongs par dus tshod gang 'dra zhig gi thog la 'gro grabs yod da lta nga tshos bshad thub rgyu khag po red/ 197941980 tsam nas rtsa ba'i rgya nag khyon yongs la 'gyur ba phyin pa dang chabs cig bod kyi thog la'ang 'gyur ba bzang po'i phyogs la phran bu 'gro gi yod pa de yag po red/ yin na'ang bod pa'i rtsa don de 'phral sel lto gos kyi don dag ma yi na par nga tsho'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i thog bod rang gi mthun mong ma yin pa'i rig gzhung goms gshis sogs gnas tshul mang po zhig dang 'brel ba yod pa dang / de yang bod lung pa'i gnas tshul tsam min par bod kyi sa cha'i chags babs rgya gar dang 'brel ba yod pa'i sa cha gal chen po zhig chags yod pa yin dus/ bod pa'i gnas tshul de rang dgar lus sdod pa rtsa ba nas yong shes kyi ma red/301

yod/ de tsho'i gnas stangs nga tshos gang yang lab ma dgos par/ btsan byol bar do snang dang 'brel ba yod mkhan mang po zhig kha gcig grags kyi thog nas/deng sang gi dus tshod la bod pa btsan byol ba rnams la btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i mthong tshul zhig dngos su chags yod pa red/ de nga tshos rgyu dngos po sprad nas nyos pa dang / mthu dang nus pa'i thog nas bsgrub pa ma red/ de ni rang bzhin gyi bden don zhig song stabs bden don ngos 'dzin byed rgyu de spyir btang mi'i gshis ka dang / chos nyid cig yin tsang da bar bod pa zhes lab dus mi bzang po zhig dang / mig dper thon thub pa zhig chags yod/de ha cang yag po red/da bar nga tsho mi lo nyer bdun nas nyer brgyad thog 'gro gi yod/ ma 'ongs par dus tshod gang 'dra zhig gi thog la 'gro grabs yod da lta nga tshos bshad thub rgyu khag po red/ 197941980 tsam nas rtsa ba'i rgya nag khyon yongs la 'gyur ba phyin pa dang chabs cig bod kyi thog la'ang 'gyur ba bzang po'i phyogs la phran bu 'gro gi yod pa de yag po red/ yin na'ang bod pa'i rtsa don de 'phral sel lto gos kyi don dag ma yi na par nga tsho'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i thog bod rang gi mthun mong ma yin pa'i rig gzhung goms gshis sogs gnas tshul mang po zhig dang 'brel ba yod pa dang / de yang bod lung pa'i gnas tshul tsam min par bod kyi sa cha'i chags babs rgya gar dang 'brel ba yod pa'i sa cha gal chen po zhig chags yod pa yin dus/ bod pa'i gnas tshul de rang dgar lus sdod pa rtsa ba nas yong shes kyi ma red/301

do bdag bod pa rang yin na'ang rung / nye 'brel rgyal khab tsho yin na'ang rung / gang ltar phyi dang nang gi gnas tshul mang po zhig gi 'og nas bod nang la bsgyur bcos shugs chen po zhig ma byung thabs med chags yod/ nga chos 'phral sel srid byus gu yangs kyis 'gyur ba phran bu phyin pa la chog shes byas te sdod pa'i dus stod cig rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ bod nang lha sa khul dang / de min grong khyer che khag srid don gyi bsam khra'i tho ྅)gas phran bu drag pa tsho'i sems shugs 'gyur ba med par gnas yod/ dper na/ spyir btang yongs grags la/ deng sang srid byus gu yangs kyis dpal 'byor phran bu yar rgyas song ste dngul mang du phyin pa'i skabs la/ sdug sa la cha bzhag na chang btung ste lus po dang / dus tshod chud zos 'gro ba'i skyon cha chen po yong gi yod pa red/ yin na'ang rtsa ba'i kun slong 'khyer so zhi da lta rang lag tu yod dus zas btung byas na ma gtogs bsags nas dgos pa gang yang mi 'dug snyam pa'i bsam tshul zhig mi mang por yod pa red/ bsags nas phan thogs mi 'dug zer ba de'i thog nas phyags btsan po med pa'i ngos 'dzin gsal po byed kyi yod pa'i rtags mtshon gyi yod/ phugs mi btsan pa gzhan gang yang ma red/ da lta rgya mi'i 'og tu bsdad yod pa des phugs btsan po med pa zhig mthong gi yod pa red/ yin na'ang sa khul kha shas la dngos yod gnas tshul gting zab wa'i bsam blo ma 'khor ba 'ga' re'i bsam par smon lam 'dra 'debs chog gi 'dug kha ton dge sbyor dang / phyag 'tshal skor sbyong 'dra byas chog gi 'dug lto gos kyi sems khral ni mi 'dug da 7rgyal ba rin po che mjal rgyu zhig byung na 'grigs song 302

zhes shod mkhan yang re zung yod pa red/yang mang che ba zhig gis 7rgyal ba rin po che mjal 'dod skad cig snga phyi byas na'ang skad cig snga ma 'dems rgyu yin/ yin na'ang / bod pa'i don dag de chab srid kyi gnad don yin dus 7rgyal ba rin po ches 'dzam gling thog ched spyi pa'i don du rang dbang ldan pa'i yul nang las ka byed thub pa de mkho gnad che ba 'dug ma gtogs/ lam sang mjal rgyu brel ba byed dgos rtsa ba nas mi 'dug ces shod kyi yod pa red/ 'di'i go don phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad pa yin na/ 7rgyal ba rin po che bod la yong ba'i nyin mo der lag pa stong par ma zhing rogs zhes don dag ngo ma de zer gyi yod pa red/ 'di shin tu rtsa ba chen po red/ bod don 'di chab srid kyi don dag yin pas 7rgyal ba rin po che chab srid kyi rang dbang ldan pa'i thog nas bod la chibs sgyur gnang rogs gnang /nge 'dra'i dus tshod cig ma byung bar du 7rgyal ba rin wo che 'dzam gling thog yod pa tsam gyis chog gi 'dug bod la phebs dgos pa'i dza drag gnas tshul gang yang mi 'dug zer ba de mang po zhig gi bsam tshul yin 'dugaphyi lo 1978 kyi lo mjug nas rgya mis rab la nga tsho bod du gtan log byed rgyu dang / gal srid de ltar ma byung yang / lta skor zhig la yong thub na yag wa red ces bshad pa red/ mtha' ma skabs de'i krung dbyang gi 'go 'khrid mtho shos mi drug gi ming thog nas nga bod la khyug tsam zhig lta skor la yong thub na yag po 'dug ces lan zhig byung / de rjes phyi lo 1980 nas srid byus gu yangs kyi 'gyur ba phyin par brten 1985 yas mas la nga rang nas gnas 303

tshul ngo ma gang 'dra yod med lta thub pa'i re ba yod ces bsam tshul zhig 1983lo stod la bshad pa yin/ gnas tshul de bod la slebs dus gzhon skyes bsam blo 'khor mkhan mang po zhig gis nga bod la yong rgyur sems nang dngangs skrag chen po 'dug yin na yang chab srid kyi gnas tshulayin dus brtan 11 byed rogs/lam sang ma yong rogs shod mkhan byung / de ni srid don gyi bsam blo gtsang ma zhig dang / thag chod po'i bsam blo 'khor ba zhig red/ gang ltar da lta de 'dra zhig gi sgang la gnas bzhin yod/phyi nas phyi rgyal mi rigs ngo shes pa dang / ngo mi shes pa de 'dra kha shas kyi bsam tshul la bod nang 'gyur ba gang la gang 'tshams shig 'gro gi yod pas/da cha bod la dmigs bsal gyi dka' ngal ga re yod pa red dam zhes shod mkhan kha shas yong gi 'dug mdo don bod nang mi re zung gi bsam tshul 'char sgo dang / phyi'i mi'i mthong tshul de lta bu'i 'og da cha bod spyi pa'i don dag de rim pa gnyis pa'i sgang la slebs nas nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod kyi rang bzhin de rnyog 'dzings che ru phyin pa red/sngon ma yin na lung pa'i nang rig gzhung gtor bshig gtong gi 'duga'agro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang dang bral nas nga tsho mu ges shi gi 'dug btson pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi gnas tshul ha cang dza drag yong gi 'dug ces bshad nas tshig gcig gnyis kyi 'grel bshad brgyab na 'grig gi yod pa red/ da cha mu ges shi gi yod pa ma red/ bod kyi rig gzhung thog la'ang lag len ngo ma gang 'dra zhig 'khel thub kyi yod med mi shes/ deng sang lha sar cha bzhag na rgya yig gtso 304

bor byed bzhin pa red/ rtsa ba'i srid byus kyi yig cha la gzhigs na/ rgya nag sa/gung gi yig chasang drug pa'i nang gsal thag chod byas nas dma' rim slob gra tshang mar bod yig khe gtsang las rgya yig rtsa ba nas bslab mi dgos/ 'bring rim slob gra nas rgya yig slob dgos kyi red zer ba zhig dang / las khungs khag rnam/sa kyis kyang bod yig gajo rwaper byed dgos shod kyi yod pa red/ ngo thog lag 'e na 'gel ba'i skabs la rgya yig gtso bo byed pa ma gtogs bod yig thog nas lag len byed kyi mi 'dug ma gzhi phyogs gcig nas dngos yod gnas tshul 'i/ ga chags yod pa red/nga tso rgya gar la'ang de bzhin red/ rtsa sge'e bod yig gi gnas tshad la gzhigs na da bar lo rgyus thog lo brgya phrag mang 'o/ de'i ring bod yig bod spyod byed sa ga༄ge ga gang du byas yod dam zhe na/ nang pa sangs rgya sa pa'i chos kyi thog la bed spyod byas yod/ de ltar byed skabs bod yig gis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog la legs sbyar gyi skad kyi nus pa dang / go sa'i gdan thob 'dra mnyam du 'dzin thub yod pa dang / yar rgyas kyang phyin yod/ mi'i 'jon thang lta bur cha bzhag na bod yig la nus pa dang 'jon thang cha tshang yod pa zhig chags yod/ yin na'ang bod yig yar rgyas 'gro sa de de snga nas chos kyi thog la ma gtogs shes bya'i sde tshan gzhan dag la dmigs bsal yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang /sbyong brdar byed pa'i go skabs ha cang shugs che ma byung ba yin tsang srid don dang /spyir btang 'dzam gling gi shes yon gsarapa'i nang da lta bod skad kyi gnas tshad lon gyi yod pa ma red/ de bod skad skyo drags pas byas mi 'dug dper na/305

spyir btang nub phyogs pa'i skad yig la mtshon na nang pa'i chos shod dus gzhi nas ming tshig gsar pa bzos/ don dag gtan 'bebs gzhi nas byas na ma gtogs yong thabs med pa zhig chags yod/ dpe de bzhin du de snga phan chad bod skad nang bed spyod byed ma myong ba'i brjod bya gsar pa zhig slebs dus/ rjod byed kyi tshig deyang 'gro stangs gsar pa zhig nas gtan 'beb byas na ma gtogs mi yong ba zhig chags sku(da/bod nang la'ang de'i dka' ngal zhig yod pa red/ de ni rgya mis mtha' gcig tu sdug pa byas pa zhig ma red/ yin na'ang rgya mis bod skad la mthong chung tan tan byed kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og slob sbyong thad bod yig slob rgyur shugs rgyag dgos zhes ji tsam bshad kyang / dngos gzhi'i slob rjodang byas pa'i tha ma las ka zhig la gtugs dgos pa las/ tshe gang 'dzin gra'i nang sdod thabs med/ 'dzin gra thon te las ga'i 'go tshugs skabs rgya yig thog nas yig tshad btang ste de'i thog nas las ka sprod kyi yod 'dug slob gra'i nang bod yig la dang zhen gtso bo byed mkhan de tsho'i gras rjes su slob gra thon dus bod yig dge rgan 'dra byas na ma gtogs las ka gzhan dag byed yul med pa'i dka' ngal zhig 'phrad kyi yod pa red/ gnas tshul de 'dras rkyen pas lhag bsam med pa min na yang / lto gos kyi don dag la thug dus mang po zhig gis rgya yig slob rgyur shugs ma thub kyis shugs rgyag dgos pa zhig chags yod pa red/deng sang mu ges shi gi med pa dang / sngon ma'i rtsis nas lto gos kyi sems khral byed dgos pa ha lam med pa chags pa red/ rig gzhung thog nas kyang 306

da lta bshad pa bzhin gzhi rtsa'i dka' ngal chen po yod na yang / srid byus 'khyer stangs de bod yig la dang zhen byed dgos shod kyi yod pa red/ chos kyi thog sde cha bzhag na'ang sngon ma rgya nag gi mkhrims de bzo dus/ 1954 rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thengs dang po'i skabs nga bod pa'i sku tshab byas nas rgya nag la slebs yod/ de dus rtsa khrims kyi don tshan gcig nang chos dad kyi skor yod pa der nga tsho go bsdur byung / chos la dad pa rang mos red/chos la dad pa byas na'ang rang dbang red/ ma byas na'ang rang dbang red/ de'i mjug tu chos dad med pa spel bar rang dbang yod ces rtsa khrims nang gsal po yod/ de dus chos la dad pa rang mos red ces lab na de gas 'thus kyi 'dugachos med ring lugs spel ba'i rang dbang yod ces pa deyin gcig bkod dgos don mi 'dug gal srid de yin gcig min gcig bkod pa yin na/ chos dad spel bar rang dbang yod ces mnyam du yod na yag po red ces skad cha byung ba red/ yin na'ang de 'grig gi ma red ces chos med ring lugs spel ṅge'i rang dbang yod ces pa de rtsa khrims nang bkod song / ma gzhi chos dad rang mos zhes par 'grel bshad rgyag stangs khyad mtshar zhig rgyag gi 'dug yang lo gcig sog yul dang / bho rad thu la slebs skabs nga dang ngo shes pa tsho chos dad rang mos skor la skad cha byung / de snga.u ru su gsar brje ma byas gong la chos dad rang mos yod pa ma red/ chos byed dgos zhesa.u tshugs rgyag gi yod pa red/ deng sang chos dad rang mos yod pa red ces 'grel bshad rgyag stangs khyad mtshar snying rje po zhig rgyag gi 'dug //307

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1987 zla 2 tshes 5 nyin/ gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi bka' dbang sta gon skabs gzhis byes bod mi mang tshogs la cing5 ba'i bka' slob/nga rang tsho da bar nyin ma bstud nas 'dir nub rub byas te gang zhin 'chad nyan byas pa yin nam zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nang tshan theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba yod pa'i bod gangs can ljongs kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i chos tshul de 'chad nyan byas pa red/ nga'i ngos nas gang shes bshad pa dang / khyed tsho'i ngos nas kyang ji ma ji bzhin blo la nges rung ma nges rung / dad pas kun nas blangs te nyan pa red/ de la brten nas mi sger so so'i shes rgyud ma rung pa 'di nyid med par 'gro thub pa zhig dang /spyi'i cha nas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs la 'gro ba'i re sems kyis 'chad nyan byas pa red/ nga rang tshos gang gi ched du bsams pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes pa 'di chags sdang gi sgo nas brjod pa'i skad cha zhig ma red/ sangs/ rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes pa 'di mthar gtugs nas bshad na ngas rtag tu brjod pa ltar/ lta ba rten 'byung dang / spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa de yin/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'grel bshad mdor bsdus na tshig de gnyis yin/ spyo da pa gnod pa mi skyel ba de la rim pa gnyis yod/ dang po rab la gnod pa 'a sa zlog pa tsam ma yin par snying rje'i bsam pa dang / phan sems kyis kun nas blangs te mi gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can kun la phan gdags rgyu de 'i na/gnyis pa gal srid phan btags ma thub kyang gnod pa mi skyel ba de yin/ nga 308

rang cho theg pa chen po'i spyod pa la smos ci dgos/ theg dman gyi gzhung la bltas na'ang 'tshe ba mi byed pa de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa bar gsungs kho/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba snying rje yin pa theg pa che chung tshang mar yongs su grags yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bshad tshul gyi spyod pa de gang yin zhe na/ 'tshe ba mi byed pa de yin/ lta ba de gang yin zhe na/ nga rang tshos las gang zhig byed rgyu'i las ga'i ngo bo dang / de byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / byed lugs kyi gnad 'gag de tsho mthong ba'i blo zhig gzhi la bzhag ste de'i thog nas las ka byed kyi sku(da pa dper na/ mi tshe 'di gcig pur bsam mkhan zhig gis tshe 'di'i don sgrub rgyu gathorwa kur byed pa de kho rang gi lta ba'i dod lta bu byas/ de'i 'og nas las ka yang mi tshe 'di gang gi 'dzugs bskrun byed rgyu kho nar bsam blo gtong gi red/ dper na/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lta ba yod mkhan zhig gis dngul bzos pa de dngul bzos pa 'dra 'dra yin na'ang dngul des mi mang po la phan pa dang / dbul phyug gi dbye ba chen po med pa bzo rgyu'i thad la 'bad brtson gtso bo byed pa'i lag len gyi spyod pa de rtsa ba'i lta ba de dang 'brel nas byung ba red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'byung gi lta ba zhes pa de yang sems can gyi bde sdug dang / 'jig rten gyi stod bcud de tsho 'jig rten bkod pa pos bzos pa ma yin par tshang ma sems kyi dbang gis byung ba dang / de yang rkyen la rag las pa/ de ltar rkyen tsam las byung ba zhig yin dus rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes bshad pa red/ rten 'brel gyi don la phra rags mang po yod/ spyir btang nang pa'i rten 'byung gi lta ba'i 309

don ni/ stod bcud 'di dag 'jig rten bkod pa po'am/ byed pa po zhig gi blo yi g.yo ba sngon du 'gro ba'i thog nas byung ba zhig ma yin par/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi thog ma ma rig pa nas bzung ba'iyan lag bcu gnyis kyi 'khor tshul dang / de la rkyen gsum ste/ g.yo ba med pa'i rkyen las byung ba dang / mi rtag pa'i rkyen las byung ba/ nus pa'i rkyen las byung ba yin pas rgyu dang rkyen tsam gyi thog nas 'byung bar bshad yod/ lta ba de lta bu yin pas nga rang tshor sdus bsngal mi 'dod na de'i rgyu 'tshe ba spong rgyus mtshon pa'i bya ba ngan pa'i rigs rnams sdom pa'i sgo nas 'bras bu sdug bsngal las thar ba byed dgos/ bde ba 'dod kyi yod na phan pa'i bya ba bsgrub pa'i sgo nas 'bras bu bde ba 'thob pa byed dgos/ spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa de yang lta ba rten 'byung dang 'brel nas yod pas na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snying po spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa dang / lta ba rten 'byung gnyis red ces lab na tshig mang po med pa don rdog gcig la tshang ba phal cher chags yod/ de ni rgya gar la sdod mkhan dang bod nas yong mkhan tshang mas sems la nges pa byed dgos/shes 11nga ngam/lta spyod gnyis po de'i don rgya bskyed nas bshad na/ dper na/ nga rang tsho nyin ma kha shas ring 'chad nyan byas pa de dag lta bu yin/ de rnams rang dgar smon lam brgyab pa tsam gyis yong thabs med/ nga rang tsho'i da lta'i blo 'di ga la bzo bcos rgyag gin rgyag gin byas nas lta ba de skye thub pa dang /gnod pa'i bsam pa can gyi ma rung ba'i blo 'di bsgyur bcos btang nas mtha' 310

gcig tu gzhan la phan bde 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa'i blo zhig la bsgyur dgos/ kha sang nas lab pa bzhin/ nang pa'i chos tshul 'di dag rnam grangs mang zhing rgya chen spro yin pas slob sbyong nges can zhig ma byas na shes pa dka'/ dper na/ kha sang nas de ring bar ngas chos 'chad skabs bod skad thog nas bshad pa ma gtogs/ rgya skad dang / rgya gar ba'i skad/ dbyin ji'i skad brgyab med kyang / khyed tsho'i nang du 'ga' zhig nas don ji bzhin ma go ba tan tan yong rgyu red/ ngas gang thub kyis go bde po zhig bshad khul byed kyi yod/ da dung go ma thub par gang zhig shod kyi yod dam bsam pa de 'dra tan tan yong gi red/ byas tsang chos kyi gnas lugs la slob sbyong bya rgyu shin tu gal chen spro yin/ nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs nang nang pa'i chos kyi shes tshad dman pa de ha cang gi skyon chen po red/ bod gangs can jongs kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba'i bstan pa spus dag shos shig yin pa ma zad/ de ni 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa spyi'i bde rtsa la thug pa zhig yin/ da lta 'dzam gling 'di dang 'brel ba yod pa'i chos lugs 'dra 'dra'i nang nas dngos gnas chos lugs gting zab shos dang / rgya che shos/ spus dag shos bcas yin pas shin tu gal chen po yin/ lhag par nga rang tsho bod pa yin pa'i cha nas bshad na'ang so so'i mi rigs la rig gzhung gi rnam grangs mang zhing / rgya chen po zhig yod pa de dag gi rtsa ba nang pa'i chos lugs la thug yod/ nga rang tsho spyir sems can yin pa'i cha nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gces spras byas te de dag shes pa dang / spus dag po zhig 'dzin skyong 311

byed dgos/ yang sgos nga rang tsho bod pa yin pa'i cha nas de dag so d+ku mi rigs kyi khyad nor gzhan la ngoms chog pa zhig yin/ lhag par nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa de gnyis ni ma 'ongs par bod kyi gzi byin thon pa'i gtso bo'i rgyu rkyen yin pas de ltar so i rig gzhung khyad nor rtsa che dag nyams pa gsor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'gro gi yod/ btsan byol ba chags pa'i nyin mo de nas bzung phyogs gcig nas chab srid kyi don la bsam blo gtong dgos pa dang / phyogs gnyis nas 'phral sel so so'i 'tsho ba so sos 'tshol thub pa'i gzhis chags bya rgyu'i bsam blo btang ste las ka byed dgos pa de tsho las 'gan gtso bor 'khur nas byas yod/ phyogs gsum nas ma 'ongs par nga tsho yar rgyas yong dang mi yong dang /'dzam bu gling 'di'i mi grangs mang nyung la ma ltos par bod pa'i spyi tshogs zhes ming 'bur thon zhig gnas dang ma gnas deng dus kyi shes yon ldan min la rag lus stabs/ slob gra 'dzugs rgyu la don gnyer byas yod/ de yang gang gi ched du byas pa yin zhe na/ bod mi rigs zhes khyad chos dmigs bsal du yod pa'i mi'i sdod skar dang / bod pa'i slob gra logs su 'dzugs pa'i ched du byas pa yin/ de dag ni nga tsho'i byas rjes shig yin/ bod pa'i ming thon pa'i gzhi gcig bod pa'i rig gzhung yin zhing / de'i rtsa ba nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba yod pa yin dus nang chos slob sbyong bya rgyur ha cang gal cher bzungs yod/ nga tshos rgya gar nang slob gra thog mar btsugs dus bod pa'i slob gra zhes 312

zur du btsugs/ slob deb nang thog mar kha dog dkar dmar nas bzung chos kyi nang don slob tshan nang la bkod pa dang / slob dge'i nang deng dus shes zhin gyi gnas tshad med na'ang chos phyogs kyi 'grel bshad rgyab thub mkhan gyi chos dge 'dzugs rgyur do snang chen po byas yod/ slob gra'i nang pho mo dang /skya ser dbyer med thog nas mtshan nyid blta dgos rgyu'i 'bad brtson yang mang po byas yod/ de dag ni nga tshos bstan pa'i don la bsam blo btang nas byas pa red/ grub 'bras kyang gang la gang 'tshams thon yod/ yin na'ang bsam pa ji bzhin nga tshos lag len mjag 'khyongs byung dang ma byung sna tshogs shig yod/ ༄dgon sde khag de tsho la dngos gnas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed mkhan ming rgyab 'khur gyi las 'ganaspedad/ de snga bod gangs can gyi jongs chol kha gsum gyi nang la ha lam dgon pa khag stong phrag drug skor zhig yod/gtso che'i dgon pa gra tshogs che ba tsho slob gnyer yang bzang shos chags yod/de yang snga dus ji ltar yin yang / dus phyis se 'bras dga' gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i dgon pa de tsho'i gras slob gnyer bzang shos yin/ rgya gar du slebs rjes se 'bras dga' gsum rtsa ba tshugs thub thabs la 'bad brtson gang thub byas pa red la/ da cha lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad phyin pa'i skabs la bzo lta gang legs chags yod/ da lam nga rgya gar rdzo phyogs khul gtso bo se 'bras dga' gsum gyi slob gnyer la blta zhib tu ched mngags phyin pa yin/ slob gnyer ba tsho'i rtsod rgyugs la lta skabs gnas tshad yag thag chod/ dngos gnas snying khong 313

rus pa'i gting nas yi rangs skye ba 'dug pas dga' po byung / rtsa ba'i mthun rkyen zhan zhing / dka' ngal mang po zhig yod na yang dpe cha 'khrid mkhan chos hur thag gis 'khrid/ dpe cha blta mkhan tshos kyang hur thag bltas pa'i lag rjes dngos gnas yag po 'dug nga rang lo gnyis gsum tsam la ma gtogs yang yang bskyod thub kyi med/ bskyod pa'i skabs la lo re lo re yar rgyas grub 'bras mig mthong lag zin dngosaganas yag po 'dug da dung ma 'ongs par mu mthud slob gnyer spus dag tshags tshud yag po yong thub pa zhig byed dgos/de snga nga rang tsho bod la yod dus so so'i yul lung gcig pu ma gtogs 'dzam gling spyi dang 'brel ba med/ deng gi skabs su 'dzam gling spyi dang 'brel ba yong gi yod pa yin dus/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos tshul skor la de snga bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po rim byon nas slob tshan sgrig yod pa de dag la nga chos bsgyur bcos gtong dgos pa med/ deng dus kyi shes yon nub phyogs pa'i lta ba'i skor dang / tshan rig pa tshos tshan rig thog nas phyi rdzas kyi rnam gzhag dang / nang sems kyi rnam gzhag de bzhin lus kyi klad pa'i rnam gzhag sogs la brtag dpyad dang 'brel ba'i thog nas rig pa gsar pa rnyed pa de tsho'i gras nga tshos nges par du shes pa byed dgos stabs slob sbyongs dang / do snang che tsam byed dgos/ slob tshan gsar pa de tsho'i gras skad yig gzhan zhig brgyud nas slob sbyong byed mi dgos par so so rang gi skad yig nang bsgyur thub pa bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug de skor ma gzhi nga tshos de sngon nas gros 'go mang po bton te 'bad brtson yang mang po byas yod/ slob gnyer ba tsho'i nang la dbyin 314

rus pa'i gting nas yi rangs skye ba 'dug pas dga' po byung / rtsa ba'i mthun rkyen zhan zhing / dka' ngal mang po zhig yod na yang dpe cha 'khrid mkhan chos hur thag gis 'khrid/ dpe cha blta mkhan tshos kyang hur thag bltas pa'i lag rjes dngos gnas yag po 'dug nga rang lo gnyis gsum tsam la ma gtogs yang yang bskyod thub kyi med/ bskyod pa'i skabs la lo re lo re yar rgyas grub 'bras mig mthong lag zin dngosaganas yag po 'dug da dung ma 'ongs par mu mthud slob gnyer spus dag tshags tshud yag po yong thub pa zhig byed dgos/de snga nga rang tsho bod la yod dus so so'i yul lung gcig pu ma gtogs 'dzam gling spyi dang 'brel ba med/ deng gi skabs su 'dzam gling spyi dang 'brel ba yong gi yod pa yin dus/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos tshul skor la de snga bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po rim byon nas slob tshan sgrig yod pa de dag la nga chos bsgyur bcos gtong dgos pa med/ deng dus kyi shes yon nub phyogs pa'i lta ba'i skor dang / tshan rig pa tshos tshan rig thog nas phyi rdzas kyi rnam gzhag dang / nang sems kyi rnam gzhag de bzhin lus kyi klad pa'i rnam gzhag sogs la brtag dpyad dang 'brel ba'i thog nas rig pa gsar pa rnyed pa de tsho'i gras nga tshos nges par du shes pa byed dgos stabs slob sbyongs dang / do snang che tsam byed dgos/ slob tshan gsar pa de tsho'i gras skad yig gzhan zhig brgyud nas slob sbyong byed mi dgos par so so rang gi skad yig nang bsgyur thub pa bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug de skor ma gzhi nga tshos de sngon nas gros 'go mang po bton te 'bad brtson yang mang po byas yod/ slob gnyer ba tsho'i nang la dbyin 314

ji'i skad yig phran bu shes mkhan kha shas yong gi yod pa de tshor dmigs bsal gyi las 'gan zhig bskur nas shes bya'i rnam grangs kyi brjod bya gsar pa de 'i gras bod yig nang la tshur bsgyur thub pa byung na/ nga rang tsho'i mkhas pa tsho phyi rgyal gyi skad yig brgyud ma dgos par so so rang gi skad yig thog nas deng dus kyi shes yon cha tshang shes thu ba pa yong gi red/ de ni ha cang gi gal chen po yin la phan thogs kyang nges can yong gi red/ lhag par de la brten nas bod kyi skad yig phyug tu dang / yar rgyas 'gro thub pa yong gi red/ nga tshos rgyagar nang ha lam lo nyi shu tsam gyi gong du slob gra thog mar 'dzugs skabs slob tshan yongs rdzogs dper na tshan rig gi skor dang / de min gyi sde tshan khag 'dzam gling rgyal rabs sogs tshang ma bod skad thog nas bslab thub pa byed dgos zhes skad cha mang po byung / ji ma ji bzhin lag len bkal ma thub par dka' ngal kho na'i ngang bsdad yod/ deng sang phran bu gtam bzang ba zhig la bod nang deng dus shes yon gyi slob tshan 'dra min de tsho dad kyi skad yig thog nas cha tshang bslab thub pa'i thabs shes shig gzhi nas byed kyi 'dug de ni rjes su yi rangs dang / mngon par bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor 'os pa zhig red/ de yang gtso bo rgya mi'i srid byus gu yangs kyi go skabs bzung ste bod chol kha gsum gyi khyon la yod pa'i mkhas pa tshos sems khur blangs nas hur thag gis shugs rgyag gi yod 'dug dngos gnas shin tu dga' po byung / nga phyo bod pa'i skad yig 'di rtsa ba dngos gnas phyug po red 'dug phyug po yin pa'i rtags ni/ 'dzam gling gi skad yig rnying pa'i nang nas legs sbyar gyi skad 315

de shar phyogs nang la rtsa ba gcig chags yod/ legs sbyar skad nang la yod pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag mang po bshad pa de tsho tshang ma bod kyi skad yig gis ldeng nas legs sbyar skad dang gdan thob mnyam du spyod thub yod/ dper na/ deng sang legs sbyar gyi skad kyi thog nas nang pa'i chos slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan de tsho'i gras kyis brjod par /legs sbyar gyi skad nang la phran bu go ma bde ba de 'dra'i rigs rgya yig dang /bod yig de min skad yig gzhan dag bcas la bsgyur yod pa'i nang nas bod kyi skad yig tu bsgyur ba de cho yag shos dang / de tsho go bde shos/ gsal shos 'dug brjod kyi 'dug nga tsho bod pa'iyi ge 'di'i rtsa ba dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi thog nas bsgrigs pa'i rlabs chen gyi skad yig chags yod/ de dag nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi nang la yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i go skabs byung zhing /de'i thog nas legs sbyar gyi skad dang mtshungs pa'i yar rgyas 'gro thub pa byung yod/ slob tshan gzhan dag dus rabs nyi shu pa'am/ yang na nye ba'i dus rabs kyi slob tshan gsar pa de tsho'i nang bod kyi skad yig bed spyod byed pa'i go skabs ma byung ba yin tsang / mi dang 'dra bar 'tshar long ma byung ba red ma gtogs/rtsa ba bod kyi skad yig rang gi thog nas ma ldeng pa zhig ma red/ deng sang bod yig nang bsgyur ba'i slob deb kha shas ngas mthong byung / dngos gnas yag po 'dug drodi skor bod nang da lta brjod pa bzhin yar rgyas 'gro gi yod pa red la/ da dung mu mthud yar rgyas 'gro ba'i re ba yod/ nga tsho rgya gar nang sdod mkhan gyi bsam blo gtong stangs ni/ da lta gdan sa tsho'i slob gnyer 316

ba dbyin ji shes mkhan tshor re ba byas pa de yin/ don snying nga tshor nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi slob sbyongasang ki dang po yod pa 'di'i thog la/ deng dus kyi shes yon de sto so so'i skad yig thog bslab thub pa zhig dgos/ gtso che shos tshan rig thog gi rig gnas gsar pa de tshor slob sbyong bya rgyu ha cang gal chen po 'dug phan thogs yong sa red/ dper na/ ngas tshan rig pa de 'dra thug myong la do snang yang byed kyi yod/ khong tsho dang go bsdur byed dus blo skyed chen po yong gi 'dug nga rang tshos phyi'i rdzas kyi rnam gzhag brtsod skabs rtsa ba'i gzhung gi nang nas rdzas la rdul phra rab kyi rnam gzhag gsungs yod/ deng sang tshan rig pa tshos bshad pa'i dngos khams rig pa'i nang gi rdzas phra mo'i rnam gzhag de tsho nga tsho las gting zab cing phra ba lta bu 'dug de bzhin dus yun la cha bzhag na'ang nga tshos dus yun skad cig gcig se gol gcig sum brgya drug cu'i char phye nas dus phra mo'i skad cig bshad kyi yod/ deng sang 'dzam gling thog 'od kyi mgyogs tshad de dus yun mgyogs shos la bshad yod/ de dang bsdur na nga tsho'i de tsho zhan tsam chags yod/ nub phyogs pa'i dus kyi rnam gzhag dang / dngos po'i rdul phra mo'i rnam gzhag bshad pa de tsho'i gras tshan rig pas brtag dpyad yang yang byas nas ra 'phrod byung ste bshad pa zhig yin pas bden don chags yod/ de nga tshos nges par du shes pa byas na phan thogs chen po 'dug sems kyi rnam gzhag skor la nub phyogs pa tshos gang yang shes kyi yod pa ma red/ lus kyi rnam gzhag dang / rtsa dang klad pa'i rdul phran gyi 'gro stangs de tsho'i gras la kho tshos dmigs bsal gyi do snang byas yod pa yin 317

dus gang la gang 'tshams shig bshad rgyu yod/ da lta yar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa red/ sde tshan de tsho'i nang slob sbyongs byed mkhan nub phyogs pa'i tshan rig mkhas pa blo gzu bor gnas pa de tshos deng sanganang pa'i chos la dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed kyi 'dug nga rang tsho nang pa'i ngos nas de tshor slob sbyongs byas te bshad thub pa'i thog nas tshan rig pa de tsho dang go bsdur bya rgyu de shin tu gal chen po 'dug des rang gzhan gnyis kur phan gyi red/ da lam ma'i sor la'ang de skor shod rgyu byung /de nas rgya gar dang bod gnyis lo rgyus kyi thog thun mong ma yin pa'i 'brel ba chen po zhig chags yod pa de yang dge rgan dge phrug gi 'brel ba lta bu zhig yin/ bod pa mang che ba nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos khas len mkhan yin pas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos de rgya gar nas byung ba red/ deng gi skabs la cha bzhag na yang dngos yod sa cha'i babs nas bod pa'i don dag 'di rgya gar ba'i don dag dang 'brel ba chags yod/ de la do snang zhig byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ gnyis nas rgya gar dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi gnas stangs skyo po yin na'ang / spyir btang dngos gnas rang dbang dmangs gatsho'i rtsa ba tshugs pa'i lung pa gcig chags yod/ khyim mtshes gzhan la ltos te rgya gar nang la dmangs gtso'i 'gro stangs de gang la gang 'tsham gyi rtsa ba tshugs yod pa'i bzo 'dug rgya gar nga tsho'i lung pa ma yin par gzhan sa yin na yang rang dbang yod pa yin dus mi'i rnam dpyod bed spyod byed thub kyi yod/ mi so sos byas na yar rgyas rab 'bring gang 'dra zhig yin kyang gtong sa yod/ bod nang 318

dus gang la gang 'tshams shig bshad rgyu yod/ da lta yar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa red/ sde tshan de tsho'i nang slob sbyongs byed mkhan nub phyogs pa'i tshan rig mkhas pa blo gzu bor gnas pa de tshos deng sanganang pa'i chos la dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed kyi 'dug nga rang tsho nang pa'i ngos nas de tshor slob sbyongs byas te bshad thub pa'i thog nas tshan rig pa de tsho dang go bsdur bya rgyu de shin tu gal chen po 'dug des rang gzhan gnyis kur phan gyi red/ da lam ma'i sor la'ang de skor shod rgyu byung /de nas rgya gar dang bod gnyis lo rgyus kyi thog thun mong ma yin pa'i 'brel ba chen po zhig chags yod pa de yang dge rgan dge phrug gi 'brel ba lta bu zhig yin/ bod pa mang che ba nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos khas len mkhan yin pas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos de rgya gar nas byung ba red/ deng gi skabs la cha bzhag na yang dngos yod sa cha'i babs nas bod pa'i don dag 'di rgya gar ba'i don dag dang 'brel ba chags yod/ de la do snang zhig byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ gnyis nas rgya gar dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi gnas stangs skyo po yin na'ang / spyir btang dngos gnas rang dbang dmangs gatsho'i rtsa ba tshugs pa'i lung pa gcig chags yod/ khyim mtshes gzhan la ltos te rgya gar nang la dmangs gtso'i 'gro stangs de gang la gang 'tsham gyi rtsa ba tshugs yod pa'i bzo 'dug rgya gar nga tsho'i lung pa ma yin par gzhan sa yin na yang rang dbang yod pa yin dus mi'i rnam dpyod bed spyod byed thub kyi yod/ mi so sos byas na yar rgyas rab 'bring gang 'dra zhig yin kyang gtong sa yod/ bod nang 318

so so'i lung pa yin na'ang rang dbang med par brten yi ge zhig bris pa yin na'ang 'bri chod byed dgos pa dang / skad cha zhig bshad pa yin na'ang shod tshod byed dgos kyi 'dug ga re byed dgos byung yang mi gzhan dag gi gdong la/ blta bzhin blta bzhin byed dgos pa zhig chags yod/ de gzhan dbang rang bzhin gyis lan pa red/ 'dir rtsab lung pa bral nas 〉 rwa1 yod kyang rang dbang yod pa red/ dper na/ nga rang tsho de ring rdo rje gdan la dngos gnas theg pa chen po'i chos tshul 'chad nyan byed kyi yod/ sngar bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i dus rtsa tshong khye'u bkra shis kyi sa nas rtsa bzhes te rtsa'i gdan la bzhugs pa bzhin/ nga rang tsho de ring 'dir rtsa gdan sgang la thal 'tshub ling ling du sdod pa 'di skyo po 'dra zhig yod pa red de/ yin na'ang dngos gnas rang dbang yod pa yin dus 7rgyal ba rin po che'i ngos nas kyang gang bshad 'dod pa rnams bshad chog gi yod/ khyed rang tsho'i ngos nas kyang nyan 'dode na nyan/ 'gro 'dod na phyin/ sdod 'dod na bsdad chog gi yod/ de 'dra'i rang dbang ni rtsa ba che zhing / mi la rang dbang zhes pa 'di gal chen po yin/ rang dbang zhes brjod pa de snang ba skyid po'i skad cha gcig pu min/ yar rgyas dgos na mi'i rnam dpyod kyi nus pa 'don dgos/ mi'i rnam dpyod kyi nus pa bton na yar rgyas 'gro thub/ mi'i rnam dpyod kyi nus pa 'don ma thub na yar rgyas 'gro mi thub la gsar gtod byed mi thub/ gsar gtod med na yar rgyas kyang med/ gsar gtod byed pa la rang dbang dgos/de ni rang bzhin gyi 'gro stangs shig yin/ nga rang tsho rgya gar nang la gtso bo 319

rang dbang yod pa'i thog rgya gar dbus gzhung dang / sa gnas gzhung so sos dngos gnas bod par thugs khur chen po gnang bar brten nas nga tsho gzhi rtsa yag thag chod tshugs yod/de ring shod 'dod byung ba zhig la spyir btang rgya gar nang la bod pa mang po zhig yod pa yin dus gdan sa khag la dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal yod/bsnyen bkur zhu rgyu sgor mo brgya nyis brgya las med na'ang de dag nges par du lob gnyer yod sa'i gdan sa tshor phul thub na bsod nams gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig gsog gi red/ ma gzhi kha rdzab chen gyi bzo 'dra po zhig chags kyi 'dug ste gra pa cho yod la med la bzhi gra/ brgyad gra de 'dra tshogs nas bsam blo gtong rgyu gang yang med pa'i 'don pa 'don mkhan la bsnyen bkur zhus pa las lo nas lo bstud de dpe cha lta mkhan tsho'i thog la sgor mo brgya las ma byung yang btang na dngos gnas smin cing phan thogs che ba yod/ shes song ngam de gal chen po mthong yong gi 'dug de bzhin spyir btang phran bu dpal 'byor yod mkhan gyi phru gu yin na/rang bzhin bsam blo'i nang slob grar gtong rgyu ma gtogs/ gra sar 'jug rgyu'i bsam blo ha lam med/ snying rje/ mi tshang skyo po tshos phru gu gra sar bcug na dpe cha zhig shes kyi red la/ lto gos kyang 'phral sel 'grigs 'gro gi red bsams nas 'jug gi yod bzo 'dug dngos gnas bsam blo btang na de dag ni ma 'ongs par bod rang gi shes yon rig gzhung khyad chos bla na med pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyi rig gzhung 'dra 'dra'i nang 320

nas phran bu ngo so thon pa 'di'i rtsa ba 'dzin mkhan gyi dmigs sgo da lta gdan sar slob gnyer rgyag mkhan de tsho chags yong gi 'dug rang re'i slob gra khag nas bon pa tsho de 'dra'i rnam dpyod thon thub rgyu khag po red/ ma gzhi gtso bo phru gu so so'i 'dod pa yin kyang / pha ma chos kha lta bslab bya byed phyogs yod na/ phru gu rig pa bkra zhing re ba yod pa de tsho gra sar 'jug rgyu gal chen po mthong gi 'dug yang ngas dpal 'byor gyi thog la ched du gnyer nas zhal 'debs bsdu dgos brjod kyi med/ nga rang sto bod pa'i goms gshis la zhar dang zhor la sgor mo brgya nyis brgya'i phyag mchod 'bul byed srol yod pa de tsho phan slebs che sa zhig la btang na yag po 'dug brjod pa de yin/ lto phyogs la gdan sa gsum dang / bkra shis lhun po bcas kyi rtsod rgyugs la lta skabs rtags gsal btang ba de tsho yag thag chod 'dug gzhis sgar bzhi par yod pa'i dpal nor rin po che'i rnying dgon la yang bshad gra btsugs nasayag thag chod 'dug sngon ma nas nga tsho'i sa skya'i mkhan po rin chen gyis dpe cha khrid nas rtsa ba gang 'tshams tshugs yod/ de nas na ning de bar mkhan po zla gsal gyis dpe cha khrid nas gzhi rtsa yag po tshugs 'dug khong tshos bshad rgyugs phul ba dang / rtsod rgyugs kyang khyug tsam phul te ha cang yag po byung /bslab pa slob gnyer de deng sang dngos yod gnas tshul la spyir sa dge gnyis dang / yang sgos dge lugs pa drag shos chags yod/ yin na'ang slob gnyer bya rgyu de dge lugs pa gcig pur 'khri ba zhig min/ sa skya dang / rnyi nga ma/ bka' brgyud bcas tshang mas slob gnyer gyi thog la dga' zhen bya rgyu gal 321

chen po 'dug dpe cha shes na/ mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nang na mdzes/ zhes pa 'di dngos gnas yong gi red/ mi shes mkhan de chos mgo ma 'chos kyi grub mtha'i 'then 'khyer phyogs ris dang zhen khog byas/ de lkug pa'i zhen khog la phyin/ chags sdang gi jog la 'gro gi yod/dngos gnas kyi gnas tshul shes pa yin na grub mtha'i chags sdang 'then 'khyer bya don med/ na ning dus 'khor dbang chen skabs bshad rgyu byung / de snga bod kyi mkhas pa'i nang la bzhed srol gnyis yod/ mkhas pa khag gcig gis so so'i bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes de kho na 'ba' zhig 'dzin pa ma gtogs/gzhan dag mang por slob gnyer dang phyag bzhes mi gnang ba dang / yang khag gcig gis sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad par slob gnyer dang / phyag bzhes gnang gi yod/ so so rang gi nyams len rigs gcig rkang 'dzin byed pa de gnas tshul tha dad yin/ deng sang spyi sgos gang la bltas kyang ris su ma chad par bslab pa slob gnyer byas/ grub mtha' yongs rdzogs la sbyangs na gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dge mtshan 'dug dper na rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi bye brag smra ba nas dbu ma bar gyi grub mtha' yongs rdzogs nga rang chorwa nad pas sbyong gi yod/ de ni grub mtha' gong ma gong ma'i khyad par shes pa'i don la/ 'og ma 'og ma 'bab stegs lta bu byas nas slob sbyong byed dus phan thogs yong gi yod/ de de bzhin byas nas bod gangs can gyi ljongs la yod pa'i sa dge bka' rnying de tshor grub mtha' gong 'og gi khyad par med na'ang / kha sang zhus pa bzhin stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi lam sgom pa'i skabs la rang rang so i bla 322

ma gong ma'i man ngag dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad re yong gi 'dug de cho tshang ma shes na 11 16) nyams len gyi gnad 'gag thog bgegs sel 11gas 'don gyis go ba rnyed rgyur phan thogs tan tan 'dug nga rang la nyams myong chen po med kyang nyams myong phran bu yod pa de thog nas bshad na/ nga rang tsho sa dge bka' rnying tshang mas slob gnyer la do snang byas thog phan tshun slob sbyong byed thub pa byung na dngos gnas dge mtshan 'dug la de gal chen po mthong gi 'dugade bzhin rgya gar byang brgyud la yod pa'i mon dang / ka rdor skang gsum/ga zha/ khu nu/ spi ti sogs kyi khul la yod pa'i dgon pa kha shas ni/ bod pa btsan byol bas gsar du bzhengs pa red/ kha shas ni yul so sor de snga nas yod/ tshang ma nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi bstan pa 'di'i rtsa ba 'dzin mkhan sha stag yin/ de 'dra yin dus slob gnyer la nges par du do snang byed dgos/ deng sang phyogs gang sa nas mi mang po 'du 'dzomasayong gi yod dus/ dgon pa yod pa tsam dang / tshogs 'tshogs rgyu yod pa tsam la ha las rgyu med/ nges par du gzi byin thon pa zhig byed dgos/slob gnyer rgya che chung dang rnam grangs mang nyung la ma tos pa'i gang ltar slob gnyer 'chad nyan yod pa zhig yong thabs la u tshugs rgyag dgos kyi 'dug gal chen po mthong gi 'dugade bzhin bal yul nang la'ang sa dge bka' rnying gi dgon khag mang po yod pa de tsho mchor po dang / rgya chen po yod pa yag po red/ yin na'ang 323

nang gi lha khang stong pa 'dra po zhig chags na yag po ma red/ snod kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa yod pa de las bcud kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs po yong ba bya rgyu gal che/ nga rang tsho lto chas za skabs dkar yol dang / gser dngul phor pa legs po zhig gi nang la thug pa bro ba gtan nas med pa zhig blugs pa yin na/ snod phun sum tshogs pa des ro bcud bzang du 'gro mi thub pas lto chas zhim po bzo rgyu gal chen po red/ gser gyi phor pa'i nang la lto chas cang cang zhig ma gtogs med na gser gyi phor pa bza' rgyur ni mi phan/ de las phor pa chag po zhig las med kyang thug pa bro ba yod pa zhig blugs na stod chag par skyon gang yang mi 'dug dpe de bzhin phyi'i dgon pa sgo mchor rdzig po dang / mchod rdzas/ sku gsung thugs rten rdzig po/ mchod pa'i yo byad rdzig po ha las rgyu zhig yod na yang nang la don gyi gzi byin med pa gdon 'dre tshogs sa'i bzo 'dra po byas nas bsdad na cho mi 'dug bong bu so gtsigs tshogs sa'i bzo 'dra po chags na cho gang yong / bal yul nang yod pa'i sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad pa'i dgon pa tshor rim pas yar rgyas 'gro gi red/ yar rgyas gtong rgyu ha cang gal chen po 'dug lhag par bod pa'i la rgya zhen khog gi thog nas bshad na dgon pa de tsho spus dag po byung na/ deng sang bod nas gnyen 'phrad 'gro 'ong gi lam gyi mid pa lta bu de bal yul chags yod/ lha sa dang / bod khyon yongs nas tshur yong mkhan tsho bal yul du slebs pa dang /dgon pa ya mtshan po de 'dra mthong na blo bde po yong gi mi 'dug phar phyogs der rgya mis rtag par rna ba'i nang mang po zhig bshad yod pa'i thog glo bur 324

dgon pa khyad mtshar ya mtshan can de 'dra mthong na rgya mis bshad pa ra sprod byed mkhan 'dra po chags na yag po ma red/ gdan sa tsho'i bzo 'dra ngo de 'dra mthong na/ mi su yin kyang dga' po yong gi red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul ji ma ji bzhin shes pa'i thog nas 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu yod red/ chos la dug ltar rtsis mkhan rgya mi tsho la cha bzhag na yang kha dang zhal thug pa lta bu min pa'i thog nas drang po drang bzhag dang / blo gzu bor gnas pa'i thog nas go bsdur bya rgyu zhig byung na lam seng khas ma blangs kyang / nga tshos bshad pa de ma red brjod thabs med pa zhig tan tan chags kyi red/ gdan sa gsum dang 'dra ba'i bslab pa slob gnyer mthil phyin rgyag mkhan zhig byung na/ cesas khas mi len mkhan gyi mi zhig yin kyang shes yon gyi bsti gnas shig 'dug bsam gyi red/ nga rang tsho rgya gar byang brgyud khul sdod mkhan sto gnam gshis rgyaba'i sdug bsngal ni myong dgos med/ mthun rkyen yanga.a'u tsam yod pas slob gnyer la chog shes ma byas par 'bad brtson byed dgos/ dge 'dun pa tshos nges par du thugs khur bzhes rogs/ de gal chen po red/de nas rgya gar byang brgyud la yod pa'i la dgas pa dang / bal yul nang shar pa dang / snye shang pa/ de bzhin 'brug pa sogs mang po zhig slebs 'dug nga tsho bod par cha bzhag na so so'i lung pa bral nas mi'i lung par gyar ba dang / so so'i lung pa ni kha thabs skyo thag chod chags te mi rigs kho rang rtsa med 'gro ba'i nyen kha'i mtshams la slebs yod/ khyed rang tsho rang so so'i 325

lung par bsdad rgyu yod pa 'di bskal ba bzang po red/ dad pa byed sa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos tshul 'di ngas gong du brjod pa bzhin spas dag po yong thabs yul so sor yod pa'i dgon pa chos 'bad brtson byedag dgos pa dang /yul pa tshos yin na yang dgon pa de tsho bslab pa slob gnyer gyi thog nas 'gro thub rgyur do snang byed dgos/ lhag par yul mi so so'i ngos nas chos shes pa byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ de gcig lab snying 'dod byung /da lam 'dir phyi rgyal gyi mi gang la gang 'tsham zhig slebs 'dug khyed rang tsho phal mo che rtsa ba ye shu'i chos lugs dar sa'i lung pa'i mi red/ yin na'ang so so'i khams dang mos pa'i thog nas nang pa'i chos la bro ba zhig rnyed nas do snang byed kyi yod/ dngos gnas khams dang mos par 'tshams pa'i nang pa'i chos ran zhing 'phrod pa zhig byas na so sor phan gyi red/ rjes su yi rangs yod/ yag po red/ bod kyi theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa'i nang pa'i chos 'di dag nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs la khyed chos dril bsgrags byas pa dang / dpe deb bris pa de 'dra'i thog nas dngos brgyud kyi phan thogs byung bar rjes su yi rangs yod/ de gal chen po mthong gi 'dug de nas bod nang la bstan pa spyi'i las 'gan gang 'dra zhig bsgrub dgos zhe na/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir srid byus phran bu gu yangs su btang ste dza drag dang / dam bsgrags de tsam med pa dang / dpal 'byor 'du 'god byed pa'i gnas stangs phran bu bzang du btang ba de 'dra'i thog nas de tsam gyi bsam blo 326

gting zab po gtong mi thub mkhan tshos da cha 'di tsam min nam/ yag po 'dug ces shod rgyu zhig bzos/ rtsa ba'i bod don la bsam blo gting zab gtong mkhan tsho la dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas dam pos dam bcings rnag thog gtsags 'khel byed pa'i srid byus gting gnag po zhig slebs yong gi 'dug des na dge bshes 'ban gung rgyal gyis kho bsgrims na nga bsgrims/ kho ltod na nga ltod gsungs pa bzhin ma byas na bod spyi pa'i don gyi gnas stangs de gzhi lci ru 'gro gi 'dug de la dpags pa'i nga tshos rig pa bsgrim rgyu gal chen po 'dug lhag par khyed tsho bod nas yong mkhan tshos rig pa bsgrim rgyu shin tu gal che/ dmar 'don byas nas bshad na 'phral sel gyi don dag la chog shes byed rgyu med/ de la mgo 'khor rgyu med/ deng sang bod nang yar rgyas gang la gang 'tsham 'gro gi yod pa dang / gu yangs srid byus kyang gang la gang 'tshams zhig/ yod/ yin na' nga de snur rgya mi'i cesag mchan thob nas byung ba zhig yin dus/ rtsa ba'i thag gcod kyi dbang cha da lta rgya mi'i lag par yod/ bod pa'i bde sdug rgya mi'i snying rje sbar stod lta bu chags yod pas nad theg thabs med/rtsa ba'i na tsha de shes dgos/ nga tsho'i dka' ngal shes dgos/ de ngos 'dzin thub pa bya rgyu de gal chen po yin/ deng sang bod lung pa'i nang rgya mis chos dad rang mos shig sprad yod/ chos dad phran bu byed chog pa'i 'og nas chos kha yam yam la phyin te phyag 'tshal skor sbyong byed pa de 'dra tsam la chog shes kyis mgo 'khor na mi 'grigs/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa de tshor slob sbyong byed pa'i go skabs med pa'i 327

thog la so sos kyang do snang ma byas pa de 'dra'i mu la phyin na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos bsreg gtub 'pher ba yag po 'di rmongs dad ma yin kyang slob sbyong yag sngon byed rgyu ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis chos dad de rim bzhin rmongs dad la 'gyur rgyu'i nyen kha zhig mthong gi 'dugade nas bod kyi rig gzhung yar rgyas skor la/ de snga bod mi rigs 'di ches rjes lus dang / ches mun nag ches gdug rtsub/ ches kla klo red ces dma' 'bebs chen 11 byas yod/ deng sang bod mi rigs bsngags brjod 'os pa red masngageg mdog bshad nas bod kyi rig gzhung la gang la gang 'tshams kyi mthong dang / do snang / rtsi 'jog byed pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan gyi 'dug de yang rgya mis phran bu'i rang dbang sprad pa de ma gtogs/ rgya mi kho rang tshos 11da par gzhen bskul byas mi yong bsam pa dran gyi 'dug bod par sha tsha ba phal cher khag po red/ kha nas spun zla mi rigs zer gyi yod kyang ngo thog don la khag po red/ deng sang nga rang tsho'i ngos nas go skabs de bzung ste rig pa bsgrim nas chos slob sbyong byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ de bzhin deng sang gi go skabs de bzungs nas bod yig la dang bstod kyis shugs chen po rgyag gi yod bzo 'dug dngos gnas rjes su yi rangs yod/ bod mis se so'i yi ge la dang bstod byas nas bod yig phyug tu btang thog bod kyi gzhas dang / rnam thar dang / cha lugs de tshor do snang gis slob sbyong byas nas de dag sra thag thag yong ba byed dgos/ de'i thog la deng dus kyi shes yon spyong dgos pa ni/ gong du dgon pa tsho'i nang la'ang deng dus shes yon sbyong dgos 328

zhes bshad yod pa ltar/ de de bzhin bod nang gi gzhon skyes tshos kyang so so'i chos dang rig gzhung gang thub sbyangs pa'i jog deng dus kyi shes yon la nges par du do snang byed dgos/ de 'dra byed ma thub na chos dad de slongs dad la 'gyur/ bod mi rigs glen lkug la 'gyur/ yul lung de rgya yul du 'gyur ba bcas yong rgyu red/ phar phyogs nas deng rabs can bzhi la bsgyur dgos bsgo kyi yod kyang / tshur phyogs la gong gsal 'gyur ba gsum ṣ+pe yong rgyu'i nyen kha chen po 'dug gzab gzab byed dgos/ chos la dad pa yod pa gcig pus mi 'grigs/ chos kyi lta ba gang 'dra yin/ spyod pa gang 'dra yin/ de la phugs kyi rgyu mtshan gang 'dug 'phral gyi rgyu mtshan gang 'dug dgos pa gang zhig 'dug tshan rig gi thog nas gang 'dra bshad kyi yod/ nang pa'i chos nas gang 'dra bshad yod/ de la 'gal ba gang 'dug mthun pa gang 'dug de tsho shes na dngos gnas chos kyi gzhi rtsa tshugs yong rgyu yin pas gal chen po 'dug slob sbyong la do snang byas nas so so'i rig gzhung yar rgyas 'gro ba'i bsam blo btang thog deng dus kyi shes yon sbyang nas mi gral la tshud pa byed dgos/ rgya mi'i ngos nas rang skyong zhes bshad kyi yod/ rang skyong zer ba ltar bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos 'bur thon du yod pa de bzung thub pa bya dgos/de ltar byung na rang zhes pa'i don dag de tshang gi yod pa red/ bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos 'bur thon gyi rnam pa de brlag pa yin na/ rtsam pa za shes tsam zhig la ha las rgyu med/ shes song ngam/ bod mi rigs kyi rnam pa thun mong ma yin pa so so'i chos dang rig gzhung dang 'brel nas yod pa de tsho 'dzin dgos 329

pa ha cang gal chen po 'dug rang gi lung pa so sos skyong ba'i rang skyong mtshan nyid tshang ba gcig yong bar mi la 'jon thang yod dgos/ chang 'thung shes pa dang / tha mag 'then shes pas 'grig gi yod pa ma red/ so so'i lung pa'i las ka so sos 'jon pa byas nas rgya mis bod par khag bzhag sa med pa zhig dang / btang 'gro bzhag sdod 'pher ba'i 'jon thang yod pa zhig so sos byed dgos/ gzhan gyis bod pas mi 'jon pa'i kha 'phang lag 'phyis byed sa chags na de yag po mi 'dug nges par du gzab gzab byed dgos/de'i thog la bod nang la rgya mi mang po zhig slobs yong gi yod pa de la ha cang do snang dang gzab grung byed dgos/ rtsa ba'i mi rigs kho rang brlag rgyu dang / so so'i lung pa'i nang gi yul mi grangs nyung chags rgyu'i nyen kha'i thog la slebs pa'i dza drag gi gnas tshul 'di sel thabs bya rgyu gtso bo nga tsho phyi la yod pa tsho'i las 'gan yin/ 'on kyang bod la yod mkhan tshos kyang de'i thog la nyams zhib do snang byed dgos/ bod kyi rang dbang zhes pa 'di chab srid kyi skad cha tshig skam po zhig min par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba'i don zhig chags yod/ da phan de'i don la mi mang pos lhag bsam rnam dag gi jog nas dka' las brgyab ste mi mang po shi ba dang / mang po zhig gis dka' ngal tshad med myangs yod/ kho tshos de ltar byas par byas rjes kyi gsol ras dang / rngan pa sprod rgyu med kyang dngos gnas bstan pa bsams nas dka' las brgyab pa yin dus bsod nams chen po bsags yod/ de 'dra yin dus/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin chab srid rang rigs slad/ /gces 330

pa'i lus srog longs spyod yongs btang ste/ /dka' ba brgya phrag sgrub pa'i skye bo rnams/ /gyu 'dzin mgon des thugs rjes skyong bar mdzod/ ces ngas bden tshig smon lam nang gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ dka' ngal myangs pa don med du ma song bar 'bras bu bzang po zhig tan tan yong gi red/ da lta phan chad la dngos gnas dka' las brgyab pa de tshor rjes su yi rangs yod la/ ma 'ongs par yin na'ang tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don dag bsgrub rgyur shugs brgyab na de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba yod dus bsod nams chen po gsog gi red/ tshang mas de rtsis bsam blo yag po gtong dgos/bod don 'di bstan pa dang 'brel ba yod pas tshogs gsog rgyu gal chen po red/ de yang thog mar rgya chen po ma byung yang ma ṇi dung phyur 'dra gsog thub na yag po red/ bar lam bod nang lha sa dang / khams khul/ a mdo khul bcas la yul tsho yul tsho dang / sger so so byas nas ma ṇi dung phyur gsog mkhan mang po byung 'dug pa ha cang yag po red/ ma ṇi dang / badz+ra gu ru yag po bsags na nga rang cho'i bsod nams kyi rgyab rten thog phan thogs chen po yod/de'i thog sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad pa mdor na bon dang bcas pa tshang ma mthun po byed dgos pa las/ chos dang lung pa'i phyogs ris byed rgyu med/de gal chen po zhig mthong gi 'dugade nas nga rang mi rtsa ba'i bod don skor gang 'dra byed kyi red dam zer na/ ngas rtag tu brjod mus bzhin mi la sems shugs yod na tan tan bden mtha' gsal gyi red/ bod mi rigs zhes pa 'di lo stong phrag mang po'i nyams 331

myong yod pa'i mi rigs shig dang / skyid sdug mang po myong ba'i mi rigs shig yin/ deng sang 'dzam gling thog lung pa gcig la lung pa gzhan zhig gis dbang yod shod pa'i dus tshod de yol zin/ rgya nag la cha bzhag na'ang deng sang 'gyur ba mang po zhig 'gro gi yod/ gtso ba nga rang tsho bod mi rigs kyi sems shugs ma brlag pa'i thog nas bden don gyi 'thab rtsod 'di sems thag chod po dang /snying stobs zhum med kyi sgo nas rgyun bsrings byas na bden pa'i mtha' tan tan gsal gyi red snyam pa rtag tu dran gyi 'dug khyed pho tshang ma blo bde po gyis/da lta'i dus stod 'di thag gcod byed pa'i dus stod cig phal cher red mi 'dug/gang yin zhe na/ rgya nag gi rtsa ba'i srid byus 'gyur ba de da lta brtan po zhig mi 'dug da dung gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig gi thog tu 'gro gi yod med mi shes/ma gzhi rig gnas gsar brje lta bu zhig byed 'dod kyang de ltar byed thub thabs med pa rgya mi tshos shes yod/ yin na'ang 'gyur ba mang po zhig 'gro bzhin pa'i rkyen gyis da lta gdengs 'khel po zhig mi 'dug byas tsang da lta thag gcod byed pa'i dus tshod min par nyams zhib byed pa'i dus tshod red ces ngas bshad yod/ ngas de rang mthong gi 'dug ma 'ongs par gang 'dra zhig yong mi yong zer ba de nga rang tsho'i sems shugs la rag lasayod/ da lta phan sems shugs dang mi rigs kyi lta ba ha las pa zhig yod thog chos lugs la dad pa chen po 'dug de bzhin rgya mi'i las byed dang / gung phran tang yon mang po zhig dang / lhag par slob gra thon pa'i gzhon skyes sogs rgya mi'i zhi drag las khungs nang las ka byed mkhan de sto so so'i mi rigs kyi don la thug dus dngos gnas 332

sems shug sa ha las pa 'dug de tshor rjes su yi rangs yod/ chos la dad pa yod med ni so so sger gyi gnad don yin pas khyad par mi 'dug na ning yang brjod rgyu byung / rgya mi'i las byed phogs zan bod mi'i nang so so'i mi rigs kyi don la sems shugs med mkhan re gnyis skudad shas che/ 'on kyang mang che ba ni mi rigs kyi don la sems shugs yod pa ha cang gsal thag chod 'dug de la rjes su yi rangs yod/ de nga tsho'i spobs pa dang re ba skye gzhi chags yad/ deng sang dmar po'i btsan shugs kyi 'gro stangs dmangs gtso gcig sdud zer ba'i dmangs gtso ni tshig skam po zhig chags/ gcig sdud zer ba'i gnas stangs der 'gyur ba 'gro gi 'dug sku zhabs ghor sba coba.u ru su'i gtso 'dzin la phebs rjes 'gyur ba mang po zhig 'gro gi 'dug de tsho ya rabs kyi bsam blos 'gyur ba phyin pa zhig yin mdog kha po red la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas dngos yod gnas tshul mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi 'dzugs skrun yar rgyas dang / mi'i spyi tshogs yar rgyas gtong dgos na nges par mi rnams la bsam phod pa dang / shod phod pa/ byed phod pa bcas kyi rang dbang yod dgos/ btsan dbang gi gnas stangs 'og la de ltar byed thub thabs med/mi'i rnam dpyod dang blo gros gsar du 'don sa med na/ spyi tshogs gsar gtod kyi yar rgyas 'gro thabs med/ de 'dra zhig la gung khran ring lugs zhes pa'i ming tshig 'di tan tan 'jug gi yod med mi shes/ deng sang btsan dbang yod pa'i lung pa de tsho'i nang la dka' ngal 'di 'dra zhig 'phrad yod/ lung 333

pa yar rgyas gtong dgos na mi spyang po bzo dgos pa dang / mi sbyang po bzos na de tshos btsan dbang la nyan gyi med pa red/ byas tsang khong tsho byed stangs ma shes par bsdad yod/ yar rgyas gtong dgos na mi'i gsar gtod kyi nus pa 'don dgos/ de la rnam dpyod yod dgos/ rnam dpyod la brten nas mi spyang po bzo dgos/ btsan dbang 'og mig gnyis dang / rna ba gnyis yod kyang de dag re re ma gtogs bed spyod med pa des 'grig gi yod pa ma red/yar rgyas dgos na rang dbang che ru gtong dgos pa de deng sang gi ming tshig gsar pa 'dzam gling spyi'i 'khor phyogs zhes pa'am/ yang na/ mi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi ra rang dbang la dga' po yod pa dang / gsar gtod bya rgyu'i 'dod pa yod pa'i thog de ltar byed pa'i go skabasayod pa zhig spyi'i 'khor phyogs/ chags yod/ der brten nga tsho bod pa'i stobs shugs kyang mtshon cha ma yin par bden don yin par brten nga tsho'i gnas babs je bzang du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rim pas bden mtha' gsal rgyu yin par nga la yid ches gtsang ma yod /de lugs tshang mas 'bad brtson hur thag byed dgos/ zhes bka' stsal// //334

༄7// phyi lo 1987 zla 3 tshes 15 nyin/ chos rwar skyes rabs gsung chos kyi sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad stsal ba/de ring nga tsho 'dir tshogs te dran gso zhig byed kyiyod pa red/ thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba ston pa bka' drin can mnyam med shākya seng ges zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i chos tshul mtha' yas pa zhig bka' 455 bas smra ba zla med dang / ston mchog bla na med par gyur pa de sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i rjes su mu stegs pa dang cho 'phrul 'gran pa'i sgo nas skye 'gro dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad pa'i lo rgyus cho 'phrul chen i dus chen 'di la nga tshos rjes dran byed kyi yod pa red/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs la yang 7rgyal ba'i bstan pa sngar med gsar du tshugs/ de mi nyams par gong nas gong du spel te dus yun ri nga po zhig gnas pa red/ phyis su 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos cho 'phrul smon lam gyi 'dus tshogs lha sar gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ de 'dra'i phyag srol de dus phyis bar la gnas pa red/ bar lam bod gangs can ljongs la nyams nyes shin tu chen po zhig byung nas de snga phan chad kyi gnas tshul mang po zhig nga rang tsho'i dran pa'i yul tsam ma gtogs med pa'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhig tu gyur pa red/ nga tsho btsan byol la yod mkhan tshos phyi lo 1970 tsam nas 'dir smon lam gyi dus chen 'di'i rgyun zin pa dang / gdan sa tsho'i nang la yang de de bzhin cho 'phrul smon lam gyi dus chen khyad par can 'di la ston pa'i rjes dran byed kyi yod/ na ning nas lha sar yang smon lam stabs bde zhig tshugs pa red/ gnas tshul 335

khag po red de yin na yang de tshugs pa tsam yang yag po red/ gang ltar yang snying nga rang tsho'i sangs rgyas kyi dus chen khyad par can zhig yin pa red/ spyir nga rang tsho'i mi tshe gang po dang / yang sgos ston pa'i mdzad pa rnam thar dang 'brel ba'i dus chod khyad par can 'di tsho'i skabs la nga rang tshos dge ba gsog sgrub gang mang byed thub pa byung na dus tshod kyi cha nas 'gyur khyad chen po yod pa red/ dus tshod 'di'i ring la ston pa'i chos tshul zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i don la ga tshod thub thub kyi dpyad 'jog zung 'brel gyi sgom 'dra rgyag thub na phan yon chen po yod pa red/ mang tshogs nas de 'dra ma byung na yang / thub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dran pa'i thog nas thub pa'i mtshan sngags 'dra bsags te dge sgrub bya gi yin na yag po yong rgyu red/ de lta bu'i rjes dran byed dgos pa'i ston pa 'di la dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos gang yod dam snyam na/ de yang 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos/ bstan pa'i ngang tshul shes nas ston pa la/ yid ches rnyed pas rtag tu gang bar shog ces gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa gang zhig yang dag pa zhig yin nam min/ khyad du 'phags pa'i khyad chos gang 'dra yod med de gang gi thog nas blta dgos zer na/ spyir sku'i yon tan/ gsung gi yon tan/ thugs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan de 'dra'i thog nas brtag dpyad bya rgyu yong mdog kha po red de yin na yang / nga rang tshos mthong chos su yod pa'i gnas tshul nas bshad na/ gsung rjes bstan gyi cho 'phrul zer na'ang rung / gang ltar yang snying ston pa gang gis gsungs pa'i gsung de la brtag dpyad byas nas de'i gsung de gzhan las khyad du 'phags 336

pa zhig dang / bsam blo gtong sa yod pa/ rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yod pa yin na de ston mkhan gyi ston pa de tshad thub yin par ngos 'dzin dgos pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / chos tshul 'di dag nga rang chos shes dgos pa yin/de ni/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ mdor bsdus nas bshad na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni/ sdig pa spangs/ dge ba sgrub/ de lta bu'i sdig pa slong zhing dge ba sgrub pa de yang rtsa ba kun slong sems la thug pa yin pas rang gi sems rgyud 'dul dgos pa de yin/ rdo don yang snying phyi'i ltar snang 'dra chags chags tsam ma yin par/gasdu bo nang gi sems rgyud dul ba'i thog nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyes spyod mtha' dag bkag ste rab tu zhi zhing dul ba zhig dgos/ rab la byung na gzhan la phan btags/ mtha' ma gzhan la phan btags ma thub na yang gzhan la gnod 'tshe mi byed mkhan zhig nges par du byed dgos/ 'di 'dra'i bslab bya ston mkhan zhig la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zer ba yin/ de yang sdig pa spong dgos pa dang / dge ba sgrub dgos don gang yin nam zer na/ nga rang sto tshang ma sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang bde skyid 'dod kyi yod pa red/ bde sdug zer rgyu 'di rang rang gi rgyu la brten nas yong gi yod pas/ nga rang tsho sdug bsngal mi 'dod patsho yin dus sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa spong dgos pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa yin tsang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba de dwang du blangs te bsgrub dgos par gsungs pa yin/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la sngon ma lo stong phrag lnga drug 337

nang nas bzung phyi nang gi ston pa 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig byung yod/ lhag par rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la yang ston pa 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig byung ba yin pa red/ de 'dra'i ston pa rang rang gis grub mtha' 'dra mi 'dra mang po gsungs yod/ deng sang dus rabs nyi shu pa 'di'i nang la yin na yang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la lta ba mi 'dra ba/ lta ba de dang 'brel ba'i spyod tshul mi 'dra ba mang po zhig yod mus red/ sdig pa spangs/ dge ba sgrub dgos pa'i bslab bya zhig phyi nang gi ston pa mang po'i gzhung gi nang la gsungs yod/ sdig pa ma byed/ dge ba sgrub ces pa'i tshig 'di 'dra po yod na yang sdig pa ngos 'dzin stangs dang / dge ba ngos 'dzin stangs la khyad par yong rgyu red/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos tshul 'di gang 'dra zhig gi thog nas khyad par thon gyi yod dam zer na/ rang gi sem/sa ni yongs su 'dul/ zhes gtso bo rang gi sems rgyud btul ba'i steng nas sdig pa spong rgyu dang / dge ba bsgrub dgos par gsungs yod/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos 'di lta ba dang / spyod pa gnyis su bshad chog gi red ces ngas nam rgyun bshad pa ltar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi spyod pa ni/ rab la gzhan la phan btags/mtha' ma gzhan la gcesad pa mi bskyel ba 'di nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos pa tsho'i spyod pa yin/ de ltar sdig pa sgong / dge ba sgrub gsungs pa'i sdig pa'i don ni/ bya ba'i ngo bo gzhan la gnod pa'i rang bzhin can gyi rgyu de sgrub pa 'i gnas skabs la/ gzhan gang yang rung ba zhig la sdug bsngal bskyed par byed pa/ sdug bsngal bskyed par byas pa de'i 'bras bu la/ las de gsog mkhan 338

nang nas bzung phyi nang gi ston pa 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig byung yod/ lhag par rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la yang ston pa 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig byung ba yin pa red/ de 'dra'i ston pa rang rang gis grub mtha' 'dra mi 'dra mang po gsungs yod/ deng sang dus rabs nyi shu pa 'di'i nang la yin na yang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la lta ba mi 'dra ba/ lta ba de dang 'brel ba'i spyod tshul mi 'dra ba mang po zhig yod mus red/ sdig pa spangs/ dge ba sgrub dgos pa'i bslab bya zhig phyi nang gi ston pa mang po'i gzhung gi nang la gsungs yod/ sdig pa ma byed/ dge ba sgrub ces pa'i tshig 'di 'dra po yod na yang sdig pa ngos 'dzin stangs dang / dge ba ngos 'dzin stangs la khyad par yong rgyu red/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos tshul 'di gang 'dra zhig gi thog nas khyad par thon gyi yod dam zer na/ rang gi sem/sa ni yongs su 'dul/ zhes gtso bo rang gi sems rgyud btul ba'i steng nas sdig pa spong rgyu dang / dge ba bsgrub dgos par gsungs yod/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos 'di lta ba dang / spyod pa gnyis su bshad chog gi red ces ngas nam rgyun bshad pa ltar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi spyod pa ni/ rab la gzhan la phan btags/mtha' ma gzhan la gcesad pa mi bskyel ba 'di nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos pa tsho'i spyod pa yin/ de ltar sdig pa sgong / dge ba sgrub gsungs pa'i sdig pa'i don ni/ bya ba'i ngo bo gzhan la gnod pa'i rang bzhin can gyi rgyu de sgrub pa 'i gnas skabs la/ gzhan gang yang rung ba zhig la sdug bsngal bskyed par byed pa/ sdug bsngal bskyed par byas pa de'i 'bras bu la/ las de gsog mkhan 338

rang nyid sdug bsngal myong dgos pa zhig red/ de 'dra ba'i las la sdig pa zer ba yin/ yang / las gang gsog pa'i gnas skabs su gzhan la yid du 'ong ba'i tshor ba ston mkhan/ gzhan gyi yid la bde skyid bskyed byed/ gzhan la phan pa'i las can/ las 'di sgrub pa'i gnas skabs su gzhan la phan btags pa yin dus/ 'di'i 'bras bu rang thog la smin yong bas rang nyid la bde ba 'byung ba yin/ de 'dra'i las de la dge ba zer/ ma mtha' na yang gzhan la gnod pa mi byed rgyu 'di nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i spyod pa yin/ 'di lta bu'i spyod pa de nga rang tsho phyi nang thun mong ba red ces ha lam lab chog pa red/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la yod pa'i chos lugs mang po zhig gi nang mi la phan btags dgos pa dang / mi la gnod pa mi byed pa zer ba'i bslab bya gcig gyur mang po yod pa red/ 'on kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gang 'dra zhig gi thog nas thon gyi yod pa dang / de 'dra'i 'tshe ba mi byed par gzhan la phan btags dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de ga 'dra zhig la thug yod dam zer na/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos spyi dang / lhag par rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel bayod pa'i dngos po'i chos de rnams rten 'byung gi rang bzhin can du bshad pa 'di yin/ gcarwa nga nga rang tsho la phan gnod yong mkhan gyi tshor ba bde sdug de rnams rgyu med pa las byung ba min par rgyu las byung ba dang / rgyu de yang mi mthun pa'i rgyu las byung ba min par rigs mthun pa'i rgyu zhig las yong dgos pas na/ rang gi sems rgyud 'dul dgos gsungs pa ma gtogs/sdug bsngal dang bde ba phyogs gzhan dag gcig nas yong rgyu min pa red/ so 339

so'i rgyud ma dul ba'i dbang gis sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang / so so'i rgyud zhi zhing dul ba zhig bzos pa'i thog nas bde ba thob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ zhes gsungs pa yin/ nga rang tsho la sems zer ba de ji 'dra zhig yod dam/ phyi'i snod kyi bkod pa dang / nang bcud kyi sems can/ nang gi tshor ba bde sdug de dag sems rgyud la 'brel ba ji ltar yong gi yod dam snyam na/ de bsam blo mang po gtong dgos pa'i gnad don zhig yin/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'byung gi lta ba zhes pa 'dis tshor ba bde sdug gis mtshon pa'i nga rang tsho la phan gnod yong mkhan gyi chos 'di thams cad rang rang gi rgyu rkyen tsam zhig la brten nas 'byung bar bshad yod/de yang go bde bar bshad pa yin na/ spyir 'khor ba'i bde sdug gi chos 'di dag gi yong stangs 'jig rten bkod pa po'i blo'i g.yo ba sngon du btang ste byung ba ma yin par rang rang gi rgyu rkyen tsam la brten nas byung bar gsungs/de yang rten 'brel gyi mdo'i skabs su bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis 'di yod pas 'di yod/ 'di skyes pas 'di skyes gsungs pa 'di shin tu gnad 'gag chen poyin pa red/ gang ltar yang snying rgyu dang rkyen cig yod pa'i dbang gis 'bras bu bde sdug sna tshogs byung ba dang / de yang yod pa tsam gyis mi chog par rgyu 11 rang yang rkyen la brten nas skye dgos pa yin/ rgyu rtag pa gcig gis 'bras bu bde sdug skye mi thub/ rkyen byed mkhan de yang rgyu gzhan zhig las skye dgos par brten mi rtag pa'i rkyen las byung bar gsungs/ 'di skyes pas 'di skyes zhes bde sdug skyed byed kyi rgyu yang rgyu gcig la brten nas skye dgos pa tsam du 340

ma zad/ rigs mthun pa zhig gi rgyu la brten nas skye dgos pas/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed gsungs pa yin/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos rten 'byung gi rang bzhin can yin pa las/ phyi'i byed pa lnga gzhan zhig gis byas pa ra mi 'dod/ nga rang tsho'i sems rgyud dul ma dul gyi thog nas bde sdug 'di dag 'byung bar bshad pa yin/ de yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos spyi'i 'gro stangs kyi cha nas bshad na/ spyir don gang dang gang yin na yang yod pa da nga / med pa gnyis su thag bcad dgos/ tshad mas dmigs pa zhig yin na/ rang 'jog byed kyi blo yod pa dang / rang sgrub byed kyi tshad ma yod pa'i steng nas yod pa zhes zer gyi yod/ rang sgrub byed kyi tshad ma med na med pa zer/ der brten tshad mas dmigs pa de yod pa dang / tshad mas ma dmigs pa de med par 'dod/ tshad ma zer rgyu 'di la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung grub mtha' so so'i thog nas 'dra min mang po zhig bshad kyi yod red de/ gang ltar nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' rig pa'i dpyad pa byas nas dpyad pa mthar phyin pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad yong dus 'jog byed tshad ma de yang gzhal bya la brten nas yong dgos pa dang / gzhal bya de yang 'jog byed la brten nas yong mkhan/ phan tshun ltos pa'i sgo nas yong ba zhig bshad kyi yod/gang ltar yod pa dang med pa ji ltar thag gcod stangs skor la phran bu go bde bar brjod na/ nga rang tsho'i sems can gyi blo dang 'brel nas snang ba'am/ myong ba'i sgo nas tha snyad du grags shing grub pa/ tha snyad du grags pa tsam yin na yang de la tha snyad dpyod pa'i blo gzhan zhig gis gnod kyi yod na mi 'grigs/341

phyi nang grub mtha' mang po zhig gi nang la 'dzam bu gling leb leb yin pa dang /dkyil la ri'i rgyal po ri rab yod par bshad yod/ mngon pa mdzod nang gsungs pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag gi 'gro stangs kha shas spyir tha snyad du grub mtha'i dbang gis grags nas bsdad yod pa red/ 'on kyang grags pa'i don de la deng sang brtag dpyad mang po zhig byas pa'i snying por 'dzam bu gling ril ril yin pa dang / nyi zla'i mtho dma' la cha mtshon na yang nyi ma shin tu thag ring ba yod pa sogs mthong chos kyi tshad gzhal/ rtsis rgyab de 'dra'i thog nas gtan la phab pa'i tha snyad pa'i tshad ma gzhan zhig gis gnod yong dus tha snyad du grags tshul sngon ma de nga tshos khas len thub thabs med pa red/ spyir tha snyad du grags pa yin pas ma tshad/ grags pa'i don de la tha snyad pa'i tshad ma sdus gzhan zhig gis mi gnod pa zhig dbe|sa/ rigs 'ga' shas kyis dpyad pa gang 'tshams byas te dpyad pa byas pa'i dpyad mthar btags don btsal nas rnyed pa'i lugs su bzhag gi yod pa/ dper na/ ye shu'i chos sogs nas 'jig rten bkod pa po bshad kyi yod/ 'jig rten bkod pa po zer rgyu 'di rgyu dang rkyen gang gis kyang ma byas par stod bcud thams cad kyi byed pa po/ smo bcud thams cad kyi bdag po/ gcig pu yin pa/ kun la khyab pa/ rang dbang ba 'di 'dra zhig chags yong dus 'di lta bu'i rnam gzhag 'di 'dra zhig khas blangs pa yin na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs gzhir bzhag rig pa rang gi thog nas brtag dpyad byas pa yin na 'gal 'du mang po zhig yong rgyu red/ de lta bu'i 'jig rten bkod pa spro zhig yod pa yin na/ dbu ma'i gzhung 342
