gi tha snyad dam/ dbu ma'i gzhung gi chos skad nas bshad pa yin na de bden grub chags bsdad yod/ de la don dam dpyod byed kyi rig pas gnod kyi yod pa red/ yod pa dang med pa'i thag gcod tshul yod pa de ji 'dra zhig bzhag dgos zer na/ tha snyad du grags pa yin mkhan/ de la tha snyad pa'i blo gzhan zhig gis mi gnod pa/ de la don dam dpyod byed kyi rig pas kyang mi gnod pa'i steng nas yod par 'jog dgos/ yod pa de la res 'ga' 'byung ba yang mang po zhig 'dug dper na nga rang tsho'i rtsi shing me tog 'di tsho'i gras dus gcig la skyes/ dus gcig la me tog shar gyi yod red/ dus gcig la 'gag 'gro gi yod pa red/ des ga re'i rtags bstan pa red zer na/ de la rgyu zhig yod pa'i rtags bstan gyi yod pa red/ rigs kha shas rtag tu yod bsdad mkhan de 'dra yang yong gi yod pa red/ yod pa la yang nang gses kyi rigs gnyis yong gi yod pa red/ res 'ga' 'byung ba'am/ res 'ga' skye ba'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas rang grub pa de rgyu gzhan zhig la tos dgos kyi yod pa'i rtags bstan mkhan zhig yod pa yin dus/ yod pa'i chos de la rgyu rkyen la brten pa zhig dang / mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin can/ nga rang tsho la phan gnod 'brel yong mkhan/ de lta bu'i snang zhing srid pa'i chos rgyu rkyen la brten nas yong pa'i chos tshul 'di tsho'i nang la/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ zhes pa'i sems kyang 'di'i nang tshud pa'i dngos po zhig yin pa red/ yang nga rang tsho'i rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i phyi rol gyi chos dang / rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i nang gi chos de la yang gzugs can dang / gzugs can ma yin pa mang po zhig yod/343

don dag yong snying mig gis mthong ba'i rigs gcig mig gis mthong rgyu med par rna bas thos pa'i rigs gcig rigs kha shas myong ba'i bdag nyid tsam zhig ma gtogs rna bas thos rgyu dang / mig gis mthong rgyu med pa'i rigs gcig yod ni yod thag chod red/ de 'dra yin dus nang shes pa dang / r+bhe gzugs can zhes pa gnyis bzhag chog gi med dam/ de lta bu'i phyi nang gi chos rtaganyi sa las/ sems rgyud 'dul dgos zhes pa'i sems ni nang gi shes pa/ myong ba'i bdag nyid/ gsal rig tsam gyi bdag nyid de 'dra zhig yin pa red/ nge 'dra'i chos tshul zhig yod pa de la ji tsam bcos rgyu yod dam med zer na/ nge dbye 'byed cig btang dgos/ rang gi sems rgyud 'dul lugs de sems ma zhi ba'i phyogs de dag nye bar bsal nas zhi ba'am/ nye bar zhi ba bzo dgos pa dang / sems rgyud kyi sku1na tan phan pa'i rang bzhin can de dag ched du gnyer nas sgrub/ ma skyes pa skyes/ tshoskyes pa gong nas gong du spel dgos pa yin/ rtsa ba rgyu rkyen la brten nas byung ba red de/ yin na yang rigs gcig gi rang bzhin gtan nas bcos rgyu med pa dang / rigs gcig ni bsdor+shas rgyu yod pa 'i rigs gcig yod sa red/ 'di'i rnam gzhag ji ltar gtan la phab dges zer na/ nga rang tsho'i lhag mthong chen mo'i nang la rig pa bzhi bshad yo/da pa de gnad 'gag chen po yin sa red/ chos nyid kyi rig pa zhes pa 'di la brtag dpyad cig byed dgos kyi 'dug dper na/ me tsha ba'i rang bzhin dang / chu rlan zhing gsher ba'i rang bzhin du yod pa zer rgyu 'di kho rang gi chos nyid dang /kho rang gi rang bzhin chags yod/ chos nyid kyi rig pa 'di la zer/ de bzhin 344

du shes pa zer ba 'di gsal tsam rig tsam gyi bdag nyid la yod pa de yang kho rang gi chos nyid rig pa yin sa red/ gzugs can zhes pa ni nga rang tsho'i da lta 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi bcud kyi sems can dang / de ga nang bzhin snod kyi bkod pa 'di thams cad yar gtugs pa'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam bu gling 'di dang po chags yong dus kyi rdul phra mo nas 'dus pa la thugagang ltar mngon pa'i gzhung gi skabs nas gsungs pa'i gzugs/ dus 'khor gyi gzhung gi nang la nam mkha'i rdul/ de lta bu'i rdul de gang ltar yang snying 'dzam bu gling thog mar chags rgyu'i rtsa ba'i rgyu cha'am rtsom/ gzhi de yin pa dang /rtsom gzhi de'i thog nas stod bcud kyi 'jig rten chags pa red/ gang ltar gzugs kyi chos ji 'dra zhig yin na yang de las shar/ de las grub/ mthar de'i dbyings su zhig pa yin/ 'di yang phal cher chos nyid kyi rig pa yin sa red/ shes pa gsal rig tsam myong ba'i bdag nyid gcig tu dang po nyid nas grub pa dang / gzugs can gyi chos rnams kyi rtsa ba'i rtsom gzhi mthar gtugs na rdul phra mo zhig la thug pa de khong rang gi chos nyid yin pas/ de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'phrin las dang / sems can gyi las kyi dbang gis bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu yod pa ma red/ de la chos nyid kyi rig pa zer/ deng sang tshan rig pa tshos rtsiyapo5125)zhes par bod skad du dngos khams rig pa zer/nga cho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung gi nang la chos nyid kyi rig pa zhes bshad pa 'di la nang gi chos/ phyi'i chos 'es dbye ba phye rgyu yod/ spyir btang nub phyogs tshan rig pa tshos mig bed spyod byas nas mthong ba zhig dang / reg bya 345

zhig gajor ngar bzungs te rtsis gzhi bskor nas rtsis rgyag pa sogs brtag dpyad byas nas de 'dra'i rnam gzhag bshad kyi yod pa de dag gatho rwa1 gzugs can dang 'brel ba chags yong gi 'dug tsan rig gi sde tshan mang po zhig chos nyid kyi rig pa dang 'brel ba chags bsdad mkhan yang yod sa red/ phyi nang gi dngos po rigs mang po zhig gcig gis gcig la tos pa dang / rang rang gi rgyu dang rkyen la ltos pa'i sgo nas 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba de 'dra'i thog nas phan dang gnod pa'i byed pa 'dra mi 'dra yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i rigs la ltos pa'i rig pa zhes bshad kyi 'dug rgyu dang rkyen la tos nas 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba 'di dag la ltos pa'i rig pa dang / bya ba byed pa'i rig pa zhes bshad kyi yod pa red/ tshan rig gi thog nas rdzas kyi rnam gzhag gam/ nus pa mthar thug pa rnams la chos nyid kyi rig pa'i thog nas brtag dpyad byed kyi yod pa dang / brtag dpyad byas pa de la brten nas rdzas 'ga' zhig phan tshun 'gal zla 'gro ba dang / rdzas 'ga' zhig phan tshun mthun rkyen la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i nus pa 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig gsar du shes kyi yod pa red/ de dag ltos pa'i rig pa dang bya ba byed pa'i rig pa'i thog nas shes pa red/ gang ltar 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la tshan rig bshad pa yin na yang deng sang gzhi rtsa 'di'i thog nas bshad yong gi yod pa red/ nang pa'i chos gtso bor gyur pa'i chos lugs tsho'i thog nas bshad stangs ni/ phyi'i rgyu dang rkyen 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig gi thog nas 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba 'di rtsa ba las dang 'brel bayong gi yod pa dang / las de sems dul ma dul thog nas yong gi yod pa/ rtsa 346

zhig gajor ngar bzungs te rtsis gzhi bskor nas rtsis rgyag pa sogs brtag dpyad byas nas de 'dra'i rnam gzhag bshad kyi yod pa de dag gatho rwa1 gzugs can dang 'brel ba chags yong gi 'dug tsan rig gi sde tshan mang po zhig chos nyid kyi rig pa dang 'brel ba chags bsdad mkhan yang yod sa red/ phyi nang gi dngos po rigs mang po zhig gcig gis gcig la tos pa dang / rang rang gi rgyu dang rkyen la ltos pa'i sgo nas 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba de 'dra'i thog nas phan dang gnod pa'i byed pa 'dra mi 'dra yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i rigs la ltos pa'i rig pa zhes bshad kyi 'dug rgyu dang rkyen la tos nas 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba 'di dag la ltos pa'i rig pa dang / bya ba byed pa'i rig pa zhes bshad kyi yod pa red/ tshan rig gi thog nas rdzas kyi rnam gzhag gam/ nus pa mthar thug pa rnams la chos nyid kyi rig pa'i thog nas brtag dpyad byed kyi yod pa dang / brtag dpyad byas pa de la brten nas rdzas 'ga' zhig phan tshun 'gal zla 'gro ba dang / rdzas 'ga' zhig phan tshun mthun rkyen la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i nus pa 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig gsar du shes kyi yod pa red/ de dag ltos pa'i rig pa dang bya ba byed pa'i rig pa'i thog nas shes pa red/ gang ltar 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la tshan rig bshad pa yin na yang deng sang gzhi rtsa 'di'i thog nas bshad yong gi yod pa red/ nang pa'i chos gtso bor gyur pa'i chos lugs tsho'i thog nas bshad stangs ni/ phyi'i rgyu dang rkyen 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig gi thog nas 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba 'di rtsa ba las dang 'brel bayong gi yod pa dang / las de sems dul ma dul thog nas yong gi yod pa/ rtsa 346

ba de sems la thug giyod par bshad/ gtsang ma bzo sa de yang sems/ gtsang ma bzo mkhan de ya nga sems/ gtsang ma bzos pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug de yang sems kyi steng nas bshad yong dus nang sems rgyud kyi skor de dag nang pa'i chos kyi nang la rgyas po thon gyi yod pa red/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ zhes gsungs dgos don de 'dra yin pa red/ ngas yag po zhig thag bcad nas zhu thub kyi mi 'dug ste/ las dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag rang rang gi rgyu la brten nas rang rang gi 'bras bu sku(nga rgyu de shin tu rgya chen po zhig yin/las bzang ngan gyi tshul la brten nas 'bras bu bde sdug 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba 'di chos nyid kyi rig pa de'i nang nas ji tsam zhig yong gi yod dam/ de nga tshos dbye ba phye dgos pa zhig red/ nang shes pa la mtshon na/ gsal rig tsam gyi bdag nyid kyi shes pa 'di rang rang gi rgyu la brten nas yong ba yin na yang / de las bzang ngan gyi thog nas yong ba zhig phal cher bshad thub sa ma red/ yang sems kyi bye brag mi'i rgyud kyi shes pa zer ba 'di phung po bye brag pa dang sbyar nas bde 'gro'i rnam shes dang / ngan 'gro'i rnam shes zhes bshad pa yin na bsam blo gtong sa yong mdog kha po red/ spyir btang gsal tsam rig tsam gyi bdag nyid 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas rnam mkhyen gyi sa la 'gro mkhan gyi shes pa kho rang la las bzang ngan gyi 'gyur ba ji 'dra zhig yong gi yod dam/ chos nyid rig pa dang / ltos pa'i rig pa de tsho'i nang nas las dkar nag gis byas pa'i phan gachoged kyi 'gyur ba 'gro mkhan de ji tsam zhig yong gi yod dam/ rtsa ba nga rang tsho la gsal tsam rig tsam gyi bdag nyid rnam 347

ba de sems la thug giyod par bshad/ gtsang ma bzo sa de yang sems/ gtsang ma bzo mkhan de ya nga sems/ gtsang ma bzos pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug de yang sems kyi steng nas bshad yong dus nang sems rgyud kyi skor de dag nang pa'i chos kyi nang la rgyas po thon gyi yod pa red/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ zhes gsungs dgos don de 'dra yin pa red/ ngas yag po zhig thag bcad nas zhu thub kyi mi 'dug ste/ las dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag rang rang gi rgyu la brten nas rang rang gi 'bras bu sku(nga rgyu de shin tu rgya chen po zhig yin/las bzang ngan gyi tshul la brten nas 'bras bu bde sdug 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba 'di chos nyid kyi rig pa de'i nang nas ji tsam zhig yong gi yod dam/ de nga tshos dbye ba phye dgos pa zhig red/ nang shes pa la mtshon na/ gsal rig tsam gyi bdag nyid kyi shes pa 'di rang rang gi rgyu la brten nas yong ba yin na yang / de las bzang ngan gyi thog nas yong ba zhig phal cher bshad thub sa ma red/ yang sems kyi bye brag mi'i rgyud kyi shes pa zer ba 'di phung po bye brag pa dang sbyar nas bde 'gro'i rnam shes dang / ngan 'gro'i rnam shes zhes bshad pa yin na bsam blo gtong sa yong mdog kha po red/ spyir btang gsal tsam rig tsam gyi bdag nyid 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas rnam mkhyen gyi sa la 'gro mkhan gyi shes pa kho rang la las bzang ngan gyi 'gyur ba ji 'dra zhig yong gi yod dam/ chos nyid rig pa dang / ltos pa'i rig pa de tsho'i nang nas las dkar nag gis byas pa'i phan gachoged kyi 'gyur ba 'gro mkhan de ji tsam zhig yong gi yod dam/ rtsa ba nga rang tsho la gsal tsam rig tsam gyi bdag nyid rnam 347

par shes pa zer ba 'di la sems byung gi rigs 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig yod pa dang / de tsho'i nang la tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms tshang ma slebs bsdad kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i bde sdug btang snyoms gsum po de dag rang rang gi las dkar nag gi rgyu rkyen de'i rjes su 'brangs na sayong gi yod sa red/ mdo don yang snying da lta ngas zhu dgos don ni/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/zhes gsungs pa'i gnad 'gag de la thug gi yod pa red/ spyir btang gi 'gro stangs 'di 'dra zhig yin pa de gzhi la bzhag pa'i thog nas rtsa ba so so'i sems rgyud dul na bzang wa'i las de 'phel yong ba zhig dang / ngan pa'i las de 'gas 'gro ba de la brten nas 'dod pa'i bde skyid yong ba dang / mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal nyung du 'gro rgyu'i gnas tshul 'di yong gi yod pa red/ skye ba phyi ma thag ring po red/ phar bzhag nga rang tsho'i mi tshe 'di rang gi nang la ji tsam gyi sems rgyud dul po yod pa zhig dang / sems rgyud bag phebs po zhig byung ba yin na skyid po yong rgyu red/ dper na chu tshod nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ring sems zhi zhing dul ba yod pa yin na sems skyid pa/ sems ma dul bar khong khro langs nas bsdad pa yin na lto chas la bro ba med pa/ gnyid yag po khug mi thub pa/ rogs pa tsho la 'khrug pa shor rgyu/ mtha' ma so so rna ba 'jam pa la blta bzo med mkhan/ skad log tshun chad rgyag dgos pa/ gang ltar yang snying ma skyid pa zhig byas nas bsdad dgos pa de nga tshos mthong gsal 'di red/ spyir btang dngul yod na bde skyid yong gi yod pa dang / dbang cha yod na bde skyid yong gi yod pa lta bu zhig blo la shar gyi yod pa red/ de gnyis sdug bsngal bas/la 348

ba dang / bde ba bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen zhig yin na yang / rjes su 'gro ldog gi bde ba sgrub pa'i rgyu ngo ma zhig min pa red/ de ltar yin na rgyu yod na bde ba yod pas khyab pa da nga / rgyu med na bde bas phongs te sdug bsngal gyi mnar rgyu yin pas khyab pa zhig yin dgos tshod la/ de 'dra med pa des phyi'i rgyu dacadas po'i thog nas nang gi bde sdug la phan gnod byed pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo de min pa thag chod pa red/ de rtags mtshan gsal po red/ der brten nga rang tsho rang gzhan su yin na'ang bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i dbang gis bde ba sgrub yag dang / sdug bsngal bsal rgyu'i ched du phyi'i cha rkyen lung par 'dzugs bskrun byed rgyus mtshon pa'i bya ba mang po zhig byed kyi yod pa red la de byed 'os pa dang / byed dgos pa red/ de bzhin du nang sems rgyud kyi steng nas sdug bsngal bsal ba dang / bde bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen ji+oge+o nga pa de dag la yang 'a bad brtson byed 'os pa dang byed dgos pa zhig red/nga rang tsho'i mthong chos la rgyu yod mkhan/ dbang sku(da mkhan la sems skyid po nam yang med mkhan/ sems ma skyid pa'i rkyen byas nas lus mi bde ba'i grog sman rgyun du zas nas sdod dgos pa dang / khag gcig lto gos thog nas skyo po yin na yang dngos gnas sems la zhi bde bag phebs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dga' tshor yod pa/ skyid snang yod pa gcig nga tshos mthong gsal yin/nga rang tsho sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan de'i thog nas sems kyi khyad par gang dang gang gis ma skyid pa bzos yong mkhan de dag bsal thub thabs shig yod na bsal dbesas pa red/ bsal 'os pa red/ sems 349

gang dang gang skyes yong dus sems skyid po dang bag phebs po yong mkhan rigs de dag 'bad brtson bskyed nas sgrub 'os pa zhig red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi nang nas nga cho ma skyid pa bzo mkhan mthar gtugs na nyon mongs zer ba 'di yin par bshad yod/ nyon mongs kyi rigs 'di dag nga rang d+ku rgyud la mngon du gyur yong dus rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag ma skyi da pa bzos yong gi yod pa red/ da lta zhi bde bag phebs yod bsdad mkhan kho de ma thag la ma skyid pa bzos pa'am/ nyon mongs par byed mkhan zhig yin dus nyon mongs zhes ming btags pa red/ nyon mongs zer ba'i tshig gi go ba'am/ don dag ni ma skyid pa byed mkhan zhig yin pa red/ blo gang skyes pa yin na rang nyid ma skyid pa bzo mkhan de la nyon mongs zer/ nyon mongs zer rgyu 'di la skyon mang po yod/ spyir btang mi tshe gcig gi nang la mtshon nas bshad pa yin na/ mi zhig khong khro chen po langs pa yin na khong khro langs pa'i 'bras bu der mi la 'khrug pa rgyag rgyu dang / mi gsod pa la sogs pa byed/ 'dod chags shugs chen po skyes pa yin na des rkyen pas rku ma rku ba dang / log g.yem byed pa la sogs pa 'di 'dra'i thog nas mi che'i nang dka' ngal bzo gi yod/ nga rgyal chen po yod na des rkyen byas nas mi la mthong chung dang / mi la dma' 'bebs byed pa de 'dra'i thog nas so so la gra ma 'grigs thon mkhan 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la yong bzhin pa red/ de bzhin the tshom nyon mongs can skyes yong dus las ka ga re yin na'ang the tshom ngang du lus nas lag len 'khel rgyu med pa mthong gsal 'di red/ spyir btang nga rang tsho'i kha skad la sems thag chod 350

po dgos kyi red ces pa'i bshad srol 'di chos kyi skad ca gcig pu min/ nyon mongs de dag gis 'phral du mi tshe gcig nang la yang nga tsho skyid du ma bcug par sdug po btang gi yod la/ phugs su yang nga tshor gnod chen po skyel gyi yod pas nyon stongs zer rgyu 'di nga tshos dang du len rgyu yod pa ma red/ nyon mongs zer rgyu 'di skyon gyi dug rtsa dug nag yin/ sngon la skye ba phyi ma bshad dgos mi 'dug tshe 'di ga rang la cha bzhag na yang / nyon mongs zhes ming btags pa'i khong khro/ nga rgyal/ 'dod chags/ the tshom 'di tsho'i gras ga chod nyung ba byung na legs pa yod/ bzang wa'i yon tan gyi cha nas sems rgyud zhi zhing dul ba/ phan sems/ byams sems/ bzod bsran/ brtson 'grus/yin lugs min lugs thag gcod pa'i rnam dpyod kyi shes rab la sogs pa 'di dag nga rang tsho'i mi tshe gcig gi nang la ha cang phan thogs yod pa'i dngos spro zhig yin/ dper na/ nga rang tsho'i phyi logs snod kyi bkod pa la cha bzhag na yang phan thogs pa de la nga tshos 'dzugs bskrun zhes ming btags nas mang du spel gyi yod/ phan ma thogs pa'i rigs dper na/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la nad na tsha mang po zhig yong gi yod pa de dag gis mi la sdug bsngal sprod kyi yod stabs na tsha sngon 'gog gi thabs shes sgo gang sa nas byed kyi yod/ de 'os pa red/ de bzhin du 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nga rang tsho mi la dgos pa'i zas gos gnas mal mthun rkyen de dag gis mi 'tsho thabs la phan gyi yod/lus la bde skyid sprad kyi yod/ de brgyud nas sems la bde skyid yong rgyu yod pa red/ de tsho bde ba sgrub pa'i cha rkyen yin par brten mi la phan pa'i rigs 351

de dag 'bad brtson chen po byas nas sgrub kyi yod/ de dag la dgag cha med de dag dgos pa red/ de dag dgos pa'i thog la ga re kha snon rgyag dgos zer na/ nang bsam blo'i nang la tshur kha bskor te bsam gzhigs yag po zhig byed dgos kyi 'dug deng sang 'dzam bu gling la sngon med gsar gtod kyi dngos po mang po yod/ 'on kyang de dang chabs cig mi la sdug bsngal mang du 'a gro gi 'dug mi la dngangs skrag che ru 'gro gi 'dug nad na tsha gsar pa 'dra mi 'dra mang du 'gro gi 'dug de ga re byas pa red dam/ rgyu yod pa gcig pus 'grigs kyi sku(da na rang shi rgyag dgos don mi 'dug rang shi rgyag mkhan nyung du 'gro dgos/ nad na tsha gsar pa de tsho nyung du 'gro dgos/ dmag 'khrus nyung du 'gro dgos pa la da dung dmag 'khrugs mang du 'gro gi 'dug sgog gsod gtong mkhan mang du 'gro gi 'dug rdzun shod mkhan mang du 'gro gi 'dusade dag gis rkyen byas nas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi nyams chung tsho la brdab gsigs mang du 'gro gi 'dug rgyu dngos po gcig pu'i thog nas sdug bsngal sel thub kyi yod na/ da tshod lung pa kha shas la sdug bsngal rmeg med yong ngathos tshod kyang da lta yong thub kyi mi 'dug 'dzam bu gling 'dir dngos gnas drang gnas phyi dngos po yar rgyas ha cang mang po btang yod/ de dgos pa reng de/de gcig pus 'grigs kyi med pa shin tu gsal po yin/ dus rabs nyi shu pa 'dir 'dzam bu gling yar rgyas chen po 'gro gi yod zer ba ltar/ da lnga than 'das pa'i lo brgya phrag gnyis tsam gyi ring la phyi dngos po yar rgyas la shugs ston chen sngo rgyab pa'i 'bras bu la de ring kha sang nga rang tsho'i pha mes tsho'i bsam 352

gyi nang la ma shong ba mang po zhig dngos su nga tshos longs spyod thub kyi yod pa red/ yin na yang da dung nga tsho la rnyog khra dang / dka' ngal mu mthud nas yong gi yod pa yin dus/ de ma yin pa'i thabs shes gzhan zhig e 'dug mi 3dug blta dgos pa red/ blta 'os pa red/ bltas na gyong yod pa ma red/ gcig byas na nga tsho la thabs shes shig rnyed mdog kha po red/ bar skabs mi tshos phyi'i gnas tshul la brtag dpyad mang po byas nas da cha mi'i shes bya'i gnas tshad mtho por slebs yod/ dper na/ deng sang tshan rig pas rdu zhwa/ phran phra mo'i rnam gzhag bshad yong dus/ nga rang tsho'i snga mo nang pa'i gzhung na nga la gsungs pa'i rdzas phra mo'i rnam gzhag de tsho'i gras ha cang rags pa red/kho tsho zhib tshags che ba yod/ de bzhin dus la cha bzhag na yang / nga tshos dus mtha'i skad cig ma zhes bshad kyi yod/ deng sang 'od lo'i grangs ka brtses nas dus kyi mgrogs tshad bshad pa de tsho shin tu zab po red/ de ltar phyi dngos kro 'i rnam gzhag de dag kho tshos shin tu zhib tshags gtan la phab ste yag po chags yod/ da cha ga res lan gyi 'dug zer na/ mi gajorwa 1ra gyur pa'i sems can zer mkhan de la lus 'di tsam ma yin pa'i rnam par shes pa zhes pa zhig shesad/ rnam par shes pa zer ba 'di mig gis mthong rgyu dang / lag pas reg rgyu zhig ma yin par gsal tsam rig tsam myong ba'i bdag nyid du yod pa red/drode sdug tshang ma 'dis byed pa dang / myong mkhan yang 'di yin pa red/ nga rang tsho la phan gnod byed pa po 'dis byed pa gang la brten nas phan gnod byed sbi/gas de shes dgos/ shes pa la shes pa po'i gang zag de'i byed pa gang gi 353

rkyen gyis shes kyi yod dam zer na/ shes pa dang / rig pa zer ba kho rang gi ngo bo de gsal rig tsam gyi bdag nyid de 'dra zhig yin pa red/ de lta bu'i chos yod dang med dpyad dgos kyi 'dug deng sang de skor brtag dpyad byed mkhan gang 'tshams 'dug dngos khams rig pa bshad mkhan gyi tshan rig pa skad grags yod pa de cho'i gras kyis rdzas kyi rnam gzhag la brtag dpyad byas pa'i mtha' mar/ nga rang tsho'i chos skad la nang rtogs pas tha snyad btags pa la 'brel ba yod pa dang / tha snyad 'dogs stangs kyi khyad par yul de lu 'brel ba yod pa zhig bshad kyi 'dug de 'dra'i tha snyad 'dogs pa po ni gang zag de yin/ gang zag des tha snyad 'dogs pa la de gcig shes pa'i sgo nas 'dogs dgos/ de la go rgyu shin tu chen po yod/ de lta bu'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos can gyi rnam gzhag dang / chos kyi rnam gzhag de dag shes pa'i thog nas rang gi shes rgyud 'dul dgos/ chos thams cad rkyen gyi dbang gis yong mkhan/ rkyen gyi dbang gis yong ba tsam du ma zad pa'i ltos pa'i sgo nas yong mkhan/ ltos pa'i dbang gis yong ba tsam du ma zad/ rten nas btags pa tsam gyi thog nas yong ba zhes bshad yong dus/ rten 'byung gi don phra mo'i thog la slebs kyi yod pa red/ chos thams cad nga rang tsho la rang ngos nas grub pa lta bu zhig snang gi yod na yang / don dngos po'i gnas tshod la rang tshugs thub pa'i sdod lugs shig rtsab nas med par chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa red ces stong nyid kyi don dag bshad kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho la nyon mongs skyes yong dus nyon mongs kyi rtsab blo gang 'dra zhig gi byed kyi yod 354

pa dang /nyon mongs kyi rtsa ba byed mkhan gyi cho de'i 'dzin stangs don la gnas pa yin dang min/ stong pa nyid kyi don bshad pa 'di'i thog nas shes dgos/nga rang tshor chags sdang skye ba'i rtsa ba'i cho de gzhan yul la 'khrul ba'i log shes yin pa nges thub pa zhig byung na de la brten nas chags sdang nyung du 'gro ba la phan gyi red/ de dag gi rnam gzhag gong du zhus pa bzhin nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos mdor bsdus na/ spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa zhig dang / lta ba rten 'byung gi lta ba yin pa nga'i bsam tshod ltar nam rgyun rtag par shod bzhin pa de shes dgos kyi 'dug de ltar shes na bcom ldan 'das zhes ston pa 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi rje sa 'brangs mgone po klu sgrub yab sras/ 'phags pa thogs med yab sras la sogs pa de dag lta ba dang grub mtha' smra mkhan 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba zhig yin spru go rgyu 'dug rtogs rgyu 'dug rtags mtshan gang 'dra zhig dgos kyi red lub na/ so so'i ngos nas spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa de lag len la bkal/ spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa byed rgyu'i rtsa ba'i gnad 'gag rten 'byung gi lta ba la thug pa 'di nga rang tshos shes pa bya rgyu 'di yin/ nga tshos rmongs dad dang / lkug pa'i byed stangs dang / a ma jo bzang gi byed stangs 'dra po byed mi rung / sems bzang po byed dgos pa dang / mi la phan btags dgos zhes dkon mchog gis gsungs pa red/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa red ces de tsam la cha ma bzhag par bzang po byed dgos pa 'di so so'i don dag la thug gi yod pa de shes/ dgos/ sangs rgyas kyis sems bzang po byed dgos gsungs pa de rgyu 355

mtshan zhig la brten nas gsungs pa ma gtogs/ gsung rgyu mang drags nas gsungs pa min/ sems bzang po byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rten 'byung gi don dag la thug pa red/ so so'i sems ngan pa byas na gyong so sor phog rgyu dang / so so'i sems bzang po byas na khe bzang so sor thob rgyu red/ gang yin zer na/ rang la yong rgyu'i bde sdug de gzhan la brten nas yong ba dang /de'i rkyen so so'i sems dul ma dul thog nas bzos yong gi yod pa red/ so so'i sems dul ba'i thog nas rkyen gsar pa zhig bzos/ rkyen gsar pa de 'i dbang gis rang la bde ba yong ba dang / so so'i sems nang chags snang skyes na des rkyen gsar pa zhig bzos/ rkyen gsar pa de'i dbang gis so so la sdug bsngal drangs yong gi yod pa red/ shes song ngam/ sems bzang po dang phan sems byed dgos zer ba 'di chos lugs 'dra min mang po zhig gi nang nas bshad yod/ chos lugs rigs kha shas thog nas sems bzang po byed dgos pa 'di dkon mchog gi bka' red ces bshad yod/ des phan na 'grigs pa red/ yin na yang nang pa'i jog nas bshad stangs ni sems bzang po byed dgos pa 'di dkon mchog gi dgongs pa yin pa gcig pu ma bshad par/ de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan rten 'byung gi don dag la thug par bshad kyi yod/ nga rang tsho'i ngos nas sems bzang po ma byas na/ sangs rgyas la thugs rje mas bu gcig pa la brtse ba nang bzhin gyi brtse ba mthar thug pa yod/ 'phrin las nyer bdun gyis mtshon pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'am/ mtha' med pa zhig yod na yang / gnang 356

thub thabs gang yang yod pa ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las de dag rkyen gyi rang bzhin can/ rkyen la ltos pa yin pa dang / nga rang tsho la rkyen ma tshang na sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las rkyen gzhan gang la yang ltos mi dgos pa'i rang dbang ba zhig min dus/ nga rang tsho so sos 'gul bskyod ma brgyab par sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las gcig pu'i thog nas grol thabs med/ rten 'byung gi lta ba gsungs pa 'dis gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag mang po zhig la 'di'i go ba slebs kyi 'dug bstan pa'i ngang tshul shes nas ston pa la/ yid ches rnyed pas rtag tu gang bar shog ces gsungs don 'di 'dra yin pa red/nga rang tsho ston pa bka' drin can 'di lta bu'i rjes su slob rgyu byung ba yin dus so sos ga stod thub thub kyis nyams len yag 11 byas/ dpe cha yag 11 blta dgos/ so so'i dad pa byed sa'i chos de ma shes na thabs skyo po red/ chos shes pa byed rgyu 'di dpe mi srid pa'i gal chen po red/ rgyu mtshan de'i cha nas spya sar nang la cha bzhag na/ bslab pa slob gnyer yod pa'i gdan sa de dag dngos gnas drang gnas gnad 'gag chen po chags yod/ de min dgon pa gzhan dag mang po yod pa chos dpe cha blta rgyu la dang bstod byed dgos/ yang tshig snam po kha nas bton na yang don dag bsam rgyu med na snying 11 de tsam med/ sgra 'dzin 'khor lo btang ba 'dra po chags kyi red/ nga rang tsho'i dgon pa khag tshos yin gcig min gcig dpe cha blta rgyu la dang bstod byed dgos/dgon pa'i nang gi gra pa tsam ma yin pa'i spyir btang mi mang tsho gin na yang nang pa'i chos shes pa byed dgos/ chos ma shes na nyams len ji ltar byed/ shes 357

pa byed dgos zhes ngas rtag tu shod don 'di red/ nga rang tsho tshang mas dpe cha blta rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ lhag par bod nang la cha bzhag na de ring kha sang phran bu'i srid byus 'gyur ba phyin te chos dad rang mos kyi lha khang bzhengs rgyu dang / dgon pa 'dra bzhengs mkhan 'ga' shas yong gi 'dug yag po red de yin na'ang ngas da gin lab pa bzhin/ lha khang rdzig po yod pa'i thog nas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi khyad chos bstan thub thabs med/ mdor na bcom ldan 'das la mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i sku yod kyang de gcig pu'i thog nas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi khyad chos ston pa dka'/ tshan rig dang mthun ma mthun zer ba yang 'di thog nas bshad dgos/ nyin re nyin re nga rang 'i mi tshe skyel rgyu'i dgos mkho'i nang la phan thogs yod med 'di'i thog nas shes dgos/ deng sang chos dad rang mos yod ces lha khang dang dgon pa bzhengs pa yag po red de/ dpe cha blta rgyu de bas gal chen po red/ lha sa nye skor gyi se 'bras dang / dga' ldan tshor chos sgo phye yod zer gyi yod na'ang dpe cha blta rgyu'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms po yod chod mi 'dug ltos sa ltos phyogs kyi cha nas se ra phran bu drag mdog kha ba 'dug ste/ yin na yang tshad longs pa zhig yong thabs rtsa ba rang nas yod ma red la/ dka' ngal chen po 'dugade bzhin du khyim tshang mi re ngo re'i nang phyag sgam re bzos te de'i steng sku gsung thugs rten sgrig gi yod pa red/ mang che bas bod rang nas bzos pa'i sku dang /rgya gar nas lug brgyab pa'i sku mang po blu yon zhus te bod nang dka' las rgyab nas 'khyer gyi yod red/ rtsa ba so so'i tshogs gsog ched yag po red de/ yin 358

na'ang so so'i shag nang la sku rten zhig gal srid med na yang a'u tsam red/gnad 'gag che ba mi 'dug de las 'phags pa brgyad stong pa dang / ri bo dge lugs pa'i chos byed mkhan yin na lam rim che chung / yang de min na dwags po'i thar rgyan lta bu gang ltar yang snying nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i blo sbyong stangs lam spyi'i rnam gzhag bshad mkhan gyi dpe cha de 'dra zhig med thabs med pa chags bsdad yod/ dpe cha de 'dra zhig so so'i shag la nyar yod na skabs re so sos dus dus la klog zogs pa 'dra yong pa'i skabs la yang 'di nang pa'i dpe cha red ces ngo sprod byas/ de ga nang bzhin mi la'i mgur 'bum yod na yag po red/ de snyan po yod pa la/ bslab bya mang po yod/ de 'dra byas na nang pa'i chos nang 'di 'dra 'dug snyam pa'i do snang gsar pa slebs thub kyi red/ de min mchod gshoms nang la bcom ldan 'das kyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod na yang / nga rang tsho las ma dag pa'i ring la gsung thos rgyu ni med/ 'od 'phro rgyu yang med/ de las gsung rab glegs bam gcig nyar gyi yin na/ des kha zhig bsgrags kyi red/ des na dpe cha la dang bstod byed dgos/ so sos dpe cha blta rgyu gal chen po red/ dpe cha bltas pa tsam du ma zad dpe cha zhig nyar rgyu yang gal chen po red/ sngon ma nas skad cha byung don/ chos zer ba 'di mchod bshom nang bsgrigs rgyu zhig min/ chos zer ba 'di sems rgyud la 'dres dgos rgyu zhig yin/ yang sgos lhag par can du deng sang bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten la dang bstod byas pa yin na gsung rten la dang bstod byas na yag po red/ so sos dpe cha zhig blu yon 359

zhus te nyar/ phyag dang mchod 'bul yang de la byed chog gi red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ 'di ni khyod kyi ston pa'o zhes /rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas pa/ nan tan dge slong chogs mdun bstod/ces so so thar pa'i mdo'i skabs la de 'dra gsungs yod/ bcom ldan 'das rang nyid dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes la nga'i sku tshab dang khyad med de so so thar pa'i mdo 'di yin zhes nan tan gsungs yod/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la cha bzhag na myang 'das kyi le'u zhes pa'i nang ji 'dra gsungs 'dug nga'i sher phyin gyi chos de nub tu ma bcug ces kun dga' bo la nan tan gsungs 'dug 'di la bdag po rgyag dgos zhes ji tsam gal chen po gsungs 'dug nga'i ring sprel bdag po rgyag dgos ma gsungs par nga'i sher phyin bdag po rgyag dgos nan tan gsungs yod pas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i sku tshab/ gsung gi gsung tshab ngo ma dpe cha 'di dag yin/ de ltar na dpe cha la dang bstod yag po byed dgos/ so so'i khang chung de'i nang la dpe cha gcig yod na yag po yod/deng sang nga rang tsho chos zhes pa zhig yod dam med/ chos yod na des phan thogs yod dang med la rtog dpyod byed pa'i dus tshod gcig la slebs yod/sngon la chos kyi rtsa ba'i gnad 'gag ngo sprod byed rgyu gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho dpe cha blta mkhan zhig yin na spyir btang chos shig khas blangs nas chos 'khrid rgyu de las sla po red de/ sngon la so mo'i 'char can gyi goms gshis kyi sgang la bsdad pa ma yin par dngos gnas chos 'di la gnad 'gag ci 'dra 360

zhig yod pa dang / des kha yod lag yod kyi phan thogs ji ltar yod pa nang nas nges pa rnyed na/ dpe cha blta rgyu la don gnyer rang shugs kyis slebs yong gi red/ dpe cha bltas pa'i dgos don yang gshis rgyud 'dul rgyu yin bsam dgos/ snga mo nga rang tsho bod gangs can jongs la skal bzang lugs bzang red/ tshang ma chos khas len pa gzhir bzhag de'i nang tshan nas nang pa'i chos khas len mkhan gzhir bzhag de'i nang nas theg chen khas blangs mkhan gzhir bzhagade'i nang tshan nas sngags bla med khas blangs mkhan gzhir bzhag byas te bshad nyan byed kyi yod/ ngas da gin zhus pa de dag rang dgar gta ma gsar pa bshad pa gang yang min/ gzhung gi nang la yod pa sha stag bshad kyi yod/ yin na'ang deng sang 'dzam bu gling gi gan sa stangs dang bstun nas rdog sgrug brgyab ste bshad pa yin/ gnad don 'di tshor do snang byas na yag po red bsam gyi 'dug der brten chos tshul 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos/ de ston mkhan gyi ston pa bka' drin can de'i rnam par thar pa la rjes su bslab ste nyams len byed kyi yin na 'di phyi tshe rabs kun tu phan pa zhig dang / gnas skabs mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad sgrub thub pa zhig yong rgyu red/ des na cho 'phrul smon lam gyi dus chen skabs la skyes rabs gsung bshad gnang rgyu'i phyag srol bzang po 'di 'dra zhig tshugs pa red/ de yang / sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar/ rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len du 'khyer shes pa zhig dgos pa red/ de ring 'dir skyes rabs kyi le'u dgu pa/ rgyal bu thams cad sgrol zhes pa de zhu gi yin/ gong du zhus 361

pa bzhin sems rgyud 'dul dgos/ sems rgyud ma rung pa byed mkhan gyi rtsa ba nyon mongs par dngos su gnyen po bsten rgyu'i nus pa ma rnyed kyi bar la nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig spyod de dag bkag dgos/ nga rang tsho chos byed mkhan chos rim pa dang por gang byed dgos zer na/ mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims kyi nyams len byed rgyu 'di yin/ mi dge ba bcu ngo shes nas 'di dag spangs te dkar po dge ba'i chos bcu nyams su blangs pa yin na de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi nyams len yin la/mi tshe gcig gi ring la spyi tshogs nang bde 'jags dang / zhi bde/ bag phebs su gnas rgyu'i cha rkyen yang yin/ dper na mi dge bcu'i dang po srog gno yin/ mi bsad pa yin na spyi tshogs nang khrims la sbyor gyi yod pa dang / srog gcod spangs na spyi tshogs la phan gyi yod/ gnyis pa ma byin len te /na ma brkus na khrims la thug gi red/ btson la 'gro dgos/ rku ma brkus na mi'i longs smi la gnod/ mi'i bde skyid dang zhi bde la gar kyi yod pa red/ dper na deng sang khang pa zhig brgyab pa yin na yang / sge'u khung rnams la mdzes po med bzhin du u tshugs rgyab nas lcags khra dang / lcags hreng tshun chad 'dzugs dgos pa ni rkun ma'i nyen srung yin pa red/ de tshun chad nas mi'i zhi bde brlag 'gro gi yod pa dang / mi sdod zos mi bde ba/ mi bag ma phebs pa chags yong gi yod pa red/ rku ma brkus na ha cang gi thabs sdug red/ deng sang mi nyam chung gis rku ma brkus na rku ma/ dbang shugs spongad mkhan zhig gis rku ma brkus na de tsam rang med mkhan/ 'di tsho dpe mi srid pa'i thabs sdug 362

pa bzhin sems rgyud 'dul dgos/ sems rgyud ma rung pa byed mkhan gyi rtsa ba nyon mongs par dngos su gnyen po bsten rgyu'i nus pa ma rnyed kyi bar la nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig spyod de dag bkag dgos/ nga rang tsho chos byed mkhan chos rim pa dang por gang byed dgos zer na/ mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims kyi nyams len byed rgyu 'di yin/ mi dge ba bcu ngo shes nas 'di dag spangs te dkar po dge ba'i chos bcu nyams su blangs pa yin na de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi nyams len yin la/mi tshe gcig gi ring la spyi tshogs nang bde 'jags dang / zhi bde/ bag phebs su gnas rgyu'i cha rkyen yang yin/ dper na mi dge bcu'i dang po srog gno yin/ mi bsad pa yin na spyi tshogs nang khrims la sbyor gyi yod pa dang / srog gcod spangs na spyi tshogs la phan gyi yod/ gnyis pa ma byin len te /na ma brkus na khrims la thug gi red/ btson la 'gro dgos/ rku ma brkus na mi'i longs smi la gnod/ mi'i bde skyid dang zhi bde la gar kyi yod pa red/ dper na deng sang khang pa zhig brgyab pa yin na yang / sge'u khung rnams la mdzes po med bzhin du u tshugs rgyab nas lcags khra dang / lcags hreng tshun chad 'dzugs dgos pa ni rkun ma'i nyen srung yin pa red/ de tshun chad nas mi'i zhi bde brlag 'gro gi yod pa dang / mi sdod zos mi bde ba/ mi bag ma phebs pa chags yong gi yod pa red/ rku ma brkus na ha cang gi thabs sdug red/ deng sang mi nyam chung gis rku ma brkus na rku ma/ dbang shugs spongad mkhan zhig gis rku ma brkus na de tsam rang med mkhan/ 'di tsho dpe mi srid pa'i thabs sdug 362

twa red/ mtshams re snying rje gi 'dug mi skyo po 'ga' zhig kha la za rgyu med/lus la gyon rgyu med nas srog 'tsho tsam gyi don du 'u thug nas rku ma brku gi yod pa red/ de ni rgyas spros kyi don du rku ma brkus pa ma red/ dpon po dang /blon che na la las sgor 'bum phrag 'bum phrag brkus na yang de la brda 'ded de tsam med mkhan 'di shin tu thabs skyo po 'dug 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la drang bden zer rgyu 'di khag po 'dug mi skyo po zhig gis 'u thug nas mi bsad pa yin na lam seng mi bsad lag dmar zhes khrims la sbyar/ btson la bcugayang na srog lan srog 'jal byed dgos/ dpon po zhig gis mi 'bum phrag 'bum phrag bsad pa yin na dpa' bo dang / byas rjes can zer/ dper na 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi bsad mkhan shugs che shos shig ma'o tse tung chags yod/ gsar brje thog mar langs pa nas rig gnas gsar brjes marngo+on pa'i dus phyis kho rang ma shi bar la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi gsod mkhan gyi dpa' bo zhig chags yod/ de ga nang bzhin lha kri lar dang / si ta yin de tsho'i gras dngos gnas drang gnas mi mang shos gsod mkhan gyi gras red/ yin na yang de tsho la rjes dran byas/ dpa' bo red/ rlabs chen red zer rgyus mtshon mi mang po gsod mkhan la dpa' bor brtse ba 'di shin tu thabs skyo po red/ chos kyi skad cha tsam ma yin par spyi tshogs nang la yang mi gsod rgyu dang / rku ma rku rgyu de mi dgos pa zhig red/ gsum pa log g.yem/ 'di nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas go don rgya chen po yod/ spyir btang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la btsan g.yem byed pa sdug por brtsi gi 'dug des 363

pha rol po'i lus la gnod/ bza' tshang gi bar la mi mthun pa chags/ phru gu'i don dag sogs gang sar gnod kyi yod pa red/ khrims khang la thug rgyu'i rnyog khra yong dang yong bzhin pa red/ log g.yem bkag yong dus btsan g.yem lhag dang bcas pa 'gag 'gro rgyu red/ 'jig rten gyi mi che'i nang gi rnyog khra mang po 'dis bsal gyi red/ de nas ngag gi sgo nas rdzun/ phra ma/ ngag 'khyal/tshig rtsub bcas bzhi po 'di ngag gi skyon yin/ rdzun bshad na mi tshe'i nang la skyid po yong thabs med/ mi mgo bde dran 'khrul byed mkhan la mi ḍa ma ru 'dra po 'dug ces bshad srolayod pa ltar red/ spyir btang chos kyi nyer dpyad ḍa ma ru la bde stong mtshon byed bshad rgyu yod red de/ mi la ḍa ma ru zer dus phar dkrog tshur dkrog byed mkhan la zer ba red/ phra ma ni mthun pa mi mthun par byed pa la zer ba yin pas/ rdzun dang phra ma bshad na mi drang po min pa la brtsi ba dang / mi ma rabs dang tha shal la brtsi gi red/ yid ches mi 'pher ba'i mi la brtsi gi red/ de shin tu thabs skyo po red/ tshig rtsub ni mi la ngan smras byed pa/ tshig kha ma11 dman gyi rkyen byas nas sang nyin nas gcig gis gcig la kha grags res mi byed pa/ gcig gis gcig la mig blta res mi byed pa zhig chags yong gi 'dug der brten tshig rtsub spangs na de 'dra yong gi ma red/ ngag kyal zer rgyu 'di dus tshod chud zos gtong mkhan sdug shos shig red/ dper na slob sbyong byed mkhan zhig yin na/ sgrung 'dra bshad nas bsdad pa yin na slob sbyong la 'thus shor/ kha 'don byed mkhan zhig yin na de la 'thus shor/ tshong rgyag mkhan zhig yin na'ang red/ de 364

bzhin 'tshem po ba dang / lha bris pa lta bu las ka de mdun la bzhag nas skad cha sha stag bshad pa yin na las ka khyon nas tshar gyi ma red/ ngag 'khyal gyis las ka ga re la yin na'ang thebs bcag gi 'dug 'di mi dgos pa zhig red 'dug brnab sems zhes pa ni pha rol po'i rdzas la yid du 'ong ba mthong / yid du 'ong ba'i rdzas de rang la mi dbang ba bzhin du nga la byung na snyam pa'i brnab sems skyes/ bsam pa de shugs che ru che ru 'gro dus rku sems slebs yong gi red/ dper na mi zhig thug 'phrad byed pa'i skabs la khos ca lag yid du 'ong ba gcig la mig blta stangs mi 'dra ba zhig bltas na.a tsi mi de ma rabs tsha mdog kha ba la bsam pa dran gyi 'dug brnab sems las byung ba'i lta stangs de mi ma rung ba dang / ma rabs pa'i gras la tshud rgyu'i cha rkyen red ma gshegegs/mi bzang po la tshud rgyu'i cha rkyen min/ des na brnab sems kyang mi dbosas pa zhig red/ gnod sems ni pha rol 11 la snying nas ma dga' ba'i sems rtsub po skyes pa la zer/ de ni rang nyid phung byed kyi rtsa ba yin/ log lta ni yod pa'i don zhig la med par bltas pa yin na skur 'debs log lta zer/ log lta sdug shos de yin pa red/ yang de dang mtshungs par don la med pa zhig la blos sgro btags nas yod par bltas na sgro 'dogs log lta zer/ da lta 'dir mi dge bcu bshad dus gtso bo skur 'debs log lta yin sa red/ des na/lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum/ ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ yid kyi las ni rnam gsum ste/ zhes mi dge bcu po 'di dag gis mi tshe dang spyi tshogs nang la gnod 'tshe drangs yong ba dang / de dag sdom pa yin na rang dang spyi tshogs 365

tshang mar phan thogs yong gi red/ 'di nang pa'i chos nyams len byed rgyu'i rim pa dang po de yin/ rim pa gnyis pa ni mi dge bcus mtshon pa'i nyes spyod kun nas slong mkhan gyi nyon mongs med pa bzo rgyu deyin/ de ni bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len thog nas nyon mongs med pa bzo dgos/ de nas rim pa gsum pa nyon mongs des bzhag pa'i bag chags/ shes bya shes pa la bar du gcod mkhan gyi nyon mongs de yang med pa bzo dgos/ nang pa'i chos yongs su rdzogs pa nyon mongs dang 'brel nas yong gi 'dug der brten dang po nyon mongs pa las byung ba'i nyes spyod bkag de nas nyon mongs bkag de nas nyon mongs des bzhag pa'i bag chags dang bcas pa bkag dgos/ nga rang tsho rtsa ba bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi cha nas nang pa'i chos nyams su len dgos/ las ngan pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal drangs yong dus thog mar las ngan de bkag las ngan pa re zhig bkag pas mi chog par phu thag chod pa zhig dgos pa yin dus de'i rtsa ba'i kun slong nyon mongs de bkag nas bsal/ nyon mongs dang bral ba de la thar pa zer/ de gtan du bde ba yin/ de ltar na yang shes bya thams cad shes pa la bar du gcod mkhan gyi sgrib pa ma zad kyi bar la zhi ba phyogs gcig pa chags bsdad yod/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa min/ nyon mongs pa des bzhag pa'i shes bya shes pa la bar du gcod mkhan gyi shes bya'i sgrib pa med pa bzos te spang bya mtha' das spangs/ yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa de la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zer ba yin/ shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs te blo yi skyon 366

tshang mar phan thogs yong gi red/ 'di nang pa'i chos nyams len byed rgyu'i rim pa dang po de yin/ rim pa gnyis pa ni mi dge bcus mtshon pa'i nyes spyod kun nas slong mkhan gyi nyon mongs med pa bzo rgyu deyin/ de ni bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len thog nas nyon mongs med pa bzo dgos/ de nas rim pa gsum pa nyon mongs des bzhag pa'i bag chags/ shes bya shes pa la bar du gcod mkhan gyi nyon mongs de yang med pa bzo dgos/ nang pa'i chos yongs su rdzogs pa nyon mongs dang 'brel nas yong gi 'dug der brten dang po nyon mongs pa las byung ba'i nyes spyod bkag de nas nyon mongs bkag de nas nyon mongs des bzhag pa'i bag chags dang bcas pa bkag dgos/ nga rang tsho rtsa ba bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi cha nas nang pa'i chos nyams su len dgos/ las ngan pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal drangs yong dus thog mar las ngan de bkag las ngan pa re zhig bkag pas mi chog par phu thag chod pa zhig dgos pa yin dus de'i rtsa ba'i kun slong nyon mongs de bkag nas bsal/ nyon mongs dang bral ba de la thar pa zer/ de gtan du bde ba yin/ de ltar na yang shes bya thams cad shes pa la bar du gcod mkhan gyi sgrib pa ma zad kyi bar la zhi ba phyogs gcig pa chags bsdad yod/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa min/ nyon mongs pa des bzhag pa'i shes bya shes pa la bar du gcod mkhan gyi shes bya'i sgrib pa med pa bzos te spang bya mtha' das spangs/ yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa de la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zer ba yin/ shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs te blo yi skyon 366

mtha' dag bsal zhing / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mngon sum mkhyen thub pa'i blo gros mnga' ba de la sangs rgyas zhes pa'i mtshan thogs pa yin/ shes song ngam/ de 'dra'i spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa bya rgyu de nga rang tsho'i mthar thug gi dmigs yul yin pas/ des na de lta bu'i rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa'i ched du dam pa'i chos 'di nyan snyam pa'i kun slong byang chub kyi sems rin po che ma mtha' bcos ma tshun chad kyi zin pa'i sgo nas gsan par zhu/ zhes skyes rabs kyi le'u dgu pa rgyal bu thams cad sgrol gyi le'u bshad lung stsal/ de'i rjes su ston pa'i mtshan sngags dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs sngags/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi gzungs sngags/ rgyal kun 'phrin las kyi rang gzugs 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gzungs sngags/ rta mgrin gyi gzungs sngags/ sman bla'i gzungs sngags/ slob dpon rin po che'i gzungs sngags/spyir dmigs brtse ma la bzhi skor/ lnga skor/ dgu skor sogs mang po gsungs yod kyang gtso bo bzhi skor yin pas de'i bzlas lung dang bcas pa stsal/ de nas mang che ba sang gnangs thug gi red/ khyed rang tsho kha shas shig phal cher sang gnangs thon 'gro mkhan yod sa red/ gong du lab pa nang bzhin nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos tshul ji 'dra yod pa de dag shes pa byed rgyu gal chen po red/ de shes pa'i thog nas bcom ldan 'ad sa la dad pa byas na de rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i dad pa red/ rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i thog nas dad pa skyes pa'i dad pa de dad pa brtan po yod/ 'di byung na rkyen phra mo zhig gi dad pa 'gyur sla 367

po de 'dra yong gi ma red/ rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i sgo nas nges pa brtan po rnyed pa'i dad pa dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang gi dad pa med par dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang gi blun dad lta bu yin na de rkyen phra mos 'gyur sla po yong rgyu red/ rgyu mtshan shes pa byas/ do snang byas/ slob sbyong byed rgyu de nges par du gal chen po red/ de'i thog nas so so rang gi ga tshod thub thub kyi chos lag len du bkal nas nyams len byed kyi yin na chos kyi bro ba kha rgyu yod nges red/chos nyams len ma byas par chos kha nas shod rgyu tsam la phyin pa yin na chos kyi bro ba kha gi ma red/ bro ba ma kha na dad pa skye gi ma red la/ nges pa rnyed thu ba kyi ma red/ kha nas bshad pa de so sos lag len la bkal nas nyams len byed kyi yin na 'phral yun kun tu phan pa zhig yong rgyu red/ de yang chos kyi snying po sems pa bzang po byed rgyu yin/ mi la phan sems byas/ mi la sems gnag byed rgyu dang / mi la thub stod shod rgyu'i rigs ma byed/ drang po drang bzhag byas/ lhag par spyi tshogs nang la bsod nams che chung dbang gis mi gra 'grigs ma 'grigs sna tshogs yong gi red/ mi nyams thag skyo po de tsho'i gras la rogs pa yag po byed dgos/ skyo po la rogs byed kyi yin na dngos gnas drang gnas bsod nams chen po thob kyi red/ dus rgyun gtan nas spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa zhig dgos pa yin dus tshang mar phan sems yag po byas/ ma mtha' yin na yang mi la gnod pa byed mi rung / lta ba rten 'byung gi lta ba yin dus nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs spyi'i rnam gzhag shes pa bya dgos/ sems bzang po byed dgos yag dang / sdig pa sgong / dge 368

ba sgrub dgos pa 'di rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa dang / de yang mthar gtugs na so so skyid pa'i don dag dang / so so'i don dag la thug pa zhig red gnad 'gag 'di ngo shes pa'i thog nas nyams len byed thub pa byung na yag po yong gi red/ khyed rang tsho bod la mgyogs po log 'gro mkhan yod pa tsho blo bde po byas/ yang rim pas rim pas 'di phyogs la gnyen 'phrad yong thub kyi red/ nga rang tsho thug gi red/ dus stod je bzang je bzang la phyin nas nga rang tsho'i bden pa'i mtha' gsal thub kyi red/ tshang ma blo bde po byed/ shes song ngam/ ngas rtag tu smon lam rgyab dang rgyab/ blo bde po byas te rgyugs/ ces bka' 455// // 369

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1987 zla 4 tshes 1 nyin/ bzhugs sgar theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du byang chub lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gsung chos kyi nyin mtha' ma'i ljags bshad skabs bka' slob stsal ba/de yang 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha ba chen po'i gsung las/ sras bcas 7rgyal ba'i rmad byung 'phrin las las/ legs grub byang chub lam gyi rim pas kyang / thar 'dod rnams kyi yid la dpal ster zhing / 7rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ring du skyong gyur cig ces ji ltar gsungs pa'i don kha sang sngon du zhus pa bzhin 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos lam rim chen mo 'di ljags rtsom gnang skabs bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa bcom ldan 'das nas bzung pa'i dngos brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad zhal gzigs nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po byung ba zhig yin par brten/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i rmad byung 'phrin las las legs par grub pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang / nyams len byed 'dod yod mkhan gyi mi rnams gsung rab rgya mcho lta bu la blta ba'i mig phyes te lam bgrod thub pa dang / de la brten nas rang rgyud la rnam mkhyen 7rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa'i sa bon grung po thebs thub payong ba shog gsungs pa yin/ 7rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ring du skyong gyur cig ces gsungs pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rjes bstan gyi cho 'phrul zab pa dang rgya che ba las brtsams pa'i legs bshad ji snyed cig yod pa de dag gis rang gzhan kun gyi rgyud la lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rgyas pa yong ba shog gsungs pa red/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos lam 370

rim chen mo mdzad nas da bar lo drug brgyar nye ba zhig 'gro gi yod/ de'i ring chos tshul 'di la brten nas dngos gnas sems can ma smin pa smin par byas/ smin pa grol bar byas/ grol ba rnams mthar phyin pa mang po zhig yod pa thag chod cing / dus kyi mtha' 'di 'dra la'ang gzhung lade 'chad nyan byed rgyu byung ba ni 'chad mkhan gyi bla ma dang / nyan mkhan gyi slob ma gnyis gas bsod nams chen po bsags pa red/ nga rang tsho tshang mas de ring phan chad kyi nyin 'ga'i ring dngos gnas gang thub thub kyi don dang ldan pa zhig byas pa 'di la rjes su yi rangs dang / dga' ba bsgoms nas bsngo smon yag po byed dgos pa ma zad/ ston pa bka' drin can gyi zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid da dung yun ring gnas thub pa'i smon lam rgyag dgos shing / gtso bo ni so sos nyams len yag po byed dgos/ de ltar byung na don dang ldan pa red/ 7rgyal ba rin po cher gcig nas dus tshod mi ldeng pa'i dka' ngal yod pa dang / gnyis nas ji ma ji bzhin cha tshang ba zhig shod thub kyi med na'ang / so med kyang rnyil gyis 'drad gsung ba bzhin u tshugs brgyabatas bshad pa red/ bshad pa'i dgos don khyed tsho'i rna bar thos te sems la nges nas nyams len yag po byed dgos pa de yin/ de yang sngon la rgya che chung la ma ltos par lam rim gyi khrid thob pa nas bzung rang nyid mi spus dag tu 'gro ba zhig byung na 'chad nyan byas pa'i dgos don tshang ba yin/ 'ga' zhig chos zhus pa tsam las rang gis de tsam shes mi thub mkhan snubarno gnas tshul ni tha dad yin/ de min chos phran bu shes mkhan tshos lag len bkal nas 371

nyams len byed ma thub na dgos pa che ba ma byung ba red/ chos zhes pa 'di so so'i gshis rgyud la sbyar nas gshis rgyud bzo bcos brgyab na dngos gnas rang nyid sems skyid la/ blo bde bag phebs shig yong thub/ gshis rgyud la 'gul bskyod ma thebs na chos shes kyang dgos pa de tsam ma byung ba yin/ da lta nas rgyud thog la bkal te nyams len byed dgos/ lhag don rda ram sa lar gtan du sdod mkhan tsho'i rna bar chos rna ba tsha tsha thos yod pas de tsho lag len la 'grel dgos/ so so snang ba dag nas rang nyid nyams len byed mkhan gyi chos pa rab gcig yin bsams nas sdod mi rung / snang ba dag drags na skyon mang po yong bas rang gis rang la brtag dpyad yag po byed dgos/ rang gis gang 'dra byed kyi 'dug zhogs pa langs pa nas dgong mo ma nyal bar byang chub lam rim chen mo dpang por bzhag thub pa'i hur thag byed dgos/ sngon ma lam rim chen mo'i gsung chos dang wa rwang brang rnying par byed skabs phal cher mi gsum brgya tsam yod pa de'i nang gi mang po zhig bsdad yod pa ltar de ring chos gral du'ang slebs 'dug de tsho 7rgyal ba rin po che'i slob ma yin la/'das pa'i lo nyi shu lhag tsam ring tshang mas gang yong ci yong byas yod/ da dung ji tsam mang du thos pa de tsam gyis so so'i sems la g.yo 'gul dang bsgyur bcos gtong thub pa zhig dgos/ de ring 'dir bla ma dge bshes dang / lhag par grwa sar slob gnyer rgyag mkhan mang po zhig don gnyer chen pos slebs yod/ khyed tshos lam gron chen po btang ste sa thag ring po nas 'dir yong ba'i dgos don snying po chos sgar so sor log 'gro skabs 'gro song btang thub pa 372

tsam ma yin pa sems nang 'khyer rgyu yod pa zhig dgos/ de yang shes lo thos lo tsam ma yin par shes nas nam rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i sems la 'gul bskyod phran bu thebs pa zhig nges par du byed dgos/kha sang nga cho gra sa khag la bskyod skabs slob gnyer rgyag stangs sgor mang po zhig la kho/ bsdur byas pa yin/ gzhi rtsa.ang ki dang po 'dug da dung phyin chad de dag rtsa ba brtan po'i ngang gang ci phun sum tshogs po yong thabs sde tshang mas 'bad brtson byed dgos stabs nga chos 'char gzhi bkod yod/ de ring 'dir phebs pa'i mkhan po las zur dang / bla ma rnam pa tshos ma gzhi bstan pa'i khur blangs nas 'chad nyan gnang gi yod/ da dung dbang lung khrid gsum cha tshang ba zhig gra sa so so'i nang yod pa zhig byed thub na yag po red/po ti lnga'i khrid rgyun ang ki dang po yod pa/dka' ba de la ltos na 'di ni phran bu sla ba zhigayin/ spyir dbang bskur rgyu dang / khrid rgyag rgyu de tsho shin tu spa sa dag po zhig byed dgos na khag po red ma gtogs/ spyir btang zhig byas rno las sla po yin/ wa ti lnga la lo bco lnga nyi shu dka' las brgyab na ma gtogs shes mi thub pa 'a byed thub sa la/ chupasa'i dbang lung khrid gsum 'a med par lus na phran bu cha mi tshang ba lta bu 'dug pas nges par du de rigs dar 'phel yong thabs la bsam blo gtong rgyu gal chen po 'dug de bzhin kha sang zhus pa ltar 'di ga rda ram sa lar dus dus su ngas bka' chos 'dra byed pa'i skabs phyogs mtha' nas bla ma dge bshes rnam pas mtshon pa'i mi gang tsam yong gi yod pa de 'dra'i skabs la stabs gcig don gnyis byas nas ngas phyogs 373

pa gang thub byed kyi red/ de rjes khyed rnam pa'i nang nas skabs su babs pa'i dbang lung khrid rgyun dang / rjes gnang 'dra phran bu gnang thub na yag po med dam zhus pa ltar/ da res sku zhabs blo chos nas dpe khrid phran bu gnang rgyu'i 'char gzhi 'dug pa ha cang yag po byung / de de bzhin gnang dgos/ nga rang tsho tshang mas chos don gnyer gyi bsam pa'i thog nas gzhung chen rnams la 'chad nyan byas pa de dag chud zos ma song ba byed dgos/khyed rang tsho phyi rgyal gyi mi tshor mtshon na/ gcig nas bod skad mi shes pa dang / gnyis nas rang nyid 'tshar longs byed sa dang / goms gshis kyi chos dad mi 'dra ba zhig chags yod kyang / dus rabs nyi shu pa'i deng gi 'dzam gling 'di'i thog rang re phan tshun gnas tshul shes rtogs byed pa'i mthun rkye na ha cang 'dzom du phyin nas 'dzam gling shar nub kyi 'brel ba nyin bzhin je cher 'gro gi yod/ shar phyogs pa tsho nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi dngos po yar rgyas la 'gram chu ldang nas de'i lad zlos byed ma thub par dka' las rgyag gi yod/nub phyogs pa tshor shar phyogs pa'i lta ba 'dra min la do snang slebs yod/ de ring 'dir yod pa khyed sto mang che ba nang chos la rgyus mnga' gang la gang 'tsham yod mkhan sngon ma'i gras yin zhing / da res kyang don gnyer chen pos yong ba yin stabs tshang mas snyugs bsrings nas nyams len yag po byed dgos pa las/ 'dod thag thung thung byed mi rung / de ring nyams len byas nas sang nyin dngos grub rdog dog gcig 'thob rgyu shin tu khag po red/ de yang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung las/ nyin re zas kyang mi dran btson 'grus 374

rtsom/ zhugs ma thag nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang 'dod/ zhag gsum lon tshe rjes med g.yeng bas 'khyer/ de 'dra de la ci yang mi yong bas/ brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten cigaspong / zhes ji ltar gsung pa ltar snyugs bsrings rgyu gal che zhing / de ltar snyugs bsrings nas nyams len byas na rim pas sems la yar rgyas tan tan 'gro gi red/ nga rang nang pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas bshad na/ khyed rang tshos nang pa'i chos la dmigs bsal gyi do snang thog nas sangs —rgyas kyi bstan par dad gus byas nas chos zhus te nyams len byed pa de ha cang yag po red/ thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / yang nga rang bod pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas bshad na/ khyed rang tshos bod kyi rig gzhung la do snang byas te spyir nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang / de'i nang tshan nas bod gangs can gyi jongs la yod pa'i theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba'i bod kyi nang chos la do snang byed skabs bod kyi rig gzhung dang / bod mi rigs la rang shugs kyis do snang byed kyi yod pa der thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ khyed tsho 'ga' shas la bod pa'i goms gshis 'jags drags te 'ga' shas nas lce snar/lus sgur de 'dra byed grabs byed kyi 'dug goms gshis de tsho 'jags dgos pa med/ ngas rtag tu brjod pa bzhin nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di'i rtsa ba ston pa bcom ldan 'das nas byung ba'i rtsa ba 'di ma brlag pa'i thog nas lung pa so sku'i rig gzhung gsar pa dang / goms gshis kyi gnas tshul gsar pa'i 'og sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di'ang rnam pa gsar pa zhig gi sgang la slebs —kyi yod/ de la brten nas bod kyi nang pa'i chos zhes pa dang / rgya nag gi nang 375

pa'i chos zhes pa lung pa so so'i ming dang 'brel nas nang chos la ming 'dogs kyi yod pas/ nub phyogs yo rob kyi nang chos zhes pa dang / a mi ri ga'i nang chos zhes pa zhig tan tan yong gi red/ deng sang gzhi nas dmar po'i rgyal khab tsho'i nang du nang chos la do snang byed mkhan phran bu mang du 'gro gi 'dug dper na/ po lan dang / tang gha ri/ u ru su sogs red/ nye char nga.u ru sur 'gro dus mi lhod lhod thug nas skad cha shod rgyu ma byung stabs brjod khag po red ma gtogs/ li zhen ghi rir slebs dus der nang chos la do snang byed mkhan yod pa'i bzo 'dug khyed rang tshos bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung la do snang byas pa de'i thog nas bod pa la do snang gsar pa zhig slebs yod/ lhag par deng sang nga tsho bod pa khag gcig so so'i lung pa bral nas gzhan gyi yul du btsan byol ba chags pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i lung par gtor bshig nyam nyes ha cang chen po byung sku(da pa de dag khyed tsho phal che bas gsal po shes yod/ bod pa'i gnas tshul/ 'di spyir btang dbyin ji'i skad kyi po li ṭig zer ba'i chab srid kyi gnas tshul 'ba' zhig min par/ mi rigs shig la yod pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i ris gzhung gting zab po mtha' dag rtsa med 'gro ba'i gnas tshul la thug yod/ der brten nga tsho bod pa'i chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod dam/ yang na mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod 'di la khyed rang tshos do snang byas par thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/bod pa'i 'thab rtsod la rgyab kyor byas pa 'di dngos gnas drang bden la rgyab khyodar byas pa zhig yin pa las/ bod par dga' po dang / rgya mir mi 376

dga' ba byas pa'i gnas tshul zhig ma red/ dngos gnas drang bden bod pa dang rgya mi sus byas kyang de la rgyab skyor byed dgos/ nor 'khrul rgya mi dang bod pa sus byas kyang de la rgyab skyor byed rgyu med/ de ni rgya mi dang bod pa sus byas ma byas kyi gnad don zhi ga min par/ rtsa ba drang bden yin min la bsam blo gtong dgos/ deng sang khyed tshos sngon ma dang mi 'dra bar bod pa'i bden don la do snang che ru phyin yod par brten ha cang dga' po byung / de ring ngas chos gral nub tu sdod mkhan bod pa tsho'i tshab byas nas chos gral shar la sdod mkhan khyed rang phyi rgyal ba tshor thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ gang yin zhe na/ nub la sdod mkhan tsho da res bod nas yong pa red/ khong tsho ni lo mang ring rgya mi'i dbang sgyur gyi dka' ngal 'og tu sdod 'dod med kyang ma bsdad mthu med byung ba'i mi'i gras red/khyed rang tsho bod nas yong mkhan tshos hur thag gis so so'i mi rigs kyi zhen khog la rgya dang 'brel ba'i thog nas chos la dad pa byas te gnas mjal dang sbrags 'di khul gyi gnas tshul phran bu shes na bsam te yong bar ha cang dga' po byung / de sngon khyed rang tshor lag khyer ma thob pa'i dka' ngal yod pa dang / deng rgya mi'i lag khyer phran bu las sla ru song yod kyang / bal po'i phyogs nas dka' ngal gsar pa zhig bzos yod/ de bzhin lam gyi 'grul bzhud la dka' ngal yod pa smos med thog 'gag lha'i khral sa so sos gcig nas yul gyi 'gro lugs dang / gnyis nas sger gyi za sgor rngams te brdab gsigs dka' ngal mang po zhig bzo gi yod pa de dag thams cad khyad gsod 377

byas te yong ba red la/ lhag par lam rim gyi bka' chos cha tshang go dang go min la ma ltos par dga' po dang zhen khog byas nas yong ba zhig yin par brten/ chos rgyun ring bshad pa rnams brjed med sems la nyar nas rang gshis yar rgyas gtong thabs su bsam blo nges par gtong dgos/ mang che ba sang gnangs nas rim pas log 'gro gi yod pa tshang ma blo bde po byas nas log rgyugs/ shes song ngam/ nga tsho mi'i lung par sdod mkhan tshos da bar lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad lhag tsam ring gang yong ci yong gi hur thag byas yod/ nor ba dang 'a khrul ba zer ba de gang duyin kyang yong gi red/ gnas tshul khyon yongs nas bshad na yag po red/ de ni ngas don med 'ud shob bshad pa min/ 'dzam gling thog btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba bod pa zhes lab dus 'ju lung 'chang gsum dang / khungs 'ded sa yod pa zhig la cha 'jog byed kyi yo/da/bod pa'i gnas tshul shes mkhan tshang mas thode pa zhes lab dus dmigs bsal gyi mthong dang cha 'jog byed kyi yod la/ nga chos kyang da phan hur thag byas yod/ khyed tsho bod la slebs nas blo bde po gyis/ 'on kyang ngas kha sang lab pa bzhin deng sang gi dus 'dir tod yangs jo yod kyi thog nas a'u tsam min nam snyam pa byed mi rung bas nges par du gzab gzab byed dgos/nga'i ngos nas cha bzhag non rgya mi la 'brel ba zhig yod na legs pa 'du ga snyam te 'brel ba byed kyi yod/ yin na'ang 'brel ba byas te rtsa ba'i thag gcod ni nga rang tsho'i don dam pa'i khe phan thad blo bzhag sa dang mdzub rngo btsugs sa zhig yong gi yod med la blta rgyu de yin/ dngos gnas don dam 378

pa'i go kyi bstan pa chab srid mi dmangs dang bcas par 'phral phugs rgyang gsum la blo bzhag sa yod pa zhig ma byung bar du 'di nas 7rgyal ba rin po tshes rtsa ba nyid nas mgo sgur gyi ma red/ der khyed rang tsho rtsa ba nas g.yeng ba byed ma dgos/ nga chos drang bden gyi 'thab rtsod cig byed kyi yod pas stobs tshe chung gi skad cha min/ stobs rgya mi che na'ang bden pa nga tshor yod/ bden pa ni stobs shugs gcig pus med par bzo mi thub/ der brten nga tshor stobs shugs kyi spobs pa med na'ang / nga tshos bden pa'i dar cha 'di bsgrengs nas rang dbang lung par bsdad pa 'di la nus pa zhig yod/ rtsa ba 'dzam gling/ mi'i spyi tshogs 'dir bden pa la phugs rgyang ring wa'i cha nas nus pa zhig tan tan yod/ spyir btang 'dzam gling thog gi lung pa mang po zhig la dbang yod dang btsan dbang shod mkhan de yang yang byung yod pa las/ de ring kha sang byung ba'i rngo ba srid kyi gnas tshul gsar pa zhig ma red/ yin na'ang dbang yod dang btsan dbang shod mkhan de rigs sku tshe ring po bzhugs thub med/ de ni nub phyogs yo rob dang / shar phyogs gang la cha bzhag kyang de ltar yin/dper na/ deng sang stobs chena.u ru su la cha bzhag na khong tshor a me ri ku'i go mtshon la lan slog thub pa'i mtshon cha yod na yang / mi'i rang dbang bsdams bzhag dus khungs 'khyol gyi med/ deng sang dngos yod gnas tshul la.u ru su'i nang rang dbang che ru 'gro gi yod/ de dang des mtshon pas dmar i rgyal khab mang po zhig nang mi'i rang dbang thob thang skor gyi skad cha shod rgyu mang du 'gro ba'i 'gyur ba zhig 'gro gi yod/ des rtags mtshan gang zhig 379

pa'i go kyi bstan pa chab srid mi dmangs dang bcas par 'phral phugs rgyang gsum la blo bzhag sa yod pa zhig ma byung bar du 'di nas 7rgyal ba rin po tshes rtsa ba nyid nas mgo sgur gyi ma red/ der khyed rang tsho rtsa ba nas g.yeng ba byed ma dgos/ nga chos drang bden gyi 'thab rtsod cig byed kyi yod pas stobs tshe chung gi skad cha min/ stobs rgya mi che na'ang bden pa nga tshor yod/ bden pa ni stobs shugs gcig pus med par bzo mi thub/ der brten nga tshor stobs shugs kyi spobs pa med na'ang / nga tshos bden pa'i dar cha 'di bsgrengs nas rang dbang lung par bsdad pa 'di la nus pa zhig yod/ rtsa ba 'dzam gling/ mi'i spyi tshogs 'dir bden pa la phugs rgyang ring wa'i cha nas nus pa zhig tan tan yod/ spyir btang 'dzam gling thog gi lung pa mang po zhig la dbang yod dang btsan dbang shod mkhan de yang yang byung yod pa las/ de ring kha sang byung ba'i rngo ba srid kyi gnas tshul gsar pa zhig ma red/ yin na'ang dbang yod dang btsan dbang shod mkhan de rigs sku tshe ring po bzhugs thub med/ de ni nub phyogs yo rob dang / shar phyogs gang la cha bzhag kyang de ltar yin/dper na/ deng sang stobs chena.u ru su la cha bzhag na khong tshor a me ri ku'i go mtshon la lan slog thub pa'i mtshon cha yod na yang / mi'i rang dbang bsdams bzhag dus khungs 'khyol gyi med/ deng sang dngos yod gnas tshul la.u ru su'i nang rang dbang che ru 'gro gi yod/ de dang des mtshon pas dmar i rgyal khab mang po zhig nang mi'i rang dbang thob thang skor gyi skad cha shod rgyu mang du 'gro ba'i 'gyur ba zhig 'gro gi yod/ des rtags mtshan gang zhig 379

ston gyi yod dam zhe na/ mi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes rang dbang zhes pa 'dir shin tu dga' po yod pa bstan pa red la/ bden don la nus pa yod pa'i rtags kyang bstan pa red/ der brten sems shugs ma chag cing / 'phral sel gyi don gcig pur mgo mi 'khor ba/ don chung tsag gis chog shes ma byas ji/ bcas kyi thog nas nga rang tsho'i rtsa ba'i rtsa don brjed med snying bcang byas na rang re gang yang byed kyi ma red/ nga tsho gzhan yul la sdod mkhan tshos gang thub hur thag byed kyi yin/ gtso bo don gyi bdag po bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang sto ngas rtag tu brjod pa bzhin da lta nang ltar sems shugs dang gnya' ma chag par bsdad phyin/ nga tsho phyi la sdod mkhan tshos skad cha shod skabs bod rgya che'i mi mang gi tshab byas nas shod kyi yod snyam pa'i rang sems spobs pa dang ldan pa'i thog nas blo khog chen pos bshad rgyu yong gi red/ bod rgya che'i mi mang tsho rim bzhin chung tsag la mgo 'khor nas des grod khog rgyags te sems shugs nam yang chag mi rung / da lta'i char 'di 'dra'i nyen kha rtsa ba nas mi 'dug kyang ma byung sngon 'gog yin/ ci ste nges med sems shugs chag pa'i rnam pa zhig thon tshe/ nga tsho phyi la yod pa'i bod pa nyung shas kyis skad brgyab kyang dpa' bo rgyab chad lta bu chags rgyur brten/ rang re'i bya ba 'di dbu ma'i gzhung nas gsungs pa'i rten 'brel tos grub ces pa de yin/ 'di khul 7rgyal ba rin po ches skad rgyag skabs bod rgya che'i mi mang gi sems shugs dang / dam tshig gong bu gcig gyur gyi stobs shugs la brten te bsdad yod/de ni dgos nges shig yin/ bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang tsho sems shugs ma 380

chags pa'i don la nga tsho 'di khul yod pa tshos gang yong ci yong byed kyi yod la/ 7rgyal ba rin po ches kyang gang yong ci yong byed kyi yod/ de yang dgos mi zhig red/ nga tshos 'bad brtson hur thag byed par bod nang gi mi mang tsho'i bsam cho'i stobs shugs de dgos la/ bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang tsho la'ang 'di phyogs nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs ldan pa'i las 'gul dang bya ba rnams dgos pa red/ de ltar rang re'i bya ba mtha' dag rten 'brel ltos grub yin par brten bod mi re re'i skal par bgo skal rdog khres re yod pa 'di tshang mas shes pa byed dgos/ skabs re mi kha shas nas snang ba skyid po'i skad cho shod kyi 'dug tshang ma ga re byas kyang 7rgyal ba rin po ches byed chog chog yod pa dang / bod rang btsan yong dang mi yong 7rgyal ba rin po che'i phyag la 'dug zer mkhan byung /7rgyal ba rin po che bla ma gang min tshad cig red ces bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bla ma la gsol ba btab na gang zhig yin kyang yong gi red gsungs pa ltar lab pa zhig yin na yang / ngas ni skad cha de so so'i lag pa 'phyis snying 'dod nas lab pa zhig la go ba len gyiyod/ mi so sos 'gan 'khur mi dgos pa de 'dra min/ bod spyi pa'i don dag bsgrub rgyu'i thad bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan tshang mas so so'i sgal par rdog khres gcig yod snyam pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos pa ma gtogs/ kha shas la 'gan 'khri ba dang / kha shas la 'gan mi 'khri ba'i bzo gang zhig la/ khe bzang cha tshang dgos pa de 'dra mi kha shas nas byed kyi 'dug de 'dra byed rgyu med/381

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa shog ces nga chos rgyun du smon lam rgyag gi yod pa ltar spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / yang sgos bod gangs can gyi ljongs la yod pa'i theg pa che chung sngags dang bcasapa yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di dngos 'brel rtsa ba sra brtan tshugs dang ma tshugs dang / gnas dang mi gnas de bod dang 'brel ba shin tu chen po chags yod/ bod pa tsho skyid sdug legs nyes ji ltar yang so so'i lung pa'i gnas stangs la rag lus yod/so so'i lung pa'i gnas stangs brtan po yod na/ bod nang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bod kyi rig gzhung dar thub pa dang / so so'i lung pa nyams nyes gtan med la song na/ chang tsho 'dir bod mi nyung shas lhag pa nas rtsol ba ji ltar byas kyang mi thog re gnyis las de nas rdzogs rgyu yin pa shes gsal red/de ni 7rgyal ba rin po che mi dgos sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sogs kyis kyang bcos su med/ dngos yod la 'grub mi thub pa zhig smon lam brgyab kyang yong thabs med/ las ka byed dgos na las ka byed mkhan gyi mi yod dgos/bod pa rang nyid nyin gcig brlag na gang 'dra byed dgos sam/ da lta'i mi rnams mi jog gcig ste lo lnga bcu 'am/ yang na drug cu bdun cu phyin na rdzogs kyi red/ de nas phru gu gsar pa'i mi thog gcig slebs te de rdzogs mtshams lo brgya tsam 'gro gi red/ da lta nga tsho rgya gar du btsan byol byas te gtso bo rgya gar gzhung gi bka' drin dang / yang sgos nga rang tsho'i rten 'brel ltos grub kyi gnas tshul mang po zhig la brten nas rdog gcig tu gnas thub yod/ yin na'ang gang mtshams nas 7rgyal ba rin po che 'das/ gzhan 'chi nges tsho' nga 382

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa shog ces nga chos rgyun du smon lam rgyag gi yod pa ltar spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / yang sgos bod gangs can gyi ljongs la yod pa'i theg pa che chung sngags dang bcasapa yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di dngos 'brel rtsa ba sra brtan tshugs dang ma tshugs dang / gnas dang mi gnas de bod dang 'brel ba shin tu chen po chags yod/ bod pa tsho skyid sdug legs nyes ji ltar yang so so'i lung pa'i gnas stangs la rag lus yod/so so'i lung pa'i gnas stangs brtan po yod na/ bod nang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bod kyi rig gzhung dar thub pa dang / so so'i lung pa nyams nyes gtan med la song na/ chang tsho 'dir bod mi nyung shas lhag pa nas rtsol ba ji ltar byas kyang mi thog re gnyis las de nas rdzogs rgyu yin pa shes gsal red/de ni 7rgyal ba rin po che mi dgos sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sogs kyis kyang bcos su med/ dngos yod la 'grub mi thub pa zhig smon lam brgyab kyang yong thabs med/ las ka byed dgos na las ka byed mkhan gyi mi yod dgos/bod pa rang nyid nyin gcig brlag na gang 'dra byed dgos sam/ da lta'i mi rnams mi jog gcig ste lo lnga bcu 'am/ yang na drug cu bdun cu phyin na rdzogs kyi red/ de nas phru gu gsar pa'i mi thog gcig slebs te de rdzogs mtshams lo brgya tsam 'gro gi red/ da lta nga tsho rgya gar du btsan byol byas te gtso bo rgya gar gzhung gi bka' drin dang / yang sgos nga rang tsho'i rten 'brel ltos grub kyi gnas tshul mang po zhig la brten nas rdog gcig tu gnas thub yod/ yin na'ang gang mtshams nas 7rgyal ba rin po che 'das/ gzhan 'chi nges tsho' nga 382

shi/ de 'dra'i skabs la nga tsho bod pa'i sgrom 'di ma gzhi gzung gi red de/ mi thog gcig phyin/ mi thog gnyis phyin/ mi thog gsum phyin pa'i skabs la yal 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod/nga rang tsho'i kha nas sems can thams cad kyi bde skyid kyi rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan nga dzesas pa shog ces smon lam rgyag gi yod/ bstan pa rgyas pa la rgyas stangs bsam blo btang nas de'i gnad 'gag shes dgos/ kha shas kyis stabs bde'i sgo nas bod kyi chab srid dang / bstan pa gnyis tha dad yin pa'i bsam blo gtong gi 'dug ngas bltas na de 'dra rang ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas dang mi gnas dngos gnas bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di la bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig chags yod pa dang / 'brel ba zhin tu dam po yod/ der brten bod pa'i chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod 'di chos dang ma 'brel ba'i 'thab rtsod gcig rtsa ba nas min/ da lta 'di rgya mis shes kyi mi 'dug yin na'ang rim pas rgya mi tshos shes dgos pa zhig chags kyi red bsam gyi 'dug da lta rgya mi'i bsam blo gtong stangs dang byed stangs de rang byas pa yin na/ bod par phan rgyu phar bzhag rgya mi kho rang tsho yang skyid pa zhig yong mi thub/ deng sang nga tsho phar log shog zer gyi yod/ dngos gnas rgya nag la log dgos na ang dang po da lta phyi rgyal la yod pa'i rgya mi'i slob phrug tsho log dgos/ de tsho ni khong tshos brgya 'dems stong sgrug byas nas btang ba sha stag red/ khong tsho yid tshims 'dod khengs kyi gnas stangs shig yod na phyir log byed kyi red/ 'on kyang khong chos phyir log byed 383

kyi min shod kyi yod/ khong tsho log gi med na/ nga tsho bod pa de bas ga la logakhong tshos nga tsho log dgos zer ba ni snang ba skyid po'i skad cha dang / lkug pa'i skad cha/ bsam blo rtsa ba nas ma btang ba bcas kyi skad cha zhig red/rgya mi rgya mi la sha tsha med mkhan med pas/ sngon la rgya mi yongs rdzogs 'dod pa khengs pa zhig bzos dang / rgya mi tsho'i 'dod pa khengs song na/ de nas ga ler bod pa tsho 'dod pa khengasa.e thub blta rgyu yongagi red/ rgya mis/ rgya mi tsho 'dod pa khengs pa bzo ma thub par da dung rgyus med nga tsho'i bod yul la yong nas dpon po byas te bsdad yod/ nga tsho bod pa'i 'dod pa khengs pa gang 'dra byas te bzo thub bam/ rgya nag rgya mi la rgyus yod cing / rgyus yong sa'i lung pa de da lta mi'i spyi tshogs mtshan nyid tshang zhing mdun lam yag po yod pa zhig bzo thub kyi mi 'dug de ltar med bzhin du nga tsho'i bod lung pa yar rgyas gtong gi yin/ 'dzugs skrun byed kyi yin/ gom pa sngon bon gras la slebs pa byed kyi yin bshad pa ni stong bshad rang red/ nga tsho bod pa rnams 'jon thang med pa zhig nam yang min/ dper na/ nga tsho mi'i lung par btsan byol du sdod ring nga tshos las ka gang 'dra byas mi 'dug gam/ deng sang 'dza ma gling thog bod pa rgyus 'dris yod mkhan tshos skad cha 'di 'dra zhig shod kyi yod/bod par go skabs byung na gang yang byed thub kyi 'dug bod pa ni rig pa yag po dang / mgo grung po/ gzhung bzang can bcas kyi mi ha cang yag po zhig red brjod kyi yod/ de bzhin slob sbyong byed sa dang / gzhan las rigs gang du yin kyang bod par go skabs byung phyin chad la de'i nang gi mi chos bod pa tsho 384

mi bzang red brjod kyi yod la/ nga tshos kyang de ltar byed thub kyi yod/ skabs 'dir ngas brjod dgos pa zhig la/ nga rang tsho tshang mar bod spyi pa'i 'gan gyi rdog khres ljid thag chod re bod mi mi re ngo re'i sgal par yod pa de gsal po shes pa byas te tshang mas hur thag byed dgos zhes 'bod skul bya rgyu yin/de nas deng sang bod nang chos dad rang mos kyi gnas tshul gsar pa'i 'og chos shes la mi shes kha shas nas shes khul byas te 'chor ba don gnyer gyis zhabs brtan bsgrub rgyu la sogs pa byas nas chos 'di sprang pos rtsam pa slong pa nang bzhin gyi don la bed spyod byed kyi yod stod 'dug pa deyag po min/ chos spus/ dag po zhig byed dgos/ kha sang nas skad cha byung ba bzhin chos slob sbyong bya rgyu gal chen po red/ dgon pa re gnyis dang / sku gsung thugs rten —kha shas bzhengs par ha las rgyu med/ gal che shos bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i nang pa'i chos ngo ma de gang 'dra zhig yin pa dang / de'i lta ba dang spyod pa gang 'dra yin pa nges par shes pa byed dgos/ mdor na lta ba rten 'byung dang / spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa zhes pa 'di gnyis ma mthar shes pa'i thog nas nang pa'i chos kyi snying po gang yin dang / des nga tsho'i mi tshe'i nang la phan stangs/ spyi tshogs nang 'brel ba yong stangs sogs kyi gnas lugs shes pa bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ de bzhin sa dge bka' rnying tshang ma ston pa gcig gi rjes 'brangs yin pas tshang ma mthun po bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ bar skabs rgya mis gcig gyur shugs chen gyis mnan pa'i skabs la tshang ma dam tshig 'o chu gcig 'dres su 385

gnas kyi yod/ deng sang chos dad rang mos zhes pa'i gnas tshul gsar pa slebs te so so'i lha khang dang / dgon pa phran bu nyams gso bya rgyu yod pa dang /bla ma gra pa tsho chags rten phran bu yong ba'i skabs la nga'i chos lugs dang / khi chos lugs zer ba'i 'then 'khyer gyi skad cha phran bu yong gi yod bzo 'dugade ni yag po rtsa ba nas ma red/ bon po la cha bzhag na'ang de'i thog ma'i 'byung khungs nang pa'i chos ma red/ 'on kyang bod mi rigs kyi gna' snga mo'i ris gnas sam/ chos dad cig red/ der brten bon po la'ang nga rang tsho bod pa gcig pa yin pa'i cha nas nges par du brtsi bkur dang / rogs ram/ gang thub kyi rgyab skyor bcas byed dgos/khyed rang tsho bod nas yong mkhan chos gnas tshul phran bu shes yod kyi red/ nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rtsa ba 7skyabs gnas bcol sa sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog bcas 7skyabs gnas gsum sngon de yin/ de dang 'brel ba'i thog nas las 'bras la yid ches kyis tshul bzhin bsrung dgos/ lhas gnod 'dug klus gnod 'dug zer ba'i skad cha shod pa de tshos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzi byin brlag 'gro gi yod pa red/ srung ma dang / chos skyong gang byung ma byung bsten pa de tsho'i gras yag po ma red/ phyis su de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'dra min phran bu yong gi 'dug rgya gar khul la'ang gnas tshul de 'dra byung yod la/ bod nang la'ang deng sang gnas tshul de rigs yong gi yod bzo 'dug de tsho shes dgos pa red/ gzhi rtsa khyed tshos zur du do snang byas na shes kyi red/ nga tshos 386

bod spyi pa'i rtsa ba'i don dag la bsam blo gtong skabs rgya che sa nas bsam blo gtong dgos/ rgya che sa nas bsam blo btang na sngon ma 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos rtsa ba 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa'i dga' ldan pho brang zhes pa 'di deng mang kutsho'i lam srol thog la 'gro gi yod pa ltar 'gyur ba shin tu chen po byung yod/gral rim gyi thog nas dbang cha 'dzin pa dang / yang na sde dpon mi drag gi dbang cha 'dzin pa'i lam srol de tsho sngon nas dus las yol te/ deng sang kha zhe gnyis med kyi mang gtso'i lam la 'gro gi sku(da/ ma 'ongs par yang ba rgya cha brgya mang gasgu re lam la 'gro rgyu red ma gtogs/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sogs gral rim ring lugs shig rtsa ba nas byed 'dod med/ gal de de 'dra zhig byed 'dod byas kyang rtsa ba nas 'grub thabs med/ 'dzam gling gi 'gyur bas tshura.u tshugs brgyab ste yong skabs/ nga tshos phara.u tshugs brgyab nas ldog ste phyin na rtsa ba nas mi 'grigs/ 7rgyal ba rin po ches bod spyi pa'i don dag gi 'gan zhig 'khyer yod dus/ da lta lam rim bla ma brgyud pa'i nang la yod pa bzhin thog mar 7rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa nas bzung 7rgyal dbang rim byon gyis bod spyi pa'i 'gan bzhes pa'i dus de'i ring la nges par du 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa'i dga' ldan pho brang dang 'brel ba chags yod/ de 'dra yin dus dga' ldan pho brang dang ma 'grigs pa'i gleng gzhi yod pa'i 'dra mi 'dra de tsho phar tsam de nas gcig gis bshad/tshur tsam 'di nas gcig gis bshad de bsdad na yag po ma red/ gyong su la rag ma rag rim pas shes yong gi red/ rjes la 'gyod pa skye dgos pa zhig 387

chags na yag po med/ 'di tshang ma'i sems la yag po nges pa byed dgos/gal che sar bsam blo gtong dgos pa las/ gal chung sar mgo 'khor rgyu med/ nga'i bla ma'i phyag bzhes yin/ yas yin mas yin zhes shod sa bsdad med/ bod mi sa ya drug yongs rdzogs kha spab nas sdod pa'i dus tshod gcig la slebs yod pa red ma gtogs/ dgon zlo re gnyis dang / bla ma re gnyis kyi skad cha ma red/ bod mi sa ya drug kha sbub nas sdod pa'i dus tshod 'dir 7rgyal ba lnga pa chen po'i skabs nas lam ston gnang ba de tshor bsam blo gtong dgos pa red ma gtogs/ khyed rang tshos rang dgar so so'i chos brgyud dang phyag len yin mdog mdog gi bsam cho'i thog nas/ ngas bshad pa de tsho bsam btang dran skyes byas nas bshad pa'i bzo 'dra po dang / yang na kha bde po byas nas bshad pa 'dra po/ de min mdzes 'chos byas te bshad pa 'dra po la kha shas kyis go ba mi len pa'i nges pa mi 'dug de tshor khyed rang chos blo gzu bor gnas pa'i thog nas brtag dpyad dang 'brel phan tshun gnyis ma'i lo rgyus rnams nyan te dpyad pa byas na rim pas gsal po shes kyi red/ gang ltar de tsho'i thog la gzab gzab ma byas na yag po mi 'dug shes song ngam/da bar gyi chos rgyun ring tshang mas gang yong ci yong gi 'bad brtson byas yod/ da dung rgyun mthud nas sems yar rgyas gtong thub pa byed dgos/ de ltar byas na/ sras bcas 7rgyal ba'i rmad byung 'phrin las las/ legs grub byang chub lam gyi rim pas kyang / thar 'dod rnams kyi yid la dpal ster zhing / 7rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ring du skyong gyur cig ces thugs smon gnang 388

ba ltar yong gi red/ da res kyi chos 'chad nyan 'di mthalayas pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don dang / de'i nang tshan nas bod spyi don dang 'brel ba chen po yod pas/ tshang mas rang gcig pu'i kun slong dor nas/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po'i kun slong bzang po 'khyer thog de dag gi don chen 'grub pa'i smon lam dang bcas chos nyams len yag po byed dgos/zhes bka' 455// // 389
