༄༅༅// phyi lo 1987 zla 8 tshes 4 nyin la dwags bod khyim rtsed thar du bod mi mang tshogs la bka' slob 455 ba/de ring nga tsho 'dir nub rub byed rgyu byung ba la dga' po byung / nga rang da lam 'dir gajorwa nga sa cha'i babs dang / gnam gshis kyi khyad par dang bcas tsha ga(ོ5ོla lta bur stabs gcig don gnyis kyi yong ba yin/ 'dir bsnyen pa 'dra btang thub na bsam ste da res 'dir zhag bzhi cu zhe grangs shig ring snga dgong thun zin nas bsdad pa yin/da res 'dir dmigs yul gtso bo kha 'don dge sbyor byed du yong ba ma gtogs/ gnas skor 'gro rgyu dang / tshogs 'du tshogs rgyu de 'dra'i 'char gzhi gang yang med/ yin na'ang nga rang tsho bod pa nang tshags de ring 'dir rub tsam bya rgyu byung na bsam byung / khyed rang tsho tshang ma dngos 'brel dad pa dam tshig g.yo ba med pa'i thog nas de ring 'dir yong ba red/ thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo mang po phyin pa red/ dngos gnas rang da lta'i mi thog 'dir bod nang du yod pa'i bod pa tshor cha bzhag na'ang dka' ngal de lta bu myangs pa red/ bod kyi lo rgyus nang du dus tshod sdug shos shig nga tsho'i mi thog 'dir 'khel ba red/ nga tsho btsan byol du gyar bsdang pa de rnams kyang ming la btsan byol ba thogs bsdad yod/ gang ltar rang yul bral nas gzhan yul gyi sa mthar gnas tshul mang po zhig 'og ga na dbang gi gnas su bsdad dgos pa zhig chags nas ༄ ༄nan yang snying nga cho ༷/da mi gzhis/ byes yongs rdzogs mi thog 'di'i sgang dus tshod sdug shos shig thog slebs bsngang 390

yod/ nga rang rgyal ba rin po cher cha bzhag na'ang rgyal ba rin po che sku phreng bcu bzhi pa yin pa red/ gzhi rkang sku mdun gong ma'i skabs la yin na yang sku ngal chen po byung yod pa red/ de'i gong gi sku thog mang po zhig gi skabs su'ang sku ngal 'phrad rgyu 'phrad yod pa red/ 'on kyang rang gi lung pa bral/ mi'i 'u/nga par dus yun lo nyer brgyad tsam zhig bsdad dgos pa phal cher nga gcig po red/ phyogs gcig nas dus tshod bkra shis po dang/ gra 'grigs po yod pa yin na mi'i rnam dpyod dang / mi'i nus pa de 'don thub pa zhig red/ dus tshod dka' ngal chen po dang / 'gal rkyen mang po zhig 'phrad pa'i gnas skabs su snying stobs dang / rnam dakhyod kyi nus pa 'don thub pa byung na dmigs bsal gyi dge mtshan sku(da pa red/nga rang sto da lta'i mi thog 'di phyogs gcig nas bod kyi lo rgyus nang dngos 'brel sdug shos shig chags bsdad pa'i dus tshod 'dir 'dzam bu gling nang bod pa zhes lab dus bsreg btub 'pher ba dngos 'brel 'ju lung 'jog zha bas yod pa/ mdzub mo 'dzugs sa yod mkhan gyi mi rigs shig yin pa deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la ra 'phrod yong li/ yod pa red/ de ni dngos gnas rlabs chen red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug de dang chabs cig rkyen ngan grogs la shar ba lta bu zhig byung yod/ nga rang tsho med pa bod la bsdad pa'i skabs yin na so so rang nyid la rig gzhung gting zab dang / chos kyi bsam tshul rlabs chen po yod pa de rnams so so rang /nga be la nga pa'i nang mgo 'khor nas bsdad pa ma gtogs 'dzam gling phyi rol nas de cam mthong sga yod pa ma 391

red/ re zung re zung shes mkhan tshos kyang bod pa'i chos zer dus ya mtshan skye sa zhig dang / khyad mtshar yi bzo 'dra po/ mdor na spyir btang nga rang tsho'i nang pa'i chos 'dir bla ma'i chos lugs red zer nas ha lam sh+ka pa thugs rje can gyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yal da gsangs pa'i chos min pa la ba'i chos ri tsho dming ri pa /ba/ ra nga shig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang de ring kha sa'i dus tshod 'dir nga rang tsho btsan byol pa mang po zhig bod kyi phyi rol du slebs pa'i rjes su 'dzam bu gling gang sa gang du 'brel ba byed rgyu'i go skabs gsar pa zhig byung / 'brel ba byed bde po zhig chags/ phyi rol gyi mi bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung la do snang yod mkhan dang / de bzhin 'dzam gling shar phyogs kyi rig gzhung la do snang yod mkhan de tshor yang 'brel ba byed bde po zhig dang / slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs shig byung / de 'dra'i thog nas phyi mi gang la gang 'tshams shig gis slob sbyong dang do snang byas yod/ de 'dra byas pa'i nyer len gyis deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod kyi rig gzhung zer dus nang pa'i chos cha tshang ba dang / gting zab po yod pa/ nang pa'i chos kyi thog nas bshad dgos byung na bod kyi nang pa'i chos 'di dngos 'brel zab shos shig dang / rgya che shos yin pa zhig la deng sang gzhi nas ngos 'dzin bya gi yod pa red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nga tsho'i mi thog 'di sdug po myong mkhan zhig chags pa yin na yang bod mi rigs kyi la rgya gong nas gong du spel mkhan zhig kyang chags pa red/de nga m+mu gzi brjid red/ de nga m+mu byas rjes kyang red/ nga rang la cha bzhag na/ a mas phru gu dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho lo lnga bcu nga grangs nang 392

slebs pa zhig nas rlabs chen po zhig dang / ha las pa de 'dra byed ma thub nasang / nga bod kyi phyi rol du slebs nas mi go gang la gang 'tshams shig bcad yod bsam pa dran gyi 'dugargya che'i bod mi mang gis re ba bcol ba nang bzhin ngas zhabs 'degs cha tshang ba zhig dang / 'dod pa khengs pa zhig sgrub thub yod pa ma red de yin na'ang zhabs 'dren mi zhu mkhan zhig byas sku da bsam pa dran gyi 'dug red dam ma red/ nga gcig po'i thog nas 'jon pa gang yang ma red/ rten 'brel ltos grub zer ba spyir btang gi 'gro stangs yin dus 'go la rgyal ba rin po che zer ba zhig dang / gsham la bod mi mang zer mkhan dngos 'brel dad pa dam tshig g.yo ba med mkhan/ blo rtsa brtan po yod pa/ rnam dpyod blo gros ldan pa de 'dra zhig yod pa'i dbang gis phan tshun gcig gis gcig la bltos pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba rin 11 ches nus pa 11na pa red/gang ltar yang snying thun mong gi thog nas hur thag byas pa'i grub 'bras su 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la dngos 'brel bod pa zhes lab dus mdzub mo 'dzugs sa yod pa zhig chags nas bsdad yod/ mi'i grangs lnga'i ngos nas cha bzhag na/ bod nang skusad pa'i bod mi sa ya drug lon mi lon zhig las sku(da pa ma red/ btsan byo la ba'i nang 'bum gcig dang khri gnyis nas gsum bar lhag yod pa ma red/ rgya mir cha bzhag na/ dngos 'brel sa ya stong phrag gi snang du slebs bsdad yod/ phyogs gcig nas mi grangs la cha bzhag na he bag chen po yod pa dang / gnyis nas bden pa zer mkhan der rtsis 'gro gtong 393

gi yod pa ma red/ dbang yod bshad/ dpung shed kyi thog nas rgya mis bod lung pa btsan po'i thog nas bzung ste bsdad yod/ drag gnon byed kyi yod red/ ngo tsha khrel gzhung yod pa ma red/ rgyu mtshan dang drang bden la bsam blo gtong gi yod pa ma red/ yin na yang dngos yod gnas tshul gyi thog sde bod pa zhes lab dus rgyu mtshan mang po'i thog nas rgya mi bzod ma bde zhig chags bsdad yod/ mi ya rabs shig dang / blo gzu bor gnas pa zhig yin na dpung gi thog nas thub chod 'gro gi yod na'ang / drang bden gyi gnas tshul thog nas phran bu sems nang mi bde ba zhig yong mdog kha po red/rgya mi kho rang tshos grangs nyung mi rigs zhes mi rigs mi 'dra ba lnga bcu nga grangs shig yod zer gyi yod pa red/ de'i nang tshan nas mi rigs rub 'dus byas nas bsdad mkhan bod pa dang / shing cang / sog po rnams cung shugs che bar brtsi gi yod pa red/ deng sang rgya mi'i dril bsgrags yig cha mang po'i nang bod lung pa'i thog khong tshos byas byas btang btang dmigs 'dzugs byas nas bshad dgos pa de rgya mi bzod ma bde yod pa'i gnas tshul gsal po red/gnas tshul 'di'i thad la bod nang yod pa'i bod pa tsho dngos gnas drang gnas ha las dgos pa'i snying stobs dang / ha las pa'i blo rtsa brtan po yod 'dug1959 lo'i nang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed pa'i 'go stod la phal cher nga rang tsho'i grong gseb sa khul gyi spyir btang zhing 'brog mi skyo ba de m+mu nang 'phral selas gsar 'dra po phran bu chags yod bzo 'dugade nas rim bzhin rig gnas gsar brje langs te rgya mi kho rang tsho yang ha lam rang shi rgyag dgos 394

pa'i spyo mchongs byas pa red/ de ltar byas pa'i nyer len gyis lo mang gsar brjer yid ches byed mkhan rgya mi'i ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub mkhan gyi mi sna mang po zhig sna 'tshig dgos pa'i gnas tshul chags yod pa red/bar lam nas bod phyi nang gi 'brel ba byung ba dang / 'dzam gling phyi rol du 'brel ba byed pa'i dus tshod cig chags yong dus de snga phan chad rgya mi gung khran gyis lo sum cu lhag ring lo rgyus 'khyogs bshad tshad med byas pa rnams rdzun rkub tshang ma brdol gyi yod pa red/ rgya mis da phan lo nas lo bstud de spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rgyal khab yag yag de'i nang tshan nas rgya nag gung khran yag yag rtag par bshad sdod kyi yod kyang / da cha spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rgyal khab dang / mag si ring lugs kyi rgyal khab de tsho bong bu thon nas sbo lug gi yod pa red/ ring por ma thogs par 'dzam gling nang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje dang / gung khran ring lugs kyi gsar brje zer ba ha log pa'i dus la slebs yod/ phyi lo 1979 dang 80 tham pa'i rjes 'dzam gling phyi log la 'brel ba bya rgyu'i dus tshod byung ba'i skabs la/ btsan rgyal ring lugs zer ba'i rgyal khab de tsho'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs dang / shes yon gyi gnas stang sa yag tu phyin/ mi mang la rang dbang chen po dang / thob thang yag wab de 'dra zhig gi dngos yod gnas tshul mthong ba'i skabs su rgya mi kho rang tsho'i bsam blo'i nang de snga phan chad dang rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba'i bsam blo zhig gtong dgos pa chags yod/ de bzhin bod nang du yod pa'i nga rang tshe thod rigs nang duyin na'ang / bod phyi nang gi 'brel ba byung ba dang / 'dzam 395

gling gi gnas tshul zhib tshags shig mthong / de snga phan chad rgya mis lab pa'i gnas tshul dang mi 'dra ba/ rgya mi gung khran gyi byed stangs nang du'ang mi 'dra ba cig slebs yod pa/ u ru sur cha bzhag na'ang gor po cob yar slebs tshar ba'i rjes su de snga'i dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs dang / spyi tshogs kyi 'gro stangs lam lugs de dag gzhi nas bsgyur bcos gtong dgos kyi yod pa dang /yang gsar brje gsar pa zhig byed dgos kyi yod pa/ de 'dra'i 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod par brten nga rang tsho bod nang du'ang bsam blor shugs rkyen chen po thebs kyi yod sa red/ mi 'ga' zhig gis rgya mi la mi dga' yang rgya mi'i 'og tu 'gro rgyu ma gtogs gzhan gyi re ba rgyag sa med bsam mkhan yod pa red/de tsho khag yod pa ma red/ yong srid kyi red/ deng sang bod phyi nang gi 'brel ba chags/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i thog bod pa'i gnas tshul bshad mkhan mang du phyin/ bod nang lha sa sogs sa khul mang po zhig tu phyi nas lta skor yong mkhan de tsho'i nang thod kyinang pa'i chos byed mkhan de 'dra yang gang 'tshams yong phyi rgyal gyi mabo sir grwa chas gyon mkhan gra pas ṇi de 'dra yang gang la gang 'tshams yong / de tsho'i gras kyis lha sa'i jo rwa1 dbu skra'i 'og phyag 'tshal gyi yod pa'i bzo 'dra po/ bod skad kyi thog nas 'don pa 'don mkhan de 'dra yang yod pa 'dra/gang ltar yang snying bod par sha tsha byed mkhan phyi rgyal gyi mi mang po zhig mngon rgyu yod pa de 'dra'i thog nas rdo don yang snying bod nang yod bsdad pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams kyi sems shugs brtan po sngon nas yod pa'i thog bar lam phyin nang gi gnas tshul 'gyur ba de tshos rkyen byas te deng sang bod nang gi mi brgya 396

cha 99 rtsa ba nas rgya mir mi dga' mkhan yin pa shin tu gsal 11 'dugade ni nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i stobs shugs red/ bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang de dag sde da lta lab pa bzhin phyi nang gi rkyen mang po zhig 'dzoms/ so so'i nyams myong bden pa'i gnas tshul mang po zhig gi thog nas deng sang sngar las kyang lhag pa'i blo stobs che ru phyin yod/ lhag don de snga nga tsho bod du rgya mi mnyam du phal cher lo dgu ma zin tsam bsdad pa red/ de'i skabs la yin na rgya mi gung khran gyis chos la ngo rgol bya gi yod pa red zer nas mi dga' ba dang / rgya mi gdug rtsub chen po red zer nas 'jigs snang byed pa tsam ma gtogs rtsa ba rgya mi rigs dang / bod mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod kyi rnam pa gsal po rang yod pa ma red/ deng sang mi rigs bar gyi 'thab rtsod kyi rnam pa gsal po chags yong gi 'dug dper na/ phru gu chung chung zhig yin na'ang kho rgya ro dang rgya ro/ kho rgya rgan dang / rgya rgan zhes bshad kyi yod pa red/ mdor na las khungs gcig gi nang du rgya skad rgyab sdod mkhan zhig yod na rgya mi zhig 'dug zer nas rnam 'gyur khag khag ston gyi yod pa dang / rgya mi de phyin tshar ba'i rjes su kho rgya ro phyin song zeratas las khungs nang tshagasayin na'ang de 'dra bshad dgos pa'i gnas tshul yong gi yod pa red/ phru gu slob grwa ba nang khul la yang gang ltar rgya phrug dang / bod phrug ces zer nas dbye 'byed yong mkhan/mdor na btson pa zhig yin na'ang rgya mi dang bod mi zhes bshad nas lam seng dbye 'byed yong mkhan de 'dra zhig chags bsdad yod pa red/ don snying mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod shugs che na po dang / mngon gsal dod po yod mkhan 397

zhig chags sku(da pa red/rgya mis gsal bsgrags byas gsal/ dus sang phyi zla 7 nas bzung ste bod rang skyong jongs kyi sa khul nang la bod yig dang / bod skad de gzhung 'brel gyi skad yig byed dgos/ gzhung 'brel gyi yig cha tshang ma bod yig nang bzhag dgos zhes gtan 'bebs byas 'dug de bod par sha tsha ba dang /11da par dga' drags nas byas pa dang / 11da par brtsi bkur byas pa min na yang / de ltar mi bya ka med byung ba red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod nang rgya mi'i srid byus sdug cag yin pa dang / rgya mis bod nang gtor bshig gi las ka mang po byas pa'i mthong tshul shugs chen yod pa dang / ga sa ga nas skad log rgyag gi yod tsang / des rkyen pas rgya mis de ltar mi bya ka med chags pa red/ de yang nga tsho'i mthun pa'i rkyen zhig red/ nga tsho'i rgyal kha zhig red/ji tsam gyis bod skad la do snang dang / ji tsam gyis bod yig la do snang byed pa'i go skabs mang ba byung ba de tsam gyis bod pa'i rnam pa shugs che ru 'gro rgyu dang / bod pa'i rnam pa de brtan tu 'gro gi yod red/ ma gzhi gzhung 'brel gyi yig cha bod yig nang bzhag pa der ha las rgyu gang yang mi 'dug yig gzu gas bod yig red ma gtogs nang don rgya mi'i srid byus dang / rgya mi'i bsam blo kho na red/ yig cha gal che ba zhig byung song na dang po rgya yig bzos/de nas bod yig thog phab rgyu red/ yin na yang gang ltar slob grwa khag gi nang dang las khungs khag gi nang du bod yig bed spyod byed rgyu dar so chen po byung ba yin na mi rigs kyi rnam pa shugs che ru 'gro ba dang / mi rigs kyi bsam 398

blo brtan tu 'gro gi yod red/ des phan gyi 'dug nyen kha che shos dang / dza drag shos ni rgya mi khyon che bod nang yong gi yod pa de red/ dper na/ nga skye sa'i sa char cha mtshon na/ mtsho sngon rang nas thon pa'i rgya yig tshags par zhig nang mtsho sngon zhing chen nang yod pa'i mi rigs kyi grangs tho zhig bkod 'dug ngas da lta mthong ba'i tshags par 'di bzhin phyi lo 1982 lo'i tshags par red/ de'i nang bod rigs kyi mi grangs 'bum bdun lhag tsam zhig dang / rgya mi'i grangs ka 'bum nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dug khams khul da lta nga tshos gsal po ba shad thub min yang / khams kyi sa khul dma' sa dang / lung pa gshongs sa de tsho'i nang rgya mi khyon che yong gi yod bzo 'dug a mdo khul la yang de 'dra chags 'dug zhing las thon skyed byed sa yod pa mang po'i nang rgya mi gzhis chags yong nas zhing pa chags/bod rigs a mdo de tsho'i gras la sa zhi nga phran bu phran bu yod pa ma gtogs mang che ba 'brog pa chags pa dang / lung pa'i khug kyog khug kyog tu bsdad/lung pa gshong sa yag sa/ rtswa chu 'dzoms sa/ zhing las thon skyed byed thub sa'i nang rgya mis khengs/ khams khul du yang de 'dra yin 'dug grangs ka da lta gsal po bshad thub kyi mi 'dugabod rang skyong ljongs zhes rgya mis zur gsal ming btags pa'i dbus gtsang sa khul nang du bar lam kho rang tshos dpal 'byor yar rgyas dang / phyi phyogs la sgo phye ba yin zhes de 'dra'i thog nas bod nang rgya mi khyon che/ mdor na lham bzo bcos rgyag mkhan tshun slebs 'dug da dung ngan byas ngo sor 'khyer 399

te da res nye char4 ri'i srid 'dzin zur pa ka ṭa pe cin du bskyod de teng zha'o thing thug 'phrad skabs sheng zha'o thing gis bod lung pa sa rgya chen po red/ thon skyed chen po red/ mis ldeng gi yod pa ma red/ thon skyed yag spro yong thub ched mi mang du gtong dgos kyi 'dug ces teng zha'o thing gis bshad 'dugade'i skor nye char rgya gar gzhung la'ang zhu gi yod la/ 'dzam gling gang sar skad rgyag gi yod/ sa khul gcig nang mi rigs khe gtsang sdod pa de'i nang mi rigs gzhan zhig btang ste tha ma sa khul de ga'i mi rigs de rnams mngon rgyu med pa zhig chags rgyu'i 'gro stangs 'dir dbyin ji'i tshig gi nang 01941825 /gang ltar rgya bskyed byed pa'i bsam tshul gsar pa zhig slebs yong gi yod/ lung par btsan 'dzul byas pas ma tshad/ lung pa de'i nang gi mi rigs kyang rim pas mngon med bzo rgyu'i las 'gul gsar pa zhig byas yong gi yod pa red/kha nas dpal 'byor dang / lung pa 'dzugs skrun zhes bshad kyi yod na'ang /phugs rgyang ring wa'i cha nas bod lung pa'i nang bod mi las rgya mi mang ba chags rgyu'i bzo lta bstan yong gi yod pa red/ de ni dngos 'brel nyen kha chen po zhig red/ nyen kha de bzhin bod pa gcig lnga'i nyen kha ma yin par rgya gar la'ang nyen kha yong gi yod pa red/ da lta'i gnas skabs su bod nang rgya mi'i dmag mi 'bum gnyis gsum yod na'ang ha las rgyu med/ bod kyi sa khul 'di rgya mir tos na sgar sa lta bu zhig red/ gang yin zer na/ bod nang gi yul mi de tshos rgya mir dga' gi yod pa ma red/ rgya mir don dam pa'i brtsi bkur byed kyi yod sa ma red/ rgya dmag bod nang slebs pa de tshos phyogs gcig 400

nas rgya gar la kha gtad 'jal dgos pa dang / gdong len byed dgos kyi yod red/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas sa khul de ga'i nang gi bod mi de rnams la dogs zon byed dgos pa dang / blos mi 'khel ba'i ngang bsdad dgos pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ rim pas rim pas hi ma la ya'i rgyab kyi lung pa'i nang rgya mi phon che chags pa yin na rgya gar la nyen kha yod pa red/ kha sang nga dang lhan bod mdza' 'brel tshogs pa'i tshogs mi tsho skad cha byung / rgya mi deng sang deng rabs can bzhi la 'gyur gyi yod pa red/ deng rabs can du 'gyur rgyu'i nang dmag r+pā deng rabs can du 'gyur gyiyod red/ rgya mi'i rtsa ba'i lta ba de dang / bsam blo'i 'khyer so de sngon ma'i kho nar bsdad pa'i thog la dmag don shugs che ru phyin/ dmag don tshags tshud du phyin/ dpal 'byor gyi nus pa shugs che ru 'gro dus nyen kha che ru 'gro gi yod pa ma gtogs chung du 'gro gi yod pa ma red/da lta'i dus stod 'di ra nga tsho bod par cha mtshon na dus stod dza drag dang / dus chod gnyan 'phrang thog slebs yod pa red/ rgya gar la cha mtshon na'ang da lta'i dus tshod 'di khe nyen 'dam ga byed sa'i mtshams dang / mi thog nas mi thog bar phyags rgyang ring po'i phan gnod 'gro rgyu'i sa mtshams su slebs kyi 'dugartsa ba'i cha nas nga rang tsho bod pa zhes lab dus dngos 'drel 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la mi mthong cha 'jog 'os pa'i mi rigs shig yin na yang / da lta'i char gnyan 'phrang dang / 'gag rtsa zhig gi dus stod la slebs yod pas nga rang tsho tshang mas da lta phan chad sems shugs ma chag par rig pa bsgrims nas bsdad pa red la/ da dung yin na yang shugs brgyab nas sdod dgos kyi 'dug rtsa 401

ba rang nyid bod pa yin bsam pa'i bsam cho de brtan por sdod dgos pa ma zad/nga tshor rang dbang bral ba 'di slar gso bya dgos yod bsam pa'i bsam blo de nga tsho'i srog gi snying po chags yod/ snying gi dkyil du bzhag dgos/ de bzhin mi rigs kyi la rgya dang / zhen khog ma brjed pa'i jog nas slob sbyong dang / thon skyed kyi las ka/ de min zhi drag gi las rigs gang zhig yin na yang so so'i skabs su babs pa'i las ka de gang ltar bod mi rigs kyi zhabs 'a dren mi zhu ba dang / bod mi rigs kyi mtshan la gong du spel ba'i thog 'gro dgos kyi red/ de rtsa ba red/ mi su zhig yin na'ang dngos 'brel ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam la rgyal kha thob pa zhig bya bsam na spobs pa dgos kyi yod pa red/ ngas thub kyi ma red/ ngas yong gi ma red bsam nas bsdad pa yin na rgyal kha thob thub thabs med/ nga tshos lkug pa dang / ham pa byas te gnod sems kyi las ka byas na nor 'khrul red/ rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig gi thog nas dngos 'brel nga yis nus kyi red/ ngas thub kyi red snyam pa'i bsam tshul 'di la spobs pa zer ba yin pas de dgos kyi yod red/ ma 'ongs par nga tsho yas po yong gi red bsam pa'i re ba med na nga tshor pham nyes yong gi red/ dper na/ rgya nag gi gsar brje byed pa'i skabs thog mar maca dpyi tung dang / thornga tsho'i gras mi nyung shas kyis 'go khrid pa dang / lhag par khong tshos nga rang che 'e bod sa rgyal rong brgyud dang / khams brgyud la yong dus ri chu khri stong la dmar dmag ga la skrag ces bshad de lam bar dka' ngal la rnying stobs ma chag par mthar bskyel byas pa'i nyer len gyis mthar phyi lo 1949 lor khong tshor 402

rgyal kha gtsang ma thob pa red/ der brten mi la snying stobs ha cang gi gal chen po red/ de bzhin dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs 'jar man gyis yo rob nang dmag 'khrug rgyag sa'i khul yongs rdzogs 'jar man gyis bzung ba dang /dbying lan gcig po lhag pa de'i mgo ga la'ang 'jar man gyi gnam grus sbam shugs chen g.yugs te bsdebs gsod gtong skabs snying stobs yod mkhan blo brtan po dang rnam dpyod chen po yod pa'i mi gcig gi sems shugs kyis 'tsho zin pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug mi zer mkhan de la ngas byed thub kyi red bsam pa'i sgobs pa dgos rgyu gal chen po red 'dug ngas 'di ltar zer dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni nga rang tsho 'dir 'brog pa'i bzo 'dra po skyo mdog kha po 'ga' shas yod na yang rtsed pa zer mkhan 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la cha 'jog 'pher ba'i mi rigs shig chags bsdad yod pa yin dus nga tsho zhum dgos pa dang / yid thang chad nas sdod dgos pa zhig rtsa ba nas ma red/ de ltar na tshang mas sngar bzhin snying stobs bskyed de hur thag byed dgos//kha seng 'di ga'i gzhis 'go dang / de min las ka byed mkhan khong chor yang nan po byas lab rgyu byung / de ga nang bzhin gzhon nu dang / bud med tsho la yang lab pa yin/ nga tshos rgya gar nang sgrig 'dzugs byas nas bsdad yod pa red/ gzhis chags khag la nang srid la sa khungs nas blta gi yod/ shes yon gyi slor la shes rig las khungs nas blta gi yod/ dgon pa khag gis mtshon pa'i chos ris gi las ma'i rigs de tshor chos don las khungs nas lta gi yod/ sde tshan so sor las 'gan dkris nas bsdad yod/ de tsho'i 'go 403

'doms bka' shag nas byed kyi yod pa red/ yin na yang nga tsho phyogs gcig nas mi'i lung par bsdad pa dang / gnyis nas mang gtso'i lam la 'gro gi lho pa yin dus khyed rang tsho nas gong rim gyis 'char gzhi bkod nas cha tshang zhig byed kyi red bsam pa'i yid ches blos 'gel byas nas sgug sdod rgyu mi 'dugakha seng me sor la yang lab pa yin/ sa gnas so so nas phran bu'i gnas tshul shes pa dang / skad yig gi thog nas 'brel ba byed thub mkhan gzhon skyes tsho red/ gzhon nu dang / de bzhin bud med kyi tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs yod pa yin tsang / khyed rang tshor sa khul so so'i gnas tshul rgyus mnga' yod pa yin dus nga rang d+ku dpal 'byor gong 'phel gtong stang dang / 'phrod bsten gyi thog nas yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong phyo gas/ rig gzhung gi thog nas yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong phyogs/ shes yon gyi thog nas yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong phyogs gang ci/ sa gnas so so'i dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la ran pa dang / 'tshams pa zhig gi go skabs gang dang gang yod sa gnas sa thog tu thabs shes byas/ 'tshol zhib byas/ nyams zhib byas/ de 'dra'i thog nas thabs lam gsar pa rnyed na khyed rang tsho sa gnas sa thog nas lag len 'gel rkyang byas/ nga tshos 'di ltar byed kyi yod ces skabs bstun 'brel lko las khungs la lab/ gal srid sa gnas sa thog nas khyed rang tsho'i nus pas mi ldeng ba dang / mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa 'dra yong gi 'dug na go skabs de 'dra zhig 'dug gnas tshul de 'dra zhig 'dug de'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms mi 'dug pas rogs ram bya dgos zhes dang / yang na rogs ram 'tshol rogs zhes 404

'brel yod las khungs so sor lab ste gang ltar skul lcag yang yang gtong ma khan zhig ma byung tshe nga tsho 'thus sna(ra gyi nyen kha chen po 'dug kha sang ngas nan po byas te lab pa yin/ las byed par cha mtshon na yang / 'dir /ba stesas srung bar yong ba ma red/ zla re zla re'i phogs thob za thub tsam zhig dang / sa gnas so so'i sgang la yod ces mdzub mo btsugs nas bsdad pas la dag gi yod pa ma red/ las byed bskos pa tsho mi mang gi zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan yin pa'i skad cha red/ mi mang mgo ma thon mkhan tsho mgo 'don mkhan yin pa'i skad cha red ma gtogs /ba stegs srung mkhan lta bu byas pas 'grigs kyi yod pa ma red/ de 'dra yin dus las byed pa chos kyang gang dga' ci legs skor gnas tshul zhib 'jug byas/ bsam blo btang / tha ma gzhan dag med na'ang dka' ngal nang lhung bsdad pa ga tshod yod med dngos dngos rjen rjen skabs so sor nga tshos shes dgos pa gal chen po 'dug 'dir nga tshos ji 'dra yod ces skad cha dris dus yag thag chod yod ces lab/ ngo thog dngos yod gnas tshul la skyo thag chod byas nas bsdad mkhan de 'dra lhags bsdad na cho gang yang byung ma song / mgo skor btang ba red/ de yag po gang yang mi 'dug lhag bsam thog skyon yod rung med rung / gang ltar yang snying las don ngo ma'i thog nas 'thus shor gyi yod pa red ma gtogs 'thus sgo tshang gi yod pa ma red/ de 'dra yin dus phyogs gcig nas khyed rang tsho las byed pa yin na yang dngos gnas rang ga re byed rgyu 'dug gam/ tshad tshad bsdur bsdur sgo gang sa nas bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ 'di gar yod pa'i khyed rang 405

cho gzhon nu'i khongs nas yin na'ang rung / bud med khongs nas yin na'ang rung / de min so so'i ngos nas bsam blo btang ste de 'dra'i thabs shes 'don rgyu gal chen po 'dug gzhan dag shod rgyu med /da shin bstan 'dzin dge byed kyis lab pa ltar la dwags sa khul gyi yul pa de dag kyang nga rang tsho rwa1da kyi rig gzhung nyams len byed mkhan sha stag red/mang che ba nang pa chags bsdad yod/ dper na kha che la cha bzhag nayang / rig gzhung goms gshis kyi thad nas bod pa rang chags bsdad pa lta bu red/ la dwags kha che ngo shes kha shas yod pa kho tshos skad cha shod dus lha sa'i skad gtsang ma rgyag gi 'dug kho tshor bod mi rigs kyi rgyun gshis cha tshang 'jags yod/dper na/ lo gcig nga tur ki zer sa der phyin pa yin/ ngas ngo shes pa shin cang spo bo lags shig yod/ kho rang rgas po chags 'dug shin cang pa gang 'tshams shig tur ki'i nang yod tsang / ngas lo gcig ched mngags phyin pa yin/ der phyin pa'i skabs la shin cang ba dang mnyam du gnyen 'brel byas te chos lugs kyi thad nas kha che chags yod pa la/ don dag yang snying nga rang tsho ༄1da rigs rang byas pa'i lha sa ba skye dman 'ga' shas nas nor bu gling kha'i 'gram kha che gling ga'i nang sdod kyi yod zer/ nor bu gling ga'i lo rgyus bshad de rnam kun rkyang thang sgang gi kha che gling khar chu brgal sa yod/ 'khyams sdod sa de tsho'i lo rgyus bshad byung / ha cang dga' po byed pa dang chabs cig ngu gi 'dug chos lugs kha che chags bsdad yod na yang / bod pa'i sems shugs shin tu chen po 'dug de 'dra'i thog nas nga rang tsho dang ha cang nang tshags 406

chags bsdad kyi 'dugardo don yang snying la dwags sa khul 'di'i mi mang de chos nga rang tsho bod pa la dmigs bsal gyi sems thag nye po zhig dang / so so'i lung pa skyod nga red de yin na'ang nga rang tsho btsan byol du sdod rgyu'i go skabs sprad pa ha cang yag po red/ la dgas kyi yul mi cho snyoms chung dang / ha cang gi yag po red/de 'dra yin dus nga chos ngad mi'i ngos nas brnyas bcos byed pa dang / khyad gsod byed pa'i bzo 'dra gtan nas bya rgyu yod pa ma red/ gnyis nas la dwags sa khul du deng sang dmangs gatsho'i khe dbang longs su spyad de 'os bsdu byed pa dang / srid don gyi shog kha 'dra min dbar 'thab rtsod byed dgos pa yong gi yod red/ de 'drayong ba'i skabs la nga rang cho ༄1da pa'i ngos nas byus gtogs byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ sngon ma 'bras jongs khul du'ang nan po byas te lab rgyu byung / de bzhina.a ru na cal nang du'ang nan po byas lab pa yin/ sogakhyel sgo so'i nang 'os bsdu byed pa'i skabs la yang bod pas phar sgril tshur sgril byas na yag po yod pa ma red/ nga tsho gzu bor gnas te sdod dgos/ dngos 'brel dgos pa rgyu mtshan yod pa zhig dang 'brel ba bya dgos byung tshe ngas kyang byed kyi red/ bod pa'i tshab ngos nas byed kyi yod red/ rgyal ba rin po ches byed kyi mi 'dug na khyed rang tshos kyang 'jam thing thing sdod rgyu red ma gtogs/ sa khul gyi srid don thog byus gtogs byed rgyu yod pa ma red/gtso che shos de ring kha sa'i dus stod 'dir bod phyi nang gnyis su gnas pa'i bod mi tshos rig pa sgrim dgos pa'i dus tshod red/ deng sang 'dzam bu 407

gling 'di'i sgang la yod pa'i nga rang tsho bod pa spyi bo gnam bsten yongs rdzogs kyis dngos gnas bod spyi pa'i don dag thog khur 'khyer gyi yod pa red la/ nga rang tsho rgya gar la sdod mkhan yin na'ang dngos 'brel so so'i skabs su babs pa ga re yin na'ang tshang mas hur thag byed kyi yod pa red/ bod nang la yod pa tshor cha bzhag na'ang gang ltar yang rgya mi'i sna khung 'tshig dgos pa zhig byas yong gi yod pa red/ phyi rgyal du bod pa nyung shas ma gtogs med pa'i lung pa tsho'i nang cha mtshon na/ dper na/ sud si'i nang yod bsdad mkhan gyi bod pa tsho dang / nub 'jar man/ ing lan/ a me ri ka/ yo'o si gro ri ya/thos( lan so gas phyi rgyal sa khul 'dra min nang yod bsdad mkhan gyi bod pa tshang mas sa khul so so'i nang mi go cha tshang bcad de rgya mi'i dpon rigs tsho lta skor du yong ba dang / yang na rgya mi'i ming 'khyer nas zlos gar tshogs pa 'dra yong skabs lta bu/ dper na/ bar lam zhig ni'u yog la rgya mi'i zlos gar chogs pa zhig yong ba red/ ming ni rgya mi'i ming 'khyer gyi yod pa red/ nang don ni bod pa'i zlos gar chags bsdad yod red/ skabs der ni'u yog tu yod pa'i bod pa tshos bod pa yin pa'i cha nas dga' bsu zhus/ dga' po byas/ thugs spro btang / rgya mi'i ming 'khyer/ 'go khrid rgya mi yod pa'i cha nas ngo rgol byas/mtha' gnyis su ma lhungs pa byed stangs ha cang yag po byas 'dug kha seng pha ran si la yang 'grems ston zhig byas 'dug 'grems ston byed dus ming de rgya mi'i ming 'khyer te slebs yong gi yod pa red/ de mnyam du rgya mi zhig kyang slebs yong gi yod pa red/ yin na'ang nang don 'grems ston byed rgyu'i 408

dngos po ni bod pa'i sku thang dang / ca lag rnying ma de 'dra red 'dug de 'dra yin pa'i cha nas bod pa yin dus dga' po byas/ dga' nye nang tshags kyi rnam 'gyur bstan/ yang rgya mi yod pa'i cha nas ngo rgol byas/ de 'dra byas 'dugayag po byung / de bzhin sud si'i nang cha bzhag na'ang / rgya mi'i dpon rigs de 'dra yong ba'i skabs la ngo rgol byed rgyu dang / rnam 'gyur 'dra min bstan pa/ go skabs dam 'dzin gyis sa gnas kyi tshags par nang du'ang gnas tshul 'god pa sogs sa khul gang sa gang du yod pa'i bod pa tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don dag gi sems khur blangs te hur thag byed kyi 'dug dngos gnas dga' po byung / nga rang tsho bod pa tshang ma'i sgal pa'i sgang la rdog khres re re 'khyer te hur thag byed kyi yod pa red/ rjes su yi rangs yod/ da dung yin na yang nga rang tsho tshang mas sems shugs ma chag par hur thag byed dgos/ shes song ngam/ bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che/ zhes 455// //409

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 11 nyin man spar phan bde gling gzhis chags su 455 ba'i bka' slob/da res 'dir gzhis chags su nyin ma mang po bsdad nas rdzod rdzod ma byung yang / nyin ma gnyis lhag tsam gyi ring la nga rang tsho don dang ldan pa 'dra po byung song / nga rang yang dga' po byung / gzhis chags kyi las rigs tshang mar blta skor byed ma thub kyang / chos 'brel dang / gtso che shos nga rang tsho tshogs 'du 'tshogs te gang ci'i 'gro stangs kyi thog la go bsdur byas/ 'grel bshad byas byed rgyu 'di gal che gi red/ da lam 'dir gzhis chags la 'byor dus spyir btang khyed rang tsho mi mang gi gos gyon stangs dang / gdong gi rnam 'gyur sogs gang ci sngon ma'i rtsis byas na drag tu phyin 'dug par dga' po byung / tshang mar thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ da lta bka' blon nas 'grel bshad byas pa bzhin/ rgya mi'i ngos nas nga tsho bod pa sdug rul la brtsis kyi yod pa red/ rtsam pa za mkhan/ dri ma kha mkhan zhes bod par rin thang med pa brtsis kyi yod pa red/ rgya mi gcig pu ma gtogs/ gzhan 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod pa tshor rus dang gzhung brtsis sa yod pa dang / chos dang rig gzhung gi shes tshad gting zab yod mkhan zhig la ngos 'dzin gyi yod/ ham pa bshad na nyin ma kha shas dang / zla ba kha shas/ lo kha shas khungs 'khyol na yang / rim pas rim pas ral pa lhan pas ma khebs pa lta bu byas nas bsdad dgos kyi yod/da lta'i rgya mi 'di dag la las mgo bskor gyi jog nas bshad kyi yod pa red/kha shas dngos gnas rang ma shes pa'i thog nas bshad kyi yod kyang / bden 410

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 11 nyin man spar phan bde gling gzhis chags su 455 ba'i bka' slob/da res 'dir gzhis chags su nyin ma mang po bsdad nas rdzod rdzod ma byung yang / nyin ma gnyis lhag tsam gyi ring la nga rang tsho don dang ldan pa 'dra po byung song / nga rang yang dga' po byung / gzhis chags kyi las rigs tshang mar blta skor byed ma thub kyang / chos 'brel dang / gtso che shos nga rang tsho tshogs 'du 'tshogs te gang ci'i 'gro stangs kyi thog la go bsdur byas/ 'grel bshad byas byed rgyu 'di gal che gi red/ da lam 'dir gzhis chags la 'byor dus spyir btang khyed rang tsho mi mang gi gos gyon stangs dang / gdong gi rnam 'gyur sogs gang ci sngon ma'i rtsis byas na drag tu phyin 'dug par dga' po byung / tshang mar thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ da lta bka' blon nas 'grel bshad byas pa bzhin/ rgya mi'i ngos nas nga tsho bod pa sdug rul la brtsis kyi yod pa red/ rtsam pa za mkhan/ dri ma kha mkhan zhes bod par rin thang med pa brtsis kyi yod pa red/ rgya mi gcig pu ma gtogs/ gzhan 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod pa tshor rus dang gzhung brtsis sa yod pa dang / chos dang rig gzhung gi shes tshad gting zab yod mkhan zhig la ngos 'dzin gyi yod/ ham pa bshad na nyin ma kha shas dang / zla ba kha shas/ lo kha shas khungs 'khyol na yang / rim pas rim pas ral pa lhan pas ma khebs pa lta bu byas nas bsdad dgos kyi yod/da lta'i rgya mi 'di dag la las mgo bskor gyi jog nas bshad kyi yod pa red/kha shas dngos gnas rang ma shes pa'i thog nas bshad kyi yod kyang / bden 410

pa'i gnas tshul rim pas mtha' gsal gyi red/ gang ltar yang snying da lta'i char 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod pa sa ya drug tsam ma gtogs med na yang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i nang la lo rgyus dang ldan pa'i mi rigs shig chags bsdad /da pa red/ mi yin pa gcig gyur yin na'ang / lo rgyus kyi thog nas mi'i snying stobs dang shes rgya che chung la sogs pa'i khyad par yod pa red/ de snga'i lo rgyus kyi nang la nga cho gad pa'i lo rgyus gsal wa ngan nas lo stong phrag gnyis lhag tsam phyin pa red/ gsalapo ma 'khod pa'i gnas tshul sgog nas bshad pa yin na/ deng sang rgya mi sa bod kyi sa khul kha shas nas/ sa'i 'og nas mi'i rus pa dang / mi'i dngos chas bon pa de la brtag dpyad byas pa'i gnas tshul bshad pa ltar na/ kha shas lo bzhi stong dang / kha shas lo drug stong sngon nas bod mi rigs byung bar bshad 'dug gang ltar bod kyi mi rigs de byung ba'i dus skabs ha cang snga po yin pa dang / mi'i spyi chogs yar rgyas snga shos kyi gras red ces bshad kyi 'dug gang ltarayongs grags kyi lo rgyus ltar na/ bod rje gnya' khri btsan po'i skabs nas bzungs lo nyis stong lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus yī pa de'i ring la bod mi rigs kyis dka' sdug mang po myong yod kyang / bod mi rigs 'di ma shi bar 'tsho zhing gnas yod dus bar skabs su bod nang la dngos gnas rang ha las pa'i gtor bshig chen po dang / bod mir dka' sdug tshad med byung na'ang bod mi'i sems shugs dang / bod mi'i snying stobs bcom thub yod pa ma red/ bod nang rgya mi'i byed stangs la mtshon na thog ma bzhi bcu zhe dgu/ de nas lnga bcu'i 'go stod dus tshod nges can zhig gi ring 411

la rgya mi'i rnam 'gyur bstan stangs de 'jam bslus rgyag rgyu'i thabs shes byas pa red/ bod lung pa'i nang la rda yang mang po btang ste grong gseb kha shas la/rgya gung bran drin can pha ma red/ dngul rda yang char pa babs babs red ces de 'dra bshad rgyu'i dus tshod byung ba red/ de nas lnga bcu nga lnga nga drug nga bdun tsam nas rnam 'gyur gdug rtsub che ru phyin te de sngon rda yang dkar po bkram pa de tsho yar bsdus te shog dngul bkram/ da dung bod mi'i me mda' go mtshon rnams bsdus te dam pos dam bcings gnon btsir byed pa'i srid byus zin pa'i dus tshod gcig phyin pa red/ lnga bcu nga dgu lo nas/ bdun cu don dgu tsam bar du chol kha gsum khyon yongs kyi bod mi yongs rdzogs la nus shugs gang yod kyi gdug rtsub drag gnon byas pa dang / mdor na sa khul kha shas la rgya mis ngan bskul byas pa ltar/ sa khul so mo'i las byed pa tsos lo bco lnga'i nang tshud la bod kyi skad yig rtsa med bzo gi yin zer ba dang / lo nyi shu'i nang tshud la bod pa'i ming tsam med pa bzo gi yin zer ba sogs 'jigs snang sdigs ra bskul te gdug rtsub sna dgu tshang ba'i drag gnon zhig byas yod kyang / bod mi rigs kyi snying stobs rtsa brlag gtong ma thub pa red/ nye dus lo shas ring la bod nang dbul bcos phyug sgyur byed kyi yin zhes srid byus gsar pa zhig brtsams te bod nang gang la gang 'tshams kyi gu yangs dang / gang la gang 'tshams kyi yar thon gyi rnam 'gyur zhig bstan te 'jam rtsub thabs shes rnam pa yod rgu rtsal sprug byed kyi yod pa red/ yin na yang bod pa'i bsam blo bsgyur thub med pa dang / bod pa'i bsam blo bslu thub yod pa ma red/ deng 412

sang rgya mi'i srid byus la bod lung pa'i don gyi bdag po bod pa rnams grangs nyung mi rigs la sgyur ched rgya mi phon chen po bod nang la gtong rgyu'i bsam blo btang gi yod pa red/ de ha cang gi nyen ka chen po red/ dper na/ nga skyes sa'i.a mdo khul la cha bzhag na/ phyi lo chig stong dgu brgya brgyad cu'i 'gor/ thon pa'i sa gnas de ga'i rgya yig gsar shog zhig gi nang la/ mtsho sngon khul lu mi grangs ji yod grang sa ka bkod pa zhig mthong byung / de'i nang la mtsho sngon gyi sa khul la bod rigs bdun 'bum lhag tsam zhig dang / rgya mi 'bum nyi shu rtsa lnga lhag tsam zhig yod pa gsal 'dug de bzhin khams khul la thon bskyed yod sa'i sa cha yag sayag sa la rgya mi gzhis chags mang po slebs spongad pa dang / dper na lha sa'i rang skyong jongs zer ba'i khongs kong po khul la grong sde gsar pa de 'dra chags/ grong sde gsar pa de tsho'i nang bod rigs las byed pa'i nang mi nyung shas tsam ma gtogs gzhan rgya mi khe gtsang yin pa'i grong sde gsar pa de 'dra kha shas kha shas chags yod pa'i bzo 'dug bod lung pa'i nang la bod pa grangs ka nyung ba chags/ rgya mi de grangs ka mang ba chags pa'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas rim pas rim pas bod yul rgya yul la bsgyur rgyu'i nyen ka dngos gnas yod pa'i bzo 'dra po 'dug 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul mu rma thud nas phyin pa yin na nam zhig bod zer ba dmigs med la 'gro rgyu'i nyen ka slebs kyi yod pa red/ 'di ni dza drag chen po'i gnas tshul zhig red/ gang ltar da lta phan la nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi snying stobs de khyags pa chu nang du bzhu ba lta bu'i nyams chag gang yang ma phyin par gnas pa 'di bod mi rigs kyi gzi 413

brjid yin pa red/ da cha nga tsho dus tshod gnyan 'phrang 'di 'dra zhig 'grims pa'i skabs su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing bod gangs can yul/ du skyes pa/ dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos kyi rnam pas brgyan pa'i mi rigs shig yin pa 'di ngos 'dzin gsal po byed dgos/ nga bod pa yin bsam pa'i snying stobs dang / nga bod pa yin bsam pa'i la rgya dang / sha zhen byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ bod mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gzi brjid dang /khyad chos 'bur dod thon sa gtso jo de so so'i rig gzhung gi thog nas thon yong gi yod pa red/ nga tsho'i rig gzhung rgya chen po dang gting zab po/ phan thogs yod pa 'di'i 'byung khungs nang pa'i chos la thug gi yod pa red/ spyir btang bod pa mang che ba nang pa yin pa'i cha nas nang pa'ichos shes pa byed rgyu 'di gal chen po 'dug so so sgor gyi 'di phyi'i don dag gi cha nas yin na yang nang pa'i chos shes pa byed rgyu de gal chen po red la/ so so'i mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gzhung gi gtso bo yin pa'i cha nas kyang de shes pa byed rgyu gal chen po red/ mi la rig gzhung gi rnam dpyod ji tsam yod pa de tsam gyis khyad par chen po yod pa 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi nang nas mtshon thub kyi yod pa reng /da lta bar du nga rang tsho tshang mas hur thag 'bad thag byas pa red/ da dung yin na'ang tshang mas sngar las lhag pa'i hur thag 'bad thag byed dgos/ 'o/ rgyus dang ldan pa dang / rig gzhung khyad chos 'bur dod yod pa'i bod mi rigs gcig rtsa brlag 'gro rgyu'i nyen ka slebs pa'i skabs 'dir mi rigs de 'tsho thub pa zhig dang / mi rigs de yi rang dbang thob thang cha tshang rtsod gleng byed pa'i 414

las 'gan bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan tshang marayod pa dang / da lta'i mi jog 'di yi dmigs bsal gyi las 'gan chags bsdad yod pa red/ nga tshos rgya rga 'thab rtsod byed pa'i rtsa ba'i srid byus gang 'dra zhig zin dgos zer na/ sngar chos rgyal tsho'i skabs nas rgya dang bod 'brel ba yod pa yin dus de dus nas srid byus gtan la phab yod/ de ni bod bod yul na skyid/ rgya rgya yul na skyid zer ba de yin/ rgya mi la cha bzhag na nga tsho grogs po red/ nga tsho'i khyim mtshes red/ bod skyid los dgos/ 'on kyang rgya mi'i bde skyid de rgya nag la bsdad nas spyad na yag shos red/ kho rang tsho la'ang phan thogs yod pa red/ kho rang mor phugs la de drin che gi red/ nga rang tsho ༄/da pa so so'i lung pa'i nang la kha khya sim po byas nas bsdad/ nga tshos mi la brdabs gsigs bzo thub kyi yang ma red la/ bzo gi yang ma red/ nga chos mi 'a/ phar brdabs gsigs bsgo gi ma red de/ nga tsho la tshur brdabs gsigs bzo mkhan zhig dgos kyi mi 'dug nga rang tsho bod pa rtsam gzan zer gyi yod pa ltar/ rtsam pa zas na 'grigs/ rgya zas 'bu srin za dgos don mi 'dug 'dzam gling spyi yongs dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa ltar/ bod du yang bzo las dang / 'brog las/ zhing las sogs ya ra rgyas gtong ba la nges par du rgya mi dgos don med/ gling 'di'i sgang la mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs la sogs pas lung pa phan tshun la rogs ram byas nas yul lung tshang ma yar rgyas yong thabs byed pa spyi srol yongs grags la brten rgya mi med na bod lung pa yar rgyas 'gro thabs med pa rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ rgya mi'i phyogs nas rgya mi bod la med na bod 415

yar rgyas 'gro gi ma red zer gyi yod pa red/ de rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / bden pa ma red/ bod par go skabs byung na rgya mi las 'jon pa zhig dang / rgya mi las mkhas pa zhig byed thub kyi red/ phyi rgyal la sku(da pa'i rgya mi/ rgya mi'i gzhung don dang 'brel ba byed mkhan/ slob sbyong byed mkhan dang / tshogs pa lta bu lhag bsam rnam dag gi rgya mi zhig yin na/ nga tsho bod pa yin zhes ngo sprod byas pa'i tshe tshur dga' po byas/ bag phebs po byas nas mnyam du bsdad nas skad cha bshad kyi 'dug rgya mi'i bsam blo'i nang bod pa'i thog la mthong chung byed mkhan gyi rgya mi zhig yin na/ nga tsho bod pa yin zhes ngo sprod byas pa dang / lam seng gdong dmar po chags/ sdod skyor rgyab ste ma bde ba chen po zhig chags 'gro gi 'dug de chags don ni khong tshor sdug gnong yod stabs ma bde ba chags pa red ma gtogs/ bod lung pa'i nang la khong tsho bsam rngu/ rnam dag gi rogs byed par yong pa zhig dang / bod rgya che'i mi mang gi bsam pa rnam dag gis khong tshor dga' bsu zhu gi yod na ngo tsha dgos don mi 'dug spam shor dgos don mi 'dug nga tsho bod pa yin zhes lab na lam seng nang ma nang tshags shig gi rnam 'gyur bstan thub kyi red/ nga tsho bod pa yin zhes lab na khong sto lam seng ma bde ba dang / ngo tsha kha skyengs byed dgos don yod pa ma red/ dper na/ nye char lha sa la zang nge zing nge byung skor sa gnas kyi khyab bsgrags tsam ma yin par pe cing rang nas khyab bsgrags la/ sa gnas kyi bde 'jags las ka byed mkhan tshos gong rim gyi bka' brtsis te me mda' rgyab yod pa ma red/ mi bsad yod pa ma red/ dkrog mda' kha shas kha shas 416

rgyag dbos byung ba red/ bod pa log spyod pa de tsho'i gras kyis rgya mi'i lag pa nas me mda' 'phrogs te rgya mi la tshur me mda' rgyab/ bod pa nang tshags kho rang tsho la'ang me mda' rgyab pa red ces dang / rgya mis thog mar mi drug yin pa yod/ de'i mjug la mi dgu tsam/ khyonabasdoms bco brgyad bcu dgu zhig shi ba'i skad cha bshad yod pa red/ me mdas mi bsad pa de me mda' yod mkhan gyis bsad pa ma galta gas/ me mda' med mkhan gyis gasku(da ga la shes/ dper na/ rgya mi'i bde 'jags kyi las ka byed mkhan zhig gi lag par rdo 'am/ sa phag phog ste kho'i me mda' lag pa nas shor ba yin pa red/bod pa gcig gi me mda' de tshur blangs nas sa la brdabs te me mda' de bcags pa red/ bod pa'i byed stangs de red/ yin na yang rgya mis gnas tshul 'grel bshad rgyag dus bod pas me mda' rgyab pa red zer ba dang / bod pas mi bsad pa red zer ba sogs/ bod pa'i mig gis mthong shin mthong gin la skyag rdzun de lta bu bshad kyi yod pa red/ de'i mjug la chab srid kyi slob gso btang / lha sar mi mang tshogs 'du skong ste nye char gnas tshul byung ba der khyed rang tshor bsam 'char ga re yod ces dri ba byas 'dug sngon la bsam 'char shod mkhan su yang ma byung bar tshang mas kha rogs bsdad/ da dung do nan po 'dra po byas te dris pa'i skabs mi kha shas kyis rgya nag dbus gzhung nas zhal rdzun de 'dra ma gnang na legs/ zhal rdzun de 'dra gnang na mis yid ches med pa byed kyi red ces bshad 'dug rgyal khab kyi srid byus don dag la go bsdur byed kyiyod pa'i skad cha red/ go bsdur byed dus mi mang gi bsam 417

'char dang po der zhal rdzun ma gnang rogs gnang zer dus gang 'dra zhis 'dug gam/ dngos yod bden pa'i gnas tshul gyis rgya mir na zug chen po yong gi yod dus 'a 'ub ma 'dus bzhin du skyag rdzun kho rang bshad/ skyag rdzun la skyabs bcol dgos kyi yod pa red/ las ka dngos gnas drang gnas bden pa bden gtugs kyi las ka yin na skyabs bden pa la bcol dgos/ rgya mis ma rung khog bcug gis thob thang med pa'i las ka byas pa yin dus skyabs de tam rdzun la bcol dgos kyi yod pa red/ gang ltar deng sang bod rgya'i 'thab rtsod kyi dus tshod gnyan 'phrang zhig gi sgang la slebs yod pas tshang mas sems shugs bsgril nas snying stobs zhum pa med pa byed dgos pa dang / sems shugs yod pa'i thog la nga tsho'i da lta'i gnas tshul shes rgyu de yang gal chen po red/gzhis 'go tshos dus rgyun ldan nas dus tshod namayod la slob gso dang / 'grel bshad 'dra brgyab/ khyed rang tsho'i mi mang nang khungs nas kyang der dmigs bsal gyis do snang byas nas gnas tshul shes thub pa byed dgos/ da ring da lta bka' thon gyi gsung bshad nang la 'khod pa bzhin/ tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs song na so so'i ngo tshab gtong ba de 'dra byas na mi 'grigs/ bod spyi pa'i don dag da lta gang 'dra zhig chags yod pa dang / rgya bod kyi gnas stangs gang 'dra zhig yod pa/ bod gzhung gi bsam blo gtong stangs gang 'dra zhig btang gi yod pa/ ma 'ongs pa la byed phyogs gang 'dra zhig yin pa sogs la do khur byas/ sems khur blangs/ go sdur byas/ gzhis 'go dang las byed pa tsho'i thog nas gnas tshul gang shes pa de dag 'grel bshad brgyab/ dus dus la 418

spyi 'thus mo dang las byed pa de 'dra yang yong gi yod pa red/ de tsho'i skabs la khyed rang tshos dri ba 'dra dris/ do snang byas te shes thub pa byed dgos/ gnas tshu la shes na sems shugs de slebs thub kyi red/ gnas tshul gang yang ma shes par bod rang btsan dgos pa yod ces lab pa yin na de rmongs dad 'dra po chags pa red/ dper na/ chos kyi gnas lugs ma shes par rmongs dad byas na mi 'grigs pa bzhin/ rang btsan dgos kyi yod na/ rang btsan gang 'dra zhig yin pa/ de bsgrub pa la thabs shes gang 'dra zhig byed dgos pa/ de dag shes pa byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po 'dug nga rang tsho'i chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod de'i ngo bo gang 'dra yin pa/ nga tshos thabs shes gang 'dra byas nas bsgrub dgos pa sogs cha tshang khog lon pa byung na bod la phar gnyen 'phrad 'gro mkhan dang /bod nas tshur gnyen 'phrad lasku1nga mkhan byung ba'i skabs la 'grel bshad byed thub pa byung na gang ltar so so'i ngo shes dang / nye ba gnyen tshan de 'dra gcig la gnyis brgyud byas nas sems shugs bskyed rgyur phan thogasayong gi red/ de tshor do snang byed rgyu gal chen po mthong gi 'dug deng sang rgya mis bod nang ta la'i log spyod pas kha bral gyi las 'gul brtsams kyi yod pa red/ log dz+nyā+od kyi byed sgo spel gyi 'dug ces bshad kyi yod pared/ de la tā la'i log spyod pa'i byed sgo'i ngo bo de gang yin zer na/ bod bod yul na skyid/ rgya rgya yul na skyid zer ba'i rtsa don de gzhi la bzhag pa'i thog nas bod par bde skyid dgos kyi yod/ thob thang cha tshang dgos kyi yod/ bod pa'i dpon po bod pas byed dgos kyi yod ces pa de yin pas 'grel bshad brgyab na bod pa lkug pa 419

zhig yin na'ang tā la'i bla mas zer smug de ma red zer rgyu mi 'dug ces bod pa su yin na'ang bshad kyi red/ rgya mis tā la'i log spyod pas kha bral gyi las 'gul spel gyi yod pa red/ de'i dmigs yul ni log spyod srid gzhung skyar log rgyag rgyu dang / spyi tshogs rnying pa zhing bran lam lugs skyar log rgyag rgyu'i ched du red ces bshad kyi yod pa red/ grong gseb khug skyog sa khul gyi mi gnas tshul ji bzhin ma shes mkhan gyi mi de 'dra la rgya mis khyed rang tsho zhing bran lam lugs la dga' ba 'dug gam/ dmangs gatho'i lam lugs la dga' ba 'dug ces skad cha dris kyi yod pa red/ de la zhing bran lam lugs dga' ba 'dug ces sus kyang zer gyi ma red/ rgya mis bar skabs tu la'i ru tshogs kyis zhing bran lam lugs bskyar gso byed rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi 'dug zer ba'i skad cha de lhag pa'i rkyen byas nas nga tshos 'dir brel ba tshub tshub kyi thog nas skad cha gsar pa zhig dang / srid byus gsar pa bzos pa gang yang min par/ nga tsho rgya gar la ma slebs gong nas bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i 'gro stangs de bsgyur bcos gtong dgos kyi 'dug zhing bran lam lugs dang / sa zhing gi 'gro stangs de dag bsgyur bcos gtong dgos kyi 'dug ces legs b.lo spyi tshogs btsugs te gadro la gang 'tshams shig lag len bkal yod pa red/bun chags gtong rgyu mtshon pas las don mang po zhig nga chos lag len 'go btsugs tshar ba red/ de nas nga tsho rgya gar lung par slebs tshar ba'i rjes la mang gatsho'i lam phyogs su bskyod rgyu'i don dag la mi mang gi spyi 'thus btsugs/ ma 'ongs pa'i rtsa khrims bzos pa de dag rgya mi la lan 'debs tsam 420

gyi ched du min par/ bsam pa rnam dag gi thog nas nga tsho mang gce'i lam la 'gro bzhin pa red/ da gin bka' blon gyis 'grel bshad byas pa bzhin/nga tsho mang gtso'i lam la 'gro rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ da lta ngas 'di bshad 'dod byung / bar skabs spyi 'thus 'dems bsgo byed stangs la dka' ngal mang po zhig 'phrad te ye shes dbyings dpyad zer ba de 'dra byas pa red/ de yag po khyon nas mi 'dug da cha ga re byas nas byung na yang gang ltar mi mang rang gis spyi 'thus 'dems bsgo byed dgos kyi 'dug ces nye char gtan gtsang ma 'khel ba yin/ mjug la spyi 'thus 'os 'dems byed rgyu de tsho'i thog la mi mang tshos rgyun du do snang byas/ sems khur blangs/ khral mngon sla bcos ma byas par gal chen po zhig la brtsis nas bsam blo yag po gtong dgos kyi 'dug nga tshos mang gatho'i mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig byed thub na bsam ste nyams myong zhig gsog gi yod pa red/ 'di ni rgya mi'i 'khyogs bshad la don gyi lan 'debs yong gi yod pa red/de nas chos phyogs kyi thog la dmigs bsal bshad rgyu de tsam mi 'dugatshang mas do snang da lta'ang byed kyi yod pa red la/ slob sbyong byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ dgon pa yas mas dang / sngags btsun tsho tshang mas so lo'i tshogs gzhung la 'don pa 'don shes tsam zhig la chog shes ma byas par/ tshig bzang po kha nas bton pa de'i don dag gang 'dra gang 'dra yin pa rnams shes pa'i don du slob sbyong byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ ngas rgyun du 'bod skul byed kyi yod pa ltar slob sbyong la do snang chen po nges par du byed dgos kyi 'dug421

de nas spyir btang slob sbyong gi sgog la da gin bka' blon gyis bshad pa bzhin slob gra'i shes yon gyi mthun rkyen ha cang tshad longs pa yod pa ma red de/ yin na yang gang yod pa de chud zos ma song bar bed spyod byed dgos/de nas gzhis chags kyi las 'gan gtso bo gcig dpal 'byor 'du 'god byed rgyu 'di yin/ de snga mo nas gang yod pa de gar 'thus ma shor tsam byung ba yin na de la chog shes byas nas bsdad na mi 'grigs pas nges par du gsar gtod kyi bsam blo gtong dgos/ thon skyed kyi las rigs gsar pa gang dang gang byed rgyu 'dug de 'dra'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ bar skabs nga rang tshos bzo zhing las rigs 'dra mi 'dra yod pa de dag tshang ma yar rgyas gtong ched 'char gzhi bzos/ phyi rgyal mkhas pa de 'dra yis zhib 'jug byas /slob ston de 'dra byas nas las ku'i gung sgrig ste rim pas rim pas lag len 'gel rgyu yin pa ltar/ nges par du gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i bsam blo gtong dgos pa dang / 'bad rtsol byed dgos kyi 'dug ma gzhi sngon ma nas bshad rgyu byung / sa gnas sa thog gi las byed pa tshor mi mang gi nyin re nyin re'i dka' ngal sel rgyu'i las 'gan yod pas tshang mas sems khur blangs te hur thag 'bad thag byed dgos/ nga 'dra po dus dus la ma gtog sa nyin ma rtag par re bzhin dka' ngal yod sa der slebs thub kyi ma red la/ slebs kyang lam seng gang yang byed thub kyi ma red/ las khyangs rim pa so sos las bgos rgyab nas sde tshan sde tshan bzos yod pa ltar/ sgo so'i las 'gan gang yod pa de nges par du khur du blangs nas 'phral 'phral 422

dka' ngal sel thabs byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug gzhan las byed pa tshos so so'i las dus lo gnyis gsum zhig gi ring la le ma thogs tsam byung na 'grigs bsam te bsdad pa yin na yag po yod pa ma red/ des mi mang bslus par 'gro gi red/ ngas mi mang tsho'i thog la sems khur chen po yod mdog mdog bshad/ dngos su las byed btsugs pa tshos ko thag slod na mi mang gis kyang 7rgyal ba rin po ches bag gro po gsung gi 'dug ste/ ngo thog 7rgyal ba rin po ches bskos pa'i las byed pa'i kha thabs 'di las mi 'dug bsam pa dngos gnas dran gyi red/ des na las byed pa chos rgyun du gzab gzab byed dgos kyi 'dug mi mang tsho'i ngos nas yin na yang / las byed pas bsam blo btang / 'char gzhi bting nas bkod bsgrigs byas pa de dag tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs byas/ sems shugs bsgril nas hur thag 'bad thag byed dgos/ yang skyon dang nor 'khrulayong gi 'dug na rgyab bshad min par skabs 'phral sbyang bshad dang / go bsdur byed dgos/ rdo don snying po las byed pa de btsugs pa'i dgos don de mi mang gi dpon po la bsgos pa ma red/ 'dir lus ka byed pa la sger sger so sos bsgrub dgos pa rigs gcig dang / spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog nas bsgrub dgos pa gnyis yong gi yod pa red/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog nas bsgrub dgos pa de la las byed pa dgos kyi yod pa red/ las byed pas bsam blo btang / 'char gzhi bzos/ gtan 'bebs byas/ 'go 'khrid byas te spyi'i nus pa thon dgos kyi yod pa red/ mi'i spyi tshogs nang la khyim tshang gcig gi nus pa ma ldang ba'i las rigs thon yong dus 423

spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs de dgos mkho yod pa red/ mi mang gi ngos nas yin na yang / spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs de la so so'i bde skyid kyi rtsa ba yin bsam pa'i ngos 'dzin gsal po byas te de la rgyab skyor byas/ de tshags tshud po yong thabs la do snang byed dgos/ de bzhin nga rang tsho spyi pa'i mnyam sbrel de m+mu gras ji tsam yag po byung ba'i tshod kyis spyi pa de la phan gyi yod pa dang / mnyam sbrel khungs ma 'khyol na spyi pa de la gnod kyi yod pa red/ tshang mas so so'i don dag la thug pa nang bzhin gyi sha tsha ldan pa'i thog nas shugs ston byed dgos/de gal chen po 'dug spyi sa bar sa byas nas 'thus shor btang na/ spyi pa der gyong rag gi yod pa red/ mi mang tshos kyang bsam cho de 'dra zhig btang / las byed pa tshos kyang bsam khrode 'dra zhig gtong dgos/ nga tsho'i spyi 'thus tsam ma yin par rim bzhin nga tsho'i gzhis chags che khag tsho'i nang gi 'go 'dzin tsho yang gzhis chags so sku'i nang nas 'os 'dems byed rgyu byung na yag po min nam zhes bar skabs bka' shag dang skad cha byung / gang yin zer na/ mang gatho'i rnam pa zhig kyang mtshon gyi yod pa dang / las don ngo ma'i cha la yin na yang gcig byas na phan thogs 'dra yong srid kyi red/ mdo don yang snying nga rang tsho bod spyi pa'i don dag thog la 'dzam gling spyi yongs nas do snang dang sha tsha ldan pa'i rgyab skyor byed kyiyod pa'i dus skabs 'dir nga rang tsho bod pa'i ngos nas yin na yang / sems shugs bsgril nas las ka gang ci'i thog la yin na yang zhe rdzod ma song bar tshags tshud po bya rgyu gal chen po 'dugade nas bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs thog nas rgya mi la 'brel ba gang 'dra 424

byed kyi yod dam zer na/ nga tsho dang rgya mi thad skar 'brel ba de bdun cu don dgu nas 'go tshugs pa red/ 'brel ba de byas nas skyon gyi cha yong srid kyi red de yin na'ang khe gyong gnyis bsdur ba yin na nga tshor khe phan che ba yod stabs/ rgya mi dang 'brel ba mu mthud nas byed kyi yod pa red/ nye char lha sa'i gnas tshul de byung ste rgya mis tā la'i log spyod pa zhes khyab bsgrags shugs chen po byas pa'i rjes la yang da dung rgya mis nga tshor 'brel ba mu mthud nas byed 'dod yod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan gyi 'dug nga tsho'i ngos nas kyang 'brel ba mu mthud nas byed rgyu'i 'dod pa yod/ 'brel ba de byas pa'i thog nas thag gcod gang 'dra zhig byed rgyu yin nam zer na/ de ni bod spyi pa'i don dag shin tu gal chen po zhig yin pas nga mi gcig gis brgya kha gcig gcod kyis thag gcod byed mi thub la/ byed thabs kyang med/ da lta yod pa'i 'brel ba de'i thog nas phan tshun gnas tshul gsal po go rtogs thub thabs dang / go bsdur thabs shes gang yong byas te bzo lta gang 'tshams shig chags gong na bod kyi don gyi bdag po bod rgya che'i mi mang la go bsdur byas nas thag gcod byed rgyu yin/ bod rgya che'i mi mang tsho bod nang la yod pa'i bod mi sa ya drug yin pas/khong tshor thad kur go bsdur byed bde po zhig med na yang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i thog nas thabs shes gang thub byed dgos kyi red/ sngon la btsan byol la yod pa'i bod mi mang tshogs la bsam tshul ring thung gang 'dra yod pa dang /'dod mos gang 'dra yod pa/ re 'dun gang 'dra yod pa/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gyi thog nas lag len ji tsam sgrub thub dang mi thub/ rim pa dang po la 425

don tshan gang dang gang / rim pa gnyis pa don tshan gang dang gang bzhag dgos pa/ da lta'i mi thog 'di yis ji tsam sgrub dgos pa dang / mi sgog rjes ma de yis las don ji tsam bzhag dgos pa sogs bsam 'char bsdus/ go bsdur zhib cha byas/ de dag byas nas rtsa ba'i thag gcod bya rgyu bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs rdzogs kyi las 'gan dang / thob thang yin pa ltar mtha' ma'i thag gcod rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis byed rgyu'i bsam blo yod ma gtogs/ rgyal ba rin po che dang / dz+nya ram sa la nas thag gcod ga re byed grabs yod med nga tshos ni shes kyi med snyam du khyed rang tsho slo g.yeng nam yang byed ma dgos/bod don thag gcod byed rgyu bod rgya che'i mi mang gi thob thang yin pa ltar/ mi mang re re'i ngos nas thob thang de longs su spyad de gang ltar so so'i bsam tshul gang yod bshad thub pa zhig byas na snyam pa nga'i bsam tshul 'di yin/ bar skabs nga tsho bka' shag la yang go bsdur snga rjes byung / mjug la nga tsho rgya bod skad cha 'grigs thabs shig yod pa yin na de'i 'char gzhi 'god rgyu nga tsho'i las 'gan red ma gtogs/ thag gcod byed pa'i thob thang 7rgyal ba rin po che la yang med pas/ gzhi byes bod mi'i bsam tshul dang / re 'dun gang yod pa de dag gzhi la bzhag pa'i thog nas thag gcod byed dgos zhes skad cha byung / da lta bod rgya'i 'brel ba yod mus ltar/ rjes la mtha' ma'i thag gcod byed rgyu'i dus tshod la slebs song na rgya che'i mi mang la go bsdur byas nas khyed rang tshos gnas tshul tshang ma shes pa'i thog nas thag gcod byed rgyu zhig yong gi red/ lam seng thag gcod ga re byed grabs yod dam bsam 426

pa'i blo g.yeng khyonanas byed mi dgo de gcig bshad 'dod byung / gzhan dmigs bsal bshad rgyu gangasang mi 'dug gang ltar deng skabs ha cang gnyan 'phrang gi dus tshod la slebs yod/ bod mi tshang mas klad pa dkrug 'phral phyags rgyang gsum gyi bsam blo btang ba'i thog nas rig pa bsgrims dgos pa'i dus tshod yin/ bod don gyi 'thab rtsod 'di las sla po zhig rtsa ba nas min/ rgya mi sa ya stong phrag yod pa'i lung po red/ bod pa saya drug ma gtogs med/bod pa'i bsam blo rgya mis dbang bsgyur thub med na yang / bod pa'i lung pa de rgya mis dbang bsgyur byas nas bsdad yod/ me mda' rgya mi'i lag par yod pa las/ bod pa'i lag par yod pa ma red/ 'thab rtsod 'di las sla po ma red/ gcig byas na phyi nang gi rkyen mang po 'phrad pa'i thog nas gang la gang 'tshams kyi gnas tshul 'gyur ba chen wa de 'dra mgyogs pospenang srid kyi red/yin na'ang gcig byas na/ da dung mu mthud zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs brten nas dusasbun ringapo bsdad dgos payangayong srid kyi red/ tshang mas mgyogs po thag gcod yong rgyu'i re ba dang / sems thag thung thung byed mi rung / dper na/ nye char bod nang nas yi ge btang mkhan zhig byung / bar lam bod nang gnas tshul bo ngas la 'dzam gling thog bod kyi bden don de gsal du phyin te bod don la rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang du 'gro gi yod lugs go byung / dus tshod 'disag po red bsam nas nga tshos rang srog blos btang gis las 'gul byas pa yin/ mgyogs myur don dgasag po zhig yong rgyu la re ba chen po yod/phyi la sdod mkhan bod pa tshang mas hur thag byed dgos zhes bris 'dug phyogs 427

gcig nas ha cang yag sngo red/ yin nayang phyogs gcig nas bltas na 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la sngar phan rgya gar la sogs pa'i lung pa mang po zhig gis rang btsan bsgrubs pa dang / da lta yin na yang rang btsan sgrub bzhin pa'i lung pa gang 'tshams da dung yang yod pa red/ de tsho kha shas ni mi thog nas mi thog sbrel te dka' las rgyab yod pa dang / kha shas lo mang po bstud nas dka' las rgyag gi yod pa red ma gtogs/ skad 'bod tshar 'ga' shas bya mu nas don dag byung ba ma red/ ma gzhi nga tsho bod par mtshon na/ da res gcig pu min par/ lnga bcu nga grangs nas dus da lta bar du lung pa 'dra mi 'dra'i nang la de 'dra'i ngo rgol mang po byas yod/ dper na drug cu re dgu'i nang la shugs che thag chod byung yod/ snye mo khul dang / de bzhin khams khul/ a mdo khul mang po la dus tshod nges med nang ngo skol mang po byas te da lta bar du lo bzhi bcu skor gyi ring la bod rang dbang rtsod len byas yod pa red/ yin na yang lo bzhi bcu skor 'di mi thog gcig gi bzo 'dra zhig yin pas/ 'dod thag thung thung byed rgyu mi 'dug nga tsho'i re don dus tshod thung thung nang la 'grub na dang / de min gang shes zer ba lta bu'i sems thag thung thung byas na nyen ka chen po yin/ nga tshos mgyogs myur gnas tshul bzang po thon pa'i re ba dang / 'bad brtso na byed dgos kyang / phyogs gzhan nas da dung mi rabs nas mi rabs sbrel te dka' las mu mthud rgyag dgos byung kyang rgyag gi yin bsam pa'i bsam blo btang ste snying stobs bskyed dgos pa gal chen po yin/ shes song ngam/ tshang ma la bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che zhes stsal// //428

༄tsho// phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 29 nyin wa nar mang tshogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/de ring slebs pa mang che ba bod nas dka' las chen po brgyab ste yong ba sha stag yin zhing / kha sang sngon ma 'byor ba tshor nyin shas ring chos 'brel thob yod/ de ring mjal khar yong mkhan nang gi kha shas mdang nub 'byor ba yin brjo da kyi 'dug pa de tshor chos 'brel byed long ma byung ba red/ yin na'ang tshang mar 'tshams 'dri dang bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ skabs der mang tshogs nas thal mo brdabs te dga' bsu zhus par/ lag pa brdabs mi dgos/ sngon ma rgya mi lha sar slebs pa'i skabs la khong tsho'i sku tshab de 'dra grong gseb khag tu mi dmangs la slob gso rgyag par phyin pa red/ de dus gzhi nas lag pa brdabs pa'i lugs srol gsar pa de dar ba red/ grong gseb pa tshor deng sang gnas tshul gsar pa ga re 'dug 'dri skabs khong chos zlog pa rgyag dgos pa'i khral gsar pa zhig 'dug ces lab pa'i skad cha yod/ de ring khyed rang tsho thug par dga' po byung / khyed rang sto yang dga' po yong gi red/ deng skabs gnas tshul zhig gi 'og nas khyed tsho bod la sdod mkhan gyi gzhis pa chags pa dang / nga tshor rang yul bral nas gzhan yul la sdod mkhan gyi byes pa chags te gzhis byes gnyis su gyes nas sdod dgos pa 'di/ nga rang tsho bod pa nang khul lta ba mi mthun ba'am/ yang na chab srid kyi gnas stangs jog ma 'grigs pa byas te byung ba zhig min par/ nga rang tsho tshang ma mi rigs gcig yin pa'i thog chos lugs dang / mi rigs kyi lta ba gcig gyur yin/429

gnas tshul de 'dra zhig gi skabs la rgya mi'i dbang shugs gsar pa zhig slebs rkyen bod mi rigs rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha 'phrad nas phyi lo/ 1959 lo nga rang tsho gzhis byes gnyis su gyes dgos byung ba dang / de'i rjes su 'byor ba'ang khag gcig yod/ gang ltar nga tsho gzhan yul la bsdad nas lo nyer dgu tsam 'gro gi yod/ nga rang la cha bzhag na bsam blo gtong skabs sems skyo po red/ so so'i mi tshe'i lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bar lha sar bsdad/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lo rang yul bral te gzhan yul la slebs shing / lo nyi shu rtsa grangs nas mi tshe'i dar sgang de gzhan yul la bskyal nas da cha lo lnga bcu nga grangs la slebs yod/ da ni mi tshe rgan du 'gro ba las gzhon du 'gro rgyu med/ so so'i mi d+ku nang gi snying bcud lta bu'i yag shos de rang gi lung par bsdad ma thub pa red/yin na'ang nga tsho byes 'byor tsho gzhan yul du bsdad pa 'di bod spyi pa'i don dag gi dmigs yul zhig bcangs te bsdad yod/ bod du yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs tshos kyang bod spyi pa'i don dag gi 'gan chen po 'khyer te bsdad yod/ rdo don snying po gzhis byes gnyis gas 'gro 'dug spyod lam gang sar bod spyi pa'i don dag snying la bcangs nas bsdad yod/bod pa spyi bo gnam bstan yongs kyi mjing par thun mong gi 'gan chen po zhig 'khyer nas 'bad brtson byas pa'i rtags mtshan la/ bar lam chig stong dgu brgya bdun bcu don dgu lo tsam nas nga tsho phyi nang phan tshun gnyen 'phrad 'gro 'ong gi dus tshod cig byung ba red/ bod nas dka' ngal mang po khyad bsad byas te rgya gar khul du yong nas nga rang tsho phan tshun thug pa red/430

gnas tshul de 'dra zhig gi skabs la rgya mi'i dbang shugs gsar pa zhig slebs rkyen bod mi rigs rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha 'phrad nas phyi lo/ 1959 lo nga rang tsho gzhis byes gnyis su gyes dgos byung ba dang / de'i rjes su 'byor ba'ang khag gcig yod/ gang ltar nga tsho gzhan yul la bsdad nas lo nyer dgu tsam 'gro gi yod/ nga rang la cha bzhag na bsam blo gtong skabs sems skyo po red/ so so'i mi tshe'i lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bar lha sar bsdad/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lo rang yul bral te gzhan yul la slebs shing / lo nyi shu rtsa grangs nas mi tshe'i dar sgang de gzhan yul la bskyal nas da cha lo lnga bcu nga grangs la slebs yod/ da ni mi tshe rgan du 'gro ba las gzhon du 'gro rgyu med/ so so'i mi d+ku nang gi snying bcud lta bu'i yag shos de rang gi lung par bsdad ma thub pa red/yin na'ang nga tsho byes 'byor tsho gzhan yul du bsdad pa 'di bod spyi pa'i don dag gi dmigs yul zhig bcangs te bsdad yod/ bod du yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs tshos kyang bod spyi pa'i don dag gi 'gan chen po 'khyer te bsdad yod/ rdo don snying po gzhis byes gnyis gas 'gro 'dug spyod lam gang sar bod spyi pa'i don dag snying la bcangs nas bsdad yod/bod pa spyi bo gnam bstan yongs kyi mjing par thun mong gi 'gan chen po zhig 'khyer nas 'bad brtson byas pa'i rtags mtshan la/ bar lam chig stong dgu brgya bdun bcu don dgu lo tsam nas nga tsho phyi nang phan tshun gnyen 'phrad 'gro 'ong gi dus tshod cig byung ba red/ bod nas dka' ngal mang po khyad bsad byas te rgya gar khul du yong nas nga rang tsho phan tshun thug pa red/430

thug pa'i skabs la tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don dag gi na tsha 'di sems nang 'khyer yī pa'i rtags mtshan la kha nas ngu skad 'don pa dang / mig nas mchi ma gtong ba'i gnas tshul zhig yod/ nga tsho da lta'i mi thog 'di dka' ngal shin tu tshe ba'i gnas tshul sdug shos shig gi 'og la gnas yod/ de ring 'dir bod nas 'byor ba gang la gang 'tsham zhig mnyam du rub nas thug rgyu byung ba 'dis rtags mtshan ga re ston gyi yod dam zhe na/ bod pa spyi bo gnam bstan tshang ma lhag pa'i bsam pa gcig gyur yin pa'i rtags mtshan bstan pa red/de ni rang res sgobs pa byed 'os pa zhig yin/ lo gnyis kyi gong sho je gdan du dus 'khor dbang chen byed skabs bod nas mi khyon che zhig 'byor te nga tsho thug rgyu byung / de nas de ring bar rtsa ba'i bod don thog la 'gyur ba gsar pa zhig byung yod/ de gang red zer na/ deng sang 'dzam gling thog bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di do snang shin tu chen po byed yul zhig chags 'dug de ltar yong rkyen ni bod lo rtsis na 'di lo'i nang dang / phyi lo rtsis na 'das pa'i lo nang du 'dzam gling thog bod pa'i gnas tshul khyab bsgrags ha cang chen po zhig byung ba red/ de yang sdug wa'i khyab bsgrags mi bsad ju 'gye la byas pa de 'dra ma yin par/ bod pa zhes pa 'di chos dang / rig gzhung / goms gshis sogs gnas tshul mang po zhig gi thog nas rgya nag dang tha dad yin pa dang / de ltar tha dad yin pa'i zhi bde'i lung par dngos gnas sems bzang snyom chung byas te sdod mkhan gyi mi rigs shig la/ rgya mis btsan dbang bshad de dbang sgyur byas pa zhig yin pa/ bden pas spo ma 'pher ba ma gtogs/ bden pa 431

bod par yod pa bcas bshad nas bod pa'i bden don gyi gnas tshul 'di mi tsho'i pyo/ yul las 'das pa'i khyab bsgrags chen po byung ba red/ bod par sha tsha'i bden rgyab kyi gnas tshul gsal po byung ba 'di nga tsho thug skabs shod rgyu'i gtam bzang zhig yin/'dzam gling gi mi dmangs rnams bod pa'i thog la sha tsha dang do snang chen po yod/ de ltar yong ba'i rgyu rkyen gatho da kha sang phyi zla dgu pa dang bcu pa gnyis la lha sar gnas tshul byung ba de red/ nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas bshad na da res lha sar byung ba'i gnas tshul de gsar pa zhig ma red/ de yang thog ma phyi lo chig stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu dang / de nas lnga bcu tham pa/ lnga bcu nga gcig de 'dra'i skabs rgya mi thog mar yong dus sa khul kha shas nas gnas tshul gsal po mi shes pa'i thog rgya mis kyang kha mkhas po byas te dngos gnas gral rim med pa dang / gsar brje'i bsam blo yod pa/ mi dmangs kyi don la bsam blo gtong ba/ dper na/ rgya nag la cha bzhag na dngos gnas grub 'bras yag po thon yod la/ phan thogs kyang byung yod/ rgya nag gsar brje ma byas gong gi gnas tshul dang / gsar brje byas rjes kyi gnas tshul gnyis bsdur na/ thog ma'i gnas tshul la gung khran tang gi lta ba gzhir bzung thabs shes 'bad brtson byas pa'i grub 'bras mthong rgyu yod pa zhig byung yod/de 'dra yin dus rgya mi thog mar chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu'i nang yong dus/ mi 'ga' shas rgya gung khran drin chen pha ma red/ dngul rda yong char pa 'bab 'bab red/ de 'dra bshad yod/ de'i thog nas rgya mi'i bsam blo ngo thog gang 'dra 432

yod dang / rjes su dmyal ba mi yul du 'phos pa lta bu bzo rgyu yin pa ma shes par thog mar mgo 'khor mkhan 'ga' shas byung yod/yin na'ang bod pa'i sems nang rang bzhin du bod rgya mi'i mnga' khongs yin bsam pa zhig gtan nas med la/ rgya mi dpon po yin bsam pa'ang med/dper na/ sa mtshams la sdod mkhan shar ngos dar rtse mdor cha bzhag na/dngos gnas bod kyi sa mtshams la slebs yod/ boda.a mdo ngos la cha bzhag na nga skyes sa'i sa cha de tsho'i gras rgya mi'i sa mtshams la slebs yod/ de tsho'i gras sa mtshams byas te rgya mi dang bod pa la phar rgyab tshur rgyab byas nas bsdad yod/ de chos tshong las dang za khang gnyer ba'i don la rgya skad rgyag mkhan phran bu yong gi yod na las/ rang bzhin sems nang nga tsho bod pa yin bsam pa zhig ma gtogs/ rgya mi yin bsam pa zhig med/ rgya dang bod gnyis rtsa ba nas tha dad so so yin snyam pa'i cho de ni dngos yod bden pa'i gnas tshul red ma gtogs/ dga' mi dga' byas nas byung ba zhig ma red/ dper na/rta dang bong bu'am/ yang na rta dang drel lta bur cha bzhag na/ mnyam du 'chams po byas bsdad nas las ka byed kyi yod kyang / rta rta red/ drel drel red/ de bzhi na bod pa dang / rgya mi zer ba de gnyis deng sang gi gnas tshul min par lo stong phrag gi sngon nas 'brel ba byung yod/ 'on kyang rgya rgya dang / bod bod byas nas bsdad pa las/ bod pa rgya mi rtsa ba nas chags med/ rgya mi thog mar yong dus bod pa'i sems nang rang bzhin du rgya mi slebs byung zhe sa phyi mi gsar pa zhig slebs byung snyam pa zhig yod/ gong du brjod pa bzhin mgo ma 433

'tshos par dga' bsu byed mkhan re zung byung yod mdog kha po red/ yang rigs kha shas ni/ bod rigs nang khul ma 'chams pa'i rkyen zhig 'phrad/ de 'dra'i dus la rgya nag nang gung khran tang gi gsar brje langs nas gzhung gsar pa zhig tshugs/ de 'dra'i dpung chen po zhig slebs yong dus mgyogs 'os bltas nas rgya 0 ri'e dmag dpon sar 'byar 'byar byed par 'gro ma/shā na byung yod/ dper na/ dpon po gnyis ma 'chams pa'am/ yang na bla ma gnyis ma 'chams pa/ yul phan tshun ma 'chams pa lta bu de 'dra la rgyab skyor 'tshol ba'i don la rgya mi'i sar rgyug 'gro mkhan de 'dra༄nga yod/ de 'dra ma gtogs/rtsa ba dngos gnas bod pa'i ngos nas rgya mir dga' bsu byas med/de nas rim pas rgya mi'i byed stangs gdug rtsub che ru song nas bod pa dog rol gtong rkyang byed pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal du 'gro dus/ bod pa chos gnas tshul gsal po rtogs nas sna tshig ste/ mtha' ma chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga lnga'i lo mjug nas bzung bod kyi sa khul mang po zhig la rgya mir 'khrug pa rgyag pa'i dus tshod shar ba red/ lnga bcu nga lnga'i lo mjug dang / nga drug gi lo 'go nas bzung khams khul nas rgya mir ngo sgol gyis dngos su 'dzing res gtong ba'i gnas tshul byung ba red/ de nas zi ling dang / a mdo'i rgyud la sogs pa'i bod sa khul yongs la gnas tshul dza drag je sdug tu song ba red/de nas lnga bcu nga dgu lo dang / mtha' ma drug cu re gnyis kyi gong tsam bar khams khul gyi sa khul 'ga' shas la be|nga gsal gnas tshul rgyun mthud gnas pa red/ de bzhin chig stong dgu brgya drug cu re dgu lo rig gnas gsar 434

brje'i zang zing yod mus thog la dper na/ ste mo sa khul nas rgya mir 'dzings pa dang / de bzhin bod kyi sa khul mang po zhig nas ha las pa'i 'thab rtsod byas yod/ de tsho phyi rol la mnyam sprel dang gyen log zer ba'i nang khul 'thab rtsod kyi rnam pa zhig yod kyang / bod pa tsho'i 'du shes bzhag stangs ni de la khag btags nas go skabs bzung ste bod pa dang rgya mi dbar gyi 'thab rtsod rnam pa'i thog bskyod yod/ de dus zang zing mang po byung yod kyang / 'dzam gling sgog khyab bsgrags 'gro thub pa byung med/da res nye char gnas tshulayong skabs lha sar phyi rgyal mi sna lta skor byed mkhan mang po zhig yod pa yin tsang 'dzam gling thog khyab bsgrags rgya che byung ba red/ de'i thog nas bod par sha tsha dang do snang gsar pa zhig slebs shing /kha sang lha sa'i gnas tshul de phan thogs chen po byung yod/ ngas 'dzam gling sgog ngo shes pa phyo brgyud de bod pa'i bden pa'i gnas tshul shod kyi yod/nga'i rnam kun gyi ngos 'dzin la/ nga rang bod mi'i rang dbang gtam brjod pa zhig yin snyam gyi yod pa ma zad/ gzhan la'ang de 'dra shod kyi yod/ don gyi bdag po ni bod rgya che'i mi dmangs tsho red/ ngas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i ming khyer nas bod rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi 'dod par gang yod pa de bsgrub dgos kyi yod/ ngas bod rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi tshab byed pa ma gtogs/ ngas 'di nas bod rgya che'i mi dmangs la phar bka' gtong rgyu zhig rtsa ba nas ma red/ dngos gnas bod rgya che'i mi dmangs la bsam tshul dang re 'dun gang yod pa de gzhi la bzhag nas las ka byed dgos pa dang / bod rgya che'i mi dmangs 435

kyi tshab byed rgyu de nga'i las 'gan red la/ nga rang gi 'du shes kyang 'di 'dra zhig bzhag gi sku(da/bod nang gi mi tshos gzhan dbang gi 'og tu kha nas 'dra chags po zhig shod kyi yod kyang / gting dam pa rgya mi la dga' gi med/ ngas 'di khul nas lo bstud de bod ces pa 'di rang dbang gi lung pa zhig yin pa dang / rgya nag dang tha dad yin/ bod lung pa rgya mis btsan zos byas song / bod rgya che'i mi dmangs la bde skyid mi 'dug ces rtag tu shod kyi yod/ ngas bshad pa rnams kyi bden dpang rgyab skyor du bod nang nas gnas tshul yong dus phan jogs shin tu chen po yong gi 'dug dngos gnas bod nang gi mi dmangs rnams kyi sems nang 'dod pa ma khengs pa'i gnas tshul shugs che yod pa mthong dus/ don dngos ra 'phrod nas phan thogs chen po yong gi 'dug skabs der lha sar phyi rgyal gyi mi phal cher brgyad brgya nas dgu brgya bar zhig yod sa red/ khong tsho'i nang gi mi mang po zhig de snga bod pa'i gnas tshul rtsa ba nas shes kyi med/bod lung pa zhes de snga 'gro myong med pa'i sa cha gsar pa zhig chags te der lta skor la bskyod pa zhig red/ sa gnas sa thog la slebs dus sa cha 'di rgya yul red mi 'dug bsam pa zhig blo la rang bzhin du 'char gyi 'dug ces phyi rgyal ba mang pos shod kyi 'dug lha sar slebs pa dang 'di rgya nag red mi 'dug snyam pa zhig lam seng mtshon gyi 'dug zer/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul thog nas rgya mis bod par rnam 'gyur ston stangs dang / bod pas rgya mir rnam 'gyur ston stangs/ rgya mis bod mi'i thog dbang sgyur byed stangs bcas kyi gnas 436

tshul rnams sa gnas sa thog la gsal po mthong dus rang bzhin du bod par sha tsha slebs kyi yod 'dug lha sar zang zing byung rjes phyi rgyal mi mang po zhig ched mngags rgya gar la yong nas rda ram sa lar nga thug par slebs byung / khong chos de snga bod pa rgyus med/ lha sar lta skor la bskyod de gnas tshul dngos su mthong dus nga cho'i sems la bzod thabs med pa zhig yong gi 'dug bod pa ni dngos gnas rang bzhin ya rabs kyi spyod pa dang / gshis ka shin tu bzang po yod pa'i mi rigs shig yin pa de rang dbang bral nas mi rigs gzhan zhig gis mnan pa mthong dus bas(da thabs rtsa ba nas mi 'dug ces shod mkhan mang po byung / dper na/ de'i skor gyi dngos byung lo rgyus shig bshad na/ phal cher wo bcu grangs kyi sngon la nor we'i nas yin pa'i rtsom pa po zhig ched mngags rda ram sa lar yong nas nga dang thug byung / khong gis brjod don/ kho rang bod la thengs gnyis phyin pa yin/ thengs dang po 'gro dus bdun phrag gcig bsdad pa yin/ bod la 'dzugs skrun mang po byas 'dug rgya mi yag po red snyam pa byung / thengs gnyis pa 'gro dus bdun phrag gnyis bsdad de gnas tshul la nyams zhib byed skabs bod la rgya mis yag po rtsa ba nas byas mi 'dugakhong rang la cha bzhag na de snga rgya mi la dga' po yod/ dga' po byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni khong rang chos la dga' gi med/ chos kyis mi la bshu gzhog gtong gi yod pas yag po ma red snyam gyi yod/ der brten rgya mis bod la chos rtsa med bzos pa yin tsang khong ha cang dga' po byung zer gyi 'dug skad cha de 437
