gang 'dra 'dug gam/ ha cang snying rje po yod/ khong gi sems nang rgya mis bod la chos med pa bzos pa de dngos gnas yag po red snyam pa'i thog nas rgya mir sha tsha dang / zhen khog slebs te bod la lta skor thengs gnyis phyin pa red/ mtha' ma gnas tshul zhib tu lta dus rgya mis chos med pa bzos pa gcig pu ma yin par/ dngos gnas bod par sha tsha med pa'i thog nas gtor bshig chen po btang 'dug der brten khong gi bsam blo 'gyur song / rgya mis bod nang ha cang sdug chags byas 'dug da cha khong gi sems nang bod par sha tsha slebs yod pa 'di phyag rtags su 'bul ched rda ram sa lar nga thug par yong pa yin/ da phyin khong gi sha tsha de bod pa'i phyogs la yod brjod kyi 'dug de tsho ni bden pa'i gnas tshul gyi gzi 'od 'phro gi yod pa'i rtags red/ 'di shod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ da res nye char lha sar gnas tshul byung ba des rkyen byas te skabs der yod pa'i phyi rgyal gyi mi mang po zhig rang bzhin bod par sha tsha slebs nas bod par khag med pa mthong ste bod pa'i thog la bden pa'i bden rgyab byed pa'i don la so so'i thabs shes gang yod ma skul dang len gyis byed kyi yin zhes nga la shod mkhan mang po byung / de chos thabs shes byas te 'dzam gling thog khyab bsgrags dpe mi srid pa'i shugs che byung ba red/gnyis pa/ nga tsho bod pa'i 'thab rtsod 'dir phyi mis sha tsha slebs pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig bod pas zhi ba'i thog nas ngo rgol byed pa las/ drag po'i thog nas 'dzing res btang ste ngo rgol byed kyi med pa de dngos gnas yag po red ces ha cang dga' po byed kyi 'dug nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod la mis do snang chen 438

po byas te dmigs bsal bsngags brjod byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig brjod pa ni/ thog mar so so'i bde sdug gi don la zhi 'jam gyi thog nas rngam ston khrom skor dang / ngo rgol skad 'bod byas/ de 'dra byed skabs rgya mi'i las byed pas brdungs pa sogs rnam 'gyur ha cang sdug po bstan pa yin tsang / gzhi nas 'u thug ste rdo dang / sa phag gzhu ba la sogs pa'i gzhu res kyi gnas tshul phran bu byung / gzhu res btang ba de gnas tshul thabs skyo po zhig red/ yin na'ang bya ba tshang ma rten 'byung yin stabs skabs der thabs med pa'i gnas tshul chags shing / lnga ga mar rgya mi'i ngos nas rnam 'gyur 'jam po bstan te dngos gnas bden pa'i gnas tshul shod pa dang / mis zang zing byed kyi 'dug na dpung gis gnon pa'i rnam 'gyur ma bstan par drang po drang bzhag gi rnam 'gyur zhig bstan na gnas tshul de 'dra yong gi ma red/ rgya mir bden pa med tsang ham pas mnan rgyu ma gtogs rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas 'grel bshad rgyag thub pa med gshis/ des na sngon ma'i byed stangs dpung gis gnon pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas/ bod par nag thig rgyag ched par rgyag pa sogs byed dus/ga re byas kyang mi bde ba zhig chags te gzhu res gtong ba'i gnas tshul thabs skyo byung ba de ni ma dgos pa zhig red/da lta ngas shod dgos pa zhig la/ de 'dra'i dus su rgya mi me mda' 'khyer ba zhig la sa phag phog te me mda' sa la gzags pa dang / me mda' de bod pa zhig gis bsgrugs te lag par slebs kyang bed spyod ma btang bar/ me mda' sa la brdabs nas bcag song zhes phyi rgyal do snang can tshos bsngags brjod 439

chen po byed kyi 'dug bod pa'i ngos nas mi bsad khrag sbyor gyi drag po'i 'tshe ba'i las ka ma byas par/ 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam nas bden dona'atshol thabs byed pa de ni dngos gnas ha las pa zhig red/ gnas skabs bod par gyong dang pham kha rag gi yod pa mthong gsal yang / de ha cang gal chen po red brjod kyi 'dug da dung phyi rgyal gyi mi tshos nga la brjod par/ rgya mis bod pa'i thog me mda' brgyab pa de khong tshos rang srung gi don la brgyab pa yin shod kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang de ni rang srung gi don la brgyab pa zhig gtan nas ma red/ rang srung yin na mi gnyis thad kur thug pa'i gnas stangs kyi thog nas nyen kha slebs te me mda' brgyab pa zhig yin pas/ de'i mde'u thad kur 'gro dgos/ da res rmas ma tshor mde 'u 'phog stangs gang 'dra yin zer na/mde'u steng nas phog ste gsham nas thon 'dug des rtags ga re bstan yod ce na/ me mda' rgyag mkhan de mtha sa zhig la bsdad nas me mda' brgyab pa'i rtags mtshan gsal 11 bstan sku da/ mtho sar sdod mkhan la 'og nas rdo kha shas gzhus na las/ mtho sar mur rdzog gi nyen kha gang yang med/ byas tsang khong tsho'i me mda' de rang srung min par phar rgol rang red brjod kyi 'dugagang ltar nye dus lha sar gnas tshul byung ba des bod don la phan thogs chen po byung / 'dzam gling thog khyab bsgrags kyang ṅga las pa byung yod/nga rang tsho bod pa'i sems nang sdug bsngal chen po yod pa 'di rgya nag gzhung gi mdun la bton rgyu gal chen 11 'dug rgya mi'i ngos nas kyang gnas tshul 'di gsal 11 shes pa byed dgos/ gang yin zhe na/ rgya mi rigs kha shas 440

snying rje/ dngos yod gnas tshul ma shes par/ lo mang ring rgya nag gzhung nas khyab bsgrags byas pa'i gnas tshul rnams de ltar yin shag gi ha log ste/go ces pa 'di rgya mi kho rang tshos sngon ma bshad pa ltar ches rjes lus dang /ches mun nag ches gdug rtsub/ ches kla klo'i lung pa shin tu skyo po zhig la/rgya mi slebs rjes gzhi nas yi ge slob kyi yod pa'i bzo 'dra po dang / gzhi nas lto chas za stongs yag tu phyin pa'i bzo 'dra po/ gzhi nas bod pa mi chags pa'i bzo 'dra po/ de'i gong la bod pa kla klo kla nag cig la mthong / de 'dra yin dus bod la rgya mi slebs pa'i thugs rje bka' drin la brten nas bod pa gzhi nas mi'i mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig chags pa las/ de snga bod rjes lus shin tu chen po red snyam pa'i ngos 'dzin byas/ bod la rgya nag gzhung nas 'gro song chen po 'di tsam zhig gtong gi yod pa dang / rgya mi mang po zhig gis dbugs mi ldeng ba dang / gnam gshis mi 'phrod pa'i dka' ngal dang du blangs nas rogs pa byed par phyin te/ bod par phugs phan gyi drin chen pos skyong gi yod/ 'on kyang bod pa de tsho ni kla klo kla nag yin thag chod red/ de ltar yin pa'i rtags la phar drin gyis skyong mkhan de la/ tshur drin lan log 'jal byed kyi 'dug snyam pa'i bsam blo 'khor gyi yod sa red/ khag mi 'dugabod pa de tshor ha cang yag po byas kyang / de tshos tshur sha tsha dang kha la nyan po byed kyi mi 'dug bsam pa zhig rgya mi'i nang dran mkhan tan tan yod sa red/yang rgya mi rigs gcig gis khong tshos dngos gnas rogs pa byed kyiyod bsam pa zhig dang / bod par sha tsha yod pa zhig de 'dra'i thog nas bod par rogs 441

pa byas pa de/ bod pa'i ngos nas kyang dngos gnas gung khran tang gi bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i thog nas dga' mos byed kyi yod pa red bsam pa zhig kha shas kyi bsam blor 'khor nas mgo 'khor gyi yod pa red/ phyi la yod pa'i bod pa nyung shas kyis skad log brgyab pa ma gtogs/ bod la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams dngos gnas rang dbang dang / 'dra mnyam yod pa gang ci'i thog yag poskusad bsam pa zhig gis kho rang tsho ha log nas sdod mkhan tan ta na yod sa red/dper na/ bod phyi nang 'brel ba byung ba'i rjes la 'di nas sku tshab tshogs pa zhig bod la phyin pa red/ sku tshab tshogs pa bod du dang po 'byor dus rgya mi'i bsam blo'i nang tā la'i bla ma'i mi yong dus bod pa tshos dga' bsu zhu rgyu phar bzhag ngo rgol gyi rnam 'gyur ston gyi red bsam pa zhig tan tan yod pa 'dra/ de'i rjes la gnas tshul gsal po zhig go byung / rgya nag dbus gzhung nas rang skyong ljongs la skad cha dris te/ a mdo khul la tā la'i bla ma'i mi yong dus dga' po byed mkhan gang 'tshams 'dug lha sar yong na gang byed kyi red dam zhes 'dri dus/ rang skyong ljongs kyi 'go khrid tshos bod nang lo nyi shu'i ring slob gso mthar phyin pa btang nas chab srid kyi slob gso.ang ki dang wa yebs te twa la'i bla ma'i mi yong dus ngo tsha dgos pa dang / kha skyengs dgos pa'i gnas tshul yong gi red ces phal cher bshad pa'i gnas tshul 'dug der brten rgya mi rang gi ngos nas gnas tshul ma shes par ha log ste sdod kyi yod sa red /mtha' ma sku tshab lha sar 'byor pa'i skabs la bod rgya che'i mi mang nas ha 442

cang dga' po'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa red/ lhag par rnam kun gsar brje pa dang / yar tho na pa zhes shod sa'i mi de tsho sngon dang por rgyu ga nas rgya mi tsho hon 'gror ba'i gnas tshul byung 'duganye dus kyi lha sa'i gnas tshul la cha bzhag na/ bdun cu don dgu dang /brgyad cu lo nas bzung srid byus lhug gtong byas nas chos dad rang mos che ru btang ste/ de snga'i g.yon thal gyi nor 'khrul rnams sel nas da cha bod rgya che'i mi dmangs tsho rgya mir sha tsha gsar pa dang / dga' zhen gsar pa slebs yod snyam ste sdod pa'i skabs la yang skyar gnas tshul gsar pa zhig thon yong dus/ yang rgya mi'i bsam sbru'i nang gzhi nas brtag dpyad gsar pa byed dgos pa dang / bsam blo gsar pa zhig gtong dgos pa'i gnas tshul chags yod bzo 'dug da res lha sa'i gnas tshul de gcig nas 'dzam gling thog khyab bsgrags la phan 11gas chen 11 byung ba dang / gnyis nas rgya mi rang gi las byed pa dang / rgya nag gzhung la cha bzhag na gzhi nas bod don de kha nas zhe po bco brgyad yod bshad pa gcig pus la mi dag par/ dngos gnas dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs pa'i bsam sdus gsar pa zhig btang nas tan tan ma byas na mi 'grigs pa'i gnas tshul mthong shugs che ru phyin nas phan thogs chen po byung / da res gnas tshul 'di'i thog nas mi mang po zhig 'das grongs song ba dang / mang po zhig btson du tshud pa red/ kha sa phyi rgyal gyi gsar 'gyur thog 'khod par gzhigs na/ paṇa chen rin po che bod la phebs nas khyeng gis thugs khur bskyed pa'i 'og mi grangs brgyad cu tsam smod bkrol btang 443

ba red ces 'khod 'dug gsar 'gyur de'i 'byung khungs rgya nag nas bshad pa zhig red/ yang sdudags gcig nas btson khang che sa zhig nas mi brgyad cu tham pa glod bkrol btang / yang sa cha khug kyog gzhan zhig nas mi 'dzin bzung byed pa de+o 'dra yong gi red/ rgya mi'i byed stangs ha cang mkhas po dang / rdzun gtam shad rgyur ha las pa yad/nye char lha sar dmigs bsal sbyong brdar sprad pa'i nyen rtogs pa lnga brgya nas chig stong bar slebs pa de dag rjes su phyir log byas pa red ces khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / don ngo ma lha sa nas thon khul byas te sa gnas gzhan la bsdad yod pa'i gnas tshul brjod kyi 'dug 'dra mi 'dra byed rgyu 'dug byas tsang btson pa brgyad cu glod pa red zer ba de yang ngo thog gang 'dra yin mi shes/nga tshos thos par gzhigs na da res kyi gnas tshul des rkyen pas batheton khang du tshud pa phal cher mi lnga brgya nas stong phrag yas mas shig yod 'dug gnas tshul gsal po shes rgyu shin tu khag po red/ btson la sku(da pa de tshor gnam thag rgyag pa dang / nyes rdung gtong ba sogs ni dacadas gnas ha cang gi thabs skyo po red/ shi mkhan tsho dang / da lta btson la sdug bsngal myong bzhin pa tsho/de la de brten gyi pha ma span nye dang / bza' tshang bu phrug dga' nye blo dkar sogs mang po zhig dngaXs skrag gi 'og la sdod dgos pa'i gnas tshul gsar pa zhig chags yod pa red/ 'das grongs song ba tshor cha bzhag na bod spyi pa'i don dag la dmigs te srog blos btang ba red/ bod spyi pa'i don dag ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba yod par brten/ khong tshos las bzang po 444

bsags pa las/ las ngan pa bsags sku(da pa ma red snyam gyi 'dug da lta btson khang nang yod pa tsho gang mgyogs thon thub pa dang / sdod pa'i ring la sdug sbyongs mi yong ba'i ched nga tsho da lta rgya mi dang thad gar 'brel ba yod pa yin tsang gang yong ci yong gi thabs shes byed kyi yod/ gang ltar de tsho tshang mar gdung sems mnyam bskyed sku(da/kha sang bod nang gnas tshul byung rjes rda ram sa lar tshags par 'god mkhan de 'dra thug pa red/ de ni gtso bo tshags par 'god mkhan mang po zhig gis do snang shin tu chen po byas nas nga la skad cha 'dri dgos yod brjod pa las nga chos 'di nas gro sgrig byas te tshags par 'god mkhan la skad cha bshad rgyu yod yong rogs zhes brjod med/ de dus tshags par 'god mkhan nas/ da res bod nang zhi ba'i ngo rgol byas pa red/ de la twa la'i bla mas rgyab skyor yod dam zhes dri gi 'dug de la'ang nga rang bod pa zhig red/ bod rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi mgrin tshab pa ngas byed kyi yod la/ nga'i ngos 'dzin la'ang de rang yod/ don gyi bdag po bod nang gi mi rnams red/ don gyi bdag pos bed spyod gang 'dra zhig byed dgos pa de bod mi rang gis thag gcod byed kyi red la/ bod mi rang la thag gcod byed pa'i dbang cha yang yod/ de la ngas gang yang shod dgos don med/ da res dngos su rngams ston khrom skor byas pa de dag la ngas rgyab skyor yod dang yod ces bshad pa yin/yang gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan zhig gis 'o na zhi ba'i thog nas bka' la mi nyan par ngo rgol byed pa'i 'gro stangs dbyin ji'i tshig cig yod pa/ sngon 445

ma lhan rdis lag len gnang yod/ de (sprudra'i thog la ngas rgyab skyor byed kyi red dam zer gyi 'dug rgyab skyor byed kyi red lab pa yin/ de la rjes su rgya mis tshig rtsa bsgrugs te khong khro byed kyi 'dug khyad par mi 'dug rgya mi khong khro za nas khe/ rang rkang pa brdabs/ lag pa brdabs te sdod kyi yod na ma gtogs/nga la gnod kyi mi 'dug ngas gsung chos skabs rtag par shod kyi yod/ khong kho dges pa des khong khro byed mkhan kho rang sems pa ma skyid pa bzo rgyu ma gtogs/gzhan gyi phan thogs gang yang med/ nga la ga re lab kyang khyad par rtsa ba nas mi 'dugargya mi la cha bzhag na nga snu'i) khyim mtshes red/ rgya mis 'dzam gling thog mi'i spyi tshogs yar rgyas tshad mtho po yod shod kyi yod/ de ni yag po red/ nga tshos rgya mi la dga' po dang sha tsha byed pa las/ rgya mi la ngo rgol byed kyi med/nga tshor ga re 'grig gi mi 'dug zer na/ rgya mi bod la yong ba red/ rgya mi bod la yong bar ha las rgyu gang yang mi 'dug yin na'ang rgya mi bod la yong nas bod pa sdug po myong dgos pa zhig dang / rgya mi ngo tsha nas sdod dgos ji/ 'i gnas tshul 'di phyogs gnyis kur ma dgos pa zhig red/ rgya mi bod la slebs nas bod pas ha cang gi sdug po myangs pa dang / mu ge che na po byung ba red/ 'di khul gnyen 'phrad la yong mkhan bod pa mi re ngo re'i thog nas patsho thug skabs pha shi song / ma shi song / a zhang shi song / a khu shi song / spun mched shi song zer ba dang / de tsho yang rgya mis dmar gsod btang song / btson khrang du shi song / ltogs shi thebs song / sdug shi thebs song zer ba de 'dra khyim 446

re re'i nang la gang ltar rgya mi slebs pas rkyen byas te rkyen slo bur bas mi ma shi ba ha lam mi 'dug de ga re byas pa red dam/ rgya mi thugs rje chen po red 'dug gam/ bod la rgya mi slebs nas dbang sgyur ba'i grub 'bras la bod pa sdug bsngal gyi nang du tshud nas sdod dgos pa zhig dang / rgya mi kho rang tshor cha bzhag na'ang bod mes rgyal dang kha bral thabs sku da pa ma red ces ma ṇi bgrang bgrang byed dgos kyi 'dug de ga re byas nas bgrang dgos byung ba red/bod rgya mi'i mnga' khongs phyi nang sus bltas kyang bston du med pa'i rtsod med cig yin na/ de 'dra'i ma ṇi bgrang bgrang shod dgos don mi 'dug bod mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs red ces rtag par shod kyi 'dug dper na/ nga tshor rgya mi de 'dra thug skabs nga rang la'ang gnas tshul 'di 'dra kha shas byung la/bod pa gzhan mang por yang gnas tshul de ga rang byung 'dug nga tsho gnam gru dang / me 'khor nang 'gro skabs rgya mi de 'dra thug ste nga cho shar phyogs pa'i mi gcig pa chags yod dus thog mar dga' po byas te phan tshun skad cha shod res kyi nang / yul gang nas yin dris par bod pa yin lab ste ngo 'phrod pa'i skabs/ rgya mi tsho gdong dmar po chags te da shin sems thag nye mdog gi dga' po byed pa'i rnam 'gyur de 'gyur nas kha shas kyis mi bde ba byed pa dang /kha shas sdod sa yang spos 'gro gi 'dug rgya mi tsho ngo tsha gi yod pa red/ gang ltar dbang sgyur byed stangs des rgya mi ngo tsha nas sdod dgos pa zhig dang / bod pa sdug bsngal nang sdod dgos pa'i gnyis sdug cig ma gtogs/ yag po gang yang mi 'dug447

des rkyen byas nas rgya gar thog yin na'ang dka' ngal dang nyen kha gsar pa zhig 'phrad yod/ rgya dkar nag gnyis 'dzam gling tho ga mi 'bor che shos kyi rgyal khab dang / shar phyogs lung pa'i nang stobs che shos red/ khong gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i gnas tshul la cha bzhag na/ bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di shin tu gnad don chen por thug yod/ rgya mis 'phral sel gyi gtam 'dod dang / nga rgyal ma byas pa'i thog nas phugs rgyang ring po'i bsam blo gzhi snying po zhig btang na/ bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di 'dzam gling zhi bde dang 'brel ba yod pa dang /rgya dkar nag gi gnas tshul dang yang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin/ rgya dkar nag gi 'brel ba'i gnas tshul gtso bo ni de gnyis dbar dmag 'khrug mi yong ba dang / de gnyis gas dmag gi thog dmigs bsal 'gro song gtong ma dgos par/ so so'i lung pa'i dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi thog la 'gro song gtong thub pa'i gnyis kur khe phan yod pa zhig bod kyi gnas tshul thog nas bzo rgyu yod pa zhig tan tan red/ rdo don snying po rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul na skyid ces chos rgyal tsho'i sku dus nas gnas tshul de yod/ nga tsho'i gnas tshul yang de yin/ nga tshos so so'i thob thang rtsod pa las/ nga tsho rgya mi la ngo log pa dang / rgya mir ngo rgol byed pa gang yang min/ bar lam gyi gnas tshul de tsho shin tu yag po byung 'dug gzhan dag mang po bshad rgyu med/ sngon ma bshad pa rnams bar lam deb thon sku(da pa de nas shes kyi red/da lta'i dus skabs 'dir 'dzam gling thog 'gyur ba shin tu chen po 'gro gi yod pa bzhina.u ru sus gtsos pa'i dmar po'i rgyal khab la 'gyur ba chen 448

po 'gro gi yod/ rgya nag la cha bzhag na'ang 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod/ nye char tang gi tshogs chen thengs bcu gsum pa tshogs pa'i rjes la/ las ka gnad yod sa'i sne la slebs pa'i mi phal che ba ltos sa ltos 'jog gis bsam blo gu yangs po yod pa'i bzo 'dug par brten 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi yod/ nye char lha sar gnas tshul byung rjes kyang rgya nag gzhung nas nga tsho phan tshun 'brel ba yod pa 'di mu mthud bzung 'dod yod pa'i bzo 'dug nga tshor cha bzhag na nga tshos sdug skad rgyag gi red/ da lta lab pa bzhin nga chos so so'i thob thang gi don la sdug skad rgyag gi yod/ nga tshos rgya mi rigs dang / rgya nag rgyal khab mi dga' ba byed sa zhig rtsa ba nas ma red/ thob thang ni dud 'gro zhig yin kyang so so'i 'dod don rtsod pa'i thob thang zhig tan tan yong gi red/ de 'dra yin tsang nga tshos mu mthud nas rgya mi dang 'brel ba byed 'dod yod la/'brel ba mu mthud gnas thub na snyam pa zhig kyang yod/rtsa ba nga rang tsho'i don dag 'di chen po zhig yin pas don chen bsgrub par ngang ring zer ba bzhin/ lam seng lo gcig gnyis kyi nang la mtha' ma'i thag gcod thub rgyu khag po red/ yin na'ang gzhis byes tshang mas mu mthud nas mi re re'i mjing par bod spyi pa'i don dag gi rdog khres re 'khur nas/'thab rtsod 'di rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / ya rabs/ zhi bde bcas kyi sgo nas rgyun bskyangs na nga tsho'i bden pa'i mtha' gsal te gnas tshul yag po zhig tan tan yong gi red snyam pa nga la yid ches yod/ khyed rang cho swātse bde po gyis/ lam seng yongs grags byas te go bsdur byed rgyu yong thub thabs yod pa ma red/ yin 449

na yang mtha' ma'i thag gcod byed pa'i dus la slebs song na dngos shugs brgyud gsum gyi sgo nas nga tshos bod nang gi mi tshor byed phyogs 'di 'dra zhig la bsam blo gtong gi yod ces shod rgyu dang / btsan byol la yod pa'i bod mi tshor yang gsal po bshad de/ de 'dra'i thog nas ga ler ga ler thag gcod byed rgyu ma gtogs/ dper na/ 7rgyal ba rin po che dang rgya nag gzhu nga thad /ra 'brel ba yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas thag gcod gang 'dra zhig byed grabs yod nga tshos shes kyi med zer ba de 'dra yong rgyu'i blo g.yeng gtan nas byed mi dgos/ shes song ngam/ da lta nga tsho 'brel ba mthud pa tsam red ma gtogs thag gcod byed pa'i dus chod la slebs med/ da lta bar gyi gnas tshul 'di 'dra red/ ma 'ongs par ngo thog thag gcod byed pa'i mtshams sde slebs song na/ byed phyogs rnams nga cho'i 'char gzhi bsam blo gtong stangs 'di 'dra yin/ go rim 'di 'dra bsgrigs yod ces gzhis byes mi dmangs yongs la gang thub kyi thabs shes brgyud de go bsdur gyi thog nas ga ler ga ler thag gcod byed rgyu'i rtsis gzhi yod/da bar bod rgya che'i mi dmangs tshang mas ha las pa'i snying stobs dang /dad pa dam tshig g.yo ba med pa'i thog /ya rabs spyod bzang ma brlag pa de ni ngo mtshar skye pa'i gnas yin pas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ lhag par bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs dngangs skrag chen po de 'dra zhig dang / sdug bsngal de 'dra zhig gi 'og la bsdad yod/ yin kyang gnas stangs de'i 'og gnya' ma chag par bsdad pa ha cang yag po red/ tshang mar thugs rje che zhu 450

gi yin/ da lta'i dus mod la bod nang rang mi rang las thub pa/ de ring kha sang rgya mis phyogs gcig nas rang skyong zer ba'i ming don mtshungs pa zhig yod mdog gi rnam 'gyur ston ched las/khungs mang po'i nang bod rigs mang tsam slebs pa'i thabs shes shig byed kyi 'a/dug nang don mtha' ma'i dbang cha bod pa'i lag par yod rung med rung / bod pa mang du gtong ba'i las ka byas pa de dga' bsu zhu 'os kyi yag po red/ nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas go skabs 'di bzung ste so sos 'gan 'khur thub pa bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/rgya mi'i mdun la bod pas 'jon gyi med pa'i gnas tshul min par/ thod par 'gan bskur te tshur cha bzhag na nga tshos byed thub kyi yod pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig nges par du yin gcig min gcig ston dgos/ de dang 'brel nas slob sbyong la do snang bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ slob gra rgya mis btsugs pa red ces slob grar gtong 'dod mi byed pa'i gti thug gi bsam blo gtong rgyu med/nges par du bu phrug slob grar gtong dgos/ slob grar btang nas slob sbyong yag po med pa dang / bod yig med na de 'dra'i thog la rtsod pa rgyab dgos/dper na/ rgya mi'i shog dngul la cha bzhag na de'i thog bod yig bris yod/bod pa'i ye ger cha bzhag snying ma 'dod kyang cha bzhag dgos pa zhig chags te shog da ngul thog bod yig bris yod/ de 'dra yin na bod par bod yig slob rgyu'i thob thang zhig nges par du yod dgos/ de khrims 'gal byas pa ma red/de la rgya mis drag gnon byed thub kyi ma red/ slob sbyong 'dod pa khengs pa med pa'i gras la bod yig bslab dgos kyi 'dug bod pa'i dge rgan 'dzugs 451

dgos kyi 'dug ces rtsod pa brgyab chog gi red/ nges par du bod pa na gzhon 'tshar longs byed mkhan tsho slob sgrong yod pa bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/slob sbyong la do snang byed dgos/ shes song ngam/de nas thod nang chos dad rang mos kyi srid byus gang la gang 'tsham zhig yong ba'i skabs la lha khang dang / dgon pa bzhengs pa'i gnas tshul mang spro zhig 'dug de rtsa ba yag po red/ lha khang dang dgon pa rtsa ba nas med pa'i grong gseb de 'dra la lha khang chung chung 'dra bzhengs thub nasag po 'dug gang yin zhe na/ mi rabs gsar pa tshor nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po 'di red/ bod kha ba can gyi lha skal thugs rje chen po 'di red ces ngo sprod byas te bsam blor bag chags ga sar pa slebs rgyur phan thogs yod/'on kyang rgyas spros chen po byas na yag po mi 'dug dgon pa lha khang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don la bzhengs kyi yod/ dngos gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsam gyi yod na/ nang pa'i chos la slob sbyong bya rgyu shin tu gal che ba yin/nang chos slob sbyong la de tsam gyi do snang ma byas par/ lha khang stong pa zhig bzhengs par ha las te sdod pa'i byed stangs ni byab chung red/ chos dad rang mos srid byus kyi go skabs phran bu byung dus/ nges par du nang chos slob sbyong byas/ nang chos phran bu shes mkhan tshor 'grel bshad rgyag rogs zhes brjod /de ltar byas te so sos dad pa byed sa'inang pa'i chos 'di 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos/ so sos dad pa byed pa 'di chos kyi rgyu mtshan thog nas dad pa byed kyi yod pa dang / lha khang bzhengs pa de tsho yang chos kyi dad pa'i thog nas byed 452

kyi mode pa yin dus/ chos shes pa bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ dper na/ so sor 'gro song gtong rgyu yod na/ chos shes pa'i don du/ dpe cha par 'debs byed pa'am/ yang na dpe cha 'bal po bzo ba'i don la 'gro song btang na /ga po red/ dgon pa lha khang mang po brgyab na yang nyi ma gcig rgya mis ga re byed grabs yod mi shes/ dper na/ da res nye char gyi gnas tshul la cha bzhag na/ se 'bras dga' gsum la rgya mis las don ru khag btsugs te dam drag byed kyi 'dug gang ltar lha khang dang / dgon pa rgya mi'i mig nang be+e gra ma lta bu chags yod/ nga rang tsho chos la dad pa yod mkhan tshos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi shes yon la dang bstod byed dgos/ 'di nga shod 'dod byung /deng sang rgya mis skad cha gsar pa zhig la twa la'i log khyodad pas spyi tshogs rnying pa ro langs rgyag pa'i don la bsam blo gtong gi yod pa red shod kyi 3dug tā la'i log spyod pas spyi tshogs rnying pa ro langs rgyag pa'i don la bsam blo gtong gi yod pa red dam/ de ni rgya mir khag mi 'dug rgya mi'i byed stangs ni snying rje skye yul zhig red/ rgya mis kyal rdzun dang ham pa kho na'i thog nas phyin pa yin tsang / bden pa'i thog bskyod dgos byung na khungs 'khyol gyi yod pa ma red/ byas tsang ral pa lhan pas ma khebs pa zhes brjod pa bzhin/ lhan pa gang 'dra byas te brgyab pa dga' blta dgos kyi yod pa red/ bar lam tā la'i bla mas phyi la las ka byas pa'i bden pa'i gnas tshul 'di bod mi dmangs grong gseb lung khug gi lkug pa zhig la shod 453

par phyin na'ang khong tsho ji tsam lkug pa yin kyang de 'dra yin na tā la'i bla mas byas pa de ma red zer rgyu mi 'dug ces brtsodad kyi red/ rgya mis tā la'i bla mas spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar gso dang / zhing bran lam lugs bskyar gso byed rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi yod pa red/ nga tshos khyed tshor deng skabs dbul bcos phyug 'gyur gyi srid byus bzang po lag len bstar gyi yod bshad de/ khong tshos dbul bcos phyug 'gyur byed dgos pa de da bar ma shes pa'i bzo lta bu ston gyi 'dugadangos gnas byas na gung khran ring lugs 'dzugs dgos don de ga dbul po phyug por 'gyur ba'i don la btsugs pa red ma gtogs/ gung khran ring lugs sngon ma de phyug po dbul po bzo rgyu dang / gung khran ring lugs rjes ma 'di dbul po phyug po bzo rgyu'i ring lugs shig ma red/ gung khran ring lugs dang po btsugs dus kyi dmigs yul de mi dbul po tshor bde ba rma/nga tsam yong ba'i ched du yin/ mi nyung shas kyis dpal 'byor nus pa'i khe phan cha tshang dge bed sbyad de/ mi mang ba sdug bsngal 'og sdod dgos pa de 'gris gi mi 'dug ces 'dzam gling thog gsar brje byung ba red/ mtha' ma ma khe si'i bsam blo yang de nas byung ba dang / le nyin la cha bzhag naya ru su'i nang gsar brje byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rtsa ba thug sa.u ru su'i rgyal po dzar dang kho tsho 'e gras gral rim dbang sgyur gyi mi sna de chos khe phan chen po zas/ u ru su'i rgya che'i mi dmangs tsho rā nas lo bstud de mu ge'i nang sdod dgos pa'i gnas tshul de mthong nas gsar brje byas pa red/ de ltar gung khran ring lugs kyi 454

rtsa ba'i dmigs yul dbul po phyug por 'gyur rgyu de yin na yang / rgya nag gung khran tang gis dbul po phyug por 'gyur dgos pa de nye char ma gtogs ma shes pa'i bzo 'dra po chags song / de 'dra ga re byas pa red dam/ gung khrin tang gi mi klad pa gtsang ma skyon med pa zhig yin na skyo po yin dgos pa zhig dang / gral rim yang skyo po nas yong ba/ shes yon yang med pa/ gang ltar sbrang po sbrang rkyang / lkug pa lkug rkyang byas bsdad na gung khran tang yon yag shos yin pa'i bzo 'dra zhig dang / ja srub ma zhig btung na yang mthong phyogs byas/ spags 'dres zhim tsam zhig zas na'ang de gang nas byung zhes lam seng 'dri rtsad byed pa de la snying po gang 'dug gam/ ha cang byab chung red/ kha dang zhal thug pa ma gtogs/ ga phyi go log gi skad cha shod kyi yod pa red/ dper na/ ma'o tse tung gi bsam blor cha bzhag na/ rtsa ba'i dmigs yul mi skyo po tsho yar langs rgyu dang / mi skyo po tshor bza' rgyu 'bal tsam yong ba'i dmigs yul 'di 'khyer nas byas pa red ma gtogs/ mi tshang ma skyo po bzo ba'i don la byas pa zhig ma red/ da gang shes bar lam dbul po phyug 'gyur byed rgyu'i srid byus bzung ste/ zhing 'brog gnyis /ra sa cha dang / ra lug sogs 'gan gtsang sprad de so sor bzhag pa red/ da yang tā la'i log spyod pa yong nas zhing bran lam lugs bskyar gso byas na khyed rang cho'i sa cha ra lug sems can de tsho shor 'gro gi red ces shod kyi yod bzo 'dug bod mi kha shas nas ga re yin kyang zhing bran lam lugs ma dgos pa zhes shod mkhan yod sa red/ de ni khag med pa'i bsam tshul zhig red /455

de skor sngon ma'i gnas tshul zhig bshad na/ ma gzhi 'ur shob 'dra po chags kyi 'dug kyang dngos yod gnas tshul yin/ chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu tham pa'am/ nga gcig gang ltar rgya mi yong ma yong gi dus la bod kyi chab srid kyi 'gan ngas 'khur dgos pa zhig chags/ skabs der nga rang lo bcu drug tsam yin/ nga chung dus nas 'dzam gling phyi'i gnas tshul la do snang phran bu byed kyi yod/ chig stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu zhe bdun lor dbyin ji'i skad yig rang sbyong 'go btsugs pa yin/ 'on te da lta khungs 'khyol ba zhig she sa kyi med/ 'go bzhi bcu zhe bdun lo nas btsugs pa red/ 'di 'dra'i slob sbyong byed mkhan ha las pa zhig ma red dam/ da lta'ang yag po mi shes pa 'di dpe ma red pas/ gang ltar 'dzam gling phyi'i gnas tshul la do snang byas te/ ngos nas chab srid kyi 'gan 'khur rjes bcos bsgyur gang la gang 'tsham zhig gtong thub na snyam pa'i re ba chen pos 'bad brtson shugs che byas pa yin/mtha' ma legs bcos spyi tshogs btsugs te thog mar lo mang song ba'i bun rnying zhing pa'i sems kyi khur po yin pa gang zhig la/ dngos su sgrub 'jal mi thub pa'i rdog khres de tsho'i gras chag yang bsgyur bcos gtong rgyus mtshon pa'i las ka mang po zhig 'go btsugs pa yin/ nga tshos 'dzam gling thog gi zhing bran lam lugs zhes pa'i rjes lu sa 'di la mngon par bstod de mu mthud 'dzin rgyu'i bsam 〈ba de dus nas gtong gi med pa gsal po yin/ nga tshos lesas bcos spyi tshogs btsugs te dngos gnas nga rang tsho bod par ran pa'i sgyar bcos shig gtong bar 'gro skabs/ rgya mi tshos rgya nag nang gsar brje ces 456

pa nang bzhin gyi bcos sgyur gtong mi thub pa'i 'gal rkyen chags stabs khong cho+os bcos sgyur gtong ma bcug pa red/ de ni ha cang gsal po yin/ nga chos lnga bcu nga da gu'i dus zing ma byung gong nas bcos sgyur gyi bsam/ blo btang yod/de nas rgya gar la 'byor rjes nga tsho mang gtso'i lam la 'gro dgos brjod pa yin/ rtsa ba dga' ldan pho brang zhes 7rgyal ba lnga pas btsugs gnang ba 'di'i mjug skyong gi las ka ngas byed kyi yod pa yin dus/ dga' ldan pho brang gi rnam pa bsgyur nas mang gtso'i lam la 'gro dgos/ mang gtso ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang mthun pa zhig yin pa las/ chos dang 'gal ba zhig rtsa ba nas ma red/ de bzhin deng gi 'dzam gling yar thon gyi bsam blo zhig kyang yin pas/ nga tsho mang gtso'i rnam pa thon pa zhig dang / spyi 'thus 'os bsdu byed rgyus mtshon pa'i las ka mang po zhig byas yod/ chig stong dgu brnye drug cu re gcig re gnyis nas ma 'ongs rgod kyi rtsa khrims bzo rgyu'i bsam blo btang ste/ drug cu re gsum lor rtsa khrims snying bsdus shig khyab spel byas/ de nas rtsa khrims rgyas pa zhig bzos te ma 'ongs pa'i byed phyogs 'di 'dra yin zhes ma 'ongs rtsa khrims bzos pa yin de'i snying don la/ tā la'i bla ma'i dbang char sgyur bcos gtong rgyu yod pa zhig bzos pa dang / sa cha yang bod gzhung spyi la dbang ba las/ sger chos la dbang rgyu med pa bzos yod/ de nas bzungs bsam pa rnam dag gis ma 'ongs pa'i byed phyogs rnams go rim bsgrigs yod/ rgya gar nang gi gzhis chags che khag 457

tsho gang thub mang gtso'i 'gro lam thog goms 'dris byed du bcug rgyu'i thabs shes kyi las ka byas sku(da/ ma 'ongs par gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms kyi gnas tshul bzang po byung skabs spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar log byed rtsis med la/ de 'dra'i bsam blo tsam yang med/ gal srid de 'dra byed 'dod kyang nam yang byed thub thabs med/ de dag shod dgos don med kyang rgya phyogs nas skad cha de 'dra shod kyi yod pa yin dus da ring ngas gsal bshad byas pa yin/ khyed rang tshos de shes dgos/ gong gsal las ta'i go rim gyi skad cha rnams de ring kha sang rgya phyogs nas skyon 'dzugs gsar pa zhig byed kyi yod pa yin tsang /de la lan 'debs byed ched 'tshab 'tshub ngang gra sgrig byas pa'i gnas tshul gang yang min par/ de snga nas lhag bsam rnam dag gis go rim bsgrigs pa yin/da cha'i gnas tshul la cha bzhag na nga tsho rgya mi dang phan tshun skad cha bshad de gnas tshul go bsdur byed pa'i skabs su rgya mis tā la'i bla mar thob thang dmigs bsal chen po yod lugs bshad/ bod mi sa ya drug gi bde ba sdug bsngal nag bsub btang nas de la rnyog dra gang yang med pa dang / tā la'i bla ma gzhan yul la gyar ba 'di rnyog dra yin pa'i bzo 'dra po bshad nas/ de'i don la rgya nag gzhung nas dgongs pa che bzhes gnang ste tā la'i bla mar 'tsho ba'i bkod sgrig yang dag pa byed kyi yin/ tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal la phyir log byed pa'i don la don tshan lnga zer ba zhig bshad pa de'i nang nga'i thob thang skor bshad yod/ nga bod la log pa'i don la krung dbyang nas dgongs pa bzhes 458

dgos kyi 'dug nga bod la log skabs sla po byas nas log na 'grigs ma song /nga la thob thang dgos zhes ngas de snga bshad pa med la/ ma 'ongs par yang tshig gcig bshad rgyu min/ nga mjo yang dge slong dang / dma' yang dge slong gi sdom pa'i thob thang zhig bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang yod/ 'di nga'i gzi brjid yin/ de las lhag pa'i thob thang go sa zhig dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mi thabs chag zhig la dgos sngasan gtan nas med/ nga ji tsam thabs skyo yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la yid ches dang / nyams len byed mkhan zhig yin/ mi tshe la cha bzhag na lo lnga bcu'i nang slebs tshar song / da phan rgya mis tu la'i bla ma'i thob thang skor tshur bshad pa red/ de yang ngo tsha kha skyengs kyi thog nas bod spyi pa'i don dag gi rnyog dra de bstan na ngo tsha gi yod pa dang /bod kyi rnyog dra yod pa ma red brjod thabs med par brten/ tā la'i log spyod pa phyi la gyar ba des rnyog dra bzo gi 'dug bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs tsho 'dod pa yongs su khengs nas skyid thag chod yod/ rnyog dra twa la'i bla mas bzo gi yod stabs tā la'i bla ma'i ched don tshan lnga bton pa yin na rnyog dra sel thub kyi red bsam gyi yod pa red/ ma 'ongs par bod rgya gnyis kyi don dag dka' ngal skor go bsdur byed skabs/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i thob thang skor la tshi ga gcig bshad dgos med/kha sang khyed rang tshor sgrog sbyang byas pa'i yi ge de'i nang du gsal po yod/bar lam rgya mis tshur tshig tho zhig sprad pa de dag yan ming phu zer bas ngag thog nas bshad pa'i khul red/ 'on te ngag thog nas bshad pa min par/ kho 459

chos yig thog la bkod de yan ming phus 'dar sig rgyag gin ngang klog pa zhig red/ gang ltar rgya phyogs nas tshur tshig tho zhig sprad yod/ tshig tho de la nga chos tshig rtsub ngan smras gang yang med par dngos gnas bden pa bden thub kyi gnas tshul nga tshor rang dbang lung par yod pa'i gtam brjod rang dbang bed sbyad de phar lan sprad pa red/ de'i nang la'ang tā la'i bla ma'i thob thang skor de snga phan bshad pa med la/ ma 'ongs par yang tshig gcig bshad rgyu min zhes gsal po bris nas tshig thag gtsang ma bcad sku1da/ nga la dgos pa ni bod rgya che'i mi dmangs la yod pa'i thob thang de yin pa dang / bod rgya che'i mi dmangs bde la 'khod pa zhig dgos/ de bzhin bod dang 'brel ba'i khrim/ mtshes lung pa rnams zhi bde dang bde la 'khod pa zhig dgos/ de byung na 'grigs pa red/ nga sger la gang yang mi dgos/ nga rang dge slong yin pa 'di la spobs pa yod la/ ha cang skyid po 'dug rgya mis chos gos gron pa'i sbyang ki zhes brjod dus nga dge slong rang byas nas bsdad yod/ yang tā la'i log spyod pa zhes brjod dus nga dge slong rang byas nas bsdad yod/ yang da la'i bla ma zhes brjod dus kyang nga dge slong rang byas nas bsdad pa las/ 'a( nas mtho ru dang dma' ru gang yang 'gro gi mi 'dug byas tsang nga'i skor bang yang bshad dgos med par ha cang skyid po 'dugade snga bod la yod dus rgyal srid chos srid kyi bdag po byas pa dang / rgya nag gi go sa yang mtho po byas nas bsdad pa red/ de nas rgya gar la slebs te rgya gar gzhung gi sku mgron byas nas bsdad yod/ nga la khyad par gang 460

yang mi 'dug 'dzam gling thog bod pa'i mi yin na'ang 'dra/ rgya gar ba yin na'ang 'dra/ rgya mi yin na'ang 'dra/ de min phyi rgyal mgo ser tsho yin na'ang 'dra/ su 'dra zhig thug kyang de dag mi yin bsams nas dngos gnas bsam pa rnam dag gis phan pa'i bsam pa 'chang gi yod/ ngas mi gzhan tshor phan pa'i bsam pa gal chen po red shod kyi yod la/ nga rang gi ngos nas kyang phan sems 'di rin thang bral ba'i nor bu yin bsam nas nyams len byed kyi yod/nyams len byas pa'i 'bras bur mi su zhig thug kyang grogs lnga'i 'du shes kyis ha hu zhes dga' po byas nas sdod kyi yod/ 'di ni rang gi gshis ka yang yin/de 'dra byas tsang 'dzam gling sa gnas gang du phyin kyang tshang mas nang tshag dang dga' po byed kyi 'dug 'di dngos gnas skyid po 'dug tā la'i bla ma ji tsam thabs sdug kyang rgya mi'i sar yas yas gnang rogs/ mas mas gnang rogs zhes nam yang brjod kyi ma red/ rgya mis da bar bka' drin che thag chod byas pa red/ da ni bka' drin gang yang dgos pa med/de nas brjod 'dod pa zhig la/ kha sang rgya mis nga la nag khra btsugs don/ tā la'i log spyod pasa.a mi ri shar rang btsan skor khyab bsgrags shugs che zhig byas pa red zer/ de skor gsal bshad cig byas na snyam/ gnas tshul ngo ma rnams khyed tshos rob tsam shes nayag po 'dug bar lam nas 'dzam gling thog bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung la do snang byed mkhan mang du song ste/ de 'dra'i thog nas rang bzhin du bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung spyi dang / lhag par bod kyi chos la do snang byed mkhan de tshor rang bzhin gyis bod pa'i bde sdug 461

skor la sha tsha slebs yod/ mi sna gal che'i nang bod par do snang byed mkhan mang du phyin/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul chags nas a mi ri ma'i gros tshogs gong 'og gi 'thus mi bod pa'i thog la sha tsha yod mkhan de 'dra nga tsho sngon ma nas ngo shes yod/ de tshos bod pa'i thog la nga tshos byed dgos pa dang byed thub pa gang 'dug ces brjod kyi 'dug khong tsho ni phyi lo 1979 lo nga a rir thog mar skyod skabs ngo shes shing bod par sems khur chen po yod/ de nas kha sang4 rir 'gro dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags pa de ni/ phyi lo 1983lo nga tshos bar lam bod yongs su rkyen ngan gyi thog nas bod mi 'das grongs ji tsam phyin yod pa'i thad lung tshan so so byas nas gnas tshul 'tshol sgrub byas bar phyi lo 1983 lo phan chad kyi gnas tshul lag son byung ba rnams la bsdoms rtsis rgyag dus/ gong lo phan rgya mi slebs pas rkyen byas te bod mi mang po zhig mu ges shi ba dang / mang spro zhig mnar gcod 'og shi ba/ 'bum bzhi tsam zhig dmar gsod btang ba bcas khyon bsdoms bod mi 'bum bcu gnyis tsam rkyen ngan 'og 'das grongs song ba de tsho'i ched du dmigs te/ gcen po stag 'tsher rin po chesa.a rir mchod rten zhig bzhengs bskrun gnang yod pa de la rab gnas byed pa dang / de bzhin a ri'i srid 'dzin zur pa ka ṭar nye char bod la phebs te khong nas kyang bod pa'i gnas tshul do snang gnang nas nga thug 'dod byed kyi 'dug de 'dra'i gnas tshul jog nas kha sngon phyi zla dgu par a rir bskyod pa yin/de'i gong du tshogs 'du gong 'og gi 'thus mi ngo shes pa tshos phyi zla drug 462

par tshogs 'du 'og ma'i nang bod pa'i skor gros chod yi ge zhig bzhag pa red/da dung da res nga a rir yong skabs nga'i thog nas dmigs bsal re 'dun rdog rdog gsal po zhig bshad rgyu byung na/ khong tshos de la rgyab skyor byed pa'i khyad par 'dug bod par sha tsha dang rgyab skyor byed rogs zhes sbom tshig ma yin pa'i rdog rdog don tshan kha shas bshad rgyu byung na yag po yong gnas brjod kyi 'dug ngas kyang de la bsam blo btang ste gong du brjod pa bzhin bod pa'i r+pā dag 'di bod mi sa ya drug gi don dag gcig pu ma yin par nga tsho'i khyim mtshes khag dang 'brel ba yod pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling gi zhi bde dang yang 'brel ba yod pa zhig chags yod dus/ gnas tshul de'i rtsa ba gang du thug yod ce na/ mi mang po zhig gi lag tu go mtshon bskur ba'i dpung chen po zhig phan tshun gdong gtugs kha gtad bcar nas bsdad na nyen kha rtag tu yod yod pa red/ der brten dmag 'khrug gi nyen kha sel ba'i thabs shes yag shos dmag gi rten gzhi med pa byung na/ che sa 'dzam gling zhi bde dang / rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi 'brel bar phan pa dang / chung sa bod par cha bzhag na'ang lag par me mda' 'khyer ba'i mi de tsho med pa zhig byung na nga tsho'i sems nang dngangs skrag chung du 'gro gi red/ dngos gnas rgya dang bod grogs po yan po zhig byed dgos byung na/ gcig gis gcig la blos 'khel ba zhig byung tshe dngos gnas grogs po red/ bod dang rgya gnyis dngos gnas grogs po yag po zhig chags rgyu'i byed phyogs thabs shes sus byed dgos sam zhe na/ nga tsho sdug po myong mkhan gyi ngos nas da cha bsam blo gtong rgyu bsdad med/ mi de tsam shi ba dang /463

sdug po 'di tsam myangs yod/ de las sdug pa nga tshor byed rgyu gang yod/ da ni nga tshor khog yangs byed rgyu gang yang bsdad med/ da cha bsam blo gtong res nga tshor thub tshod dang dbang yod gtong mkhan tshos gu yangs kyi bsam blo gsar pa zhig gtong dgos pa yin/ bod rgya gnyis mthun sgril gyi rtsa bar gu bshangs kyi bsam blo rgya phyogs nas gtong dgos pa las/ nga tsho'i ngos nas gtong rgyu gang yang bsdad med/ rgya phyogs nas gu bshangs kyi bsam blo gtong ba'i thabs shes yag shos ni/ rgya mis bod rgya che'i mi dmangs la yid ches yod/ blos bkal gyi yod/ khyed tsho'i /ba la me mda' 'khyer mkhan gyi mi de tsho 'dzugs kyi min zhes bshad nas rgya dmag tshang ma phyir 'then byas na/dngos gnas bod pa'i sems nang blos sgang kha bkal na sgang kha dang / phyed ka bkal na phyed ka zhes dpe la yod pa bzhin rgya mi'i ngos nas bod pa la tshur mi mthong cha 'jog byas te blos bkal na/ nga tshos kyang bsam blo gtong gi red/rang btsan dang / kha bral gyi skad cha mang po bshad dgos don med/ nang don bod rgya gnyis dbar don dam pa'i mthun sgril zhig dgos na/ sngon la rgya mi'i ngos nas bod par kha nas mthun sgril zhes bshad rung ma bshad rung /don snying bod pa mi re ngo rer slos ma 'khel bar tshang ma'i /ba la me mda' 'khyer mkhan re btsugs yod dus gang 'dra byas te yid ches byed thub/ sngon la rgya dmag rnams 'then pa yin na/ de yang rim pa gnyis kyi thog nas bod nang yod pa'i dmag gi rten gzhi 'tham gling gling chen phan tshun dang 'brel ba yod pa'i me shugs 'phur mdel shugs che de tsho'i gras thad shar bod par 464

dmigs nas bsgrigs pa zhig min dus rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul dang bstun nas lug len byed dgos pa dang / sa gnas sa thog la me mda' 'khyer te bsdad pa'i mi de dag gis me mda' bod par rgyag gi sku(da pa las/ me mdel gyis rgya gar la ni bsnyab kyi med/ sa mtshams kyi gnas tshul ni tha dad red/ de 'dra yi na tsang bod nang gi rgya dmag de tsho 'then te zhi bde'i bsti gnas bzo dargos zhes bshad pa 'di don tshan dang po yin/ de ltar byas na 'dzam gling zhi bde dang rgya dkar nag gi 'brel bar phan pa dang / nga rang tsho bod pa rang gi sems nang du'ang zhi bde zhig slebs kyi red/ don dam pa'i bod dang rgya'i dam tshig mthun lam ces pa 'di de'i thog nas sku nga dgos pa red/ byas tsang don tshan dang 11 rgya dmag 'then dgos bshad pa yin/ de la rgya mi tsho khong khro za thag chod nas rang btsan brjod kyi 'dug bshad pa red/ ngas rang btsan bshad rgyu ma byung zer gyi yod/ rang btsan gyi skad cha bshad med/ rang btsan dang rang skyong gi skad cha'i sgros gang yang bshad med/ gang ltar dngos yod gnas tshul la rgya dmag med pa zhig byung na/ nga tsho skad cha ga le ra la bshad chog gi red/don tshan gnyis pa/ bod nang rgya mi khyon che zhig yong gi yod pa de dag da mus bzhin yong na rim pas bod yul rgya yul la 'gyur 'gro ba dang / bod yul rgya yul chags na rang skyong zer ba 'di ming snyan po zhig las rtsa ba'i bod don brlag rgyu yin stabs de 'grig gi mi 'dug bod nang rgya mi yong rgyu de mtshams 'jog byed dgos bshad pa yin/ de ni nyen kha ha cang gi chen po mthong 465

dmigs nas bsgrigs pa zhig min dus rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul dang bstun nas lug len byed dgos pa dang / sa gnas sa thog la me mda' 'khyer te bsdad pa'i mi de dag gis me mda' bod par rgyag gi sku(da pa las/ me mdel gyis rgya gar la ni bsnyab kyi med/ sa mtshams kyi gnas tshul ni tha dad red/ de 'dra yi na tsang bod nang gi rgya dmag de tsho 'then te zhi bde'i bsti gnas bzo dargos zhes bshad pa 'di don tshan dang po yin/ de ltar byas na 'dzam gling zhi bde dang rgya dkar nag gi 'brel bar phan pa dang / nga rang tsho bod pa rang gi sems nang du'ang zhi bde zhig slebs kyi red/ don dam pa'i bod dang rgya'i dam tshig mthun lam ces pa 'di de'i thog nas sku nga dgos pa red/ byas tsang don tshan dang 11 rgya dmag 'then dgos bshad pa yin/ de la rgya mi tsho khong khro za thag chod nas rang btsan brjod kyi 'dug bshad pa red/ ngas rang btsan bshad rgyu ma byung zer gyi yod/ rang btsan gyi skad cha bshad med/ rang btsan dang rang skyong gi skad cha'i sgros gang yang bshad med/ gang ltar dngos yod gnas tshul la rgya dmag med pa zhig byung na/ nga tsho skad cha ga le ra la bshad chog gi red/don tshan gnyis pa/ bod nang rgya mi khyon che zhig yong gi yod pa de dag da mus bzhin yong na rim pas bod yul rgya yul la 'gyur 'gro ba dang / bod yul rgya yul chags na rang skyong zer ba 'di ming snyan po zhig las rtsa ba'i bod don brlag rgyu yin stabs de 'grig gi mi 'dug bod nang rgya mi yong rgyu de mtshams 'jog byed dgos bshad pa yin/ de ni nyen kha ha cang gi chen po mthong 465

gi 'dug dper na/ nga skyes sa'i grong gseb la cha bzhag na/ ha lam hu ha dang rgya mi mang ba chags nas/ nga tsho.a mdo ba nyung nyung chags yod/ phyi zlo 1982 lo a rir mtsho sngon nas thon pa'i rgya yig tshags par zhig mthong byung / de'i nang mtsho sngon sa khul gyi mi grangs bshad par bod pa 'bum bdun dang / rgya mi 'bum nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas rgya mi ldab gsum gyis mang ba chags 'dugakhams khul gyi gnas stangs bsgyu mas gsal po zhig ba༄ged thub kyi mi 'dug rung / rong sa dma' ba de tshor rgya mi'i grong gsar pa chags yong gi yod pa dang / sa cha de tsam yag po med pa de tshor bod pa tsho sdod pa'i gnas tshul de 'dra kun su'u dang / mtsho sngon khul la mang po yod 'dug sngon ma rgya mi rtsa ba nas med sa de 'dra la deng sang rgya grong gsar pa chags pa dang / g.yag 'ded mkhan gyi rgya mi 'brog pa de 'dra 'dug zer/ de snga yin na rgya mi g.yag 'ded mkhan yong mi srid pa zhig red/ deng sang khyad mtshar rgya mi g.yag 'ded mkhan gyi 'brog pa yod pa red/ khong choras 'ur rdo rgyag shes kyi yod dam med/gang 'dra byed kyi yod dam/ khong tshos 'o ma dkrog shes kyi yod pa yin nam/gang 'dra byed kyi sku(da dam snyam nas bsam blo 'khor byung / rgya mi thug pa dang bag leb bzo mkhas po yod pa las/ khong tsho mar 'don du bcug na gang 'dra byed kyi mongad dam/ rgya mis rnam kun bod pa mar za mkhan la dri ma kha gi 'dug zer gyi yod/ gang ltar rgya mi phon che bod nang slebs pa 'di dngos gnas nyen kha red/ nga tsho phyi la yod mkhan tshos skad brgyab nas thabs shes kyis gang ltar 'di dag 'gog thabs shig byed ma thub na/ gnas tshul de dngos gnas 466

byas na gcig nas 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang brdal bshig byas par 'gro gi yod pa dang / gnyis nas mi rigs rtsa med bzos pa zhes pa de'i nang la'ang 'gro rgi yod 'dug dbyin ji'i tshig nang la ji na'o sa'i ṭi (60ba00170)zhes zer gyi 'dug gang ltar dngos yod gnas tshul la 'grel bshad yag po brgyab ste gsal bshad yag po byed thub na/ 'dzam gling gi mi rigs spyi'i thob thang gnas tshul brdal bshig 'gro gi yod pas rtsod pa rgyag pa'i rgyu mtshan chen po zhig chags par brten don tshan gnyis pa 'di dza drag dang / gal che'i gnas tshul zhig chags yod/ rim pas rim pas bod lung par bod pa nyung zhing rgya mi/ mang ba zhig chags te/ so so'i lung pa'i nang so so'i mi 'di grangs nyung mi rigs shig chags pa yin na de ni tha ma red/ re ba rgyag sa gtan nas med par 'gyur bas dpe mi srid pa'i nyen kha chen po red/ de 'dra yong rgyu'i nyen kha sngon ma nas yod/ chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga bzhi lo ngos rang rgya nag pe cing la bskyod de lnga bcu nga lnga lo bod la phyir log byas pa yin/ pe cing nas thon khar ma'o tse tung dang / li'u hra'o chi/ kru'u te/ kra'u en le bcas bo/ nga tsho thug 'phrad du bskyod pa yin/ li'u hra'o chi thug skabs khong nas nga la brjod par/ nga tsho ma 'ongs par bod dang rgya nag gnyis tshong rgyag dgos/ stong sa re rgyag dgos zer na/ bod lung pa sa rgya che la mi nyung nyung yin pa dang /rgya nag lung pa sa rgya chung la mi shin tu mang bas sa cha'i thog mi ma shong bar bsdad yod pas bod rgya gnyis tshong rgyag dgos zer 'dug tshong gang 'dra byas te rgyag dgos cired dam/ bod kyi cha sa nas bkog ste rgya nag la 'khyer thabs 467

yod na khyad par mi 'dug kyang / de ni bkog thabs med/ da ga 'dra byed rgyu red ce na/ rgya mi bod la yong rgyu de red ma gtogs bod pa'i sa cha rgya nag la 'or thabs med/ stong de ni nga tshor gyong rag rgyu'i stong red/ de dag rgya mi'i ngos nas stong lta bu zhig la brtsi gi yod na yang / nga tsho'i ngos nas 'ji ni tshong ma yin par sa cha 'phrog 'gro gi yod pa red/ yang ma'o tse tung gis de 'dra min pa zhig bshad byung / da lta rgya nag nas bod la yar rogs pa byed kyi yod/ lo nyi shu song rjes bod yar rgyas song nas bod pas rgya nag la mar rogs ram byed thub kyi red/ de skabs rgya mi bod la sdod mi dgos pas thong nas 'then gyi red bshad byung / skad cha de tsho sprul pa'i bka' mol rang red 'dug ngo thog ga re yin mi shes/don tshan gsum pa/ 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang brdal bshig phrin pa der 'dzam gling nub phyogs nas/ u ru sus gtsos pa'i yo rob shar rma 'i dmar 16) sa khongs kyi rgyal khab de tsho'i nang la 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang brdal bshig phyin par do snang chen po byas te/ gnas tshul chung chung zhig lhasas kyang lam seng 'dzam gling yongs nas do snang byed kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang rgya nag nang la gnas tshul de rigs yong skabs do snang gtan nas byed kyi med par brten de la do snang nges par byed dgos zhes dang / lhag don bod nang 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang brdal bshig byas pa'i gnas tshul shin tu tshabs che yod pa de dag la do snang nges par byed dgos brjod pa yin/ nga tshos de la do snang byed dgos brjod don ni rgya mi la skyon 'dzugs gcig pu'i ched bshad 468

pa min par/ de las ldog ste phugs rgyang ring po'i thog nas rgya mi la sha tsha byas te bshad pa yin/ gang yin zhe na/ mi'i spyi tshogs gang du yin kyang yar rgyas legs po zhig yong bar mi la lhan skyes su yod pa'i gsar gtod kyi rna ma dpyod bsam 〉 de dag ji tsam shugs che ba 'don thub pa de tsam gyis spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro thub/ gsar gtod kyi rnam dpyod bsam blo ༄da spyod byed ma thub na spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro mi thub/ der brten ma 'ongs par rgya nag rang nyid rig gzhung dang / dpal 'byor sogs gang thad yar rgyas legs po zhig yong thabs su mi la yod pa'i rang bzhin gsar gtod kyi rnam pa cha tshang bed spyod gtong thub pa'i go skabs shig yod dgos/ de yong ched sha tsha'i kha nas gtam snyan med ces pa ltar skyon brjod byas na dngos gnas kyi gsar gtod dang /bsam blo phugs rgyang ring po gtong mkhan de tsho bsam blo grung bas/ gnas tshul mang po zhig bsam blor 'khor gyi yod pa yin dus de tshos da lta'i srid gzhung gi las ka byas pa de tshor de ga rang red lab kyi ma red/ ga re byas kyang khong tshor bsam blo mang po zhig yod pa de tsho bton dus/ skyon brjod kyi bzo zhig la mngon nas skyon brjod byed kyi 'dug ces ma lab par/ de tsho'i gsar gtod kyi rnam pa ga tshad yin kyang byed du bcug na/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro bar phan gyi red/ der brten rgya nag nang phran bu bsam 'char shod mkhan dang / lhag don chab srid thog bsam 'char shod mkhan byung ma thag lam sang sbug bsub gtong ba'i gnas tshul de med pa zhig byung na/ phugs rgyang ring po'i cha nas rgya nag rang nyid yar rgyas 'gro bar ha cang phan thogs 469

yod/ byas tsang nub phyogs rgyal khab tshos rgya nag nang 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang brdal bshig phyin pa de la do snang dang / lhag don bod nang tshabs che'i gnas tshul mang po zhig yong gi yod pa de tshor do snang nges par byed dgos zhes bshad pa yin/don tshan bzhi pa/ bod kyi sa char de snga yin na rang bzhin bdag tu ma bzung ba'i sems can rnams ri rgya klung rgya bsdams stabs sems can ha cang mang po yod/ byang rgyud la 'grong la sogs pa'i sems can mang po yod pa de tsho bar lam rgya mis mang po bsad pa dang / bod pa tsho yang bza' rgyu med pa'i dka' ngal la thug yang 'ga' zhig ni ched mngags khral bkal ba bcas kyis mang po bsad de sems can grangs 'bor nyung du phyin yod pa de dag myur skyob byed dgos pa dang / lhag par bod kyi sa cha 'di 'dzam gling gi yang thog ces shod srol yod la/ sa cha'ang mtho shos cha gas yod cing / bod kyi gnam gshis 'gyur 'gros kyi rkyen pas khyim mtshes rgyal khab tsho dang / tha nas mi ri ga'i gling chen gyi gnam gshis bcas par shugs rkyen chen sngon zebs kyi yod pa deng sang tshan rig pa tshos shod kyi 'dug bod kyi sa cha 'di sngar lo sa/ (5 mang po'i gong bod dang rgya gar gling phran dpar rgya mtshos bcad yod pa dang /de nas rgya gar gyi gling phran de ga ler ga ler byang phyogs su yong nas bod kyi sa sne dang thug ste/ bod 'di sa gzhi nyis rtsegs lta bu chags nas mtho ru mtho ru song ba des rkyen pas bod sa'i gnas stangs thun mong ma yin pa zhig chags yod/ de ltar bod kyi gnam gshis 'di bod gcig pu ma yin par/ nye 'khor 470

khyim mtshes rgyal khab khag dang / mdor na a mi ri ka dang bcas pa'i gnam gshis la 'brel ba yod pa yin dus/ bod kyi rang bzhin 'byung khams 'pho 'gyur mi yong ba'i ched du dper na/ nags tshal srung skyob bya rgyu dang / rdul sngon gyi rdzas ro rnying pa bod nang gang byung du sba ba de rigs med pa zhig dgos zhes bshad pa yin/don tshan lnga pa/ rgya nag gzhung dang mu mthud 'brel ba byed rgyu'i 'dod pa yod ces bshad pa yin/ don tshan bzhi 1— de la skabs der rgya mis go ba cha tshang len ma thub pa'am/ yang na ha be lha pe'i thog nas bltas pa/ de min kho rang tshos bod btsan zos byas pa de'i gnong yod pa de la/ twa la'i bla mas skad cha bshad nas ngo rgol gyi rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug bsams nas skyag gnong ngos len byas pa yin bzo 'dug nga'i skad cha'i nang de snga bod dang rgya gnyis tha dad kyi rgyal khab so so yin pa dang / bod rang btsan yin pa gsal por bkod yod/ de ni bden pa'i gnas tshul yin pas sus kyang sgrib thub thabs med/ rgya mis tam pa ji tsam bshad kyang sgrib thub kyi ma red/ ma 'ongs par gang 'dra zhig tu 'gro dang mi 'aX de rgya mi'i byed stangs la rag lus yod/ rgya mi'i lta stangs spyod stangs la nga tshos blta rgyu yin/ rgya mi'i lta stangs spyod stangs la lta bzhin lta bzhin gyi thog nas ma 'ongs par nga tshos bsam blo gu yangs ji tsam gtong dgos min blta rgyu yin pa de ni gnas tshul tha dad red/'das pa'i gnas tshul la bod rgya gnyis tha dad so so yin pa de la sus kyang rtsod pa byed yul med/ rgya nag gi yig cha kha shas nang bod rgya khongs yin 471

pa bshad yod kyang / thang deb rnying pa sogs yig cha kha shas nang bod rgyal khab tha dad yin pa gsal po 'khod yod/ nga tsho'i lha sa gtsug lag khang gi rdo ring yi ge'i nang ((leng go'o nyinyi zhes gsal po bris 'dug ((leng go'o nyi zhes pa ni rgyal khab gnyis zer ba red/ de snga'i 'das pa'i lo rgyus nang bod dang rgya gnyis tha dad so so yin pa tshang mas shes gsal red/ yang rgya mis yon gong ma sog po'i skabs nas bod rgya khongs red zer ba dang / skabs re man ju'i skabs nas bod rgya khongs red zer ba shod kyi yod/ de ni kho rang tshes kho rang tshor 'khyog bshad kyi 'grel bshad brgyab pa zhig red ma gtogs bden pa'i gnas tshul ma red/ nga tsho bod kyi rgyal rabs 'di bod pa'i lo rgyus la cha bzhag dgos pa dang / bod pa'i lo rgyus gtso bor brtsi dgos/ 'di'i thos nas bshad na bod dang rgya'i 'brel ba de mchod yon sbyin bdag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'brel ba zhig byung yod pa las/ bod rgya mi'i khongs gtogs yin pa zhig nga tsho'i yig cha'i nang rtsa ba nas gsal med/ rgya/ hor/ bod gsu ma zhes tha dad so so yin pa gang sar gsal yod/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi darngosga yod gnas tshul rna mas gsal por bshad de/ ma 'ongs par gang du 'gro dang mi 'gro ni de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rten gzhi zhig bzo rgyu dang / rgya mi phon che bod la yong ba de mtshams 'jog dgos rgyu/ 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang skor la nub phyogs rgyal khab tshos gtsos pa'i 'dzam gling spyi sa do snang chen po byed dgos pa/ bod kyi sa cha'i rang bzhin 'byung ba 'pho 'gyur chen po mi 'gro ba 'i sa gzhi gtsang mar 'jog dgos pa bcas yin/472

de ring thog ma'i 'char gzhi byas na mjug tu bka' blon thub bstan nas rgya gar nang gi gnas tshul phran bu bshad na bsam pa yod kyang / dus tshod sang tsam 'gor song bas 'dir mtshams 'jog rgyu yin/ yang khyed tshos rgya gar nang gi gnas tshul shes 'dod yod tshe/ dper na/ nga rang tsho'i bod mi btsan byol ba rgya gar gtso bor gyur pa'i phyi rol la gang 'dra yod pa dang /da phan chos dang rig gzhung thog la las ka gang zhig byas yod pa/ 'char gzhi gang 'dra yod pa/ gtso che shos shes yon skor la slob gra gang 'dra yod pa de 'i rigs khyed tshos phran bu phran bu thos yod kyi red kyang / gnas tshul yongs mas phyogs bsdoms nas nyan bshad byed rgyu byung na/ gnas tshul gsal twa r+shas rgyur phan thogs yong mdog kha bas/ dus tshod btsal nas sa cha bsil rna/ zhig smu zur du tshogs na 'grigs/ khyed rang tsho tshang ma blo bde po dang sems pa skyid po byas sdod rogs/nga'i sems nang rtag tu dran pa ni/ so so'i lung pa'i nang yod pa'i mi rnams dngangs skrag dang sdug bsngal chen po zhig gi 'og la bsdad yod kyang tshang ma sems shugs ma chag par gnas te mdor na rgya mi'i las byed nang yod pa dang / gung khran tang yon yin pa/ lo mang rgya mi dang mnyam du las ka byed myong mkhan/ dper na/ kha shas 'go stod kyi dus skabs la lhag bsam rnam dag gi thog nas rgya mis bshad pa'i skad char yid ches byas te 'gro mkhan de 'dra yod kyang / de tsho'i sems kyi gting la so so'i mi rigs kyi lta ba dang mi rigs kyi zhen khog cig yong dgos kyi red la/ dngos gnas ha las pa'i 473

shugs chen po 'dug rgya mi'i mtho rim las khungs nang yod pa'i mi de sprudra nas tshur nga la skyabs zhu bskur ba'am/ yang na lan mang po bskur mkhan byung /de tsho kha sha sa ni lha sa 11gas bod kyi sa khul khag dang / 'ga' zhig ni pe cing dang / lan kru'u/ mtsho sdon/ drin tu sogs nas red/ khong tshos 'di phyonus re ba chen snga rgyag gi sku da brjod pa ni dngos gnas ha las pa red/ bed mi rtsam zan ma ṇi bgrang mkhan tshang mar so so'i mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / nyen khog 'gran zla bral ba zhig 'dug pa de ni gzi brjid yin la/ spobs pa byed chog pa zhi ga kyang red/ da bar tshang mas hur thag byas pa der bka' drin che/thugs rje che zhes khyed tshor brjod rgyu ma zad/ khyed tsho brgyud nas bod nang yod pa tshor ngas 'di 'dra brjod kyi 'dug ces lab rogs/bod rgya che'i mi mang dang / de bzhin 'tshar longs yong bzhin pa'i sacan skyes slob phrug tsho ni de bas ha las dgos pa'i sems shugs chen po 'dus ba sang 11da nas bros byol sku nga ba'i phru gu lo bcu grangs byas pa zhig thus sding /grung mdog kha po zhig 'dug nye dus zang nge zing nge byed dus yod dam 'es dris pas/ sku(da zer gyi 'dug de dus ga re byas pa yin nam lab par/ rlangs 'khor dang sbag sbag de 'dra la me rgyag par phyin pa yin zer 'dug ta la/sa byung / da res btson khang nang du'ang phru gu lo bcu bzhi byas pa de 'dra gang tsam bcug yod pa de tshor nyes brdung mang po gtong gi 'dug zer/ de dag ni nga tsho'i gzi brjid red/ phru gu chung chung de tshor yang so so'i mi rigs kyi tshen khog shugs che ngo/da pa dang / slob gra chung ba dang / slob gra 'bring ba/ mtho 474

rim slob gra/ de bzhin rgya nag nang gi mtho rim slob gra khag bcas la yod pa'i slob phrug de tsho ha las pa'i sems shugs chen po 'dug pe cing dang / drin tā/ lan kru'u sogs la slob sbyong byed mkhan a mdo khul dang / khams khul nas yin pa de 'a dras yi ge mang po btang byung / dngos gnas ha las pa red ladug byas tsang las byed pa dang / gung khran tang yon/ tang yon yin pa tsam du ma zad lo mang po rgya mi'i las khungs nang las ka byas te phyi tshul la bltas na rgya mi rgya rgan chags pa dang / rgya mi'i rgyug khyi rgyug nag yin pa'i baXsgo 'dra po de 'dras nang don so so'i mi rigs kyi zhen khog ha las pa yod pa de tsho'i gras la ngas thugs rje che zer gyi 'dug ces khyed tshos lab rogs/ yang mi ba shas mgo rmongs te gnas tshul gsal po ma shes par rgya mis gang bshad pa de rang red bsam mkhan re zung yong srid kyi red/ de tsho ni snying rje'i yul yin pas nga tshos khong khro byas te sdang 'dzin byed dgos don med/ khong tshos slo 'pher gyi ma red/ bden pa'i mtha' gsal yong gi yod pas/ khong tsho ṣ+pe rog dkar po chags rgyu ma gtogs gang yang med/ 'di khyed tsho'i sems la zhogs/ tshang mar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/nga tsho byes la yod pa'i mi mang tshos da bar hur thag byas pa red/ khyed rang mo kha shas nas rgya gar nang yod pa tsho mthun sgril yag po mi 'dug zer ba'i mthong tshul de 'dra zhig yong gi yod 'dug gnas tshul de 'dra ma red/de yang shes dgos kyi 'dug gtam brjod rang dbang yod pa'i lung pa'i nang blo mthun ma mthun phran bu yong ba'i skabs la yag 'dug nyes 'dug shod mkhan 475

yong gi red/ bod nang rgya mis mnan bsad byed pa'i 'og gi mi'i gnas stangs dang / rang dbang lung par sdod mkhan gyi mi'i gnas stangs dbar mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod/ rang dbang lung par sdod mkhan tshor ga re byas kyang mthos 'dug dmas 'dug zer ba'i skad cha shod rgyu'i rang dbang yod/ de ni gzhi rtsa'i stobs shugs yin pa las/ sdug pa ma red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug 'gas rtsa'i gnas tshul gal che sa zhig la thug na bod bsam rma zhig tshang mar yod/nye char lha sar gnas tshul byung ba'i skabs la 'dzam gling sa gnas gang sar yod pa'i bod pa tsho dang / lhag don phyi rgyal la skyes pa'i bod phrug bod yul mig gis ma11nga ma myong ba de tsho sems shugs ha cang chen po 'dug khong tshos bod skad khrag ge khrog ge ma gtogs mi shes kyang / bod pa yin bsam pa 'i sems shugs dngos gnas ha las pa 'dug skabs der 'dzam gling gi sa cha bod pa yod sa gang sar rgya mi'i gzhung tshab khang gis mtshon pa'i las khungs yod sa de tshor bskyod de skad 'bod byed rgyu dang / de bzhin sa cha gal che sa ra skad 'bod ngo rgol byas pa red/ khong tsho phar bltas na phyi rgyal gyi rig bzhung la goms pa'i bzo lta bu dang / gzhas shig btang yang phyi rgyal gyi gzhas gtong ba las/ tho(da gzhas mi gtong ba/ bod gzhas mi shes mkhan de 'dra tsha/nga/ dngos gnas kyi 'gag gcig la thug dus nga bod pa yin/ bod pa yin bas rma pa'i bsam blo ha cang shugs chen po 'dug de ltar nga tsho phyi la yod mkhan tshos da bar hur thag byas pa red la/ da dung yang hur thag byed kyi red/ nga rang tsho bod gzhis byes yongs la 'gan gcig dang khur gcig red/ tshang rma/ blo 476

bange po byas sdod rogs/nga rang la tā la'i log spyod pa zer na'ang 'dra/ tā la'i bla ma zer na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar don snying dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos da bar hur thag byas pa yin la/ da dung yang dpral ba sa la ma gzags bar hur thag byed kyi yin/ de ni so so'i las kyis bskos pa red la/ nga rang gi 'gan yang chags yod/ phyogs gcig nas dka' ngal chen po yin na yang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas ji tsam dka' ngal che ba de tsam gyis so sos 'gan khur nas hur thag byed dus/ 'di ni gzi brjid yin snyam pa dran gyi 'dug khyed rang tsho blo bde po byed rogs/ nga'i ngos nas hur thag byed kyi red/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes 455// // 477

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1988 zla 4 tshes 2 nyin ldi 'i.a sho ka mgron khang du ma shi bar gyi zas bcad ngo rgol nang zhugs mkhan tshor stsal ba'i bka' slob/bod nang rgya mi'i go mtshon 'og la zhum pa med pa'i thog nas rang sros blos btang gi las ka gcig byed kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho 'di phyogs nas bod bstan pa chab srid dang / mi mang gi thob thang gi don dag la so sos dwang du blangs nas zas bcad ngo sgol gyi sgo nas rang srog blos btang gi snying stobs bcangs nas las 'gul byas pa la ha cang dga' po byung / dngos gnas drang gnas yag po red/ ha las pa zhig red/ khyed rang tsho rang dgar kha nas srog blos gtong gi yin zer ba'i tshig skam po bshad pa tsam ma yin par don dag lag len ngo ma'i thog nas dngos gnas rang so sos dwang du blangs te de lta bu'i sems thag bcad pa de ngo mtshar skye 'os pa zhig red/ khyed rang chos lhag bsam dang / zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs 'di tsam bcangs pa la khyed rang tshor thugs rje che zer rgyu yin/ rtsa ba khyed rang tsho so so'i ngos nas zas bcad ngo rgol gyi thog nas rang srog blos btang gi snying stobs de tsam skyes pa red de/ ngo thog don dag ngo ma'i thog la nus pa ga tshod thon gyi red dam zer na/ de rkyen mang po zhig la ltos pa red/ da lta'i gnas stangs kyi 'og nas dril bsgrags chen po zhig yong gi red/ gtso che shos bod nang dang / bod kyi phyi rol du yod pa'i bod pa tsho'i ngos nas dngos gnas 'dod pas dwang du blangs te lus srog blos btang gi las 'gul byed kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul go yong dus tan tan gang ci'i thog nas phan thogs nges can zhig yong rgyu red/ nga 478

rang tsho bod mi nyung shas shig gis srog blos btang ba des 'dzam gling thog la dril bsgrags gang 'tshams shig ma gtogs/ don dag bsgrub thub kyi red zer rgyu ha cang khag po red/ gtso che shos rgya mi'i ngos nas g.yo 'gul byed dgos/rgya mis g.yo 'gul byed thabs la bod pa sa ya gcig lhag tsam shi yod pa red de/ der rtsis 'gro gang yang ma btang ba zhig la/ nga tsho 'dir mi nyung shas shig gis srog swārtos btang ba la rgya mis gasku( 'gul byed rgyu khag 11 red/ tshudags gcig nas de dngos yod gnas tshul red/ gnyis nas nga rang gi ngos nas cha bzhag na/ nga dge slong gcig red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi thog nas khyed rang tshos dngos gnas lus srog blos btang byas dus ngas kha rog bsdad pa yin na/ sems kyi bzod thabs med pa lta bu 'dug nyan dang ma nyan khyed rang tsho do bdag gi gnas tshul tha dad red/ nga rang gi ngos nas ngas dge skyon mthong ba de ma lab na mi 'grigs pa yin dus/ mtha' ma bkra shis dbang 'dud mdun la nga rang gi bsam tshul gang yod pa yig thog la bris nas bskur te khyed rang tshor lab ces mngags pa yin/ khyed rang tsho'i ngos nas/ phyogs gcig nas bod spyi don la lhag bsam dang / snying stobs bcangs te bod don la lus srog blos btang gi sems thag bcad pa red de/ yang de rjes ngas btang ba'i yi ge de 'byor yong dus/ 7rgyal ba rin po ches lab pa de la khyed rang tshos dngos gnas dga' po dang / dad pa dam tshig g.yo ba med pa'i thog nas khyed rang tshos nyan shes byas pa de la nga rang yang ha cang dga' po byung / nga'i ngos nas dngos yod gnas tshul la rgyu mtshan jog nas brtag dpyad byas/ nga 479

rang dge slong yin pa'i cha nas bzod thabs med pa'i gnas tshul thog nas lab pa de la khyed chos nyan pa red/ de la shin tu dga' po byung /de la phyogs gcig nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ khyed rang tshos bod spyi pa'i don dag la bsam blo btang nas srog blos btang gis dam bca' zhig bzhag nga rang tsho bod spyi pa'i don dag de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba yod pas/ khyed rang tsho la bsod nams dpag tu med pa zhig thob yod/ yang ngas yi ge bris nas khyed rang sto ma shi bar du zas bcad sdod rgyu mtshams 'jog byas par brten/ nga'i ngos nas mi mang po zhig srog skyabs pa'i bsod nams gsog rgyu'i go skabs byung ba red/ ngas gang yang ma lab par bzhag pa yin na/ khyed rang tsho spyi pa'i don dag la dmigs te srog blos btang ba'i mtha' ma shi rgyu yin pa red/ ngas nga rang gi bsam tshul yod pa de bshad nas/ khyed rang tsho'i srog skyabs pa'i bzo 'dra po chags yong dus mi gang 'tshams shig la mi 'jigs srog gi sbyin pa lta bu'i nyams len byed rgyu'i go skabs byung / des rgyal ba rin po che'i tshe yun du brtan pa la yang phan pa red/ sems can gcig tshe thar btang yang tshe thar gtong mkhan de'i tshe la phan gyi yod pa ltar/ da res gnas stangs khyad mtshar zhig gi 'og nas mi 'ga' shas tshe thar btang ba lta bu byung bas go gnyis chod byung ba red/ khyed rang tsho'i ngos nas bsod nams bsags yod la/ nga rang gi ngos nas kyang bsod nams gsog pa'i go skabs byung ste/ yag po byung song / bkra shis bde legs yod/kha sang yi ge'i nang la bris pa bzhin/ da cha lhag bsam de 'khyer 480

nas las rigs mang po zhig gi nang la nus pa 'don sa yod/ so so rang shi rgyab ste nag thum du phyin pas de tsam gyi rlabs che rgyu med/ de las so so'i srog yun du 'tsho ba'i thog nas dwang blangs kyi sems shugs dang / snying stobs 'gyur ba med pa zhig yod pa de mu mthud nas/ nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang bod kyi chab srid skor dang / bod kyi rang dbang skor la rang bzhin mi'i do snang slebs pa'i ched du dper na so so'i dga' nye blo dkar dang / so so'i bu phrug tshun chad la bod rang dbang bden pa'i don dag la 'thab rtsod byed pa'i bsam blo'i slob goso gtong rgyu sogs de 'dra'i thog nas las ka byed rgyu mang po zhig tan tan yad/gzhan yang 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul 'gyur 'gros la gzhigs pa'i skabs su babs pa'i zas bcad ngo rgol byed dgos pa de 'dra yang yong srid pa red/ dper na kha sang nga yang 'di 'dra zhig dran byung / dngos gnas skabs ran po gcig dang / cha rkyen skabs su babs pa dngos gnas zhig byung ba yin na/ snga mo lhan rdis kyang zas bcad ngo rgol mang po zhig gnang gi yod pa red/ nga rang gi ngos nas maha rdam lhan rdi'i gnang stangs la yi rangs dang mos pa chen po yod/ nga rang yang zas bcad 'dra byed 'dod byung / spyir 'dzam bu gling spyi'i don dag 'dra yin na yang rung / nga rang tsho bod pa'i don dag 'dra yin yang rung / gang ltar ran po gcig dang / skabs su babs pa don phan ldan pa byung ba yin na/ nga rang gi ngos nas kyang zas bcad byed 'dod yod/nga tsho mjug la blta chog gi red/ da lta'i char so sor lhag bsam dang / snying 481

stobs yod pa de mu mthud nas so so gson pa'i dgos don tshang ba zhig byed thub na yag po red/da skyid po byas nas sdod/ da res khyed rang tshos las 'gul byas pa des dngos gnas chab srid thog nas bshad pa yin na/ bod pa'i snying stobs dang sems thag chod po yod pa'i rtags mtshan bstan thub pa red/ chos phyogs kyi 11ga nas bshad pa yin na/ so so kun 11nga rnam dag gi thog nas srog blos btang gi snying stobs skyes pa yin dus bsod nams dpag tu med pa bsags yod/ rang dgar rgya mir khong khro byas/ khong khri'i rkyen gyis byas pa yin na/phan sku(na 1geb kyi ma red/ phan pa'i sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa brgyud nas mi mang sngoge zhig dang / mis mtshon pa'i khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phan pa'i sems bskyed dgos/ gang ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zer dus skye 'gro'i bde skyid dang 'brel ba yod/ bya ba bzang po gcig sgrub pa la ltos nas bsdad yod/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zer ba de yang bya ba bzang po byed dgos/ bsam pa bzang po byed dgos zhes bshad pa ma gtogs de min pa'i don dag gcig yod pa ma red/ de 'dra'i bsam blo btang nas zas bcad ngo rgol gyi bya ba byed pa'i kun slong de 'dra zhig gis rgyab 'khyogs pa yin na/ da1dus gnas drang gnasakyi bsod nams thob kyi red/ so sos rjes su yi rangs bya dgos/ nga'i ngos nas kyang tshe thar btang ba lta bu'i go skabs yag po zhig byung ba red/ de 'dra yin dus de ring khyed tshor bkra shis bde legs zer rgyu yin/ dga' po byung / khyed tshos thengs 482

dang po de lta bu'i sems thag bcad nas yong dus/ nga ngo mtshar skyes byung /kha stong pa'i 'ur shob sus kyang bshad thub kyi red/ ngo thog don dag ngo ma'i thog de lta bu'i sems thag bcad nas sems shugs bsgril rgyu zer ba de las sla po ma red/ khyed rang tshos de tsam gyi bsam blo btang ba de dngos gnas rang ngo mtshar skyes song / shin tu dga' po byung / thengs gnyis pa ngas ma byed zer lab dus rgyal ba rin po che'i kha la nyan po byas pa red/ sems shugs yod pa gang zhig la rgyal ba rin po che'i kha la nyan 11 byas skusang dus/ nga rang gi ngos nas cha bzhag na/ de tsam gyi mis nga la yid ches byas pa de'i tshod kyis nga rang gi 'gan de ljid du 'gro gi 'dug da ngas gzab gzab ma byas na/ mis de tsam blos 'gel gyi yod pa dang / mis de tsam gyi cha bzhag gi yod red/ngas nor 'khrul gyi sgang la phyin pa yin na ga nas 'grigs bsam pas nga rang gi sems nang 'gan lci ru 'gro ba dang / rdog khres che ru'agro gi yod pa lta bu zhig byung / gang ltar yang snying ha cang dga' po byung / tshang ma la thugs rje che/ da blo bde po byas nas sdod ces stsal// //483

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1988 zla 4 tshes 33 nyin don grub gling gzhis mi tshor 455 ba'i bka' slob/da ring nga rang tsho 'dir ltod lhod byas te thug pa dga' po byung / khyed rang tsho'i phyi snod kyi bkod pa dngos gtsang ma/ spus dag po 'dug gzhis chags che khag kha shas kyi khang par mtshon na/ 'dir yod pa tshang ma gang la gang 'tshams hra tag tag yag po 'dug snod 'di'i nang gi sdod mkhan gyi skya ser rgan gzhon dbye ba med par tshang ma grung tog tog dngos gtsang rma//gdong 5/nga tshang ma gsos ril ril zhig yin mdog kha po mthong song nge 'dra yin tsang nga rang ha cang dga' po byung / de ltar yong ba'i rtsa ba so so 'i sger gyi khe phan la/ rang don rang gces su yin yang byed kyi red/ de dang chabs cig bod spyi pa'i la rgya zhen khog ma dor ba'i thog nas tshang mas bod pa/ yin bsam pa'i 'du shes rtag tu sems la bcang nas bsdad pa'i lag rjes thon yong gi yog red/ tshang mas lo nas lo bstud de lhag bsam snying stobs 'dor ba med par bsdad pa'i 'bras bu yin dus da ring nga rang tsho 'dir mnyam 'dzoms byas pa'i sar thugs rje che zer gyi yin/nga rang tsho sngon ma nas skad cha byung ba nang bzhin red/ nga tsho bod ri btsan byol ba tshos gnas skabs shig nga tshor rang dbang gi rtsod len byed rgyu'i ched du mi'i lung par nga tsho gzhis chags pa'i ring rtsa ba bod spyi pa'i don das la dmigs nas las ka gang ci'i thog la hra tag tag yag po byed thub na rma 'ongs par nga tsho gzhis byes phar tshur thug 'phrad kyi go skabs byung mtshams 484

bod nas tshur yong mkhan tshos nga tsho btsan byol du lo mang sdod rgyun ring gi bzhi rtsa'i gnas stangs dang / thabs shes ji ltar byas yod pa bcas mig gis mthong ba yin na sems la dga' tshor bskyed thub pa yong gi red/ de min nga tsho mi'i lung par 'a 'ub khyon nas ma 'dus par mtha' zhan skyo por gnas yod na bod nas sku(nga mkhan lhag bsam can gyi mi 66) sems zhum pa dang / sems skyo po yong rgyu zhig dang / rigs kha shas kyis khyad gsod byed rgyu'i nyen kha yang lho/ da cha nga tsho mi'i lung par slebs te lo nyi shu rtsa dgu song ba dang / phran bu phran bu'i dka' ngal mu mthud yong gi red la/ 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa yang mang po zhig da lta bsdad yod na yang / spyi yongs nas bshadatsho pa yin na nga rang tsho dngos gnas hra tag tag chags nas bsdad yod/ nga tsho sger so sor yang khe phan yod la/ bod spyi pa'i don dag la yin na'i mtshan la dgung 'degs kyi zhabs 'degs nges can zhig sgrub thub pa red/ yag po byung ba red/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus la bsam blo btang na tshudags gcig nas nga tsho rang gi lung pa bral nas mi'i lung par gyar ba 'di las skyo ba med/ so so'i lung pa'i nang la yang nyams nyes de lta bu byung / blo yul las 'das pa'i gtor bshig ha cang chen po byung yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i nang la bod mi rigs zer ba lo rgyus yod mkhan/ chos dang rig gzhung rnying khungs rin thang can yod pa'i mi rigs shig rtsa brlag 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha'i mtshams su slebs yod pa red/ yin na'ang rkyen ngan grogs la shar ba lta bus nga rang tsho mi'i lung par gyar nas chos lugs dang / mi rigs 'dra mi 'dra'i yul khag la 'brel ba byed rgyu'i go skabs 485

gsar pa zhig byung ba dang / go skabs de'i thog nas da cha 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung la do snang byed mkhan gyi tshogs pa gsar pa ha lam stong phrag skor zhig btsugs yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung gi bro ba myangs pa'i dbang gis bod nang la nyams chag gtor bshig phyin pa de rnams blo pham gyi bsam tshul shugs che ru phyin/ de dang chabs cig bod mir rang bzhin gyis sha tsha shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs te deng sang chab srid kyi thog nas bod don thog la rgyab skyor byed mkhan je mang du 'gro gi yod/ sngon ma lnga bcu nga dgu dang / drug cu re grangs nang la 'dzam gling rgyal tshogs su bod don gleng slong skabs chab srid kyi gnad don gcig pu'i thog nas rgyab skyor byas pa red/ deng sang gzhung phan tshun nas chab srid kyi gnad don thog nas bod par rgyab skyor byed thub kyi med/ yin na yang tshogs pa khag dang / mang tshogs nang nas 11da par rgyab skyor gyi rnam pa thon yong mkhan de dag dngos gnas drang gnas kyi rgyu mtshan shes pa'i thog nas bod par rgyab skyor dang / dga' zhen mi'i brtse ba'i bsam lha'i thog nas rgyab skyor byas pa ma gtogs/ tshong dngos wa'i khe phan dang / chab srid kyi 'phral sel khe gyong zhig la bltas nas rgyab skyor byas pa zhig ma red/deng sang nga tshor rgyab skyor yod pa 'di dag dngos gnas drang gnas mi'i khyad chosas gcig gis gcig la sha tsha dang / gcig gis gcig la gus brtsi byed pa'i bsam tshul thog nas bod par rgyab skyor byas pa zhig red/ 'das pa'i lo yun de'i ring la tshang mas dka' las rgyab pa'i grub 'bras gang la gang 486

gsar pa zhig byung ba dang / go skabs de'i thog nas da cha 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung la do snang byed mkhan gyi tshogs pa gsar pa ha lam stong phrag skor zhig btsugs yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung gi bro ba myangs pa'i dbang gis bod nang la nyams chag gtor bshig phyin pa de rnams blo pham gyi bsam tshul shugs che ru phyin/ de dang chabs cig bod mir rang bzhin gyis sha tsha shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs te deng sang chab srid kyi thog nas bod don thog la rgyab skyor byed mkhan je mang du 'gro gi yod/ sngon ma lnga bcu nga dgu dang / drug cu re grangs nang la 'dzam gling rgyal tshogs su bod don gleng slong skabs chab srid kyi gnad don gcig pu'i thog nas rgyab skyor byas pa red/ deng sang gzhung phan tshun nas chab srid kyi gnad don thog nas bod par rgyab skyor byed thub kyi med/ yin na yang tshogs pa khag dang / mang tshogs nang nas 11da par rgyab skyor gyi rnam pa thon yong mkhan de dag dngos gnas drang gnas kyi rgyu mtshan shes pa'i thog nas bod par rgyab skyor dang / dga' zhen mi'i brtse ba'i bsam lha'i thog nas rgyab skyor byas pa ma gtogs/ tshong dngos wa'i khe phan dang / chab srid kyi 'phral sel khe gyong zhig la bltas nas rgyab skyor byas pa zhig ma red/deng sang nga tshor rgyab skyor yod pa 'di dag dngos gnas drang gnas mi'i khyad chosas gcig gis gcig la sha tsha dang / gcig gis gcig la gus brtsi byed pa'i bsam tshul thog nas bod par rgyab skyor byas pa zhig red/ 'das pa'i lo yun de'i ring la tshang mas dka' las rgyab pa'i grub 'bras gang la gang 486

'tshams byung yod pa yag po red/ rgya mi'i ngos nas da lta phan chad la bod pa zer mkhan de dbang yod dang drag shugs thog nas mnan te med par bzo dgos pa med pa bzos/ brje dgos pa de brjes nas rgya mi rang nyid kyi kha nas bshad pa nang bzhin bod gsar pa zhig yong gi red bsam pa'i re ba byas yod kyang / deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi dngos yod gnas tshul la blta dus bod pa'i chos dang / rig gzhung zer ba 'di dag phan ma thogs pa'i ca dngos lta bu ma yin par rin thang yod par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ rgya mi kho rang tshos ma shes pa ma gtogs 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung la do snang byed mkhan de rnams mi lkug pa sha stag nam yang min/ rgya mi kho rang tshos mngon par bstod cing mig dpe blta sa'i lung pa'i nang nas bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung la do snang byed mkhan yong dus rgya mis bsam blo gsar pa gtong dgos pa zhig dang / bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung la rgya mi'i ngos nas sems nang dga' zhen med na'ang / kha nas sha tsha byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul gsar pa zhig chags yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas rang shugs kyis bod pa'i thog la lam seng gang byung byed bde po med mkhan zhig chags yong gi 'dug bod spyi'i gnas stangs thog la nga rang tshos 'das pa'i lo de'i ring la sa bon btab pa rnams la da cha 'bras bu smin pa'i 'go tshugs yod pa red/ da dung yang nga rang tsho tshang mas 'das pa'i lo rgyun de'i ring la nga tshor nyams myong byung ba de rnams gzhi la bzhag ste tshang mas hur thag 'bad thag byed kyi red la byed rgyu gal chen po red/487

da shin 'dir bka' shag gi gsung bshad nang yod pa bzhin nga rang tsho 'dir spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs yod pa dang / 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang du bod kyi phyi logs la bod pa ga 'dra ga 'dra yod pa de rnams tshang mas shes pa byed rgyu de gal chen po 'dug bod spyi pa'i don dag 'di bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs rdzogs la 'khri ba'i las 'gan zhig red/ bod spyi pa'i don dag la sems khur blangs te nga rang tsho btsan byol ba'i gnas stangs mgo 'tshos pa zhig byed dgos kyi 'du ga dper na bod la gnyen 'phrad du 'gro mkhan bod nang slebs skabs so sdurware dga' nye blo dkar gyi sems kyi nang la rgya mi'i gdug rtsub dang / mnar gcod 'og la lo mang bsdad pa'i na tsha yod pa 'di la phan pa'i gnas tshul gsos pa gtam bzang ga re shod rgyu yod dam snyam pa'i skad cha nyan skabs bod du gnyen 'phrad 'gro mkhan des so so'i nang mi'i skor ma gtogs gang yang shod rgyu med pa dang / yang na so so sdod sa'i gzhis sgar de'i gnas tshul tsam las shod rgyu med pa chags skusang dus bod nang lhag bsam sku(da mkhan gyi mi rnams sems shugs chag rgyu dang / sha tsha yod mkhan gyi dga' nye blo dkar zhig yin na yang dngos gnas blo pham skyed gzhi chags pa red/ dus rgyun gtan nas do snang byas te nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs gang 'dra yod pa dang / chab srid kyi lam lugs mang gtso'i sgang la 'gro stangs de tsho shes pa byed rgyu gal chen po red/ de la tshang mas do snang byed dgos/ ngos nas bskyar zlos byed dgos pa mi 'dug ste/ da lta phan chad nga rang tsho'i 'das pa'i lo rgyun de'i ring la 488
