bod mi zhes lab dus mdzub mo btsugs sa yod pa de spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di la brten nas phan thogs chen po byung mo da/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di la mi mang gis brtsi bkur dang rgyab skyor shugs ston bya rgyu gal chen po chags bsdad yod/ yang spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs thog nas mi mang gi lhag bsam dang / snying stobs yod pa de bed spyod byed sa'i lam phyogs su kha lo bsgyur te thabs shes zung 'brel thog nas phan thogs chen po yong gi yod pa red༄/ nga tshor spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs yod pa gzhis lus bod mis kyang shes pa byas/ de la brtsi bkur dang rgyab skyor byed rgyu gal chen po red/bar lam 1979 lo nas bzung rgya mi dang / nga tsho phar tshur 'brel ba 'go tshugs pa red/ da lta phan chad la nga tsho phar tshur 'brel ba mu mthud nas bsdad yod/ da dung yin na'ang 'bre la ba mu mthud de byed thub pa'i re ba rgyag gi yod/ rgya gzhung ngos nas kyang de 'dra'i bsam tshul yod pa red/ma 'ongs par 'brel ba mu mthud pa'i thog nas dus tshod ngang sgug gis rgya dang bod gnyis kyi phan tshun yid ches dang / phan tshun gyi bsam blo'i thod ngags yag tu phyin pa yin na/ 'dzam bu gling spyi'i 'gyur 'gros dang / nga rang tsho bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang gi lhag bsam dang / snying stobs kyi gnas tshul thog nas ri ma pas rim pas gnas tshul 'gyur ba 'gro rgyur re ba sku(da pa red/ yin na'ang lam seng lam seng lo gcig gnyis nang la 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi red bsam pa'i nga tshos tshod dpag dang / re ba byed rgyu med/ don dag chung chung ma red/ don dag chen po red/ dper na nga rang tsho phan tshun 'grigs 'jags 489

byed rgyu 'di dag las sla po med/ da lta bar du bod nang la stod bcud gnyis kur nyams tshabs ci che byu nga ba'i rjes la don dag chung chung zhig gi khe bzang la nga tsho yid tshim pa dang / blo kha khengs pa yong thabs med/ de 'dra byas pas la dag gi ma red/ yang sdig pa mig btsums kyis mi dang mi'i 'brel ba ma byas par rgyab sprod byas te bsdad pa yin na'ang rgya mi stobs shugs chen po red/ nga rang tsho sa ya drug dang / rgya mi sa ya stong phrag gcig red/ 'dzam bu gling 'aci'i sgang gi rgyal khab mang po zhig gis chab srid kyi khe phan dang / dpal 'byor gyi khe phan thog nas rgya mir 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i thog la sha tsha yod na' nga dngos su rgyab skyor byed nus kyi med pa red/dngos yod gnas tshul 'di dag nga tshos khyad gsod byed thabs med/ 'di yang nga tshos shes dgos pa red/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir mi dang / mi'i 'brel ba mu mthud byed rgyu las thag gcod byed rgyu'i dus tshod la slebs yog ma re da/nga tshos ngang sgug byas te bsam blo gtong dgos pa chags kyi 'dug ma 'ongs par rgya dang bod kyi rtsod pa'i thog la rmang gzhi'i bsam blo gtong sa zhig la kha sang ngas mi ri /ra yod pa'i skabs la don tshan lnga zhig bshad pa red/ bod kyi sa khul rnams 'tshe ba med pa'i zhi bde'i bsti gnas shig dgos pa dang / de'i gnas tshul thog nas rgya dmag phyir 'then dgos pa/ bod kyi sa cha'i sgang la rgya mi gzhis chags 21na chen po zhig slebs dang slebs bzhin pa de tsho'i gras ma yong ba/ bod nang la 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang brdal bzhig gtong gi yod pa dang / brtsi med rdog ro la gyi gnas tshul mang po zhig yong gi yod 490

pa de tsho mtshams 'jog byed dgos pa/ bod lung pa'i rang bzhin snod kyi bkod pa gtsang ma yag po yod pa de tsho'i gras nyams chag mi 'gro ba/ don tshan lnga pa rgya bod gnyis mu mthud de 'brel ba byed dgos pa bcas/ don tshan lnga'i bsam tshul bshad pa red/ de la rgya nag gzhung gis dwang len dang / bsam blo gtong gi med pa'i mkhregs po'i rnam 'gyur bstan gyi yod kyang / rgya nag gzhung dang 'brel ba da lta mu mthud de bsdad yod/ rgya mi'i ngos nas gu bshangs kyi bsam blo ji tsam gtong gi yod med tshod thig pa med na yang / nga rang tsho'i ngos nas ma lan ma 'gyod pa'i thabs shes byas pa yin na yag po min nam snyam pa dran yong gi 'dug rtsa ba bod mi mang la rang dbang dgos pa ni lo rgyus thog nas nga rang tshor thob thang yod pa zhig red/ de yang lo rgyus thog nas dngos su nga tshos longs su spyad myong ba zhig chags bsdad yod/ bar lam rgya bod mchod yon gyi 'brel ba zer ba'i thog nas bod nang man ju'i dbang shugs gang la gang 'tshams bed spyod byed pa'i skabs la'ang nga rang tsho bod pa'i ngos nas lta stangs rgya dang / bod ces tha dad so so yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ bod rgya nag gi cha shas yin pa ngos 'dzin nam yang byas sku(da pa ma red/ rgya mis btsan po dbang yod btang ba de ni gnas tshul khag khag red/ bod pa'i ngos nas dwang du blangs te rgya mi'i rjes su rgyug gi yin zer mkhan rtsa ba nas yong gi med/ nga rang tshor rang btsan gyi thob thang yod pa red/ bod rgya mi'i dbang bsgyur 'og la tshud nas nga tsho bod par khe phan gang byung yod dam zer na/ lam bzo dang / bzo grwa re zung / sman khang / slob grwa bcas ming 491

tsam zhig gi thog nas bstan rgyu yod na'ang / tshur gtor bshigs btang ba de gnyis yang lci bsdur ba yin na do thabs med pa gsal po red/ bod la rgya mi slebs pa'i rjes su gtor bshigs tshad med byas pa'i gnas tshul des rkyen pas bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang / mdor na byis pa tshun chad/ rgya mis dbang bsgyur byas tshar ba'i rjes la skyes pa'i phru gu de rnams kyi rang bzhin bsam blo'i nang༄ la rgya dang bod zer ba tha dad so so yin pa rang gis ngang gi skye yong mkhan zhig dang / dper na rgya mi'i las khungs nang la yod pa'i las byed pa phan tshun yin yang rung / dmag mi'i nang la yin yang rung / slob gra'i nang la yin yang rung / mdor na btson khang zhig nang la yin rung rgya mici btson pa dang / bod pa'i btson pa zer ba tha dad so so yin pa'i bag chags mthug po yod pa shin tu gsal po 'dug de 'dra'i dngos yod kyi gnas tshul thog nas bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams rgya mi'i 'og la sdod 'dod med pa chags bsdad yod/ 'di nas rgyas bshad byed ma dgos par bod nang gi bar lam gnas tshul ngo ma'i thog nas 'dzam bu gling yongs grags mig gis mthong rgyu yod pa dang yid ches 'pher ba byung yod pa red/ rtsa ba nga rang tshor rang btsan gyi thob thang yod pa zhig red la/ dgos pa yang red/ 'on kyang rgya mi'i bsam blo gtong stangs dang / byed stangs la gzhigs na nga tshor lam seng rang btsan thob rgyu khag po red/ nga rang tsho'i ngos nas snying stobs chen por gnas dgos/sngon la ma lan ma 'a11da pa'i thabs shes kyis skad cha byas na bsam pa'i nga'i bsam tshul 'di 'dra zhig red/ de yang lam seng 'tshab 'tshub kyis thag gcod 492

byed thub kyi ma red la/ byas pas la yang dag gi ma red/ ngas nam rgyun rtag tu shod bzhin pa ltar nga rang tsho'i don gyi bdag po de bod rgya che'i mi mang red/ lhag don bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de rnams nga tsho'i don gyi bdag po ngo ma yin/ da lta mtha' ma'i thag gcod byed rgyu'i dus tshod la slebs med/ thag gcod byed dgos pa'i dus tshod cig la slebs pa yin na sngon la nga rang tshos bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tsho la dngos su 'brel ba byed rgyu'i thabs shes rgya che tsam byed thub pa'i 'bad brtson byas na yong srid kyi red/ sngon la nga rang tsho btsan byol la yod pa'i bod mi tsho bod mi mang gi cha shas shig yin dus go bsdur zhib phra byas/ de nas rim pas rim pas bsam blo gtong rgyu red/ da lta ma lan ma 'gyod pa'i ched rgya dang bod gnyis 'grigs 'jags yong ba'i lan dgu chad mthud kyi dpe bzhin thabs shes byas pa yin na 'gal ba mi 'dug snyam pa'i nga'i bsam tshul de red/ de nas bka' blon gyi ne/sung bshad nang la the wan skor zhib phra byung song / yin na'ang ngas gsal bshad cig byas na bsam gyi 'dug the'i bon skor la cha bzhag na nga rang tsho'i bod rigs nang nas khag gcig gis the wan la chos phyogs kyi 'brel ba ma gtogs gzhan dag gang yang med ces zer nas 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa red /rtsa ba chos kho na'i ྅geg nas 'brel ba byas pa zhig yin na 'grigs pa red/ yin na'i nga rang tshos de snga 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong thog nas bsam blo zhig btang ba yin na gzab gzab byed dgos pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ da gin lab pa bzhin rgya dang bod zer ba tha dad so so red/ rgya bod mchod yon gyi 493

byed thub kyi ma red la/ byas pas la yang dag gi ma red/ ngas nam rgyun rtag tu shod bzhin pa ltar nga rang tsho'i don gyi bdag po de bod rgya che'i mi mang red/ lhag don bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de rnams nga tsho'i don gyi bdag po ngo ma yin/ da lta mtha' ma'i thag gcod byed rgyu'i dus tshod la slebs med/ thag gcod byed dgos pa'i dus tshod cig la slebs pa yin na sngon la nga rang tshos bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tsho la dngos su 'brel ba byed rgyu'i thabs shes rgya che tsam byed thub pa'i 'bad brtson byas na yong srid kyi red/ sngon la nga rang tsho btsan byol la yod pa'i bod mi tsho bod mi mang gi cha shas shig yin dus go bsdur zhib phra byas/ de nas rim pas rim pas bsam blo gtong rgyu red/ da lta ma lan ma 'gyod pa'i ched rgya dang bod gnyis 'grigs 'jags yong ba'i lan dgu chad mthud kyi dpe bzhin thabs shes byas pa yin na 'gal ba mi 'dug snyam pa'i nga'i bsam tshul de red/ de nas bka' blon gyi ne/sung bshad nang la the wan skor zhib phra byung song / yin na'ang ngas gsal bshad cig byas na bsam gyi 'dug the'i bon skor la cha bzhag na nga rang tsho'i bod rigs nang nas khag gcig gis the wan la chos phyogs kyi 'brel ba ma gtogs gzhan dag gang yang med ces zer nas 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa red /rtsa ba chos kho na'i ྅geg nas 'brel ba byas pa zhig yin na 'grigs pa red/ yin na'i nga rang tshos de snga 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong thog nas bsam blo zhig btang ba yin na gzab gzab byed dgos pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ da gin lab pa bzhin rgya dang bod zer ba tha dad so so red/ rgya bod mchod yon gyi 493

'brel ba zhig red ma gtogs gzhan dag gang yang ma red/ yin na'i deng sang rgya mis ྅/da rgya khongs yin pa'i sgrub byed mtha' gtugs sa de mchod yon gyi 'brel bar bsnyad de shod kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pas snang ba dag nas man ju'i gong mar cha bzhag na/ stobs chen rgyal khab cig gi rgyal spro yin pa tsam du ma zad/ chos kyi thog nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin zer nas dad pa'i sems thag nye po dang / gong mar gang la gang 'tshams kyi brtsi bkur byas yod/ yin na'ang don dngos po'i thog rgya nag gong ma'i chab 'bangs sam/ mi ser lta bu yin bsam pa'i bsam tshul yod pa ma red/ nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas chos phyogs kyi 'brel ba dang / py-i mi'i ngos nas dpon g.yog gi 'brel ba zhes gleng rtsod byed kyi yod/ the ldan gyi gnas tshul 'di de tsam gyi chen po min na yang / yong stangs de ni nga tsho bod pa'i ngos na sa chos phyogs kyi don das/ yang na lung pa'i don dag de min dngul phran bu'i don du phar 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa red/ tshur bod rgya khongs yin pa'i blta stangs thog nas yul gyar phyin pa'i krung go'i phyi sdod rang mi mes rgyal du 'tshams 'dri byed par yong ba red bsam pa dang / go ming tang gzhung la phyag 'bul zhu bar yong ba red bsam pa'i bed spyod byas yong gi 'dug nga 'o re ngos nas chos phyogs kyi rgyu mtshan thog nas 'brel ba byas pa der phar phyogs nas chab srid kyi 'brel ba'i thog bed spyod byed kyi yod pa yin dus gzab gzab byed dgos kyi 'dug ces brjod dgos don de yin/ sngar phan bod kyi lo rgyus nang la sna khung 'tshigs myong ba yin tsang da cha bskyar du sna khung 'tshigs 494

gin bsdad na dgos pa gang yang mi 'dug de 'dra yin dus gzab gzab byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug mi dang mi'i 'brel ba zer mkhan de go ming tang phar bzhag gung khran la yin na'ang mi dang mi 'brel ba mthud kyi yod pa red/mi dang mi'i 'brel ba mthud pa de mgo btags pa gang yang ma red/ 'brel ba bzo dgos pa red/ yin na yang gzab gzab ma byas na mgo 'khor thebs rgyu'i nyen kha med pa ma red/nga sto nam rgyun rtag par skad cha yong bzhin pa ltar rgya bod gnyis kyi 'thab rtsod de'i nang la nga tsho'i stobs shugs ni drang bden de red/ bden pa zer mkhan de la dngos gnas drang gnas kyi nus pa zhig yod/ ngang bsrings yong dus bden pa zer ba de la nus pa zhig thon rgyu yod pa red/ nga rang tsho lnga bcu nga grangs nas bzung rgya mi'i dpung stobs drag shugs kyis go mtshon med mkhan bod mnan pa red de/ yin na'ang bden pa bsub thub thabs med par bsdad yod/ sngon ma lnga bcu nga dgu'i nang dang / drug cu'i nang la bod par sha tsha yod mkhan/ bod par snying nye po yod mkhan nga tshor phan grogs kyi las ka byed mkhan rgya gar ba 〉lha sa lags de tshos gang drag bod pa'i gnas tshul de khag mi 'dug kyang / da tshar ba red/ byed thabs gang yang yod pa ma red ces shod mkhan byung / hob ste bltas na/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'dra po chags yod na yang / de dus ngas shod rgyu byung / nga tshor dngos gnas drang gnas bden pa yod/ mi'i sems shugs zer mkhan de yod pa yin na bden pa'i mtha' gsal gyi red/ rgya mis bod 'khyur mid btang na yang 'ju thub med/495

yang na yar skyug dgos kyi red/ yang na mar bshal dgos kyi red/ skyug bshal gang rung zhig byed dgos kyi red ces ngas sngon ma nas bshad yod/ da cha lo nyi shu rtsa dgu phyin/ lo sum cu skor phyin pa'i skabs la bod don yal rgyu par bzhag ste da dung bod don gsos pa lta bu chags pa red/ de chags pa'i rtsa ba gang yin zer na/ bden pa'i gnad don la brten nas byung ba ma gtogs/nga tsho bod par gri me mda'i stobs shugs thog nas byung ba zhig ma red/ bod don 'dis rgya nag gzhung la rtag tu zhe bsun yong ba 'di yang nga tsho'i bden pa'i gnas tshul 'dis byung ba red/ nga rang tshos rgya mir rtsod pa rgyag rgyu'i rgyu mtshan de red/ nga tshos rgya mir lkog lab rgyab ma dgos par rgya mi'i mdun la skad cha bshad pa yin na nga tshor rgyu mtshan shod rgyu yod pa red/ rgya mi ngo tsha dgos pa zhig dang / rgya mi'i gdong dmar po bstan dgos pa zhig bzo thub pa'i bden pa nga tshor yod/ gal te nga rang tsho bod pa'i ngos nas go mtshon bed spyod kyis rgya mir phar rgol byas pa yin na rgya mis dga' zhing spro bzhin du rang srung gi ming btags nas rtsa med shul med bzo rgyu las sla po red/ nga tsho'i blo gdengs 'cha' sa'i bden pa de'i thog nas mi dang mi gtugs nas rgyu mtshan gsal bshad byas/ rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas stugs bsrings byed rgyu nga cho'i stobs shugs yin bsam 'dug da lta phan chad bod par sha tsha byed mkhan rigs gcig gis bod pas zhi bde'i lam la 'gro gi 'dug 'di dngos gnas yas po red ces rgyab skyor byed kyi yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la rang dbang 'thab rtsod byed mkhan gyi mi rigs 'dra mi 'dra mang po yod pa red/ mang po 496

zhig gis drag po'i go mtshan bed spyod byas te 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod/ de dag la re zhig phan cha srid pa yin na'ang / phugs nas mi'i sha tsha slebs thub pa khag po red/ bod pa'i gnas tshul de dngos gnas drang gnas bden pa'i rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / 'tshe ba med pa'i zhi ba'i lam kho nar bsten nas rang dbang 'thab rtsod byed pa de ni shin tu ngo mtshar chen po red zer nas bod par rgyab skyor dang / dga' po byed kyi 'dug nga rang tsho'i rtsa ba'i stobs shugs brten sa de bden pa dang / rgyu mtshan zer ba de red bsam pa thog mtha' bar gsum la dran gyi yod/ gnyis nas kha seng dang mdang dgong skad cha shod rgyu byung / nga tshos bden pa'i rgyu mtshan thog nas rtsod pa rgyag rgyu de nga rang tsho bod pa'i dngos yod gnas tshul la ran pa tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la nga tshos mig dpe dang thabs jus gsar gtod cig chags kyi yod/ da lta phan chad 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la phar tsam der gnam gru btsan 'khrid byas song zer ba dang / tshur tsam der 'bom 'bar gas byung 'dug zer ba'i gnas tshulayong dus do snang byed kyi yod pa'i bzo 'dra po dang / de 'dra'i gnas tshul ma byung na do snang mi byed pa'i bzo 'dra zhig yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i cha nas nga rang tsho bod rigs nang khungs la yang rigs gcig gis 7rgyal ba rin po che nas 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam gsungs pa de la nus pa gang yang thon gyi mi 'dug zing tsam zing tsam zhig ma byas na 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces shod mkhan yong gi 'dug zang nge zing nge zhig ma byas na khyab bsgrags yong gi med pa dang / khyab bsgrags ma byung na do snang yong gi med pa'i rgyu mtshan de'i ngos 497

nas bltas na/ phran bu phran bu'i zang nge zing nge yong dgos mkhan 'dra po zhig chags kyi yod na yang / nga tshos spyi yongs kyi phyogs nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ mi zer mkhan de la rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi mi gsod khrag sbyor byed rgyur mi dga' ba dang / mi mang po bsad rmas phyin pa go na sems nang la ma bde ba zhig yong gi yod pa red/ mi'i rang gshis la 'tshe ba med pa der dga' mos yod pa zhig dang / mi gsod khrag sbyor byed rgyur mi dga' ba rang bzhin lhan skyes la yod bzhin du mi gsod khrag sbyor byung na do snang byed pa dang / de 'dra'i dza drag gnas tshul ma byung na do snang mi byed pa de ni mi spyod las 'das pa'i byas nyes la don gyi rgyab lha ra byed pa lta bu zhig chags kyi 'dug ces ngas shod kyi yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la dngos gnas drang gnas 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi rang rang so so'i thob thang rtsod len byed pa'i skabs bden pa dang rgyu mtshan gyi thabs lam thog nas snyu da len byed pa de la rgyal kha thob dgos kyi red bsam gyi 'dug zhi ba dang bden par rgyal kha thob pa yin na dper na deng sang de 'dra'i thabs lam nas rtsod len byed mkhan nga tsho bod pa yin na yang / shugs kyis 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la de 'dra'i lam srol zhig gsar gtod chags yong gi red/ mi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bsam blo'i nang la dga' po med pa'i mi gasdudad khrag ྅tshor byed ma dgos par/ thabs shes gzhan zhig thog nas mi'i rang dbang khod ma snyoms pa de rtsod len byed thub pa'i lam srol gtod thub na/ nga tsho bod pa'i gzi brjid red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la da lta phan chad ma byung ba zhig bod pas srol gtod thub na de nga tsho'i 498

rgyal kha red/ nga tshos mtha' gcig tu 'tshe ba med pa'i lam la brten nas rang dbang rtsod len byed pa de ni spyi'i cha nas bshad pa yin yang rung / nga tsho bod kyi phyogs nas bshad pa yin yang rung / de la phugs rgyang ring po'i cha nas khe phan dang dge mtshan yod pa red/ rgya bod kyi rtsod pa rgyag rgyu de yang mtha' gcig tu 'tshe ba med pa zhi bde'i lam gyi thog nas phyin pa yin na 'phral phugs kun la dge mtshan yod pa zhig red/ rgya bod rtsod pa'i skor la bod rigs nang khungs nas rigs gcig gis phyed ka dad pa dang / lhag bsam yin pa lta bus ga re shod kyi yod dam zer na 7rgyal ba rin po che yod pa'i ring la nga tsho'i bden mtha' zhig gsal ba yin na gsal ba red ma gtogs 7rgyal ba rin po che med pa shar song na bod don gyi rtsod pa 'am/ re ba mtha' dag brlag rgyu red zer mkhan 'ga' shas yong gi 'dug bsam chob de shin tu nor 'khrul red/ ma gzhi lo bcu/ bco lnga'i nang la 'gyur ba bzang po yong rgyu'i re ba yod pa dang / nga tsho gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms yong gi red ces ngas thengs 'ga' shod rgyu byung na yang / nga tshos sdug sa nas bsam blo btang ba yin na ci ste nges med nga tsho'i mi thog 'dir don 'bras ma son na yang / gnas tshul 'di mi rigs gcig gi rtsa sngasan yin pas nga tshos mi rabs nas mi rabs sbrel te so so'i rang dbang rtsod len byed dgos pa'i bsam blo dang gra sgrig dgos pa las/ de rgyal ba rin po che yod med kyi skad cha min/ rtsa don de shin tu gal chen po yin/ ma gzhi bod nang deng sang dngos yod gnas tshul la/ phyi no chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu'i nang dang / drug cu'i nang la bod kyi bden don 499

thog so so'i lus srog longs spyod blos btang ste dka' las rgyag mkhan gyi mi thog de rdzogs 'gro gi yod pa dang / nga tsho btsan byol ba'i nang cha bzhag na'ang deng sang lnga bcu nga dgu'i gong gi gnas tshul shod rgyu yod pa'i mi nyung nyung chags yong gi 'dug lhag par du bod nang la rgya mi'i gdug rtsub mnar gcod 'og mi rgan pa phal cher rdzogs te mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod na yang / snga lo lha sar rgya mir zhi rgol byas pa'i gnas tshul yongs stangs la blta dus bod mi rgan pa rdzogs pa'i mjug tu mi thog gzhon pa tshos mthud ka rgyab pa nang bzhin las 'gan blangs yod/ mi thog rgan pa'i las 'gan gzhon pa tshor rtsis sprod mkhan med na yang / don gyi las 'gan blangs pa des dngos gnas drang gnas mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod yin pa'i rnam pa gsal 1— 5na pa red/ mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod zer ba 'di 'dra zhig dgos kyi yod pa red la yong gi yang yod pa red/ rgya bod dbar gyi rtsod pa 'di nga rang tsho'i mi thog 'di la 'grub na 'grub pa dang /de min thabs shes med pa lta bu'i bsam blo btang na nor ba red/ de 'dra ma red/ nga tsho'i mi thog rgan pa rdzogs kyin rdzogs kyin la mi thog gzhon pa 'tshar longs byed mkhan tshos 'gan khur mu mthud de blang thub pa'i bsam blo'i nang la go sgrig byed dgos/ da lta 'dir yod pa'i gzhon skyes pho gsar mo gsar khyed rang tsho'i skyes sa gcig byas na rgya gar la skyes pa yin 'gro/ bod lung pa da phan mthong myong med pa red/ yin na'i bod pa'i sha khrag rus pa nas mched pa'i bod pa zhig yin dus gang ltar bod kyi mi thog rgan pa rnams nas don dag ga 'dra zhig gi thog la dka' las rgyab pa dang / ngon dag ga re'i thog la so 500

so'i lung pa blos btang ba mdor na lus srog longs spyod blos btang gi ngal ba dwang len byas pa'i dmigs yul de mi thog gzhon pa khyed rang tshos ngos 'dzin gsal po byas nas mjug skyong byed dgos pa gal chen po red/ da dung de'i rjes la yong rgyu'i gsar skyes phru gu byis pa tshun chad la rim pas rim pas nga tsho bod pa zer ba ji 'dra zhig yin pa dang / nga rang tsho bod kyi bden don rtsod len de ji ltar byed dgos pa'i lam ston zhig mi thog gzhon pa tsho'i bsam blo'i nang la thog ma nas 'khor thub pa'i bslab bya gung sgrig dgos kyi 'dug nga da lta lo lnga bcu nga grangs shig yin pa red/ da dung lo sum cu so grangs shig nga rang tsho mnyam por bsdad nas dka' las rgyab thub pa zhig yin pa red/ngas rnam rtog blangs te bshad pa min na yang nga dza(re bsam blo'i nang la nges par du gung sgrig dgos kyi 'dug shes song ngam/ bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang rnams rgyal zhen gyi sems shugs 'gran bla bral ba yod/ rgya mis btson la bcug rgyu dang / srog la nyen kha yod pa tshod thig gin thig gin la da dung dwang du blangs te dka' las rgyag gi yod pa red/ nga tsho 'dir rang dbang lung par yod mkhan tshor de 'dra'i srog gi nyen kha med/ da lta phan chad la tshang mas hur thag byas pa ltar da dung yin na yang bod nang gi gnas tshul de rnams kyis rang rang so so'i sems la skul lcag btang ste bod spyi pa'i don dag la tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs kyi sems khur blang dgos pa de ni shin tu gal chen po red/ hur thag 'bad brtson byed rogs/ bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che/ zhes bka' 455// //501

༄༅// phyi lo 1988 zla 6 tshes 26 nyin sud sir bod rigs mang tshogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/slob phrug tshor dmigs bsal brjod rgyu la/ khyed rang tsho mi'i mi tshe gsar pa'i 'go gzhi nas tshugs yong gi yod pa red/ mi tshe'i nang la gal che shos ni bsam blo gtong rgyu'i nus pa zhig yod dgos/ bsam blo'i nus pa ji tsam che ba de tsam gyis chos dang / 'jig rten gang gi thog la yang thabs shes zab pa zhig dang / rlabs che ba byed thub kyi yod pa red/ de yong ba'i lde mig lta bu de slob sbyong yin pas de la do khur byas te so so'i mdun lam gal che shos yin bsam pa'i sgo nas slob sbyong la hur bskyed byed dgos/ phru gu'i shes yon gyi jog la 'gan gcig dge rgan tshor 'khri yod pa dang / khag gcig pha ma tshor 'khri gi yod/ phru gu tshos 'dzin gra'i nang la shes yon gsar pa zhig bslab kyi yod na yang / shes yon de sems nang la gting phyin pa zhig 'jags thub pa'i don dag la slob sbyong tshar gcig byas pas mi chog par de la goms 'dris byed dgos pa dang / rang sbyong mgatsam byed dgos pa dge rgan dang /pha ma tshos zhar dang zhor la shes yon gal chen po yin pa'i go brda yang yang sprad de phru gu so so'i sems kyi nang nas do khur slebs pa zhig byung ba yin na/slob sbyong la khral gyi 'du shes ma bzhag par do snang brtson 'grus byed rgyur phan gyi red/ ma gzhi rang lta nga rang tsho tshang ma phru gu byas nas yong ba sha stag red/gang ltar ga tshod thub thub shes yon gal chen po yin pa'i ngo sprod byed dgos kyi 'dug mi la shes yon yod kyang mi bsam pa ngan po zhig chags pa yin 502

na shes yon yod pa las med na legs pa lta bu red/ bsam ngan ma rung khog bcug gi mis shes yon de dag gzhan la brdabs gsigs gtong rgyu dang / mi la mgo bskor gtong rgyu'i cha rkyen du phyin pa yin na ha cang thabs sdug chags pa red/ sman dug la phyin pa dang / lha bdud du babs pa lta bu rang gzhan gnyis phung chags pa red/ rtsa ba'i mi'i lhag bsam dang / mi'i gshis ka bzang po yong thabs la 'bad rtsol byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug phru gu'i ngos nas bsam blo gtong thub rgyu khag po red/ dge rgan tsho dang / pha ma/ rogs pa tsho'i jo ga nas bslab bya byed rgyu gal chen po red/ gang ltar she sa yon sbyong ba'i dgos pa bde skyid kyi don dag dang / yar rgyas kyi don dag la shes yon sbyang gi yod pa red/ dmigs yul bde skyid kyi don dag yin stabs bde skyid yag po yong ba la mi bzang po zhig dgos pa red/ mi bzang po zhig byung na bde skyid tan tan yong gi red/ mi ngan pa zhig byas pa yin na mi 'jon po dang rgod po ga tshad yod kyang bde skyid yong thabs med/ mi ngo kog byed mkhan dang / ngo tsha khrel med byed mkhan yin na sems nang la ma bde ba zhig dang / ma skyid pa zhig yong gi red/ lhag don nga rang tsho bod pa'i spyi tshogs 'di'i nang la chos kyi skad cha zhig ga dus yin kyang go thos yong gi yod par brten /so so'i mi tshe ma rabs shig gi sgang la bskyal ba yin na ga re byas kyang sems kyi nang ma bde ba zhig dang / ngo gnong dgos pa/ mi tshe'i mtha' mar slebs skabs 'gyod pa chen po skyes pa zhig yong gi red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi cha nas shes yon yar rgyas gtong ba dang chabs cig bsam blo yar rgyas gtong 503

ba dang / mi'i gshis ka yag po yong thabs bya rgyu ha cang gal chen sngo rdod/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang spyir btang cha snyoms byas nas bshad pa yin na/shes yon gyis phongs med kyang mi'i rang gshis bzang po byed pa dang / mi'i lhag bsam bzang po byed pa de tsho'i cha nas ma ldang pa'i rkyen gyis dka' ngal 'phrad kyi yod pa red/ gnyis nas nga rang tshorwa 1da pa'i phru gu tsho so so'i lung pa bral nas mi'i lung par gyar bsdad pa'i dus stod zhig red/ bod nang la cha bzhag na/ bod rgya che'i mi mang mi thog rgan pa tsho'i las ku'i 'phro mi thog gzhon pa tshos skyel yong gi yod pa red/ dper na/ bzhi bcu zhe dgu dang /lnga bcu nga grangs nang sa mtshams khag la rgya mi dang 'khrug pa rgyag pa'i dus tshod byung yod pa red/ de dus kyi mi thog de dag drug cu re grangs/ bdun cu don grangs 'di'i nang la rdzogs 'gro gi yod pa red/ yang lnga bcu nga dgu'i yas mas la dka' las rgyag mkhan gyi mi de dag kyang deng sang rdzogs 'gro gi yod pa red/ mi thog rgan pa'i gnas skabs la yag nyes gang yin kyang nyams myong mang po bsags/ las ka 'phro can du lhag bsdad pa 'di dag mi thog gzhon pa tshos mu mthud mjug skyong byed kyi yod pa red/ dper na/ bar skabs bod nang skad 'bod byed mkhan gtso bo gzhon pa lo nyi shu rtsa lnga man dang / lo bcu grangs de 'dra'i thog nas byed kyi yod pa red/ bod nang gi mi de dag rgya mi'i mnar gcod gdug rtsub de'i 'og la gnya' ma chag par rgan pa'i mjug mthud nas yong gi yod pa red/ nga tsho gzhan yul rang dbang lung par yong mkhan tshos de de bzhin byas te rgan pa'i mjug gzhon pas mthud dgos pa zhig 504

dang / rgan pa'i mi thog 'di'i skabs la ma 'grub pa de dag gzhon pa'i mi thog 'dis bsgruba.e thub mi thub blta dgos pa zhig chags kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho'i rtsa ba'i bod mi rigs kyi las 'gan de bod pa'i mis 'khyer dgos pa ma gtogs/ bod pa'i las 'gan phyi rgyal mis 'khyer thub kyi ma red/ phyi rgyal mi mang po zhig gis nga tsho bod mi'i don dag la sha tsha dang / do snang byed kyi yod pa ni yag po red/ bod mi rigs kyi rtsa don las ka 'gangs chen po 'di mi thog gcig gis sgrub pas mi 'grigs par mi jog nas mi thog sbrel te sgrub dgos par brten/ mi thog gzhon skyes 'di dag gi mjing pa'i sgang la 'gan khur zhig slebs kyi yod/ las don byed pa la phyogs gcig nas bodapa'i gnas tshul shes dgos/ phyogs gcig nas sems shugs yod dgos/ sems shugs yong ba la gang gi don du dka' las rgyag sa'i don dag de shes dgos/ dper na/ bod dang / rgya'i lo rgyus gang 'dra yin pa dang / bod du rgya mi gang 'dra byas nas slebs pa/ bod la chos dang rig gzhung gang 'dra zhig yod pa/ bod mi rigs kyi gshis ka gang 'dra yod pa/ bod lung pa'i stod kyi bkod pa gang 'dra yod pa/ bod kyi spyi tshogs nang legs pa'i cha gang yod pa/ skyon gyi cha gang dang gang yod pa tshang ma shes dgos/ rgyu mtshan shes pa'i jog nas lhag bsam dang sems shugs bskyed dgos/ yang lhag bsam dang sems shugs yod pa tsam gyis mi 'grigs par/ las ka byed thub pa dang / nus pa thon grub dgos kyi yod pa red/ deng sang nga tsho'i bod kyi chab srid rang dbang gi 'thab rtsod dang / bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi 'thab rtsod byed pa de 'dzam 505

bu gling 'di'i sgang la khyab gdal du phyin yod/ 'dzam gling thog 'thab rtsod byed pa la/ 'dzam gling spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs kyi shes yon zhig dang / spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs kyi nus pa zhig ma thon na lhag bsam yod pa gcig pus la dag gi yod pa ma red/ khyed rang bod phrug tsho bod mi rigs kyi las mjug bskyel mkhan zhig yin pa'i cha nas deng dus kyi shes yon dang / bod kyi shes yon gnyis po de zung du 'brel ba'i jog nas slob sbyong byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ da gin las bsdoms nang la bshad pa de tsho yag po red/ so so'i skad yig goms gshis de 'dra'i thog la do snang byed kyi yod pa yag po byung 'dug phyi rgyal la gzhis chags nas bsdad mkhan bod pa'i phru gu bo da pa'i shes yon yag po zhig sbyang rgyu'i don dag la thabs shes gang 'dra byed dgos kyi 'dug ces lo mang sngon nas skad cha rtag par yong gi yod pa red/ rtsa ba'i slob gra'i slob sbyongayod mus thog la zhar zhor go skabs nam byung la slob sbyong sprod thabs byas par khyed tsho phru gu'i ngos nas bsun snang bskyed gzhi 'dra po byung yod kyang /da lta yig tshad de tshor blta dus yag thag chod 'dug khyed rang phru gu tshos hur thag byas par ha cang dga' po byung / thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ de bzhin bod yig bslab mkhan tshos kyang so so'i dus stod mang po zhig gu bshangs byas te bod mi rigs la phan pa byung na bsams pa'i thog nas so sos gang yong ci yong gi nus pa bton nas 'bad brtson byas pa de dag shin tu yag po byung 'dug pas thugs rje che zer gyi yin/sngon ma dang mi 'dra bar deng sang bod pa'i phru gu tsam du ma zad/ phyi 506

rgyal gyi grogs po nang pa yin pa/ de tsho'i nang nas nga la 'di 'dra zer mkhan byung / phru gu 'di'i pha ma gnyis nang pa yin/ phru gu 'di phyin chad nang pa smug po zhig byung rogs byas na snyam pas smon lam gnang rogs/ thabs shes gang legs pa yod dam zer mkhan byung / 'ga' zhig gis phru gu chung chung de 'dra gra pa bzos te rgya gar la dgon pa'i nang la.u tshugs byas nas bzhag gi 'dugade tsho'i gras nyen ka red/ gang yin zer na/ pha ma'i ngos nas phru gu rgya gar nang dgon pa de 'drar bzhag nas dpe cha blta ru bcug pa de mtha' 'khyongs mjug 'khyol byung ba yin na mdun lam zhig yong gi red/ yag po red/ gal srid mjug la de khungs ma 'khyol na/ spyir btang phru gu spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs gzhi rim gyi slob sbyong byed pa'i dus stod de'i ring der dgon pa zhig gi nang la bsdad/ bod skad dang / bod yig zhig bslabs/ nang pa'i chos phran bu bslabs pa de mthar ma 'khyol bar/ des chos dang bod skad bslabs pa de 'i jog nas mi tshe 'khyol ma thub pa chags na phru gur dka' ngal chen po 'phrad nyen yod/ pha mar 'gyod pa ma skyes kyang / phru gu'i bsam blor pha mas drin chung btang 'dug bsam pa de 'dra yong ba'i nyen ka yod/nga rang sto ga le ga ler pha ma nang pa yin mkhan phyi rgyal grogs po mang po yod pa tsho dang / go bsdur byas te mtho rim slob sbyong spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs su 'gro rgyu dang / dma' rim gyi slob sbyong byed sa nang chos slob gra zer ba lta bu de 'dra btsugs chog gi yod dam med/ de 'dra'i slob gra btsugs chog gi yod na bod pa'i phru gu gcig pu'i don dag ma yin par/ phyi rgyal ba nang chos 507

rgyal gyi grogs po nang pa yin pa/ de tsho'i nang nas nga la 'di 'dra zer mkhan byung / phru gu 'di'i pha ma gnyis nang pa yin/ phru gu 'di phyin chad nang pa smug po zhig byung rogs byas na snyam pas smon lam gnang rogs/ thabs shes gang legs pa yod dam zer mkhan byung / 'ga' zhig gis phru gu chung chung de 'dra gra pa bzos te rgya gar la dgon pa'i nang la.u tshugs byas nas bzhag gi 'dugade tsho'i gras nyen ka red/ gang yin zer na/ pha ma'i ngos nas phru gu rgya gar nang dgon pa de 'drar bzhag nas dpe cha blta ru bcug pa de mtha' 'khyongs mjug 'khyol byung ba yin na mdun lam zhig yong gi red/ yag po red/ gal srid mjug la de khungs ma 'khyol na/ spyir btang phru gu spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs gzhi rim gyi slob sbyong byed pa'i dus stod de'i ring der dgon pa zhig gi nang la bsdad/ bod skad dang / bod yig zhig bslabs/ nang pa'i chos phran bu bslabs pa de mthar ma 'khyol bar/ des chos dang bod skad bslabs pa de 'i jog nas mi tshe 'khyol ma thub pa chags na phru gur dka' ngal chen po 'phrad nyen yod/ pha mar 'gyod pa ma skyes kyang / phru gu'i bsam blor pha mas drin chung btang 'dug bsam pa de 'dra yong ba'i nyen ka yod/nga rang sto ga le ga ler pha ma nang pa yin mkhan phyi rgyal grogs po mang po yod pa tsho dang / go bsdur byas te mtho rim slob sbyong spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs su 'gro rgyu dang / dma' rim gyi slob sbyong byed sa nang chos slob gra zer ba lta bu de 'dra btsugs chog gi yod dam med/ de 'dra'i slob gra btsugs chog gi yod na bod pa'i phru gu gcig pu'i don dag ma yin par/ phyi rgyal ba nang chos 507

byed mkhan khyim tshang khag gi phru gu de tsho'i gras mnyam du nang chos slob sbyong byed rgyu yod pa zhig byung na snyam/ rtsa ba'i gzhi rim gyi slob sbyong spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs yod pa'i thog la/ nang pa'i chos slob sbyong byed rgyu yod pa de 'dra byung ba yin na yag po red/ bod kyi nang pa'i chos slob sbyong byed dgos byung na bod pa'i skad yig ma bslab thabs med red/ gcig byas na de 'dra yong ma srid pa ma red/ de 'dra yong thub kyi yod med blta gi yin na/ su dza lan ḍi'i nang la bod pa'i phru gu phon che shos yod pas go skabs yag shos red/ su'i si'i nang la slob gra de 'dra zhig byung ba yin na/ nga rang tsho'i pha ma nang pa yin pa 'jar man dang / pha ran se de min yo rab lung pa 'dra mi 'dra'i nang la gang 'tshams yod stabs de 'dra byed thub na khyad mtshar mi 'dug gam/ 'di khul chos tshogs de 'dra yod pa'i sa nas slob ston dang / nyams myong 'dra len rgyu yod med/ phar tshur go go bsdur bsdur ci thub gang thub byed kyi yin na yag po red/ mdo don snying po de nga dus kyi shes yon med na 'byon thang yong gi ma red/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob sbyong med na lhag bsam dang sems shugs bskyed mi thub pas bod pa'i slob sbyong dang zung du 'brel ba'i deng dus kyi shes yon slob sbyong byed rgyu 'di bod pa'i phru gu tsho'i kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi las 'gan lta bu yin pas tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/sud si lung pa'i nang la bod mi 'dus sdod mang shos yin pa ltar/ da lta phan chad la tshang mas sems shugs 'khyer te mig dpe mtshon thub pa 'dra po byung ba 'di khyed rang tsho'i byas rjes red/ yag po byung 'dug yo re nas 508

la re bod pa'i rnam pa gsal du gsal du dang / bod don thog la do khur byed shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ sngon ma bdun cu don gsum lo sud sir yong dus phru gu gzhon skyes gang 'tshams shig gi bod skad yongs su brjed/ nga tsho thug 'phrad yong ba'i skabs la bod skad ma shes pa'i 'tsher snang byed kyi 'dugade'i mjug la 'di nas tshur thengs kha shas yong ba'i skabs la bod pa'i rnam pa de shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa lta bu 'dug 'go stod su dza lan la bod mi gzhis chags gtong skabs blo g.yeng che shos ni rim pas rim pas bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung de yang brjed/ mi rigs kyi rnam pa de yang brlag mi yong ngam bsam pa byung yang / ma 'ongs pa la mi thog mang 16) rjes ji yong gang shes ma gtogs/ da lta'i char de 'dra'i nyen ka grol tshar ba 'dra po red/ bar skabasdo/ shig la bod pa yin zer rgyur 'tsher snang byed kyi yod kyang / deng sang 'dzam gling spyi'i phyogs mang po zhig gi 'gyur 'gros la gzhigs pas bod pa yin zhes zer rgyur bod pa phal che bas slobs pa 'dra po byed kyi yod 'dug sngon ma nga tsho 'dir gzhon nu'i tshogs 'dur yong ba'i skabs la bod skad go la ma go mang po rgyag gi 'dug da res bod skad ha cang bde ru phyin 'dug pa de yang yar rgyas red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa de shugs che ru 'gro dus tshang mas so skur ngad pa yin zhes lab na der spro shugs yod pa'i rnam 'gyur thon gyi 'dug ta cang dga' po byung / thugs rje che zer rgyu yin/las bsdoms nang gsal bod spyi pa'i don dag la zhal 'debs ma dngul phul ba de'i skor la dga' po byung / khyed rang phos bod spyi pa'i don dag la 509

dmigs te sems khur blangs pa yag po red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang 'gul bskyod rgyab phyin chad la 'gro song gtong dgos/ lhag don phyi logs la dril bsgrags byed rgyu dang / phyi mir khyab bsgrags byed rgyu de tsho'i gras la dus rgyun ldan nas mi la 'brel ba bzo rgyu/ mi la gnas tshul 'phral 'phral gsal bshad bya rgyu gal chen po yin stabs/ mdor na ṭa dpar tshun chad kyi 'drel ba rgyun du yod na gnas tshul lam seng shod sa yod pa zhig yong gi red/ nam rkyen 'gul bskyod ma thub par 'khums te bsdad pa yin na dza drag byung ba'i skabs la shod sa med pa byed kyi red/ nga tshor de 'dra'i nyams myong mang po byung yod/dus rgyun ldan nas mi la 'brel ba byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug 'brel ba bzo ba la yang 'gro song mang po gtong dgos/ mi tsho yin na dngul phyi rgyal la bzos/'gro song rgya gar nang la gtong ba de byed stangs mkhas po yin pa red/ nga tsho bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'gro stangs kyi cha nas gab phyi log ste dngul de rgya gar nang thabs shes byas/ gtong sa de phyi rgyal du don gcod khag la phon chen po gtong dgos par brten dka' ngal 'phrad kyi yod/ rgya gar nang mu cha bzhag na/ gzhis sgar yas mas tshang ma dka' ngal chen po red/ dpal 'byor skyo po yin na yang sems shugs kyi jog nas che gzhogs chung gzhogs kyi zhal 'debs 'bul gyi yod pa red/ 'di nas tshur yod mkhan tsho 'gro song che ba yod kyang gzhi rtsa'i dpal 'byor gnas stangs drag gi red/ de 'dra'i thog nas bsam blo btang ste tshang mas dga' bzhin sgro bzhin du so so'i 'gan khur zhig la brtsis te zhal 'debs phul ba la ha cang dasa' po byung / tshang 510

mar thugs rje che zer gyi yin/de nas 'di khul nad pa kha shas sman khang la gshag bcos byas nas na tsha sdug tu phyin pa de 'dra dang / yang de min grib skyon 'dra po'i na tsha khyad mtshar de 'dra rgan gzhon tshang ma'i nang la yong gi 'dug pa/ de tsho'i ched du 'di khul bod pa'i sman khang yan lag chung chung de 'dra btsugs thub pa yin na phan thogs yong gi yod dam med/ nad rigs mang po zhig la bod sman gyi phan nus chen po thon gyi yod/ nad rigs khag gcig la phyi rgyal gyi deng dus kyi sman phan sgogs che ba yod pa red/ nad rigs mang po zhig la bod sman phan thogs che ba brgya cha brgya tham pa tshod thig pa yod bzhin du sa khad 'gyangs pa'i stabs kyis bed spyod ma thub par lus bsdad na phangs po red/ su dza lan la bod mi 'du sdod che sa zhig yin dus bod pa'i sman lam seng len sa yod pa zhig byung na/ rgya bod zung sbrel thog nas nga tsho'i 'phrod bsten la phan gyi red/ de 'dra'i rigs bsam blo gtong rgyu med dam/ bod pa nad gcong chags/ mar dang /chu la phu rgyag rogs zer de tsho yen rtags 'dra po zhig red/ de 'drar re bcol ma yin par sbyor rdzas tshad ldan bzos pa'i bod sman de 'dra'i 'phrod bsten byas na legs/ bod pa'i em rje yang tshad yongs pa zhig dgos pa gal che/ de'i gras gtan sdod ma thub kyang / dus dus la skor ba brgyab ste bdun phrag kha shas bsdad thub pa yong gi red/ de 'dra'i thog la gros bsdur byas/ bsam blo btang gi yin na yag po med dam bsam byung / bsgrub ma thub pa gang yang ma red/511

de nas chos dad kyi thog la/ spyir btang nga tsho bod rigs phal che ba chos dad yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig red/ yin na'ang deng sang spyi yongs mang tshogs kyi shes yon chu tshad mtho ru 'gro gi yod stabs chos kyi shes tshad de yang nges par du mtho ru 'gro ba'i thabs shes byed dgos kyi 'dug de yang da res bka' chos thob song / skal pa bzang po byung zer ba tsam min par dus dus la chos shes mkhan gyis 'grel bshad byas/ nang pa'i chos kyi gnad 'gag gang 'dra gang 'dra yod pa de tsho'i gras sde tshan sde tshan byas te bshad/ don dag rnams sems la nges thub pa zhig byed dgos/ sngon ma nas skad cha byung ba bzhin/ lta ba rten 'byung dang / spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa de tsho'i gras la bsam blo btang ste rtsa ba'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi shes tshad bod rgags mtho ru 'gro thabs bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug de tsho'i skor chos phyogs che tshan chung tshan yod pa de tsho'i gras kyi dmigs bsal las 'gan chags bsdad yod/ lhag don khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas rab byung ngur smrig gi rtags cha lugs 'chang mkhan tshos rgyun gyi spyod lam tshul dang mthun pa byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug mdor na dus rgyun ldan nas gyon gos gyon stangs/ skra bzhar stangs tshun chad gzab gzab byed dgos/ gra pa gzhon pa kha shas skra bzhar rgyur 'tsher snang byed pa dang / gra pa rgan pa kha shas a ra bzhar rgyur 'tsher snang byed pa de byab chung ba red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyu mtshan zhig dang / dgos pa zhig la brten nas bcas khrims mdzad pa red/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul thog dgos pa las dgag cha che ba zhig yod pa yin na gnas tshul 512

tha dad red/ spyir btang bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su 'brangs mkhan tshos bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la ma brtsis na sus rtsis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sgrig khrims bzos pa 'di dag nga chos srung dgos/ bsrung ba'i babs 'os nga tshor yod/ bstan pa rgya mis bshigs par ha las rgyu gang yang med/ bstan pa nga rang tshos bshigs na thabs sdug red/ gra pa rgan pa tshos kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' gang gnang ba rnams rgyab mdun ngo lkog med par sgrub dgos/yang gra pa gzhon skyes tshor cha bzhag na yang / tshur tsam 'dir gra pa 'dod blo ma khengs pa zhig byas/ phar tsam der spyir btang khyim pa'i 'tsho ba skyel stangs 'char can de 'dra byas pa yin na/ yag 11 gang yang min/ che sa chos byed dang mi byed so sor rang dbang yod pa'i mjug la gra pa byed mi byed rang dbang los yod/ gra pa byed kyi yin na spus dag po zhig byed dgos pa shin tu gal chen po red/ deng sang gzhi nas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nang pa'i chos la do snang chen po byed kyi yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ mi chos nang pa'i chos dang /chos byed mkhan tshor brtag dpyad byed pa'i dus tshod zhig la slebs yod pa ma gtogs/ de snga bod la yod pa bzhin dad pa dag snang gis yid ches byed kyi yod pa ma red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i nang la cha bzhag na'ang ci mdzad legs mthong zer ba 'di yag po mi 'dug ces bshad kyi yod/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos tshul bsregs btub 'pher ba zhig gsungs yod pas ci mdzad legs mthong byed dgos don med/ glen pa yin na ma gtogs sus kyang legs pa legs par ngos 'dzin thub kyi red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba'i nang la 513

bla ma'i mtshan nyid gsungs yod/ mdo sde'i nang la bla ma'i mtshan nyid gsungs yod/ sngags kyi nang la bla ma'i mtshan nyid gsungs yod/ so so bla ma byed 'dod yod na/ mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig byas na/ ci mdzad legs mthong la u tshugs rgyag mi dgos/ de ngas nam rgyun tshang mar bshad kyi yod pa ltar tshang mas gzab gzab byed dgos/ lhag don bla ma dge bshes 'dra po 'ga' zhig gis phyi rgyal gyi dge phrug dang / sbyin bdag 'dra byung skabs dbang bskur byed mkhan de 'dra kha shasayong gi 'dug de 'dra byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ 'brom ston pas gsungs pa bzhin mis bstod smad ji ltar byas kyang so so'i ngos nas dman sa bzung na yag shos red/ de nas bod pa'i ming bris stangs la do snang byed dgos/ kha shas kyis phyi rgyal gyi lugs srol byas te so lo'i ming de sngon la bris/ khyim tshang gi ming de mjug la bris pa de khyad mtshar po zhig 'dugadabyin ji yin na gnas tshul tha dad red/ bod yig nang la 'bri srol med pa'i deng sang gi gnas tshul gsar pa zhig yin na gzhan nas dpe blangs na ma 'grigs pa gang yang med/ nga tsho bod yig rang gi nang la bris srol zhig yod bzhin pa de phar bzhag nas dbyin ji'i lad zlos byed kyin bsdad na cho gang yang med/ nga rang tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung gi gnad don la do snang chen po byed dgos/ gzhi rtsa nga chos ngad pa'i skad yig phyug tu gtong thabs la 'bad rtsol sgo gang sa nas byed dgos/ so so'i chos dang rig gzhung srung skyob byed pa la skad yig yar rgyas gtong dgos/ skad yig ma ldang bzhin du u tshugs byas nas bsdad dgos byung na dka' ngal red/ nga tsho'i skad yig yar rgyas gtong 514

thabs skor rgya gar nang dang / bod kyi nang la yang skad cha yong gi yod pa red/da phan lo sum cu ma zin tsam zhig gi ring la de skor las don yag po zhig sgrub thub yod pa ma red/ yin na yang dngos yod gnas tshul la ma 'grub na byed thabs gang yang mi 'dugade nas nga tshor dge 'dun gyi bsti gnas dgon pa 'ga' shas yod pa red/ tha'i lan ḍa dang / ming ga pur gyi dgon khag tsho'i nang gra pa'i sgrig khrims kyi 'gro stangs ha las pa'i spus dag po 'dug dper na/ sgor so so'i gzugs po'i gnas tshul gyi thog nas lag len thub ma thub tha dad red/ spyir btang dge slong yin phyin phyi dro'i kha zas sgongs dgos/ dgong bcad byed pa'i mig ltos lam srol nges par gtod dgos kyi 'dug nga rang tsho de snga bod la mthun rkyen 'dzoms yod pa red/ deng sang rgya gar la cha bzhag na se 'bras kyis mtshon pas dgon pa che khag de tsho'i gras dgong bcad byed dgos nges yin kyang / gra pa tsho las dus skabs las /ra 'gro dgos pa sogs dngos yod gnas tshul nas 'a 'ub ma 'dus par lus pa ma gtogs snang chung byas bzhag pa ma red/ 'di khul du mthun rkyen gang ci'i cha nas lto bcud kyis ma ldang pa dang / ngal rtsol gyi dka' rnyog med stabs snga dgung to chas 'grigs nges zas/ phyi dro dgong bcad byed thub na ha cang yag po 'dugabod kyi rtsa don skor la ngas na ning a mi ri rkar skad cha bshad pa don tshan lnga po de dang / nye char skad cha bshad pa zhib phra blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis lab pa de dag red/ de la skyar zlos yang zlos dgos don mi 'dug bsam 515

cho de 'dra 'khor dgos don ni spyir btang da gin skad cha rob tsam byung ba ltar red/ rtsa ba'i nga rang tsho'i mi mang spyi'i sems shugs dang / las don thog 'gan 'khyer mkhan gyi mis 'phral phugs kyi dmigs yul rgya chen po yid la bcangs nas mi mang gi 'dod pa bsgrub thabs byed dgos pa red/ dngos yod gnas tshul ji tsam sgrub rgyu yod pa rnams sgrub dgos pa dang / de yang phyags rgyang ring po'i cha nas khe gyong snyi yang bteg ste bsam blo gtong dgos pa de chos nyid red/ nga tsho rgya gar la slebs tshar ba'i rjes la rim pas bden pa'i mtha' gsal gyi red ces tshang mas sems shugs bsgril nas bsdad pa red/ bden mtha' gsal ba la gsal stangs red/ bden mtha' gsal ba'i thabs shes kyi go rim zhin/ sgrig dgos pa dang / bgrod lam zhig 'tshol dgos kyi yod pa red/ bden mtha' gsal gyi red ces spyi ma sgom la bzhag pa ma yin par gom pa rim bgrod lag len bkal stangs kyi bsam blo zhig gtong dgos kyi yod pa red/ nub phyogs rgyal khab khag gi nang mi mang po zhig gis sha ḍā thog nas bod pa'i thog la rgyab skyor dang / sems khur shugs chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ yin na yang gzhung so so'i las 'gan 'khyer mkhan de dag bod pa la sha tsha med pa dang / gdung sems mnyam bskyed med pa min na yang /dngos yod gnas tshul gyi lag len thog bsam blo zhig gtong dgos kyi yod pa red/ dpe de bzhin du nga rang tsho bod pa'i nang la cha bzhag na'ang / mi mang gi sems shugs thog nas so so'i thob thang gi rtsa ba rtsod gleng byed mkhan gyi langs phyogs 'dra po gcig yod pa red/ ngo thog lag len bkal yong dus 516

dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun nas thabs shes gom pa rim bgrod kyi bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig yong gi yod/ de 'dra'i thabs shes las 'gul sgo sna tshogs nas byed phyogs skor chig stong dgu brgya drug cu re bdun re brgyad/bdun cu don grangs nang nas nga tsho go bsdur skad cha mang po zhig de dus nas byung yod/ de nas bar skabs rgyal spyi'i nang 'gyur ba mang po phyin/ rgya nag dang nga tsho thad kur 'brel ba byung ba red/ 'brel ba de byung ba'i rjes la nga tshor khe gyong gang byung yod dam zer na/ gzhi rkang las rigs gang 'dra zhig la yin na yang dge skyon gnyis ga'i cha yong rgyu yin pa de chos nyid red/ ngos gcig nas bltas na dge yod pa 'dra po dang / ngos gcig nas bltas na skyon yod pa lta bu zhig gang du yang yong gi yod/ de 'dra'i skabs la dge skyon khe grong gi lci yang la zhib brtag gi bsam blo btang dgos kyi yod pa red/ de ltar na bar skabs nga tshos rgya mi dang thad kur 'brel ba byas pa der nor 'khrul gyi cha byung yod 'bo( ste/ yin na'ang che sa nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ bod rang gi nang la tā la'i bla ma'i sku tshab tshogs pa'i ming 'khyer nas 'gro thub pa dang / de'i rkyen gyis rang bzhin gyi bod mi'i bsam khra'i nang snying stobs gsar pa skyes pa dang / re ba gsar pa skyes rgyu/ chos dad rig gzhung slar gso/bod phyi nang 'gro 'ong bya rgyu sogs la phan thogs chen po byung yod pa tshang mas shes gsal red/da lta'i dus stod 'dir rgya mis bod nang la dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul thog la phran bu'i srid byus gu yangs dang / dam bsgrags lhug gtong byas pa 517

'dir/ bod nang grong gseb khug skyog gi mi bsam blo gtong mi thub mkhan kha shas kyis da cha skyid thag chod 'dug ces bshad kyi yod pa dang / 'dzam gling phyi logs kyi mi 'ga' zhig gis kyang hob ste mthong snang la bar skabs bod nang dka' ngal byung ba ma gtogs da cha bod nang dpal 'byor yar rgyas dang /srid byus gu jigangs phyin nas lhing 'jags yag po yod pa'i mthong tshul yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul 'og don gyi bdag po bod nang gi bod pa tshos bsam blo grung po dang / bsam blo gting zab gtong rgyu shin tu gnad gal chen spro yin/ rgya mis bod yar rgyas gtong gi yod ces phyi logs su rnam 'gyur gsar pa zhig bstan nas bod nang las rigs 'dra min gyi 'char gzhi mang po bting / de 'dra'i thog nas rgya mir las sha'i go skabs sprad/ bod kyi shar phyogs khyim mtshes gcig zi khron zhing chen mi grangs sa ya brgya skor yod pa zhig red/ de'i nang la mi mang drags pa'i rkyen gyis khong tsho'i to gos thabs 'tshol byed par bod nang du yong / ar las dang / 'dzugs bskrun sogs las gzhi che khag smos ci/ mdor na za khang chung chung zin mkhan dang /lham gog bzo bcos byed mkhan tshun chad rgya mi ha cang phon che bod nang slebs yod pa dang / de bzhin kun su'i sa khul de tsho gzhi rtsa'i gnas babs skyo spro yin pa'i thog la chu log gi nyams nyes dang / skabs re than pa'i nyes skyon gyis mi mang gi dpal 'byor gnas stangs skyo po yod pa red/ de min rgya nag bi mnga' sde gzhan dag de tsho'i nang nas kyang bod nang la slebs yong gi yod pa red/ dngos su 'char gzhi bkod pa yin min gang ltar yang / don du 518

rang bzhin gyis rgya mi mang po bod nang la 'khya mas nas yong ste lo re nas lo re mi sdod par bod nang rgya mi'i grong sde gsar pa chags yong gi yod pa red/de yī rgya mi masang /sul la med pa'i sa gnas mang po zhig la yang deng sang rgya mi slebs dukhyod pa red/ 'di mur rgyun mthud phyin na ring por mi thogs par dud kyi sa khul phal mo che la rgya mi khyon che gzhingan chags byas pa yin na k+ka cang ngaka re ngal chen po skyesang rgyu red/ ngas bar skabs ngu ram sa lar snga rjes lab rgyu byung / nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas rgya mi la drang bden gyi rgyu mtshan bkod de t+t+waṃ mol gyi thog nas rtsod gleng byed pa ma gtogs/ drag po'i zing slong gi 'bad rtsol rtsa ba nyid nas byed kyi med/ nga tshos zing slong gi 'thab rtsod byas pa yin na/ rgya mis rang srung la ming btags te rtsa med bzo rgyur dka' tshegs med/ bod mi sa ya drug sku1da sar rgya mi sa ya drug cu tham pa las sla por btang gi red pa/ de 'dra yong ma srid pa ma red/ da lta'i char bod lung pa rgya mis bzung nas bsdad yod kyang / 'dzam bu gling gi 'gyur ba/ dmar po'i rgyal khab tsho'i 'gyur ba/ rgya nag rang gi srid byus la 'gyur ba/ bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang gi sems shugs de 'dra'i thog nas 'dzam bu gling la khyab bsgrags chen po byung ste phyogs gang sa nas bod don la do snang chen ngo byed pa'i dus tshod 'di'i skabs 'dir/ sngon la nga tshos bod nang rgya mi phon chen po mi yong ba zhig dang / bod chol kha gsu ma yongs rdzogs sgrig 'dzugs ga cig gyur gyi thog nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung / mi rigs dang bcas pa srung skyob thub pa bya rgyu 'di dgos pa gtso bo zhig chags bsdad yod pa red/ nga tsho de 'dra'i 519

bsam blo btang nas dbu ma'i thabs lam 'tshol gyi yod/ des bod rgya khongs yin zer gyi med/ rgya dang bod tha dad so so red/ yin na yang dngos yod gnas tshul bod rgya mis zin nas bsdad yod/ nga tsho bod pas rgya mi bod nas mthar skrod thub rgyu khag po yin/ 'dzam gling phyi logs nas bod la sha tsha yod na yang / drag shugs kyi thog nas rgya mi bod nas phyir 'bud bya rgyu khag po red/'di 'dra'i ngang nas dus 'gyangs phyin pa yin na bakhro nyes gang 'dra zhig la 'gro rgyu'i nyen ka shod ma thub pa zhig red/ de las da lta'i go skabs yag po yod pa 'di'i skabs la dbu ma'i lam btsal nas thabs shes shig byas na bsam gyi yod/ da lta'i gnas stangs 'di la rgya mi yin na'ang rtag tu ngo tsha nas bsdad dgos pa/ khungs 'khyol la ma 'khyol gyi 'grel bshad gcig rang rgyag dgos pa/ bod pa tsho yang sdug bsngal rgyun ma chad pa myong dgos pa/ sdug bsngal myang pas ma tshad sdug sa zhig nas bshad pa yin na ring por mi thogs par bod mi ming med 'gro rgyu'i nyen ka zhig gi sgang la slebs yod pas sngon la tshong 'grigs lta bu yong min thabs shes byas pa yin na 'gyod pa gang yang yod pa ma red/ da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul la ran pa zhig gi bsam blo btang na bsam pa'i bsam tshul spyir btang de 'dra zhig red/ da lta yig cha'i nang la gsal po byas nas bkod yod/ bod kyi don gyi bdag po de bod rgya che'i mi mang red ma gtogs gzhan dag su zhig ma red/ mtha' ma'i thag gcod de bod rgya che'i mi mang gis zhed snang med pa'i thog nas byed rgyu red/ da lta'i dza drag gi skabs de mthong ba'i gnas tshul 'di'i 'og nas ngas thabs shes gang 520

yong gi bsam blo gtong dgos pa de nga rang gi 'os 'gan red/ nga rang sger gyi ngos nas 'phral phugs kyi bsam blo btang ba yin na/ ngas nam rgyun rtag par lab mus ltar 'gro ba mi'i rigs tshang ma gcig gyur yin pa la ngas yid ches byed kyi yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la so so so so'i rgyal khab dang/mi rigs dum bu mang por bgos pa 'di mi'i spyi tshogs la rnyogs khra mang po yong ba'i rgyu rkyen 'dra po chags 'gro gi yod pa red/ so so'i lung pa gcig pu'i dka' ngal la bsam blo btang ba des rkyen byas nas mi spyi yi bde sdug la 'thus shor 'gro gi yod pa red/ nga rang sger ngos nas rgyun du de 'dra zhig mthong gi 'dug deng sang 'dzam gling nang dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs mang po zhig phan tshun gcig la gcig brten ma byas mthu med cig dngos yod gnas tshul la chags yod dus mi rigs gcig dang / to tshang gcig gi bsam blo btang na chung chung red/ che sa nas bsam blo gtong dgos zhes ngas rtag par bshad kyi yod/ 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la mi rigs tha dad dang / lto tshang tha dad mang po yod na yang / mi'i rigs spyi'i thun mong gi khe phan gyi don dag la sha tsha rnam dag dang / bsam pa rnam dag thog nas gcig gis gcig la yid ches byas/ gcig gis gcig la grogs po dang rogs byas nas 'gro ba mi'i rigs spyi'i khe phan la tshang mas sems khur blangs rgyu de 'dra zhig yong ma srid pa ma red/ da lta'i nga tsho'i bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul la cha bzhag na yang / sngon la 'grub tshod dpag tshod kyi bsam blo zhig btang nas bsam tshul 'di byung ba red/ bsam tshul 'di yongs grags byed pa'i dus tshod la slebs nas bton 521

pa red/ bsam tshul 'di'i yong stangs lo mang sngon nas byung yod/ don gnad shin tu gal cher brten thabs shes ring thung sgo gang sa nas byed phyogs bsam blo btang ste 'di 'dra zhig kyang byed rgyu med dam/ 'di 'dra zhig kyang byed rgyu med dam/ zhes bsam blo mang po btang ba'i mthar don tshan 'di 'dra zhig byung ba red/ yin na yang / bod nang gi rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams rang dbang 'dod pa'i sems shugs me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs la lab na/ ma 'os ma 'tshams pa lta bu dang / gshis ka slog pa lta bur mthong rgyur brten/ da bar ngang 'then byas pa yin/ da cha bod don thog 'dzam gling gis do snang dang / sha tsha chen po zhig slebs pa'i skabs 'dir nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas bsam pa rnam dag gis gu bshang byed rgyu med na ma gtogs yod tshad byas te gros 'go bton pa yin na/ rgya mis ma nyan na le khag 'dzugs sa rgya mi'i sgang la 'gro rgyu dang /de nyan pa yin na de ga de ga'i bsam blo gtong sa zhig yod pa red/ bsam tshul 'di'i 'char gzhi yong stangs dang / gsal bsgrags byed stangs de 'dra yin/yin na'ang spyir btang 'dzam gling spyi'i gnas stangs ni/ yul lung gang du yin kyang mi mang gi sems shugs 'khyer stangs gcig dang / las 'gan 'khyer mkhan gyi bsam tshul gzhan zhig byung ste skabs re bsam tshul gnyis po de phran bu'i mi mthun pa zhig shugs ma thub kyi yong gi yod pa ltar nga rang cho gedad pa'i gnas stangs kyang de 'dra zhig chags srid pa red/ mi mang gi langs phyogs dang / mi mang gi bsam tho de khyed rang tsho rang nyid kyis bsam blo btang /52 2

khyed rang tsho rang nyid kyis gros bsdur nas thag gcod byed pa ma gtogs/7rgyal ba rin po ches gsung gi 'dug skyon zhig lta 'dug ste 7rgyal ba rin po ches gsungs tsang zer ba lta bu byas na nam yang 'grigs kyi ma red/ mang gtso'i ngo bo brlag 'gro gi red/ ngas ma 'ongs pa la bod mang gtso'i gzhung gi nang la byus gtogs byed kyi min zer ba'i rgyu mtshan gcig gnad don de la thug yod/ ngas las ka byas na mang gtso spus dag yong ba la sad rkyen du 'gro gi 'dug rgya gar nang la cha bzhag na'ang bka' shag nang la mi mang du gtong dgos kyi 'dug bod spyi pa'i don dag la ngas 'gan 'khyer gyi red de/yin na'ang las ka lag len bkal mkhan tsho'i lnga ga nas 7rgyal ba rin po che med pa dang khyad med pa'i 'gan khur mang tsam blangs na yag po 'dug nga dgos mkho yod sa zhig la bed spyod byas chog gi red/ de min rtsa ba'i las 'gan yongs rdzogs bod spyi rnga/'i sgrig 'dzugs btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs rang gi thog nas 'gan 'khyer ba yin na mang gtso kha nas bshad pa ltar don dam pa'i lag len gyi cha nas mang gtso yong thub kyi red/ kha nas mang gtso bshad bzhin du ngo lnga ga las 'gan tshang ma nga mi gcig gi lag par bzhag pa yin na/ bod pa tshos dga' po byed rgyu dang / ngas kyang bsam pa rnam dag byed kyi red de/ nga'i mi tshe rgas 'gro gi red/ lo lnga bcu brgal zin pa dang /tshe ga tshad ring na yang brgyad cu dgu bcu'i nang la mi tshe'i mtha' la slebs rgyu red/ dper na dgra bcom pa ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyang dgung lo brgyad cu'i nang la dgongs pa rdzogs pa red/ de dngos yod gnas tshul red/ chos 523

pa zhig yin na'ang 'chi ba mi rtag pa nyin re bzhin du dran dgos pa ltar/ nga rang tsho spyi pa'i don dag la yin na'ang nyin ma gcig 7rgyal ba rin po che med pa'i nyin ma zhig shar rgyu yin pa brgya cha brgya tham pa thag chod pa red/ de yong ba'i skabs la 7rgyal ba rin po che yod pa ma red/ bod spyi pa'i don dag la bsam blo btang rgyu bsdad ma song ces lab na skug pa red/ skad cha de so sgo so sos bslus pa red/ so so rang shi rgyab pa dang gcig pa red/ nga chos mi rigs shig gi don dag dang / mi rigs shig gi khe phan ched 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod pa ma gtogs mi thog gcig gi don dag la 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod pa ma red/ 7rgyal ba rin po che med na yang / bod mi rigs de sra tag tag bsdad thub pa zhig dgos kyi yod pa red/ desku/nga ba la lo mang po'i gong nas ga le ga ler 7rgyal ba rin po che med pa dang khyad med pa'i las 'gan blangs te nyams myong bsags/ goms gshis 'jags thub pa byed dgos kyi 'dugade 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi cha nas da lta'i gnas skabs nas bka' shag dang / las khungs tshos 'gan khur mang tsam len dgos zhes ngas bshad kyi yod/ dngos yod gnas tshul de red/ma 'ongs pa la bod kyi nang ngas chab srid kyi 'gan khur blang gi min zer ba'i dgos pa gcig ni rgya mis tā la'i bla mas bod don kha 'khyer byed pa de rang gi thob thang khe phan gyi ched du red ces khag 'dogs byed kyi yod pa red/ de la don dam pa'i lan zhig rgyag dgos byung na/ kha nas tshig brgya bshad stong bshad byed ma dgos par/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi gnas tshul yig cha bkrams 524

pa'i nang /bod nang ngas chab srid kyi las khur blangs rgyu min pa gsal po bkod yod/ de snga phan chad la yang nga 7rgyal ba rin po che sger gyi don dag rtsod pa med cing / ma 'ongs pa la yang sger don rtsod 'dod rtsab nas med ces thag bcad nas bshad yod/ rgya mi'i ngos nas rnam 'gyur de 'dra bstan yong dus thar lan de 'dra zhig rgyab yod/ 'dzam gling mi mang gi thog nas kyang yid ches 'gro gi red/ gtso che ba'i cha rkyen gcig ni da lta gong du lab pa bzhin mang gtso dngos gnas drang gnas spus dag cig yong ba'i don dag la 7rgyal ba rin po che the gtogs nyung tsam byas na yag sngon red bsam gyi 'dug yang phyogs gcig nas nga rang sger gyi ngos la cha bzhag na nga bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs nang pa'i dge slong zhig red/ dge slong de'i ngos nas chos sbyang dgos pa dang / chos nyams len byed dgos pa las/ chab srid kyi gnas tshul sbyang dgos don med/ skyid sdug myangs pa'i thog nas nyams myong phran bu bsags yod pa ma gtogs/ de las lhag pa'i ngas rgyal spyi'i khrims kyi 'gro stangs dang /spyir btang chab srid kyi 'gro stangs shes kyi ma red/ dus tshod gnyan 'phrang dang / 'gan khur chen po zhig slebs yod par brten so so'i lhag bsam gyi thog nas ga tshod thub thub kyi phan thogs byed rgyu yod pa rnams byas/ rtsa ba rim pas rim pas 'byon thang yod pa'i mi mang la las 'gan bkod sgrig byas na yag po red bsam gyi 'dug nga rang gis sbyangs pa dang / nga rang gis stod thig pa'i las ka de'i nang la shugs che tsam byed thub na yag po red bsam gyi 'dug bsam pa de bshad pa yin/ snang ba la 'gro dang ma 'gro khyed rang tsho 525

la rag lus pa red/ shes song ngam/ gang ltar bod spyi pa'i don dag bsgrub rgyu de nga tsho tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs byasate sgrub dgos pa ma gtogs/ lkug pa u tshugs byed pa dang / skad log rgyab pa gcig pus phan thogs yong gi ma red/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir bod yul rgya yul la bsgyur rgyu dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos de rmongs dad can gyi chos lugs shir+sha la bsgyur rgyu/rga mi'i rang gshis shes rmongs can la bsgyur rgyu'i bzo lta 'dug ces ṅge ning bshad rgyu byung / de'i nyen ka da lta bsdad yojo pa red/ phugs rgyang ring po'i cha nas nga tsho bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs rdzogs kyi 'dod pa bsgrub rgyu'i thob thang yod pa red/ yin na yang 'grub tshod dpag tshod kyi bsam blo ma btang na mi 'grigs pa chags kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra zhig red/ khyed rang sto go bsdur byas pa yag po byung 'dug dus tshod mang po yod pa ma red de/ do dgong gzhon nu dang khyed rang sto 'dzoms sar/ sbyang bshad yag po byas/ go bsdur yag po byed dgos/ lam seng zla ba kha shas nang la tshar thub pa yong gi ma red/lo nas lo bstud go bsdur bya gin bya gin bsam tshul bton dgos/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i ngos nas bsam blo btang rgyu med na ma gtogs yod tshad btang ba red/ da cha rim pa gnyis pa gang 'dra zhig byed dgos min rgya mi'i byed stangs la blta rgyu ma gtogs bsam blo gtong rgyu med pa lta bu red/ ngas nam rgyun bshad mus ltar/ don gyi bdag po bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams yin pas/gtso che shos rgya mi'i byed phyogs la bltas nas ma 'ongs par nga tsho'i las ka byed stangs skor mi mang tsho'i bsam tshul 'don dgos kyi 'dug byas na de 526

ga yin/ bkra shis bde legs/da ring brel ba byas nas khyed rang tshor mjal kha byed rgyu'i dus tshod ma byung ba red/ khyed rang tshor byin rten ma ṇi ril bu dang bdud rtsi chos sman yod pa 'di dag khyim tshang tshang mar ma chad pa sprod/ thugs rje che/ zhes bka' sung5// // 527

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1988 zla 8 tshes 4 nyin la dwags khul sdod bod mi'i thog bka' slob stsal ba/de ring 'di gar nga tsho bod rigs rgan gzhon ser skya gang tsam zhig 'dus nas yod pa red/ lo ngo nyis stong tsam song ba'i bod kyi lo rgyus nang nas deng sang gi dus tshod 'di khag shos dang / 'gag rtsa che shos/ dza drag che shos snang gnas yod pa red/ de 'dra'i yo 'khyoms dang / 'gal rkyen gyi stobs shugs 'og nga tsho'i gnas stangasayag thag chod byung yod/ nga tsho btsan byol ba byas te lo sum cu 'gro ba'i ring la nga rang tshos chos phyogs kyi las ka dang / slob sbyongs kyi las ka sogs gang ci'i thog mthun rkyen la dpags te tshang mas hur thag byas pa'i nyer len la brten nas nga rang tsho gong bu gcig chags thub ste bod pa zhes mdzub mo 'dzugs sayod pa zhig dang / 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang bod pa zhes lab dus gting zab po'i chos dang / rig gzhung gi bro ba kha rgyu yod pa ma zad/ da dung gtso che shos bod pa zer dus rang bzhin gyi mi'i gshis ka dul po zhig dang / yid ches 'pher ba'i spus tshad ldan pa zhig yod pa la brten nas mi gzhan gyis nga tshor dga' po dang sha tsha slebs thub pa byung ba red/ de snga phyi lo 1950760770 nang gi gnas tshul la bltas pa yin na deng sang bod pa'i chos dang / rig gzhung gi skor la gnas tshul shes mkhan mang du phyin/ de 'dra'i thog nas nga tsho bod par rang bzhin gyis sha tsha dang do snang slebs pa zhig chags yod/ gtso che shos bod nang rgya mi'i mnar gcod dang / gdug rtsub yug gcig gis bod mi'i bsam blor sgyur 528

bcos 'gro thabs dang / gzhon pa tsho la mgo skor bslu 'khrid kyi gnas tshul 'khyog bshad lo nas smro ljel te bsam blor 'gyur ba sgo gang sa nas gtong thabs byas pa red/ 'on kyang bod pa'i bsam blo de mi rigs kyi lta ba la thug yod stabs bod mi'i bsam blor 'gyur ba gtong ma thub pa red/ de bzhin nga tsho btsan byol la yod pa tshor 'dzam gling phyi rol la 'brel ba byed rgyu'i go skabs yod pa yin dus phyi la 'brel ba dang / dril bsgrags mang po zhig byas yod/yang snying lo rgyus yun ring yod pa'i nga cho ༷ da mi gzhis byes gnyis kyi dus stod khag shos dang / gnyan 'phrang che shos kyi skabs 'dir nga tsho'i mi thog 'dis gang la gang 'tshams kyi zhabs 'degs sgrub yod bsam gyi 'dug bod nang rgya mi slebs te lo bzhi bcu skor 'gro gi yod/ de'i ring la dka' sdug gi 'og nas mi mang po zhig 'das grongs phyin yod pa red/ de'i tshe de'i dus dka' las rgyag mkhan gyi mi mang po zhig rgas 'khogs chags bsdad yod/ de rnams kyi byas rjes de dngos gnas drang gnas bsub mi thub pa zhig yin pa nga rang tshos dus rtag tu dran dgos pa zhig red/ da lta'i mi thog gsar pa 'tshar longs zhing mkhan de tshos kyang lhag bsam gyis hur thag 'bad thag byed kyi yod pa red/ der brten gzhis byes bod mi yongs kyis da lta bar du bod spyi don thog hur thag byas yod pa red la byas pa de la grub 'bras mig gis mthong rgyu dang /lag gis zin rgyu yod pa zhig byung yod/ der ngas tshang ma la thugs rje che zer rgyu dang / da dung yin na'i mu mthud hur thag byed dgos zer rgyu de yin/la dwags sa khul la cha bzhag na thog ma sa cha dang / gzhan gyi mthun 529

bcos 'gro thabs dang / gzhon pa tsho la mgo skor bslu 'khrid kyi gnas tshul 'khyog bshad lo nas smro ljel te bsam blor 'gyur ba sgo gang sa nas gtong thabs byas pa red/ 'on kyang bod pa'i bsam blo de mi rigs kyi lta ba la thug yod stabs bod mi'i bsam blor 'gyur ba gtong ma thub pa red/ de bzhin nga tsho btsan byol la yod pa tshor 'dzam gling phyi rol la 'brel ba byed rgyu'i go skabs yod pa yin dus phyi la 'brel ba dang / dril bsgrags mang po zhig byas yod/yang snying lo rgyus yun ring yod pa'i nga cho ༷ da mi gzhis byes gnyis kyi dus stod khag shos dang / gnyan 'phrang che shos kyi skabs 'dir nga tsho'i mi thog 'dis gang la gang 'tshams kyi zhabs 'degs sgrub yod bsam gyi 'dug bod nang rgya mi slebs te lo bzhi bcu skor 'gro gi yod/ de'i ring la dka' sdug gi 'og nas mi mang po zhig 'das grongs phyin yod pa red/ de'i tshe de'i dus dka' las rgyag mkhan gyi mi mang po zhig rgas 'khogs chags bsdad yod/ de rnams kyi byas rjes de dngos gnas drang gnas bsub mi thub pa zhig yin pa nga rang tshos dus rtag tu dran dgos pa zhig red/ da lta'i mi thog gsar pa 'tshar longs zhing mkhan de tshos kyang lhag bsam gyis hur thag 'bad thag byed kyi yod pa red/ der brten gzhis byes bod mi yongs kyis da lta bar du bod spyi don thog hur thag byas yod pa red la byas pa de la grub 'bras mig gis mthong rgyu dang /lag gis zin rgyu yod pa zhig byung yod/ der ngas tshang ma la thugs rje che zer rgyu dang / da dung yin na'i mu mthud hur thag byed dgos zer rgyu de yin/la dwags sa khul la cha bzhag na thog ma sa cha dang / gzhan gyi mthun 529

rkyen gang yang yod pa ma red/ yin na'i la dwags mi mang gis nga rang tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung gcig par brtsis te dmigs bsal gyi sha tsha dang thugs khur gyis bod mi gang 'tshams sdod sa'i sa cha zhig thob/ go skabs shig byung /rim pas da lta'i bu phrug khyim sde yang btsugs te gnas stangs 'di 'dra zhig chags pa red/ bu phrug khyim sde 'dir mthun rkyen yag thag chod yod pa dang /sgrig 'dzugs kyang bu phrug khyim sde'i sgrig srol 'khyer te tshags tshud thag chod yod pa red/ yin na'ang la dwags nang da lta'ang dka' ngal 'og gnas pa'i bod mi gang la gang 'tshams yod pa red/ snga lo nga tsho skad cha byung ba bzhin khug kyog la sku da pa'i khyim tshang tshor rang gi cha rkyen gyis ma ldang / spyi pa'i morigs ram gyi nus pa yang ma slebs/ rogs ram byed mkhan dang 'brel ba yang ma byung bar dka' ngal yod pa de 'dra lhags yod/ de 'dra yin dus snga lo nga tsho skad cha byung don rogs ram tshogs chung btsugs te gang thub ci thub byas pas gang la gang 'tshams kyi phan thogs kyang byung 'dug che sa nas da lta lab pa nang bzhin yag po byung yod kyang / yin na'i khug kyog gi dka' ngal la ltod g.yengs bya rgyu mi 'dug der brten tshang mas da lta bar du hu+or thag byas yod la da dung yang tshang mas hur thag byas te shugs rgyag dgas/da lta bka' blon gyis lab pa ltar/ la dwags nang btsan byol bar mthun 'gyur rogs phan byung yod pa tsam ma zad/ bod nang la bod kyi bden don 'thab rtsod shugs chen po zhig yong ba'i skabs su la dwags mi mang dang /530

dge 'dun pa chos sems khur chen po'i ngang bod rang btsan gyi don du so so'i don dang khyad med ngos 'dzin gyis las 'gul shugs chen po spel ba des bod mi mang la dmigs bsal gyi sha tsha dang do snang yod pa'i rtags mtshan bstan zhing gi yod/ de ring 'di gar la dwags khul gyi grogs po 'ga' shas slebs yod pa red/ tshang mar ngas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ de snga yin na'ang la dwags nas bzung a ru na cal khul bar hi ma la ya'i ri brgyud du yod pa'i sa khul de rnams rig gzhung bod kyi rig gzhung dang gcig gyur yin/ der brten bod kyi rig gzhung nyams gud song na sa khul de tsho'i rig gzhung nyams gud 'gro rgyu red/ so so rang nyid kyi lung pa'i gnas stangs kyis dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'gro gi yod pa de yag po red/ yin na'ang mi'i spyi tshogs gang du'ang rim pas rim pas dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs yag tu 'gro dus gzhi nas rig gzhung de gal chen po zhig yin pa shes yong gi red/ rang gi dpal 'byor yag tu phyin te 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal sel ba'i skabs la rang gi gna' snga mo'i rig gzhung la do snang gsar pa zhig slebs kyi yod pa de chos nyid cig red/ nga rang tsho'i sa khul de dag la rang gi rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gtong rgyu gal chen po red/ bod kyi dar gud kyi gnas tshul de lha ma la'i ri rgyud kyi sa khul mi mang dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig chags yod/ da lta bar du sa khul de dag tu mi mang gis dmigs bsal de'i thad do snang shugs chen po byed kyi 'dug nga rang yang sa khul de dag mi nyung ba zhig tu slebs yod pas de'i skabs do snang shugs chen po byed kyi/ 'dug pas de tsho'i thad 531

la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ kho tsho'i bka' drin dran dgos pa zhig red/nga rang tsho bod pa'i chab srid da lta'i char gang 'dra zhig tu gnas yod dam zhe na/ nga rang tsho btsan byol ba byas te tshang mas dus da lta bar bod rang dbang rang btsan yong ba byed rgyur sems thag bcad de bsdad pa red/ nga rang tshor rang btsan thob thang brgya cha brgya tham pa sku/da/ gal che shos bod nang la rgya mi'i dpung sde slebs pa'i rjes la dngos gnas drang gnas kha yod lag yod nga tsho bod par khe phan ga 'dra zhig byung yod dam/ kha yod lag yod bod par sdug bsngal ga tshod byung yod dam/ de 'dra byas te zhib rtsis shig rgyab na bod de yar rgyas la phyin rung / sdug bsngal zhig myong gi yod na sdug bsngal de las thar thabs byed pa las sdug bsngal de myong 'dod byed mkhan gcig kyang yod pa ma red la/ sdug bsngal de las thar thabs byed pa'i rang dbang yod dgos/ nga tshor 'das pa'i lo rgyus la yang rang btsan rtsod pa'i thob thang yod/ bar lam gyi dngos yod gnas tshul gyi cha nas bod pa rgya mi'i 'og la bsdad de skyid pa zhig rtsa ba nas yong gi med stabs mi su yin na'ang sdug bsngal myong 'dod med pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa zhig yin dus/ sdug bsngal de gang la brten te byung ba red dam zer na/ rgya mi bod la slebs te byung ba yin tsang rgya mi'i 'og la sdod kyi min zer ba de chos nyid cig chags bsdad yod/'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bden pa zer ba de rim pas rim pas lo nas lo bstud mi thog nas mi thog mthud de mtha' gsal rgyu yod pa zhig red/ 'on kyang kha thug kha thug la bden pa rgyal zer ba de yong rgyu khag po red/ der brten 532

nga tsho bod nang gi gzhis lus mi dmangs yin na'ang 'dra/ byes 'byor mi mang yin na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar rang btsan gyi thog la stobs shugs bsgril te thabs shes gang yong byed kyi yod kyang / da lta nga tsho so so'i nus pa dang / 'dzam gling gi gnas stangs thog nas rang btsan thob rgyu'i thabs shes kyis ldengs thub pa zhig yod dam med/ gal che shos thabs shes de dngos 'brel lag tu son thub pa zhig yod med la bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug nga tsho'i da lta'i stobs shugs dang / rgya mi'i stobs shugs kyi khyad par/ rgya mi'i lung pa gnad chen po chags pa'i rkyen gyis rgya mi la sems nas mi dga' na yang dpal 'byor dang dmag don gnas stangs/ rgyal spyi'i 'brel ba'i gnas stangs kyi thog nas rgya mir ngo srung byed pa dang / bstun mkhas byed dgos pa zhig yong gi yog red/ bod pa'i gnas tshul la bod par bden pa yod pa dang / sdug bsngal myong dgos kyi yod par gting nas sha tsha yod na'ang don ngo ma'i thog nas bod pa'i srid don la rgyab skyor byed thub min ni gnas tshul tha dad red/ de 'dra'i dngos yod kyi gnas tshul de yag nyes gang yin rung shes rtogs dgos pa zhig yin dus de shes rtogs yong ba byed rgyu gal chen po red la/ de shes pa'i thog nas rtsis rgyag rgyu de bas gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho tshang mar rang btsan yong rgyur sems shugs yod la rang btsan rtsod pa'i thob thang yang yod/ 'on kyang rang btsan lam seng yong gi red pas zer na de khag po red/ nga tsho rang btsan ma byung bar sgug gi yin zer na'ang yag po red/ 'on kyang bod nang la lo re nas lo re bzhin 'gyur ba shugs chen po 'gro gi yod pa red/ 'gyur 533

ba gang 'dra 'gro gi yod pa red zer na/ da lta bka' blon gyi lab pa bzhin rgya mi 'bor chen po zhig bod nang ga le ga ler khyab yong gi yod pa red / da lta'i gnas stangs de mu mthud bsdad pa yin na bod lung pa de ma 'ongs par lo lnga /bcu/ bco lnga tsam nas rgya yul chags rgyu'i nyen kha chen po yod pa dang / bod mi rnams grangs nyung mi rigs chags rgyu shin tu gsal 11 red/ gal te bod yul de rgya yul chags bod mi rnams grangs nyung mi rigs chags song na de nas ga 'dra byed dam/ nga tshor thabs shes gang 'dug gam/ de la bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug nga rang tsho rang btsan rtsod len byed rgyu dang / mi rigs spyi thob thang / dpal 'byor sogs kyi thob thang rtsod len byed pa'i rtsa ba mi kho nar rag las pa red/ der brten do bdag mi kho rang ga le ga ler rgya mi'i nang la sim te yal song na nga tsho'i las ka de ga re chags 11nga ngam/ nga tshos phyogs gcig nas lo rgyus kyi dngos yod gnas tshul thog nas rang btsan thob thang rtsod len byed pa dang / phyogs gnyis nas rang btsan phar bzhag rang nyid kyi mi rigs kyang brlag 'gro rgyu'i dngos yod gnas tshul zhig chags bsdad yod/ de gnyis dbar nga'i bsam par ma lan ma 'gyod pa'i thabs shes shig byas na dran gyi 'dug rang btsan gtsang ma yong rgyu yang khag po red/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bod nang rgya mi 'bor chen po zhig yong ste rang skyong zhes ming skam po zhig las nang don thag gcod tshang ma rgya mis byed kyi yod pa de yang min rma /de gnyis kyi bar du dbu ma'i lam zhig btsal na 'gal ba yod srid kyi ma red bsam gyi 'dug rang btsan zer ba de rgya mis dbang sgyur byed pa de med thu 534

bzo rgyu red/ de med pa bzo ba la 'khrugs pa rgyag dgos/ bod pa dang rgya mi 'khrug pa rgyab na bod pa rgyal thub kyi red dam zer na sus yin na'ang shes kyi red/ de shin tu khag sngo yin/ gnyis nas 'khrug pa rgyag yul rgya mi yin rung 'khrug pa zer ba de mi dgos pa zhig red/ dper na nga la cha bzhag na'ang bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs dge slong zhig yin/ chab srid tho ga la cha bzhag na'ang rgya gar gyi gna' snga mo'i 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam de dag bdag nyid chen po lhan rdis dus rabs nyi shu 'di'i thog chab srid thog lag len gnang ba de'ang ha cang gi rlabs chen zhig red bsam gyi 'dug nga rang yin na'ang 'tshe ba med pa zhi ba'i lam zer ba de thog mtha' kun tu mi'i gshis ka dang mthun pa'i ya rab sa kyi spyod tshul zhig yin par ngos 'dzin gyi yod/ drag po byas te mi gsod khrag sbyor gyi las ka byed pa de phugs la bsam blo btang na mi'i gshis ka dang ma ran pa zhig red/ 'jam po byas na rgya mis nyan gyi ma red/ rgyu mtshan bshad na rgya mis nyan srid kyi ma red/ der brten rtsub po byed rgyu red/gal te rtsub po byas na'ang nga chos rgya mi thub kyi ma red la mi gsod khrag sbyor byas na thabs kyang sdug po red/ nga tshos bod dbang sgyur byed mkhan gyi rgya mi la nga tshos bden pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad de mi dang mi'i ṅge tsha skyes pa byed rgyu dang /mi dang mi'i dbar dngos gnas sems kyi gting nas ngo shes pa byed rgyu zhig red/ ngas ngo shes zer ba de 'di rgya mi red bsam pa zhig dang / 'di bod pa red bsam pa zhig gi spyir btang ngo shes tsam zhig la bshad kyi med/ nga'i ngo shes pa zer ba de bod pa'i sdug bsngal de rgya mis shes pa zhig dang / rgya mi'i 535

sdug bsngal de yang bod pas shes pa zhig la zer gyi yod/ rgya mi yang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa zhig dang bde ba 'dod pa zhig yin pa dang / bod pa yang de bzhin yin par phyogs gnyis gas ngo shes pa byung na da lta'i dbang yod shod mkhan gyi rgya mi dang / sdug bsngal myong mkhan gyi bod mi'i dbar gyi dka' ngal sel byed kyi thabs lam zhig mthong gi 'dug mis mi la sha tsha dang / sems kyi gting nas ngo shes thub pa'i dbu ma'i thabs lam gsar pa zhig 'tshol rgyu med dam bsam gyi 'dug de lta'i thabs lam zhig yong gi red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug de ltar sdug bsngal sprod mkhan gyi rgya mi dang / sdug bsngal myong mkhan gyi bod mi'i dbar tshong dang 'dra bar mi gnyis kyi bar la 'grigs chags kyi bsam blo btang ba yin na rgya mi la'ang blo 'jog sa yod pa zhig dang / nga cho bod pa la'ang khe phan sku(da pa zhig gi thog nas bsam blo gtong rgyu gal chen shoṃ red/ de min nga rang tsho kho na'i khe phan gyi bsam blo btang na dper na/ tshong dang ma song na'i 'grigs pa'i gzhi yog ma red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i ngos nas gang la gang 'tshams shig blos gtong dgos pa dang / rgya mi'i ngos nas cha ba/zhag na bod pa'i thog gang la gang 'tshams shig blos gtong da gos/ rtsa ba gnyis wa de gang 'dra zhig la bsam blo gtong dgos kyi yod dam zer na/ nga tsho bod pa la bod chol kha gsum gcig tu sgril ba'i sa khul rnams so so'i 'gan so sos 'khyer te so so'i don dag so gos thag gcod byed rgyu/ mi mang rang mos kyis drang bden gyi 'os bsdu'i jog nas btsugs pa'i bod srid gzhung zhig dang /srid gzhung de'i thog nas bod chol kha gsum gyi 'gan 'khyer rgyu yod pa de 'dra 536

zhig byung na bod pa sdug bsngal las grol thub pa dang / bod pa'i chos dang reg gzhung nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel tan tan byed thub kyi red/ chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril dus rang gi mi rigs kyi chos dang rig gzhung so so'i rnam pa ston rgyur tan tan rlabs chen po zhig gi rgyal kha thob yong gi yod/ de ltar byung na sngar bod de rang btsan yin pa dang / da phyin chad la'ang bod pa de bod pa rang las rgya mir nam yang 'gyur mi thub/ dper na gser rdo la 'gyur mi srid/ snod chas gcig gi nang la gser rdog rdog dang /dngul rdog rdog byugs nas bzhag pa lta bu red/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i lo rgyus 'phel rim nang la rtsa ba do bdag thun mong gi khe phan gal cher brtsi gi yod/ skad rigs mi 'dra ba bcu drug tsam yod pa dang / mi'i gdong ris bzo lta 'dra mi 'dra sna tshogs yod na yang thun mong gi khe phan thog nas rgya gar mang gtso'i rgyal khab gcig gi 'og la gcig gyur du bsdad yod/ rgya gar yongs rdzogs gcig gyur mang gatho'i rgyal khab 'di bcom ldan 'das byon pa'i skabs nas byung med/ de snga rgya gar nang yul lung so sor rgyal po re byas te gnas yod cing / bcom ldan 'das 'khrungs yul lum bi ni yi brgyud la yang shakya'i rgyal po zhes rgyal phran gcig yod pa red/ chos rgyal mya ngan med dam/a sho lnga'i skabs la gcig gyur gyi rgyal po byung yod med ngas gsal po mi shes/de ltar thun mong gi khe phan med na mi rigs gcig gyur yin kyang tha dad 'gro srid pa red/ nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas rgyal khab zer ba'i khe phan de rgya mir sprad pa yin dus chab srid kyi gnas tshul thog nas phyi srid de rgya mis 537

mu mthud byed rgyu dang / srung skyob kyi las ka de rgya mis 'gan khur rgyu byas pa yin na'ang / bod kyi sa cha'i gnas stangs de rgya nag dang / rgya gar/ shar tur ki si tan bcas kyi bar du 'brel yod pa dang / gtso che shos rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi bar der shugs rkyenaspend pa'i sa cha'i gnas babs kyis rkyen pas rim pas bod lung pa de zhi bde'i bsti gnas zhig bzo thub na nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin pa la 'os po yod/ de snga chos rgyal tsho'i skabs bod dpung stobs chen po yod pa lo rgyus nang gsal ba ltar red/ phyis su bod sil bu chags te gnas tshul mang po zhig gi thog nas nga tsho bod pas phyi rol tu stobs shugs chen po bed spyod kyis dbang sgyur byas sa byung med/ gang ltar nga ra nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhig yin dus nga tsho bod lung pa de go mtshon med pa'i zhi bde'i bsti gnas shig bzo thub na 'tshams po yod/ byang a mi ri rka'i ko si ta ri ka zer ba'i lung pa der dmag mi rtsa ba nas med tshod 'dug de snying rje po ga 'dra mi 'dug gam/ phyin chad bod lung pa de dmag gi rten gzhi rtsa ba nas med pa zhig bzo thub na rgya gar la phan gyi red la/ rgya mi la'ang phan gyi red/ bod lung pa'i nang rgya mi'i dmag mi 'bor chen po zhig bzhag pa des rgya mi'i dpal 'byor la gnod kyi yod la/ rgya mi'i 'dzugs bskrun byed rgyur gnod kyi yod/ bod la rgya mi'i dmag mi 'bor chen po zhig yod tsang hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud la rgya gar gyis kyang dmag mi 'bor chen zhig bzhag dgos pa chags kyi yod pa red/ des rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor 'dzugs bskrun la gnod pa dang gyong gun ga tshod tsam phog gi red/ dpal 'byor yar rgyas rgya dkar 538
