nag gnyis kus gtong dgos kyi yod pa red/ der brten bod nang zhi bde'i bsti gnas yag po zhig bzo thub na/ rgya gar gyi phar nyen kha med pa dang / rgya mis tshur nyen kha med pas phyogs gnyis gas hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud du dmag mi bzhag dgos don med/ nga rang tsho bod lung pa'i nang la yang dza drag dang dngangs skrag med pa ma zad/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab tsho la'ang phan thogs chen po zhig yong gi red/ de byung na rgya dkar nag khyim mtshes mthun po zhig chags kyi red/ bod lung pa'i sa cha'i babs nas rgya dkar nag gnyis /ra nyen kha med par zhi bde gtan gnas yong rgyur rogs byed thub pa tan tan yong gi red/de 'dra zhig bzo dgos na bod nang rgya dmag rtsa ba nas mi dgos pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ hob ste bltas na rmi lam lta bu zhig 'char gyi yod pa red/'on kyang sngon la rmi lam lta bu'i 'char gzhi zhig bsam blo btang / de nas rim gyis sgrub thub pa byung na yag po yong gi red/ ga la te rmi lam gyi bzo 'dra spro'i bsam cho de 'dra ma btang na lag len gyi grub 'bras ngo ma yong thub thabs med/ yang rgya dmag bod nas 'then dgos/ bod zhi bde'i bsti gnas bzo dgos zer dus rgya mi 'drogs 'go langs kyi yod pa red/ de ni rgya mi kho rang tshos bsam blo gtan gtan ma btang ba'i skyon red/ ngas rgyu mtshan ga re shod kyi yod dam zer na/ gang ltar skad cha 'dra chags po dang / skyag rdzun ga stod gral sgrig rung ma sgrig rung / bod pa dang rgya mi'i dbar 'gal ba ga tshod yod med sus yin na'ang shes gsal red/ rgya mi'i ngos nas bshad na gang ltar bod pa zhig yin phyin gung khran tang yon yin pa dang / tang yon byas te lo 539

20730 phyin yod na'ang yid ches ma thub par dogs pa skyes nas sdod dgos pa zhig chags yod/ de bzhi na las byed pa rnams la yang ming chen po dang /'dra chags po ga re btags yod rung / rgyab tu dogs pa byas byas par bsdad kyi yod pa red/ de bzhin bod pa'i ngos nas cha bzhag na'ang rgya mi zhig yin phyin chad bod pa'i bsam blor rgya ro khos nga tshor yag po byed kyi ma red bsam pa zhig dngos 'brel dran gyi yod/ deng sang tha na bod pa'i phru gu chung chung m+mu kha rgyun la'ang rgya rgan/ rgya ro zhes shod pa dang / ma dga' ba byed kyi 'dug de mi rigs kyi 'gal zla yin pa las mthun sgril ma red/ bod pa chos kyang rgya mi la ma dga' na yang nga tsho dang rgya mi khyim mtshes byas te sdod mi dgos pa yong thabs med/ 'dzam gling 'dir khyim mtshes lung pa chags tshar ba'i rjes la 'dod kyang ma 'dod kyang de ltar sdod rgyu las/ bod lung pa de nas lhe pa bkog ste zla ba'i sgang la bskyal rgyu zhig yong gi ma red/ de nang bzhin rgya mis bod pa 'dod kyi med na yang bod pa h+pho sa rag gi ma red/ sdod rgyu ni mnyam du sdod dgos/ bsdad pa'i rjes su mdza' brtse'i ngang bsdad na gnyis kur de dga' gi red/ da lta bshad pa nang bzhin nga tsho bod pa tshos rgya mi la mi dga' ba dang / rgya mi yang sems la na tsha btang ste sdod dgos pa de nga tsho bod par mi dgos pa zhig red la/ rgya mi la'ang mi dgos pa zhig red/ de ni rgya mis bod pa'i mgo brdung ste byung ba ma gtogs/ bod pas rgya nag la phyin te rgya mi'i mgo brdung ba ma red/ nga cho dad pa su zhig gis rgya nag la tshul min byas pa med/ sngar chos rgyal tsho'i dus skabs su bod dmag rgya nag la 540

phyin yod pa red de de ni 'das tshar ba red/ da lta bod nang gdug rtsub mnar gcod gtong ba de sngar khri ral skabs nga tshor sdug sbyongs btang byung zer nas yong ba yin gyi ma red/ de tshar ba red/ da cha rgya dang bod zer ba mi rigs tha dad gnyis po de dam tshig mthun sgril zhig bzo dgos byung na/ bod par gdug rtsub gtong mkhan gyi rgya mis bsam blo gtong dgos pa ma gtogs gdug rtsub myong mkhan nga tsho'i ngos nas bsam blo gtong rgyu gang yang lhag med/ der brten da cha rgya mis bod pa la nga tshos khyed tshor sha tsha yod/ brtsi bkur yod/yid ches yod/ blos 'khel gyi yod zer nas yig cha'i nang la tshig 'dra chags po dang snyan po/ spun zla mi rigs dang / las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar ldan pa/ blo gros ldan pa/ babs chags pa sogs bris pa'i tshig skam pos gang yang phan gyi mi 'dug de mtshungs bod pa sangs rgyas red zer na yang phan thogs mi 'dug bod pa'i bsam blo'i nang rgya mis bod pa'i thad dngos gnas drang gnas kyi bsam blo gtong gi 'dug bsam pa'i yid ches skye thabs ji ltar byed dgos zer na/ rgya mi'i ngos nas bod pa mi re'i rgyab la me mda' re btsugs bsdad pa de tsho 'then dgos pa dang / bod nang nas rgya nag mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dmag mi rnams phyir 'then byas pa yin na/ gzhi nas bod mi'i bsam khra'i nang / da cha dngos gnas drang gnas rgya mis nga tshor yid ches byed kyi 'dug cha 'jog byed kyi 'dug snyam pa'i bsam blo 'khor gyi red/ tshur mi'i mthong bzhag ste cha 'jog byas na/ nga tshos kyang phar rgyu 'bras 'pher ba zhig byed kyi red ma gtogs rgya mi'i dmag mi 'then song zhes de'i go skabs 541

zin te rgya mir ngo rgol byed kyi ma red la/ byas kyang pham nyes yong rgyu zhig las yod pa ma red/ de 'dra yin dus rgya mi blo g.yeng byed dgos don mi 'dug rgya mi kho rang tsho klad pa chung drags/ byab chung drags/ rnam rtog za drags te ngas bod zhi bde'i bsti gnas bzo dgos zer dus kho rang tshos rang btsan gyi skad cha shod kyi 'dug zer nas 'drogs 'go langs pa red ma gtogs/ don dam pa'i mthun sgril yag po zhig bzo dgos byung na gong du bshad pa bzhin bod mi'i blo dang ma mthun pa'i bod mi'i thog btsan gnon byed mi rung / rgya dmag phyir 'then dgos zer ba de kha bral gyi skad cha shod kyi med/ don dam pa'i phan tshun gcig gis gcig la yid ches slebs thub pa dang / sha tsha slebs thub pa'i don du phan pa'i ched du bshad pa yin/ rgyal spyi'i zhi bde'i thad la'ang bod kyi zhi bde'i gnas tshul de gal chen po zhig chags yong gi yod/ de 'dra'i bsam blo'i thog nas bod zhi bde'i bsti gnas bzo dgos pa dang / rgya dmag bod nas 'then dgos pa'i bsam tshul de byung ba red/ des rgya mi la khe phan phyi 'brel dang / rgyal srung thog the gtogs yod pa dang / bod de rgyal khab chen po zhig gi nang tshan lung pa zhig thog gnas rgyu/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i khe phan ni so so'i lung pa'i nang gi dbang cha gtsang ma so so rang gis bzung te bsdad rgyu yod pa zhig yong gi yod pa red/ de ring kha sang rgyal spyi'i nang 'gyur ba shugs chen po zhig 'gro gi yod pa red/ dper na/ u ru su'i nang 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod pa red/ de dang chabs cig rgya nag nang la'ang 'das pa'i lo bcu tsam nang ha las pa'i 'gyur ba phyin yod/ rgya mi'i dpon rigs 542

tshos da lta'i srid jus de dus nam yang phyir bshig rgyag gi ma red zer gyi yod pa red la/ de bzhin rgya nag nang gi mi'i rang bzhin gyi bsam blo'i thod rgags dang / mthong thos kyi shes rgya che ru phyin te yang skyar sngon ma'i gu dog po'i srid jus thog bskyar log 'gro e thub bsam pa 'dug rgya nag nang lo bcu'i ring 'gyur ba chen po zhig phyin yod pa ltar/ da dung mu mthud 'gro gi red bsam gyi 'dug de snga dmar po'i rgyal khab kyi btsan dbang dang / drag rtsub kho nas gnon pa'i srid jus der 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod dus gnas tshul de'i cha nas rgya mi gung khran de snga'i gung khran de rang ma yin par rgya mi gung khran gsar pa zhig chags yong gi yod pa red/ gcig gis gcig la mi'i 'du shes thog nas skad cha bshad rgyu dang / rgyu mtshan drangs te phyogs gnyis ka nas gu bshangs gang la gang 'tshams byed pa'i bsam blo gtong gi yin na gcig byas na dbu ma'i lam gsar pa zhig thob mi yong ngam snyam pa'i re ba de 'dra zhig rgyag gi yod/ de yang nga mi gcig gis thag bcad pa gang yang min/ nga tsho 'gan yod pa tshang mas zla ba nas zla ba sbrel te go bsdur byas pa yin/ rtsa ba'i bsam 〉 de nye char byung ba yang ma red/ phyi lo drug cu re grangs nas rtsa ba nga tshos bod rang btsan rtsod dgos kyi yod pa red/ nga tshor rang btsan thob thang yod/ nges med kyi rang btsan ma byung ba yin na nga tshor bsam slo gtong rgyu gang 'dug gam/ rab la 'di de min na 'di zhes cig stong dgu brgya drug cu re grangs dang / bdun cu don grangs nas nga tsho'i bsam khro'i nang la go rim zhig sgrig yod pa red/ yin na yang de'i tshe de'i dus nga tshos skad cha de 543

bshad na dngos 'brel lag len 'khel thub rgyu'i bzo lta med stabs nga tsho su zhig gis bshad med/ bar lam phyogs gcig nas da lta lab pa bzhin rgya mi'i nang 'gyur ba chen po zhig 'gro gi yod pa dang / gtso che shos bod na nga gi mi mang tsho'i sems shugs ha las pa zhig yod dus snga lo dang da lo 'dzam gling sgang khyab bsgrags ha las pa byung ba red/ bod nang lta bskor la 'gro mkhan dang / 11da kyi gnas thosan shes mkhan phal cher brgya cha brgya tham pas bod par rang bzhin gyis sha tsha dang / bod par dga' po byed kyi 'dug der brten 'dzam gling nang bod pa'i bden don gsal po chags kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul thog nas rgyal spyi'i tshogs pa 'dra min mang po zhig gis bod par sha tsha dang / don dam pa'i rgyab skyor byed kyi yod/ de bzhin srid gzhung sgo sku'i thog nas kyang rtsa ba so so'i gzhung la bsam blo gtong dgos pa dang / 'phral sel gyi khe phan la bstun te rgya mi'i ngo srung dgos pa zhig yod dus bod par mngon gsal dod pos rgyab skyor dang sha tsha byed bde po med kyang 'gro ba mi'i thob thang thog nas rgyab skyor byed rgyu dang / bod don skor gleng slong byed rgyu sogs kyi thog bsam blo gtong ba/ bod nang la gna' snga mo'i rten gzhi mang po yod pa nyams pa sor chud yong thabs la do snang byed mkhan 'dzam gling sa cha gang sa gang nas yong gi 'dug rgya bod gnyis dbar gyi dka' rnyog sel ched rgyu mtshan de 'dra zhig bton pa yin na phyogs gang sa nas rgyab skyor shugs drag che ru 'gro rgyu'i cha rkyen la phan gyi 'dug bden pa bod par yod kyang gnas tshul gyi cha nas khag po red ces shod mkhan yod pa ma zad/ bod pa'i thog 544

sdug pa byed mkhan zhig la cha bzhag na'ang bod pas dngos yod gnas tshul dang ba stun te drang po byed kyi 'dug bsam pa'i sha tsha dang rgyab skyor shugs che ru 'gro gisku(da pa bcas gnas tshul de dag la brten nas ngas gros gzhi de bton pa red/ yin na'ang rtsa ba'i thag gcod de nga mi gcig gis brgya kha yug gcod byed thub kyi ma red la byas pas 'grigs kyi ma red/ ngas nam rgyun nas don gyi bdag po bod rgya che'i mi mang yin zhes bshad kyi yod la/ bod spyi pa'i don dag de nga sger gyi yin snyam pa'i bsam blo yang med la yong thabs kyang med/ngas da lta 'gan zhig 'khyer/ 'go zhig 'khrid de bsdad kyi yod dus bsam tshul de 'dra zhig bton pa red/ rtsa ba'i mtha' ma'i thag gcod de bod rgya che'i mi mang gis bsam sduge tan tan zhig btang / ga le ga ler thag gcod byed rgyu de nga'i bsam tshul yin/ma 'ongs par ngas mang gce'i sgrig btsugs nang las ka byed kyi min zer ba de la rgyu mtshan kha shas sku(da/ rgyu mtshan gciga.a lag gis bshad pa ltar/ rgya mis bod nang zang zing byas pa de tā la'i bla mas brgyud bskul byas pa red/ de'i dmigs yul ni spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar log dang / ro langs rgyag ched red ces shod kyi yod/ gang ltar nga'i khe phan gyi don la las ka byed kyi yod pa lta bu shod kyi yod/ de bzhin nga tsho dang rgya mi'i dbar 'brel ba byung ba'i rjes la rgya mis bod nang gi rnyog dra de tā la'i bla ma'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro stangs la thug par ngos 'dzin byas te tā la'i bla ma'i don dag la don tshan lnga zhes bshad pa red/ nga'i skor la de snga phan chad tshig gcig bshad med la/ ma 545

'ongs pa la'ang tā la'i bla ma'i thob thang skor la tshig gcig shod rgyu med ces tshig thag gtsang ma bcad zin pa yin/ ngas bshad pa de bod mi mang gi don du shod kyi yod/ der brten ngas ma 'ongs par las ka byed 'dod med ces bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig de yin / rgyu mtshan gnyis pa/ nga rang tshor don dam pa'i mang gatsho'i gzhung lam zhig yong ba'i re ba rgyag gi yod pa dang / bsam blo gtong gi yod pa red/de snga bod nang sdod dus mang gatho'i bsam blo 'khor byung la/ rgya gar nang la'ang mang gtso'i lam la 'gro dgos kyi 'dug ces gom pa dang po de mang gatsho'i rtsa khrims dang / spyi 'thus kyi sgrig 'dzugs btsugs pa red/ mang gatsho'i lam thog kha zhe gnyis med 'gro gi yod/ lhag don nga tsho ma 'ongs par dngos gnas drang gnas kyi don dam pa'i mang gtso dgos kyi yod na/ ngas 'gan 'khyer bsdad na 'grig gi mi 'dug dper na de ring kha sang yong dang yong bzhin pa red/ gal te gnas tshul zhig thag gcod byed pa'i skabs rang gi blo la ma babs na thog mar rgyal ba rin po che'i bka' slob red dam zhes brtsad gcod byas/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i bka' slob yin na yag po yod kyi red zer bshad de der do khur byed kyi mi 'dug der brten ngas 'gan khur te bsdad na bod mi mang so so'i bsam tshul mi mthun pa de bton rgyur gnod kyi 'dug ngas 'gan ma khur bar bsdad pa yin na dngos gnas drang gnas mi re ngo re'i so so sgor gyi bsam tshul ngo ma ga re yin na'ang 'don rgyur dka' ngal med pa zhig dang / gros bsdur byed rgyu'i thog bsam tshul 'dzems zon med pa 'don rgyur 546

phan sgogs yong gi red/ ngas 'gan 'khyer te sdod skabs bsam 'char shod zer na'ang / ngas mi mang la dbang yod dang 'jigs bskul byas pa'i rkyen gyis shod ma nus pa ma red de/ rang gi sems kyi gting nas brtse po dang / dga' po/ brtsi bkur/ yid ches byed pa'i mi des bshad pa de rang gi blo la ma babs rung / dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan yod pa la brtsis nas blos ling 'grel byed kyi yod pa red/ de ni ha lam rmongs dad lta bu chags kyi 'dug ngas 'gan ma 'khur na mang gtso dngos gnas ming don mtshungs pa yag po zhig mi yong ngam snyam pa'i bsam slo de 'khor gyi 'dug de ni bsam pa rnam dag yin/rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig ni dngosasku1da gnas tshul la gang zer rung mi zer rung / mthar thug rang gzhan tshang ma shi rgyu red/ dper na nga rang yang lo lnga bcu nga grangs la slebs yod/ da phyin chad lo sum cu bzhi bcu'i nang la rgyal ba rin po che rdzogs rgyu red ma gtogs rgyal ba rin po che sdod thabs med/de 'dra yin dus mi'i nang la 'gan 'khur mkhan de yang rim pas 'phos nas 'gro dgos/ rgyal ba rin po che gcig pur blos bkal te bsdad na nyin gcig glo bur la med pa zhig chags na/ de mtshams 'gro stangs ma shes pa chags rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ nga na rgas rji rdib ma chags gong la nga tsho'i las ga'i 'gan khur mkhan tsho yang go sgrig byas te da lta'i bka' shag gi nang bka' blon mang du btang ba dang / las ga'i 'gan khur mang che ba de bka' shag rang gis khur dgos kyi 'dug ces lo bco lnga nyi shu'i gong nas bshad pa yin/ da lta nas rtsa 547

ba'i 'gan khur mkhan zhig yod na/ nga ga dus yin na'i 'di gar yod yod pa red/ chos sam/ srid/ yang na rig gzhung gang gi thad la phan sgogs byed rgyu'i thad nga 'di gar yod yod pa red/ yin na'ang nga yod med la ma ltos par sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog nas 'gan gtsang ma 'khyer thub pa zhig byung na/de'i thog la nga yod pa de dpal dang rgyan chags pa red/ gal te nga med na'ang 'gan 'khyer thub kyi yod pa red/ de ltar min par tshang ma nga'i thog 'gan bskur bzhag pa yin na/ nga yod pa'i ring 'dir ga tshod thub thub byed kyi red de/ nga med pa'i nyin mo der dum ste chad rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug gnas tshul de tshor brten nas ngas bsam blo de 'dra gtong gi yod/dper na/ sngon ma ghan rdi la cha bzhag na'ang rgya gar rang btsan rtsod pa'i skabs thugs 'gan ga༄ ༄1 bzhes te so so'i grub 'bras thon pa'i rjes su kho rang rgya gar gzhung gi nang ma bzhugs par spyir btang gi smu'i gras su bzhugs pa red/ nga rang yang nga tsho'i gnas stangs thog thag gcod gang la gang 'tshams shig byung ba yin na ngas gzhung nang gi 'gan ma 'khur bar zur du bsdad/'on kyang chos srid gang gi thad la yin na'ang phan thogs bya rgyu yod pa byas/ zur du sgor pa spyi mos yod pa zhig byas te bsdad bsam gyi 'dug ngas gzhung nang gi 'gan 'khur gyi min zer ba de'i bsam tshul dang rgyu mtshan de 'dra yin/ der gnad 'gag 'dug gam/ 'grigs 'dug gam/ ngas de la gnad 'gagayod par brtsis pa yin/ khyed rang tshos bltas na de la gnad 'gag 'dug gam mi 'dugargya mi'i ngos nas ngas gros 'go bton pa der mos mthun yode zer bshad 548

pa yin na don du rang btsan ngos len byas pa'i bzo 'dra por 'gro gi yod pa red/ de ltar rgya mis bshad thub kyi ma red/ yang ma red ces bshad na/ nga tsho rgya nag dang 'brel ba dang po byung ba'i nyin der ting sha'o thing gis rang btsan ma shod/ de min ga re shod rgyu yod na'ang 'grigs kyi red ces lab pa yin dus/ 'grigs kyi red ces lab na'ang ma bde ba zhig dang / 'grigs kyi ma red ces lab na'ang ma ran pa'i bzo 'dra zhig chags kyi yod pa red/ ngas skad cha bshad pa de dngos 'brel gnas tshul yin/ bod rgya mi'i ma red/ bod rang btsan ni red/ yin na'ang da lta'i gnas tshul la nga tshor rang btsan byed 'dod kyang rang btsan yong gi yog ma red/ bod yongs rdzogs rgya mis mnan tshar ba red/ de'i 'og nas ga tshod thub thub kyi khe phan sgrub thabs byed rgyu de yin dus da lta rgya mir khag mi 'dug kyang / rim bzhin skad cha shod rgyu zhig mi yong ngam bsam pa 'dug 'on kyang thag chod pa zhig bshad thub kyi ma red/rgya mis ga 'dra byed kyi 'dug nga cho'i ngos nas gu bshangs byed rgyu med na ma gtogs gang yong byas pa red/ de lhag nga tshor byed rgyu bsdad yog ma red/rgya mi'i ngos nas da lta gros 'char bton pa de la gu bshangs ga re byed min blta rgyu red/ gal te de'i thog la rgya mis bsam blo btang rgyu med na nga tshor de las lhag pa'i gu bshangs byed rgyu bsdad med/ nga tshos rgya mir khe phan sprod rgyu med na ma gtogs yod tshad sprad tshar ba red/ de las mang ba zhig sprod thabs med/ spyir btang 'dzam gling mang gtso'i lung pa'i nang la cha bzhag na'ang rtsa ba mang gtso'i gzhung yin stabs mi mang gi 'dod pa gzhir bzung thog nas 549

gzhung srid 'dzin dgos mkhan gyi gzhung gci ga yin na'ang / skabs re mi mang gi bsam tshul dang ma ran pa zhig yong dus kha thug kha thug gi khe phan 'a/ bltas te lag len 'gel dgos pa de 'dra yong gi yod pa red/ de ni chos nyid red/ de ltar yin dus nub phyogs rgyal khab khag nang yod pa'i bod mi rgan gzhon mang po zhig gis gros 'char de thabs skyo po byung 'dug ces shod kyi yod pa dang / rgya gar nang cha bzhag na'ang bod mi tsho blo pham chen po yod pa'i bzo lta 'dug de 'dra'i blo pham yong srid la/ yong dgos pa zhig kyang red/ der brten mi mang gis thob thang rtsod pa dang / so so'i bsam tshul 'don rgyu de gal chen po red/ yin na'ang sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'gan 'khyer mkhan gyi cha nas sems shugs dang / bsam tshul gcig pus mi 'grigs par dngos yod lag len gyi thog nas ji tsam sgrub thub min bltas te gom pa ma rgyag rma/thu med red/ 'gan 'khyer mkhan gyi cha nas bsam blo gtong stangs gcig dang /mi mang gi phyogs nas sems shugs kyi bden don 'thab rtsod byed phyogs gcig yong gi red/ de gnyis po phran bu mi mthun pa chags yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra rang bzhin gyis chags rgyu red/ de 'dra yin dus khyed rang tshos gsal po shes pa byas/ bsam blo brtan brtan btang / gal che shos rgya mi'i ngos nas da lta ngas bton pa der ga chod kyi bsam blo gtong gi 'dug de la dpag pa'i nga rang tshos kyang bsam blo gtong dgos/ rim pas rim pas gsal du 'gro gi red/ shes song ngam/ tshang mar bkra shis bde legs yod/ zhes rgyuskor// //550

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1989 zla 7 tshes 16 nyin/ a ri lo sirmen ji li sir dus 'khor dbang chen zhu bar bcar ba'i rang rigs mang tshogs rnams la bka' slob bka' drin stsal ba/tshang mar bkra shis bde legs yod/ bar lam bod nang rgya mi'i srid byus gdug rtsub che ru gong ste mtha' ma dmag khrims lag len bstar nas da lta mu mthud de gnas yod/ skabs der shin tu dza drag gi gnas tshul byung ste mi mang po zhig 'dzin bzung byas pa dang / khyim tshang mang po'i nang dmag mi 'dzulanas bsngogs bsher gyis gang byung me mda' brgyab nas khyim tshang kha shas kyi nang mi rgan gzhon dbye ba med par bsad 'dug khyim tshang gnyis tsam gyi pha ma dang phru gu bcasanang mi tshang ma bsad gnas shod kyi 'dug zhib phra'i gsal spro zhig shes ma song / khyim tshang gcig nang rgya mi'i dmag mi 'dzul nas rngam ston khrom skor na nga zhugs mkhan mi zhig der gab bsdad yod pa de bzung nas 'then yong skabs khyim bdaga.a ma rgan mo zhig yod pa des rgya dmag la zhu ba 'then pa dang / de 'phral rgya dmag gisa.a ma de'i mgo la me mda' brgyab nas bsad pa dang / rgya dmag de'i rogs la bod mi skor srung dmag mi zhig yod pa des gnas tshul de bzod 'khur ma thub par rgya dmag der me mda' brgyab nas bsad pa red zer gyi 'dug bden pa yin min gsal po mi shes kyang /skabs der gdug rtsub chen po zhig byas yod 'dugagazhi rkang na ning nas go thos byung bar rgya nag gi dpon rigs tsho'i nang bsam 'char khag gnyis la gyes pa red zer/deyang dmag mi'i phyogs gtogs 551

de tshos bod la gdug rtsub kyis drag gnon byas na byed rgyu gang yang yod pa ma red/ 'jam po byas na bod pas sdod ma tshugs byed kyi red zer ba'i bsam tshul shugs chen po zhig bon gyi yod pa dang / yang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur sogs de tsho'i khongs kyi las byed pa tshos de 'dra byas na yag po yod pa ma red/ mu mthud srid byus lhug gtong byas na yag gi red bshad pa bcas bsam tshul khag gnyis byung ba pe cing phyogs nas thos byung la/ lha sa nas kyang thos byung / mjug tu drag shugs bed spyod byed dgos zer mkhan de tsho phal cher rgyal ba 'dra/ mtha' ma rgya nag nang la'ang gnas tshul de ga rang red/ kho rang tsho nang khul la yang drag shugs bed spyod byed rgyur ya nga bag tsha med par nga chog nad pa'i thog la drag shugs spyod dang spyod/ rgya nag nang la yang gnas tshul gdug rtsub chen po zhig lag len 'gel gyi yod pa red/kha sang lha sa'i nang dmag khrims btsugs rjes ldi lir yod pa'i rgya nag gi gzhung tshab brgyud nga tsho mu mthud 'brel ba byung / rtsa ba'i bod don thog la srid byus 'gyur ba gang yang med zer gyi 'dug de rjes nga rang 'di phyogs ma thon bar gnas tshul gsar pa gang yang ma byung / nga tsho'i ngos kyi gnas stangs ni rtsa ba'i cha nas don tshan lnga sngon ma bshad pa de dang / de'i rjes 'brel gyi rgya nag la mu mthud skad cha bshad rgyu de la 'gyur ba med/ yin na yang gnas stabs gcig rgya nag gzhung de rgya nag mi dmangs kyi tshab byed ma thub pa zhig dang / rgya nag mi dmangs ngo log pa'i gzhung zhig chags yod pa dang / tshur tsam 'dir rgya nag gi slob phrug dang / shes yon can tshos dngos gnas dmangs gtso dang 552

rang dbang dgos pa dang / de bzhin rgyu brngan rjes 'brangs kyi las ka byed stangs de tsho mi dgos zhes skad 'bod byas pa de yang dag pa red/ der brten slob phrug dang shes yon can tshor nga tshos gdung sems mnyam skye dang / rgyab skyor yod pa'i rnam pa ston rgyu de gal chen po 'dug de 'dra'i thog nas lam seng rgya nag gzhung la phar dmigs bsal 'brel ba byed bde med pa lta bu 'dug yin na'i gzhi rtsa'i thog 'gyur ba dmigs bsal gtong dgos don mi 'dug nga tsho'i lungs phyogs de ga rang 'gyur ba med par bsdad yod/sngon ma a me ri /ra zhi ba'i don tshan lnga bshad pa dang / de mjug yo rob gros tshogs la bod rgya'i dbar ma 'ongs par skad cha bshad na/ skad cha shod rgyu'i don tshan 'di 'dra yin zhes gros gzhi zhig bton pa red/ yin na'ang da lta dngos yod gnas tshul la lam seng rang dbang rang btsan gtsang ma zhig dgos kyi 'dug lab kyang shin tu khag po chags yod/ de 'dra'i ngang mu mthud lo bcu 'am/ nyi shu/ sum cu phyin pa yin na/ ngo thog bod yul rgya yul la 'gyur rgyu'i nyen kha chen po yod/ gnas skabs bod nang rgya mi gzhis chags pa yong rgyu mtshams chod pa zhig dang / bod chol kha gsum yongs kyi nang la nga rang chos dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun/ rig gzhung 'dzugs skrun/ slob sbyong skor sogs de tsho'i gras bod mi rang nyid kyis 'gan gtsang ma 'khyer nas tshags tshud po yag po zhig byed thub na/ da lta kha tsha lag thogs kyi don dag 'di'i sgang la thug yod stabs gnas skabs de 'dra zhig la bsam blo btang na (5ga po min nam zhes bsam tshul bshad thoni 'de 'drayin/ bsam tshul 'odeyang bar lam bsam 553

blo gsar pa 'khor ba zhig min/ sngon ma phyi lo drug cu dang bdun cu don grangs nang nas ma 'ongs par nga cho ༷/da pa'i bden don mtha' gsal stangs gang 'dra zhig thog nas gsal yong / yang 'dzam gling la 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung nas des rgya nag la'ang 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung ste de 'dra'i thog nasayong dang / yang rgya nag khyon yongs la 'gyur ba zhig ma phyin kyang nang khul srid byus la 'gyur ba byung ste de 'dra'i thog nas yong / yang rgya dkar nag rgyal khab phan tshun gyi gnas stangs 'gyur ba'i thog nas yong srid pa bcas de ltar phyi nang gi gnas tshul 'gyur 'gros la gzhigs pa'i nga tsho'i ngos nas byed phyogs 'di 'dra'i thog nas yong srid/ de 'dra'i thog nas yong srid/ yang na 'di 'dra byas te yong srid ces go bsdur byed skabs bsam tshul mang po yong gi 'dug bsam 'char gcig gi nang la bod chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i bod rang skyong rang dbang chen po yod pa zhig yong srid pa red ces de dus nas nga tshos bshad yod/bar lam phyi lo 1987 lo lha sar gnas tshul byung ba dang / de bzhin bod nang phyi rgyal lta skor 'gro mkhan mang po byung ba de tsho'i thog nas kyang khyab bsgrags chin po byas pa'i gnas tshu la yod dus/ da cha phal cher gnas tshul de gsal po bzos na/ phyogs gcig nas rgya nag la bdun cu don brgyad kyi lo mjag dang / don dgu tsam nas 'brel ba byas te lo bcu tsam song yod/ byas tsadro gnas tshul de bton rgyu'i dus tshod ran po min nam zhes bton pa red/ yin na'ang bsam tshul 'di'i thog la bod mi mang po zhig gis tan tan blo pham byed kyi red ces thog ma nas tshod dpag byas yod/ tshod dpag byas pa ltar gnas 554

blo gsar pa 'khor ba zhig min/ sngon ma phyi lo drug cu dang bdun cu don grangs nang nas ma 'ongs par nga cho ༷/da pa'i bden don mtha' gsal stangs gang 'dra zhig thog nas gsal yong / yang 'dzam gling la 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung nas des rgya nag la'ang 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung ste de 'dra'i thog nasayong dang / yang rgya nag khyon yongs la 'gyur ba zhig ma phyin kyang nang khul srid byus la 'gyur ba byung ste de 'dra'i thog nas yong / yang rgya dkar nag rgyal khab phan tshun gyi gnas stangs 'gyur ba'i thog nas yong srid pa bcas de ltar phyi nang gi gnas tshul 'gyur 'gros la gzhigs pa'i nga tsho'i ngos nas byed phyogs 'di 'dra'i thog nas yong srid/ de 'dra'i thog nas yong srid/ yang na 'di 'dra byas te yong srid ces go bsdur byed skabs bsam tshul mang po yong gi 'dug bsam 'char gcig gi nang la bod chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i bod rang skyong rang dbang chen po yod pa zhig yong srid pa red ces de dus nas nga tshos bshad yod/bar lam phyi lo 1987 lo lha sar gnas tshul byung ba dang / de bzhin bod nang phyi rgyal lta skor 'gro mkhan mang po byung ba de tsho'i thog nas kyang khyab bsgrags chin po byas pa'i gnas tshu la yod dus/ da cha phal cher gnas tshul de gsal po bzos na/ phyogs gcig nas rgya nag la bdun cu don brgyad kyi lo mjag dang / don dgu tsam nas 'brel ba byas te lo bcu tsam song yod/ byas tsadro gnas tshul de bton rgyu'i dus tshod ran po min nam zhes bton pa red/ yin na'ang bsam tshul 'di'i thog la bod mi mang po zhig gis tan tan blo pham byed kyi red ces thog ma nas tshod dpag byas yod/ tshod dpag byas pa ltar gnas 554

tshul yongs grags byed skabs/ phyi la yod pa'i bod pa tsho'i nang nas blo pham byed mkhan mang po 'dug la/ de bzhin bod nang nas kyang blo pham byed mkhan yong gi 'dug yin na'ang spyir btang 'dzam gling gang du yin yang mi mang la sgo so'i drang bden gyi thob thang rtsod pa'i langs phyogs shig yong gi yod la/ yang dngos yod gnas tshul la 'gan 'khyer mkhan tshos 'grub stod dpag tshod kyi bsam blo gtong dgos pa'i 'gro stangs shig kyang lung pa gang sar yod pa ltar nga tsho'i gnas stangs kyang de 'dra zhig red/ mi mang gi ngos nas so so'i bsam tshul ltar bden pa'i thob thang rtsod len byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ rtsa ba nga'i yig cha'i nang la gsal po bkod yod/ mtha' ma'i thag gcod bod rgya che'i mi mang gis byed kyi red ma gtogs/ nga mi gcig gis brgya kha gcig gcod byed thub thabs med ces bshad yod/ sngon la rgya mi'i thog nas bsam blo ga tshod gtong gi 'dug ma lan ma 'gyod kyi thabs shes gang yang byed dgos pa red/ bod rgya khongs red lab pa rtsa ba nas med/ bod rang btsan yin pa dang /rgya bod so soyin pa bshadaskusad/ yin na'ang dngos yod kyi dka' ngal sel ba'i don la nga tshos dmag brgyab pa yin na rgyal kha thob pa dka'/ 'dzam gling rgyal khab gzhan gyis 11da pa'i tshab byas te dmag ni mi rgyag des na rgya mi dang mnyam du skad cha bshad de 'grigs thabs kyi bsam blo gtong rgyu ma gtogs/ de min gyi thabs shes med/ rgya mi mnyam du skad cha shod rgyu'i bsam blo gtong dgos na/ rgya mi'i ngos la yang phran bu blta sa yod pa zhig dang / nga tsho bod pa'i ngos 'a/'ang blta sa yod pa zhig dgos pa chos nyid red/ bod rgya mis dbang 555

shugs la brten nas btsan bzung byas pa red/ gnas tshul de'i 'og nas nga tsho ma 'ongs par gang 'dra zhig byed kyi yin zer na/ mnyam du bsdad de gnyis kur khe phan yod pa'i bsam blo zhig gtong gi yod/ mi mang gi ngos nas khyed rang tshor bsam tshul yong gi yod pa ltar de bton nas so so'i bden pa'i thob thang mu mthud rtsod rgyu gal chen po red/ yang dngosayod lag len gyi thog phyogs gang sa nas ma lan ma 'gyod kyi thabs shes byas pa yin na/ phyin chad bsam blo gtong yul zhig yong gi red/ de yang gnad 'gag cig med dam bsam gyi 'dugasngon ma nas ngas phyi rgyal la yong skabs rtag para.a ri dang / yo rob khul sogs layod pa'i bod mi tshor rgya mi'i slob phrug dang shes yon can de tshor nga tshos go skabs nam byung la 'brel gtugs byas te khong sto dang grogs po ngo shes byed dgos bshad yod/ lhag par da lta'i dus tshod 'di shin tu bzang spro zhig chags 'dug rgya nag gzhung gis ham rdzun ga tshad shod kyi yod med rgya mi'i nang kho rang tsho'i rang gi nyams myong thog nas shin tu gsal po ra 'phrod byung ba yin tsang / bod pa'i gnas tshul gyi thog la da phan rgya nag gzhung gis skad cha bshad pa de dag kyag rdzun gung sgrig nas shod kyi yod pa rang bzhin gyis ngos 'dzin thub kyi yod 'dugakha sang nga ni'u yog la sdod skabs rgya mi tsho khag gnyis thug byung / slob gra ba khag gcig dang / gsar 'god mkhan khag gcig 'dug khong tsho'i nang nas mi gnyis gsum zhig gis nga la brjod don/ sngon ma bod pa'i gnas tshul 556

gyi thog la de tsam gyi do snang med la shes kyi yang med/ da cha pe cing du so so rang gi thog la nyams myong byung ba yin dus/ bod pa'i thog la do snang dang mthong tshul gsar pa zhig slebs song zhes shugs chen po brjod kyi 'dug de 'dra brjod mkhan gzhan dag kyang mang po yod pa shod mkhan byung / rgya mi'i slob grwa ba de tsho'i gras khong rang tshos tshur do snang ma byas par g.yol bsdad na de ni gnas tshul tha dad red/ de min nga rang tsho'i ngos nas 'brel ba mthud de bod pa'i bden don gnas tshul skad cha shod rgyu ha cang gal chen po 'dug gang du yin nam mtho slob zhig la nga tsho'i ngo shes pa gcig gnyis kyis legs sbyar gtong sar rgya mi'i slob phrug de 'dra yod 'dug bod kyi skor legs sbyar btang tshar ba'i rjes la slob phrug kha shasayarayong ste bod pa la rang btsan gyi thob thang dgos pa red/bod kyi gnas tshul gang 'dra yin da lta bar shes ma byung / da cha phyi rgyal lung par slebs te gnas tshul gsal po shes dus/ bod rang btsan red 'dug rang btsan gyi thob thang nges par yod dgos kyi 'dug ces shod mkhan kha shas byung 'dugakha sangasang lan la rgya mi'i slob phrug stong phrag bzhi tsam zhig gis rngam ston khrom skor byas pa dang / rgya nag gzhung la yi ge don tshan dgu yod pa zhig sprad pa'i don tshan brgyad pa'i nang grangs nyung mi rigs tshang mar rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang sprod dgos zhes bkod 'dug cing / grangs nyung mi rigs tshang mar rang thag rang gcod sprod dgos bshad dus bod pa ma yin rang yin red/ bod pa grangs nyung mi rigs zer ba'i nang nas shugs che shos yin la/557

'dzam gling gi do snang che shos kyang yin/ rgya mi'i slob phrug khong rang tsho'i nang nas grangs nyung mi rigs la rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang sprod dgos kyi 'dug ces gzhung la yi ge sprad pa 'di rtsa ba chen po mthong gi 'dug rgya nag la nye dus gnas tshul byung ba de da cha phal cher phan med phyin pa red/ yin na'ang gnas tshul des rgya nag mi mang gi bsam cho'i nang brjed dka' ba'i 'khon 'dzin zhig slebs yod par brten ring por mi thogs par rgya nag nang rim pas rim pas rgya nag gung khran tang gi mi tshe myur du rdzogs rgyu'i cha rkyen ched mngags bzos pa lta bu yin pas 'gyur ba 'gro gi red/ de yang lo gcig gnyis zhes brjod mi thub rung / lo lnga drug bcu grangs nang 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi red/ der brten rgya nag gi ma 'ongs pa de da lta log spyod par brtsis pa'i slob phrug gzhon skyes de tsho'i lag par slebs rgyu red/ rgya mi spo'o lags de tsho mu mthud nas bskal pa khri khrag nas khri phrag bar brtan par shog lab kyang sdod thub kyi ma red/lo lnga drug bdun brgyad las sdod thabs med/ der brten nga tshos phyags rgyang ring po dang / phyogs mang wa'i thad nas bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug yang dngos yod kyi gnas tshul 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung ste dus tshod gsar pa zhig shar ba yin na de ni gnas tshul tha dad red/ rgya nag gzhung rtsa ba mu mthud nas brtan po byas bsdad pa yin na/ mi dang mi'i brtse ba dang / mi dang mi'i 'brel ba/ mi dang mi'i 'du shes bcas slebs pa yin na nga tsho bde sdug bshad hūṃ yong gi red/ nga tshos rgya mi rigs la ngo rgol byed kyi med/ rgya mi rigs la sdug pa zhig byung rogs byas na snyam pa dran gyi med/ nga tshos bsam pa rnam dag byas 558

nas sngar chos rgyal tsho'i skabs rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul na skyid gsungs pa bzhin rgya mir bde skyid dgos la/ bod par yang bde skyid dgos/ rgya mi'i bde skyid kyi don la bod pa'i bde skyid blos btang na 'grig gi ma red/ nga tsho bod pa'i bde skyid kyi don la rgya mir sdug pa zhig byung rogs byas na bsam tshe nor ba red/ nga rang tshos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i snu sa kyi thog nas sems can thams cad ces smon lam rgyag gi yod/ sems can thams cad ces pa'i nang rgya mi los sku(da/ ngas rgya mi thug dus tshang mar bod pas rgya mi rigs la ngo rgol byed dgos don med ces rtag par brjod kyi yod/ 'dod kyang rung / ma 'dod kyang rung nga tsho lo stong phrag ring gshibs te bsdad yod/ skabs re 'khrug pa brgyab yod la/ skabs re 'cham sngoge byas nas bsdad yod/ ma 'ongs par cha bzhag na rgya mis bod pa ma 'dod kyang bod pa dang gshibs te sdod rgyu dang / bod pas rgya mi ma 'dod kyang rgya mi dang gshibs te sdod rgyu red/ nga tsho phan tshun khyim mtshes byas nas gshibs te sdod dgos pa'i rjes la 'cham po zhig byung na bde skyid yong rgyu red/ 'dzam bu gling spyi yongs la 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod/ dper na/ dmar po'i rgyal khaba.u ru su'i nang 'gyur ba chen po gang 'dra 'gro gi mi 'dug gam/ de bzhin po lan ḍi dang / tang gha ri'i rgyal khab de tshor 'gyur ba gang 'dra 'gro gi mi 'dug gam/ lo gsum bzhi'i gong blo yul la med pa'i 'gyur ba deng sang dngos su 'gro gi yod/ de yong ba'i gzhi rtsa ni mi la rang bzhin lhan skyes su yod pa'i rang dbang la dga' po dang drang bden la dga' po byed pa'i bsam khro de yin/ nga tshos ga re shod kyi yod dam zhe na/ bde skyid dang 559

rang dbang dgos shod kyi yod/ rgya mi drang po drang bzhag byed mkhan zhig yin na de sus kyang shod kyi red la/ shod pa'i thob thang yang yod pa red/ rang rer rgya mi'i slob phrug de 'dra thug rgyu'i go skabs byung ba'i skabs la rgya mi gcigayin yang bod pa'i bden don gnas tshul rnams shod rgyu gal chen po yin/de nas don tshan gcig la/ nye lam yo rob gros tshogs la bshad pa'i skad cha'i nang gsal po bkod yod/ ma 'ongs par 'os bsdu byas pa'i mang ga'i gzhung gi nang ngas 'gan 'khyer gyi min zhes bris yod/ de ni bsam btang dran skyes kyi bsam blo gsar pa zhig ma red/ rtsa ba nga tsho mang gatsho'i lam la 'gro dgos pa zhig sngon ma nas bsam blor yod/ gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul bshad na/nga tsho bod la yod pa'i skabs nas bod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs la sgyur bcos 'gro dgos pa dang / nga tsho'i byed stangs mang po zhig rjes lus kyi rnam pa yin pa gsal poskudad par brten nga tshos bsam gzhigs byas te legs bcos las khungs zhes pa zhig btsugs nas/ sngon la khral chag dang bun chag gtong ba'i las ka gang 'tshams byas pa khyed tsho rgan pa tshos sdud pes red/ yin na'ang rgya mi slebs tshar rjes nga tshos bsgyur bcos shugs chen po zhig gtong bar phyin na rgya mis de la ngo rgol bya rgyu'i gnas tshul rnyog 'dzings chen po zhig gidus rdzo slebs yod/ gang ltar nga tshos rnying pa'i byed stangs mang po zhig bsgyur bcos gtong dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byas yod/ rgya gar la slebs rjes phyi lo 1960lor mi mang spyi 'thus bsdus pa dang / 1961 lo mang gtso'i rtsa khrims bzos pa de tsho rgya mi la kha gtad gcog ched gsar du bzos pa zhig ma red/bod 560

mi nang khul nas mang gtso byed dgos shod mkhan su gcig med/ yin na'ang nga tsho tshang mas bsam pa rnam dag gi thog nas 'dzam gling spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs kyi mang gtso bya rgyu shin tu gal chen por ngos 'dzin bya sa pa yin/ de snga phyi lo lnga bcu nga bdun nga brgyad nang lha sar sdod skabs drung yig chen mo lha sding mdzod spug do dam mkhan cher 'phos yod/ nyin gcig nga rang spyan bsal gling khar bskyod de khong dang skad cha byung / khong nas nga rang tshos rtsa khrims shig bzo dgos/nga tsho'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro stangs 'di 'dra yin zhes yig cha'i rtsa khrims shig byung ba yin na/ mi su yin kyang blta gi red la/ mthong rgyu yod pa zhig yong gi red/de gal chen po red gsungs byung / de dus nas bsam blo gtong gi yod/ de nas drug cu re gcig lor rtsa khrims snying bsdus shig bton pa de'i nang 7rgyal ba rin po che'i dbang char bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu zhes pa zhig bkod yod/ de mjug drug cu re gsum lor༄ rtsa khrims rgyas pa de bton pa red/ de'i nang don tshan gcig la 7rgyal ba rin po che'i dbang cha tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi sum gnyis kyi mos mthun thog nas bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu zhes pa zhig bkod yod/ de ni mang gtso'i ngo bo gtso bo marān pa'i ched du red/ drug cu re dgu'i lo gsum bcu'i dus dran gyi gsung bshad nang / bod kyi don dag 'di bod mi sa ya drug gi don dag red ma gtogs/ de nga tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs spyi'i skad cha dang /tā la'i bla ma'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi don dag ma red/ tā la'i bla ma'i 'gro stangs mu mthud gnas dang mi gnas de bod rgya che'i mi mang gi 'dod pas thag gcod byed dgos zhes gsal po bkod/ de ltar shod dgos don ni nga tshos bsam pa 561

rnam dag gis ma 'ongs par mang gtso'i thog 'gro rgyu'i ched du bshad pa red/ kha sang yo rob gros tshogs la'ang don dag da ga mu mthud de skad cha bshad pa red ma gtogs/ rgya mi mnyam du skad cha shod pa'i gnas tshul gsar pa zhig gi 'og la bsam btang dran skyes byas nas skad cha gsar pa bshad pa ma red/'di lo wa ra ṇa sir chos tshogs tshogs chen thog 'grel bshad rob tsam byed rgyu byung / de rjes nye char rda ram sa lar las bsdoms tshogs chen 'tshogs skabs kyang 'grel bshad zhib phra byas pa yin/ nga tsho ma 'ongs par mang gatsho'i thog la 'gro dgos zer ba 'di kha mkhas 'dra chags bshad pa min/ lung pa gang dang gang zhig yin yang yar rgyas 'gro ba la tshang ma spyi rub kyi thog nas nus pa 'don rgyu 'di yar rgyas 'gro ba'i rtsa ba yin/ gung khran ring lugs kyi lung pa mang po zhig yar rgyas 'gro mi thub pa de gang la thug pa red zer na/ 'go khrid med pa ma red/ sgrig 'dzugs med pa ma red/ skul mkhan med pa ma red/skul mkhan yod pa'i nang nas bka' btsan thag chod dang / sgrig 'dzugs dam thag chod yod/ yin na'ang mi dmangs so sos dang du blangs nas rang 'gul gyi nus pa 'don rgyu'i go skabs med pa red/ de ma bton pa'i nyer len gyis dmar po'i lung pa tsho rtag par rjes lus thebs kyi yod/ rang dbang mang gtso'i lung pa'i nang la rgyab nas rgyug pa 'khyer te 'ded mkhan med la/ btsan dbang shod mkhan yang med/ yin na yang mi mang nas rang 'gul gyi nus pa bed spyod byed kyi sku(da pa yin dus yar rgyas 'gro gi yod/ lung pa gang zhig yin yang yar rgyas 'gro bar yul mi mi re ngo res sems khur blangs te rang 'gul gyi nus shugs 562

'don dgos/ de 'dra yong ba la rang dbang yod na nus shugs 'don gyi red/rang dbang med par bka' bkod gtong mkhan zhig yod na le ma thogs tsam zhig byed pa las/ de lhag gi sems khur len gyi med/ lung pa yar rgyas dang /spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro ba la mi re ngo res nus pa 'don dgos/ nus pa 'don pa'i go skabs dang thob thang zhig yod dgos pa red/ der brten mang gtso zhes pa 'di don ngo ma'i thog yar rgyas 'gro ba'i rtsa ba chags yod/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i spyir nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang / yang sgos theg pa chen po'i chos 'di mang gtso'i lta ba dang shin tu mthun po yod/ snubs kyi to/ga nas bshad na'ang 'dra/ lung pa yar rgyas kyi thog nas bshad na'ang 'dra/ mang gtso zhes pa 'di shin tu gal chen po yin/ bod nang cha bzhag na bar lam rgya mis ched mngags go skabs bzung nas nga tshos 'dir bod rang dbang gi don la rtsod len byed pa'i las 'gul byas pa 'di spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar gso byed pa'i dmigs yul red ces ched du 'khyog bshad byed kyi yod/ de ltar 'khyog bshad byed dgos don ni/ mi su zhig la spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar gso byed kyi 'dug ces lab na rna bar 'gro po zhig yong gi med pa yin tsang khag de la bzhag ste bshad na/ tā la'i bla mas mtshon pa'i phyi la yod pa'i bod mis rang dbang gi don la las 'gul byas pa der dri ma nag po zhig byug thub bsams nas de 'dra'i re ba rgyag gi yod pa red/ dper na/mtho rim mi sna kraca dmi yang gis kyang skad cha 'di 'dra bshad pa red ces rgya mi kho rang tsho nang khul nas blo pham chen po byed kyi 'dug kra'o tsi yang nga tsho'i dmag 563

spyi zhig gis skad cha mgo ma 'tshos snang bar mi 'gro ba shod kyi 'dug de ni lkug pa red ces rgya mi'i slob phrug tsho'i nang nas shod mkhan byung / bod nang gsar brjer dga' po byed mkhan tan tan yong gi red/ nga tshos nges par du mang gtso byed dgos/mang gtso dngos gnas byed dgos na/ ngas kha sang las bsdoms tshogs 'du'i thog 'di 'dra bshad pa yin/ so nam grong par dpe ltos zer ba bzhin bar lam nas gung khran gyi lung pa tshos gang 'dra byed kyi mi 'dug gam/dper na/ u ru sur cha bzhag na/ mang gtso byed dgos kyi 'dug ces shod kyi yod/ 'on kyang de dag chol 'grigs la ma 'grigs shig rtag par yong gi yod pa de gang la thug zer na/ tshogs pa gcig gi dbang char bstun dgos pa der thug pa red/ tshogs pa gcig gi dbang cha de la do rwa1ga ma thebs pa'i thog nas mang gtso byed dgos zhes lab na de ni yong thabs med pa zhig red/dpe de bzhin du nga tshos tshur phyogs 'dir 7rgyal ba rin po ches chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po red ces shod pa 'dir bsgyur bcos shig ma btang na/ nga tsho'i mang gca de yang lhan pa brgyab pa lta bu zhig ma gtogs yong gi ma red/ 7rgyal ba rin po che chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po red shod pa 'dir bsgyur bcos shig btang ste/ bod kyi 'go khrid de dngos gnas tshad ldan gyi 'os pesdu byas te yar slebs rgyu'i lam lugs shig bzos pa yin na/ spyi 'gre'i lam nas 7rgyal ba rin po che 'go khrid la slebs pa yin na yang khyad par gang yang mi 'dug de min 7rgya la ba rin kro ce'i yang srid ngos 'dzin byas rjes chos srid gnyis kyi bdag 564

po red bshad pa de ma 'grigs pa zhig red/ nga chos mang gtso byed 'dod yod/de ltar mang gtso yag po zhig yong ba la/ rtsa ba'i lam lugs der sgyur bcos gtong snying ma 'dod par bsdad pa'i 'og nas mang gtso bzo gi man zhes ji tsam byas kyang cha mi tshang ba zhig chags kyi yod pa red/ ma gzhi nga rang tshos 7rgyal ba ri na po che zhes brjod pa ni btsan dbang gi thog nas bshad pa ma yin par/ rang bzhin spyi mos kyi thog nas byung ba red/ hob ste lta dus 'dra po yod na yang / ma 'ongs par 7rgyal ba rin po che chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po red zer ba 'di bsgyur bcos gtong dgos/ bsgyar bcos btang nas 'go khrid lte ba de 'os /sdu'i thog nas yong rgyu yod pa skog bzo dgos/ yin na yang 'di dag ran dang ma ran/ byed phyogs gang 'dra zhig byed dgos kyi 'dug dang mi 'dug nga sto go bsdur zhig byas/ tshogs chung zhig btsugs na yag po red bshad pa yin/ de'i thog tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi mang po zhig gis blo pham chen po byed kyi 'dug la/ gtso che shos gnas tshul de bod nang slebs kyi red/ bod nang slebs dus mang gtso'i ngo bo dang / mtshan nyid/ khyad chos bcas gsal po zhig ma rtogs pa'i gnas tshul chosag nas da 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku dbang la bsgyur bcos 'gro gi yod pa red/ 7rgyal ba rin po ches khur len gyi yod pa ma red ces de 'dra'i mthong tshul dang go 'dzol thebs na bod nang mi mang po zhig gi blo pham byed rgyu dang / nyen kha 'dug ces bshad pa red/ gnas tshul zhib phra dang gnad 'gag ma shes na hob ste kha la ya mtshan skye srid/ skabs der hong kong khul tshags par kha shas thog 7rgyal ba rin po 565

po red bshad pa de ma 'grigs pa zhig red/ nga chos mang gtso byed 'dod yod/de ltar mang gtso yag po zhig yong ba la/ rtsa ba'i lam lugs der sgyur bcos gtong snying ma 'dod par bsdad pa'i 'og nas mang gtso bzo gi man zhes ji tsam byas kyang cha mi tshang ba zhig chags kyi yod pa red/ ma gzhi nga rang tshos 7rgyal ba ri na po che zhes brjod pa ni btsan dbang gi thog nas bshad pa ma yin par/ rang bzhin spyi mos kyi thog nas byung ba red/ hob ste lta dus 'dra po yod na yang / ma 'ongs par 7rgyal ba rin po che chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po red zer ba 'di bsgyur bcos gtong dgos/ bsgyar bcos btang nas 'go khrid lte ba de 'os /sdu'i thog nas yong rgyu yod pa skog bzo dgos/ yin na yang 'di dag ran dang ma ran/ byed phyogs gang 'dra zhig byed dgos kyi 'dug dang mi 'dug nga sto go bsdur zhig byas/ tshogs chung zhig btsugs na yag po red bshad pa yin/ de'i thog tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi mang po zhig gis blo pham chen po byed kyi 'dug la/ gtso che shos gnas tshul de bod nang slebs kyi red/ bod nang slebs dus mang gtso'i ngo bo dang / mtshan nyid/ khyad chos bcas gsal po zhig ma rtogs pa'i gnas tshul chosag nas da 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku dbang la bsgyur bcos 'gro gi yod pa red/ 7rgyal ba rin po ches khur len gyi yod pa ma red ces de 'dra'i mthong tshul dang go 'dzol thebs na bod nang mi mang po zhig gi blo pham byed rgyu dang / nyen kha 'dug ces bshad pa red/ gnas tshul zhib phra dang gnad 'gag ma shes na hob ste kha la ya mtshan skye srid/ skabs der hong kong khul tshags par kha shas thog 7rgyal ba rin po 565

ches dbang cha dang las 'gan 'jog gi yod pa red/ las 'gan 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan chab srid kyi gnad don la thug gi yod lugs de 'dra kha shas bkod 'dug de tsho'i gras 'di gzugs med grib bzo dang / dogs pa rnam rtog gis bshad pa red/ nga ni de 'dra min/ ngas ni bsam pa rnam dag gi mang gtso yag po zhig dang / tshags tshud po zhig byung na bsam te bshad pa yin ma gtogs/ nga zhum pa skyes nas phyir 'then brgyab pa yang min/ nga'i re 'dun ni gnad 'gag cig la thug ste bshad pa yin zhes las bsdoms tshogs chen thog bshad pa yin/ lnga bcu nga grangs nas drug cu re grangs/ de nas bdun cu don grangs/ brgyad cu gya grangs la slebs dus gnas tshul dus la gtugs yong gi 'dug 'dod kyang rung ma 'dod kyang rung / gog po brgyab nas 'gro rgyu red ma gtogs thabs shes mi 'dug da lta 7rgyal ba rin po che ma rgas rji ma rdib pa'i gong nas ma 'ongs pa'i mang gtso'i 'gro stangs gas la 11 gtan 'bebs yag po zhig byas te lag len bkal nas goms 'dris shig byung thub na/ mtha' ma nga'i mi tshe gang du slebs kyang / las don byed stangs chu bo ltar rgyug lam byang zhig byung na ga re byas kyang 'gal rkyen nyung ba'i bzo zhig mthong gi 'dug snga phyi ma gtogs nga med pa chags rgyu red/ med pa chags skabs la 'tshab 'tshub byas na/ de'i bar nas gnas tshul 'dra min yong srid pa red/ ngas da lta nas mang gtso'i bsam slo gtong ngagos kyi 'dug ces bshad pa 'di nga tsho'i las ka tshags tshud po zhig dang / spus dag po/ yag po nus pa thon che ba zhig byung na bsam nas bshad pa ma gtogs/566

ngas phyir 'then brgyab pa ma red ces skabs de gar bshad yod/ gnas tshul de 'di khul khyed tshos kyang phran bu thos yod dam snyam gyi 'dug bar lam bod nas rgya gar du 'byor ba ha lam mi stong phrag bzhi lhag tsam zhig yod pa de nas slob gra khag la phru gu stong phrag gnyis tsam dang / gra sa khag la stong phrag gnyis tsam/ slob gra'i sku( tshad mo la zhing / gra sa khag la 'gro mkhan min pa nyis brgya tsam zhig sbir gzhis chags nang slob gra btsugs te slob sbyong sprod kyi yod/rtsa ba'i bod khyon yongs kyi gnas tshul ha las pa 'dug 'on kyang sa khul grong gseb khug kyog 'ga' zhig la de snga'i spyi tshogs nang 'u lag rgyugs mkhan kha shas la ba phyug re zung dang / tshal zhing phran bu thob nas khyim tshang 'dzin rgyu yod par brten deng sang skyid po 'dug sngon ma nga tshor gang yang med shod mkhan kha shas yong gi yod sa red/ de min bod pa spyi bo gnam bstan tshang ma rgya dmar zer dus sems kyi zhe la brgyab nas/ mi tshang de la med ces sna 'tshig nas bsdad 'dug lhag don gzhon skyes tsho shin tu sems shugs chen po 'dug bar lam mdo smad khul nas gzhon skyes de 'dra slebs byung / rtsa ba'i grangs ka nyung nyung red kyang / de tsho rgya nag gi pe cing mtho rim slob grwa dang / lan kru'u'i mtho rim slob grwa sogs nas thon te gyong thag chod 'dugargya mi'i mtho rim slob grwa 'grims kyang do snang byed sa bod yig la byas nas snyan sum sogs sbyangs 'dug kha nas skad cha shod skabs dbus gtsang gi skad cha sgra dag po zhi/ ga lam sang shod dgos na khag po byed kyi 'dug 'on kyang yig thog la 'bri skabs brjod bya bde po ha las pa ngo mtshar skye ba 'dug khong tsho 567

bod kyi mtha' mtha' nas yin kyang so so'i mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / rig gzhung la do snang chen po byas 'dug khong tsho brgyud nas gnas tshul thos par mdo smad khul gyi slob grwa khag gi slob phrug khyon chen po zhig shin tu sems shugs chen po red 'dug kha sang lha sa khul la zhi rgol byung skabs khong chos mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod pa red ces gdung sems mnyam bskyed byas 'dugabod mi rigs zhes pa 'di sngar chos rgyal tsho'i skabs nas bzung lo rgyus yun ring yod pa'i mi rigs shig yin pa dang / bod mi rigs la 'dzam gling thog gzhan la smon mi dgos pa'i rig gzhung bzang po zhig yod pa'i thog rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi mi'i sems rgyud kyang bzang po yod pa bcas nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di rlabs chen gyi mi rigs shig yin/ ya rabs dang sems bzang ldan pa'i mi rigs 'di rgya mis 'bu ches chung zos kyi btsan zos byas te mi rigs kyi rig gzhung la mthong rtsa ba nas med pa'i thog nas nyams chag chen po bzos pa red/de la nga tsho nad mi theg par skad rgyag gi yod/ btsan dbang shod mkhan tshor nga tsho bod pa'i rig gzhung las lhag pa med kyang ma chad pa'i thog nas mi ya rabs dang bzang po byed mkhan zhig yod na khyad par mi 'dug kyang / de 'dra mi 'dug rgya mi kho rang tshos bod pa tsho gshis ka 'jam po 'dug rgya mi ni gdug rtsub chen po dang / phrag dog tsha po red shod kyi 'dug dper na/ gan su'u zhing chen slob gra chen mo'i slob phrug rgya rigs gcig rgya nag nas bros te bod sa brgyud bal yul du 'byor ba mi des nga thug par slebs byung / nga thug skabs brjod don/ de snga ngas bod pa'i gnas tshul shes kyi med/ bod sa 'grims 568

te bros yong ring kho rang rgya mi yin yang bod pas lto chas ster ba dang / rgya dmag thug grabs byed skabs 'gebs srung byed pa bcas srog skyob rogs ram yag po byas byung / bod mi rigs 'di shin tu bzang po dang ya rabs 'dug ces kho rang ha las nas mig chu gtong grabs ngang brjod byung / de'i bka' drin rjes dran gyi ched du kho rang gi lo rgyus 'khod pa'i deb cig bris pa yin zhes rgya yig deb cig bris 'dug rgya mis rgyun du krung go rlabs chen yin/ gung khran tang rlabs chen yin shod kyi sku(da kyang / kherdzong tsho rlabs chen yin min mi shes/ rgyun du ral pa lhan pas ma khebs par sdod dgos pa dang / tang gi srid byus la thog mtha' bar gsum du 'gyur ba med shod kyang 'gyur ba rtag par 'gro gi 'dug de ltar srid byus yang dag pa yin zhes rtag par brjod kyang /yang dag pa kho ril grabs ril grabs byas te rta kha 'then 'then par sdod dgos pa dang / h+pho lugs grab byed kyi 'dug tshur phyogs bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba dang 'brel ba'i bod pa'i ya rabs goms gshis rnams nga tshos yang dag pa yin zhes brgya bshad stong bshad byed kyi med kyang / rin thang mis rgyag gi 'dug bod pa zhes lab dus dngos gnas mi ya rabs dang / bod pa'i rig gzhung zhes lab dus bsam blo gting zab gtong rgyu yod pa yag po 'dug ces tshur shod kyi 'dug 'di yag po red/ rgya dmar la mis bstod bsngags gtong mkhan med par kho rang snuras skad brgyab nas bshad dgos pa de dka' las khag po red/ thugs rje che/ zhes 355// //569

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1990 zla 1 tshes 4 nyin/ sim la khul du rang rigs mang tshogs la 355 ba'i bka' slob/tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ de ring ram pur la nang pa'i lha khang rnying pa zhig nyams gso'i 'go 'dzugs byed kyi yod pa de'i rmang rdo 'ding bar yong dgos zhes kha sang mnga' sde'i spyi khyab blon chen dz+nya ram sa lar phebs skabs gsung gi 'dug ram pur sa khul 'dir gzhi nas nang pa'i chos la do snang slebs kyi yod pa 'di yag po red snyam nas de ring khyug tsam yong ba yin/ tshang ma rdzod thug byed rgyu'i dus tshod yod pa ma red/ khyed rang tsho 'dir yong bar dga' po byung / deng gi bod spyi pa'i gnas stangs nas bshad na/ nga rang tsho bod pa lam 'gro chen po yod pa'i dus stod cig yin/ rgya mis gdug rtsub chen po zhig byed kyi yod kyang / bod nang gi mi dmangs nas srog blos btang ste rgya mir ngo rgol gyi rnam 'gyur shugs chen po bstan te gnas yod/gnas tshul des 'dzam gling phyi rol gyis bod pa'i gnas tshul shes rtogs bya rgyu shin tu gsal po chags nas bden pa dang / rgyu mtshan yod pa'i rang bzhin de je gsal du phyin te bod par mthong tshul yag tu song yod/ 'dzam gling thog srid gzhung so so'i rnam 'gyur ston stangs so so'i srid byus kyis rkyen pas gnas tshul tha dad yin kyang / rtsa ba'i mi dmangs kyi bsam tshul nas bshad na bod 'di rang btsan gyi lung pa zhig yin shag shag dang / de rgya mis btsan zos byas pa zhig yin pa 'tham gling gi phyogs gang sar rtsod med chagasayod/ dper na a ri dang / yo rob sogs gang du yin kyang gsar shog che khag tshang ma'i 570

spyir btang mthong tshul la bod rgya mis btsan zos byas par ngos 'dzin byed pa'i gnas tshul de gsal po thon gyi 'dug gzhung so so'i thog nas da lta dngos yod gnas tshul la bod rgya mis dbang ste bsdad yod pa yin tsang de'i cha nas bod rgya nag gi cha shas yin pa zhig la ngos len byed kyi yod/ de ni gzhung so sos da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul la bstun nas srid byus de 'dra zhig bzung gi yod pa red/ spyir btang 'dzam gling thog rgya bod tha dad yin pa ngos 'dzin gsal po byas nas bod par bden rgyab byed pa'i bsam tshul shugs chen po yod/'dzam gling gi sa gnas gang sar bod pa'i chab srid rang dbang gi don la rgyab skyor byed pa'i tshogs pa 'dra min btsugs rnye lung pa mang por khyab yod pa dang /yo rob sa khul phal mo cher yod/ bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di rgya che gting zab yin pa de la 'dzam gling thog nas do snang byas te lung pa mang po'i nang nang chos slob sbyong byed mkhan gyi chos tshogs che chung phal cher bzhi brgya lnga brgya zhig yod/ bod pa'i chos rig la do snang yod mkhan zhig yin phyin rang shugs kyis bod pa'i bden don la sha tsha dang rgyab skyor byed pa zhig yong gi yod/nye char yo rob shar phyogs kyi lung pa lo mang dmar wa'i rgyal khab byas pa de tsho'i gras deng sang dmar po'i lam lugs la zhe log ste mi dmangs kyis las 'gul byas te mtha' ma dmar pos dbang sgyur byed pa'i gzhung tshang ma 'thor nas rang dbang dmangs gatsho'i gzhung gsar pa 'dzugs kyi yod/ khong chor dmar po'i lugs srol 'og btsan dbang dka' sdug gi sdug bsngal shin 571

tu chen po myangs pa'i rang thog gi nyams cadang cha nas bod par dmigs bsal gyi do snang dang sha tsha byed pa dang / rgyab skyor gyi rnam pa shugs chen po jon gyi 'dug phar phyogs rgya nag la mtshon na yang deng sang mi dmangs rnams da lta'i rgya nag gzhung la 'dod mos med pa dang / dmar po'i srid byus la yi rangs med pa'i rnam 'gyu ra gsal po thon yod/ da lta drag po'i shugs kho nas bzung ba las rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi thog nas bshad na gung khran ring lugs la yid ches brlag zin pa gsal po 'dug na ning rgya nag nang gnas tshul gsar pa chen po zhig thon pa'i rkyen byas nas deng sang rgya mi'i nang kho rang tsho'i gzhung 'di rdzun bshad mkhan dang / dbang yod bshad mkhan zhigayin pa gsal po mthong ba dang / da phan rgya nag gzhung gis bod ce sa pa 'di gang 'dra zhig yin pa'i skor 'grel bshad brgyab pa der rgya mi tshos the tshoms dang dogs pa byed pa'i gnas tshul thon yong gi 'dug de ni 'gyur ba chen po red/ bod nang la yang deng sang rgya mi khag gcig gis bod pa'i gnas tshul la do snang gsar pa byed pa dang / bod par sha tsha'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug da cha rgya mi tsho so so'i gzhung la ngo log gi yod/ rtsa ba rgya mi dang / bod pa gnyis rgya nag gzhung la ngo log dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan tha dad yin kyang / gzhung la mi dga' ba byed pa 'di gcig gyur chags pa de'i thog nas deng sang lha sa khul la spyir btang gi rgya mi las byed pa tsho dang / bod pa 'brel ba yag tu 'gro gi yod pa'i gnas tshul go rgyu 'dug de 'gyur ba chen po red/'dzam gling phyi rol du bar lam lo bcu'i nang rgya mi'i slob phrug mang spro 572

zhig slebs yod/ khong tsho de sngon rgya nag la yod dus bod kyi gnas tshul gang yang shes kyi med/ phyi rol lung pa 'dra min nang lo nas lo bstud de sdod skabs bod kyi gnas tshul ji 'dra yin pa gzhi nas gnas tshul gsar pa mang po zhig mthong thos kyis de 'dra'i thog nas bod par sha tsha dang do snang byed mkhan je mang du 'gro gi yod/ lhag par kha sngon gnam bde sgo mo che'i gnas tshul de byung rjes rgya mi'i slob phrug mang po zhig rgya nag gzhung la mtha' gcig tu zhe log pa'i thoganas rgya nag la mang gtso dang / rang dbang dgos pa'i las 'gul byed mkhan gyi tshogs pa 'dra min 'dzam gling phyi rol du btsugs yod/ de tshos bod par dmigs bsal gyi do snang dang / tshur 'brel ba byed kyi 'dug kho rang tsho phyi rol la slebs nas rgya nag la mang gtso dang rang dbangayong ba'i las 'gul brtsom dus/ nga tsho bod pa lo sum cu tsam ring 'dzam gling rgyal khab 'dra min nang kha 'thor te gnas yod pa ma zad/ bod gzhung gi las khungs kyang kha shas yod pa dang / de bzhin ngo shes kyi grogs po gang la gang 'tshams yod pa bcas la brten rgya nag la mang gtso dang rang dbang yong ba'i las 'gul byed mkhan rgya mi shes yon can dang / slob phrug tshos nga tsho bod par tshur re ba bcol te bstun mkhan dang / lag pa brkyangs nas lag gdangs sbrel ba'i gnas tshul zhig chags yod/ nga tsho'i ngos nas kyang rgya nag mi dmangs ni bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa gcig pa dang / gung khran ring lugs kyi rtsub spyod 'og sdug bsngal myong mkhan gcig pa red/ der brten mang gtso dang rang dbang gi las 'gul byas pa 'di yang dag pa yin pas/573

nga cho ༷/da pa'i ngos nas rgyab skyor rogs ram byed rgyu ci yod byed dgos pa dang /gang thub kyis rgyus mnga' yang byed bzhin yod/ khong tsho'i ngos nas kyang tshur bod ces pa 'di rgya mi rigs dang tha dad yin pa dang / bod la dmigs bsal gyi thob thang dang rang dbang dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byas te bar lam ngos nas bod rgya'i dbar skad cha byed pa'i don tshan lnga bshad pa dang / de 'dra'i bsam tshul dang gros 'go bton pa de tshor khong tshos bsam pa rnam dag gis rgyab skyor byas te 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod/ de ltar bod pa'i thog la lam 'gro chen po yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags yod/rgya'i slob phrug kha shas kyis nga la bshad byung la/ nga rang gi ngos nas bltas kyang phal cher lo lnga nas bcu bar la rgya nag nang 'gyur ba chen po zhig 'gro mi yong ngam snyam gyi 'dug da lta'i dbang sgyur ba de tsho lo brgyad cu brgal ba sha stag red/ de dag mtho na'ang lo gsum bzhi las mi tshes ldeng thabs med pas 'gyur ba 'gro gi red/ de 'og 'go khrid mjug mthud nas yong mkhan tsho ni da lta nas nang khul mthun po med par gcig 'og gcig ma 'dus pa'i gnas tshul gsal po 'dug khong tsho rdog 'gril po sra thag thag cig yong rgyu phal cher khag po red/ lo lnga drug nang rgya nag tu 'go khrid gsar pa sde khag gcig slebs te gnas tshul 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro rgyu dang / gcig sgril gyi nus pa de yang phal cher shugs chung du 'gro gi red/ 'dzam gling phyi la yod pa'i dmangs gajo'i las 'gul byed mkhan gyi rgya mi de tshos da lta rgya nag nang 'brel ba byed rgyur dka' ngal yod kyang / rim pas 'brel ba shugs ma thub 574

kyisayong rgyu yin dus tshang mas 'bad brtson byas te phyi rol gyi shugs rkyen chen po thebs rgyu dang / rgya nag gi 'go khrid rim pa gnyis pa de dag phal cher dka' ngal chen po zhig gi nang la nyi ma gang 'khyol gyis sdod mdog kha po red bsam gyi 'dug lam sang dmangs gtso zhes pa'i bsgyur bcos chen po zhig yong grab yod med mi shes kyang / sra thag thag gis shebang shugs 'dzin rgyu de khag po byed kyi red/ de nas lo kha shas song rjes 'go khrid lo gzhon pa kha shas bon yong mdog kha bas de mtshams dmangs gtso dang rang dbang shugs che ru tan tan 'gro gi red/ de 'dra'i 'gyur ba phyin te rgya nag gzhung dngos gnas dmangs gtso dang / rang dbang la brtsi bkur byed mkhan zhig dang / mi dang mi'i tshor snang yod pa zhig byung song na bod don skor skad cha shod sa dang / rgyu mtshan bgrangs sa yong gi red/ nga chos mtha' gcig tu rgya mi dgra la bltas te rgya mi dang mnyam du nam yang 'grig thabs med ces brjod kyi med/ rgya mis nyan shes go shes kyi bsam blo btang na/ nga tsho nad pas kyang 'chams mthun gyi thog nas phan tshun gnyis kur rnyog dra dang dka' ngal med pa zhig byung na/ nga tshor dgos pa de yin/ mtha' gcig tu rgya mir sdug pa zhig yong dgos pa dang /dus nam yang nga tshos rgya mi sna rtsar ma dkris par sdod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med la bsdad de dgos pa yang med/ pha rol rgya mi'i ngos nas kyang rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i bsam blo gu bshangs byas pa yin na/ rgya nag nang dmangs gtso dang rang dbang gi 'gyur ba gang 'tshams byung rjes nga tso bod pa'i gnas tshul las sla po'i thog nas thag gcod thub kyi red bsam gyi 'dug yang gcig byas na 575

de'i gong du bar lam yo rob kyi lung pa kha shas nang dza drag gis 'gyur ba phyin pa ltar rgya nag nang du'ang 'gyur ba mi yong ba'i nges pa med/nga tsho bod pa btsan byol ba byas te lo sum cu brgal ba de'i ring tshang mas hur thag byas sku(da/ tshang mas sems shugs ma chag par rig pa bsgrims nas bsdad pa'i lag rjes la da cha bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di gzhi nas gsal du 'gro ba dang / bod don gyi gnas tshul sos pa zhig chags te dngos gnas 'gyur ba chen po 'gro rgyu'i re ba chen po yod pas tshang mas da lta bzhin hur thag byed dgos/ blo bde po dang / sems skyid po byas nas sdod/ (mtshams 'dir khu nu ba yod dam zhes bka' brtsad gnang )nga tsho btsan byol ba chags te rgya gar nang bod kyi bla ma dang / dge 'dun mang po zhig slebs yod/ go skabs de la brten te nub la dwags nas shar mon bar gyi de snga bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos yod pa'i sa khul de dag la gzhi nas bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba'i thad do snang gsar pa zhig slebs yod/ nang chos ni tshudags gcig nas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi chos rnying khungs shig yin pa dang / phyogs gnyis nas nang chos 'di chos lugs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu yod pa zhig dang / rgyu mtshan gabo byed mkhan zhig yin/ dad pa gcig pu min par rgyu mtshan gyi gzhi la brten nas dad pa byed pa'i chos shig yin pas tan tan nang pa'i chos 'di deng sang 'dzam gling thog chos lugs 'dra 'dra'i nang nas phran bu mi 'dra ba zhig dang / tshan rig 576

dang mthun shos shig tu gyur yod/ de yang tshan rig gi 'grel bshad rgyag stangs dang / nang chos kyi rtsa ba'i lta ba gnyis mthun phyogs 'dra po yod pas/ deng sang 'dzam gling tshan rig pa'i nang du'ang nang pa'i chos la do snang phran bu mi 'dra ba zhig yong gi 'dug spyir btang 'dzam gling thog phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas mang po phyin yod kyang / de gcig pus mi'i dka' ngal tshang ma sel thub pa dang / mi'i bde skyid tshang ma sgrub thub pa zhig yong gi med pa rim pas gsal du 'gro gi yod/ dngos po yar rgyas phyin pa'i lung pa'i nang rang bzhin gyi mi'i dka' ngal dang / sems mi skyid pa'i gnas tshul mang po zhig yong gi yod/mi'i dka' ngal sel bar phyi'i mthun rkyen yo byad dgos kyang / de gcig pus mi 'grigs pa nyams myong gi thog nas rim pas gsal du 'gro gi yod stabs nang sems kyi bde skyid yong thabs la do snang gsar pa zhig slebs yod/ sems kyi bde skyid bsgrub rgyur do snang slebs dus sems kyi zhi bde sgrub pa'i thabs lam spyir btang byas na cesas lugs khag tsho yin/ 'on kyang rgyu mtshan 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu med par dad pa kho na gtso bo byas te 'gro ba'i chos lugs de tsho lam sang khas len dang / yid ches byed rgyu cung mi bde ba chags pa'i mi de tsho'i gras la nang pa'i chos 'di shin tu ran po chags yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di chos lugs tshang ma'i nang bshad pa ltar byams pa dang / snying rje zhes pa 'di rtsa bar bshad yod la/ 'tshe ba mi byed pa'i bslab bya rgyag gi yod/ 'tshe ba mi byed pa dang / sems bzang po byed dgos pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu mtshan de nga rang tsho'i bde sdug gis mtshon pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi rigs de dag tshang 577

dang mthun shos shig tu gyur yod/ de yang tshan rig gi 'grel bshad rgyag stangs dang / nang chos kyi rtsa ba'i lta ba gnyis mthun phyogs 'dra po yod pas/ deng sang 'dzam gling tshan rig pa'i nang du'ang nang pa'i chos la do snang phran bu mi 'dra ba zhig yong gi 'dug spyir btang 'dzam gling thog phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas mang po phyin yod kyang / de gcig pus mi'i dka' ngal tshang ma sel thub pa dang / mi'i bde skyid tshang ma sgrub thub pa zhig yong gi med pa rim pas gsal du 'gro gi yod/ dngos po yar rgyas phyin pa'i lung pa'i nang rang bzhin gyi mi'i dka' ngal dang / sems mi skyid pa'i gnas tshul mang po zhig yong gi yod/mi'i dka' ngal sel bar phyi'i mthun rkyen yo byad dgos kyang / de gcig pus mi 'grigs pa nyams myong gi thog nas rim pas gsal du 'gro gi yod stabs nang sems kyi bde skyid yong thabs la do snang gsar pa zhig slebs yod/ sems kyi bde skyid bsgrub rgyur do snang slebs dus sems kyi zhi bde sgrub pa'i thabs lam spyir btang byas na cesas lugs khag tsho yin/ 'on kyang rgyu mtshan 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu med par dad pa kho na gtso bo byas te 'gro ba'i chos lugs de tsho lam sang khas len dang / yid ches byed rgyu cung mi bde ba chags pa'i mi de tsho'i gras la nang pa'i chos 'di shin tu ran po chags yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di chos lugs tshang ma'i nang bshad pa ltar byams pa dang / snying rje zhes pa 'di rtsa bar bshad yod la/ 'tshe ba mi byed pa'i bslab bya rgyag gi yod/ 'tshe ba mi byed pa dang / sems bzang po byed dgos pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu mtshan de nga rang tsho'i bde sdug gis mtshon pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi rigs de dag tshang 577

ma rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mang po zhig tshogs pa'i thog nas sku(nga dgos pa'i 'brel bshad byed pa de tshan rig pa'i 'grel bshad rgyag stangs dang mthun po yod pa dang / rgyu mtshan yang rlabs che zhing zab po zhig yod/ dus rabs nyi shu pa 'dir spyir btang chos lugs mang po zhig la dad pa nyung du song nas chos dad brlag 'gro gi yod kyang / dus rabs nyi shu pa'i mjug rdzogs la nye ba'i skabs 'dir nang pa'i chos la do snang gsar pa zhig gzhi nas slebs yong gi 'duga'adi khul khu nus mtshon pa'i la'o si spa ti sogs de snga nas nang pa'i chos lugs yin zhing / sngar yod kyi nang chos mi nyams rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu gnad chen po red/ lung pa yar rgyas 'gro gi yod/ dper na/ hi ma cal nang la cha bzhag na sngon ma mnga' sde thog mar 'dzugs skabs dang da lta bsdur na yar rgyas chen po phyin yod/ slob grwa dang / sman bcos sogs gang cir yar rgyas shin tu chen po phyin yod/ da dung yang mu mthud phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas 'gro gi red/de dang chabs cig nang bsam blo'i thog nas spyir chos dang / yang sgos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi bslab bya ji snyed cig yod pa 'di dag ma brjed par rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug spyir btang gi shes yon yar rgyas phyin/nang pa'i chos kyi shes sku(na nyams chag song nas dad pa byed stangs mi shes pa lta bu chags na/ nam zhig 'gyod pa skye dgos pa zhig yong gi red/ de snga nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad pa yod pa'i 'di khul yul lung nang du nang pa'i chos zhes pa 'di gang 'dra zhig yin pa'i gzhi rtsa'i 'gro stangs la do snang dang /lhag don phru gu tshos nang chos kyi 'gro stangs gang 'dra yin par do snang byas te 578

shes pa byed rgyu gal chen po yin/da lam rgya gar gzhung gsar pa sgrig 'dzugs byas yod/ 'di zla'i zla dkyil tsam la nga rang ldi lir bskyod rgyu yin/ de skabs srid blon gsar pa dang / de min sdudan chen gsar pa khag gcig mjal 'phrad zhu rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod/ nga tshor 'das pa'i dus yun ring dngos yod kyi nyams myong gang zhig byung yod ce na/ rgya gar gzhung gis bod pa'i thog gna' rabs nas bzung rgya gar dang bod gnyis thun mong ma yin pa'i 'brel ba zhig yod pa de 'dra'i thog nas rang bzhin gyis sems thag nye po zhig chags sku(da pa dang / lhudags gzhan nas bod kyi sa cha 'di rgya gar gyi srung skyob thad shin tu gal che zhig chags yod/ de snga bod nang rgya mi'i dmag mi ma slebs bar bod pa dang 'brel ba'i rgya gar gyi sa mtshams khag dngos gnas zhi bde'i sa mtshams byas te nyen kha gang yang med par gnas yod/ phyis su bod nang rgya dmag slebs rjes rgya gar byang rgyud kyi sa mtshams gnas stangs dngos yod gnas tshul la 'gyur ba phyin pa red/ der brten rgya gar gyi mi sna bsam blo gtong mkhan su 'dra zhig yin kyang rang bzhin gyis bod kyi gnas tshul 'di rgya gar thad gal chen po yin pa dang rgya gar gyi srung skyob dang / ma 'ongs yar rgyas gtong phyogs sogs phyogs mang po zhig la 'brel ba yod pa'i dbang gis rgya gar gzhung gi srid blon snga rjes phebs mkhan tshang mas rang bzhin gyis bod par sha tsha dang rgyab skyor gnang gi yod/ da res kyi rgya gar gzhung gsar pa 'di yang de dag las lhag pa med kyang chad pa zhig yong gi ma red snyam gyi 'dug rgya gar sa khul khag la yod 579

pa'i nga rang tsho bod pa tshang mas shod rgyun la yod pa ltar yul chu 'thung nas yul khrims 'khu ra dgos zhes pa ltar sa khul de dang de'i rgya gar yul mi tsho dang mthun lam byed rgyu dang / khrims mthun lugs mthun/ ya rabs snyom chung byas nas bsdad yod/ sdug pa re zung ni yong srid pa zhig red/ da bar spyir btang nas bshad na rgya gar sa khul gang du yin na'ang bod par bstod bsngags gtong mkhan dang / bod mi ni ya rabs spyod bzang 'dug ces grags pa bzang po 'di sa khul gang sar khyab yod/rgya gar tsam ma zad/ a mi ri ka/ yo rob khul sogs la yang bod mi zhes lab dus mi bzang po dang / ya rabs/ gzhung 'ded sa yod pa'i mi zhig yin pa'i bsngags brjod byed kyi 'dug da dung yang tshang mas mi ya rabs shig dang / mi bzang po zhig byed rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po yin pas hur thag byed dgos/ skabs re 'di khul dma' rim slob grwa thon te mtho rim slob grwar 'gro rgyu'i mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa dang / yang mthun rkyen 'dzoms kyang kha shas nas go skabs yod bzhin du 'phral sel tshong las byed rgyur mgo 'khor nas slob sbyong mjug 'khyongs ma thub pa yong gi 'dug de 'dra byed rgyu med/ slob sbyong bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ slob sbyong byas pa dang chabs cig gzhi rtsa'i mi'i kun spyod bzang po zhig gi thog nas mi tshe skyel thub pa ma byung na nyen kha yod/ slob sbyong gang la gang 'tshams shig yod pa de'i thog nas 'jom phran bu sangs/ dngos gnas slob sbyong tshad longs pa'i las ka dang /gla phogs gang thad gya nom payong ba'i slob sbyong zhig byed ma thub/ 'jom sangs 580

kyang so so'i mi tshe skyel stangs cha tshang zhig chags ma thub pa byas te sdod pa'i bar nas mgo bde lnga byed rgyu dang / kha bslus rgyag rgyu/ rdzun khram shod rgyu sogs de 'dra byed pa'i nyen kha yod/ nga tsho bod par deng dus kyi shes yon med kyang de snga bong nang 'tshar longs byas te yong ba'i mi khag gcig la bden pa bden thub dang / bla ma dkon macogeg byed pa'i sku(na tan zhig yod/ myosan tan 'di yang 'jags thub pa dgos/ deng dus kyi shes yon phran bu shes te mi la mgo skor gtong rgyu dang / kha bslus rgyag rgyus mtshon pa'i sdug pa byed stangs rnams shes/ tshur phyogs nas ya rabs bzang po'i kun spyod kyi stangs 'dzin byed rgyu ma ldang pa'i gnas tshul chags na nyen kha red/ da phan spyir btang bod pa mchog dman rgan gzhon su 'dra zhig gi thog nas bshad kyang bod pa zhes brjod skabs dngos gnas bsngags brjod thob pa'i mi gshis shig yod/ de dag rim pas thug pa ltar sla ru mi 'gro ba bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ shes song ngam/ khyed rang rgan pa tshos do snang byed dgos la/ lhag par phru gu slob grar 'gro mkhan snuras do snang byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ mi'i gshis ka yag po ma byung na/ shes bya po na tan yod pa gcig pur ha las rgyu med/ shes bya yon tan gyis rang la mthong rgya thos rgya mang po zhig byung ba dang / des rkyen pas sems nang 'dod chung chog shes med par 'di yang dgos la/ de yang dgos pa'i khra khra zing zing gi lad zlos byed snying 'dod/ de dag tshul mthun gyi thog nas bsgrub ma thrub pa'i skabs la khram pa shod rgyu'i thog slebs kyi yod/de ni yag po ma red/ deng sang yar rgyas de tsam phyin med pa'i rgya gar sa khul 581

de tsho'i nang rkun ma rku mkhan dang / rdzun shod mkhan nyung ba yod pa dang / slob sbyong sogs gang 'tshamasayar rgyas phyin pa'i yul de tsho'i nang khram pa byed mkhan mang ba yong gi 'dug ces rgya gar sa gnas las byed pas de 'dra shod kyi 'dug shes bya yonye tan phran bu shes/ des so so'i mi che'i 'tsho ba gdengs 'khel ba zhig kyang ma byung / 'thom phran bu sangs te sgug nas sdod dgos pa'i gnas tshul 'og nas ma rabs kyi spyod pa shes rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ der zab zab byed dgos/ sprang 'khyam brgyab ste sdod mkhan chags na yag po med/ rdo don snying po nga rang tsho mi zhes pa 'di la ya rabs kyi spyod pa med na so so skyid pa med la/mi'i spyi tshogs nang du'ang mthong brlag gi red/ da lta phan chad bod pa ni rang bzhin mi'i spas ka tshad 'dzin sa dang tshad longs pa zhig la brtsi pa 'di ni nga tsho'i rin tharjo chen po zhig yin pas de rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dugadaper na phyi rgyal gyi mi bod nang lta skor du 'gro myong ba'am/ yang na rgya gar nang dang / bal yul sogs bod mi rub rub byas nas sdod sar slebs myong ba phal mo ches bod pa ni rang bzhin gyis mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug ces tshang mas bstod bsngags gtong gi 'dug nga rang tsho so sos rang la dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos gang zhig yod pa shes kyi med pa red/ mi tshos do snang byed dus bod pa tsho mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug ces tshang mas dga' po byed kyi 'dug 'di rtsa ba chen po red/ nga rang tshor mi su 'dra zhig thug kyang rang bzhin ngo gdong 'dzum shig shig byed pa dang / dga' nye blo dkar ltar gyi rnam 'gyur ston pa'i gshis ka zhig yod pa 'di rtsa chen yin/ dper na/ bod nang sa cha gcig gi sgang 582

la yod kyang bod mi dang rgya mi gnyis phyi rgyal gyi mi tshos lam sang dbye 'byed thub kyi 'dug rgya mi tshang ma sdug pa min kyang spyir btang rgya mi'i goms gshis kyis mi thug dus gdong nag po bstan pa dang / skad cha zhig bshad na yang rnam 'gyur ngan pa'i thog nas shod kyi 'dug ces phyi rgyal mi tshos shod kyi 'dug bod pa zhig thug na lam sang gad mo bgad pa dang / skad brda ma 'phrod kyang 'dir shog mdog mdog gis grogs po'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug ces phyi rgyal gyi mi tshos yod kyi 'dug bod pa'i rang gshis/ la mi su thug kyang lhag bas// rnam dag dang / grogs po'i rnam 'gyur ston pa 'di rtsa ba chen po yin/ nga tsho bod mi'i rang bzhin gshis ka 'di so so'i lung pa'i gnas stangs nas yin srid la/gtso che shos rgya gar nas yong ba'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang / de'i nang tshan nas theg pa chen wa'i chos kyi gzhi rtsa 'di bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang dngos gnas rus pa'i gting la zug pa ltar theg pa chen po'i chos kyi bslab bya khyab gdal chen po phyin pa de 'dra'i thog nas min nam/ rang bzhin gyis bod mi tsho sems bzang po yod/ der brten 'dzam gling thog bod pa'i spyir btang bsam blo'i 'gro stangs kyi cha nas nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di glen pa dang / lkug pa zhig la rtsa ba nas brtsi gi mi 'dug nyams myong gsog pa'i go skabs shig byung phyin klad pa grung po dang / thabs shes zung 'brel byed thub mkhan zhis 'a/ brtsi gi 'dug mi ya rabs yin pa'i thog grung po byed thub mkhan zhig yin dus phyin chad ma 'ongs par 'dzam gling thog bod pa'i mis bzang po'i lam ston byed thub pa yong srid/ da lta nga tsho bod kyi phyi rol la yod pa tsho btsan byol ba'i gnas 583

bab thog gnas yod pa dang / bod nang yod mkhan tsho yang rgya mis mthong chung byas pa de myangs nas ba sdad yod/ yin na'ang rim pas dus stod 'gyur ba zhig phyin na tan tan nga cho nad mi rigs kyis 'dzam gling thog rnam dpyod ldan pa'i mi ya rabs gang 'dra byas te bzo dgos kyi yod pa dang / mi ya rabs gang 'dra byas te byed dgos pa'i thad lam ston byed thub pa dang / spyod bzang mig ston byed thub pa mi yong ngam snyam gyi 'dug da lta nga tsho gnas tshul thabs skyo po zhig gi 'og bsdad yod kyang mi'i spus tshad bstan thub kyi yod/ so i lung pa dang bral te rang dbang rtsa brlag song nas mi'i lung par btsan byol byas te bsdad yod/ spyir btang gi mi zhig yin na gra 'grig po yod kri'i skabs la 'dra chags po sus kyang byed thub/ 'a chad 'u thug gi skabs la sdig pa mig btsums kyis ya nga bag tsha med pa'i gnas tshul 'dzam gling thog mang po yong gi yod/ yin na'ang bod pa'i mis ga re byas yod dam zhe na/ rang yul bral te gzhan yul la gyar ba'i 'u thug thabs zad kyi gnas tshul 'og tu'ang nga rang tsho'i bzang po'i yon tan dang / ya rabs kun spyod kyi gshis ka rnams ma dor bar bzung thub yod/ de'i thog nas nga tsho btsan byol la gyar ba'i skabs 'dir yang mis cha mthong byed pa dang / brtse ba slebs pa zhig byed thub pa yin dus/rim pas nga tsho'i lung par gnas tshul 'gyur ba phyin song na/ deng sang 'dzam gling gi sa khul gang sar shes bya yon tan gyi cha nas phongs kyi yod pa ma red la/ bslab bya'i thog nas phongs kyi yod pa ma red/ rig gnas kyi thog nas phongs kyi yod pa ma red/ yin na yang ya rabs kyi spyod pa nyams 'gro gi 'dug584

ya rabs kyi spyod pa med pas phongs kyi 'dug ces dmar po'i rgyal khab nang dang / rang dbang lung pa'i rgyal khab nang sogs 'tham gling gang sar skad rgyag gi 'dug la/ mi gzhung bzang po byed rgyu 'di nyams chags 'gro gi 'dug ces do snang byas nas skad rgyag gi 'dug rgya gar gyi grong gseb dang grong khyer gnyis la cha bzhag nas bshad na/ grong khyer nang gi mi sto ya rabs kyi spyod pa nyung ba 'dug zer/ spyir btang deng sang lung pa mang por shes yon zla ba yar ngo bzhin yar rgyas 'gro gi yod la/ dpal 'byor longs spyod dang / rig gnas kyang de bzhin yar rgyas 'gro gi yod/ 'on kyang de snga tshang mas dmigs bsal do snang mi byed pa'i ya rabs spyod bzang zhes pa 'di nyams chag 'gro bzhin yod cing / de'i 'bras bur shes yon dang dpal 'byor longs spyod yod kyang sems pa skyid po med pa dang / des rkyen pas sems la na tsha phog ste mi spyon pa chags pa dang / yang na/ rgyu mtshan med par gang byung mi gsod pa/me mda' gang byung du rgyag thal byed pa sogs de 'dra yong gi 'dug der brten 'dzam gling thog ya rabs kyis ldang gi mi 'dug ya rabs bzang wa'i yon tan nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong ched chos lugs khag tsho gal chen po 'dug ces do snang gsar pa slebs yod/yang lung pa kha shas nang deng sang ya rabs kyi spyod pa nyams chag 'gro ba 'di dza drag gi gnas tshul yin par ngos 'dzin byed pa gang zhig la/ ya rabs chos kyi jog nas bzo dgos kyi yod pa 'di khas len byed thub kyi med pa red/ spyir btang byas na ya rabs chos kyi bslab bya'i thog nas yong gi yod/585

lha(na kyang cesas khas len byed 'dod med pa'i mi khag gcig gis chos khas len byed ma dgos pa'i thog nas mi ya rabs bzo ba'i thabs shes gang zhig yod dam bsam nas do snang byed kyi 'dug des rtags mtshan gang zhig bstan gyi yod dam zhe na/ 'dzam gling thog phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas gtong rgyu kho nar da bar shugs bsgril te bsdad pa'i 'bras bur nang bsam blo yar rgyas ma phyi na par 'thus shor ba 'di gzhi nas mngon gsal dod du phyin te de la thabs shes gsar pa gang zhig byed rgyu 'dug snyam nas deng dus kyi shes yon slob khrid byed stangs dang / deng dus spyi tshogs kyi 'gro stangs/ deng dus khyim tshang gi bsam blo gtong stangs bcas kyi thad nas ma ldang pa'i gnas tshul gang zhig chags kyi yod pa de skor do snang byed mkhan mang po 'dug der brten nga rang tsho bod par ya rabs kyi spyod pa yod pa 'dis ma 'ongs par chos khas len min dang /nang pa yin min la ma ltos par rnam dpyod ldan pa'i mi ya rabs byed rgyu 'bad brtson byed mkhan tshor thabs lam gyi mig dpe bzang po zhig yong rgyu red/ de sngon spyi lo drug cu da nga / bdun cu'i skabs la nga rang sto rang mgo thon tsam zhig byung na snyam pa las/ de 'dra'i bsam blo 'khor gyi med/ spyi lo bdun cu nas brgyad cu'i nang slebs skabs 'dzam gling gi mi mang pos bod pa'i thog re ba gsar pa zhig byed pa dang / dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed kyi 'dug de ni nga tsho skyo po red/ snying rje zer ba de 'dra'i thog gcig pu min par/ bod pa zhes pa 'di phran bu mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa de ci yin nam/ khong tsho rang bzhin sems bag phebs po dang skyid por sdod mkhan zhig dang / ya rabs 586

byed mkhan zhig 'dug de gang gi thog nas yong gi yod dam zhes do snang byed ma/khan mang po 'dug der brten nga tshor khyad chos zhig tan tan yod/ phyi khu+ol du nga sbyo dzor po byas nas sdod kyi yod kyang / nang la thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan zhig yod/ so so'i lung pa'i rang dbang bskyar gso byas te gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms bkra shis bde legs kyi nyi ma zhig 'char rgyu yod pa dang /'dzam gling spyi yongs la 'ang bod mi rigs dang / bod kyi rig gzhung gi thog nas phan bde bsgrub thub pa'i go skabs shig yong mi srid pa min/ gnad 'gag 'dug tshang ma sems skyid po byas nas sdod/ hur thag gyis/ bkra shis bde legs// //587
