ra༅༅// phyi lo 1990 zla 8 tshes 6 nyin hun sur gzhis sgar ser skya mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/'di ga gzhis sgar gyi mi mang gtso bor gyur pa'i de ring 'dir 'dzoms pa'i ser skya mi mang rnams la zhu rgyur/ da lta las bsdoms nang zhib tshags 'khod pa ltar las don mang po zhig thad yar rgyas mang po byung 'dug ma gzhi deng sang dus tshod dbyar gzhung 'khel yod la/ sngon chad 'debs 'dzugs byas pa'i shing sna rnams 'tshar skyes yag po byung yod pa'i khar/ sa zhing rnams kyang sngo ljang snum shig ger yod pa bcas bag phebs pa'i rnam pa bzang po zhig mthong byung / 'bras ldan shing gis mtshon pa'i shing sna'i rigs 'debs 'dzugs bya rgyu 'di 'phral sel lta snang mdzes po yong ba tsam ma zad/ gnam gshis tsha grang dang / 'phrod bsten sogs mang po zhig la phan thogs yod 'dug skabs re nga la ngo shes mi 'ga' zhig nas 7rgyal ba rin po ches zhi ba'i don tshan lnga zhes khor yug srung skyob skor bka' mol gnang yod/ yin nayang bod mi 'dus sdod byed sa'i sa khul kha shas kyis de la do snang gtan nas byed kyi mi 'dug che sa'i thad gsung rgyu gsung dgos kyang / sngon la kha tsha lag thog so so bod mi'i sdod snar dang / grong sde chags sa de tshor gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten dang / khor yug srung skyob sogs de rigs la do snang che tsam byed thub nayag po 'dug ces nang tshags rtsed mo'i sgo nas shod mkhan yong gi 'dug de ni bden pa red/che sa nas nga tsho ma 'ongs par bod lung pa 'di dngos gnas zhi bde'i bsti gnas shig chags thub pa'i 'bad brtson byed kyi yod cing / bod sa mtho'i sa babs 588

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1990 zla 8 tshes 6 nyin hun sur gzhis sgar ser skya mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/'di ga gzhis sgar gyi mi mang gtso bor gyur pa'i de ring 'dir 'dzoms pa'i ser skya mi mang rnams la zhu rgyur/ da lta las bsdoms nang zhib tshags 'khod pa ltar las don mang po zhig thad yar rgyas mang po byung 'dug ma gzhi deng sang dus tshod dbyar gzhung 'khel yod la/ sngon chad 'debs 'dzugs byas pa'i shing sna rnams 'tshar skyes yag po byung yod pa'i khar/ sa zhing rnams kyang sngo ljang snum shig ger yod pa bcas bag phebs pa'i rnam pa bzang po zhig mthong byung / 'bras ldan shing gis mtshon pa'i shing sna'i rigs 'debs 'dzugs bya rgyu 'di 'phral sel lta snang mdzes po yong ba tsam ma zad/ gnam gshis tsha grang dang / 'phrod bsten sogs mang po zhig la phan thogs yod 'dug skabs re nga la ngo shes mi 'ga' zhig nas 7rgyal ba rin po ches zhi ba'i don tshan lnga zhes khor yug srung skyob skor bka' mol gnang yod/ yin nayang bod mi 'dus sdod byed sa'i sa khul kha shas kyis de la do snang gtan nas byed kyi mi 'dug che sa'i thad gsung rgyu gsung dgos kyang / sngon la kha tsha lag thog so so bod mi'i sdod snar dang / grong sde chags sa de tshor gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten dang / khor yug srung skyob sogs de rigs la do snang che tsam byed thub nayag po 'dug ces nang tshags rtsed mo'i sgo nas shod mkhan yong gi 'dug de ni bden pa red/che sa nas nga tsho ma 'ongs par bod lung pa 'di dngos gnas zhi bde'i bsti gnas shig chags thub pa'i 'bad brtson byed kyi yod cing / bod sa mtho'i sa babs 588

kyi thad nas ci ste bod lung pa'i nang gi khor yug gnas stangs la 'gyur ba chen po zhig phyin pa yin na nga cho gengad mir gyong rag pa smos ci/ nye 'khor khyim mtshes rgyal khab tsho'i nang la'ang rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gnas stangs la 'pho 'gyur chen po zhig yong gi yod sa red/bod 'di ma 'ongs par zhi bde'i bsti gnas dang 'brel ba'i thog nas phyi'i stod kyi bkod pa dang / nang bcud kyi sems can bcas pa tshang ma zhi bde'i bsti gnas ming don mtshungs pa zhig yong thabs byed pa'i skor nga tshos bshad yod/ de ni don med stong bshad byas pa zhig ma yin par/ de 'dra zhig yong ba'i ched du nga rang tshos 'bad brtson byas nas dngos su 'grub thub pa byed dgos shing / nga rang tsho bya ba 'di sgrub mkhan yin stabs/ da lta btsan byol gyi gnas skabs nas sdod sgar khor yug gi gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten dang / shing 'bras 'debs 'dzugs sogs la do snang chen po byed dgos/ dper na/ shing 'bras lta bur mtshon na yul gyi mdzes bkod la phan pa ma zad 'bras bu yang longs spyod rgyu yod/ ma gzhi gong du brjod pa bzhin gzhis sgar 'di ljang thing nger sdod pa'i sa babs yag po zhig chags 'dug mi mang gi 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs la bltas na skabs re ston 'bras legs po ma byung ba dang / de bzhin mi 'bor 'phar ba bcas kyis dka' ngal yong gi yod kyang / gzhi rtsa'i thog lo re bzhin gnas stangs bzang du phyin yod/ de ni gtso bo mi mang so sos rang don rang gces kyi 'bad brtson sgo gang sa na sa byas pa dang / gzhan la rogs ram 'bod skul byas pa/ rogs ram byed mkhan tshos kyang bod pa'i ngos nas rogs ram 589

blangs pa rnams bar ma dor chud zosdo/ ma btang bar grub 'bras bstan rgyu yod pa zhig byed dus bod par ro gas ram byas na btab sar smin thub pa dang / nad thog sman 'khel lta bu yong gi 'dug ces yid ches cha 'jog chen po byed kyi yod pa bcas kyi 'bras bu red/ da dung yang tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/chos dang rig gzhung gi thog la mang po zhu ma dgos pa da lta bka' shag gi gsung bshad nang zhib tshags po byung song / spyi yongs kyi cha nas nga rang tsho lo sum cu so gcig ring btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i yar rgyas tshags tshud byung yod/ bod mi rigs zhes khyim mtshes kyi mi rigs spyi dang / lhag par rgya mi rigs dang nga tsho tha dad yin zhes brjod pa'i ma rtsa lte ba de yang nga tsho rgya mi rigs dang shin tu tha dad yin pa'i rig gzhung zhig yod pa 'di yin pas rtsa che yin/ bod kyi chos gatho nar gyur pa'i rig gzhung dang /goms gshis 'bur thon du yod pa 'dis dus gang dang gang du yin kyang rgya mi dang bod tha dad yin pa'i rnam pa gsal po thon gyi yod/ de'i thog nas bod rang btsan rgya mis khas len byas rung ma byas rung / don ngo ma'i jog bod pa'i rig gzhung dang / bod pa'i goms gshis 'dis 'grel bshad byed ma dgos par bod pa rgya mi dang tha dad yin pa bltas pa tsam gyis mthong thub pa zhig yod /rgya mi'i thog nas kho tshos brjod pa ltar bod mes rgyal zer ba dang kha bral 'gro rgyur snga phyi bar gsum du dogs pa byas nas skad rgyag gi yod/ de 'dra byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang bod rgya mi dang tha dad yi na pa'i gnas tshul 'dis chags pa red/ nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi thob thang rtsod len byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i rten 590

gzhi ni mi rigs zur gsal yin pa 'di dang / de la brte na pa'i rig gzhung dang goms gshis zur gsal yod pa 'di yin pas shin tu gal che/ yang mi rigs kyi rig gzhung rnams zur gsal zhig yod kyang nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang phan grogs med na de 'dra zhig yin/'dzam gling thog mi'i bsam blo dang goms gshis 'gyur ba 'gro bzhin yod la/ dngos yod gnas tshul yang 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod/ yin na yang nga rang tshor goms gshis bzang po zhig yod pa 'dis nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang phan thogs kyi yod/ phan jogs pa nga rang tshos la/ma seng tshor thub kyi med kyang /phyi rgyal gyi mi mang po zhig gis bod pa zhes brjod dus gshis ka dang sems rgyud bzang po zhig mthong gi yod/ de ni skyes pa'i skabs na sa nga tsho'i sha rus gdos bcas kyi phung po 'di mi gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa gtan nas min par mi tshang ma gcig gyur yin/ sa babs mtho dma'i rkyen gyis mi'i dbang 16) don stod la khyad par phran bu yod shas che/ de lhag gzhan gang yang med/ 'o na mi'i gshis /ra khyad par 'di lta bu yong ba gang yin nam zhe na/ de ni khor yug gi gnas stangs dang / gtso bo rig gzhung gi gnas stangs thog nas khyad par yong gi yod/ rig gzhung dang goms gshis 'di las mi'i gshis ka 'jam po yag po zhig thon gyi yod/ des rkyen pas nyin re'i mi tshe skyel skabs blo bag phebs pa zhig dang / dka' ngal chen po zhig 'phrad pa'i skabs kyang las rgyu 'bras dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam blo btang ste sems nang sdug bsngal bzod mi thub pa zhig mi yong ba bya rgyur tan tan phan gyi yod/ des 591

na rig gzhung rtsa cher brtsis nas dmigs bsal gyi bdag gces bya rgyu gal che/ bod kyi rig gzhung srung skyob yin zhes dpe cha blo 'dzin skyor sbyangs byed rgyu lta bu zhig min par/ de ni rten 'brel ltos grub kyi phyogs mang po'i rkyen tshogs pa'i jog nas yong dgos/ gzhi rtsa'i cha rkyen gtso bo ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang / de'i nang nas kyang phan pa'i sems sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snying rje'i rtsa ba yin zhes pa 'di yin/ chos kyi lta spyod 'gro stangs rnams jog mar yag po shes pa byas/ shes nas nyams su blangs te rang gi shag nang bzang po'i spyod lam ldan pa'i sgo nas mi tshe skyel gyi yin na/ de la de brten nas shag tshang 'khor bcas tshang mar rang bzhin bag chags bzang po'i mig ltos shig 'jags te rim pas spyi tshogs khyon yongs la shugs rkyen thebs thub pa yong gi red/ bod mi ser skya tshang mas de la dmigs /sal gyi do snang bya rgyu gal chen po 'dugalhag par slob gra khag nang slob sbyong byed mkhan slob phrug tshor shesayon slob sbyong sprod pa tsam ma yin par rtsa ba'i mi spus dag po zhig bzo rgyu'i thad dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed dgos/ spyir btang 'dzam gling thog shes yon slob sbyong sprod mkhan tshang mas ya rabs dang / spyod pa bzang po byed dgos pa'i bslab bya rgyag gi yod kyang / spyi'i mthong tshul la slob gra zhes brjod dus gcarwa 1 shes yon kho na slob sbyong sprod rgyur do snang byed mkhan zhig tu mngon gyi yod/ de gcig pus ldeng mi thub/ gang yin zhe na/ shes yon yod kyang lhag bsam gyi rgyab 'khyog pa zhig ma byung na/ shes yon gyi phan thogs grabs yod 592

dam/ gnod skyel grabs yod brjod mi thub/ des na slob gra'i nang 'tshar longs byed bzhin pa'i mi rabs rjes ma rnams spas dag po yong bar tshang mas do snang bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ ༄bod spyi pa'i don dag skor da lta bka' blon gyis 'grel bshad brgyab pa ltar 'das pa'i lo sum cu so gcig nang nas deng sang do snang shugs che shos chags yod/ srid gzhung so so'i thog nas do snang bya rgyu da lta'i char phran bu khag po yin kyang / rgyal khab so so'i nang gi chab srid kyi tshogs pa dang /de min rgyal spyi'i tshogs pa 'dra min de tshos bod don la do snang byed pa 'di deng sang shugs che shos chags te nga tsho'i bden rgyab sngar las che ru phyin yod/ de bzhin gzur gnas kyi tshogs pa mang che ba'i nang phyi lo 1950 zho'i yas mas la bod rgya mis btsan bzos byas pa red zer ba las/ bod rgya mis bcings bkrol btang ba red zer ba zhig ha lam thos myong med/ blo gzu bor gnas shing chab srid kyi las don dang 'brel ba med mkhan phal mo che'i rang bzhin brjod par rgya mis bod la btsan 'dzul gyis ham zos byas pa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin gcig gyur byed kyi 'dug de ltar bod pa'i bden mtha' rang bzhin du gsal nas bden rgyab je cher song ba 'di deng sang shin tu tshad mtho rwa1 zhig tu slebs yod/yang gnas tshul sdug sa nas bshad na/ da lta'i dus stod 'di nga rang sto tshang mas phyi nang gang sar thabs shes 'bad brtson byed dgos pa rnams yag po byed ma thub par chos zab sar bdud zab ces pa'i dpe bzhin gal te 'gal 593

rkyen zhig phrad de da lta mthun rkyen mang po 'dzoms nas gom pa rim bgrod kyis bod don la mthong chen po slebs pa 'di las gcig lhung na bskyar gso bya rgyu khag po yin/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir rgya phyogs nas rgya mi 'bor chen bod la gtong ba dang gcig bar lam dmag khrims bsdams nas bod mi mang po 'dzin bzung dang / mang por nyes rdung btang ba sogs rmeg med bzo ba'i gdug rtsub kyi bya thabs lag len bstar ba dang gnyis bcas dang / phyogs gzhan nas da lta nga rang tshor mthun rkyen mang po zhig 'dzoms pa 'di yang rtag pa brtan pa med pas nga tshos gzab gzab byed ma thub na/ bod par rogs ram byed dgos kyang ko thag slod kyi 'dug zer dgos pa de 'dra zhig gal srid chags tshe nga tshos go skabadz+ra/ bzang po shor te chud zos btang ba yin pas/ slar go skabs de 'dra zhig 'thob rgyur dka' ngal mang po yong nges yin/ gnas tshul de dag gi cha nas nga tsho gnyan 'phrang gi dus skabs shig tu gnas yod ces brjod chog de ltar phyogs tshang ma'i gnas tshul la bltas na da lta'i dus tshod 'di dngos gnas spyi don la rig pa bsgrims dgos pa'i dus stod cigayin pas tshang mas shugs bskyed de gzab gzab bya rgyu gal chen po 'dugamang gtso'i skor la 'das pa'i lo sum cu so gcig ring nga rang chos mang gtsoyong ba'i don la 'bad brtson mu mthud rim pa mang po byas yod/ der brten mi mang po'i sems nang mang gatho'i ngo bo dang dbye ba ji ma ji bzhin zhig shes thub kyi med kyang / spyir btang kha nas mang gtso zhes bshad thub pa zhig chags yod/ da cha mang gtso lag len 'khel thabs la shugs bskyed rgyu shin 594

tu gal chen po chags par brten bar lam spyi 'thus kyi sgrig 'dzugs gnas stangs la bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu dang / de yang mi mang nas spyi 'thus tsho bskos/spyi 'thus chos bka/'a blon tsho bsko rgyu bcas da lta go rim 'di 'dra zhig bsgrigs yod/ de 'dra byed dus dngos gnas mang gtso'i rnam pa gsal po mtshon gyi yod/ sngon ma lo gcig nas 7rgyal ba rin po che dngabaka' shag gi bar la mi gcig bskos na zhes brjod rgyu byung yang 'os pa'i mi zhig ma byung bar lus shing / bar lam de skor bskyar du gleng yang mtha' ma'i dus la srid blon nam srid tshab ces pa zhig bskos na lam seng lag len thog bde po zhig yong gi mi 'dug der brten snga 'phros bka' shag gi bka' blon rnams mi mang spyi 'thus kyis bdam rgyu yod pa zhig dang / de'i nang nas bka' blon khri pa zhig bskos na yag po mi yong ngam bsams nas da lam gtan 'bebs byas yod/ des na da phyin spyi 'thus bsko rgyu 'di da lta bka' blon nas brjod pa ltar shin tu gal chen po chags shing / chos brgyud so so'i 'thus mi tsho yin na'ang 'dra/ chol kha so so'i 'thus mi tsho yin na'ang 'dra/ de dag tshang ma bod mi mang spyi'i tshab byed mkhan zhig dang / blo gzu bor gnas pa'i thog nas dngos gnas spyi pa'i don dag la sems shugs sgril mkhan zhig 'dems sgrug bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ 'das pa'i lo sum cu'i nyams myong nas skabs re 'thus mi bsto dus so so'i rang khungs kyi skor la rtsod pa rgyag thub mkhan zhig byung na/ des 'thus mi'i mtshan nyid tshang gi yod pa'i 'du shes yong gi yod sa red/ 'o na kyang bsam blo sbug sub dog po gtong rgyu med/ che sa spyi pa'i don dag la bab lding brtan 595

gsum gyis shugs bsgril thub mkhan gyi mi slebs thub pa dgos/ ma gzhi yong mdog kha po ma red de/ bsam blo rgya chung chung ma gtogs mi 'khor mkhan dang / don ma go dkrog rkyen bzo mkhan de 'dra byung ba yin na yag po med/sngon ma'i spyi 'thus tsho gal chen po yin la/ da cha lhag par du gal chen po chags yod/ phyin chad spyi 'thus 'dems bsko byed rgyu 'dir 'os 'phen mkhan mi mang tshang mas dmigs bsal gyi do snang byas nas so gos rtsad gcod byed pa dang / mi la skad cha dris nas thag gcod so so rang gis byed dgos/ de ltar byas nas spyi 'thus kyi mi 'gro rnams spus dag po yong ba'i 'bad brtson dang do snang byed dgos/ spyi 'thus kyis bka' blon tsho bsko rgyu 'di mang ga'i rang bzhin je gsal du 'gro ba'i don la thag gcod byas pa yin/ 'di 'dra byas na mi mang dang spyi 'thus tsho bcas pa tshang ma'i sems nang rang shugs dmigs bsal gyi 'gan zhig slebs kyi yod/ da phan do 'khur ma byas pa min na yang / blo'i phugs nas 7rgyal ba rin po ches le 'grigs pa zhig byed kyi red bsams te ltod g.yeng 'gro gi med dam snyam/ 'gan dbang cha tshang bed spyod byed rgyu yod pa zhig byas na/ so sor 'gan 'khri dus dmigs bsal do snang mi byed rang byed chags kyi yod par brten bar lam bsgyur bcos btang ba red/nye lam sbe la kob spa gzhis chags nang rkyen ngan byung ba'i skor da lta bka' blon nas brjod pa ltar/ bod gzhung gi las byed pa'i thog gnas tshul chags yong dus thabs skyo po blo pham gyi rang bzhin red/ phyin chad 'khrug pa 596

rgyag rgyu med/ gal srid 'khrug pa rgyag dgos kyang nga tshos mang gtso'i lam la 'gro gi yin zhes brjod pa 'di rdzun bshad pa min par don dam pa'i mang gtso'i lam la 'gro gi yod/ ma 'ongs par gyod zhib lhan khang lta bu'i khrims khang gsar pa zhig 'dzugs rtsis yod la/ deng phan la yang bka' shag gis gtsos pa'i 'brel yod gang la yin kyang rgyu mtshan bshad sa yod pa las/ rgyu mtshan bshad sa med pa min/ ma 'ongs par gyod kha mchu byung rigs la mdor na bka' shag dang bcas pa'ibatsan byol gzhung yin kyang gyod ya gcig byas te khrims sar 'dra mnyam byas nas sdod rgyu ma gtogs/ bod gzhung yin zhes dbang cha bed spyod byed sa med pa zhig dgos rgyu mang gatho'i cha rkyen yin stabs 'phral sel nga tsho btsan byol la sdod ring gyod kha mchu'i rigs thag gcod byed mkhan bod gzhung la stabs bstun ma dgos pa'i sgrig 'dzugs rang btsan pa zhig 'dzugs rgyu thag bcad zin pa yin/su la yang gtug sa dang bshad sa yod pas/ lam seng lag pa bkyag rgyu de yag po min/ phran bu blo mthun ma mthun yong skabs/ byung na tshang mas bzod bsran byed dgos/ gal te rtsa ba'i gzhi chen po zhig 'dug na gang du yin kyang drang pos gzhung bsrangs nas rgyu mtshan bshad sa yod pas skad cha bshad nas thag gcod byed dgos/ ngas rtag par brjod pa bzhin las byed pa'i thog nas kyang ma 'grigs pa yong srid/ de 'dra yong dus skad cha bshad na rgyu mtshan nyan mkhan yod cing / ga dus yin kyang sgo phye yod/ ya rabs sgrig 'dzugs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i thog nas phyin na dngos gnas yag po red/597

de min zang nge zing nge byed pa 'di shin tu thabs skyo po yin/ lhag par nga cho bod pa'i gshis ka sdug sa nas bltas na/ rkyen rtsa phran bu zhig mi re zung gi thog nas byung ba de lam seng chen po bzos te chos lugs kyi thog nas shog kha bsgril res byed pa'am/ yang na chol kha'i thog nas shog kha bsgril res byed pa/ le thogs mkhan gyi mi des kyang lam seng rgyab rtsa zhig btsal/ spyi tshogs thog gi mi khag gcig bis kyang lam seng de la ming gzhan zhig bed spyod byas nas shog bsgril byed pa'i gshis ka zhig 'dug pa 'di ni mi dgos pa zhig yin/ma gzhi de 'dra byed mkhan nga chorwa r+shad pa gcig pu min pa rgya gar nang la'ang 'dugadaper na/ bar lam pan jab kyi gnas tshul dang / /shi mir gyi gnas tshul/shrī laṅka'i gnas tshul bcas lta bu yin/ pan jab nang gi gnas tshul lta bur mtshon na hin du dang sig zer ba dang / shrī laṅka'i nang nang pa dang ta mil mi rigs zer ba/ kāsha mir nang hin du dang kha che zer ba bcas de dag don ngo ma mi don ma go byed gte re zung gis rnyog dra bslangs te/ chos lugs phan tshun dang / mi rigs phan tshun gyi 'gal ba'i ming chen po zhig bed spyod byed dus/ mi'i bsam blo'i 'char snang la de ni rtsod pa chung chung zhig ma yin par chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi 'gal ba zhig tu mthong nas mi mang po'i sems nang shugs rkyen ngan pa zhis thebs kyi yod/ dngos gnas byas na rgya gar rgyal yongs nang kha che sa ya mang po yod pa las/ /shi mir gcig pu ma gtogs med pa rtsa ba nas min/ yin na yang slo bur chos lugs phan tshun gyi rtsod pa/ yin pa'i rnam pa zhig bstan dus/ rgya gar nang chos lugs mi 'dra ba'i mi sri/ 598

ya mang pos lo brgya phrag mang wa'i ring khyim mtshes byas te bsdad pa'i gnas tshul rnams mi mngon pa chags te lam seng chos lugs phan tshun gyi rtsod rnyog chags pa 'di shin tu thabs sdug po 'dugang rang tsho bod pa'i nang la de de bzhin gyi lab gleng rtsod pa phran bu zhig byung ba yin na/ lam seng chos lugs kyi gnas don bsres yong ba dang / yang na chol kha'i gnad don bsres yong ba 'di shin tu thabs sdug 'dug de 'dra byed mkhan tshos gcig byas na bsam blo chung chung btang ste so so'i 'gro khungs btsal ba yin 'gro/ gcig byas na dngos gnas rkyen chung chung zhig gis gnod chen po bskyel ba'i don la ched du dmigs nas bzos pa yin mi srid pa min/tshang mas de 'dra mi yong ba'i gzab gzab bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ lo sum cu so gcig ring nga rang tshos ma 'os pa'i las ka phran bu phran bu byas yod kyang / che sa nas bshad na ha cang yag po yin/ rang re yar rgyas byung nas 'dzam gling jog bod pa zhes brjod dus tshad 'dzin sa byed sa'i mi rigs shig chags pa 'di gzi brjid dang grub 'bras chen po yin zhing / de yang gtso bo bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tshos lhag bsam dang / bzod bsran/ snying rus bcas lo nas lo bstud de 'phyugs pa med par gnas pa'i 'bras bur bod par mthong dang cha 'dzin slebs nas cha 'jog 'pher ba zhig chags yod/rgya mir cha bzhag na bod khyur mid btang yang khog pa'i nang du 'ju mi thub par bsdad yod ces ngas sngon ma nas bshad pa ltar da cha dngos gnas de rang chags yod/ rgya mi bod pa'i dpung gis glags 'khel mi thub kyang / bod 599

kyi bden pa'i dpung gis rgya mi tsho 'a 'ub ma 'dus par rjod dgos pa zhig bzos yod/ da lta'i rgya nag gzhung gi dbang cha 'dzin mkhan de tsho lo rgan brgyad cur slebs zin pa'i mi sha stag la brten khong tsho'i sems kyis slebs sar lus kyis slebs ma thub pas lo kha shas nang tan tan 'gyur ba 'gro gi red/ deng sang rgya nag 'dzam gling phyi rol la sgo phye ste 'brel ba byed pa'i go skabs shig yod pa 'dis da lta 'tshar longs byed bzhin pa'i rgya nag mi mang dang / lhag par shes yon can tshor 'dzam gling phyi rol gyi gnas tshul phran bu bod ges thub pa yong gi yod/ der brten srog ldan mi smos ci/ dud 'gro zhig yin kyang rang dbang la dga' po byed pa dang / btsan dbang la dga' po mi byed pa 'di chos nyid yin pas rgya nag gi mi rigs kyang 'gro ba mi rang yin tsang / mtha' gcig tu dbang yod dang rdzun bshad nas srid dbang 'dzin mkhan de tsho gnas thabs rtsa ba nas med/ rgya nag gi slob phrug dang shes yon can mang pos da nas lo lnga nas bcu'i bar la rgya nag nang 'gyur ba chen po zhig 'gro gi red brjod kyi 'dug ngas bltas kyang tan tan de ltar yong gi red snyam gyi 'dug nga rang tsho da phan lo sum cu so gcig song zin cing / da cha lo kha shas kyi ring la tshang mas gzab gzab ngang rig pa bsgrims nas shugs rgyag dgos pa'i dus tshod yin pas chung tsag la mgo 'khor rgyu med/ byab chung gis nyi ma skyel rgyu med/ don 'gangs che sar tshang mas rig pa bsgrim thub na yag po red/ bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che/ / //600

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1991 zla 1 tshes 3 nyin wa khor bal yul brgyud bod nas 'byor pa'i mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/ da ring bod nas tshur gsar pa 'byor pa dang / sa mtshams nas yong mkhan bcas khyed rang tsho tshang mar 'tshams 'dri yod/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 'dul zhing / zhi ba'i bsti gnas rang bzhin gyis mi tshang ma la byams brtse yod pa'i lung pa de da cha dngangs skrags kyis khengs bsdad pa'i lung pa gcig chags nas thabs skyo po zhig tu gyur yod/ rgya mis bod dbang bsgyur byas nas lo bzhi bcu tsam zhig 'gro ba dang / lnga bcu nga dgu lo nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so grangs shig 'gro gi yod pa red/ da cha mtho na lo bcu yas mas shig la nga rang tsho gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms bde skyid kyi nyi ma shar thub pa'i re ba yod pa red/ de'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tshos zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs bcangs/ mdor na so i srog la ltos pa med pa'i sgo nas bden don rtsod nas bsdad yod pa red/spyir btang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la gnas tshul gsar pa zhig thon na lo gcig gnyis phyin pa'i rjes gnas tshul de rnying pa chags kyi yod na yang / nga rang tsho bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di lo bzhi bcu tsam 'gro gi yod kyang / gzhi nas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la do snang gsar pa gcig dang / bod don gleng slong byed rgyu'i go skabs gsar pa zhig chags yong gi yod pa red/ de ni gtso thong ngad nang rgya che'i mi mang rnams zhum pa med pa'i lhag bsam g.yo ba med par bsdad pa'i 'bras bu red/ yang sgos gzhon skyes de snga'i spyi tshogs rnying pa mthong 601

ma myong ba tshor rgya mis phyi byug nang blug gi slob gso sprad nas 'tshar longs byung ba de tshos so so'i mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / so so'i mi rigs kyi thob thang ngos 'dzin gsal po byas te rang dbang rtsod len gcig mjug gnyis mthud byed kyi yod pa red/ dper na/ sngon ma rgya mi thog mar yong skabs rgol 'dzings dang ngo rgol gdong len byed mkhan mi thog de tsho ha lam rdzogs tshar ba red/lnga bcu nga dgu yas mas la rgya mi la gdong len byed mkhan sto yang da cha rgas po rgas mo chags pa dang / mang po zhig ni nad gcong chags nas bsdad yod/deng sang rgya mi bsun po bzo mkhan gyi gdong len pa/ bod mi'i thob thang rtsod len byed mkhan 'di dag mi thog gsar pa zhig chags yod pa red/ de'i thog nas nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod de mi thog gcig gi 'thab rtsod min par mi rigs gcig gi 'thab rtsod yin pa gsal po bstan gyi yod/ nga tsho'i mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod kyang mi rigs de mu mthud gnas dgos par brten/ mi thog gsar pa'i thog nas mu mthud rtsod len byed kyi yod pa red/ rgya mi kho rang tshos lo stong phrag bzhi lnga'i lo rgyus yod zer ba bzhin/ nga tsho bod mi rigs kyang lo stong phrag mang wa'i lo rgyus yod pa zhig red/ chos dang rig gzhung gting zab los kyi thog nas bshad na nga rang tsho bod mi rigs 'di yar rgyas chen po phyin pa'i gnas tshul gsal po yod/ nga rang tsho bod mi rigs 'di lo rgyus yod pa'i mi rigs shig dang / rig gzhung gting zab yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i lta ba gting zab yod pa zhig red/ 'on kyang rgya mi'i ngos nas lta ba gas/ra pa zhig dang / dbang sgyur gsar pa zhig spel gyi yod/ gung 602

khran gyi byed stangs 'di mthar lhung ba'i gdug rtsub chen po yin pas/ mi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi gshis ka dang ma 'tshams pa zhig chags yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'dir thog mar gsar brje zhes 'ur 'drog gi thog nas las 'gul brtsams pa dang / spyi yongs kyi thog nas bshad na/ dmar po'i lta ba ma khe se dang / le ning ring lugs nang mi mang ba'i khe phan dang / lhag par nyams thag rnams kyi khe phan rtsod pa de rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / lhag bsam gyi dmigs yul bzang po bzung yod na yang / de sgrub pa'i byed thabs de'i nang la gral rim 'thab rtsod sogs gdug rtsub dang / lta ba'i thog nas 'khon 'dzin shugs chen po 'chang gi yod pa yin dus/ rang mos dwang blangs byed mkhan dmar po'i rgyal khab tshang ma'i nang la khag po chags yod/ mtha' gcig tu btsan dbang dang sdug sbyong kho na gtong rgyu de mi'i gshis ka la ran gyi med pa red/rgya mi gung khran gyis nga rang bo da la thog mar dbang bsgyur byed skabs mkhas snyan bslu brid kyi thog nas mgo bskor gtong e thub brnyes yod/ de rjes ga le ga ler kho rang tsho'i rang gshis rjen pa'i gdug rtsub lag len bstar bar brten mi tshang ma zhen pa log dgos pa chags pa red/ gnyis nas nga rang tsho'i bod mi rigs 'di rgya mi dang sgo kun nas tha dad yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas gnas tshul gsal po chags yong gi yod pa red/ dper na/ bar skabs nga rang tsho bod pa'i phru gu khag gcig chung chung sgang nas rgya nag la 'khrid nas rgya mi'i dkyil la 'tshar longs byed mkhan de cho'i gras rim pas rim pas so so'i shes yon gyi gnas tshad mtho ru phyin pa'i skabs bod pa zer ba de gang 'dra 603

zhig yin pa dang / bod pa'i rig gzhung gang 'dra yin pa/ bod pa'i lo rgyus gang 'dra yin pa bcas rang shugs kyi shes 'dod dang do snang yong gi yod pa dang / de la brten nas bod mi ri gas 'di lo rgyus yun ring yod pa'i mi rigs/rgya mi dang tha dad yin pa gsal po chags yong dus chung chung nas rgya mi'i slob gso'i 'og la 'tshar longs byed mkhan bu dang bu mo tshos so so'i rang stobs kyi bsam blo 'khor ba'i tshe rang bzhin gyis bsam slo 'gyur yong gi 'dus bar lam bod nas spongang mkhan kha shas mtho rim slob gra 'grims myong ba dang de 'dra slobs yod/ de cho'i gras thog mar rgya mis gang bslab pa de gar yid ches byed pa ma gtogs gang yang shes kyi yod pa ma red/ rim pas slob sbyong byed pa dang / mi'i rnam dpyod kyi nus pa che ru phyin pa'i skabs su shugs rme thub kyis so so'i mi rigs la do snang zhig slebs/ de 'dra'i thog nas so so'i mi rigs kyi lo rgyus dang rig gzhung gting zab yod pa de mor shes 'dod byung / de nas so so'i mi rigs kyi thob thang rtsod len byed 'dod rang shugs kyi yong gi yod pa red/ gtso bo bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams lhag bsam 'gyur ba med tsang dka' ngal la gdong len mu mthud byas pa'i lag rjes lta bur 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la deng sang bod pa'i gnas tshul shes mkhan ha cang mang du 'gro gi yod pa ma zad/ rang bzhin gyis sha tsha dang /bod par rgyab skyor byed mkhan je mang du 'gro gi yod pa red/ gang ltar bod don shi thub kyi yod pa ma red/ bskyar gleng shugs chen byas yong gi yod pa red/ der brten rgya mi'i gzhung nas bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di 'gan chen po 604

zhig la brtsi dgos pa dang / ma bde ba chen po yod pa zhig chags yod/ lhag donabod nang la khong chos drag shugs kyi thog nas mi'i sems dbang du bsdu thub kyi med na yang / lus po dbang du bsdu thabs ched khong tshos sdig pa mig btsums kyis 'bad rtsol byed kyi yod kyang / des phan thogs ma byung ba'i khar 'dzam bu gling nang bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di rgya nag gi phyi 'brel srid byus la dka' ngal che shos shig dang / rnyogs khra tsha shos shig chags yod/ snga mo nga rang tsho bod pa so so'i lung pa'i nang la bsdad dus phyi logs la 'brel ba de tsam med pa dang do snang yang de tsam byed kyi yod pa ma red/ 'dzam gling phyi logs nas kyang bod pa'i gnas tshul shes mkhan ha cang nyung nyung red/ lnga cu nga dgu'i rkyen ngan de byung nas bod pa mang po phyi rgyal du slebs pa dang / phyi phyogs la 'brel ba rang bzhin gyis byung bar brten/ bod mi tshor gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam 'gyur 'dzum shig shig yod mkhan zhig dang / gzhung bzang po yod pa/ drang bden yid ches blos 'gol byas chog pa/ lhag par chos dang rig gzhung rnam grangs ha cang mang po dang / rgya chen po/ gting zab po yod pa zhig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ rgya mi gung khran gyis bod mi rigs zer ba 'di ha cang rjes lus dang / ha cang gi gleng rmongs shig la brtsis kyi yod pa red/ sngon thon zer ba'i rgya mi rigs kyis rogs ram ma byas na bod mi rang mgo mi bon pa ha lam klo pa lta bu'i 'du shes bzhag gi yod/ rgya mis klo pa'i 'du shes bzung sa'i lung pa 'di'i thog la deng sang 'dzam gling dngos po yar rgyas dang / tshan rig yar rgyas phyin pa'i lung pa rgya mi kho rang tshos brel 'tshub 605

ngang mig dpe blta sa dang / so so'i bu phrug rnams tha bas shes gang yong gi thog nas slob sbyong du gtong sa/ lhag don rgya mi'i dpon rigs tsho'i phru gu dang /nye ba gnyen 'brel de tsho'i gras gcig las ma byung rung gtong thabs byed yul gang ltar sems kyi nang nas mngon par bstod sa phyi rgyal lung pa de tsho'i nang nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung la slob sbyong byed rin yod pa dang / de la do snang byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul 'di dag mthong dus rgya mi tsho'i bsam khi nang la de gang 'dra yin nam bsam nas ya mtshan skyes kyi yod pa red/de ltar na nga rang chog nad mi rigs zer ba 'di dngos gnas rlabs chen gyi mi rigs shig yin/ nga rang tsho'i mes wa de tsho'i gras rnam dpyod yod pa/dka' las rgyag thub mkhan/ dper na bod pa'i dngos por cha bzhag na/ bod pa'i gna' snga ma'i dngos rdzas de sto ha cang spas dag po/ bris cha dang bzo bskos sogs lag shes gang ci'i jog la 'dzamaje gling 'di'i sgang la tshad longs pa zhig tan tan yod pa red/ 'on kyang bar lam dus rabs bcu dgu pa dang /dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang nga chos 'dzam gling phyi la 'ubrel ba byed ma thub par/nang khul la mgo 'khor nas bsdad de phyi dngos po'i yar rgyas 'gro ma thub par rjes su lus/ mtha' ma des rkyen pas nga tsho'i lung pa gzhan lag shor ba red/deng sang nga rang tsho phyogs gcig nas rkyen ngan byung nas thabs skyo po red de/phyogs gcig nas rkyen ngan grogs la shar ba lta bu'i nyams myong gi bslab cha yang thob yod/ nga rang tsho'i lung pa'i nang nyams chag phyin pa spyi dang / lhag don yig cha rnying pa 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la ngo bshus gcig ma gtog sa 606

med pa lta bu'i dpe deb rnying pa de 'dra dang / snga mo lo tsā ba de 'i gras kyis dka' ngal chen pos rgya gar nas 'khyer yong ba dang / yang na/ nga rang cho ༄dad kyi mkhas pa rnam dpyod can de tshos brtsams bris yig cha shin tu rtsa che de cho'i gras rtsa med shul med la phyin pa rnams bzo thabs dang gso thabs med pa'i gnas tshul de tsho shin tu thabs skyo po red/ de tsho bsam blo 'khor dus sems 〉༄ 1 yong gi 'dug de min nyams chag phyin pa'i gnas tshul gzhan dag rnams rtsa ba'i mi rigs rang nyid gnas phyin chad nyams pa slar gso byed thub kyi red/bod nang dngos po nyams chag phyin pa dang / bod mi rnams sdug bsngal chen po myang dgos pa'i gnas stangs de 'dra zhig yod na yang / 'dzam bu gling phyi phyogs su bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung la do snang gsar pa slebs pa dang / chos dang rig gzhung gi thog nas 'brel ba gsar pa rgya chen po yong gi yod/ dper na/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i skang la dus rabs bcu dgu pa dang / nyi shu pa'i 'go stod kyi tshan rig mkhas pa de tsho'i bsam blo gtong stangs dang / deng sang gi tshan rig pa'i bsam blo gtong stangs mi 'dra ba 'dug deng sang khong tsho'i bsam blo gting zab tu phyin pa dang / rgya che ru phyin pa'i rkyen gyis da cha phyi dngos po yar rgyas phyin pa gcig pu'i thog nas mi la brgya cha brgya tham pa phan thogs yong ba'i gdeng tshod yod pa bshad thub rgyu khag po chags yod/ nang bsam blo dang 'brel ba yod pa'i thog la deng sang do snang gsar du byed kyi yod pa red/sems kyi tshan rig gi rnam bzhag la brtag dpyad byed mkhan zhig yin phyin/shar phyogs kyi lta ba de sems kyi rnam bzhag la 'grel bshad mang shos shig yin 607

pa dang / de'i nang tshan nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba la rang shugs kyis do snang gsar pa yong gi 'dug nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi nang nas cha tshang shos bod kyi chos 'di chags yod/ de snga nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di gtso bo bod dang hi ma la'i ri brgyud/ sog yul/ rgya nag bcas par dar khyab byung ba las/ 'dzam gling sa phyogs gang sar khyab thub yod pa ma red /ma 'ongs pa la 'dzam gling sa phyogs gang sar bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung gi thog nas las ka mang po zhig byed rgyu tan tan yong bzo 'dug bar skabs kyi rkyen ngan 'di'i jog nas nga cho༄ 1da mi rigs kyi spus tshad gang 'dra yod med de 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bstan thub pa byung yod pa dang / 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang nas nga sto bod par da phan rgyu mtshan ca/thong ba'i sgo nas sha tsha dang /yid ches byed mkhan gang la gang 'tshams byung yod la/ da dung je mang je mang du 'gro rgyu red/ ma 'ongs pa la nga tshor rang dbang gi nyi ma shar ba'i mtshams la nga tshos las ka gsar pa mang po zhig byed dgos kyi red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug nga tshor mdun lam chen po yod/ nga tsho bod mi rigs la rang dbang thob pa'i mtshams su so so'i lung pa yar rgyas gtong rgyu rmos med thosabod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi thog nas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la zhabs 'degs gang 'tshams bsgrub rgyu'i mthun pa'i rkyen dang go skabs nga tshor yod pa zhig mthong gi 'dug 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi cha nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ bod mi rigs ni rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ zhum dgos pa dang / nyams dma' dgos pa rtsa ba nas med/ da lta'i gnas tshul la cha bzhag na'ang / thod 608

mi rigs zer ba 'di sreg btub 'pher ba'i mi zhig dang / dka' ngal la gdong len byed thub mkhan gyi mi rigs shig yin pa gsal po yod/ ma 'ongs pa la cha bzhag na yang nga chog nad mi rigs la so so'i chos dang rig gzhung gting zab yod pa'i rlabs chen gyi mi rigs shig dang / lung pa mdzes sdug phun sum tshogs pa'i snod bcud gnyis po 'di'i thog nas 'dzam bu gling spyi la zhabs 'degs bsgrub thub kyi red bsam gyi 'dug de ltar na nga rang tsho bod mi rigs spyi bo gnam bstan yongs rdzogs kyi sems nang la spobs pa skye chog pa zhig dang /so sor yid ches byas chog pa zhig tan tan red/ ngas gnas/ tshul 'di rgya mi gung khran gyi brgyud sbrags yin cha lta bur bshad pa min/ khyed rang tshos nyams zhib byas na shes kyi red/ nga tsho phyi logs su bsdad nas lo sum cu so gcig lhag tsam phyin pa red/ 'dzam bu gling gang sar ngo shes pa mang po dang 'brel ba yong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na tshod thig gi 'dug gang ltar ma 'ongs par bod mi rigs zer ba 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la gal chen po'i lung pa zhig chags thub kyi red/ e sha ya'i snying khams lta bu 'dzam gling yang thog tu gnas yod pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling spyi yongs la nga chos bde skyid kyi cha rkyen gang la gang 'tshams sgrub thub pa zhig byed thub kyi red/spyir btang kha rgyun du bod 'di 'dzam bu gling gi yang thog ces bshad kyi yod pa ltar/ nga tshos ma 'ongs par 'dzam bu gling spyi la zhabs 'degs bsgrub rgyu 'di nga tsho'i 'gan khur yin bsam pa zhig bod pa mi re ngo re'i sems nang la nyar dgos pa zhig red/ de yang nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di rlabasdo/ chen yin zhes 609

ma ṇi bgrang bgrang byas pas mi 'grigs par/ mi rigs rlabs chen yin pa 'di rig gzhung dang bya spyod kyi thog nas mtshon pa byed dgos/ nga tshos bod kyi rig gzhung la nyams zhib byed dang / slob sbyong byed dgos pa ma zad/ de dang chabs cig deng dus 'dzam bu gling gi spyir btar shes yon khag la'ang rdo snang byed dgos/ de gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i thog nas nga tshos ma 'ongs par 'dzam gling spyi la zhabs 'degs bsgrub rgyu'i mig dper 'os pa zhig tan tan byed thub kyi red/ des na shes yon la do snang byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/nga tsho rgya gar la slebs nas 'das pa'i lo de tsho'i ring shes yon gyi thog la rdo snang dang / thabs shes sgo gang sa nas byas te 'dod pa yongs su khengs pa zhig byung med na yang / grub 'bras gang la gang 'tshams thon yod/ bod nang 'tshar longs yong bzhin pa'i bod pa tshos shes yon la do snang dang / do khur chen po byed dgos/ skabs re sa khul kha shas la rgya mis btsugs pa'i slob gra'i nang la so so'i phru gu gtong 'dod mi byed pa dang / yang rgya yig ma gtogs med pa'i slob gra'i nang bod phrug rnams gtong 'dod byed kyi med pa 'dra/ de tsho khag mi 'dug dngos gnas so so'i mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / bsam blo gtong stangs de tsho yag po red/ 'on kyang shes yon gtan nas med na so so'i mi rigs kyi thob thang rtsod thub thabs med pas/ rgya mis btsugs pa'i slob gra zhig yin yang rung / rgya yig ma gtogs bslab sa med pa zhig yin yang rung / slob sbyong med pa las yod pa gal che ba dang / phan thogs che ba yin pas/ slob sbyong nges par du byed dgos/610

bar skabs rtsa ba'i rgya nag khyon yongs la srid byus lhug gtong byas pa'i rjes la chos phye ba'i rnam pa'i thog nas bod chol kha gsum gyi sa khul la dgon pa nyams gso byed pa dang / gra btsun gsar pa dgon pa'i nang zhugs mkhan gang la gang 'tshams yong gi yod pa red/ de tsho'i gras la bsam blo nan tan gtong dgos pa zhig red/ nga tshos mi rigs shig 'dzugs bskrun byed dgos pa dang / 'gyel sa nas langs thabs byed dgos pas phyogs gang sa nas bsam blo gtong dgos pa ma gtogs/ dgon pa nyams gso byas pa gcig pu'i thog nas nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi rang dbang thob thub pa khag po red/ de bzhin gra btsun grangs ka mang po yod pa tsam gyis nus pa thon rgyu yang khag po red/ bod mi mang tshogs la shes yon yar rgyas yod pa dang / dpal 'byor yar rgyas yod pa sogs phyogs tshang ma'i thog cha snyoms kyi yar rgyas 'gro dgos/ nga rang sto bod mi gzhon skyes tsho'i slob sbyong byed stangs kyang 'phral sel tsam ma yin par/ dpal 'byor dang / rig gzhung bzo rigs lag rtsal bcas kyi shes yon rnams rgya yig brgyud nas slob dgos byung na yang bslab ste gang ltar rang miri+o gas kyi rnam pa cha tshang ba thon thub pa'i sgo nas yar rgyas gtong thabs byed dgas/da lta 'dir gsal bshad byed dgos pa zhig la/ nga tsho'i rang dbang rtsod len byed stangs 'di mtha' gcig tu zhi ba'i lam rgyud nas rtsod len byed kyi yod/ de la dgos pa rgyu mtshan mang po yod/ de snga lnga bcu nga lnga nga drug nas/ drug cu re grangs bar la sa khul mang po zhig nang dngos su rgol 'dzings 611

mang po byas pa red/ de'i rjes 'bras la rgya mis dmag mi 'bor chen bod la dpung 'jug byas nas/ zhing 'brog sa khul kha shas nang dmigs med shul med bzos pa de 'dra gang 'tshams byung yod/ nga mos sgol 'dzings byas pa yin na rgya mis drag gcadan byed rgyur ya nga the tshom rtsa ba nas med pas nga tshor gyong rag rgyu'i nyen ka yod/ dper na rgya mi'i ngos nas da phan drag gnon byed skabs nam rgyun kha'i rtse mor yul gyi bde 'jags ched dmag mi btang tshul bshad kyi yod/ gang ltar nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas drag zing gi bya thabs spel ba yin na/ rgya mis drag gnon byed bde'i cha rkyen sgrub pa lta bu chags kyi yod pa red bsam gyi 'dug gal te drag zing la nga tshor grub 'bras shig son pa yin na yang de brtan po gdeng 'khel zhig yong rgyu khag po red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling gang sar thabs shes drag shos de mi dang mi'i mdza' 'brel gyi thog nas gnyis mophas kyi thabs shes 'tshol rgyu de rang red/ gnyis mos kyi chodag nas thag gcod byas pa de lam seng 'dod pa yongs rdzogs khengs pa zhig ma byung na yang /de ni khyedags gnyis ga'i mos mthun gyi byung ba zhig yin stabs de brtan po chags kyi yod pa red/ ngas da lta bar du zhi ba'i thabs lam 'ba' zhig brgyud nas 'gro dbo(sa zer ba 'di dgos pa rgyu mtshan mang po zhig la bsam blo btang nas bshad nga/ red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nga tsho bod par rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang po zhig gis bod pa'i rang dbang rtsod len byed stangs 'di 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam kho nar brten nas 'gro gi yod pa de ngo mtshar chen po red/ de la nges par du rgyal kha thob thub pa zhig dgos kyi red ces de 'dra'i thog nas bod 612

par rgyab skyor dang / sha tsha byed mkhan mang po yong gi yod pa red/ da lta phan chad nga tshos 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la phyin pa'i grub 'bras la deng sang rgya mi'i nang nas kyang bod par sha tsha byed mkhan dang / bod pa'i rang dbang 'thab rtsod kyi bden don la rgyab skyor byed mkhan yod/ nga tsho jo/da pa'i ngos nas mtha' gcig tu drag zing thog phyin pa yin na rgya mi rigs yin phyin/ bsam cho'i nang la ma bde ba chags srid kyi red/ da lta'i char grangs ka nyung nyung yin na yang /lo re lo rer mi sdod par rgya mi'i nang nas bod par sha tsha byed mkhan mang du mang du 'gro gi 'dug rgya nag nang la yod pa'i rgya mi tsho dang nga tsho 'brel ba yong gi med stabs khong tshos gnas lugs rjen pa de shes thub rgyu khag po red/'dzam bu gling phyi phyogs rang dbang lung pa'i nang yod pa'i rgya mi'i slob phrug khri phrag 'ga' shas yod pa'i nang nas lo re bzhin bod pa'i thog la tshur dga' po byed mkhan dang / bod par sha tsha byed mkhan je mang je mang la 'gro gi yod /dper na nga rang la dngos su 'phrad par mtshon na yang / a mi ri ga'i slob grwa de 'dra'i nang rgya mi'i slob phrug de 'dra nga'i 'khris la yong// mig chu btang nas nga rgya mi yin/ dgongs dag zhu gi yin/ rgya mi rigs kyis bod nang gtor bshig dang / bod mi mang la mnar gcod bsam yul las 'das pa btang 'dug de sngon rtsa ba nas shes kyi med/ da cha rang dbang lung pa'i nang〉 slebs rjes gnas tshul rjen pa de tsho shes rgyu'i go skabs yod pa'i skabs su gzhi nas shes tshor yong gi 'dug ngas rgya mi rigs kyi tshab byas nas bod mir dgongs dag zhu gi yod ces mig chu btang nas zer mkhan de 'dra kha shas byung / de 613

ni lo gcig gnyis gong gi gnas tshul red/ rgya mi'i nang nas kyang de lta bu'i do snang byed mkhan mang du 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo gcig nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas drang bden dang lhag bsam rnam dag mi'i mdza' brtse'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pa/ rang bzhin gyi kun spyod bzang po'i thog nas rang dbang 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod pa'i gzi 'od de gzhi nas thon yong gi yod pa red/ gnas tshul de ni ha cang gal chen po zhig yin/da lta phan chad la nga'i ngos nas thabs lam bsten stangs thad/ rtsab nga sbyor rang dbang rang btsan gtsang ma'i thob thang yod pa red/ lhag don bod nang la skusad pa'i rgya che'i mi mang sku(ngas su rdzogs pas rgya mi dang rtsa ba nas 'brel ba byed mi dgos pa'i rang dbang gtsang ma zhig 'dod kyi yod pa red/ de rgyu mtshan ldan pa red/ yin na yang de lam seng lag len 'khel thub par rkyen mang po zhig 'dzoms dgos pas dka' ngal yod/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'dir 'gyur ba ha cang chen po 'gro bzhin yod pa red/ dper na/ dmag chen gnyis pa'i gong la 'dzam gling sa khul gang sar rang btsan dang / rang dbang zhes so so sger gyi lung pa'i thob thang rtsod rgyur gal chen po brtsi gi yod na yang / deng sang 'dzam bu gling gi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi gnas stangs thog na sa lung pa phan tshun gcig gis gcig la bsten dgos pa'i gnas tshul ha cang shugs chen po chags pa'i nyer len gyis so so rang btsan kher sdod byed pa las/ lung pa phan tshun thun mong mnyam las byed thub na khe phan che ba yod pa dngos yod gnas tshul la brten nas snga mo so so'i thob thang rtsod mkhan de tsho'i gras deng 614

sang thun mong mnyam las byed pa'i phyogs su 'gro gi yod pa red/ deng skabs yo rob sa khul la gnas tshul de'i thad 'gyur ba chen po 'gro bzhin yod pa dang /'dzam gling sa khul gzhan dang gzhan la'ang gnas tshul de 'phel rgyas 'gro gi yod pa ltar/ ma 'ongs par e sha ya'i nang la'ang tan tan gnas tshul de yong gi red/ de ni dus rabs gsar pa'i dpal 'byor 'phel phyogs kyi 'gro stangs red/ nga rang tsho bod lung pa'i tshong las phyi rgyal la thad gar 'brel ba byed sa'i mtsho lam med par brten bod lung pa 'dzugs bskrun byed rgyu dang / yar rgyas 'gro thabs ched rgya gar dang / rgya nag gnyis la bsam blo gtong dgos pa shugs ma thub kyis chags kyi yod pa red/ de ltar na rgya mir dgra nag tu 'dzin pa las rgya mi dang mnyam du 'brel ba byas/ phan tshun mdza' grogs yong thabs kyi bsam blo gtong thub pa byung na nga tshor yun ring gi khe phan che ba yong srid pa zhig red/ de ltar ma lan ma 'gyod pa'i ched ngas zhi bde'i don tshan lnga dang / de'i rjes yo rob rgyal khab mnyam 'brel gyi gros tshogs sar gros 'char zhig bton pa yin/ de'i nang ma 'ongs pa'i bod rgya nag dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'brel lam yod pa'i thog nas so so'i nang gi rang dbang cha tshang longs spyod rgyuyod pa dang / rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig ni da lta bod nang la yod bzhin pa'i dza drag gi gnas tshul 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang brdal bshig btang nas mi 'dzin bzung byed pa dang / nyes brdung gtong ba/ lkog gsod gtong ba sogs tshad las brgal ba dang blo yul la ma shong ba yod pa de tsho mtshams 'jog thub thabs/ de bzhin mdo stod smad dang / dbus gtsang khul sa cha cung gnam 615

gshis dro ba dang / sa bab dma' ba zhing las thon bskyed drag sa'i sa cha mang por rgya mi gzhis cha gas byed mkhan je mang du 'gro gi yod pa red/ lha sa dang gzhis ka rtselha bu grong khrer che khag nang da cha mi mang ba rgya mi chags tshar ba red/ gnas tshul de ni bod yul rgya yul ngo mar 'gyur rgyu'i dza drag gi gnas tshul yin dus/ rgya mi spyi byings bod nas phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i bsam 'char bton yod/ gnad don de dag gi ched du rgya nag dang nga snu'i dbar gros mol zhig byung na bsams nas 'bod skul byas pa yin/'on kyang ngas gros 'go bton nas dus yun gang 'tshams song rung da lta bar du rgya nag gzhung nas bsam zhib go bsdur gang yang ma byung ba red/ bar lam 'dzam gling spyi yongs la 'gyur ba mang po gcig 'gro gi yod pa dang / 'dzam gling shar nub kyi 'brel ba yag tu 'gro gi yod pa red/ lhag don dmar po'i rgyal khab mang po zhig nang 'gyur ba shin tu chen po 'gro bzhin pa red/ rgya nag gzhung gi bsam blo gu yang tsam zhig gtong gi med pa yin na/ ngas sngon ma gros 'char bton pa de'i thog la nga tshos bskyar du bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig chags yod/ nga tshos bsam blo gang 'dra zhig btang kyang btang chog chog red/ de nga tshor thob thang yod pa zhig red/ gnas tshul de gsal bshad byas na bsam pa byung /mi'i spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro ba la mang gtso gal chenapo yin/ mang gtso ༄ra ba de mgom med mjug med kyi skad cha min/ mang gatsho'i dgos don spyi 'bangs yongs rdzogs la khe phanayod pa zhig dang / spyi 'bangasayongs rdzogs 616

la 'gan khur yod pa zhig byung ba yin na/ spyi 'bangs mi re ngo re'i cha nas yar rgyas dang / gsar gtod kyi bsam blo dang nus pa 'don thub kyi yod pa red/ de ni deng sang mang gtso dang rang dbang yod pa'i lung pa'i nang la yar rgyas shugs che ba 'gro gi yod pa dang / mang gtso rang dbang med pa'i lung pa'i nang la mi'i nus pa 'don ma thub pa lta bus yar rgyas 'gro mi thub pa gsal por mtshon gyi yod/ nga rang chog nad mi rigs la cha bzhag na/ ma 'ongs pa la mang gtso yang dag pa zhig gi lam la 'gro dgos pa las/ lam gzhan dag gang yang med/ nga tsho yar rgyas shig 'dod phyin chad la lam de rang brgyud nas 'gro dgos pa ni chos nyid kyi 'gro stangs chags yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs kyang mang gtso'i lam phyogs dang mthun pa zhig red/dper na/ dam chos 'dul ba'i nang la dge 'dun gyi sgor dge slong bzhi gra yan chad cesags pa'i thog nas thag gcod byed pa ma gtogs/ mkhan po yin zhes mi gcig gis thag gcod byed mi chog bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyi khrims tshang ma dge 'dun tshogs pa'i steng nas thag gcod byed rgyu ma gtogs/ dge slong gcig gis thag gcod pa'i thob thang gnang yod pa ma red/ de ni mang gtso'i nang don dang mthun pa zhig red/ nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang mthun pa zhig dang / dngos yod gnas tshul la dgos mkho yod pa zhig yin pas na/ nga tsho mang gtso'i lam la 'gro rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po red/ nga tsho mang gatsho'i lam la 'gro dgos bshad de ngas 'go 'khrid nas bsdad na yag po med/ sems shugs chag pa dang / ngas rgyab bshig byas 617

pa rtsa ba nas min/ ngas da lta bar du gang yong ci yong byas pa yin/ da dung yang ma shi bar du bod mi mang la zhabs 'degs bsgrub rgyu las la bsgos pa zhig yin pas/ de nges par du byed kyi red/ yin na yang da lta skabs su babs pa nga tsho mi rigs shig gi don dag chen po zhig bsgrub dgos pa 'di mi thog nas mi thog go rim sgrig dgos pa ma gtogs/ 'phral sel mi thog gcig gi don dag min/ ma 'ongs par bod nang mang gtso'i lag len cha tshang ba zhig dang /nyams myong phun sum tshogs po zhig yong thabs dus yun thung ngu'i nang nges par du byed dgos par brten/ nga tsho btsan byol ba byas nas sdod pa'i ring la mang gtso'i 'gro stangs sgo gang sa nas tshad tshad bsdur bsdur gyis lag len byas pa dang / nye ba'i char mang gtso'i ngo bo shugs che ru gtong rgyu'i thabs shes byas dang byed mus red/ phyin chad bod la mang gtso yag po zhig yong ba la gtso che shos bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams la 'gan chen po 'khri yod/ da lta rgya mi'i las khungs yas mas nang yod pa'i bod rigs las byed pa de tsho ga tshad mi 'dug zer na yang nyams myong gang la gang 'tshams bsags yod pa dang / so sos las ka byed pa'i 'gan khur yang gang la gang 'tshams spyad myong ba yin dus/ khong tsho ha cang gal chen po red/ rgya mi'i las khungs nang la dngos su las ka byed mkhan/ bod rigs las byed gtso bor gyur pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams la ma 'ongs bod nang mang gtso'i ngo bo cha tshang ba yag po zhig yong ba'i don du dmigs bsal gyi 'gan 'khri yod pa de shes dgos pa yin/618

nga tsho mang gtso'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i btsan byol gzhung zhig btsugs nas da lta bar spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod par brten nga tshor grub 'bras gang la gang 'tshams thob yod/ shes skurdzon skor dang / gzhis chags khag gi dpal 'byor gnas stangs/ chos dang rig gzhung gi las don/ 'dzam bu gling spyi yongs dang gzhung phan tshun/ tshogs pa 'dra mi 'dra la 'brel ba byed rgyu sogs las don mang po zhig gi thog la nga tshor spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa'i rkyen gyis phan 'bras gang 'tshams thon yod pa dang / 7rgyal ba rin po che'i ming gi cha nas phan thogs nges can zhig byung sku da kyang de gcig pu rtsa ba nas min/spyir btang gzhung gang zhig yin rung / las byed pa 'dra mi 'dra'i thog nas mang tshogs nang mthong tshul mi legs pa dang / des rkyen mang tshogs kyi yid ches brlag pa de 'dra yul phyogs gang du yang yong mus ltar/ nga rang tsho ༷ped btsan byol gzhung la yang skabs re mi mang nang la blo shas yong ba dang / dogs pa byed dgos pa 'dra po yong srid pa dang / bod nang nas kyang btsan byol bod gzhung la yid ches byed rgyu yod pa ma red zer mkhan yod tshod 'dug de tsho nor 'khrul red/ nga tshor btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'di bod rgya che'i mi mang gi khe phan gyi don du rtsa ba chen po yin pas/ btsan byol bod gzhung 'di la yid ches byas/ 'di la rgyab skyor byed dgos/ 'di'i las ka byed mkhan mi bye brag pa'i ngos nas ma 'grigs pa dang / yang sgrig 'dzugs 'gro stangs kyi lam srol thog la ma 'grigs pa de 'dra yod na de tsho nges par du sgyur bcos btang chog gi red/ sgyur bcos gtong bzhin gtong bzhin spus 619

ka dag tu dag tu 'gro ba chos nyid yin dus nges par du yar rgyas gtong thub kyi red/ yang las ka byed stangs gcig gi thog nas ma 'grigs pa'am/ yang na las ka byed mkhan mi bye brag pa gcig gis ma 'grigs pa'i gnas tshul thon skabs bod btsan byol gzhung gis 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces bshad na nor ba red/ de la skyon yod pa red/ gnad don de shes dgos pa red/de bzhin bod nang rgya mi'i las khungs nang gi las byed pa tshang mar mthong phyogs byed mi rung / rgya mi'i ngos nas 'thab phyogs gcig gyur zhes shod kyi yod pa ltar/ nga rang chos kyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ ngas phal cher tshod thig gi 'dug nga rang tsho bod mi rtsam zan zhig yin phyin chad la sems kyi gting der nga bod pa yin bsam pa'i bsam blo med pa mi 'bum phrag nang gcig gnyis tsam las yod mi srid/ bod chol kha gsum gyi sa khul mang 16) nang da phan rgya mi'i las ka byed mkhan tang yon byas nas lo mang po phyin pa/ nye ba'i char spyi bde'i las byed yin pa/ bod pa 'dzin bzung byed mkhan dang / bod mir nyes brdung gtong mkhan/ de min sems kyi nang la mi rigs kyi lta ba dang bag chags sad pa lta bu'i rgya mi'i las byed gnad yod de 'dra'i bsam tshul shes rtogs byung bar gzhigs na/ khong tsho phyi rgyar rgya mi'i las khungs nang gi las byed pa yin na yang / bsam blo'i gting der bod pa yin bsam pa'i bsam blo shugs che ru che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ kha shas ni sngon ma nas ngo shes pa'i gung khran tang yon rgas po de 'dra yang gang 'tshams yod/ khong tsho'i gras bar skabs bod mi rigs kyi zhen khog 620

dang / bod mi rigs kyi lta ba shugs chen po yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis mang po zhig btson 'jug byas pa dang / nyes chad phog pasang byung yod/ khong tsho'i gras la bod mi rigs kyi lta ba bsam blo'i nang thub tu med par gnas yod/ de min nyams myong mang po ma thob pa'i gzhon skyes tsho'i bsam blor yang 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod pa red/ don snying rgya mi'i las khungs nang las ka byed mkhan bod rigs tsho'i sems kyi gting la mi rigs kyi lhag bsam dang / mi rigs kyi zhen khog tan tan yod pa red/ gnas tshul de yang gsal po shes dgos pa red/ nga rang tsho tshang mas spyi'i la rgya bzung nas chig bsgril byed rgyu de gal chen po red/khyed rang tsho mang po zhig gra sa khag la phyin te slob gnyer byed mkhan yin pa red/ da lta phan chad khyon che thag choda'abyor yod/ khong tsho tshang ma ris su ma chad pa'i chos sde khag nang la bslab pa slob gnyer hur thag 'bad thag byed kyi yod pa red/ khong tsho rgya gar nang slebs nas lo lnga drug bdun brgyad ma gtogs ma phyin yang deng sang dpe cha cung drag pa'i gras la slebs yong gi yod/ khyed rang tsho gsar pa 'byor pa rnams kyang ris su ma chad pa'i chos sde khag nang slob sbyong hur thag 'bad thag byed dgos/yang khag gcig bod nang rgya mi'i gdug rtsub kyi 'og la skyid med sdug zad chags nas spro thung thung / lam seng rgyag res rgyab chog chog de 'dra yang kha shas yong gi 'dug de 'dra yong srid pa red/ bod pa nang tshags la rgyag res rgyag dgos don med/ yang rigs kha shas klad med lta bu rgya mi'i 'khris 621

la zhum bu 'dra po byas nas bsdad/ bod pa nang tshags nang pho sgod mdog byed mkhan de 'dra yod na jab chung red/ de 'dra byed mi rung / dpa' blo khog yod na rgya mi'i 'khris la ngoms dgos/ bod pa nang khul la mthong chung byed mkhan de 'dra gal srid yod pa yin na zhabs 'dren ma gtogs/ yag po gang yang ma red/ bod mi nang khul mthun po byas/ snyoms chung byed dgos/ gnam gshis tsha grang 'gyur ba dang bstun nas 'phrod bsten byed lha'i thog gzab gzab byed dgos/ phran bu gzugs po ma bde ba yong dus lam seng sman bcos byed pa las lhod yangs byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ khyed rang tsho'i nang sbir slob gra la 'gro mkhan de 'dra kha shas yod pa red/ sbir slob gra 'di bar lam dza drag gi gnas tshul 'og nas btsugs pa'i slob gra zhig red/ gang ci'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms po med na yang / slob sbyong byed sa zhig yod pa red/ rim pas rim pas tshags tshud du dang / spas dag tu 'gro gi red/ de min bod la log 'gro mkhan khag gcig yod pa re|/ khyed rang tshos ngas da gin lab pa de tsho sems la nges pa byas/ so so'i lung par mi gzhan gyis dbang sgyur byed pa'i rkyen gyis dngangs skrags byas nas sdod dgos pa sems skyo po red/ 'on kyang nga rang tsho'i rtsa ba'i stobs shugs de bod nang la yod pa red/ bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang gis da lta bar du sems shugs ma chag par bsdad pa de mu mthud nas rgyun 'dzin byed dgos/ ma 'ongs pa la bod yar rgyas zer ba de bod nang la gtong dgos par brten/ khyed rang tsho rang yul la log mkhan tshor las 'gan chen po yod/ nga tsho byes la sdod mkhan tshos kyang bod spyi pa'i don dag 622

bsgrub rgyu'i 'gan 'khyer nas bsdad yod/ tshang mas hur thag 'bad thag byed dgos/bal bod sa mtshams 'gram dang / sle mi sogs la sdod mkhan slebs yod pa 'dra/ bod nas tshur dza drag gi gnas tshul 'og nas bros yong mkhan de chos skad mi shes pa dang / lam yang shes kyi ma red/ dngangs skrags dang dza drag gi 'og nas tshurayong dus sa mtshams la sdod mkhan yul pa chos phyogs gcig nas mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / gnyis nas chos dang rig gzhung gcig gyur gyi la rgya'i 'og nas phan grogs dang 'go 'don 'tsho skyong byed mkhan mang po byung 'dugabod nas bros yong mkhan tshos zer gyi 'dug de tsho dngos gnas drin chen po red/ dza drag dang nyen ka yod pa'i gnas tshul 'og la rogs byed pa de nad thog sman 'khel gyi bya ba red/ ha cang yag po red/ bod mi rigs spyi'i la rgya'i thog nas zhabs 'degs chen po bsgrubs pa dang / chos kyi thog nas bshad pa yin na bsod nams chen po gsog pa'i las ka red/ mi srog skyabs pa'am/ 'jigs pa las skyabs pa de tsho'i gras mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa yin pas phan yon chen po yod/ 'ga' zhig nas da phan bod mir rogs ram byed myong med na yang / ma 'ongs par de 'dra byed rgyu'i go skabs yong gi red la/ lhag par da lta bar du byed mkhan de tsho'i gras la ngas thugs rje che zer rgyu yin/ ma 'ongs pa la yang sngar bzhin du rogs ram byed rogs byed/ sa mtshams la sdod mkhan tshos kha yod lag yod kyi rogs ram byed thub pa de rtsa ba chen po red/ bka' drin chen po red/ bod lung par sangs 623

rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / dngos gnas bde skyid ldan pa zhig byung ba yin na hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi sa khul yongs rdzogs la khe phan chen po yong rgyu chos nyid red/ bod lung par gnas tshul thabs skyo po zhig yong dus sa mtshams yongs rdzogs la'ang 'gyur ba dang / dka' ngal 'phrad kyi yod pa red/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud/ bod kyi sa 'dres yin pa'i mi tshang mas bod spyi'i bde ba bsgrub thabs byed rgyu de khyed rang tsho'i bde sdug thog la'ang 'brel ba chen po yod pa zhig red/ nga rang tsho thun mong gi khe phan dang / thun mong gi las 'gan thog la tshang mas da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red/ da dung yang hur thag byed rogs byed zer rgyu yin/bod nang sa khul kha shas la sger pa'i slob gra de 'dra kha shas btsugs yod sa red/ a mdo khul la'ang gcig gnyis shig yod pa'i gnas tshul 'dug sa khul 'ga' shas la nyin gang min na yang / snga dgong las zhor nang mi la slob sbyong sprod rgyu de 'dra byed mkhan kha shas yod tshod 'dug de tsho ha cang rtsa ba chen po red/ spyir btang mang tshogs nas kyang de 'dra'i thog la rgyab skyor dang / de tsho'i gras la dpal 'byor gyi mthun rkyen sogs mthun 'gyur rogs ram nges par du byed dgos/ spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro ba la shes yon dang / 'phrod bsten sogs gal chen po red/ skabs re 'ga' shas nas bya ba de tsho chos ldan gyi bya ba min pa lta bur rtsis nas snang med byed kyi 'dugade 'dra ma red/ mi'i shes yon yar rgyas 'gro thabs dang / 'phrod bsten gyi las ka 'di tsho chos ldan gyi bya ba rlabs chen po red/ yang so sor shes yon 624

rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / dngos gnas bde skyid ldan pa zhig byung ba yin na hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi sa khul yongs rdzogs la khe phan chen po yong rgyu chos nyid red/ bod lung par gnas tshul thabs skyo po zhig yong dus sa mtshams yongs rdzogs la'ang 'gyur ba dang / dka' ngal 'phrad kyi yod pa red/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud/ bod kyi sa 'dres yin pa'i mi tshang mas bod spyi'i bde ba bsgrub thabs byed rgyu de khyed rang tsho'i bde sdug thog la'ang 'brel ba chen po yod pa zhig red/ nga rang tsho thun mong gi khe phan dang / thun mong gi las 'gan thog la tshang mas da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red/ da dung yang hur thag byed rogs byed zer rgyu yin/bod nang sa khul kha shas la sger pa'i slob gra de 'dra kha shas btsugs yod sa red/ a mdo khul la'ang gcig gnyis shig yod pa'i gnas tshul 'dug sa khul 'ga' shas la nyin gang min na yang / snga dgong las zhor nang mi la slob sbyong sprod rgyu de 'dra byed mkhan kha shas yod tshod 'dug de tsho ha cang rtsa ba chen po red/ spyir btang mang tshogs nas kyang de 'dra'i thog la rgyab skyor dang / de tsho'i gras la dpal 'byor gyi mthun rkyen sogs mthun 'gyur rogs ram nges par du byed dgos/ spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro ba la shes yon dang / 'phrod bsten sogs gal chen po red/ skabs re 'ga' shas nas bya ba de tsho chos ldan gyi bya ba min pa lta bur rtsis nas snang med byed kyi 'dugade 'dra ma red/ mi'i shes yon yar rgyas 'gro thabs dang / 'phrod bsten gyi las ka 'di tsho chos ldan gyi bya ba rlabs chen po red/ yang so sor shes yon 624

phran bu yod pa'i jog nas mang tshogs kyi bu phrug la skad yig slob pa dang / yang las rigs gzhan dag nang slob sbyong sprod thub pa'i cha rkyen yod pa yin na de 'dra'i thog nas zhabs 'degs zhu thub pa byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ phan thogs chen po yong gi red/kha sngon dbu ma rin chen phreng ba 'khrid skabs la'ang skad cha byung ba ltar/bar skabs lha sa khul la chang ma mang 11 chags/ gcig byas na rgya mis kyang phugs rgyang ring wa'i sems gnag de 'dra ma 'dres pa'i nges pa yod pa ma red/de 'dra yin min gang ltar yang / chang 'thung bag yangs byed mkhan ha cang mang po zhig yong gi yod sa red/ sngon ma nas thengs 'ga' shas lab pa yin la/ da nyin nga rang tsho 'dir 'dzoms pa'i skabs 'dir ngas yang skyar lab 'dod byung / gnas tshul de ni yag po gtan nas min/ 'phral sel gyi las ka 'thus shor rgyu/ rtsa ba'i mi kho rang yang rim pas sprang po khrims med chags nas mi tshe 'phro brlag tu 'gro ba'i nyen ka yod pa red/ chang 'thung bag med ngang mi tshe don med chud zos gtong ba 'di nam yang byed rgyu mi 'dug chang 'thung bag med byed mkhan de tsho'i gras kyang mi rigs kyi thob thang la zhen khog shugs chen yod pa mang po zhig 'dug rgya mi la sems kyi gting nas mi dga' ba'i dbang gis rgya mi'i las ka gang yin rung byed 'dod med pa zhig chags/de 'dra'i sems nad kyis chang 'thung ba dang / 'khyams nyul byed pa la khag lta mi 'dug snying rje/ yin na yang byed stangs de 'dra byas pa yin na so sor gyong phog rgyu las/ khe phan gang yang med/ gnas skabs shig rgya mi'i las 625

ka byas pa yin na des phyags rgyang ring wa'i cha nas nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi 'dzugs bskrun bya gzhag la nyams myong dang phan thogs yong gi red/ dgag cha dgos pa'i cha nas bsam blo gtong dgos/ gang ltar yang snying chang 'thung bag med byed pa 'di rigs spyi sgor 'phral phugs gang thad nas gnod skyon chen po yod pa zhig yin pas/ khyed rang tsho sems la nges pa byas te ngas nan po byas nas zer gyi 'dug ces lan bskyel dgos/ de gal chen po 'dugayang bod nas bros yong mkhan kha shas kyi ca dngos yongs rdzogs 'phrog song zhes dka' ngal dmigs bsal can 'phrad pa de 'dra yong gi 'dug snying rje de tsho'i gras la 'phrog bcom mi yong ba'i thabs shes 'go 'don 'cho skyong lta bu ga tshad thub thub tshang mas byed thub pa zhig byung na gal chen po 'dug ngas da shin lab pa bzhin spyir btang nga tsho bod mi rigs 'di dngos gnas rlabs chen gyi mi rigs shig yin/ da lta'i char bod mi mi re ngo re'i mjing pa'i snang la rdog khres re 'khrid yod pas tshang mas hur thag byed dgos pa las/ nga cho bod pa spyi'i zhabs 'dren ma zhus pa byed dgos/ thugs rje che/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes dang /yang / da res bal yul nas ched mngags dbang chen la 'byor pa skya ser rnams la da lta zur du thug nas skad cha bshad rgyu'i go skabs byung ba la dga' po byung / bal po sa 'dres yin pa tsam du ma zad/ chos dang / rig gzhung / dpal 'byor gang ci'i thog nas 'brel ba ha cang chen po yod pas pha ma phu nu lta bu'i mdza' grogs kyi 'brel ba yod pa red/626

dper na/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi bzo bkod de tsho'i gras bal wa'i bzo pa lag rtsal mkhas can chos bskrun pa'i dmigs bsal khyad chos yod pa red/ de bzhin bod pa'i ri mo'i nang la yang bal bris zhes ha cang mthong chen po brtsi gi yod pa red/ de tsho'i thog nas lo rgyus kyi nang bal bod gnyis ha cang 'brel thag nye po yod pa'i rtags bstan gyi yod pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos gtso che shos rgya gar nas byung ba yin na yang / bod la 'dzul sa de bal yul brgyud nas yong gi yod par brten/ chos kyi thog la'ang 'brel ba ha cang chen po yod pa red/ bar lam nga tsho bod lung par rkyen ngan byung nas bod pa mang po zhig btsan byol du gyar ba'i skabs la'ang bal yul nang bod pa stong phrag mang po zhig gnas sdod byas yod pa red/ phran bu phran bu'i dka' ngal yong gi red de/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas bal yul lung pa skyo po yin na yang bod pa'i thog la bka' drin ha cang chen po yin/ nga tshos rtag tu bka' drin dran gyi yod/ da lam bal yul nas yong pa'i nga tsho'i chos grogs mang po zhig thug 'phrad byung ba'i skabs 'dir/ nga tsho sngar nas da bar 'brel ba chen po yod pa'i gnas tshul dran pa'i thog nas ngas khyed rang sto la 'tshams 'dri dang / khyed rang tsho bal yul rgyal khab dang / spyi 'bangs tshang ma ma 'ongs par bde skyid ldan pa'i yag po zhig yong thub par ngas smon lam 'debs kyi yod/'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la dus rabs nyi shu pa 'di'i nang nyams myong mang po zhig byung yod pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis mi tsho'i bsam blo zab tu dang /627

rgya che ru phyin nas deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la zhi bde dang / rang dbang mang gtso bcas gzhi nas yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro bzhin pa red /'dzam bu gling spyi yongs la 'gyur ba phyin pa dang chabs cig bar lam bal yul nang la yang mang gtso'i 'gyur ba chen po byung yod pa red/ lo rgyus kyi thog nas nga tsho chos grogs yin pa'i nang pa'i dge slong zhig gi ngos nas khyed rang tsho la bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ mang gtso la brten nas mi mi re ngo re la thob thang dmigs bsal zhig yong gi yod pa dang / thob thang de dang mnyam du 'gan khur zhig kyang slebs kyi yod pa red/ grogs po rnam pa tshos thob thang dang / 'gan gnyis ka yag po zhig spyod thub pa la ngas re ba rgyag gi yod/ da gin khong gis nga bal yul la gcig yong thub na zhes ngag thog nas gsungs pa ltar/ da lta yi ge'i nang du'ang bal yul la yong nas chos 'brel byed rgyu sogs 'khod 'dug pas dga' po byung / thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ nga la lung gi yon tan dang / rtogs pa'i yon tan yod pa gang yang min rung / bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs dge slong zhig yin/ theg pa chen wa'i chos kyis sems can thams cad la phan pa'i bsam pa bskyed dgos pa la rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i sgo nas so sos yid ches dang mos pa byas/ nyams len gang thub byed kyi yod/ bal yul nang la nang pa'i chos tshogs mang po zhig yod pa de tsho'i thog la ngas zhabs 'degs dang phan thogs phran bu byed thub na/ nga rang bsod nams gsog rgyu'i gzhi gcig yin pa red/ bal yul nang la yod pa'i sems can spyi/ yang sgos mi/ de'i nang tshan nas nang pa'i chos grogs tsho la ngas phan thogs bsgrub thub pa zhig yod 628

na ngas dga' zhing spro bzhin zhu gi yin/khyed rang sto da res bka' chos sar yod stabs mang po zhig go yod pa red/ chos zer ba 'di so mo'i lag len la bkal thub pa yin na mig gis mthong rgyu dang / dngos su nyams myong gi thog nas khe phan zhig yong gi red/chos lag len bkal ma thub na bsod nams gsog gi red ces zer rgyu tsam las/ so so ra dngos su nyams myong tshor snang yong rgyu khag po red/ da res dus tsho da med pas mjal kha byed thub pa mi 'dug la/ dgos pa yang med/sngar bod la nam rgyun snyoms chung byas nas bzhugs mkhan zhig yod pa red/de la chos pa gzhan dag gcig gis de'i yon tan mthong nas bka' chos shig gnang rogs gnang zhes zhus par bla ma snyoms chung des ngas de 'dra khyon nas yong gi ma red ces gsungs pa red/ chos 'brel zhu mkhan des mtha' ma chos 'brel rgya chen po ma byung na yang / byin rlabs tsam zhig byung na de gas 'grig cesatwa tshugs byas nas zhus pa red/ des don gnyer chen po byas par brten bla ma des ngas byin rlabs byed dgos byung na sdug bden yin pa'i lag pa mi'i mthos la bzhag nas byin rlabs byed mkhan zhig min/ sems rgyud la gnas lugs ngo sprod byas nas rtogs pa rgyud sprod byed mkhan gyi bla ma zhig yin gsungs pa'i lo rgyus yod pa ltar/ nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i byin rlabs zer ba 'di so so rang nyid kyi sems la bsgyur bcos btang nas sems rgyud yar rgyas 'gro thub pa byung na de'i thog nas byin rlabs yong gi red/ byin ni gzi byin dang / rlabs ni bzang por bsgyur ba'i don yin pas/ nga rang tsho'i sems 629

ma dag pa nyon mongs dug gsum yod pa'i sems ma dul ba 'di bsgyur bcos btang nas dul ba dang / skyon med pa zhig bzo thub tshe de la byin zlobs zer ba yin/ phyag dbang mgo la bzhag nas byin rlabs de tsam thob rgyu khag po red/khyed rang tshor byin rten ma ṇi ril bu shog chag bdun stong tham pa dang / bdud rtsi chos sman shog chag gsum stong / srung mdud grangs chig khri tham pa yod /'di dag khyed rang tsho bgo bsha' rgyab/ da res gnas chen 'oder nga tsho 'dzoms pa'i dran rten lta bur sems nang nges dgos pa de gang yin zer na/ ngas kha seng 'go stod nas lab pa bzhin/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lta ba rten 'byung dang / spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa'i spyod pa gnyis ma brjed pa byed dgos/ rab la sems can gzhan dag la phan btags dgos pa dang / gal te phan btags ma thub na yang gnod pa ma byed pa 'di 'tshe ba med pa'i don dag ngo ma de yin pa red/ gzhan la phan 'dogs byed stangs la mtshon na spyi tshogs kyi zhabs 'degs/ nad pa'i zhabs 'degs/ shes skusgon gyi lngardzog nas mi'i shes tshad yar rgyas gtong rgyu/ lung pa 'dzugs bskrun gyi las don/ yang chos phyogs na sa blang dor gyi gnas ston rgyu dang / dpe cha rtsom bris/ dpe cha par bskrun byed pa/ bsam blo chab srid kyi phyogs lhung ma yin par mi la legs nyes 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod gong 'phel 'gro thabs la gsar shog spel 'grems byed pa sogs 'di cho1) gras spyi tshogs zhabs 'degs yin pas/ gzhan la phan pa bsgrub pa'i don dag 'di tsho tshang mar go thub kyi yod pa red/ dper na/ sems can rta drel ba glang dang / ra lug nad pa/ rkang lag skyon can de tshor lta rtogs 630

phan grogs byed pa/ skam gsher la gnas pa'i sems can rigs la skabs bstun phan bde bsgrub rgyu sogs la rgyun du do snang byed dgos/ gal srid phan bde sgrub ma thub na yang / gnod pa mi byed pa de rtsa ba yin/ da res wa ra ṇa si la phyin nas gnad don gsar pa 'di dag shes byung bsam pa byed dgos/'dir dge 'dun pa de 'dra gang 'tshams phebs 'dug bal yul nang dgon pa gsar bzhengs byed mkhan gyi de 'dra'i thog nas gra rgyas po yod sa red/ yin na yang gtso bo dgon pa'i nang la yod pa'i gra btsun rnams spas dag po byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug gtsug lag khang yag po yod pa re'i nang sdod mkhan sngags 'chang ngam/ rab byung pho mo gang yin rung / spus dag po byed dgos/ phyi'i cha lugs dang / skra bzhar stangs/ spyod lam sogs tshul mthun med par skya min ser min lta bu byas na yag po med/ phyi'i spyod lam bzang po byed pa dang chabs cig nang pa'i chos slob sbyong byas nas nang pa'i chos kyi gnad don shes pa byed rgyu de yang shin tu gal chen po red/ ngas sgrung zhig bshad kyi yin/ snga mo bod du gra pa bgres song gcig dang / nye skor na gra chung dpe cha phar phyin blta mkhan zhig yod pa red/ skabs shig gra pa bgres song de la gra chung des rgan lags nga bka' 'dri zhig zhu rgyu yod zhus par/ bgres song des ga re dris rgyu yod gsungs pa red/ gra chung des/ nga tsho rnam rtog dwogs pa za ba 'di gang byas pa yin nam zhes dris par/ bgres song des rnam rtog sbyongs/ rnam rtog sbyongs zhes lab nas phyin pa red/ don snying bgres song des gang yang shes kyi med pa red/ yang ngas sgrung gzhan zhig bshad na/631

de gong dha ram sa lar ngas ngo shes pa'i nyi 'ong gi mi zhig yod/ khong gis nam rgyun dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i skor mang po bshad kyi red/ kho rang slob dpon legs ldan gyi gzhung la mos pa yod mkhan zhig dang / slob dpon legs ldan gyi rtog ge 'bar ba dang / 'grel pa shes rab le'u de tsho'i gras la rgyus yod chen po yod pa zhig red/ khong tshar gcig dha ram sa lar yong pa'i skabs su mo kra'i babs tshugs su gra pa zhig thug 'phrad byung bar khong gis dbu ma rang rgyud pa dang / thal 'gyur ba gnyis la lta ba'i khyad par gang yod dam/ nga dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i mi yin/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lta ba yag gi red ces bshad par gra pa des gang yang zer gyi mi 'dug ces bshad byung / gang ltar gra btsun tshos dpe cha ma shes na skyon chen po yod/ snga 31 bshad srol sku(nga / mi gcig la dkon mchog gang du yod dris par/ nam mkhar mdzub mo btsugs te ya gi na yod zhes bshad pa'i lo rgyus yong gi 'dug nga tshos nang pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs yag po zhig ma shes na gtan nas mi 'grigs pas/ chos kyi slob sbyong byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po 'dug yo rgan gzhon dang skya btsun gyi khyad par gang yang med/ gang ltar nang pa'i chos la yid ches yod pa dang / nang pa yin bsam pa byed mkhan su yin na yang nang pa'i cesas kyi rnam gzhag gang 'dra gang 'dra yin pa de slob sbyong byas te shes thub pa byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ lhag par du deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la phyi dngos po nu /ra rgyas chen po 'gro gi yod pa dang / phyi dngos po yar rgyas deyang tshan rig dang / rdzas bsgyur gyi thog nas 'gro gi yod pa red/ tshan rig gi thog nas brtag dpyad 632

rim pa byas te phyi dngos wa'i gnas lugs mig mthong lag zin gyi ra sprod dang /'grel bshad rgyag gi yod/ chos kyi thog nas thad gar mig mthong lag zin zhig med na yang / chos spyi dang / lhag par nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog la mi'i rnam dpyod bed spyod byas te rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas 'grel bshad byed thub pa zhig yod pa red/ dper na/ tshan rig dang / 'phrul chas yar rgyas ji ltar phyin na yang sems kyi gnas lugs dang / sems kyi ngo bo gang 'dra yin pa 'phrul 'khor gyis brtag dpyad byas nas bshad thub kyi yod pa ma red/ chos kyi thog nas rgyu mtshan la brten nas so mo'i sems nang nges pa rnyed thub pa zhig dang / rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i sgo nas yid ches byed thub pa zhig yong gi yod pa red/ de byung ba yin na dad pa de yang spus dag po dang / chos de yang spas dag po chags yong gi red/ de 'dra med na ha lam rmongs dad 'dra po zlogs nyen yod/ cho sa kho rang rmongs dad kyi rang bzhin can min na yang / so sos chos de ma shes/ rgyu mtshan ma mthong ba'i dbang gis sngar gyi lugs srol 'dra por 'gyur nyen yod/ pha mas chos byed pa ltar bu tshos kyang lad zlos byas pa lta bur bsdad pa yin na/ deng sang dngos po yar rgyas chen po phyin pa'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas skabs re chos la the tshom skye ba de 'dra yong srid kyi red/ spyir btang shes yon sna tshogs yar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang nyid nang chos kyi gnas lugs shes thub pa dang / chos kyi ro myong thub pa/ 'grel bshad byed shes pa gcig byung ba yin na nyen ka gang yang med pas ma tshad/ da dung gcig phan gcig grogs lta bu yong thub kyi red/ yang 633

ngas lo rgyus shig bshad na/ ngas hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul gang sar phyin stabs/ sa gnas gcig la ngas ngo shes pa'i chos pa gcig yod/ khong nang pa'i chos pa ma red/ khong bgres song yag po zhig 'dug nga gnyis chos kyi skor la skad cha byung / khong gis 'khor lo'i 'gro lam bzo rgyu 'di chos la gnod tshabs chen po 'dug 'khor lam bzos rjes lung pa'i nang la khra khra zing zing mang du phyin/ mi yang phar tshur 'grims 'grul mang du phyin/ gnas tshul 'dra mi 'dra mang po mthong ba'i rjes la chos dad chung du chung du 'gro gi 'dug ces bshad byung / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos pa ngo ma zhig yong ba la chos kyi gnas tshul dang / deng dus kyi gnas tshul cha tshang shes pa zhig dgos kyi yod pas slob sbyong byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ de khyed rang tshang ma'i sems la nges pa byas/ hur thag byed rogs/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' sding5// //634

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1991 zla 7 tshes 12 nyin/ u ru su'i rgyal sa mo se kor mi mang chig stong brgal ba'i mang tshogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/chos grogs rnam pa lhan rgyas la zhu rgyur/ de ring 'dir bka' mol zhu rgyu'i go skabs byung bar ha cang dga' po byung / gra sgrig byed mkhan tshang mar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ dus yun ring po zhig dka' ngal 'og bsdad nas nyams su myong mkhan gyi nga tsho'i grogs po tsho dang de ring 'dir 'phrad nas dngos gnas rang mi'i sems nang ga re yod pa dang / rang rang so so'i bsam blo ga re yod pa de thad kur bshad rgyu'i go skabs yod pa'i dus tshod 'di 'dra zhig byung ba 'di shin tu rtsa ba chen po yin pas/ nga rang dmigs bsal gyi dga' po byung / ngas dus rgyun du rang dbang zer ba deyar rgyas dang bde skyid kyi gzhi rtsayin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ gzhi rtsa'i rang dbang de byung ba yin na mi'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gsar gtod byed rgyu'i go skabs rnyed kyi yod pa red/ dka' ngal gang 'udra zhig dang 'phrad pa yin rung mi'i rnam dpyod bed spyod byed rgyu'i go skabs byung ba yin na dka' ngal de sel thub pa ha lam thag bcad nas lab thub kyi red/de ring 'dir ngas gleng mol zhu rgyu de zhi bde dang / sems shugs/ re ba zhes pa'i thog nas zhu gi yod/ ngas da lta 'dir bka' mol zhu ba'i skabs la nga rang ngos nas cha bzhag na'ang nga mi gcig yin pa'i 'du shes kyi thog nas zhu gi yin/ nga bod nas yong ba dang / nang pa yin pa dang / de 'dra'i khyad par de phar bzhag nas spyir btang gi mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas zhu gi yod/ khyed rang tsho nyan mkhan snu'i ngos nas yin na'ang nga rang tsho spyir btang gi mi dang mi'i 635

dbar skad cha bshad kyi yod pa'i 'du shes kyi thog nas nyan pa yin na nga rang tsho gcig gis gcig la bsam blo 'khor rgyu las sla ba yod/ ngas da lta gleng mol zhu rgyu de skar ma sum cu skor dang / de nas dri ba dris lan bcas skar ma bzhi bcu lnga bcu skor gyi dus yun yod/gal che shos de nga rang tsho mi gcig chags nas bsdad yod/ mi'i mi tshe'i snying 1— de gang yin pa dang / mi'i mi tshe'i dgos don de gang yin pa der bsam blo zhig btang ba yin na/ nam rgyun nga'i yid ches la/ nga rang tsho mi'i srog 'tsho ba'i ring la rang la bde skyid gcig byung na bsam/ skyid pa gcig byung na bsam nas srog 'tsho gi yod/ nga rang tsho mi'i srog 'tsho ba'i dgos don bde skyid kyi rtsa ba dang / mi'i mi d+ku snying po bde skyid red zer gyi yod/ nga tshor bde skyid sgrub rgyu'i thob thang cha tshang yod la/ bde skyid dang ldan pa'i 'dzam gling zhig bzo rgyur thob thang cha tshang yod/ da lta ngas skad cha bshad rgyu'i brjod gzhi/ zhi bde dang / sems shugs/ re ba de gsum ni bde skyid sgrub pa'i gzhi rtsa'i cha rkyen khag yin/ bde skyid zer ba der nga tshos hob ste blta dus bsam lha'i nang ga re 'khor gyi yod zer na/ mthun rkyen yag po yod na bde skyid yong gi yod pa lta bu dang / dngul 'bel po yod na bde skyid yong ba 'dra po/ grogs ngo bzang po yod na bde skyid yong gi yod pa'i bzo 'dra po de 'dra'i bsam tshul gyi thog nas nga rang tsho'i bde skyid zer rgyu de phyi nas yong gi yod pa'i bzo 'dra po zhig blo la shar gyi yod/ ma gzhi phyi'i mthun rkyen de dag nga rang tsho'i bde skyid kyi 'byung khungs gcig yin pa red/ yin na'ang bde skyid yong ba'i rgyu'i gtso 636

bo de nang gi bsam blo'i bde skyid de yin/ nga rang chos mthar thug gi bde skyid yong ba'i thabs lam de nang nas btsal dgos pa las/ phyi nas btsal rgyu zhig min/ de yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni phyi rol gyi mthun rkyen bzang po cha tshang yod pa yin na'ang sems kyi nang la zhi bde med na mi der skyid po yong gi med/ sems kyi nang zhi bde yod pa yin na phyi rol gyi mthun rkyen cha tshang ba zhig med na yang mi des sems skyid po byas nas bsdad thub kyiyod/ bag phebs po byas nas bsdad thub kyi yod/ 'phrod bsten gyi thog nas bshad pa yin na'ang sems kyi zhi bde de lus po'i 'phrod bsten gyi cha rkyen gtso bo zhig yin/ sems kyi zhi bde yod pa yin na rang bzhin gyi lus kyi 'byung ba de dag cha snyoms dang / de 'dra'i thog nas 'phrod bsten la yang phan gyi yod/ sems kyi zhi bde brlag na/ sems ma skyid pa byas te sems la dngangs skrag dang / sems sbug srub dog wa de 'dra yong ba'i skabs la lus kyi 'byung ba cha ma snyoms par 'khrug dper na gnyid ma khug pa dang / lto chas dwang ga 'gag pa de 'dra'i thog nas so so'i gzugs po ྅ rwa1 chags yong gi yod/ des na 'tho bsten gyi skad cha bshad payin na'ang sems kyi zhi bde dang 'brel ba chen po yod/ nga rang tsho mi'i bde skyid kyi cha rkyen gcig spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro dgos pa yin/ spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro ba la spyi tshogs dam tshig mthun po dang / 'cham po de 'dra'i thog nas yong dgos/dngos gnas drang yinas kyi dam tshig mthun po dang 'cham po yong ba de sger so so'i sems kyi zhi bde dang 'brel ba yod/ de tsam du ma zad nga tsho mi sgor so sor bde skyidayong ba la nga rang tsho sdod sa'i gling 'di'i snang la zhi bde yod dgos 637

pa dang/ gling 'di'i sgang la khoraslig gtsang ma/ rlung gtsang ma/ chu gtsang ma sogs snod bcud kyi 'drel bar skyon med pa zhigayod dgos/ de tsho nga i bde skyid dang 'brel ba chags nas bsdadayod/ bde skyid kyi cha rkyen gtso bo nga mi sems kyi zhi bde dang 'brel ba yod pas sems kyi zhi bde de shin tu gal chen po yin/nga tshos sems kyi zhi bde gang 'dra byas nas bzo dgos zer na/ sems kyi zhi bde dkrug mkhan gyi 'gal rkyen che shos ni gnod 'tshe'i bsam blo dang /'khon 'dzin gyi bsam cho de yin/ de 'dra'i sems kyi zhi bde dkrug mkhan dang /sems kyi 'gal rkyen zhe sdang la sogs pa de rnams med par bzo rgyu'i thabs shes byed dgos/ de rnams shugs chung du gtong rgyu'i thabs shes byed dgos/ sems la sbyong bdar gyi thog nas sems la bzo bcos rgyag rgyu yod pa nges gtan yin/dper na nga tshos phyi rol gyi dngos po la zhib 'jug byas/ phyi rol gyi dngos yi rnam grangs mang po yode pa de rnams la dpyad pa byas te phan thogasayode pa rnams nga tshos bed spyod byed kyi yod/ de bzhin du nang sems zer ba 'di la cha bzhag na'ang / sems zer ba'i tshig gcig wa de'i 'og la don dag rnam grangs ha cang mang po yod/ sems kyi tshor ba 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig yod pa de rnams la nga tshos zhib 'jug zhib tshags po byas nas phan thogs yod pa de rnams yar rgyas btang / phan thogs med pa de rnams shugs chung du gtong rgyu de 'os shing 'tshams pa yin/ phyi rol gyi dngos po'i thog la blang dor byas pa bzhin/ nang sems kyi thog la yang brtag dpyad byas nas kha shas tshur blang dgos pa dang / kha shas phar dor dgos pa 'dra ba yin/ mi'i sems zer ba der brtag dpyad byas pa 638
